title: urubyiruko itorero erc giterane cy’ububyutse kiyobowe apostle joshua masasu

gishimwa n’imana kandi rugatumbira yesu kristo buzima bwabo buri munsi iki giterane gifite insanganyamatsiko igira iti boneza amaso imbere yawe ugumye uhatumbire kandi utunganye inzira z’ibirenge title: rusizi bambaye udupfukamunwa n’ubwo bamwe batarameya twambara neza
content: kuri kabiri tariki gicurasi urasanga isura nshya y’abantu bacaracara mihanda y’umurenge nyakabuye karere rusizi bambaye udupfukamunwa ukabona wagirango n’impuzankano bahuriyeho bamwe baturage batuye murenge baravuga bakiriye gahunda kwirinda bakoresheje agapfukamunwa bakavuga babyishimiye rwego kwirinda kurinda abandi rundi ruhande hari ababangamiwe kukambara kuko usanga ubwambere bagakoresheje ariko bazarushaho kubimenyera kuko ubundi umuti urura niwo ukiza indwara umwe bacuruzi bakorera centre nyakabuye witwa semana jervais wavuganye muhabura rw yabwiye umunyamakuru yaba umugurira kandi ugurisha bagomba kuba bambaye udupfukamunwa rwego kwirinda yagize atikwirinda biruta kwivuza ntabwo umuntu yabura kwirinda yambara agapfukamunwa kagura y’u rwanda ukabura amagara hejuru kwanga kubahoriza amabwiriza kwirinda kurinda abandi dutahirize umugozi umwe twirinda tunarinda abandi kandi icyorezo tuzagitsinda umusaza nsabimana w’imyaka mirongo irindwi waganiriye n’umunyamakuru aje kugura kurya isoko nyakabuye rirema buri kabiri buri gatandatu yavuze yabyakiriye neza ariko akomeje kugorwa kukambara yagize atinibyo rwose kwirinda byiza gusa njye kukambara byangoye buryo bugaragara kuko nikintu ntarimenyereyekuvuga birikunanira nkanavuga cyane nibwira turikuvugana atarikunyumva mukeshimana claudine umucuruzi centre nyakabuye avuga agapfukamunwa gafasha kwirinda icyirezo coronavirus nkuko yagiye abibona ahandi agasanga intambwe itewe n’akarere rusizi n’igihugu rusange yagize atino bushinwa usanga abantu benshi batwambaye rwego kwirinda kurinda abandi kandi ariho iko cyorezo covid- cyatangiriye uburyo bwiza kwirinda kurinda abandibravo leta y’ubumwe ku ruhande rwabacuruza udupfukamunwa bavuga ntacyo batakoze hamwe n’abafatanyabikorwa kugirango buri muturage wese abe yagura agapfukamunwa kamurinda kakanarinda n’abandi uhagarariye urugaga rw’abikorera murenge nyakabuye bwana ndayisabye emmanuel avugana muhabura yavuze urebye agapfukamunwa kari kugura amafaranga aringaniye buryo rwitazo uvuga hari uwakabuze yagize atiamafaranga magana atanu si menshinku buryo hari uwazana urwitwazo kutakambara agapfukamunwa avuga gahenzerwose dufatanye dukumire cyorezo kuko ingamba ikomeye kdi ihamye kucyirinda icyi cyemezo kwambura udupfukamunwa giherutse gufatirwa nama y’abaministiri yafataga imyanzuro gukomeza kwirinda icyorezo covid- ndetse kukirinda abandiaho bavuze kandi buri munyarwanda wese agomva kwambara agapfukamunwa rwego kwirinda icyorezo covid- ibi kandi birashimangirwa n’itangazo ryashyizweho umukono ministiri w’ubucuruzi madame nyirahakuziyaremye suraya ruburira abanyarwanda umubare wabagomba gukorera isoko bangaba kandi ahamya ugura ndetse n’umucuruzi bagomba gutanga service kuyihabwa bambaye agapfukamunwa hirindwa ikwirakwiza ry’icyo cyirezo gihangayikishije u rwanda n’isi rusange denis fabrice nsengumuremyimuhaburarw

title: akarere rubavu karishimira ibikorwa by’amajyambere kagezeho
content: mu bikorwa byamuritswe harimo umuhanda uhuza imipaka yombi y’u rwanda repubulika iharanira demokarasi kongo grande et petite barierre ukazatwara akayabo k’amafaranga akabakaba miliyoni ndetse n’ umuhanda pave ujya biro by’akarere watangiye gukorwa munsi umuyobozi w’akarere sheh bahame hassan yavuze akarere kabwiye rwiyemezamirimo imodoka zikora mihanda zitazasubirayo utugari tutazikoresheje dusane uduhanda tujya hasuwe kandi umusozi wimuweho imiryango kubera ikibazo cy’isuri yicaga abahatuye gihe cy’imvura uyu musozi murenge gisenyi guterwamo ibiti binyuranye bifata ubutaka hakazubakwamo uduhanda intebe n’ibitare kuruhukiramo mukerarugendo iki gikorwa kizatwara amafaranga miliyoni bavuye musozi ubuyobozi b’akarere rubavu bwasuye akagari karukogo umurenge rubavu birebera ibikorwa ndengera foundation uyu muryango wubatse amasoko y’amazi agemurira abaturage amazi meza ndetse n’ibitaro kijyambere umuyobozi w’akarere yasabye umuyobozi ndengera foundation gufatanya n’akarere bakareba masoko y’amazi yakwaguka abaturage benshi bakavomaho abayobozi banagejejwe ahari kubakwa amashanyarazi ako kagali jean berchmas bahige ukuriye ewsa rubavu yasobanuye mashanyarazi azagera baturage tugali twa byahi kanembwe karukogo ibarizwa mirenge rubavu cyanzarwe bahige yashimangiye mashanyarazi afite ingufu zihagije zizafasha abaturage kwivana bukene bahige yagize mushinga wizwe neza ibikoresho byose birahari igikorwa cyose gikoreshwa n’amashanyarazi kizahakora kirahari mpungenge hasuwe n’isoko ryo ako kagali ariko rizatangira gukorerwamo mutarama nyuma seth mugema asanga amajyambere kwihuta abagana buryo yiteguye gutangiza umushinga iwabo cyaro nogosha imisatsi mujyi none kubera batuzaniye amashanyarazi ngiye kwimurira salon yanjye karukogo nk’uko title: gakenke inkeragutabara n’abafasha barahuguwe mateka
content: kubakira byiza mateka y’u rwanda kugira uruhare kubungabunga umutekano hatangwa amakuru gihe muntu wese wahungabanya umutekano bimwe byagarutsweho mahugurwa yateguwe komisiyo gusubiza buzima imvano y’amateka yateye jenoside yakorewe abatutsi yavuze abazungu banditse kandi bakigisha amateka y’u rwanda bayagoreka nkana kugira bacemo ibice abanyarwanda babashe kubategeka bise cyongereza n’ubutegetsi bubi bamburaga ubuzima abavandimwe basaga miliyoni asobanura ikigenderewe kwiga amateka yavuze kubaka ejo hazaza bwana safali yagize kumenya amateka yacu bidufasha kwirinda amabi jenoside tukubakira mateka meza bidufasha kandi kumenya twatsinzwe n’aho twatsinze nk’abanyarwanda ni byiza kwiga amateka kuko ushaka kwiyibagiza amateka ashaka kuyasubiramo ibyo bigamije kubaka ejo hazaza h’igihugu cyacu kizira amacakubiri n’ingengabiterezo jenoside umutekano isoko y’iterambere lt muhozi charles ubarizwa batayo ikorera karere gakenke watanze ikiganiro mutekano yavuze iterambere u rwanda rwagezeho rurikesha umutekano niyo mpamvu tugomba kuwubungabunga kugira tutazasubira inyuma yibukije abitariye amahugurwa batagomba kwirara bagomba gutanga amakuru gihe muntu wese ushobora kuhungabanya umutekano koloneli karegeya claudien komisiyo gusubiza buzima busanzwe witandukanyije fdlr yabasabye gukangurira abavandimwe ndetse n’inshuti zabo zikiri mashyamba kongo gutahuka bagafatanya n’abandi banyarwanda kubaka igihugu cyabo kandi abizeza kuzabafasha kubagezaho butumwa izo nkeragutabara zitandukanyije fdlr zinjijwe gahunda zitandukanye z’iterambere barihirwa amashuri y’imyuga barubakiwe bavanwa nyakatsi ndetse baninjizwa gahunda gira inka mushimiyimana jeannette umwe mubakurikiranye mahugurwa avuga mahugurwa yayungukiyemo byinshi yavuze yasobanukiwe imvano jenoside amateka yagoretswe akaba agiye gufata iya mbere akayarwanya avuga amateka y’ukuri kandi agomba kubaka igihugu cy’u rwanda ayo mahugurwa yitabiriwe n’inkeragutabara hamwe n’abafasha basaga baturutse turere twa rulindo gakenke batahutse bava mashyamba repubulika iharanira demokarasi kongo guhera kugeza mwaka turimo nshimiyimana leonard

title: uburwayi umutwe indwara nk’izindi kandi buravurwa
content: mu kiganiro yagiranye n’abanyamakuru kabiri tariki ukwakira dr kayiteshonga yvonne ukuriye ishami rishinzwe iby’ubuzima mutwe minisiteri y’ubuzima yagaragaje intera urwanda rumaze gutera mubijyanye guteza imbere ubuzima umutwe ugereranije n’ibindi bihugu karere hakaba harimo politiki nshya kwegereza abanyarwanda ubuvuzi bujyanye n’indwara umutwe kuburyo nibura byazagera kurwego rw’ibigo nderabuzima kuko kugeza hari abaganga b’ubuvuzi bw’uburwayi umutwe rwego rw’akarere gusa hashyizweho kandi serivisi yakira ikanasuzuma abafite ibibazo by’uburwayi umutwe yunganira ibitaro by’indera hatanzwe ibitabo bifasha abunganira ibikorwa by’ubuzima habayeho gufatanya n’izindi nzego leta guhangana niki kibazo igihe bibaye ngombwa nko gihe cy’inkiko gacaca gufatanya komisiyo ishinzwe gusezerera gusubiza mubuzima busanzwe ingabo zavuye kurugeroyasobanuye kandi uburwayi umutwe uburwayi nk’ubundi ndetse hari n’ubushobora kuvurwa bugakira ikibazo cy’uburwayi mumutwe rwanda kigenda gifata intera umwaka utashye nkuko imibare y’abitabira servise z’ubu buvuzi ibigaragaza mwaka umubare w’abagannye buvuzi abantu mwaka mwaka bamaze kugera umwaka ushize abagannye serivisi uretse kuba u rwanda rwarahuye jenoside ndetse n’ingaruka zayo zimwe muzindi mpamvu zitera kuzamuka kw’iyi mibare abanyarwanda bamaze gukangukira kwitabira gahunda z’ubuvuzi cyane cyane kuko banafite ubwisungane kwivuza ikindi imyumvire igenda ihinduka kuko ubundi wasangaga abafite burwayi barafungiranwaga bagahezwa bagahishwa cyangwa bakavurizwa mubavuzi gihanga mubapfumu bumwe buvuzi buhabwa abafite burwayi harimo imiti gufashwa buryo bw’ibiganiro hamwe kubafasha kwongera gusubira buzima busanzwe buryo butatu hari ushobora kubuhabwa bwose hari n’ushobora guhabwa bumwe cyakora uburyo gusubizwa buzima busanzwe bakaba babuhuriraho nubwo ariko hari ibyakozwe nibiteganywa gukorwa inzitizi ziracyahari izagarutsweho nk’ikibazo cy’imyumvire itari myiza ndwara mumutwe abantu bagitekereza uzirwaye atakiri umuntu muzima wagira akamaro bityo agahabwa akato imyumvire nimwe ijyana n’umuco ndetse n’imyizerere benshi bazita amarozi bagahitamo kugana abapfumu cyangwa hakaba abazifata nk’amadayimoni bakaguma nsengero ntibavuzwe ikindi umubare w’inzobere buvuzi ukiri muto rwanda mu butumwa bwatanzwe harimo kumva ikibazo cy’uburwayi umutwe icya buri wese kandi uwahuye nabwo akitabwaho mumuryango hakabaho guhindura imyumvire ndwara hakorwa ubukangurambaga buhagije kugira imikoranire hagati ministeri y’ubuzima n’abavuzi gihanga kuko usanga abafite burwayi abenshi ariho babanza bigatuma bagera kubuvuzi nyabwo batinze ikindi nabagize ibyago kuzirwara bakwiye gufashwa bakanitabwaho muryango nyarwanda kuko uburwayi umutwe nabwo uburwayi nkubundi ndetse nuwahuye nabwo akongera kwakirwa buzima busanzwe marie jose ikibasumba

title: kwitwara neza buroko gufasha urukiko bimwe bitumye bagaragaza agiye kurekurwa
content: iki cyemezo cyafashwe tariki ukwakira n’umucamanza khalida rachid khan uyobora urukiko mpuzamahanga mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho u rwanda tpir gusaba irekurwa bagaragaza michel wakatiwe igihano gufungwa imyaka mwaka ushize amakuru kigalitodaycom gikesha itangazo ry’uryo rukiko aravuga mpamvu zatanzwe kumurekura harimo kuba urukiko mpuzamahanga mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho yougoslavia tpiy rufite imikorere ijya gusa n’iya tpir ruteganya imfungwa zakatiwe zishobora kurekurwa nyuma kumara bitatu kane by’igifungo barakatiwe kandi bagaragaza amaze imyaka afunze ukuvuga by’imyaka umunani yakatiwe izindi mpamvu michel bagaragaza ubwe yiyemeje kwishyikiriza urukiko akanemera yashinjwaga ndetse akerekana azi uburemere bwabyo akanabyicuza kuba yararanzwe n’imyitwarire myiza afungiye sude mugabane w’u burayi nyakanga umunyarwanda michel bagaragaza yahoze umuyobozi mukuru w’ikigo ocir- ishami ry’icyayi akaba yarafatwaga nk’umwe nkoramutima juvnal habyarimana perezida w’u rwanda yamaze igihe ashakishwa tpir byaha kunoza umugambi jenoside yakorewe abatutsi kugira uruhare jenoside n’ubufatanyacyaha jenoside tariki kanama bagaragaza yishyikirije tpir bwende bwe yitaba urukiko munsi ukurikiyeho ariko ahakana byaha byose yashinjwaga nyuma y’aho bidashobokeye yoherezwa kuburanishirizwa rwanda nyuma kugirana imishyikirano yihariye n’ubushinjacyaha bagaragaza yemeye kuba yaragize uruhare ruziguye jenoside kuko yaremeye intwaro zari zigenewe gukora jenoside zibikwa ruganda rw’icyayi rubaya ndetse akaba yaranaguriraga interahamwe inzoga akanaziha amafaranga yemereye urukiko kandi yahaga interahamwe imodoka z’uruganda bazikoreshe ngendo zabo ariko yongeraho yabikoraga akiza amagara n’umuryango uko gufasha interahamwe bikaba aribyo byatumaga ubushinjacyaha buvuga yazorohereje akazi bigatuma zibasha kwica abantu bahungiye musozi kesho kiliziya nyundo utwo duce twose turi karere rubavu kubera kwemera yaregwaga kubisabira imbabazi imbere y’urukiko tariki ugushyingo bagaragaza yakatiwe igifungo cy’imyaka umunani kandi urukiko rutegeka hakurwamo igihe yafunzwe michel bagaragaza azafungurwa itariki ukuboza bivuze ashigaje ukwezi kumwe n’iminsi itandatu buroko ernestine musanabera

title: ikipe bizimana djihadi aheruka gusinyira yanyagiwe akayabo k’ibitego
content: ikipe bizimana djihad aherutse gusinyira gihugu cy’ububiligi cyiciro mbere yitwa waasland beveren yanyagiwe ibitego umunani busa sv zulte waregem mikino kamarampaka gushaka amakipe azasohokera gihugu europa league irushanwa kabiri rikomeye burayi nyuma champions league iyi kipe yarangije umwaka w’imikino usanzwe mwanya itsinze imikino icyenda inganya umunani itsindwa gihe club brugge anderlecht zimenyerewe mikino mugabane w’u burayi arizo zari ziyoboye nk’uko bigenda bubiligi amakipe yarangije shampiyona y’icyiciro mbere hagati y’imyanya karindwi yiyongeraho atatu yabaye mbere cyiciro kabiri akaba agashyirwa matsinda abiri rimwe ry’amakipe atandatu buri igahura n’indi mukino ubanza n’uwo kwishyura ikipe irangije iyoboye itsinda a ihura n’iyoboye irya b mukino nyuma itsinze igahura mukino umwe kamarampaka n’ikipe yabaye iya gatanu shampiyona itsinze igahita ikatisha itike kuzakina imikino mugabane w’u burayi europa league waasland-beveren bizimana djihad nayo makipe arwanira tike itsinda a irimo mwanya nyuma mikino umunani ikaba imaze gutsinda umwe inganya ibiri itsindwa itanu mu mukino yakinnye kabiri zulte-waregem iyoboye tsinda yayinyagiye ibitego - byatumye amahirwe kuzagaragara mikino mugabane w’u burayi ayoyoka kuko n’iyo yatsinda imikino isigaje itashyikira iya mbere ifite amanota biteganyijwe bizimana djihad wabanje kugaruka rwanda nyuma yogusinyira kipe amasezerano y’imyaka itatu agomba gusubirayo bitarenze tariki kamena kugira atangirane bagenzi imikino ibanziriza shampiyona y’umwaka utaha pre season’ iyi kipe yashinzwe yitwa red star iza kugenda ihindurirwa amazina kugera yiswe waasland-beveren ntirabasha kwitabira rimwe imikino mugabane w’u burayi ndetse igihe kinini yakimaze byiciro hasi bubiligi abakinnyi zulte waregem bishimira kimwe bitego umunani banyagiye waasland beveren agahinda kari kenshi bakinnyi waasland-beveren nyuma y’umukinowaasland beveren bizimana djihad yanyagiwe ibitego umunani busa mukino gushaka itike kuzitabira europa league yanditswe habarurema djamali

title: gisagara umugabo n’umwana w’imyaka bishwe batemaguwe
content: ntezirembo jean w’imyaka n’umwana witwaga kwizera jean de dieu kagali nyaruteja murenge nyanza karere gisagara bishwe batemaguwe nyuma umugabo akorerwa iyica rubozo ritamenyerewe nzeli uwo bivugwa yabahitanye yitwa niyibizi jean damascene abaturage n’ubuyobozi bakaba bemeza gihe cyashize arwaye mutwe ariko bakaba bazi yakize abageze niyibizi yakoreye mahano bavuga yateye icyuma bw’umurenge buvuga ababaje bikaba byatumye niyibizi ahita asubizwa bitaro by’indwara mutwe caraes ndera mujyi kigali niyibizi yabyukanye icyuma ahuye ntezirembo ajya guhinga arakimutera ariko cyanga kwinjira noneho amwambura umuhoro afite amutema imipaga myinshi ako kanya abona akana gashoreye ihene atema ihene arakomeza arakirukankana nako aragatema karapfa aya amwe magambo izubarirasherw abaturage bavuga mahano yaje atunguranye kuko nubwo niyibizi yigeze kurwara mutwe bazi atakirwaye kuko amaze amezi atandatu ahagaritse imiti umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’umurenge nyanza uwimana jean bosco yabwiye izubarirashe mu by’ukuri niyibizi twe twari twamujyanye muganga mwaka bamutugarurira amaze imyaka batwereka yakize kandi imiti yayifataga ariko biragoye kumenya iby’umuntu ufite bakurikirana bakareba uwagiye kuvuzwa yarakize koko kugira bigaragaye yateza ikibazo asubizwe muganga hakarebwa mutwe bitarahindutse buryo yateza ibindi bibazo ati tugiye gukurikirana imyitwarire y’umuntu wese waba yaragize ikibazo mutwe turebe imyitwarire dukoresheje gahunda menya nkumenye avuga kandi abarwayi mutwe bakuwe muganga bagiye gusaba kujya babasuzuma nibura nyuma y’amezi hazirikanwa ibisazi atari indwara ikira nk’izindi inkuru izubarirasherw

title: ikinyabupfura n’ubunyamwuga musanganywe bizabafashe gukomeza kuzamura ibendera ry’u rwanda-digp felix namuhoranye
content: umuyobozi mukuru wungirije polisi y’u rwanda ushinzwe ibikorwa digpops felix namuhoranye yahaga impanuro itsinda ry’abapolisi b’u rwanda bagiye butumwa kubungabunga amahoro gihugu repubulika content: aba basore bakora akazi kubika gushyingura neza inyandiko n’ibindi bivuga mamateka jenoside yakorewe abatutsi rwanda bagiye kwiga uburyo amateka jenoside rwanda yashyingurwa buryo bugezweho cyane cyane kubika amateka buryo bw’amashusho n’amajwi iki kigo gifite uburambe kubika ubutumwa bw’amajwi amashusho ndetse n’inyandiko birebana n’amateka jenoside umuyobozi w’iyi fondasiyo karen jungblut ukurikirana mushinga gukusanya amateka jenoside rwanda yatangajeko mubyo umubano w’ibi bigo uzibandaho harimo guhana ubuhamya kugirango amateka jenoside amenyekane kw’isi bateganya gushaka amajwi n’amashusho bijyanye jenoside yakorewe abatutsi rwanda nayo ashyirwe bubiko bw’iki kigo kuko kugeza bafite ubuhamya bwanditse gusa nabwo bwaje kinyarwanda bikagerageza kubushyira zindi ndimi ikigo mpuzamahanga shoah foundation ntigiharanira inyungu kikaba gikora ubushakashatsi bijyanye n’amateka jenoside ibikorwa kwibuka abaguye ntambara kabiri y’isi iki kigo kivuga kigamije ukugerageza gufasha abantu kurenga ibibazo by’urwikekwe kugira imitima ibababarira hagati y’umwaka w’ muryango wabashije kwakira ubuhamya bw’abantu bihugu bagiye barokoka buryo butandukanye marie jose ikibasumba

title: skol yashimishije abatuye huye
content: iki gitaramo cyateguwe skol cyabereye club universitaire kikaba kandi cyari kinagamije kumenyekanisha nzoga skol kubatari bwakayimenyeuhagarariye skol karere huye nyaruguru nyamagabe maniragaba dieudonn yatangaje bateguye gitaramo kugirango nakire abanyeshuri bashya kaminuza iki gitaramo cyahuriranye n’isozwa ry’ibizamini leta mashuri yisumbuye bibam akarusho usibye ibibazo bijyanye n’ibyuma muzika byagiye bigaragara ubundi abanyeshuri n’abandi bitabiriye gitaramo batangaje baryohewe cyane n’ibyo bateguriwe birimo igabanyirizwa ry’ibiciro skol nini n’intoya tombora ndetse n’umuziki ugezweho dieudonn aravuga ubwitabire yabonye bwari buhagije kuko gikorwa kitanateguwe igihe kinini kuri habonetse abantu atakekaga kandi n’ibinyobwa bye bikaba byaguzwe bihagije ikirutaho akaba yabashije gushimisha abantu akahava atagawe abaturage n’abanyeshuri mujyi huye bitabiriye gitaramo barasaba ibitaramo nk’ibi byajya bibageraho kenshi theogne umwe bitabiriye gitaramo yagize abahatuye tutakidagadura kandi bitaramo bizajya binafasha huye kwivugurura kuko kuvugurura si ukubaka gusa dieudonn aratangaza ibitaramo nk’ibi biteganyijwe aka gace byinshi kandi gihe kitarambiranye ngo bizajya biba birimo tombora nyinshi kuruta izari zirimo joro akaba ahamagarira abantu kuzajya babyitabira benshi iki gitaramo cyatangiye saa kumi n’ebyiri z’umugoroba kikarangira gitondo gatandatu cyitabiriwe n’abantu hagati kwinjira byari amafaranga ugahabwa skol ntoya y’ubuntu muryngo ibihembo byatanzwe tombora byari imipira kwambara amakarito y’ibirahure y’inzoga n’ibirahuri skol clarisse umuhire

content: ibibaso bikomeje kuba urusobe bayobozi bawo barimo kayumba nyamwasa kugeza n’aho leah karegeya umugore w’umwe bashinze mutwe avuze agiye kwihuza n’abandi badashyigikiye kayumba nyamwasa umutungo rnc akawushora bikorwa bye by’ubucuruzi biri afurika y’epfo mozambique n’ahandi leah karegeya wahoze kanama gashinzwe imyitwarire n’imikorere rnc minsi ishize yashyize hanze ibaruwa ifunguye title: ibimenyetso byakwereka umusore wihebeye atakigukunda
content: birumvikana bishengura kubona bimwe bimenyetso bikwereka umuhungu wihebeye ashobora kuba atakigukunda cyane igihe wowe wumvaga urushaho kumukunda gusa igihe ubashije kubibona amahirwe wowe kuko bikurinda gutakaza umwanya ndetse ukaba wamenya imyanzuro ukwiriye gufata hakiri kare ibi bimwe bimenyetso bishobora kukwereka umuhungu wihebeye atakigukunda arakurakarira n’aho bitari ngombwa umuhungu mukundana atagishaka mukundana wakoraga bikamushimisha hari igihe ubikora bikamurakaza cyangwa wagira umubaza niyo cyaba cyoroshye gusubiza akagusubizanya umushiha uyu mushiha n’uburakari yindi mpamvu uzi ibimutera nk’umunaniro yakuye kazi cyangwa ibibazo afite bye giti cye biba ikimenyetso cy’uko atakigushaka ndetse yifuza urukundo rwanyu ruhagarara aratinda cyangwa ntasubize ubutumwa bwawe iyo urukundo rugitangira abakundana bashaka kubonana kenshi gashoboka igihe bitakunze bakohererezanya ubutumwa bwinshi kandi ntibatinde gusubizanya mu gihe umuhungu mukundana usigaye umwandikira ubutumwa bugufi ntagusubize cyangwa akagusubiza haciyemo igihe wabimubaza bikamurakaza ndetse ntagire impamvu aguha yumvikana yatumye abikora biba ikindi kimenyetso yifuza urukundo rwanyu ruhagarara ahagarika kukubwira agukunda iyo umusore rukundo arabigaragaza ndetse agashaka umenya uburyo yiyumva akubwira agukunda kenshi bishoboka gihe atakikubwira agukunda kandi yarajyaga abikora ndetse wamubaza akigukunda akakubaza impamvu ubimubajije ikimenyetso cyerekana ashobora kuba atakigukunda ntaguha umwanya igihe ubona umuhungu mukundana atakiguha umwanya uze imbere buzima bwe ikimenyetso cy’uko ashaka urukundo rwanyu ruhagarara umuhungu ugukunda n’ubwo yaba ahuze cyane agerageza gushaka umwanya mukabonana cyangwa mukavugana igihe akubwiye ahuze akabigira impamvu kuba mutabonana uburyo kukwigizayo ariko akaba adafite imbaraga kukubwira atakigukunda mbere ntaguhumuriza bibazokimwe byiza kuba rukundo ukumva ufite umuntu ukuri ndetse ushobora kugufasha bibazo byose wahura nabyo akabana mu gihe ubona umuhungu mukundana atakikuba ahubwo ibibazo byaza ukabona ararushaho kuguhunga bishobora kuba ikimenyetso cy’uko atakigukunda akunda kugaragara nk’utishimye birasanzwe rukundo umuntu wese agira igihe yumva atameze neza ndetse atishimye ariko igihe ubibona buryo buhoraho musore mukundana ariko utazi impamvu ibimutera wenda ituruka hanze y’urukundo rwanyu bishobora ikimenyetso title: umuganda inyunganizi ngengo y’imari y’igihugu
content: kimwe n’indi myaka yashize mwaka - wakozwemo ibikorwa binyuranye by’umuganda gihugu hose birimo guhanga imihanda y’imigenderano gutinda amateme kubaka amazu y’abatishoboye kubaka amashuli y’uburezi bw’ibanze bw’imyaka ybe kubaka ubwiherero kubaka ibigega guhunikamo imyaka gucukura imyobo guteramo ibiti gutera ibiti kubaka ibiro by’utugari gucukura ibyobo bifata amazi n’ibindi ibikorwa byose byakozwe bikaba byarahawe agaciro kangana y’amafaranga y’u rwanda nk’uko bigaragara rapport yashyizwe ahagaragara minaloc italiki mbere nzeli n’ubwo ibikorwa byakozwe bifite agaciro kanini gihugu hose ariko ntibyabujije hakorwa ibarura rigamije kumenya ubwitabire buri ntara muri raporo baragaragaza umujyi kigali hamwe n’intara y’uburengerazuba ziri mwanya nyuma n’ubwitabire bungana akaba nazo zifite ubwitabire buri hasi ugereranyije n’izindi ntara gihe intara y’amajyaruguru mwanya mbere n’ubwitabire igakurikirwa n’intara y’amajyepfo ifite intara y’uburasirazuba ikaza mwanya gatatu n’ubwitabire bungana aha intara zititwaye neza zikaba zisabwa kwikubita agashyi nyuma kumenya ubwitabire buhagaze gihugu hose barebye intara yakoze ibikorwa bifite agaciro kanini intara y’iburasirazuba iza isonga n’ibikorwa bifite agaciro kangana z’amafaranga y’u rwanda gihe umujyi kigali uza mwanya nyuma n’ibikorwa bifite agaciro kangana z’amanyarwanda aha kugira agaciro k’ibikorwa by’umuganda karusheho kuzamuka abakoze raporo berekanye hari ibintu by’ingenzi bitatu bigomba kwitabwaho ubwitabire bw’abaturage umurava buri wese witabiriye igenamigambi rinoze kandi risesengura neza ibikorwa by’ingenzi bifitiye abaturage n’igihugu rusange akamaro si gusa ariko byakozwe kuko mpera z’ukwezi werurwe minisiteri y’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu yatangije amarushanwa y’ibikorwa by’umuganda nshuro kabiri akaba yarashyiriweho kugirango atere imbaraga n’ubushake abaturage barusheho gukunda kwitabira ibikorwa by’umuganda benshi binyuze muco guhiga guhanga udushya umurenge kavumu karere ngororero intara y’uburengerazuba akaba waje mwanya mbere rwego rw’igihugu ubikesha urugomero rw’amashanyarazi rwubatswe n’abaturage bakabasha kwivana icuraburindi ku mwanya kabiri haje umurenge musange karere nyamagabeintara y’amajyepfo wahinze inanasi buso bungana ha bikazabafasha kwikura bukene ku mwanya gatatu hari umurenge manyagiro karere gicumbi intara y’amajyaruguru abaturage bawutuyemo bubatse amazu y’abahejwe inyuma n’amateka rwego kubafasha kwiteza imbere batura heza uretse ibikorwa byakozwe muganda rusange kandi raporo irerekana ibindi byakozwe n’ingabo polisi cyumweru army week police week n’ibindi byakozwe n’abanyarwanda banyuranye nzego zitandukanye hari kandi n’ibyakorewe mahanga babaga butumwa rwego kumenyekanisha umuco mwiza igihugu cyacu gifite aha twavuga ingabo z’u rwanda butumwa bw’amahoro bw’umuryango w’abibumbye majyaruguru darfur ahitwa el-fasher batangizaga umuganda buri kwezi bafatanyije n’ingabo z’ibindi bihugu ziri butumwa nyuma y’umuganda hagendaga habaho ibiganiro bitandukanye bigamije gukangurira abaturage kwitabira gahunda leta hamwe kugira uruhare bikorwa bibakorerwa batanga umusanzu wabo rwego kwiyubakira igihugu cyane cyagerwaho batabigizemo uruhare anne niwemwiza

title: ngoma kubufatanye leta police y’u rwanda iti bayi bayi gatadowa buje
content: mugutangiza icyumweru cy’ibikorwa police y’u rwanda police week rwego rw’akarere ngoma byabereye m’umurenge jarama akagali karenge umudugudu kanombeaho bacaniye imiryango bakoresheje ingufu zituruka imirasire y’izuba gahunda guca agatadowa ndetse buje igikorwa kikaba gikomeje police y’u rwanda kandi iteganya gucanira imiryango ibihumbi turere gihugu nkuko biri gukorwa turere tugize igihugu ubufatanye leta police y’u rwanda ikomeje ibikorwa bitandukanye mugihe cy’ icyumweru police week gufasha abanyarwanda kubona umuriro w’amashanyarazi ukomoka ngufu z’imirasire y’izubauwo muhango rwego rw’akarere ngoma watangiriye murenge jarama kagari karenge witabiriwe n’abayobozi batandukanye harimo umujyana minisitiri w’urubyiruko n’ikoranabuhangaingabo policeumuyobozi w’akarere ndetse n’abaturage watangijwe gutaha bimwe mubikorwa byakozwe basura imiryango yacaniwe bamwe miryango banejejwe n’iterambere leta y’u rwanda ndetse police babagejejeho bamwe bemeza bizatuma babasha ku’irindira umutekano mugihe hari ubujura bukabije kubera umwijima umuturage yarambikaga igale hasi ageze murugo kugirango akingure yacyebuka inyumaagasanga bararitwayeariko kubera urumuribasigaye bafite umutekanomwijambo umuyobozi wungirije police y’u rwanda dgatare yageje kubari yavuze cyumweru week police bateganya gucanira ingo ibihumbi turere gihugu k’ubufatanye leta y’u rwanda abatangariza ibikorwa kwibandaho cyumweru harimo umusanzu guca agatadowa buje bamaze gucanira imiryango m’umudugudu kanombegukangurira abaturage umutekano barwanya ingengabitekerezo jenoside ndetse kubungabunga ibidukikijekurwanya ibiyobyabwengekurwanya ihohoterwa rikorerwa igitsina n’icuruzwa ry’abantukurwanya ruswa ndetse kwirinda impanuka mumuhanda asoza asaba abari ibimaze kugerwaho birindwa abashaka kubyangiriza umuyobozi w’akarere ngoma nambaje aphrodis yatangiye ashimira police y’ u rwanda ndetse n’ubuyobozi bukuru bw’igihugu buyobowe nyakubahwa perezida repubulika paul kagameku amashanyarazi batanze akomoka mirasire y’izuba umusemburo w’iterambere nkuko biri cyerekezo abanyarwanda bazaba bacana amashanyarazi gipimo bagasezera gucana agatadowa akomeza agaragaza imikorere myiza police agira atiisura nziza police yacu umwihariko kwisi kuko ifatanya n’abaturage bikorwa gucunga umutekano yongeraho kandi bikomoka miyoborere myiza leta y’u rwandaagira iyi myumvire y’abanyarwanda kurindira hamwe umutekano policeiyi mikorere myiza police gukorana n’abaturagebikomoka miyoborere myiza igihugu cyacu kimaze kugeraho tubicyesha nyakubahwa perezida repubulika y’u rwanda paul kagame nifuza mwanya mwa mushimira mumuha amashyiasoza ashimangira ubufatanye police n’abaturage gucunga umutekano kurwanya ubucyene buzakomeza kuko butanga umusaruro umuyobozi w’ungirije police y’u rwanda dgatare yanditswe habarurema djamalimuhaburarw

title: bugesera umurego kurwanya ibiyobyabwenge
content: ibi baturage babitangaje cyumweru polisi y’igihugu bufatanye n’ubuyobozi bw’akarere bagiye kariya gace guta yombi abaturage bacuruza ibinyobwa bitemewe n’amategeko abaturage batuye aka gace mirambi bavuga gakunda kugaragaramo ikibazo cy’umutekano muke bikururwa n’ibibazo bitandukanye birimo ubujura n’icuruzwa ry’ibiyobyabwenge kanyanga irimo cyane mezi abiri ashije hiciwe abantu babiri karemera sam umuyobozi polisi ntara y’iburasirazuba witabiriye igikorwa guta yombi abaturage bakoze uruganda gucuruza kanyanga kariya gace yatangarije abaturage gihe kitari gito polisi igiye gushyira bikorwa icyifuzo cyabo gufungura ishami ryayo aka gace icyakora ariko karemera yababwiye icyihutirwa kurusha ibindi ukugira ubushake gufatanya n’ubuyobozi bw’akarere guhangana n’ibikorwa bibahungabanyiriza umutekano rwagaju louis umuyobozi w’akarere bugesera kubufatanye n’abari bahagarariye inzego z’umutekano bitabiriye gikorwa yabwiye abaturage bagomba kwirinda ibikorwa gucuruza kanyanga n’ibindi biyobyabwenge byose kuko nyir’abayazana w’umutekano muke karere bugesera rwagaju kandi yavuze ubuyobozi bw’akarere bwari busanzwe buzi ibihakorerwa icyari gisigaye ukuza guta yombi abacurizi kanyangaati’’twari tubizi icyari gisigaye cyari umwanya kuza kubafata iyo uhamwe n’icyaha gucuruza kanyanga inzoga itemewe n’amategeko y’u rwanda uhanishwa igihano cy’igifungo kiri hagati y’amezi atatu n’imyaka itanu cyangwa ihazabu y’amafaranga ibihumbi byaba ngombwa ukabihanishwa byombi mimi rachel mukandayisenga

title: imfubyi jenoside zirasaba kurushaho kwegerwa
content: nubwo u rwanda rufite rugeze guhangana n’ingaruka jenoside abana bagizwe imfubyi baracyakeneye inama urukundo gusurwa kwitabwaho kuko abakagombye kubibaha batagihari nk’uko byatangajwe n’uhagarariye ibuka karere rubavu kabanda innocent kabanda yasabye abanyarubavu kwita bana ndetse n’abapfakazi kabanda yongeyeho ubupfura batojwe butabemerera kwangana mpamvu biteguye gutanga imbabazi babiciye babishaka yagize ntabwo tuzizirika muntu watwiciye uzashaka imbabazi azatwegere tuzazimuha uyu munsi kwibuka tariki wabimburiwe n’urugendo ruva murenge rugerero rujya rwibutso rw’uwo murenge wanaranzwe n’indirimbo z’abana barokotse jenoside yakorewe abatutsi bibumbiye itsinda ryitwa imanzi’ ubuhamya gushyira indabo rwibutso rugerero ku isaha saa sita abanyarubavu bunamiye inzirakarengane iminota itatu hanyuma bakurikirana radiyo ijambo nyakubahwa perezida repubulika yavugiye sitade amahoro mujyi kigali umuyobozi w’akarere rubavu sheikh bahame hassan yashimiye abaturage b’ako karere kuba bitabiriye gahunda benshi anabasaba kuzitabira gahunda z’icyumweru cy’icyunamo zizaba zirimo ibiganiro yongeyeho kwegera abacitse icumu ingenzi bagahumurizwa urwibutso rugerero rushyinguyemo imibiri y’abatutsi gusoza icyumweru cy’icyunamo karere rubavu bikazabera murenge mudende tariki mata kugeza imibare yavuye bushakashatsi bwakozwe ibuka yerekana abazize jenoside bangana rwanda hose pascaline umulisa

title: imihango n’imigenzo yakorwaga n’abanyarwanda kwirukana ibiza n’ibyorezo
content: imihango yakorwaga ahanini yabaga ishingiye biteganywa n’ubwiru umwuga w’ubupfumu ubuvubyi ubuhennyi ubuhoryo n’ubuhaditsi igitabo imizi y’u rwanda cyanditswe n’umusizi nsanzabera jean de dieu inzobere muco amateka n’ubuvanganzo havugwamo buri cyorezo cyateraga u rwanda habaga hari uburyo bwateguwe kucyohera cyangwa kukirukana bakoreshejwe migenzo n’imihango yashyizwe u rwanda rwahangwaga inzira kivu ni inzira yabagamo urwunge rw’imihango yakorwaga gihe gihugu habaga hateye umwuzure ukangiza byinshi gihugu bakoraga imihango kwirunka mwuzure inzira muhekenyi ni inzira hakurikiragaho abahanga gakondo kuvura icyateye cyorezo kucyohera ntikizagaruke bamwe bakoraga mihango bakurikira abavubyi mu rwanda ha mbere abavubyi bafite umumaro uhanitse mibereho myiza title: uko u burundi uganda byafashije kayumba nyamwasa kurema umutwe gisirikare rdc
content: abo bantu biganjemo abanyarwanda bayobowe rtd maj habib mudathiru bakurikiranyweho ubufatanyacyaha kwinjira mutwe w’ingabo utari ingabo zemewe n’igihugu ubugambanyi cyaha kugirira nabi ubutegetsi buriho kugirana umubano n’izindi nzego leta mahanga hagambiriwe gushoza intambara kurema umutwe w’abagizi nabi ibyaha bashinjwa n’ubushinjacyaha bigaragaza neza uruhare ibihugu by’u burundi uganda byagize ishingwa ry’umutwe gisirikare ushamikiye ihuriro p rigizwe n’amashyaka atemewe rwanda rnc fdu inkingi pdp imanzi ps imberakuri amahoro people’s congress ibyo ubushinjacyaha bwagaragaje bihuye n’ibyatangajwe n’impuguke loni mpera z’umwaka ushize zasohoraga raporo igaragaza repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo hari umutwe w’inyeshyamba kayumba nyamwasa ugamije guhungabanya umutekano rwanda iyo raporo yavugaga kayumba nyamwasa afite umutwe w’inyeshyamba zikorera misozi fizi uvira kivu y’amajyepfo uwo mutwe ugizwe n’abagera uyobowe shaka nyamusaraba wahoze ayoboye inyeshyamba gomino ukaba ukoresha intwaro ziturutse burundi n’ubundi bufasha bavana uganda kayumba yafashijwe gushinga umutwe w’inyeshyamba umushinjacyaha yavuze rtd major habib mudathiru yahunze u rwanda akajya uganda agezeyo ahurirayo n’uwitwa maj robert higiro wahoze ngabo z’u rwanda akaba umwe bagize rnc amugira inama gushaka ibyangombwa by’impunzi kugira abone umutekano ngo ibyangombwa yarabishatse tanganyika bambukira bwato bagera rdc bagezeyo baje kwakirwa n’abandi basanzweyo mbere kwinjira rdc bahawe imbunda bwoko smg lmg mmg n’ibikarito by’amasasu smg sheni z’amasasu nmg umushinjacyaha yavuze nyuma gushinga p kayumba yaje kugira colonel nyamusaraba umuyobozi w’ibikorwa byose yungirizwa sibo charles habib mudathiru ashingwa ibikorwa n’imyitozo semahurunguru ashingwa iperereza politiki uwitwa richard ashingwa ubutegetsi n’ibikoresho olivier ashingwa imari nyuma kayumba yahamagaye mudathiru telefoni ikoresha icyogajuru amusaba batekereza bahindura bakorera ashaka bava kivu title: rdc muzito wahoze minisitiri w’intebe yasabye congo gutera u rwanda ikarwegukana
content: muri repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo rdc adolphe muzito wahoze minisitiri w’intebe w’iki gihugu akaba umuhuzabikorwa w’ihuriro ry’amashyaka atavuga rumwe leta gihugu ryitwa lamuka yatunguranye ahamagarira igihugu cye gushoza intambara k’u rwanda nk’uko inkuru dukesha urubuga radiyo mpuzamahanga y’abafaransa rfi ibivuga muzito yabitangaje mbere tariki ukuboza murwa mukuru i kinshasa yakoraga ikiganiro cye mbere n’itangazamakuru nk’umuhuzabikorwa lamuka yashinjaga u rwanda kuba inyuma y’ibikorwa by’umutekano muke burasirazuba bw’iki gihugu gusa mvugo ntiyahuriweho n’abandi bayobozi lamukaadolphe muzito yabaye minisitiri w’intebe congo hagati ku adolphe muzito gushyira imbaraga ngabo ziri butumwa bw’umuryango w’abibumbye monusco ntibitanga igisubizo kirambye kugarura amahoro burasirazuba congo ahubwo akaba asaba hashyirwaho ingamba zikaze yagize gukemura ikibazo hagomba gushozwa intambara k’u rwanda niba dushaka kugenzura uburasirazuba repubulika u rwanda rugomba guterwa kugira intambara ibe hakenewe igisirikare hakenewe ubuyobozi bukomeye n’amikoro ahagije tukigarurira u rwanda nyuma u rwanda tukarwomeka congoadolphe muzito avuga ashize amanga u rwanda rwivanga politike congo kinshasa uganda ariko gihamya y’ibyo avuga muri kiganiro n’abanyamakuru cyamaze amasaha abiri adolphe muzito yanasobanuye yifuza umuryango w’ubukungu w’ibihugu biyiga bigari cepgl wagakwiye gukora kurushaho rwego kwirinda amakimbirane hagati y’abanyamuryango bityo kwitabaza intambara ntibibe bikenewe muzito iyo mvuga gutera u rwanda bivuga hari bizaba ngombwa bikora hagati ibintu bitagiye buryo ntabwo intego ubwayo gusa gitekerezo adolphe muzito ntabwo agihuriyeho n’abandi bayobozi lamuka urugero mose katumbi jean pierre bemba bahise bashyira hanze iharanira uku kutavuga rumwe lamuka kuje gihe abayobozi bayo biteguraga kujya i beni rwego kugaragariza abahatuye ubufatanye ku ruhande leta y’u rwanda umunyamabanga mukuru minisiteri y’ububanyi n’amahanga olivier nduhungirehe yanenze imvugo y’uyu munyapolitike agaragaza bwenge buyirimo butumwa yanyujije rukuta rwe twitter agira umunsi adolphe muzito azagarura amahoro gace kitwa ’ntekerezo nzima raison’ n’umunsi azigarurira ubutaka bwitwa ’ubwonko cerveau’ bizaba intambwe ikomeyeubutumwa olivier nduhungirehe bunnyega amagambo muzito

title: fanaf irakangurira abatanga ubwishingizi rwanda gushora imari bikorwa by’iterambere
content: mu biganiro yagiranye minisitiri w’intebe w’u rwanda gatatu tariki protais ayangma ayang yatangaje amasosiyete y’ubwishingizi akwiye kugira uruhare iterambere ry’igihugu kuko guverinoma y’u rwanda iyafasha gukora neza ayang yagize abanyamakompanyi bakwiye gukoresha umutungo wabo kuzamura ubukungu bw’igihugu uhagarariye ishyirahamawe nyarwanda ry’amasosiyete y’ubwishingizi assar marc rugenera yatangaje leta yabemereye inkunga irenzeho kugira ibikorwa byabo bikomeze bijye imbere yavuze nubwo u rwanda rukiri inyuma bijyanye n’ubwishingizi afite icyizere ariko abanyarwanda bagenda basobanurirwa bazarushaho byumva cote d’ivoire cameroun nibyo bihugu bihagaze neza bwishingizi afurika congo-brazzaville iza isonga bigo byinshi by’ubwishingizi byeguriwe abikorera u rwanda rugeze isoko ry’ubwishingizi gihe ibihugu byateye imbere bigeze ubwishingizi binyabiziga nibwo buri hejuru cyane rwanda kubera itegeko leta risaba ababitunze kubifatira ubwishingizi inama ihuje amasosiyete y’ubwishingizi afrika yibumbiye mpuzamashyirahamwe nyafurika y’uburenganzira bwishingizi fanaf iteraniye i kigali tariki - fanaf ihuriwemo n’ibigo by’ubwishingizi ikaba ifite icyicaro senegal emmanuel n hitimana

title: uburwayi umutwe indwara nk’izindi kandi buravurwa
content: mu kiganiro yagiranye n’abanyamakuru kabiri tariki ukwakira dr kayiteshonga yvonne ukuriye ishami rishinzwe iby’ubuzima mutwe minisiteri y’ubuzima yagaragaje intera urwanda rumaze gutera mubijyanye guteza imbere ubuzima umutwe ugereranije n’ibindi bihugu karere hakaba harimo politiki nshya kwegereza abanyarwanda ubuvuzi bujyanye n’indwara umutwe kuburyo nibura byazagera kurwego rw’ibigo nderabuzima kuko kugeza hari abaganga b’ubuvuzi bw’uburwayi umutwe rwego rw’akarere gusa hashyizweho kandi serivisi yakira ikanasuzuma abafite ibibazo by’uburwayi umutwe yunganira ibitaro by’indera hatanzwe ibitabo bifasha abunganira ibikorwa by’ubuzima habayeho gufatanya n’izindi nzego leta guhangana niki kibazo igihe bibaye ngombwa nko gihe cy’inkiko gacaca gufatanya komisiyo ishinzwe gusezerera gusubiza mubuzima busanzwe ingabo zavuye kurugeroyasobanuye kandi uburwayi umutwe uburwayi nk’ubundi ndetse hari n’ubushobora kuvurwa bugakira ikibazo cy’uburwayi mumutwe rwanda kigenda gifata intera umwaka utashye nkuko imibare y’abitabira servise z’ubu buvuzi ibigaragaza mwaka umubare w’abagannye buvuzi abantu mwaka mwaka bamaze kugera umwaka ushize abagannye serivisi uretse kuba u rwanda rwarahuye jenoside ndetse n’ingaruka zayo zimwe muzindi mpamvu zitera kuzamuka kw’iyi mibare abanyarwanda bamaze gukangukira kwitabira gahunda z’ubuvuzi cyane cyane kuko banafite ubwisungane kwivuza ikindi imyumvire igenda ihinduka kuko ubundi wasangaga abafite burwayi barafungiranwaga bagahezwa bagahishwa cyangwa bakavurizwa mubavuzi gihanga mubapfumu bumwe buvuzi buhabwa abafite burwayi harimo imiti gufashwa buryo bw’ibiganiro hamwe kubafasha kwongera gusubira buzima busanzwe buryo butatu hari ushobora kubuhabwa bwose hari n’ushobora guhabwa bumwe cyakora uburyo gusubizwa buzima busanzwe bakaba babuhuriraho nubwo ariko hari ibyakozwe nibiteganywa gukorwa inzitizi ziracyahari izagarutsweho nk’ikibazo cy’imyumvire itari myiza ndwara mumutwe abantu bagitekereza uzirwaye atakiri umuntu muzima wagira akamaro bityo agahabwa akato imyumvire nimwe ijyana n’umuco ndetse n’imyizerere benshi bazita amarozi bagahitamo kugana abapfumu cyangwa hakaba abazifata nk’amadayimoni bakaguma nsengero ntibavuzwe ikindi umubare w’inzobere buvuzi ukiri muto rwanda mu butumwa bwatanzwe harimo kumva ikibazo cy’uburwayi umutwe icya buri wese kandi uwahuye nabwo akitabwaho mumuryango hakabaho guhindura imyumvire ndwara hakorwa ubukangurambaga buhagije kugira imikoranire hagati ministeri y’ubuzima n’abavuzi gihanga kuko usanga abafite burwayi abenshi ariho babanza bigatuma bagera kubuvuzi nyabwo batinze ikindi nabagize ibyago kuzirwara bakwiye gufashwa bakanitabwaho muryango nyarwanda kuko uburwayi umutwe nabwo uburwayi nkubundi ndetse nuwahuye nabwo akongera kwakirwa buzima busanzwe marie jose ikibasumba

title: minisitiri ndagijimana yatanze icyizere imvura nyinshi ngaruka izagira kwihaza biribwa
content: minisitiri w’imari n’igenamigambi dr ndagijimana uzziel yatangaje nubwo igihembwe mbere cy’ihinga cyibasiwe n’imvura idasanzwe guverinoma y’u rwanda yafashe ingamba zifatika zizatuma ikomeza kwihaza biribwa igipimo cy’ihindagurika ry’ibiciro by’ibiribwa giherutse gutangazwa n’ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe ibarurishamibare rwanda nisr cyerekanye ukuboza ibiciro mijyi byiyongereyeho kwezi ugereranyije ukuboza muri raporo cyatangaje bimwe byatumye ibiciro byiyongeraho kwezi byatewe n’ibiciro by’ibiribwa n’ibinyobwa bidasembuye byazamutseho n’ibiciro by’ibinyobwa bisembuye n’itabi byazamutseho umuyobozi mukuru nisr yusuf murangwa yavugiye nama y’igihugu y’umushyikirano yabaye ukuboza hari impamvu ebyiri zishobora gusobanura isano hagati y’izamuka ry’ubukungu rwanda buri kigero mwaka n’ibiciro byazamutse isoko gihe yavuze byatewe n’uko ugushyingo n’ukuboza akenshi umusaruro ugabanuka kandi haguye imvura nyinshi ikangiza ibihingwa indi mpamvu ikomeye usanga abantu bahanze amaso umusaruro w’ubuhinzi bitaretse n’ubwiyongere bw’abaturage bubigiramo uruhare mu ntangiriro z’umwaka imvura yakomeje kugwa ndetse ikigo cy’igihugu cy’iteganyagihe meteo rwanda cyagiye giteguza abaturage kuba maso cyane birinda ibijyanye n’ibiza kubera imvura nyinshi hari impungenge ishobora kugira ingaruka ibura ry’ibiribwa bigatuma bikomeza guhenda isoko minisitiri w’imari n’igenamigambi dr ndagijimana uzziel mutarama yabwiye itangazamakuru hashyizwe imbaraga bijyanye kwita musaruro w’ubuhinzi buryo mpungenge zikwiye kubaho yagize turi guhura n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe bitewe n’imvura idasanzwe ishobora kugira ingaruka musaruro kwihaza biribwa igenzura guverinoma rigaragaza tuzabona umusaruro mwiza gihembwe mbere cy’ubuhinzi’’ yakomeje avuga bihingwa by’ibanze birimo ibigori ibishyimbo n’ibindi hitezwe umusaruro mwiza kandi mwinshi ugereranyije n’uwabonetse ati imvura yaje mutarama gashyantare gihe cy’isarura imbogamizi ariko guverinoma yafashe ingamba kubika neza umusaruro kugabanya ingano y’uwangirika’’ muri mwaka guverinoma y’u rwanda yashyize ingengo y’imari ihagije kuzamura uburyo kubika umusaruro nko gushyiraho ubuhunikiro bwumisha ikoranabuhanga rikoresha imashini zumisha zishobora kwimukanwa mobile dryers mu ngengo y’imari y’uyu mwaka ubuhinzi bwongereweho miliyari zirimo miliyari frw zashyizwe gutunganya umusaruro kugira ntuzongere kwangirika andi mafaranga yashyizwe gutunganya ifumbire n’imbuto kugira biboneke bwinshi minisitiri dr ndagijimana yagize turiteguye umusaruro umeze neza nta kibazo cy’ibura ry’ibiryo’’ ku bijyanye n’ibiciro minisitiri dr ndagijimana yavuze umwaka watangiye biri hasi ariko mpera zawo bikazamuka ati mu ukuboza ibiciro byagiye hasi kandi twizeye mutarama bizakomeza kugabanuka bitewe n’umusaruro uhari dufite imibare myiza twejeje igabanuka ry’ibiciro’’ nisr igaragaza ibiciro by’ibicuruzwa by’imbere gihugu byazamutseho ugereranyije n’umwaka ushize ugereranyije n’ukwezi gushize gihe ibiciro by’ibicuruzwa bitumizwa mahanga byazamutseho ugereranyije n’umwaka ushize ugereranyije n’ukwezi gushize naho ibiciro by’ibicuruzwa by’umwimerere fresh products bihingwa gihugu nk’ibishyimbo imboga hateganywa guhingwa hegitari ibihumbi wongeyeho by’ubuso bwahujwe buhingwaho n’ubwakuwe nzuri burasirazuba bungana

title: ibyaranze iminota nyuma y’ubuzima george floyd wishwe n’umuporisi umeze nk’inyamaswa reba hano
content: ubuzima busa n’ubwahagaze leta zunze ubumwe z’amerika kubera imyigaragambyo kwamagana urupfu rw’umunyamerika w’umugabo ufite inkomoko afurika wapfiriye maboko polisi george floyd ufite imyaka y’amavuko yapfuye nyuma gutabwa yombi polisi hanze y’iduka ryo mujyi minneapolis leta minnesota amashusho agaragaza gutabwa yombi kwe itariki y’uku gatanu yerekana umupolisi w’umuzungu derek chauvin atsikamira ijosi bwana floyd gihe yatsikamiriwe hasi bwana chauvin w’imyaka yamaze kuregwa urupfu rwe ibihe bikuru byagejeje rupfu bwana floyd byabaye minota gusa dushingiye byavuzwe n’abatangabuhamya amashusho n’amatangazo yatanzwe n’abategetsi dore tuzi kugeza byatangiriye kivugwa inoti mpimbano y’amadolari ikirego kijyanye n’iyo noti cyatanzwe mugoroba itariki y’ukwezi gatanu bwana floyd yaguraga ipaki y’itabi ry’isigara cigarettes iduka ryitwa cup foods ricuruza imboga mu kwibwira inoti amaze guhabwa y’amadolari mpimbano umukozi iryo duka yahise atanga ikirego polisi bwana floyd amaze imyaka myinshi mujyi minneapolis nyuma kwimuka iwabo ivuko mujyi houston leta texas hari hashize igihe akora ’bouncer’ gucunga umutekano nzu z’ibitaramo mujyi ariko kimwe n’abanyamerika bandi benshi yahindutse umushomeri bitewe n’iki cyorezo coronavirus bwana floyd asanzwe umukiliya uhoraho w’iryo duka cup foods yari umukiliya mwiza umenyerewe utari warigeze rimwe ahateza ikibazo nkuko mike abumayyaleh nyir’iryo duka yabibwiye televiziyo nbc amerika ariko nyir’iduka ntabwo kazi munsi uwo mukozi w’urubyiruko gutanga kirego noti atashize amakenga yakoze amabwiriza y’akazi asanzwe ateganya yahamagaye nimero isaha saa mbili n’umunota umwe z’ijoro zaho inyandiko-mvugo yatangajwe n’abategetsi ikubiyemo mukozi iduka yabwiye uwamwitabye yasabye mukiliya kumusubiza iryo tabi ry’isigara ariko ntabwo ashaka kubikora nkuko nyandiko ikubiyemo kiganiro kijyanye gutanga ikirego ikomeza ibivuga mukozi iduka avuga mugabo agaragara nk’uwasinze kandi ntiyibashije nyuma gato y’uko guhamagara saa mbili n’iminota z’ijoro abapolisi babiri barahageze bwana floyd yicaranye n’abandi bantu babiri modoka iparitse nyuma kwegera modoka umwe bapolisi witwa thomas lane yasohoye imbunda ategeka bwana floyd kumanika amaboko muri nyandiko-mvugo y’ibyabaye abashinjacyaha ntibasobanura impamvu bwana lane yasanze ngombwa asohora imbunda abashinjacyaha bavuga bwana lane yashyize ibiganza bye bwana floyd akamukurura akamuvana modoka nuko bwana floyd yirwanaho yanga gushyirwaho amapingu ariko amaze gushyirwaho amapingu bwana floyd yacishije macye akurikiza bwana lane yamusobanuriraga amubwira atawe yombi kubera gutanga inoti mpimbano kugundagurana byabaye abapolisi bageragezaga gushyira bwana floyd modoka ahagana isaha saa mbili n’iminota z’iryo joro bwana floyd yaragagaye atembagara butaka abwira abapolisi atinya kuba ahantu hafunganye nkuko nyandiko-mvugo ikomeza ibivuga bwana chauvin arahagera we n’abandi bapolisi bagize uruhare rindi gerageza ryo gushyira bwana floyd modoka polisi muri iryo gerageza ryabaye saa mbili n’iminota z’ijoro bwana chauvin yakuye bwana floyd ruhande rwerekeye bagenzi bituma yitura hasi nkuko nyandiko-mvugo ibivuga ahitura yubitse amaso amapingu akimuriho icyo gihe nibwo ababibonye batangiye gufata amashusho bwana floyd byagaragaraga ababaye cyane ’uburyo yapfuyemo burenze ukwemera’ ibyo bihe ako kanya byafashwe telefone zigendanwa nyinshi bigasakazwa mbuga nkoranyambaga byarangiye bibaye ibya nyuma umutima bwana floyd ugitera yacigatiwe n’abapolisi gihe bwana chauvin yamutsikamizaga ivi rye ry’ibumoso riri hagati y’umutwe n’ijosi bwana floyd muri mashusho bwana floyd akomeza kumvikana agira simbasha guhumeka agatabaza nyina nako atakamba nyabuneka nyabuneka nyabuneka mu gihe cy’iminota n’amasegonda bwana chauvin yagumishije ivi rye ijosi bwana floyd nkuko raporo y’ubushinjacyaha ibivuga hashize iminota gihe bwana floyd yataye ubwenge amashusho y’ibyabaye agaragaza gihe bwana floyd yacecetse abari bashungereye bakinginga abapolisi barebe umutima ugitera nuko umwe bapolisi bandi witwa ja kueng arabikora arebera mpera y’ikiganza cy’iburyo bwana floyd abura umutsi ariko nubundi abapolisi title: ubwicanyi bukorerwa abanyamulenge bugereranywa jenoside
content: abaturage bwoko bw’abanyamulenge bagera biciwe gitero cy’abitwaje intwaro ubu bwoko burashinja leta kuba ntacyo biyibwiye bakabona bwicanyi ntaho butandukaniye jenoside abanyamulenge bavuga baterwa n’abantu bafite bahuriye n’imitwe y’iterabwoba yatojwe gisirikare ngo baza bafite intwaro bagatwika bakica abaturage bamwe bagahungira mashyamba kurinda amagara ngo abenshi bicwa malariya cyangwa bakarumwa n’inzoka ziba mashyamba nyuma y’ubu bwicanyi bumaze igihe bubakorerwa batangiye gushinga imitwe y’ubwirinzi ariko abayigize bamenyekanye bahigwa cyane uyu mwanzuro kwirwanaho bawufashe kamena alexis byicaza umuyobozi w’ishyaka innovative forces for union of congolese democracy ubara makuru avuga bwicanyi bukorerwa abanyamurenge jenoside igamije kubatsemba bavuga bakunze guterwa n’aba mai mai ndetse n’abagize umutwe red tabura urwanya ubutegetsi bw’uburundi iyi mitwe ibiri ishinjwa igitero giherutse kugabwa i minembwe ’mulenge’ abasaga bakahasiga ubuzima ubwoko bw’abanyamulenge buba repubulika demukarasi congo ntara kivu y’amagepfo mupaka uhana imbi n’u rwanda n’ u burundi gace ’mulenge’ kari misozi uvira bafite ururimi bavuga rwabitiriwe rujya gusa n’ikirundi n’ikinyarwanda bagira kandi umwami wabo bwite

title: minisitiri biruta asanga uganda ifite ubushake ibibazo byayo n’u rwanda byakemuka cyumweru kimwe
content: kuwa gatanu tariki gashyantare nibwo inama yabereye i gatuna ihuje abayobozi b’u rwanda uganda angola repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo yahaye uganda ukwezi kumwe kugenzura ibirego repubulika y’u rwanda bikorwa bibera butaka bwayo by’imitwe ibangamiye guverinoma y’u rwanda byaba ukuri uganda igafata ingamba zose kubihagarika kwirinda byakongera kubaho nyuma hakabaho ibiganiro gufungura imipaka mu kiganiro majuscule propos televiziyo y’u rwanda cyavugaga bibazo by’u rwanda uganda cyatambutse cyumweru minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga dr vincent biruta yabajijwe cyizere cy’uko uganda yaba izubahiriza yasabwe kwezi kumwe yahawe asubiza ikibazo atari igihe kubikemura ahubwo ikibazo ubushake politiki yavuze u rwanda rusaba byumvikana kandi ibintu bitatwara icyumweru kimwe kugira bikemuke uganda iramutse ifite ubushake kubikemura ati njye ntekereza haba ubushake politiki bitajyaga gusaba iminsi kubera u rwanda rusaba birumvikana dufite abanyarwanda bafashwe gereza dusaba barekurwa turasaba gufata abanyarwanda kubatoteza buryo bunyuranyije n’amategeko bihagarara turasaba ibikorwa gushyigikira imitwe irwanya u rwanda bihagarara ndatekereza itari inakenewe ibintu abantu bakora cyumweru kimwe uganda bibazo by’ubukungu ndetse banki nkuru y’icyo gihugu iherutse kwerurira abagize inteko ishinga amategeko yaguye gihombo miliyoni z’amadorali amerika myaka ishize abasesenguzi basanga uganda ikeneye cyane umupaka ufungurwa nubwo n’abanyarwanda bawukeneye ku ruhande rumwe bisa nk’aho museveni yizeye inama iheruka isiga iwufunguye nkuko n’ubutumwa yanditse twitter bibugaragaza nyuma gato y’iyo nama yanditse mfitiye impuhwe abaturage uganda n’ab’u rwanda bagizweho ingaruka n’ifungwa ry’umupaka gatuna ndabasaza kwihangana gihe turi gushaka igisubizo kirambye nizeye ukuri kuzagaragara kubera guverinoma nrm ishyaka riri butegetsi ihagaze my sympathies go out to the citizens of uganda and rwanda that have been affected the closure of the katuna border i call upon you to patient as pursue a lasting solution i am very optimistic that the truth will come out because the nrm government stands for the truth pictwittercombtmktk yoweri k museveni kagutamuseveni february dr vincent biruta nama yabereye i gatuna yavuze abahuza bateguye gahunda irimo n’ikimenyetso kwambuka umupaka ariko abakuru b’ibihugu baza kuyihindura nyuma nabwo ikiganiro bihagaze perezida museveni gitutu gikomeye bisa nk’aho museveni yatekerezaga inama yabaye gatanu izafungura umupaka ariko si byagenze kuri hari igitutu ruhande rw’ubukungu nubwo n’abanyarwanda bawukeneye umupaka dr kimonyo asanga uganda yaratunguwe n’uburyo u rwanda rwitwaye bijyanye n’ifungwa ry’umupaka itangira gufata ibyemezo bitandukanye ati ikibazo gitangira uganda yaravuze u rwanda ruze rupfukame ariko ntibyashobotse ntabwo museveni yakuyeho pasiporo charlotte mukankusi ushinzwe dipolomasi mutwe w’iterabwoba rnc washinzwe kayumba nyamwasa ntabwo busa batangiye kurekura bamwe bafunze ndatekereza azakora asabwa bikenewe umupaka ufungurwa nkuko yabivuze hashize imyaka itatu hari ubwumvikane buke hagati y’ibihugu byombi u rwanda rushinja uganda gukorana gukingira ikibaba ibikorwa by’imitwe igamije kuruhungabanyiriza umutekano birimo iby’imitwe rnc fdlr rud urunana n’indi hari gufata gufunga abanyarwanda buryo bunyuranyije n’amategeko bagakorerwa iyicarubozo ndetse kubangamira ubucuruzi bwarwo intambwe imaze guterwa kuzahura umubano hagati y’ibihugu byombi irimo kurekura abaturage bafunzwe buri ruhande gusinya amasezerano guhererekanya abanyabyaha ibyo u rwanda rusaba uganda kimwe u rwanda rwari rwasabye mbere y’inama kane y’i gatuma gutesha agaciro pasiporo yahawe charlotte mukankusi rnc nayo yakoreshaga ngendo ze cyarubahirijwe u rwanda kandi rwari title: covid minisiteri y’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu irashima abantu bakomeje kugoboka bagenzi
content: mu gihe leta y’u rwanda ikomeje kugoboka abagizweho ingaruka n’icyorezo koronavirusi minisiteri y’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu irashima abantu b’ingeri zinyuranye bakomeje kugoboka bagenzi bikomeye bafasha kubona amafunguro imirimo yabaye ihagaze kubera ingamba kwirinda icyorezo kugoboka abatishoboye bisanzwe kimwe leta y’u rwanda ishyira imbere ndetse ikabinyuza gahunda zitandukanye muri gihe isi yugarijwe n’icyorezo covid- perezida repubulika paul kagame yahumurije abaturage abizeza leta itazabatererana ku munsi kabiri leta itangiye guha amafunguro imiryango itarashoboye gukomeza imirimo isanzwe ikora kubera ingamba kwirinda koronavirusi abaturage bagiye bishyira hamwe hakurikijwe amikoro bakusanya ibikenewe babisaranganya abaturage abo midugudu kabuhunde vision murenge kinyinya karere gasabo bavuze bikorwa ikimenyetso kigaragaza leta yita baturage uwajenesa marine yagize ubundi nakoraga imirimo ijyana n’ububumbyi kugira mbone kurya ariko yarahagaze sinabonaga kurya ariko iminsi igiye gukomeza yisunike nkaba nshimira abanteye inkunga’’ mu murenge gikomero ho abaturage bahawe inkunga y’ibiribwa bagenewe leta ibunganira minsi batakijya kwirwanaho gakimbagira joseph ’’nari mfite umushinga gukora amasabune ariko kubera ukuntu transiporo yahindutse ntabwo nkibona njya nyabugogo gushakayo ibikoresho bivuze icyari kintunze cyahagaze iyi nkunga irashimishije kuko leta iba yatwibutse ikabona dukwiye gukomezanya n’abandi buzima dushimiye leta n’umukuru w’igihugu udutekerezaho cyane’’ mu gahunda guhangana n’icyorezo covid- kandi urugaga rw’abatumiza n’abadandaza ibikomoka peteroli bunganiye ministeri y’ubuzima bayigemnnera inkunga ingana miliyoni zisaga z’amafaranga y’u rwanda azifashishwa n’ibinyabiziga bikoreshwa n’iyo minisiteri mutaganda eric akuriye urwo rugaga ’’twasabye minisiteri nkunga y’amavuta twabemereye bashobora kuza kuyakoresha guhera mbere ibinyabiziga minisiteri bizajya bikoresha cartes cyangwa vauchers’’ umunyamabanga leta minisiteri y’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu nyirarukundo ignatienne ashimira abagize uruhare gikorwa akavuga mijyi yunganira kigali ho byamaze gutegurwa ati ’’iki gikorwa twakibonyemo ubwitange n’imbaraga zikomeye hari abikorera bitanze n’abafite ibikoresho by’isuku abahinzi b’umuceri batanze umuceri mwishi ndetse n’amadini ariko tubasaba bikorerwa hamwe bikarangira none ariko yindi mijyi yunganira kigali ho barimo kwitegura’’ nta barura ryimbitswe ryakozwe hamenyekane umubare nyakuri w’abagomba guhabwa nkunga mujyi kigali cyane gikorwa cy’ubufasha cyaje gitunguranye ariko umunyamabanga leta minaloc agenekereje avuga abagomba gufashwe hagati by’abatuye umujyi kigali denis fabrice nsengumuremyi muhaburarw

title: umufaransa gianadda christus regnat bishimiwe gitaramo bahuriyemo i kigali amafoto
content: iki gitaramo cyabereye kigali conference and exhibition village camp kigalimu ijoro ryo gatandatu tariki ukwkaira cyitabiriwe rwego hejuru n’ab’ingeri zitandukanye barimo abana urubyiruko abakuru abakecuru n’abasaza abanyamahanga bashimishijwe kwihera ijisho umuziki kera wanyuraga amatwi n’imitima benshi ngoboka cyriaque uyoboye gitaramo niwe wabanje kujya rubyiniro ashyira abantu mwuka w’umuziki w’umwimerere uyu mugabo ntabwo yamaze igihe kinini rubyiniro wenyine kuko yahise ahamagara abacuranzi ndetse n’abandi baririmbyi korali christus regnat batambuka gake gake baza byicaro byabo imbere iyi korali imaze kuririmba indirimbo yahamagaye umukobwa witwa samantha amufasha kubwira abantu ibigwi christus regnat n’ibindi byerekeye igitaramo abaririmbyi bahise bakomeza baririmba indirimbo eshanu bahereye yitwa kumbaya’ y’itsinda peter paul mary yitwa christus regnat’ ivuga ibyiza byayo n’izindi zivanzemo iz’ikinyarwanda jean claude gianadda wakurikiyeho yishimirwa ndirimbo ze zitandukanye zirimo trouver dans ma vie ta prsence’ qu’il est formidable d’aimer’ marie tendresse dans nos vies’ magnificat’ n’izindi nyinshi uyu muhanzi gufashwa korali christus regnat yasozaga kuririmba indirimbo yakomerwaga amashyi y’urufaya ubona abitabiriye gitaramo banyuzwe n’umuziki yageze afata gitari yanditseho amazina ayongera birungo by’umuziki christus regnat uryoheye amatwi buryo buhambaye iki gitaramo christus regnat cyari kigamije gukusanya inkunga gufasha ikigo cyita bana bafite ubumuga babarizwa centre inshuti zacu i gahanga’ murenge gahanga karere kicukiro mu bitanze harimo jean claude gianadda watanze sheki y’amayero gufasha centre inshuti zacu kuko ukwemera gukwiye guherekezwa n’ibikorwa igitaramo gihumuje musenyeri antoine kambanda yahawe ijambo ashimira jean claude gianadda ndetse anibutsa abantu iby’ukwezi kudasanzwe kw’iyogezabutumwa ati wakoze jean claude gianadda kuba waje gitaramo n’abandi ndabashimira cyane kuba mwaje ni umugisha n’ibyishimo bikomeye sinzi mubizi turi kwezi kudasanzwe kw’iyogezabutumwa isi uburyo kwizihiza imyaka y’ibaruwa ikomeye yanditswe papa benedigito atangaza kandi atuma intumwa kujya isi yanavuze gikorwa cyiza gufasha cyari byatumye gitaramo gitekerezwa cyane kuko umuntu abana n’ubumuga akwiriye gushyigikirwa ati muzi gitaramo kigamije igikorwa cy’urukundo bariya bana bafite ubumuga iyo umuntu adafite amaguru abayafite tuba dufite inshingano kumugeza ashaka kujya adafite amaboko abayafite tuba dufite inshingano kuyamubera na bariya bana badafite amahirwe kubona ibyangombwa by’ubuzima twebwe bireba jean claude gianadda nk’umushyitsi mukuru gitaramo niwe wihariye igihe kinini kuririmba uyu musaza wanyuze benshi yavutse bufaransa afite imyaka yabaye umwarimu siyansi n’umuyobozi w’ishuri koleji saint bruno i marseille bufaransa kugeza uyu muhanzi w’umunyabigwi yashyize hanze album mbere yafatanyaga kuririmba kwigisha ku myaka y’amavuko yasezeye umwuga w’ubwarimu afata inzira kuririmba nk’ubutumwa bwe bw’ibanze kiliziya gatolika jean claude gianadda nk’umuririmbyi yakoze indirimbo nyinshi cyane zikubiye album zirenga ni abahanzi bake isi bafite aka gahigo yaririmbye indirimbo zirimo tiens ma lampe allume’ jsus me voici devant toi’ trouver dans ma vie ta prsence’ n’izindi yashyize hanze album qu’il est formidable d’aimer’ prs de toi marie’ n’izindi yashinze umuryango witwa association jeunesse et culture saint-bruno’ intego nyamukuru zawo zigabanyije bice bibiri birimo kwibanda guteza imbere indirimbo zisingiza imana mu buzima busanzwe afasha abababaye haba gihugu cye kavukire n’ahandi isi korali christus regnat yamutumiye yashinzwe ivukira centre christus i remera mujyi kigali kuva ibarizwa paruwasi yitiriwe umwamikazi w’amahoro regina pacis i remera ubu ifite imizingo itandatu y’indirimbo zabo buryo bw’amajwi gihe imaze gukora ibitaramo bikomeye bine amafoto niyonzima mose

title: abahanzi basuye urwibutso jenoside ntarama n’urwa nyamata
content: abahanzi batorewe gukomeza cyikiro kabiri bitabiriye urwo rugendo usibye knowless bubiligi kwitabira gahunda zijyanye kwibuka nk’uko umujyanama manager abitangaza abo bahanzi babanje gusura urwibutso ntarama basobanuriwe amateka yaho ndetse n’iyicwarubozo ryahabereye basobanuriwe ukuntu mbere jenoside abatutsi bahigwaga ariko uwabaga yahungiye kiriziya ntacyo yabaga ibyo byatumye jenoside benshi bahungira kiriziya bizeye gukira nk’uko byagendaga mbere ariko siko byagenze kuko bamaze kwirundiramo interahamwe zabasanzemo zibica urw’agashinyaguro abatutsi bahungiye kiriziya central ntarama babanje kwihagararaho ariko bigeze itariki nibwo abasirikare n’interahamwe baje banakoresha n’ibisasu kuburyo haguye abagera mu rwibutso ntarama hari imibiri y’abatutsi bazize jenoside kandi hagaragara bimwe bikoresho byifashishwa rugo baje bitwaje cyangwa se bahunganye kuko batekerezaga igihe kizagera bagasubira mungo zabo hagaragara kandi n’imyenda biteye agahinda buri munyarwanda wese ava akagera yagombye kugira ntibizongere ukundi nyangezi freddy umwe baherekeje abahanzi akaba uhagarariye bralirwa gikorwa yagize kwibuka igikorwa buri wese ku ruhande rwacu bralirwa igikorwa twubaha cyane uretse guteza imbere abahanzi tugomba kubigisha amateka bralirwa yubatse inzibutso ebyiri jenoside zishyinguwemo abakozi bakoraga bralirwa bazize jenoside gisenyi kigali bralirwa kandi ikorana n’urwibutso gisozi rwego kugira busitani bwarwo hahore hasukuye ikindi abana b’imfuzi ababyeyi bishwe jenoside bakoraga bralirwa bishyurirwa amafaranga y’ishuri mashuri mato kugera secondaire ariko hari gahunda gutangira kubishyurira kaminuza ku rwibutso nyamata ahantu hafite amateka yihariye nk’uko abahanzi babisobanuriwe niho ha mbere haguye abatutsi benshi cyane gihugu abatutsi baguye hano nyamata barashinyaguriwe bitavugwa nyamata ituwe n’abatutsi barakuwe turere dutandukanye tw’amajyaruguru gisenyi ruhengeri rwego kugira bapfe kuko hari ishyamba habagamo inyamaswa nyinshi ndetse n’amasazi yateraga indwara tsetse hapfiriye benshi gihe mu mwaka habaye ubwicanyi bumeze nk’aho byari igeragezwa jenoside buhitana abatutsi bagera kandi ntawigeze ahanirwa ukwicwa kw’abo batutsi hari umuzungu w’umutariyanikazi utuye witwaga tonia locatelli bamwishe tariki bamuziza yababwiraga adashyigikiye iyicwa ry’abatutsi bahatuye buryo ndetse yaranatangiye kubatabariza miryango mpuzamahanga mu mwaka w’ haguye abatutsi barenga hakaba hashyinguye abagera muri bahashyinguye harimo umubyeyi witwaga mukandori annonciata wishwe abanje gufatwa ngufu n’interahamwe z’abagabo nyuma bamujomba igisongo gitsina kirakomeza gitunguka mutwe uwo ashyinguwe ukwe isanduku wenyine rwego kugira harusheho kugaragazwa ubugome bw’indengakamere bwakorewe mubyeyinyuma gusobanurirwa byinshi kwirebera n’amaso abahanzi bagize babivugaho ntakirutimana danny uzwi izina danny nanone yagize hari ikiyongereyeho kuko ubwa mbere nsuye nyamata hiyongereye mateka narinzi nk’uko jenoside yagizwe uruhare n’abahanzi ndateganya gukora indirimbo irimo ubutumwa ubutumwa natanga kubagezweho jenoside ukwihangana gukurikiza gahunda z’icyunamo kudaheranwa n’agahinda tukiyubaka ikivi cy’abacu tuzacyusa kandi ibyabaye ntibizongere buri muhanzi cyangwa se itsinda bagize bavuga kubyo bamaze kubwirwa ndetse kwirebera n’amaso dore magambo make ubutumwa bwatanzwe n’abahanzi nyuma gusura urwibutso ntarama n’urwa nyamata riderman yagize igihe kirageze dutange ubutumwa bwibaka banyarwanda king james ngiye kurushaho gutanga ubutumwa bwunga abanyarwanda ndirimbo zanjye bull dog abahanzi batanze ubutumwa bwanganisha abanyarwanda bakwiye kubiryozwa dream boys ijwi platini iti umuhanzi indorerwamo rubanda duharanire gusiga isi nziza kurusha twayisanze just family ijwi jimmy iti dukwiye guhindura amateka y’umuziki tukirinda ubutumwa busenya emmy yagize ibyo mbonye birandenze dukwiye gukora bwabaga kugira bitazongera young grace atinjye nari muto mbyumva mateka ariko abafana banjye n’abanyarwanda rusange nabakangurira kunga ubumwe bagakundana bakaba ubumwe jay polly iyo mbonye ibintu nkibi birandenga abakoze bashyiraga bikorwa ibitekerezo by’abategetsi babi twe twongere ingufu gushyira bikorwa iby’abayobozi beza badusaba danny dukwiye guharanira bitongera kubaho ukundi umuyobozi mukuru east african promotors yasobanuye impamvu bazanye bahanzi gusura inzibutso magambo ukugira batazakora batazanatekereza n’umunsi rimwe kuba bakora ibikorwa nk’ibi bashyigikira cyangwa bakaririmba ibikorwa nk’ibi kuko byatugejeje ahantu nakwita habi cyane ndasaba urubyiruko rusange igikorwa cyabaye rwanda cy’ubwicanyi bumeze gutya bw’indengakamere kitabaho ukundi marie clemence cyiza uwimanimpaye

utuwe n’abaturage ufatwa nk’umurwa mukuru w’u burayi kubera ariwo ubarizwamo ibikorwa by’inama y’ubujyanama bw’u burayi urukiko rw’u burayi rw’uburenganzira muntu inteko ishinga amategeko y’u burayi n’ibindi ni umujyi kandi ubarizwamo ibikorwa byinshi bibungabungwa unesco nk’umutungo kamere w’isi muri harimo cathdrale notre-dame de strasbourg n’agace gakundwa mukerarugendo kazwi kitwa petite france ni agace karimo imigezi myinshi ndetse myaka hambere kakundaga kubamo abarobyi cyane magingo gace gasurwa cyane strasbourg imiterere yako igaragaza imyubakire bufaransa kera kinyejana nayo mpamvu unesco yahisemo kugashyira duce tubungabunzwe kubera amateka yako naho cathdrale notre-dame de strasbourg igizwe n’inyubako zigaragaza amateka kera y’abaromani ndetse igaragazwa nk’urugero rwiza kwerekana amateka hambere dore myaka yabaye inzu mbere ndende isi ireshya metero uyu munsi kiliziya nsengero esheshatu ndende mateka y’isi ndetse yihariye agahigo kuba ariyo mbere ndende mateka y’isi yubatswe hagati y’ikinyejana gatanu n’icya umusizi victor hugo n’umudage goethe umwanditsi bakunze kuyigereranya n’igiti cy’imana bashaka kuvuga uburebure bwayo bitewe n’uko iteye ahantu hose hari umusozi mujyi uwugiyeho bituma umuntu abasha kuyibona neza ku bantu bakunda gutembera bihera amaso ibyiza bitatse isi umujyi mwiza cyane mu habaga inama nato barack obama chancelier w’u budage angela merkel bakoze urugendo rw’amateka n’amaguru bava strasbourg bagera kehl banyuze kiraro passerelle des deux rives cyubatswe nk’ikimenyetso cy’ubumwe burayi nta passport bisaba muntu ushaka gukora uru rugendo nk’urwabo ugera budage gace rhine alsace agace strasbourg kazwi ho kugira umuvinyo uryoheye ijigo ndetse n’inzoga nyinshi zituruka baturanyi b’abadage mu masaha y’ijoro usanga notre-dame hari abantu benshi gacupa bungurana ibitekerezo umujyi strasbourg guhera uyoborwa roland ries nyuma kuba umwarimu kaminuza strasbourg n’umusenateri aka karere imyaka icyenda amafoto karirima a ngarambe

title: antoine griezmann yamaze kwerekeza fc barcelona atletico igiye kugana inkiko
content: ikipe fc barcelone yamaze kwemeza yaguze rutahizamu mpuzamahanga w’umufaransa antoine griezmann wakiniraga atletico madrid iyi kipe y’i catalan yavuze yishyuye amasezerano griezmann asigaranye atletico yatanze miliyoni z’amayero gusa ruhande atltico madrid yavuze mafaranga make ndetse yiteguye kwitabaza inkikofc barcelone yatangaje yamaze gusinyisha antoine griezmann antoine griezmann afite amasezerano atletico madrid ageza kamena amafaranga yashyizweho ikipe yakwifuza kumugura miliyoni z’amayero ubu fc barcelone yatangaje igiciro gishya ikipe izifuza kumugura miliyoni z’amayero uyu mugabo wavukiye i mcon yatangiye gukina ruhago nk’uwabigize umwuga ikipe real sociedad yayikiniye imikino atsinda ibitego mbere kwerekeza murwa mukuru i madrid ikipe atletico yaje kwamamarira cyane atangiye gutozwa diego simeoneantoine griezmann amaze imyaka ikabakaba itanu atletico madrid antoine griezmann yafashije atletico madrid kugera mukino nyuma uefa champions league ndetse aza mwanya ballon d’or mwaka gihe kandi yanatsindiwe mukino nyuma w’igikombe cy’uburayi euro hamwe n’ikipe y’u bufaransa batsinzwe portugal hamwe atletico madrid yatsinze ibitego atanga imipira yavuyemo ibitego mikino yayikiniye mu gikombe cy’isi umwe bakinnyi b’inkingi mwamba bafashije ubufaransa kwegukana gikombe ndetse yanatowe nk’umukinnyi w’umukino mukino nyuma batsinzemo croitie life is all about second chances la vida tiene segundas oportunidades la vida t segones oportunitats antogriezmann a post shared fc barcelona fcbarcelona on jul at am pdt mu butumwa bwe mbere bwanyujijwe mbuga nkoranyambaga fc barcelone antoine griezmann yagize nkiri muto data yanyigishije gariyamoshi ihita inshuro gusa guhera igihe kirageze ngere ntego y’icyerekezo gishya inzira zacu birangiye zihuye nzarwanirira amabara barca n’umwete wanjye wose ni igihe cyacu ni inzira yacu muri bara byitezwe mufaransa azakorana inyabutatu ikaze y’ubusatirizi hamwe lionel messi luis suarez gihe ibya neymar bitarasobanuka neza griezmann kandi ashobora guhurira bene wabo b’abafaransa kipe barimo samuel umtiti clment lenglet jean-clair todibo ousmane dembl gihe baramuka bahagumye antoine griezmann yitezweho gufatanya messi suarez bagakaza ubusatirizi barca grizou nkuko bamwe nshuti ze bamwita ntabwo yigeze agaragara rimwe myitozo atletico yatangiye cyumweru gishize ashishikajwe kwihutisha gurwa rye ndetse hagiye havugwa umwuka mubi hagati y’amakipe yombi bijyanye kumvikana igurwa ry’uyu mukinnyi nyuma yaho fc barcelone itangaje yamaze kugura griezmann gatanu atltico madrid nayo yahise itangaza itangiye inzira kurengera inyungu zayo kipe y’i madrid ivuga mukinnyi yasheshe amasezerano buryo bubogamye yirengagije uruhande rumwe iyi kipe ivuga mufaransa barca bumvikanye mbere tariki nyakanga kandi gihe amafaranga gusohoka atletico miliyoni z’amayero kuba bityo kipe bita colchonero ikaba ivuga amafaranga yishyuwe barca make kugira irekure mukinnyi bafitanye amasezerano azageza

title: mineduc igiye gushyiraho sitati nshya igenga abarimu
content: ubwo yatangazaga ibyavuye manota y’abanyeshuri barangije amashuri abanza n’ay’icyiciro rusange umunyamabanga leta minisiteri y’uburezi olivier rwamukwaya yavuze kuba abanyeshuri baratsinze harimo n’umuhate mwarimu bityo akaba agomba gushimirwa minisiteri y’uburezi ivuga abarimu bagiye guhabwa sitati nshya ibagenga bitandukanye n’uko bafatwaga nk’abandi bakozi leta bigahura n’uko umwuga wabo wihariye mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru cyabaye kane cyicaro minisiteri y’uburezi umunyamabanga leta minisiteri olivier rwamukwaya yavuze hakomeje gutekerezwa ibyatuma abarimu barushaho gukora umwuga wabo bawishimiye yagize igishya giteganyijwe twizera gihe gito kiba cyashyizwe n’ahagaragara sitati yihariye y’abarimu ni kimwe bizabafasha kubona ibyatuma bitabwaho buryo bwihariye kubera n’umwuga wabo wihariye kugeza abarimu bahabwaga byose byashingiraga sitati igenga abakozi leta rusange rwamukwaya yakomeje agira bitewe n’umwihariko w’umwuga wabo minisiteri y’uburezi ifatanyije ministeri y’abakozi leta twarangije umushinga sitati yihariye y’abarimu izifashishwa kugira bazajya bagenerwa byihariye bijyanye n’umwuga wabo aha avugamo nko kuba abarimu bazajya bazamurwa ntera intambike cyangwa ngazi ibintu ubusanzwe bitajyaga bibahorwamukwaya yakomeje agira icyo gihe umwarimu azajya azamurwa ntera n’umushahara uzajya ugenda wiyongera bikurikije n’igihe amaze kazi buryo n’iyo yaba umwarimu ashobora kubona umushahara uruta uw’umuyobozi w’ishuri rwamukwaya yakomeje agira ikindi guhera mwaka tugiye kujya tubaha agahimbazamusyi ubundi kagenerwa buri mukozi wese leta wesheje neza imihigo ibi byarateganyijwe buryo nyuma kureba neza besheje imihigo abarimu bazajya babarirwa agahimbazamusyi minisiteri y’uburezi ivuga izakomeza gushyigikira koperative mwarimu sacco ariko abarimu bakanashishikarizwa gukoresha mahirwe kuko nubwo guverinoma ishyiramo amafaranga abarimu batarakangukira kuyibyaza umusaruro ku kijyanye n’iguriro ry’abarimu rwamukwaya yavuze hamaze gufatwa umurongo abarimu ubwabo bazakoresha inguzanyo koperative umwalimu sacco akaba bayitangiriza nk’uko bakora imishinga yindi ibabyarira inyungu ibi bitandukanye n’amasoko guverinoma ishyiriraho abasirikare n’abapolisi ahubwo azaba ahantu mwarimu ashobora kwerekana ikarita bakamuha ibicuruzwa gihe umushahara utaraboneka cyangwa agahabwa akeneye giciro kiri munsi y’icy’undi utari umunyamuryango amaduka nk’aya hari yamaze gutangizwa majyepfo majyaruguru nko karere musanze n’ubwo bitaragera hose mineduc isanganywe gahunda girinka mwarimu buri murezi wakoze neza agatsindisha isomo yigisha hakaba hari gahunda korohereza abarimu kubona mudasobwa binyuze umwalimu sacco amafaranga akagenda akatwa mushahara w’umukozi buri kweziyanditswe ubwanditsimuhaburarw

title: abahanzi basuye urwibutso jenoside ntarama n’urwa nyamata
content: abahanzi batorewe gukomeza cyikiro kabiri bitabiriye urwo rugendo usibye knowless bubiligi kwitabira gahunda zijyanye kwibuka nk’uko umujyanama manager abitangaza abo bahanzi babanje gusura urwibutso ntarama basobanuriwe amateka yaho ndetse n’iyicwarubozo ryahabereye basobanuriwe ukuntu mbere jenoside abatutsi bahigwaga ariko uwabaga yahungiye kiriziya ntacyo yabaga ibyo byatumye jenoside benshi bahungira kiriziya bizeye gukira nk’uko byagendaga mbere ariko siko byagenze kuko bamaze kwirundiramo interahamwe zabasanzemo zibica urw’agashinyaguro abatutsi bahungiye kiriziya central ntarama babanje kwihagararaho ariko bigeze itariki nibwo abasirikare n’interahamwe baje banakoresha n’ibisasu kuburyo haguye abagera mu rwibutso ntarama hari imibiri y’abatutsi bazize jenoside kandi hagaragara bimwe bikoresho byifashishwa rugo baje bitwaje cyangwa se bahunganye kuko batekerezaga igihe kizagera bagasubira mungo zabo hagaragara kandi n’imyenda biteye agahinda buri munyarwanda wese ava akagera yagombye kugira ntibizongere ukundi nyangezi freddy umwe baherekeje abahanzi akaba uhagarariye bralirwa gikorwa yagize kwibuka igikorwa buri wese ku ruhande rwacu bralirwa igikorwa twubaha cyane uretse guteza imbere abahanzi tugomba kubigisha amateka bralirwa yubatse inzibutso ebyiri jenoside zishyinguwemo abakozi bakoraga bralirwa bazize jenoside gisenyi kigali bralirwa kandi ikorana n’urwibutso gisozi rwego kugira busitani bwarwo hahore hasukuye ikindi abana b’imfuzi ababyeyi bishwe jenoside bakoraga bralirwa bishyurirwa amafaranga y’ishuri mashuri mato kugera secondaire ariko hari gahunda gutangira kubishyurira kaminuza ku rwibutso nyamata ahantu hafite amateka yihariye nk’uko abahanzi babisobanuriwe niho ha mbere haguye abatutsi benshi cyane gihugu abatutsi baguye hano nyamata barashinyaguriwe bitavugwa nyamata ituwe n’abatutsi barakuwe turere dutandukanye tw’amajyaruguru gisenyi ruhengeri rwego kugira bapfe kuko hari ishyamba habagamo inyamaswa nyinshi ndetse n’amasazi yateraga indwara tsetse hapfiriye benshi gihe mu mwaka habaye ubwicanyi bumeze nk’aho byari igeragezwa jenoside buhitana abatutsi bagera kandi ntawigeze ahanirwa ukwicwa kw’abo batutsi hari umuzungu w’umutariyanikazi utuye witwaga tonia locatelli bamwishe tariki bamuziza yababwiraga adashyigikiye iyicwa ry’abatutsi bahatuye buryo ndetse yaranatangiye kubatabariza miryango mpuzamahanga mu mwaka w’ haguye abatutsi barenga hakaba hashyinguye abagera muri bahashyinguye harimo umubyeyi witwaga mukandori annonciata wishwe abanje gufatwa ngufu n’interahamwe z’abagabo nyuma bamujomba igisongo gitsina kirakomeza gitunguka mutwe uwo ashyinguwe ukwe isanduku wenyine rwego kugira harusheho kugaragazwa ubugome bw’indengakamere bwakorewe mubyeyinyuma gusobanurirwa byinshi kwirebera n’amaso abahanzi bagize babivugaho ntakirutimana danny uzwi izina danny nanone yagize hari ikiyongereyeho kuko ubwa mbere nsuye nyamata hiyongereye mateka narinzi nk’uko jenoside yagizwe uruhare n’abahanzi ndateganya gukora indirimbo irimo ubutumwa ubutumwa natanga kubagezweho jenoside ukwihangana gukurikiza gahunda z’icyunamo kudaheranwa n’agahinda tukiyubaka ikivi cy’abacu tuzacyusa kandi ibyabaye ntibizongere buri muhanzi cyangwa se itsinda bagize bavuga kubyo bamaze kubwirwa ndetse kwirebera n’amaso dore magambo make ubutumwa bwatanzwe n’abahanzi nyuma gusura urwibutso ntarama n’urwa nyamata riderman yagize igihe kirageze dutange ubutumwa bwibaka banyarwanda king james ngiye kurushaho gutanga ubutumwa bwunga abanyarwanda ndirimbo zanjye bull dog abahanzi batanze ubutumwa bwanganisha abanyarwanda bakwiye kubiryozwa dream boys ijwi platini iti umuhanzi indorerwamo rubanda duharanire gusiga isi nziza kurusha twayisanze just family ijwi jimmy iti dukwiye guhindura amateka y’umuziki tukirinda ubutumwa busenya emmy yagize ibyo mbonye birandenze dukwiye gukora bwabaga kugira bitazongera young grace atinjye nari muto mbyumva mateka ariko abafana banjye n’abanyarwanda rusange nabakangurira kunga ubumwe bagakundana bakaba ubumwe jay polly iyo mbonye ibintu nkibi birandenga abakoze bashyiraga bikorwa ibitekerezo by’abategetsi babi twe twongere ingufu gushyira bikorwa iby’abayobozi beza badusaba danny dukwiye guharanira bitongera kubaho ukundi umuyobozi mukuru east african promotors yasobanuye impamvu bazanye bahanzi gusura inzibutso magambo ukugira batazakora batazanatekereza n’umunsi rimwe kuba bakora ibikorwa nk’ibi bashyigikira cyangwa bakaririmba ibikorwa nk’ibi kuko byatugejeje ahantu nakwita habi cyane ndasaba urubyiruko rusange igikorwa cyabaye rwanda cy’ubwicanyi bumeze gutya bw’indengakamere kitabaho ukundi marie clemence cyiza uwimanimpaye

title: abarundi nkambi y’impunzi uganda batawe yombi bashinjwa kuba intasi z’u rwanda
content: abarundi bane babarizwa nkambi y’impunzi nakivale uganda batawe yombi abandi babiri baratoroka bashinjwa kuba intasi z’u rwanda ikinyamakuru sos mdias burundi cyanditse kane tariki werurwe ahagana saa tanu gitondo abapolisi uganda bateye ahantu hari hari itsinda ry’urubyiruko rw’impunzi z’abarundi imbere nkambi nakivale ibarizwamo abantu batandukanye bihugu karere afurika y’uburasirazuba ababonye biba bavuga urwo rubyiruko rwari ruri kuganiraga bisanzwe kintu kimwe kiruhangayikishije nyuma bagatungurwa kubona batangiye gufatwa n’abapolisi n’abakozi b’inzego z’ubutasi
