title: allain jupp avuga atahakanye jenoside ahubwo yayemeye kuba
content: jupp avuga mwaka w’ butumwa bw’inteko ishinga amategeko yasobanuye yakoresheje ijambo jenoside kuya gicurasi nama y’abagize akanama k’abaminisitiri b’u burayi yabereye i buruseli bubiligi ikinyamakuru survie dukesha nkuru gitangaza alain jupp yaba yaratangaje nyuma y’uko uwari umunyamabanga mukuru loni gihe boutros boutros ghali yatangaje ibiri kuba rwanda atari ubwicanyi busanzwe ahubwo jenoside iki kinyamakuru gikomeza gitangaza minisitiri jupp yaba yaratangaje gihe jenoside rwanda igeze hagati ikorwa kandi n’igihe cyari gishize kikaba cyari gihe gikomeye cyane kuko aricyo cyishwemo abantu benshi aha bakaba bibaza bitaba ugusubiza ubwenge gihe igihe cyarenze prise de conscience tardive aha bavuga guverinoma y’u bufaransa rwanda gihe jenoside iriho itegurwa kandi ntacyo yakoze ibe yahagarika ubwicanyi bwatangiye tariki mata survie ikomeza ivuga gihe jenoside yakorerwaga abatutsi iriho kuba itariki mata jupp minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga w’u bufaransa hamwe l’lyse ingoro perezida w’u bufaransa bakiriye jrme bicamumpaka minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga w’u rwanda gihe jenoside ndetse jean-bosco barayagwiza umurwanashyaka w’ishyaka cdr aha bakaba bavuga icyiswe opration turquoise yazanywe n’ingabo z’abafaransa itariki kamena yafashije abari bamaze gukora jenoside guhungira cyahoze cyitwa zare akaba repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo muri babashije guhungishwa n’abafaransa havugwamo thodore sindikubwabo umukuru w’u rwanda gihe jenoside ndetse jrme bicamumpaka umaze amezi abiri yakiriwe jupp mu gihe cy’uruzinduko mbere perezida kagame yagiriye bufaransa kwezi gushize jupp yatangaje adashobora guhindura imyumvire jenoside raporo yitiriwe mucyo’ kubera izina ry’uwari umuyobozi w’iyo komisiyo mucyo jean de dieu yerekana alain jupp yagize uruhare bikorwa bitandukanye muri harimo kuba yarakoranye atizigamye guverinoma yakoraga jenoside iyo raporo kandi ivuga kuba tariki mata alain jupp yarakiriye jrme bicamumpaka jean bosco barayagwiza guverinoma y’abatabazi ikibazo gikomeye kuko umuryango mpuzamahanga warafashe icyemezo guha akato guverinoma ndetse u bubiligi leta zunze ubumwe z’amerika bakaba bamaze kubigaragaza bima viza bagabo inkuru dukesha igihecom

title: ikawa n’icyayi ibihingwa bifitiye runini u rwanda
content: nk’uko ntakirutimana corneille umuyobozi mukuru wungurije ushinzwe kuzamura umusaruro w’ibyoherezwa mahanga rwanda kigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe kwita byoherezwa mahanga naeb abitangaza bihingwa nibyo byinjiza amadevize menshi ugereranije n’ibindi byoherezwa mahanga bivuye rwanda ibi bihingwa kandi bigirira akamaro kanini umuhinzi wabyo kuko bimuzanira amafaranga kugeza umuhinzi w’icyayi ahabwa amafaranga ijana kiro cy’amababi y’icyayi kigero cy’ubwiza kiri hagati naho cyayi kiri bwiza kugeza umuhinzi ahabwa amafaranga kiro ariko hari n’inganda zimwe zishobora kuyarenza muri mwaka igiciro cy’ikawa cyavuye mafaranga kiro cy’ibitumbwe kigera mafaranga ibi bikaba biterwa n’uko igiciro cy’ikawa cyagiye kizamuka masoko mpuzamahanga amafaranga avuye bihingwa afasha abahinzi kongera umusaruro ndetse kwikenura kuko umuhinzi aguriwe giciro cyiza agira umwete kongera umusaruro kugira yeze byinshibimwe bihugu kawa ikunze kugurishwamo harimo leta zunze ubumwe z’amarikaubuyapani ndetse bimwe bihugu by’iburayi icyayi gikunze kubona amasoko bihugu by’abayisiramu iby’abarabu ndetse bimwe bihugu by’iburayi nk’uko corneille aritangaza abanyarwanda ntibitabira cyane kunywa icyayi n’ikawa avuga abanyanyarwanda bakwiriye kuba isoko ry’ibyo beza ntibatege amasoko banyamahanga gusa umwaka ushize umusaruro w’icyayi woherejwe hanze urenga toni zinjije akayabo kagera miliyoni z’amadorari y’amerika umusaruro kawa woherejwe hanze ugera toni zinjije miliyoni z’amadorari y’amerika corneille avuga bihingwa bifasha cyane igihugu kuko bituma ubukungu bw’igihugu kuzamuka ndetse bigatuma u rwanda rugira ijambo rwego mpuzamahanga aya madevize kandi afasha u rwanda kugura ibicuruzwa rukura hanze rudahenzwe avuga u rwanda rweza umusaruro muke ugereranyije n’ibihugu duturanye ariko icyari n’ikawa by’u rwanda bifite uburyohe kurusha bihugu nk’uko ntakirutimana corneille yabidutangarije ikawa zihingwa gihugu hose ariko zibanze cyane ntara y’amajyepfo ndetse n’iy’iburengerazuba kuko ariho hari ubuso bunini bw’iki gihingwa icyayi kibanze ahanini ntara y’uburengerazuba misozi miremire y’isunzu congo nil ndetse n’iy’amajyepfo y’u rwanda cyane turere twa nyaruguru nyamagabe mu ntara y’iburengerazuba hari inganda esheshatu hakaba hanateganywa kubakwa izindi nganda eshatu rwego kuzamura ubwiza bw’umusaruro w’icyayi mu ntara y’amajyaruguru hari inganda z’icyayi mulindi gicumbi sorwathe karere rulindo mu rwego kongera umusaruro uturuka bihingwa ndetse n’ibindi byoherezwa mahanga imboga imbuto n’ibireti harateganywa kongerwa ubuso bihingwaho gihugu hose urugero ntara y’amajyepfo n’iy’iburengerazuba hegitali ziziyongera hegitali zisanzwe cyayi hari ubutaka gishwati bugera hegitali bugahingwaho icyayi ikawa hakazongerwaho hegitali zahingwaga iyi gahunda ikazakorwa mwaka - abaturage bakaba basabwa kuzitabira guhinga bihingwa rwego kurushaho kwizamura kuzamura umusaruro w’ibyoherezwa mahanga rusange imboga imbuto ndetse n’ibireti nabyo bizongererwa ubuso ndetse cyane ntara y’amajyaruguru ndetse ntara y’uburengerazuba bw’amajyaruguru safari viateur

content: guverinoma y’u rwanda yasinyanye amasezerano y’ubufatanye n’ikigega banki y’isi cy’imari gitera inkunga imishinga y’ishoramari ifc agamije kurufasha kubaka inzu ziciriritse i kinyinya mujyi kigali aya masezerano yashyizweho umukono kabiri muhango wahuriranye n’itangizwa ry’inama y’iterambere ry’ubukungu afurika dff yitabiriwe n’abantu barenga uyu mushinga uzashyirwa bikorwa bufatanye ifc ikigo cy’igihugu cy’ubwiteganyirize rwanda rssb banki itsura amajyambere y’u rwanda brd n’ikigo cy’abashinwa kizobereye bwubatsi broad homes industrial international co ltd biteganyijwe uzasozwa huzuye inyubako zirimo guturamo n’izigenewe ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi kinyinya uyu mushinga uzungukiramo abagera uzatwara asaga miliyoni akabakaba miliyari frw visi perezida ushinzwe itumanaho n’imikoranire ifc karin finkelston yavuze abikorera bafite uruhare kunoza imiturire mijyi afurika yagize ifc ishyigikira imishinga igamije kwagura uburyo bw’imiturire kwegereza abaturage afurika inzu nziza kandi ziciriritse mu myaka ishize ikigega mpuzamahanga gitsura amajyambere ida n’igitanga ingwate miga ifc byatanze miliyari ishoramari ry’abikoreraminisitiri w’imari n’igenamigambi dr uzziel ndagijimana yatangaje imiturire ikirimo icyuho kinini ariko hari ingamba zafashwe ati muri gahunda guverinoma y’imyaka irindwi harimo iyihariye kunoza imiturire kigali mijyi iyunganira dufitanye ubufatanye banki y’isi hari imishinga ibiri igiye gutangira irimo uwa kinyinya tumaze gusinya amasezerano y’ibanze turateganya gushyiraho ikigega cyihariye giteza imbere imiturire mijyi kizatangirana banki y’isi iheruka guha u rwanda miliyoni azashorwa bikorwa remezo birimo imihanda ireshya n’ibilometero izubakwa mijyi itandatu yunganira kigaliagace kinyinya kagenewe inzu guturamo zigezweho inkuru igihe

title: banki y’isi yemeje umushinga miliyoni uzahuriza imipaka y’u rwanda-drc-uganda bucuruzi
content: kuri mbere ubuyobozi banki y’isi bwemeje inkunga miliyoni z’amadolari amerika agiye gushyigikira umushinga koroshya ubucuruzi bwambukiranya imipaka karere k’ibiyaga bigari cyane cyane u rwanda repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo drc ugandabanki y’isi ivuga mushinga wiswe great lakes trade facilitation project uzafasha abacuruzi bambukiranya imipaka n’imiryango bagera bihumbi bakabona ibibatunga bihagije akazi ndetse bigateza imbere imibereho y’abatuye akarere rusange mu itangazo banki y’isi yasohoye yavuze mushinga uzatera ingabo bitugu cyane cyane abacuruzi biganjemo abakora ubucuruzi buto n’ubuciriritse n’abagore ni umushinga kandi uzafasha guteza imbere amasoko yegereye imipaka kandi biteze imbere urujya n’uruza rw’abantu ibicuruzwa serivise ndetse bifashe inzego leta zegereye zegereye imipaka kurushaho kwagura kunoza serivise zitanga makhtar diop umuyobozi banki y’isi wungirije ishami afurika yavuze ibihugu by’u rwanda drc uganda biri mushinga bisangiye imbogamizi bucuruzi bityo kuzikemura hagomba kubaho uburyo bukomatanyije kubikemura umushinga great lakes trade facilitation uje usa n’uwuzuza umuyobozi banki y’isi jim yong kim yemeye ruzinduko rw’akazi bihugu by’u rwanda drc uganda mwaka rwego gushyigikira amahoro umutekano n’iterambere karere ngo hatoranyijwe umushinga w’ubucuruzi bwambukiranya imipaka kuko basanze ushobora guteza imbere abaturage ukabahuza n’amasoko y’akarere kandi ukarushaho gushimangira ubuhahirane aha banki y’isi itanga urugero mupaka muto petite barrire uhuza gisenyi rwanda goma drc munsi hatambuka baturage hagati y’ibihumbi bajya kurangura cyangwa gushaka abaguzi anabel gonzalez umuyobozi mukuru banki y’isi ushinzwe ubucuruzi asanga mushinga mushya uzazana ituze karere kuko uzateza imbere imibereho y’abaturiye imipaka ukoroshya ubucuruzi bwambukiranya imipaka ndetse ugakomeza ubwisanzure bukungu binyuze guhuza ibikorwa remezo politile n’imikorere amafaranga yateganyirijwe mushinga azakoreshwa kubaka ibikorwa remezo n’ibikoresho bizafasha kunoza kurinda urujya n’uruza rw’abantu n’ibintu n’ibinyabiziga by’ubucuruzi byambukiranya imipaka ngo hazanazamurwa umutekano w’abacuruzi bato bubakirwa inzira zabo zihariye amatara camera ndetse n’inzu z’ububiko bufite umutekano bazajya babikamo ibicuruzwa byabo banki y’isi ikizera guteza imbere ibikorwa remezo kuvugurura imikorere mipaka bizafasha abacuruzi bato cyane cyane abagore bakunze kwibasirwa n’ihohoterwa ifatwa ngufu kwakwa ruswa y’igitsina ngufu indatwanet

title: ibinini ibuprofen byatangiye kugeragezwa kuvura coronavirus
content: itsinda ry’abaganga bitaro by’i londres bizera muti usanzwe ukoreshwa kugabanya ububabare wakwifashishwa gufasha abantu barwaye coronavirus bafite ibibazo by’ubuhumekero bizera muti ihendutse iboneka isoko ushobora gufasha abarwayi buryo batashyirwa mashini zibongerera umwuka mu bushakashatsi bwabo abazabukorerwaho barwaye bazahabwa muti bawufatanye n’ubufasha basanzwe bahabwa n’ibitaro ubushakashatsi bwakorewe nyamaswa bwagaragaje muti ushobora gufasha bijyanye n’ibibazo by’ubuhumekero kimwe bibazo abarwaye coronavirus bahura nabyo prof mitul mehta wigisha king’s college london yavuze bakeneye gukora igerageza kugira babone ibimenyetso nyabyo bihura n’ibyo bakeka ikoreshwa ry’uyu muti ubwo cyorezo cyadukaga isi hari impungenge umuti ibuprofen ushobora kugira ingaruka buzima bw’abantu bafite ibimenyetso by’iki cyorezominisitiri w’ubuzima bufaransa oliver veran yigeze kuvuga gukoresha muti byakongera ibibazo muntu urwaye cyorezo ahubwo byarutwa gukoresha paracetamol nyuma abahanga baje kwemeza paracetamol ishobora kwifashishwa kuvura ibimenyetso coronavirus harimo nko kugabanya umuriro ndetse yanafasha abarwaye ibicurane

title: mu masaha macye itorero inyamibwa rirakora igitaramo gikomeye inkera i rwanda
content: iki gitaramo giteganyijwe cyumweru tariki kibere ihema rinini ryahahoze hitwa camp kigali kcev kigali cultural exhibition village munyaneza landry umuyobozi witorero inyamibwa yatangaje biteguye cyane gitaramo bise inkera i rwanda kwinjira ukwishyura itike yibihumbi bitanu frw myanya isanzwe ibihumbi icumi frw myanya yicyubahiro ndetse hanateguwe ameza afite imyanya ihwanye namafaranga yu rwanda ibihumbi ijana mirongo itanu frw kugeza amatike yatangiye kugurishwa amatike kuboneka simba super market gishushu kicukiro kimironko wayasanga kandi camilia tea house chic kisimenti utc ahandi wayakura sawa city super market i nyabugogo station engin kanogo ahateganye carwash aho wagura itike incamake yamateka yitorero inyamibwa itorero inyamibwa ryatangiye mwaka ritangijwe nabanyeshuri babaga aerg kaminuza nkuru yu rwanda rifite intego kwimakaza umuco nyarwanda abarigize baje gusanga bashobora kubyaza umusaruro ubuhanga bafite kwimakaza umuco ndirimbo mbyino batangiye kujya ahabona barakundwa none bamaze kuba ubukombe iri torero ryatangiye gutera imbere buhoro buhoro kubera kugira ibikorwa byiza ritangira gukorana kaminuza bikorwa byayo bitandukanye kugeza ryatangiye gusa nk’aho ryo kaminuza nako ryagiye ryaguka cyane mubare w’abanyamuryango kugeza inyamibwa zigizwe n’ibyiciro by’abanyamuryango habarirwamo bamwe bariciyemo kera mirimo yubuzima busanzwe ndetse n’abakiri ngamba ariko bakaba bahurira bikorwa bitandukanye bibahuza abanyamuryango bakiri ngamba bagera abafite indi mirimo bakagera ndetse banarenga ubu itorero risigaye ribamo abanyamuryango kaminuza zitandukanye kuko kaminuza yahurijwe hamwe bituma naryo risigaye ribarizwa kigali ariko huye hose rikaba rihafite icyicaro itorero inyamibwa rigiye gukorera i kigali igitaramo gikomeye nyuma yibindi binyuranye baherutse gukorera i burayi bihugu bitandukanye nku bufaransa u bubiligi espagne bagaragaje ibyiza bihatswe numuco nyarwanda ndetse bakumbuza benshi u rwanda muhamirizo nimbyino gakondo cyane cyane abanyarwanda bihugu itorero inyamibwa ryari i burayi ryari ryitabiriye iserukiramuco ryiswe iry’amajyepfo festival du sud ryabaye taliki kamena kugeza taliki kanama ryitabiriwe namatorero atandukanye migabane hagamijwe guhuriza hamwe imico kuyiha agaciro iserukiramuco festival du sud ryo mwaka naryo itorero inyamibwa rikubutsemo ryari ryitabiriwe nibihugu birimo u rwanda argentine chili chypre y’amajyaruguru el salvador indoneziya irlande kzakhstan mexique mongolie u burusiya seribiya

title: centre afurikaumuyobozi w’ishami polisi onu yasuye abapolisi b’u rwanda butumwa bw’amahoroamafoto
content: ku gicamunsi kane tariki nzeri nibwo maj gen lus carrilho umuyobozi w’ishami polisi muryango w’abibumbye onu kumwe brig gen ossama el moghazy umuyobozi wungirije w’intumwa z’umuryango w’abibumbye ziri butumwa bw’umuryango w’abibumbye kugarura amahoro kubumbatira umutekano gihugu repubulika santrafurika munisca basuye abapolisi b’u rwanda butumwa bw’amahoro gihugu aba bayobozi kandi kumwe colonel martin faye umuyobozi wungirije ushinzwe ibikorwa polisi ntumwa z’umuryango w’abibumbye zishinzwe kubungabunga kugarura amahoro gihugu repubulika santrafurika minusca uru ruzinduko rw’icyumweru kimwe muyobozi agiriye gihugu rwatangiye mbere tariki nzeri agamije guhura n’abayobozi bakuru b’intumwa z’umuryango w’abibumbye zirimo kubungabunga amahoro gihugu ndetse gusura abayobozi b’amashami agize minusca maj gen luis carrilho ijambo rye yashimiye abapolisi b’u rwanda butumwa kugarura amahoro repubulika santrafurika avuga ubunyamwuga bwabo n’umuhate bibaranga bituma babasha kuzuza neza inshingano bahawe yagize gukora cyane kwitanga ndetse n’umuhate biranga abapolisi b’u rwanda butumwa gihugu kubashimira mufite uruhare runini kubumbatira amahoro n’umutekano w’abaturage gihugu nzi neza ireme ry’umurimo mukora kandi mbikuye mutima ndabizeza abapolisi b’u rwanda ntagereranywa butumwa bw’umuryango w’abibumbye twishimiye ukuntu mwatwakiriye nkambi yanyu yakomeje asaba abapolisi b’u rwanda gukomeza ubunyamwuga ndetse n’ubushobozi bubaranga kurwanya ihohotera rishingiye gitsina rwego gukomeza guhesha isura nziza u rwanda ndetse n’umuryango w’abibumbye rusange maj gen lus carrilho n’abari bamuherekeje basuraga abapolisi b’u rwanda bakiriwe senior superintendent of police ssp alex fata umuyobozi w’ itsinda ry’abapolisi b’u rwanda bashinzwe kurinda abayobozi bakuru b’igihugu repubulika santrafurika ab’umuryango w’abibumbye ndetse n’abandi banyacyubahiro basura gihugu mu ijambo rye ssp alex fata yagarutse kazi n’inshingano z’umutwe ayoboye kurinda abayobozi bakuru n’abandi banyacyubahiro gihugu yashimiye umuyobozi w’ishami polisi muryango w’abibumbye kuba yafashe umwanya agasura abapolisi b’u rwanda avuga ikimenyetso gikomeye muryango ugaragariza abapolisi b’u rwanda butumwa kubungabunga amahoro santrafurika yagize turashimira ubuyobozi bw’umuryango w’abibumbye ndetse n’ubuyobozi bw’umutwe ushinzwe kugarura amahoro gihuguminusca uru ruzinduko rurashimangira inkunga n’ubufatanye mudahwema kutugaragariza kugira tubashe kuzuza neza inshingano zatuzanye gihugu ssp alex fata yakomeje ashimangira bufatanye nk’abapolisi b’u rwanda bubatera imbaraga gukomeza gukora neza akazi bashinzwe u rwanda rwatangiye kohereza abapolisi kazi kubungabungabunga umutekano gihugu repubulika santrafurika mwaka kuri rufiteyo amatsinda atatu hari abiri ashinzwe gucunga umutekano hakaba umutwe ushinzwe kurinda abayobozi bakuru b’iki gihugu ndetse n’abo muryango w’abibumbye hakaba n’itsinda ry’abapolisi bajya butumwa bw’amahoro bw’umuryango w’abibumbye buryo bwihariye

title: ibitekerezo moses guhangana n’ingaruka covid- bucuruzi
content: moses turahirwa yishimira yambitse perezida paul kagame kuba by’abakiriya bahoraho byatumye badashegeshwa cyane covid-mu myaka ishije abinyujije nzu y’imideli moshions bahuguye abarenga moses turahirwa washinze inzu y’imideli moshions atangaza gihe kuguma rugo hirindwa icyorezo covid- ubucuruzi bwe kimwe n’abandi busa bwahungabanye icyakora bakabifashwa kuba barizigamiye bihe byatambutse turahirwa yatangarije umuseke icyorezo covid- cyazanye impinduka nyinshi bucuruzi ati mu gihe covid- sinavuga abantu benshi bashishikajwe kugura imyenda dukora kuko abantu ntabwo bavaga nzu abenshi bagura imyenda bigendanye n’uko bafite ibirori cyangwa bagiye kwambara imyenda bitewe n’aho bagiye yakomeje avuga ikoranabuhanga ryabafashije kwegerana n’abakiriya babagana kiriya gihe kuguma rugo hirindwa icyorezo covid- ati ijana by’abakiriya batugana abahoraho muri harimo abayobozi b’igihugu nzego zitandukanye n’abakiriya bandi ikoranabuhanga dusanzwe turikoresha bucuruzi bwacu by’umwihariko kwegerana n’abakiriya bacu turikoresha turimo kwamamaza ibikorwa byacu biciye mbuga nkoranyambaga ubu turikubaka uburyo kujya ducuruza imyenda dukora rubuga rwacu ni ibintu dutekereza mezi abiri bizaba birangiye gukorwa buryo wabasha kugura ibicuruzwa byacu waba hose isi yakomeje avuga isomo yakuye bihe covid- by’umwihariko nk’umucuruzi uguhora witeguye kuko hashobora kuza ibishobora kugukura bucuruzi gihe gito zimwe ntego moshions bagezeho harimo kuba bafite abakiriya bahoraho kandi benshi bagera turahirwa icyo bivuze kuba dufite abakiriya biganjemo abayobozi b’igihugu nzego zitandukanye bitwereka ibikorwa byacu bishyigikiwe kandi byishimirwa n’izo nzego burya binadufasha gukora cyane ndetse tukarushaho gukorana ubushishozi imyambaro yacu turahirwa uvuga ubuhanzi rwanda buri gutera imbere cyane atangaza ahawe ubushobozi afite yahindura ati mpahwe amahirwe kugira nahindura buhanzi ntekereza nashyira imbaraga gushishikariza urubyiruko gukurikira impano zabo ngashyiraho gahunda gukurikirana mpano numva byafasha abakiri bato kumenya impano zabo kare muri moshions bamaze guhugura bijyanye n’ubudozi guhanga imyambaro abagera turahirwa yemeza myaka ishize yageze nzozi yahoraga arota atangiye kwinjira bijyanye guhanga imideli ati muri myaka nambitse abantu batandukanye barimo perezida paul kagame n’umufasha mme jeanette kagame nambitse abayobozi nzego zitandukanye ndetse nambitse n’ibyamamare sonia rolland wabaye nyampinga w’u bufaransa umukinnyi firimi w’umunyarwanda nshuti gatwa n’abandi benshi turahirwa kandi asanga abantu batari bakwiye kurebera made in rwanda ishusho kuko ifite amashami menshi ariko cyane bijyanye n’imyambarire harimo ingeri nyinshi hari abakora imyenda yambarwa n’abafite ubushobozi buke ariko nanone hari abakora imyenda yambarwa n’abafite title: nyamagabe imbere kiliziya habonetse imibiri irenga y’ abishwe jenoside yakorewe abatutsi
content: mu murenge cyanika karere nyamagabe hamaze kuboneka imibiri y’ abatutsi bishwe jenoside yakorewe abatutsi igikorwa gushakisha indi mibiri kirakomeje hanitabajwe imashini ihinga mu murenge mbere imaze kuboneka wabonetse tariki nzeri makuru ubuyobozi bwahawe n’ umukobwa w’ imyaka wakoraga isambu padiri mudahunga avuga bakimara kubona makuru bahise bajyanayo komite ibuka basanga koko imibiri y’ abishwe jenoside bamaze kubona imibiri barahagaritse bakomeza munsi babona nyuma bategura kuzahakorera umuganda rusange umuganda rusange usoza ukwezi wabaye tariki nzeri habonetse imibiri kuri wambere tariki hari gukoreshwa imashini ihinga mu masaha saa sita twavuganaga gitifu mudahunga yavuze bamaze kubona mubiri umwe kanamugire venuste uhagarariye ibuka murenge cyanika yabwiye ukwezi jenoside yakorewe abatutsi hari abatutsi bahungiye kiliziya cyanika ati uwavagamo wese yahitaga yicirwa ngaho kuko hari bariyeri ubuyobozi bwatumyeho abireze bakemera icyaha baze bafashe abari title: icyizere gicye ruganda rwimyidagaduro nyuma coronavirus
content: imyidagaduro gisobanuro cyoroshye ukwizihirwa kwabantu bahuriye hamwe bakanywa bakarya bakabyina ndetse bakanasusurutswa ucyumva gisobanuro kwidagaduro ukibuka coronavirus yandura inaherekanwa uhita wibaza bizamera inyarwanda yaganiriye n’abasanzwe babarizwa ruganda rw’imyidagaduro umunsi munsi bavuga batekereza hazaza h’uru ruganda gentil gideon ntirenganya umunyamakuru kigali today mboni ze ejo hazaza huruganda rwimyidagaduro ntabwo heza ati ruzaba rwarazahaye cyane kuko abahanzi bamwe batangiye kwishakira utundi turimo twamaboko bakora ruzaba rukennye cyane abahanzi bazagorwa production’ bityo ruzasubira inyuma cyane icyizere gicye gentil gideon gishingira kuba nizindi nzengo zose zubukungu zarashegeshwe kimwe gentil eddy nsabimana the new times arabona umwijima gusubira inyuma gukabije ruganda rwimyidagaduro atanga urugero rwibyo aherutse kubona ati ntabwo navuga izina rye gusa mperutse kumenya amakuru yabantu bihuje bateranyiriza amafaranga umwe dj bakomeye abashe kubona amafaranga kwishyura inzu akomeza ejo hazaza myidagaduro ntabwo heza leta yareba uburyo ifasha kino gice nkuko nahandi hose bikorwa ni uruganda rutanga imirimo ariko rwazahaye bizagorana rweguka rusubire murongo biteye agahinda cedrick shimwayezu akora ibiganiro byimyidagaduro radio television isango star kimwe nabo bakora bimwe icyizere gicye ruganda rw’imyidagaduro ati mbona hazabaho gusubira inyuma kubera imyidagaduro ibaho igihe nubundi bukungu bumeze neza bityo bigafasha ibigo byubucuruzi gushoramo amafaranga ntagushidikanya uruganda rwimyidagaduro ruzasubira inyuma gusa mbona bitazatinda remmy lubega umwe bashoramari bakomeye bashyize imitungo myidagaduro abinyujije gutegura ibitaramo ngaruka kwezi kigali jazz junction n’ibindi nawe asanga ejo hazaza himyidagaduro rwanda hazagorana ati n’ubu bibi bizakomeza kuba bibi urebye ibitaramo biba abantu bahurira ahantu hamwe abantu bazakomeza kugira bwoba karemano nta nama ziba nta bukwe mbese imirimo ijyanye kwidagadura yarazahaye ariko reka tugumane icyizere ibintu bizongera kuba byiza turaba dushaka ubundi buryo dukoramo twinjize lubega agira inama abafata imyanzuro gutekereza ruganda rw’imyidagaduro ati ubu imyidagaduro ikenewe kurusha mbere kandi nayo umuti uvura abantu agahinda kwiheba kugira ubwoba abantu bagasubirana icyizere muhoza nina ubarizwa itsinda charly nina afite impugenge zivanze nicyizere ati nta kidashoboka gusa bizafata igihe abantu bashire ubwoba bongere kwitabira ibitaramo uwiringiyimana jean nepo ashyira amafaranga ikarita bus gare giporoso umukunzi wimyidagaduro afite abyumva ati urumva koko byakongera koroha duhurira parikingi stade uzi ukuntu batubwiye coronavirus yandura dukumbuye kubyinana nabahanzi bacu ariko bizagorana bamwe ibyishimo nabahanzi mbimenyera club gusa igihe bizafungurira ubanza tuzaba bacye tuzajya tujyayo bizadufata igihe kongera kumenyera tukisanzura tukidagadura covid- yarabidukoze ubuse tuzajya tubyina dushyizemo numujyi kigali ukuyemo akarere rusizi rubavu byarafunguwe gusa biragoye kumenya igihe ibikorwa byimyidagaduro bizafungurirwa cyane uretse uburyo interineti bugezweho ubusanzwe biba habayeho amakoraniro yabantu kandi benshi remmy lubega rg consult itegura ibitaramo kigali jazz junction nibindi yavuze ahazaza huruganda rwimyidagaduro atari heza ingingo gusubukura ibitaramo nandi makoraniro title: akarere rubavu karishimira ibikorwa by’amajyambere kagezeho
content: mu bikorwa byamuritswe harimo umuhanda uhuza imipaka yombi y’u rwanda repubulika iharanira demokarasi kongo grande et petite barierre ukazatwara akayabo k’amafaranga akabakaba miliyoni ndetse n’ umuhanda pave ujya biro by’akarere watangiye gukorwa munsi umuyobozi w’akarere sheh bahame hassan yavuze akarere kabwiye rwiyemezamirimo imodoka zikora mihanda zitazasubirayo utugari tutazikoresheje dusane uduhanda tujya hasuwe kandi umusozi wimuweho imiryango kubera ikibazo cy’isuri yicaga abahatuye gihe cy’imvura uyu musozi murenge gisenyi guterwamo ibiti binyuranye bifata ubutaka hakazubakwamo uduhanda intebe n’ibitare kuruhukiramo mukerarugendo iki gikorwa kizatwara amafaranga miliyoni bavuye musozi ubuyobozi b’akarere rubavu bwasuye akagari karukogo umurenge rubavu birebera ibikorwa ndengera foundation uyu muryango wubatse amasoko y’amazi agemurira abaturage amazi meza ndetse n’ibitaro kijyambere umuyobozi w’akarere yasabye umuyobozi ndengera foundation gufatanya n’akarere bakareba masoko y’amazi yakwaguka abaturage benshi bakavomaho abayobozi banagejejwe ahari kubakwa amashanyarazi ako kagali jean berchmas bahige ukuriye ewsa rubavu yasobanuye mashanyarazi azagera baturage tugali twa byahi kanembwe karukogo ibarizwa mirenge rubavu cyanzarwe bahige yashimangiye mashanyarazi afite ingufu zihagije zizafasha abaturage kwivana bukene bahige yagize mushinga wizwe neza ibikoresho byose birahari igikorwa cyose gikoreshwa n’amashanyarazi kizahakora kirahari mpungenge hasuwe n’isoko ryo ako kagali ariko rizatangira gukorerwamo mutarama nyuma y’ubunani uru rugendo rwasorejwe isoko kijyambere ry’akarere rubavu riri kubakwa mujyi rwagati murenge gisenyi imirimo kubaka soko iracyari hasi ariko irimo kwihutishwa kugira rizatangire gukoreshwa aho riri isoko risanzwe rikorera hazazamurwa irindi gorofa hanubakwe imodoka zihagarara asoza gikorwa umuyobozi w’akarere rubavu sheh bahame hassan yibukije inshingano buri wese kurinda gukoresha neza ibikorwa remezo gihe bizaba byuzuye bahame yagize ibikorwa nk’ibi iby’umuturage turifuza buri wese agira uruhare kubibungabunga kubikoresha kuko uburenganzira bweumwe baturage utuye kagari karukogo seth mugema asanga amajyambere kwihuta abagana buryo yiteguye gutangiza umushinga iwabo cyaro nogosha imisatsi mujyi none kubera batuzaniye amashanyarazi ngiye kwimurira salon yanjye karukogo nk’uko byagaragaye akarere rubavu kari kwihutisha ibikorwa remezo bijyanye n’icyerekezo ariko cyane cyane hubakwa imihanda ariko inzira ikiri ndende akarere karateganya kuganira n’abafite amazu mujyi rwego kubafasha kwihutisha bikorwa bakihutisha iterambere aka karere pascaline umulisa

title: amerika yifatanyije n’abanyarwanda kwibuka jenoside yakorewe abatutsi

title: umwanda gereza mageragere watangiye gutunganywa udatera indwara abayituriye
content: kuba gereza ikikijwe n’imirima n’inzu z’abaturage ndetse n’umugezi nyabarongo biri byatumye hatekerezwa uburyo kubyaza umusaruro amazi ayiturukamo hubatswe uburyo gutunganya amazi mabi ava bwiherero bikoni ndetse bwogero kugira ajye akoreshwa bindi bikorwa by’isuku kuhira imyaka kwisuka nyabarongo cyangwa mirima y’abaturage umuyobozi mukuru rema ruhamya collette yavuze bahisemo gutunganya myanda ituruka mazi butaka bw’iyi gereza kubera idatunganyijwe iba intandaro kwangiza ibidukikije gutera indwara abaturage yagize nk’uko mwabibonye gikorwa kigamije gutunganya imyanda ituruka mazi y’iyi gereza kubera twese tuzi imyanda igiye bidukikije nko mazi butaka idatunganyijwe ahanini ariyo iba intandaro kwangiza ibidukikije gutera indwara baturage umuyobozi rcs cgp rwigamba george yavuze gikorwa cyiza ndetse kizagira akamaro cyane kuko amazi y’umwanda yavaga gereza azatunganywa akongera agakoreshwa yagize bizagira akamaro cyane kurengera ibidukikije kubera umwanda uva gereza uwuretse ukamanuka wakabaye ukajya mugezi nyabarongo wakwangiza byinshi akamaro bizagira amazi y’umwanda yavaga agiye gutunganywa akavamo umwanda wose akongera agasubira gukoreshwa bikorwa birimo iby’ubuhinzi n’isuku kandi akaba atazagera baturage ayo mazi yatunganyijwe bisaba abanza gutekwa muntu wakenera kuyanywa yujuje ubuziranenge binateganyijwe gahunda gutunganya imyanda izagezwa zindi gereza n’ibindi bigo binini rwego kubungabunga ibidukikije

title: kizito mihigo yagiye iwabo i kibeho birori bisobanuye byinshi hantu avuka
content: nyuma y’amezi macye avuye gereza umuhanzi kizito mihigo akomeje ibitaramo byibanda by’umuziki w’indirimbo zihimbaza imana akaba yerekeje iwabo i kibeho ahabera ibirori bifite igisobanuro ubwe by’umwihariko ariko bikaba n’ibirori bikomeye hantu avuka karere nyaruguru nyuma y’amezi macye avuye gereza umuhanzi kizito mihigo akomeje ibitaramo byibanda by’umuziki w’indirimbo zihimbaza imana akaba yerekeje iwabo i kibeho ahabera ibirori bifite igisobanuro ubwe by’umwihariko ariko bikaba n’ibirori bikomeye hantu avuka karere nyaruguru kuri kabiri tariki ugushyingo nibwo kizito mihigo yageze i kibeho karere nyaruguru birori kwizihiza isabukuru y’imyaka ishize i kibeho habaye amabonekerwa ahabwa agaciro gakomeye cyane bakirisitu gatolika rwanda hirya hino isi kizito mihigo kandi mabonekerwa yabaye iwabo i kibeho amaze igihe gito avutse dore afite imyaka y’amavuko mu gitaramo aherutse gukorera i nyamirambo kizito mihigo yasobanuye agaciro ubwe amabonekerwa y’i kibeho ndetse n’ukuntu yishimira kuba yarabereye avuka i kibeho anaboneraho gutangaza azajya kwifatanya n’abandi masengesho n’igitaramo kwizihiza imyaka mabonekerwa abayeho kizito mihigo amaze kugera i kibeho kabiri abinyujije mbuga nkoranyambaga yagize kuri ugushyingo nageze iwacu i kibeho abakerarugendo b’iyobokamana ibihumbi n’ibihumbagiza bahuriye murwa w’umwamikazi bizihize isabukuru y’imyaka ishize bikiramariya abonekeye alphonsine mumureke ndaba mpari nshyiremo ikirungo nkore umuti nyuma y’amasaha macye muhanzi yatangiye gutaramira abitabiriye gitaramo kizito mihigo yataramiye ab’iwabo i kibeho n’abahageze baturutse hirya hino kuba birori bibaye mwaka kizito mihigo yizihizamo isabukuru y’imyaka nayo myaka ishize habaye mabonekerwa byiyongeraho kuba ubwa mbere muhanzi agiye gutaramira iwabo i kibeho yafungurwa bigatuma igitaramo gifite igisobanuro gikomeye muhanzi wagiye kwishimira ivuko amateka y’amabokenerwa y’i kibeho byinshi biyavugwaho kibeho umujyi muto uherereye karere nyaruguru majyepfo y’u rwanda ni ahantu hamenyekanye cyane igihe habaga amabonekerwa mwaka w’ akaba hari ishusho yezu rwego afurika ifite icyicaro i kibeho niyo shusho nini isi ifite uburebure metero esheshatu ipima ibiro maganacyenda mirongo itanu kg iyo shusho igaragara ahantu hatandatu isi kuko buri mugabane w’isi ufite ishusho nk’iyo umugabane w’afurika ishusho wagennye musozi nyarushishi uherereye murenge kibeho akarere nyaruguru ntara y’amajyepfo amateka y’ibonekerwa ry’i kibeho ku italiki ugushyingo mwaka w’i ishuri ryisumbuye ry’abakobwa ry’i kibeho habereye ibintu bidasanzwe ubwo hari ma saha nyuma saa sita abana barangije gufungura ariko bakiri hamwe cyumba cy’amafunguro alufonsina mumureke ugeze kigero cy’imyaka cumi n’itandatu yumva ijwi ryoroheje rimuhamagara kinyarwanda rigira riti mwana wanjye ubwo ahaguruka bwangu akurikira iryo jwi ridasanzwe kirongozi abona umugore ufite ubwiza buhebuje amuhagaze imbere yari yambaye umwambaro wera kandi yitwikirije umwenda w’ubururu mutwe ugakomeza ugana inyuma ibiganza bye byari bibumbiye gituza ariko intoki zireba hejuru nta nkweto yambaye alufonsina amubazanya igihunga agira uri nde uwo mugore amusubiza bwangu avuga ndi nyina jambo alufonsina ahagarara yemye nk’ufashwe n’umuriro w’amashanyarazi agumya kwitegereza mugore ariko kandi akanibaza uburyo nyina jambo yaje kirongozi cy’ishuri ryabo bikira mariya yongera kumubaza ni nde ukunda cyane alufonsina usanzwe umwana uvuka muryango w’abakristu kandi agerageza kuyoboka nzira asubiza adatindaganije nkunda imana bikira mariya wabyaye yezu mariya yumvise gisubizo asagwa n’ibyishimo abwira alufonsina nazanywe kugukomeza kuko numvise amasengesho yawe yongeraho ndifuza inshuti zawe zikomera kwemera kuko zitemera bihagije ubwo alufonsina yatangiye kuvuga amasengesho yoroheje nyina jambo azamuka ajya ejuru umwana agumya kwitegereza mubyeyi utagira asa arembera ibyo byamaze nk’iminota cumi n’itanu abageragezaga kumuvugisha cyangwa se kumunyeganyeza ntibagira bageraho kuko ameze nk’umuntu wafashwe n’ubujeni bukomeye cyane nta muntu n’umwe wemeye iby’ibonekerwa rye ahubwo bamwe batangiye gukeka yarwaye indwara idasanzwe dore avuka i kibungo abanyarwanda title: amatariki y’ingenzi yaranze urugamba rw’inkotanyi guhagarika jenoside
content: ku itariki mbere ukwakira ingabo fpr inkotanyi -rwanda patriotic army rpa zatangije urugamba kubohora igihugu nyuma y’imyaka ine ngabo zari zigizwe ahanini n’urubyiruko zatangije urugamba guhagarika jenoside kubohora igihugu maboko y’abicanyi aya amwe matariki y’ingenzi yaranze urugamba guhagarika jenoside tariki mata ingabo rpa zagabye igetero ruhengeri n’i byumba zigamije guhagarika zafashe umujyi rusumo tariki gicurasi bamwe barahunze bagarutse rwanda rpa imaze kubohora agace k’amajyepfo ashyira uburasirazuba tariki gicurasi ingabo rpa zakomeje kurokora abari bihishe hirya hino tariki gicurasi ingabo rpa zafashe akarere bugesera zikiza n’abasaga kiliziya ntarama tariki gicurasi ikoresheje radio muhabura fpr yabwiye abaturage uduce turimo umutekano tariki gicurasi fpr yakomeje kurokora abicwaga karere bugezera tariki gicurasi ingabo rpa zafashe ikibuga cy’indege kanombe n’ikigo gisirikare kanombe tariki gicurasi ingabo rpa zakomeje kurokora abicwaga ndetse zikomeza zigana i gitarama tariki gicurasi abanyamakuru mpuzamahanga baje i kigali duce twari twamaze kubohorwa rpa tariki kamena ingabo rpa zafashe umujyi kabgayi i gitarama ndetse zirokora benshi bahari tariki kamena abaturage duce nyanza ruhango basubiye zabo kuko ingabo rpa zari zamaze kuhafata tariki kamena ingabo rpa zafashe rucunchu ibirindiro bine gisirikare n’ikiraro musambira tariki kamena fpr yarokoye abantu bafashwe bugwate st famille nkengero zayo tariki kamena imirwano yarakomeje kigali fpr yakomeje yerekeza i butare kibuye guverinoma y’abicanyi ikomeza guhunga tariki kamena ingabo rpa zakomeje kubohora uduce dutandukanye ingabo zakoraga jenoside nazo zikomeza guhunga tariki kamena ingabo rpa zahurije hamwe uduce zari zafashe kigali abandi bakomeza iya butare tariki kamena ingabo rpa zigaruriye ibice bitandukanye kigali gitarama butare tariki nyakanga rpa yakomeje kuvura inkomere zacitse icumu ndetse n’abasirikare ngoro y’inteko ishingamategeko tariki nyakanga ingabo rpa zakomeje kwigarurira ibice kigali n’ibindi bice majyepfo majyaruguru tariki nyakanga ingabo rpa zafashe umujyi kigali butare iba ntambwe ikomeye guharika jenoside yakorewe abatutsi tariki nyakanga ingabo rpa zarokoye ababikira barimo n’ababiligi babiri i butare tariki nyakanga ingabo rpa zatangiye kugenzura umupaka w’u rwanda n’u burundi ndetse ziha inzira abagarukaga rwanda tariki nyakanga ikinyamakuru the new york times cyatangaje umujyi kigali urimo ituze ndetse abantu batangiye kuwugarukamo tariki nyakanga ingabo rpa zafashe umujyi ruhengeri ibirindiro bikomeye by’abakoraga jenoside tariki nyakanga radio rwanda yongeye kumvikana ikoresheje ibikoresho radio muhabura tariki nyakanga ingabo rpa zafashe umujyi gisenyi ndetse zirokora abicwaga tariki nyakanga ingabo rpa zatangaje imirwano ihagaze tariki nyakanga fpr yatangaje hashyizweho guverinoma y’ubumwe uwo munsi pasteur bizimungu yarahiriye kuba perezida gen maj paul kagame arahirira kuba visi perezida faustin twagiramungu arahirira kuba minisitiri w’intebe salongo richardmuhaburarw

title: inkomoko y’insigamugani ni bilindi
content: aba agereranyije iryo joro n’iry’umutasi cyilima rugwe witwaga bilindi yagenzemo ajya i bugesera gutata ubukwe nyanguge sagashya ahagana mwaka w’i icyo gihe cyirima rugwe umwami w’u rwanda nsoro bihembe umwami w’u bugesera bagiganiraga umukobwa w’umukonokazi witwaga nyanguge sagashya umwe ashaka kuba umurongora mugaragaro cyilima rugwe atanga nsoro kumurongora rwihishwa ijoro rimwe n’iryo yarongoweho nsoro mugaragaro niho hakomotse imihango y’ubukundwakare nyanguge yahize bakeba agira ndabaruta jye warongowe n’abami babiri ijoro rimwe bimuviramo impamvu yamutanije nsoro agacyurwa cyilima rugwe bakabyarana kigeli mukobanya uwo mugabo bilindi wakomotsweho n’iyi nsigamugani nyina umuhondogokazi ukomoka bikomangoma by’i bugesera ni umutasi cyilima rugwe wahoraga atata igihe ubukwe nsoro nyanguge buzabera kugira amutange kumurongora nk’uko indagu zari zabyemeje azabyara umwami w’u rwanda n’ubwo yasabwe nsoro akanamukwa cyilima agasubirayo agasaba agakwa mu gihe umunsi w’ubukwe umaze kumenyekana bilindi yaherekeje cyilima bajya bugesera gutaha ubukwe nk’abandi ariko umugambi nibamara gukora ibirori by’ubukwe cyilima akora ashoboye akarongora nyangunge mbere nsoro nuko cyilima amaze kurongora mukobwa nyanguge mpamvu z’imitsindo baziranyeho dore bombi bazi azavukaho igihangange cyilima yigarukira i rwanda ijoro ryose atinya hagira impamvu ituma bamenya yarongoye nyanguge rwihishwa agarukana bilindi baje kwihamba batazi bugere rwanda bikubitiyeho i bugesera ukagera i kigali cyilima rugwe atuye hari ishyamba ry’umutamenwa gusa bilindi azi inzira neza kuko yayicagamo kenshi ajya nyirarume b’abahondogo bugesera nuko bihereza iryo shyamba bararyogoga bagera i kigali gicuku nyuma gishyira urukerera abararirizi cyilima babakubise amaso baratangara bati iri joro bilindi cyilima bariturutse he abandi baricecekera mabanga bafitanye kuko rwanda muntu uzi cyilima yarongoye nyanguge rwihishwa nsoro wamusabye atabizi cyilima rugwe amaze kugaruka i rwanda nsoro asigarana nyanguge kuko wamurongoye mugaragaro kurongora cyilima wundi ukuzi uretse gusa bazi nyanguge yasabwe n’abo bami kandi bombi bagakwa byatangazaga rubanda bagira bati uriya mugabo sagashya wakiriye inkwano z’abami babiri azabigenza ate ubwo cyilima rugwe amaze kugaruka akajya atuma bilindi nyanguge akamwoherereza intashyo bilindi akagenda rwihishwa ijoro ryose kugeza igihe nyanguge yanganye nsoro bapfuye mihigo guhiga bakeba arabaruta yarongowe n’abami babiri ijoro rimwe cyilima amaze kumenya nyanguge yatanye nsoro ahera yohereza bilindi basare b’i bugesera kuko baziranye amuha n’amakoro y’amagumba y’ibimasa bazambutse nyanguge bitagoranye bilindi amaze gushyikiriza abasare ajyana amaturo sagashya amaze kugerayo avuga ubutumwa cyilima barabwemera biba gutebutsa kuko yarakoye bamaze gucutsa imisango agarukana nyanguge ijoro ryose ageze rwanda ahita abyarira mukobanya nyakabanda kigali cyilima yita umwana izina acyura nyina atyo nuko urwo rugendo bilindi majoro y’umwijima ajyana ubutumwa cyilima rugwe ruhinduka iciro ry’imigani ijoro ritashyemo umwijima mubi ryose urisohotsemo agana hanze yabura ava n’aho agana akiyamirira abwira asize nzu yemwe hanze hano hari ijoro bilindi

title: kwitwara neza buroko gufasha urukiko bimwe bitumye bagaragaza agiye kurekurwa
content: iki cyemezo cyafashwe tariki ukwakira n’umucamanza khalida rachid khan uyobora urukiko mpuzamahanga mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho u rwanda tpir gusaba irekurwa bagaragaza michel wakatiwe igihano gufungwa imyaka mwaka ushize amakuru kigalitodaycom gikesha itangazo ry’uryo rukiko aravuga mpamvu zatanzwe kumurekura harimo kuba urukiko mpuzamahanga mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho yougoslavia tpiy rufite imikorere ijya gusa n’iya tpir ruteganya imfungwa zakatiwe zishobora kurekurwa nyuma kumara bitatu kane by’igifungo barakatiwe kandi bagaragaza amaze imyaka afunze ukuvuga by’imyaka umunani yakatiwe izindi mpamvu michel bagaragaza ubwe yiyemeje kwishyikiriza urukiko akanemera yashinjwaga ndetse akerekana azi uburemere bwabyo akanabyicuza kuba yararanzwe n’imyitwarire myiza afungiye sude mugabane w’u burayi nyakanga umunyarwanda michel bagaragaza yahoze umuyobozi mukuru w’ikigo ocir- ishami ry’icyayi akaba yarafatwaga nk’umwe nkoramutima juvnal habyarimana perezida w’u rwanda yamaze igihe ashakishwa tpir byaha kunoza umugambi jenoside yakorewe abatutsi kugira uruhare jenoside n’ubufatanyacyaha jenoside tariki kanama bagaragaza yishyikirije tpir bwende bwe yitaba urukiko munsi uruhare ruziguye jenoside kuko yaremeye intwaro zari zigenewe gukora jenoside zibikwa ruganda rw’icyayi rubaya ndetse akaba yaranaguriraga interahamwe inzoga akanaziha amafaranga yemereye urukiko buroko ernestine musanabera

title: diasipora rwanda belgique urubyiruko rwatangije ubukangurambaga gufasha abanyarwanda
content: mu gihe u rwanda ruri guhangana guhagarika gukwirakwira virusi corona icyorezo cyugarije isi buri wese asabwa kuguma rugo hirindwa ingendo zitari ngombwa bwizo mpamvu urubyiruko rutuye gihugu cy’u bubirigi diaspora rwanda belgique rwatangije ubukangurambaga rushishikariza urundi rubyiruko rwabanyarwanda ruri hirya hino kw’isi gufasha abanyarwanda bagizweho n’ingaruka z’icyorezo coronavirus nkuko byatangajwe mugabo pierre uhagarariye urubyiruko diaspora rwanda belgique avuga buri rubyiruko nyarwanda ruri hose kw’isi rukwiye kugira umutima w’impuhwe utabara abanyarwanda bahuye n’ingaruka z’icyorezo covi ubwo bukangurambaga buragira buti ’’ nk’ urubyiruko rutuye gihugu cyu bubirigi twifatanyije n’igihugu cyacu cy’ u rwanda mur’ikigihe kiri guhangana guhagarika ikwirakwira ry’icyorezo coronavirus cyugarije isi kubwizo mpamvu tuboneyeho guhamagarira urundi rubyiruko rw’abanyarwanda batuye hirya hino ku’isi kwitanga buri muntu yifite kugirango tugaragarize urukundo dufitiye u rwanda n’abanyarwanda nk’uko hozeho muco nyarwanda kandi burigikorwa cyose n’ingirakamaro gutanga wifite reba ubutumwa batambukije bw’urukundo urubyiruko rutangije bukanguramba nyuma y’uko ababyeyi nabo baramaze gutangira ibikorwa gukusanya inkunga kugoboka abanyarwanda kandi gikorwa kikaba kirimo genda neza nk’uko byemezwa n’umuyobozi diaspora rwanda belgique gilles bazambanza inkuru bifitanye isano diaspora covid abanyarwanda batuye bubiligi batangije gahunda kugobaka u rwanda mu butumwa umuyobozi diyasipora nyarwanda gihugu cy’ububirigi diaspora rwanda belgique gilles bazambanza yahaye abanyarwanda batuye gihugu cy’ububirigi yashimiye abavandimwe bamaze kwitanga anakangurira abandi kwihutisha gikorwa vuba kugirango nkunga ibashe kuba yagera kubo yagenewe gilles bazambanza yagize bavandimwe turabashimira ubwitange mo kugaragaza mugufasha abavandimwe rwanda bugarijwe n’ingaruka z’icyorezo covid turabamenyesha tumaze gukusanya inkunga eur turabasaba gukomeza guhuza ingufu gushishikariza inshuti n’abavandimwe kw’itanga minsi mike irimbere eur tuzayarenze nyuma yaho urubyiruko rutangirije ikigikorwa gutera ikirenge cy’ ababyeyi babyishimiye umubyeyi umaze imyaka irenga mirongo itatu gihugu cy’u bubiligi madame marie goretti mukunde bwiye umunyamakuru muhabura bishimiye uburyo urubyiruko rw’ifatanyije n’ababyeyi gikorwa gushaka inkunga kugoboka abanyarwanda bagizweho n’ingaruka y’icyorezo covid madame marie goretti mukunde yagize njye navuga hari umugani gifaransa ugira uti’’la pomme ne tombe jamail loin de l’arbre’’ nyuma kubona urugero rwiza rw’ababyeyi diaspora rwanda belgique urubyiruko ruhise rukomereza k’urugero rwiza byatunejeje ’’ madame mukunde akomeza agira ati byatunejeje urubyiruko n’ubuzima bw’igihugu ndetse n’ahazaza hacyo hari biganza byabo bityo bakaba bafite umukoro kurangwa n’ibikorwa n’imyifatire bitanga icyizere hazaza h’igihugu cyabo batanze urugero rwiza kugeza minisiteri y’ubuzima rwanda iratangaza umubare w’abagaragayeho coronavirus rwanda ugera barakize ruhumuriza richard muhaburarw

title: abanyarwanda batuye canada bibutse abazize jenoside yakorewe abatutsi
content: igikorwa kwibuka kitabiriwe kandi n’abahagarariye ibihugu byabo canada n’izindi nshuti uyu muhango watangijwe n’urugendo walk to remember rwatangiriye nteko ishingamategeko canada rugera biro by’umujyi ottawa ahabereye imihango kwibuka nyuma y’indirimbo zubahiriza ibihugu byombi hakurikiyeho umunota kwibuka inzirikarengane zishwe jenoside padiri callixte kabalisa wayoboye isengesho yasabiye abahuye n’ibibazo binyuranye harimo abafashwe ngufu asaba imana gukomeza impfubyi n’abapfakazi n’abandi bagize ibibazo bikomeye uhagarariye u rwanda canada edda mukabagwiza perezida w’ishyirahamwe ry’abacitse kw’icumu rizwi kw’izina humura alain ntwali bagaragaje bibuka amateka jenoside yabaye rwanda bagamije gufata ingamba ibyabaye ntibizongere kuba ukundi nk’uko itangazo ambasade y’u rwanda canada ribivuga berekanye umuhango ukorwa ugamije kwibuka ariko abantu bakanatekereza uburyo gufasha abacitse icumu bagarutse nsanganyamatsiko y’uyu mwaka twigire mateka twubaka ejo hazaza bavuga genoside yakorewe abatutsi mateka y’ubu n’ejo hazaza itazibagirana mu muhango kwibuka kandi hatanzwe ibiganiro bibiri l’historique de l’impunit des crimes haineux au rwanda et les signes avant-coureurs du gnocide contre les tutsis cyatanzwe bwana richard nsanzabaganwa les mots qui tuent cyatanzwe prof philippe basabose nsanzabaganwa yerekanye ubwicanyi bwagiye buba ariko ubutegetsi ntibuhane abakoze ibyaha kwica aha yavuze uduce tunyuranye ubwoko bw’abatutsi bwagiye bwicwa yerekanye kwica byagiye bishyigikirwa n’ubutegetsi kurengera abatutsi babaga bibasiwe prof basabose yerekanye amagambo yagiye akoreshwa rwanda yagize uruhare ishyirwa bikorwa ry’ubwicanyi yakoze isesengura ry’ijambo ryavuzwe leon mugesera i kabaya yakanguriye abanyamuryango mrnd abereka umwanzi wabo umututsi n’abahutu mashyaka ataravugaga rumwe mrnd gahunda ziteganijwe zijyanye kwibuka zizagera kwezi gatanu zirimo amasengesho ikiriyo n’ibiganiro bizatangwa taliki mata abanyarwanda n’inshuti zabo bongeye guhura gitambo misa kwibuka cyabereye paruwasi mutagatifu yozefu gatineau quebec

title: minani washakishwaga kubera ibyaha jenoside yafatiwe i kigali yarihinduye umunyatanzaniya
content: polisi y’u rwanda yataye yombi umugabo w’imyaka y’amavuko wiyitaga umutanzaniya akaba asanzwe ashakishwa n’ubutabera rwanda kubera uruhare yagize jenoside yakorewe abatutsi hussein minani warabonye ubwenegihugu tanzaniya izina hussein abdi kitumba mujandi yafatiwe i remera karere gasabo itariki gicurasi mwaka akaba yareretswe itangazamakuru kabiri tariki gicurasi sitasiyo polisi kicukiro afungiye kugeza umuvugizi polisi y’u rwanda assistant commissioner of police acp celestin twahirwa yavuze minani yashakishwaga ruhare yagize jenoside ibyaha byibasiye inyoko muntu ubwicanyi gusambanya abagore gahato yakoreye cyahoze perefegitura butare komini ngoma karere huye minani watwaraga amakamyo hagati tanzaniya n’u rwanda mazina y’amahimbano akurikiranyweho mwaka w’ yatwaraga interahamwe bikorwa bibi zakoreye butare kandi akaba yaragize uruhare rukomeye kwica abanyeshuri n’abakozi b’abatutsi b’icyahoze kaminuza nkuru y’u rwanda i butare afatanyije n’interahamwe kandi minani akurikiranyweho uruhare yagize rupfu rw’uwari umutoza mukura victory sport witwaga sitaki charles hamwe n’inshuti bivugwa yitwaga kamina babishe babasanze kamina bihishe acp twahirwa agira atinyuma kumenya amakuru ruhare minani jenoside yakorewe abatutsi ndetse n’amarorerwa amwe yakoze giti cye ishami ry’ubugenzacyaha polisi ryegeranyije ibyangombwa byose bigize dosiye bukaba bwarayishyikirije ubushinjacyaha yongeyeho atiishami ry’ubushinjacyaha rikurikirana abakoze jenoside bihishe ryari ryaramushyiriyeho impapuro zimufata ariko polisi mpuzamahanga interpol ikaba yarashyizeho urupapuro kumufata kuya ugushyingo umwaka ushize nyuma kwegeranya amakuru y’aho yaba aherereye n’uwo kugira afatwe minani yemera yahoze umushoferi nyiramasuhuko pauline ministri w’iterambere ry’umuryango wakatiwe n’urukiko mpuzamahanga mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho u rwanda ictr ariko agahakana uruhare yagize jenoside yakorewe abatutsi minani kandi yakunze kuza rwanda azanye imodoka nshya yabaga avanye cyambu dar-es-salaam buryo n’igihe yafatwaga atwaye imodoka nshya kompanyi izicuruza hano rwanda yitwa rwanda motor ltd

title: abaturage bakwiye kurushaho kubungabunga ubuzima bwabo bihe by’imvura
content: mu bihe by’imvura aribyo tunarimo rwanda usanga aribwo hamera ibigunda nkike z’ingo nyinshi cyane biturage nk’uko mukambungo esperance umujyanama w’ubuzima mudugudu rubugurizoumurenge shyogwe karere muhanga abivuga yongeraho bihuru bishobora kuba indiri y’imibu ishobora kurya abantu ikabanduza malariya niyo mpamvu asanga abaturage bakwiye kugira ingamba nshashya kwirinda indwara zabo bihe by’imvura iyo imvura igwa usanga imyanda izanwa n’imvura yakwiriye hamwe hamwe ni nayo mpamvu asanga isuku ikwiriye kurushaho kwitabwaho cyane gihe cy’imvura kuko usanga gihe haboneka indwara nyinshi abantu batirinze zimwe ndwara nk’uko abivuga harimo choleraumusongainzoka ndetse malaria kubera ndwara zangiza umubiri w’uzanduye buryo hari n’ubwo zamwica ziramutse zitavuwemukambungo esperance nk’umujyanama w’ubuzima aboneraho gukangurira abaturage kwita gutema ibihuru bishobora kwihishamo imibu itera maralia uyu mujyanama w’ubuzima akomeza avuga kwirinda ibinogo birekamo amazi nabyo ngombwa kuko indiri y’inzoka zinjirira birenge igihe umuntu ayakandagiramo iyo umuntu abyirinze hakiri kare ndiri z’inzoka ntizibasha kuboneka rugo rwe ikindi ugutema ibihuru bizengurutse ingo byakwihishamo imibu kandi bikajyana kurara nzitiramibu ziteye umuti gihe nk’iki cy’imvura ibi bishobora kugabanya malariya kunywa amazi atetse cyangwa arimo umuti wica mikorobe sur’eau nabyo n’ingenzi kuko usanga gihe cy’imvura cyane cyane amasoko arushaho kuzana amazi yanduyebityo rwego kwirinda inzoka akaba yatekwa cyangwa agashyirwamo sur’eau mbere kunyobwa ababyeyi bakwiye gushishikarira gufubika abana bihe by’imvura kugira babarinde indwara ziterwa n’imbeho nk’umusonga n’izindi kwambara inkweto bihe buri wese nabyo byaba byiza cyane kuko birinda uzambaye inzoka zinjirira birenge n’izindi mikorobe zishobora gukurura indwara zitandukanye nk’uko umujyanama w’ubuzima mukambungo yabigarutseho kuri ningombwa abaturage babungabunga biruseho ubuzima bwabo gihe cy’imvura kandi n’abandi bajyanama b’ubuzima barusheho kubikangurira abaturage b’imidugudu bashizwe safari viateur

title: abanyarwanda batuye canada bibutse abazize jenoside yakorewe abatutsi
content: igikorwa kwibuka kitabiriwe kandi n’abahagarariye ibihugu byabo canada n’izindi nshuti uyu muhango watangijwe n’urugendo walk to remember rwatangiriye nteko ishingamategeko canada rugera biro by’umujyi ottawa ahabereye imihango kwibuka nyuma y’indirimbo zubahiriza ibihugu byombi hakurikiyeho umunota kwibuka inzirikarengane zishwe jenoside padiri callixte kabalisa wayoboye isengesho yasabiye abahuye n’ibibazo binyuranye harimo abafashwe ngufu asaba imana gukomeza impfubyi n’abapfakazi n’abandi bagize ibibazo bikomeye uhagarariye u rwanda canada edda mukabagwiza perezida w’ishyirahamwe ry’abacitse kw’icumu rizwi kw’izina humura alain ntwali bagaragaje bibuka amateka jenoside yabaye rwanda bagamije gufata ingamba ibyabaye ntibizongere kuba ukundi nk’uko itangazo ambasade y’u rwanda canada ribivuga berekanye umuhango ukorwa ugamije kwibuka ariko abantu bakanatekereza uburyo gufasha abacitse icumu bagarutse nsanganyamatsiko y’uyu mwaka twigire mateka twubaka ejo hazaza bavuga genoside yakorewe abatutsi mateka y’ubu n’ejo hazaza itazibagirana mu muhango kwibuka kandi hatanzwe ibiganiro bibiri l’historique de l’impunit des crimes haineux au rwanda et les signes avant-coureurs du gnocide contre les tutsis cyatanzwe bwana richard nsanzabaganwa les mots qui tuent cyatanzwe prof philippe basabose nsanzabaganwa yerekanye ubwicanyi bwagiye buba ariko ubutegetsi ntibuhane abakoze ibyaha kwica aha yavuze uduce tunyuranye ubwoko bw’abatutsi bwagiye bwicwa yerekanye kwica byagiye bishyigikirwa n’ubutegetsi kurengera abatutsi babaga bibasiwe prof basabose yerekanye amagambo yagiye akoreshwa rwanda yagize uruhare ishyirwa bikorwa ry’ubwicanyi yakoze isesengura ry’ijambo ryavuzwe leon mugesera i kabaya yakanguriye abanyamuryango mrnd abereka umwanzi wabo umututsi n’abahutu mashyaka ataravugaga rumwe mrnd gahunda ziteganijwe zijyanye kwibuka zizagera kwezi gatanu zirimo amasengesho ikiriyo n’ibiganiro bizatangwa taliki mata abanyarwanda n’inshuti zabo bongeye guhura gitambo misa kwibuka cyabereye paruwasi mutagatifu yozefu gatineau quebec

content: mu bihe by’imvura aribyo tunarimo rwanda usanga aribwo hamera ibigunda nkike z’ingo nyinshi cyane biturage nk’uko mukambungo esperance umujyanama w’ubuzima mudugudu rubugurizoumurenge shyogwe by’imvura iyo imvura igwa usanga imyanda izanwa n’imvura yakwiriye hamwe hamwe ni nayo mpamvu asanga isuku ikwiriye kurushaho kwitabwaho cyane gihe cy’imvura kuko usanga gihe haboneka indwara nyinshi ubukwe bw’aba bombi bukaba bwararanzwe n’udushya twinshi ndetse n’ibitwenge bantu benshi cyane babutashye ni ubukwe kandi abatari bacye bakunze kutavugaho rumwe bamwe banavugaga kwizera azajya ata kiganiro n’ikinyamakuru ukwezi icyaha akurikiranyweho n’ubu nicyo agikurikiranyweho habonetse ibimenyetso bishya bituma akomeza gukurikiranwa ingingo y’ itegeko riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano rusange ivangamutungo rusange kuko imitungo afite iya se ibi byakuruye impaka ndende ahabereye masezerano mukaperezida n’umugabo biyemeza kabuza bagomba gusezerana ivangamutungo rusange n’umurenge title: igihombo cy’inama u rwanda rwasubitse kubera coronavirus gishobora kurenga miliyari frw
content: minisiteri y’ubucuruzi n’inganda yatangaje u rwanda rwafashe icyemezo gusubika inama rwagombaga kwakira mezi werurwe mata hagamijwe kurengera ubuzima gihe ruhanganye coronavirus igihombo gishobora kurenga miliyoni z’amadolari ukuvuga nibura miliyari frw inama nyinshi byari byitezwe zizabera kigali convention centre muri gihe ubukungu bw’isi buri bihe bikomeye kubera icyorezo coronavirus cyatangiriye bushinwa mpera z’umwaka ushize ariko cyamaze kugera rwanda abantu batanu bamaze gusangwamo ndwara ubwo cyorezo cyatahurwaga bushinwa inyigo zerekanaga ubukungu bw’isi bushobora kugabanukaho miliyari zirenga rumwe nzego u rwanda rwinjizagamo amafaranga menshi ukwakira inama ariko uru rwego rwarahungabanye ni gihe nko guhera nyakanga kugeza gashyantare - u rwanda rwari rumaze kwinjiza miliyoni z’amadolari miliyari frw gutegura kwakira inama mpuzamahanga gusa magingo inama nyinshi zikomeje guhagarikwa iy’umuryango ugamije kugeza ingufu zirambye sustainable energy for all-seforall watangaje wasubitse ihuriro wagombaga gukorera i kigali gicurasi mwaka ryimurirwa matariki - gashyantare mu kiganiro yagiranye televiziyo rwanda cyumweru minisitiri w’ubucuruzi n’inganda soraya hakuziyaremye yavuze guhagarika inama abantu bakora nzego bakomeje kugirwa inama byemezo bafata yakomeje kuri hari inama eshanu twasabye zakwigizwa inyuma kugira tubanze turebe cyorezo rwego rw’isi rwanda gihagaze ariko nacyo cyizere twagiye duha amahoteli n’abagombaga kwakira nama bakwemerera bazifite kuzisubika kugira inyungu kuzikuramo izakomeze ariko nanone ikindi tugomba kureba n’ingaruka z’uko n’ubwo nama zaba zisubitswe hari igihombo kirimo nk’ubu hari imibare baduhaga igihombo gishobora kugera miliyoni zirenga eshanu z’amadolari nayo mpamvu twavuze inama zigomba gusubikwa kugira turebe mezi imbere igihe inama zakongera kubera yavuze ingaruka ziterwa gusubika inama ziterwa n’uko zungura abantu benshi barimo amahoteli bararamo abagemura kurya kunywa n’abandi bacuruza kubera hari urujya n’uruza rw’abantu bitabiriye inama mu gihe inama mezi abiri zirimo gusubikwa imyiteguro kwakira izahuza abakuru b’ibihugu guverinoma b’ibihugu bikoresha icyongereza chogm izaba mpera kamena irakomeje icyemezo nyuma kizayifatwaho hagati mata u rwanda rwafashe ingamba byoherezwa mahanga muri gihe ibihugu byahagaritse ingendo hari bimwe byanahagaritse kwakira ibintu biturutse mahanga buryo byabangamiye urwego rw’ibyoherezwa mahanga rwanda ni ikibazo cyahereye bitumizwa mahanga minisitiri soraya yakomeje twakomeje kuganira n’abikorera kwezi mbere kuko by’ibyo dukura mahanga twabikuraga bushinwa kwezi mbere kurangira kugeza ibiganiro byari bikomeje kugira abagirwaho ingaruka kudashobora kuzana ibintu bavanaga bushinwa cyane cyane ibijyanye n’iby’ubwubatsi ibikoreshwa nganda imashini tube twashaka ahandi babikura yavuze ikibazo kitahise kigira ingaruka rwanda kuko cyatangiye gihe u bushinwa bwarimo bujya kiruhuko cy’umwaka mushya ariko kubera cyakomeje birasaba guhindura ingamba yakomeje kuva uku kwezi kabiri kwarangira turabona tugomba gushyira imbaraga gushaka andi masoko twabikuramo cyane cyane nk’ibyo bijya nganda inkweto nabyo ibintu twakuraga bushinwa cyane tukaba twaragerageje kureba bihugu turikiya misiri kugira bintu bitazabura masoko ariko cyorezo cyagiye gikomeza kugera bihugu harimo gushakishwa ayandi masoko n’uko abantu badashobora kujya bihugu ahubwo bashobora gukorana n’abandi bakoresheje ikoranabuhanga bintu bikaba byahagera uretse ikibazo cy’ibitumizwa mahanga rwanda harimo kuvuka n’ikibazo cy’ibyoherezwa mahanga kuko bimwe bihugu byabaye bihagaritse ibikorwa bijyanye kwakira ibitumizwa mahanga minisitiri soraya yakomeje twagiye tubona hamwe barimo kutubwira ibicuruzwa batabyemera byumweru bibiri cyane cyane twoherezaga nk’indabo n’urusenda byagiye bigaragara nubwo twavuga hatarimo imbogamizi turimo gushaka cyane twafasha abantu urwo rwego kohereza ibintu mahanga tutababoneye isoko nabyo bigira ingaruka byinjizwa bukungu ibintu turimo kuganira nabo kugira twohereza mahanga bitagabanuka cyane icyo dushyize imbere ubuzima bw’abanyarwanda ubukungu bukaza nyuma kubera bantu badafite ubuzima nubundi byose byahagarara yasabye masoko hashyirwa ahantu ho gukarabira kandi abantu bagirwa inama kwirinda gutonda masoko kuko byagira ingaruka kongera ibyago kwandura coronavirus yavuze kugeza harimo gukorwa ubuvugizi n’izindi nzego bireba kugira abahuye n’ingorane bafashwe bishoboka nko bijyanye n’imisoro kwishyura banki bagujijemo

title: havumbuwe urwengero rw’inzoga rukuze kurusha izindi kw’isi
content: abashakashatsi baravuga batahuye urwengero rw’inzoga rukuze myaka kurusha izindi isi ndetse n’ibisigazwa by’inzoga imaze imyaka ibihumbi buvumo bw’amateka buri y’umujyi haifa majyaruguru israel bavumbuye bakoraga ubushakashatsi mva yashyingurwagamo abantu banyuzagamo bakagenda bimuka n’abari batunzwe gusoroma imbuto byari bisanzwe byibazwa kwenga inzoga byaba byaratangiye nko myaka ibihumbi ishize ariko bushakashatsi bushobora kuba bugiye guhindura amateka y’inzoga yakabaye ibyavuye bushakashatsi kandi bisa nk’ibisobanuye inzoga itengwaga gusa gihe habaga hakorwaga imigati nkuko mbere byatekerezwaga aba bashakashatsi bavuga badashobora kumenya icyatangiye mbere - gukora imigati cyangwa kwenga inzoga ndetse kinyamakuru cyandika bushakashatsi mateka ajyanye n’imibereho muntu journal of archaeological science reports basa nk’abavuga inzoga yengwaga mihango kwibuka abapfuye li liu wigisha kaminuza stanford leta zunze ubumwe z’amerika wayoboye itsinda ry’aba bashakashatsi yanditse agira atiibi bimenyetso kera cyane kurusha ibindi bigaragaza inzoga yakozwe n’umuntu isi iyi nzoga kera imeze cyane nk’igikoma cyangwa ikindi kintu gifatira byibazwa imeze bitandukanye cyane n’inzoga izwi bihe muri buvumo raqefet misozi carmel israel hanatahuwe ibinogo byifashishwaga nk’amasekuru yanditswe habarurema djamali

title: ingengo y’imari ingana imaze gukoreshwa mishinga y’iterambere
content: minisiteri y’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu itangaza ingengo y’imari imaze gukoreshwa mishinga y’iterambere kigero mwaka - ibi byatangajwe n’umunyamabanga uhoraho minisiteri y’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu dusengiyumva samuel yitabye komisiyo y’inteko ishinga amategeko ishinzwe ingengo y’imari rwego kugaragaza loda igeze ishyira bikorwa imishinga y’iterambere nk’uko bisobanurwa perezida komisiyo y’ingengo y’imari nteko ishinga amategeko prof omar munyaneza avuga nyuma y’isesengura ryakozwe n’iyi komisiyo rusange ingengo y’imari imaze gukoreshwa mishinga y’iterambere ingana gihe hasigayeyo amezi atanu gusa kugira umwaka w’ingengo y’imari usozwe akaba asanga ikigero ingengo y’imari yagenewe imishinga y’iterambere ikiri hasi yagize mu mishinga y’iterambere imaze gukorwa isaga ingana urebye amezi asigaye umwaka w’ingengo y’imari usozwe imishinga imaze gukorwa mike n’ingengo y’imari imaze gukoreshwa ntoya prof munyaneza avuga igikurikiyeho ukujya turere kureba imishinga imaze gukorwa gusaba minaloc n’uturere gukoresha ingengo y’imari yagenewe imishinga y’iterambere bikorwa biteza imbere abaturage kugira umwaka w’ingengo y’imari uzasozwe imishinga imaze gushyirwa bikorwa perezida komisiyo y’ingengo y’imari nteko ishinga amategeko avuga isesengura komisiyo yakoze igaragaza hari uturere tugeze gukoresha ingengo y’imari gihe hari utundi tukiri hasi nk’akarere nyarugenge kari kigero gukoresha ingengo y’imari yagenewe imishinga y’iterambere ati isesengura twakoze ritugaragariza hari uturere tugeze gukoresha ingengo y’imari gihe hari utundi tukiri hasi nk’akarere nyarugenge kari utwa rubavu musanze tumaze gukoresha ingengo y’imari kigero umunyamabanga uhoraho minisiteri y’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu dusengiyumva samuel avuga ikibazo cyatumye uturere tw’umujyi kigali harimo n’akarere nyarugenge imikoreshereze y’ingengo y’imari yatwo yahujwe n’umujyi kigali utwo turere tukaba tutagifite ubuzima gatozi kuko imishinga izajya ishyirwa bikorwa biturutse rwego rw’umijyi ku kijyanye n’utundi turere tukiri hasi gukoresha ingengo y’imari yagenewe imishinga dusengimana avuga bagiye gukurikirana bakareba impamvu bakadushishikariza kongera imbaraga gushyira bikorwa mishinga ayinkamiye speciose umudepite nteko ishinga amategeko akaba umwe bagize komisiyo y’ingengo y’imari yagaragaje umwe mishinga y’iterambere ry’abaturage wakozwe imihanda ikorwa n’abagenerwabikorwa vup gahunda y’ibikorwa rusange ariko ntirambe kuko idahabwa imiferege itwara amazi y’imvura bigatuma yangirika itamaze kabiri aha umuyobozi mukuru loda nyinawagaga claudine avuga bagiye kureba uburyo imihanda izajya ikorwa buryo butuma amazi atangiza umuhanda bikaba bigiye gusuzumwa guhinduka yanabajije kandi loda izakemura ikibazo cy’abahabwa inguzanyo batishoboye vup financial service ntibazishyure dore n’ingwate basabwa nyinawagaga avuga zisigaye zitangwa nyuma kubaha amahugurwa mikoreshereze y’iyo nguzanyo n’uburyo zizishyurwa yagaragaje inguzanyo zitangwa vup baturage batishoboye kiciro mbere cy’ubudehe zishyurwa hamwe n’inyungu y’amafaranga bakaba basabwa kuyishyura kugira n’abandi bayabone abadepite bagize komisiyo y’ingengo y’imari barateganya kujya turere gusuzuma imishinga y’iterambere ikorwa turere rwego kumenya igeze ishyirwa bikorwa

content: perezida paul kagame yavuze abanyarwanda bishimiye gukorana kaminuza mpuzamahanga carnegie mellon carnegie mellon university cmu ashimira ubuyobozi bwayo uburyo bwagiriye ikizere u rwanda title: u rwanda rwatahanye umwanya kabiri mikino y’i bujumbura
content: amakipe y’u rwanda yitabiriye mikino afite umugambi kwitegura imikino y’akarere gatanu izabera rwanda tariki - muri mikino yitabiriwe n’amakipe burundi rdc n’u rwanda amakipe yagombaga guhura hagati yayo hakarebwa amakipe abiri mbere agakina umukino nyuma mu bahungu u rwanda rwatsinze umukino umwe gusa rutsindwa imikino ibiri u rwanda rwatsinzwe n’amakipe abiri y’uburundi yitabiriye irushanwa ariko rutsinda ikipe yaturutse congo mu bakobwa ikipe y’u rwanda nayo yakoze nk’ibya basaza kuko yatsinze ikipe congo ariko itsindwa n’amakipe abiri y’uburundi ukurikije amakipe yitabiriye iryo rushanwa yitwaye amakipe abiri y’uburundi niyo yabaye mbere u rwanda ruba urwa kabiri congo iza mwanya gatatu nawo nyuma kuko yatsinzwe n’amakipe yitabiriye irushanwa umunyamabanga mukuru w’ishyirahamwe ry’umukino basketball rwanda ferwaba richard mutabazi waherekeje ikipe burundi yavuze intego yabajyanye bayigezeho kuko bashakaga ikipe y’u rwanda itinyuka gukina n’amakipe akomeye dore yakinaga n’abayirusha imyaka mutabazi avuga umutoza w’iyo kipe amonovic nenad yishimiye abakinnyi bitwaye mikino kuko hari abakinnyi batunguranye cyane mikino bakora byinshi batabatekerezagaho buryo byatanze icyizere cy’uko gikombe cy’akarere gatanu bashobora kuzahangana n’amwe makipe ahabwa amahirwe kenya mu irushanwa ry’akarere gatanu rizitwabirwa n’u rwanda uganda kenya tanzania ethiopia sudan ethiopia ikipe izaba iya mbere izahita ibona itike kuzakina igikombe afurika afrobasket u’ kizabera mozambique tariki - theoneste nisingizwe

title: abanyarwanda batuye canada bibutse abazize jenoside yakorewe abatutsi
content: igikorwa kwibuka kitabiriwe kandi n’abahagarariye ibihugu byabo canada n’izindi nshuti uyu muhango watangijwe n’urugendo walk to remember rwatangiriye nteko ishingamategeko canada rugera biro by’umujyi ottawa ahabereye imihango kwibuka nyuma y’indirimbo zubahiriza ibihugu byombi hakurikiyeho umunota kwibuka inzirikarengane zishwe jenoside padiri callixte kabalisa wayoboye isengesho yasabiye abahuye n’ibibazo binyuranye harimo abafashwe ngufu asaba imana gukomeza impfubyi n’abapfakazi n’abandi bagize ibibazo bikomeye uhagarariye u rwanda canada edda mukabagwiza perezida w’ishyirahamwe ry’abacitse kw’icumu rizwi kw’izina humura alain ntwali bagaragaje bibuka amateka jenoside yabaye rwanda bagamije gufata ingamba ibyabaye ntibizongere kuba ukundi nk’uko itangazo ambasade y’u rwanda canada ribivuga berekanye umuhango ukorwa ugamije kwibuka ariko abantu bakanatekereza uburyo gufasha abacitse icumu bagarutse nsanganyamatsiko y’uyu mwaka twigire mateka twubaka ejo hazaza bavuga genoside yakorewe abatutsi mateka y’ubu n’ejo hazaza itazibagirana mu muhango kwibuka kandi hatanzwe ibiganiro bibiri l’historique de l’impunit des crimes haineux au rwanda et les signes avant-coureurs du gnocide contre les tutsis cyatanzwe bwana richard nsanzabaganwa les mots qui tuent cyatanzwe prof philippe basabose nsanzabaganwa yerekanye ubwicanyi bwagiye buba ariko ubutegetsi ntibuhane abakoze ibyaha kwica aha yavuze uduce tunyuranye ubwoko bw’abatutsi bwagiye bwicwa yerekanye kwica byagiye bishyigikirwa n’ubutegetsi kurengera abatutsi babaga bibasiwe prof basabose yerekanye amagambo yagiye akoreshwa rwanda yagize uruhare ishyirwa bikorwa ry’ubwicanyi yakoze isesengura ry’ijambo ryavuzwe leon mugesera i kabaya yakanguriye abanyamuryango mrnd abereka umwanzi wabo umututsi n’abahutu mashyaka ataravugaga rumwe mrnd gahunda ziteganijwe zijyanye kwibuka zizagera kwezi gatanu zirimo amasengesho ikiriyo n’ibiganiro bizatangwa taliki mata abanyarwanda n’inshuti zabo bongeye guhura gitambo misa kwibuka cyabereye paruwasi mutagatifu yozefu gatineau quebec

title: uko ibitaro uganda byanze kwakira umunyarwanda bimuviramo urupfu
content: umunyarwanda witwa mwiseneza bosco w’imyaka y’amavuko ukomoka murenge cyanika karere burera yaguye bitaro ruhengeri kabiri tariki gashyantare nyuma kurwarira uganda i kisoro amaze imyaka itanu atuye yajya kwivuza bakanga kumuvura kubera umunyarwanda umuvandimwe witwa benon twishimye wabanaga i kisoro uganda yavuze yajyanye mwiseneza bitaro kiboga mujyi uganda ariko banga kumwakira kubera umunyarwanda ati mu by’ukuri birababaje kuba abaganga b’ibitaro banze kumuvura yavuze abaganga bababwiraga miti bafite abamenye inkuru y’urupfu rw’uwo munyarwanda ntabwo batunguwe kumva umunyarwanda atavuwe umwe bamenye urwo rupfu yagize niba bafunga amagana n’amagana y’abanyarwanda buryo butazwi cyatuma bita urwaye ubwo bangaga kumuvura umuvandimwe yafashe moto ibageza mupaka cyanika ahamagara muryango baza kumwakira umwe bagiye kumwakira mupaka yagize mwiseneza arembye atabasha kwicara cyangwa kuvuga inzego z’umutekano z’u rwanda mupaka cyanika zahise zishaka ambulance yihuse imujyana bitaro cyanika agezeyo bihita bimwohereza ruhengeri umwe bagize umuryango yavuze yahageze arembye cyane yaguye akihagera yagize twagezeyo arembye cyane bahita bamwohereza bitaro by’icyitegererezo ruhengeri ariko bw’amahirwe make apfa tukihagera undi bagize umuryango yavuze umuntu wabo yananijwe n’urugendo moto yakoze kandi arembye avuga bitaro kiboga byari bitabashije kumuvura nibura biba byaratanze n’uburyo kumutwara cyangwa yaba miti bikamwohereza bitaro byisumbuye akarere kisoro byabereyemo niko gakomokamo umunyamabanga leta ushinzwe ubutwererane bw’akarere philemon mateke werekanye urwango afitiye u rwanda n’abanyarwanda buryo butandukanye mateke inyuma y’igitero cyagabwe murenge kinigi karere musanze ukwakira umwaka ushize cyahitanye abaturage kigakomeretsa bamwe icyo gihe inzego z’umutekano z’u rwanda zishe bagabye igitero baturutse rud-urunana zifata mpiri batanu aribo baje kugaragaza mateke abifitemo uruhare kandi wateguye gitero mu bayafatiwe igitero cyabereye harimo telefoni zerekanaga mateke yavuganaga n’abo barwanyi rud-urunana mbere gihe igitero cyabaga mateke umuntu ufite ingengabitekerezo kurwanya u rwanda nkuko abamuzi neza babivuze kenshi uwo minisitiri ukorana rnc fdrl yanagize uruhare ifungwa ry’inzirakarengane z’abanyarwanda uganda gihamya abaherutse gukurwa nzu z’imbohe z’urwego rw’ubutasi cmi boherejwe i kisoro aho byari biteganyijwe boherezwa rwanda nyuma y’amezi bamaze buroko buryo butemewe n’amategeko rubanza cyangwa gukurikiranwa mateke yafashe abagera arongera arabafunga ibyo byabaye ukwakira imiryango y’abo bantu yaguye kantu mateke yinjiraga cyumba cy’urukiko akavugana n’umucamanza gihano uwari rukiko yavuze umucamanza kisoro yahise ategeka bafungwa andi mezi bashinjwa kwinjira gihugu buryo bunyuranyije n’amategeko

title: inkomoko y’umugani ’bateye rwaserera’
content: uyu mugani bawuca babonye abantu basahinda bateye imvururu niho bavuga bateye rwaserera’ wakomotse rwaserera w’i rusororo rukaryi kigali ahagana mwaka ubwo hari ngoma cyirima rujugira hatera akanda k’inzara kayogoza u bwanacyambwe n’u rukaryi n’u buganza abantu utwo turere bicwa n’inzara karahava mu rukaryi i rusororo hagatura umugabo witwa rwaserera akaba umukungu ukomeye cyane afite amasaka yuzuye ibigega abantu utwo turere bakajya bamucaho inshuro ndetse n’abafite ibimasa n’amasuka akabahahira inzara igumya guca ibintu utwo turere bukeye umugabo utuye i buganza shyiramuruzi witwa rubanguka mpama arikora ajya gukeza rwaserera ageze iwe nje kugukeza unsindire cyago cy’inzara rwaserera aramwemerera aramuhaka amushyira bahinzi bukeye rwaserera ajya kureba abahinzi bahinga ageze asanga rubanguka yihagarariye amubonye aramutonganya aranamutuka cyane dore nyana y’imbwa w’umuganza w’umudeshyi irandeheshereza abahinzi nkabona iwanyu mwararimbuwe n’inzara bunebwe bwanyu rubanguka abyumvise ararakara isuka ayijugunya hasi aragenda n’incuro yaciye arayita ataha iwabo i shyiramuruzi agezeyo abitekerereza abaturanyi ababwira rwaserera umugome wasagutswe n’umurengwe bikabije amaze kugenda rwaserera biramubabaza nta wundi muganza nzongera guhingisha cyangwa muhahire kuva uje guhakwa rwaserera akabanza kumubaza aturuka yamubwira aturuka i buganza akamwirukana abanyabuganza babura bahahira haciye iminsi rubanguka abagisha inama gutera rwaserera bamunyage bukungu akangisha baranga bati nta twakwiteza umuntu ejo bitazatugwa nabi batware cyangwa ibwami abandi ahari iwe haratikira hazize mucancuro rubanguka mpama w’i shyiramuruzi kuva babona abantu benshi musozi basahinda bakavuga bateye rwaserera ubwo babagereranya n’abateye rwaserera w’i rusororo azize agasuzuguro n’umurengwe byakuwe gitabo ibirari by’insigamigani

title: ku myaka y’amavuko umucyecuru yagiye i maka gukora umutambagiro mutagatifu
content: umukecuru witwa amina mukanduhura atuye nkoto karere kamonyi y’umujyi kigali umwe bayoboke b’idini islamu bahagurutse i kigali ijoro ryo cyumweru berekeza i maka arabiya sawudite mutambagiro mutagatifu hidja mukanduhura ugendera kabando kubera ubona afite intege nke yavutse akaba afite imyaka y’amavuko avuga n’ubwo atuye nkoto ariko iwe nyirizina i nyarugenge ahitwa mucyo bwa mbere agiye gukora hidjango yashatse kujyayo kera ariko ntibyamukundira none akaba yishimiye abashije kujyayo gusa avuga ibyishimo bye bitaba byinshi kubera ataramenya agerayo amahoro amina ubu se urambaza ibyishimo mfite nari namenya ngerayo uyu mukambwe avuga yatangiye gutegura kujya mutambagiro mutagatifu akiri urubyiruko ariko amafaranga bisaba ntabashe kuyabona kuri nshuro kugira abashe kujyayo yagurishije akarima se aherutse gutsindira nyuma y’igihe kirekire amaze akaburana ati ngiye i maka kuko butaka bw’intumwa zacu imana yavuze umusilamu uzapfa yarageze i maka azapfa neza imana izamwakira neza kandi ikamwishimira ningerayo ndatekerereza imana ibyanjye kandi irabizi uwo mukecuru avuga amaze igihe idini islamu kuko umuslamu ati icyo nabwira abantu ugukunda imana kuko ngeze bwayo kujya i maka mutambagiro mutagatifu bisaba ubushobozi miliyoni zisaga eshatu z’amafaranga y’u rwanda muntu umwe abagera barimo abagore n’abagabo bahagurutse rwanda berekeje i maka nshuro umukuru amina mukanduhura w’imyaka umuto afite imyaka y’amavuko indege ibavana i kanombe kibuga cy’indege yahagurutse saa ijoro ryakeye biteganijwe bakazagaruka rwanda tariki kanama hakunze kuvugwa ibibazo by’umutekano muke n’umubyigano ukabije bitabiriye mutambagiro mutagatifu hakaba n’igihe biviramo bamwe bawitabiriye kuhasiga ubuzima kuba hakunze kuvugwa umutekano mucye utewe n’umubyigano w’ababa bitabiriye gikorwa bikaba byatuma hari n’abahasiga ubuzimaabayoboye tsinda batanze ikizere mpungenge z’umutekano wabo bafite kubera babanje kubahugura mbere guhaguruka bagomba kwitwaraikindi kandi gucyemura kibazo amacumbi bazabamo yegereye umusigiti w’i maka gukora umutambagiro mutagatifu hidja biri nkingi eshanu islamuumuyisilamu wese ubifitiye ubushobozi asabwa gukora umutambagiro mutagatifu ubera i maka arabiya sawudite nibura inshuro buzima bwe yanditswe habarurema djamali

title: abahanzi basuye urwibutso jenoside ntarama n’urwa nyamata
content: abahanzi batorewe gukomeza cyikiro kabiri bitabiriye urwo rugendo usibye knowless bubiligi kwitabira gahunda zijyanye kwibuka nk’uko umujyanama manager abitangaza abo bahanzi babanje gusura urwibutso ntarama basobanuriwe amateka yaho ndetse n’iyicwarubozo ryahabereye basobanuriwe ukuntu mbere jenoside abatutsi bahigwaga ariko uwabaga yahungiye kiriziya ntacyo yabaga ibyo byatumye jenoside benshi bahungira kiriziya bizeye gukira nk’uko byagendaga mbere ariko siko byagenze kuko bamaze kwirundiramo interahamwe zabasanzemo zibica urw’agashinyaguro abatutsi bahungiye kiriziya central ntarama babanje kwihagararaho ariko bigeze itariki nibwo abasirikare n’interahamwe baje banakoresha n’ibisasu kuburyo haguye abagera mu rwibutso ntarama hari imibiri y’abatutsi bazize jenoside kandi hagaragara bimwe bikoresho byifashishwa rugo baje bitwaje cyangwa se bahunganye kuko batekerezaga igihe kizagera bagasubira mungo zabo hagaragara kandi n’imyenda biteye agahinda buri munyarwanda wese ava akagera yagombye kugira ntibizongere ukundi nyangezi freddy umwe baherekeje abahanzi akaba uhagarariye bralirwa gikorwa yagize kwibuka igikorwa buri wese ku ruhande rwacu bralirwa igikorwa twubaha cyane uretse guteza imbere abahanzi tugomba kubigisha amateka bralirwa yubatse inzibutso ebyiri jenoside zishyinguwemo abakozi bakoraga bralirwa bazize jenoside gisenyi kigali bralirwa kandi ikorana n’urwibutso gisozi rwego kugira busitani bwarwo hahore hasukuye ikindi abana b’imfuzi ababyeyi bishwe jenoside bakoraga bralirwa bishyurirwa amafaranga y’ishuri mashuri mato kugera secondaire ariko hari gahunda gutangira kubishyurira kaminuza ku rwibutso nyamata ahantu hafite amateka yihariye nk’uko abahanzi babisobanuriwe niho ha mbere haguye abatutsi benshi cyane gihugu abatutsi baguye hano nyamata barashinyaguriwe bitavugwa nyamata ituwe n’abatutsi barakuwe turere dutandukanye tw’amajyaruguru gisenyi ruhengeri rwego kugira bapfe kuko hari ishyamba habagamo inyamaswa nyinshi ndetse n’amasazi yateraga indwara tsetse hapfiriye benshi gihe mu mwaka habaye ubwicanyi bumeze nk’aho byari igeragezwa jenoside buhitana abatutsi bagera kandi ntawigeze ahanirwa ukwicwa kw’abo batutsi hari umuzungu w’umutariyanikazi utuye witwaga tonia locatelli bamwishe tariki bamuziza yababwiraga adashyigikiye iyicwa ry’abatutsi bahatuye buryo ndetse yaranatangiye kubatabariza miryango mpuzamahanga mu mwaka w’ haguye abatutsi barenga hakaba hashyinguye abagera muri bahashyinguye harimo umubyeyi witwaga mukandori annonciata wishwe abanje gufatwa ngufu n’interahamwe z’abagabo nyuma bamujomba igisongo gitsina kirakomeza gitunguka mutwe uwo ashyinguwe ukwe isanduku wenyine rwego kugira harusheho kugaragazwa ubugome bw’indengakamere bwakorewe mubyeyinyuma gusobanurirwa byinshi kwirebera n’amaso abahanzi bagize babivugaho ntakirutimana danny uzwi izina danny nanone yagize hari ikiyongereyeho kuko ubwa mbere nsuye nyamata hiyongereye mateka narinzi nk’uko jenoside yagizwe uruhare n’abahanzi ndateganya gukora indirimbo irimo ubutumwa ubutumwa natanga kubagezweho jenoside ukwihangana gukurikiza gahunda z’icyunamo kudaheranwa n’agahinda tukiyubaka ikivi cy’abacu tuzacyusa kandi ibyabaye ntibizongere buri muhanzi cyangwa se itsinda bagize bavuga kubyo bamaze kubwirwa ndetse kwirebera n’amaso dore magambo make ubutumwa bwatanzwe n’abahanzi nyuma gusura urwibutso ntarama n’urwa nyamata riderman yagize igihe kirageze dutange ubutumwa bwibaka banyarwanda king james ngiye kurushaho gutanga ubutumwa bwunga abanyarwanda ndirimbo zanjye bull dog abahanzi batanze ubutumwa bwanganisha abanyarwanda bakwiye kubiryozwa dream boys ijwi platini iti umuhanzi indorerwamo rubanda duharanire gusiga isi nziza kurusha twayisanze just family ijwi jimmy iti dukwiye guhindura amateka y’umuziki tukirinda ubutumwa busenya emmy yagize ibyo mbonye birandenze dukwiye gukora bwabaga kugira bitazongera young grace atinjye nari muto mbyumva mateka ariko abafana banjye n’abanyarwanda rusange nabakangurira kunga ubumwe bagakundana bakaba ubumwe jay polly iyo mbonye ibintu nkibi birandenga abakoze bashyiraga bikorwa ibitekerezo by’abategetsi babi twe twongere ingufu gushyira bikorwa iby’abayobozi beza badusaba danny dukwiye guharanira bitongera kubaho ukundi umuyobozi mukuru east african promotors yasobanuye impamvu bazanye bahanzi gusura inzibutso magambo ukugira batazakora batazanatekereza n’umunsi rimwe kuba bakora ibikorwa nk’ibi bashyigikira cyangwa bakaririmba ibikorwa nk’ibi kuko byatugejeje ahantu nakwita habi cyane ndasaba urubyiruko rusange igikorwa cyabaye rwanda cy’ubwicanyi bumeze gutya bw’indengakamere kitabaho ukundi marie clemence cyiza uwimanimpaye

title: abakozi bagiye kujya bakatwa yunganira mituweli
content: minisiteri y’abakozi leta n’umurimo yaraye isohoye itangazo risaba abakoresha bigo leta n’iby’abigenga kujya bakata mushahara buri mukozi mafaranga akunganira gahunda y’ubwisungane kwivuza mituelle de sant itangazo ryasinywe minisitiri w’abakozi leta n’umurimo rwanyindo kayirangwa fanfan rivuga buri mukoresha azajya akusanya buri kwezi musanzu akawushyira konti rssb nyuma akawumenyekanisha bitarenze tariki y’ukwezi abakozi bahembwemo aya mabwiriza ashingiye iteka minisitiri w’intebe n ryo ryerekeye inkunga z’ubwisungane kwivuza nk’uko bivugwa gaka k’ingingo ivuga inkunga leta bwisungane kwivuza iri teka rigena inkunga itangwa leta ituruka bigo bitanga ubwishingizi kwivuza rwanda ituruka uguhamagara telefone icuruzwa ry’ibikomoka peteroli inkunga leta miliyari esheshatu frw aturuka ngengo y’imari y’umwaka ibihumbi bitatu by’amafaranga y’u rwanda frw buri mwaka buri muntu utishoboye cyiciro mbere cy’ubudehe mirongo itanu ijana by’amafaranga yishyurwa iyandikwa ry’imiti n’ibikoresho buvuzi ijana ijana by’amafaranga yishyurwa n’abakora ubushakashatsi rwego rw’ubuzima icumi ijana by’amafaranga acibwa serivisi zihabwa amasosiyete y’ubucuruzi akora ibikorwa by’imikino y’amahirwe mirongo itanu ijana by’amafaranga yishyurwa kugenzura imiterere y’ibinyabiziga icumi ijana by’amafaranga acibwa abatwara ibinyabiziga bakoze amakosa muhanda ijana ijana by’amafaranga acibwa abacuruza ibintu bitujuje ubuziranenge amafaranga ijana frw ava mahoro yakwa parikingi z’ibinyabiziga buri isaha bihagaze zeru n’ibice bitanu ijana y’umushahara umukozi atahana icumi ijana by’amafaranga ava bukerarugendo agenewe uturere bireba amafaranga ibihumbi makumyabiri frw ava ihererekanya ry’imodoka n’ibihumbi icumi frw ava ihererekanya moto ibihumbi bine frw hegitari
