title: sport argentine gikombe cy’isi bikozwe messi
content: argentine kimwe bihugu by’ibihangange bifite amahirwe kucyerekezamo ariko yaraye ikoze ibisa n’ibitangaza ibifashijwemo rutahizamu lionel messi ikatisha itike argentina mwanya gatandatu bihugu byarimo bihatanira amatike atanu kuzahagararira umugabane amerika y’amajyepfo gikombe cy’isi mbere y’uko ikina umukino nyuma quateur yasabwaga gutsinda bitaba igasezererwa burundu irushanwa yakinnye umukino waryo nyuma riheruka ryabereye brazil ntabwo byatangiye neza kuko munota mbere gusa imaze gutsindwa igitego mbere myugariro romario ibarra byasaga n’aho icyizere cyose abakunzi argentine n’umukinnyi wayo lionel messi bakunzwe cyane isi bafite gitangiye kuyoyoka byasabye iminota kugira messi umaze gutorwa nk’umukinnyi mbere isi inshuro eshanu atangire guhindura umukino yatsinze igitego mbere mupira ahawe angel di maria nyuma iminota irindwi messi yashyizemo icya kabiri cyatumye imitima y’abanya-argentine itangira gusubira gitereko ndetse aza gushimangira inzozi zabo kuzagaragara gikombe cy’isi munota atsinda igitego gatatu umukino amahirwe nyuma urangira ibitego - nubwo messi yafashije argentine kubona itike ikiyongera bihugu brsil iyobowe neymar uruguay luis suarez colombia radamel falcao peru izaca mikino kamarampaka kimwe bihangange mugabane cyatunguwe chile iyobowe rutahizamu arsenal alex sanchez yarangije iya gatandatu ikaba izasigara rugo leta zunze ubumwe amerika nayo yatunguwe ndetse ntabwo izagaragara gikombe imaze imyaka itaraburamo rimwe kuko gice concacaf ishakiramo itike mexique costa rica panama nizo zayibonye honduras ikazanyura mikino kamarampaka ku mugabane w’u burayi ibyishimo bafaransa nabo baraye babonye tike bigoranye nyuma gutsinda belarus ibitego - antoine griezmann olivier giroud kimwe portugal iyobowe cristiano ronaldo yabonye itike bidasubirwaho itsinze u busuwisi ibitego - igihugu gikomeye cyatunguwe u buholandi bwatsinze sude ibitego bibiri busa byombi arjen robben gusa ntibyagira biyifasha kuko yasabwaga gutsinda ibiri hejuru birindwi bityo ikaba itazagaragara rushanwa

title: reb irasabwa gukurikiza amategeko kwirinda kurenganya abakozi

title: abanyarwanda burusiya bibutse jenoside yakorewe abatutsi
content: umuhango kwibuka jenoside yakorewe abatutsi wabaye gicurasi hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga bijyanye n’ingamba kwirinda icyorezo covid- giterwa n’agakoko coronavirus witabiriwe n’abanyarwanda n’inshuti zabo ziba burusiya n’intumwa zihagarariye ibihugu byazo bibutse jenoside yakorewe abatutsi rwanda ambasaderi w’u rwanda burusiya lt general frank mushyo kamanzi ijambo rye yasobanuye umugambi jenoside wacuzwe ukanashyirwa bikorwa yagize nk’uko mubizi gihugu cyacu cy’u rwanda guhera mata gihe cy’iminsi habayeho jenoside yakorewe abatutsi y’indengakamere yateguwe inashyirwa bikorwa n’ubutegetsi bwariho gihe yakomeje avuga uyu munsi burusiya hanze yabwo abanyarwanda n’inshuti zabo baribuka inzirakarengane zirenga miliyoni zishwe zizira abatutsi’’ ambasaderi lt general frank mushyo yahumurije abacitse icumu anabashimira ubutwari bwabo kwihangana kubabarira byagize uruhare kwiyunga gukiza igihugu yashimiye ingabo rwanda patriotic army zari zirangajwe imbere perezida paul kagame kubohora guhagarika jenoside gihe amahanga yareberaga mu akanama k’umuryango w’abibumbye gashinzwe umutekano kashyizeho icyemezo cyerekeye gukumira kurwanya jenoside n’ibindi byaha bikomeye bikubiye mategeko mpuzamahanga yemeza guhakana jenoside yakorewe abatutsi kandi isaba ibihugu bigize muryango guteza imbere uburezi bwabo bashyiramo gahunda z’amasomo yigisha jenoside yakorewe abatutsi rwego gukumira handi jenoside izongera kuba icyo cyemezo kandi gihamagarira ibihugu byose gukora iperereza guta yombi gukurikirana cyangwa kohereza rwanda cyangwa nkiko mpuzamahanga abantu baregwa jenoside butaka bwabo ibi ariko hari bitarashyirwa bikorwa kuko abantu benshi bakekwaho icyaha gukora jenoside bakorera bwisanzure bihugu bimwe bimwe ariko banakomeza gukwirakwiza ingengabitekerezo jenoside yakorewe abatutsi kuyihakana ambasaderi lt general frank mushyo yahamagariye ibihugu byaba bifite abanyabyaha kubashyikiriza ubutabera yashimiye minisiteri y’ububanyi n’amahanga y’u burusiya butumwa yoherereje abanyarwanda ashimira inshuti z’u rwanda bufatanye bwabo gihe kwibuka kwigomwa umwanya bakitabira igikorwa kwibuka gihe isi ihanganye covid- mu bashyitsi bakuru bitabiriye igikorwa kwibuka barimo ambasaderi cameroun mahamat paba sale uhagarariye itsinda ry’abambasaderi b’abanyafurika burusiya mu ijambo rye yihanganishije abanyarwanda anavuga ibyababayeho ibyago rwanda afurika yashimiye iterambere ry’u rwanda nzego zitandukanye rukaba igihugu gifatwa nk’ishema afurika mu ijambo rye pasiteri pavel yagejeje bakurikiranaga muhango kwibuka yavuze umwanya nk’uyu kuzirikana byabaye banyarwanda kandi urubyiruko rwabonye ibyabaye n’urutarabibonye rukigishwa rudakwiye kuzijandika bikorwa kinyamaswa yagize ntibizongere kubaho ukundi umuyobozi diaspora nyarwanda i moscow ruhinda alexis yibanze kubwira urubyiruko bagenzi myaka ishize hari isomo rikwiye gusiga ati turimo twibuka hari urubyiruko rwagendeye nama mbi rukoreka igihugu’’ yasabye urubyiruko kumenya gushungura amakuru rubona cyane cyane akwirakwiza ingengabitekerezo jenoside kuko ntaho yageza igihugu ahubwo yagisubiza inyuma ibikorwa kwibuka jenoside yakorewe abatutsi bizasozwa nyakanga igihe kingana n’iminsi yamaze mbere guhagarikwa

title: bamwe bakorera uburaya i nyamirambo ntibacyemera imibonano mpuzabistina idakingiye
content: kigalitoday yegereye itsinda bamwe bakorera uburaya i nyamirambo bayibwira bamenye ububi sida bakurikije babona sida imerera nabi bamwe bagenzi itsinda ry’indaya z’i nyamirambo ryemeye kuganira kigalitoday rivuga ntawabona cyangwa abe yumva ububi sida abure gufata ingamba kwirinda sida ntitucyemera gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina gakingirizo n’abakiriya bacu kuko twamenye ingaruka mbi z’imibonano mpuzabitsina idakingiyeabagabo badakoresha agakingirizo bafite virusi itera sidaiyo yanze dukoresha agakingirizo acaho njye nkacaho nubwo ariko bamwe bakora uburaya i nyamirambo bavuga batacyemerera gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina abakiriya banga gukoresha agakingirizo hari abakora uburaya bageraho bakemera gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina gakingirizo kubera ubukene kubura abakiriya itsinda ry’indaya z’i nyamirambo riti hari bagenzi bacu bageraho bakemera gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina gakingirizo kubera ategereza umwanya munini umukiriya wemera agakingirizo akamubura kandi yenda abana baburaye ubushakashatsi bwakozwe n’ikigo cy’igihugu cy’ubuvuzirwanda bio-medical center bugashyirwa ahagaragara mwaka buragaragaza bakora uburaya umuntu umwe babiri yanduye virusi itera sida umukozi rbc dr mwumvaneza mutagoma uyoboye itsinda ry’ubushakashatsi bwagaragaje imibare y’ubwandu virusi itera sida rwanda dr mwumvaneza avuga imibare yavuye bushakashatsi bakoze igaragaza gihugu hose rwanda abakora uburaya abagera banduye virusi itera sida mujyi kigali ijanisha rikaba riri hejuru ugereranije gihugu rusange kuko ho abagera banduye virusi itera sida inzobere ndwara sida zivuga indaya itsinda ry’abantu rifite ibyago byinshi kwandura virusi itera sida kurusha andi matsinda ibi biterwa indaya abantu bakora imibonano mpuzabitsina inshuro nyinshi kandi n’abantu batandukanye barimo abanduye vihsida u rwanda ubushakashatsi bugaragaza rutuwe n’abaturage barenga gato miliyoni muri rusange gihugu hose abantu babana virusi itera sida by’abanyarwanda ni ukuvuga rwanda abantu bagera bihumbi babana virusi itera sida jean baptiste micomyiza

title: perezida caf yambuwe ubuyobozi n’amatora
content: issa hayatou umukambwe ukomoka gihugu cameroon wayoboraga caf byari byarananiranye avaho harinze kwitabazwa amatora arekure ubuyobozi yaramaranye imyaka aharire abakiri bato uyu issa hayatou umaze imyaka ayobora shyirahamwe ry’umupra w’amaguru yasimbuwe werurwe umunyamadagaskari niwe musimbuye mwanya w’umuperezida caf ahmed ahmed w’imyaka akazayiyobora mugihe kingana manda y’imyaka ine ese issa hayatou muntu ki issa hayatou umukambwe w’imyaka y’amavuko yavukiye i garoua kamerone afite umugore n’abana bane akaba umukinyi gusiganwa maguru yegukanye ibihembo bitari bicye ntera metero ndetse hagati yi aza kuba umwe mubanyamuryango bagize itsinda ry’umukino w’amaboko basketball ndetse n’umikino ngororangingo yagize uruhare mugutuma amakipe nyafurika yitabira igikombe cy’isi yiyongera akava makipe akagera mubijyanye n’ubuyobozi - yabaye umwarimu lyce leclerc i yaounde - yabaye umunyamabanga mukuru w’ishyirahamwe ry’umupira w’amaguru kamerone - umuyobozi w’imikino kameroneministri w’urubyiruko n’imikino ndetse akaba yaranari mukanama gafata ibyemezo mw’ishyiramwe ry’umupira w’amaguru - perezida caf ariko by’umwihariko hagati akaba yarari kanama gafata ibyemezo fifa visi prezida fifa hano niwe yarakuriye komite ishinzwe gutegura imikino ngororangingo kugeza akaba visi perezi comite ishinzwe umutekano n’ubwumvikane fifa yarari umwe mubari bashinzwe gutegura igikombe cy’isi yabaye umwe mubagize akanama mpuzamahanga k’abagore mumikino ngororangingo yatowe kuba umwe mubagize komite mpuzamahanga y’imikino ngororangingo yabereye mubu rusiya i moscow - yabaye prezida w’inzibacyuho fifa reba urutonde rw’abayoboye caf abdel aziz addallah salem-abdel aziz moustafa -abdel halim muhammad-yidnekatchew tessema -abdel halim muhammad - incuro kabiri yanditswe habarurema djamalimuhaburarw

title: igihugu gihagaze neza pe-perezida kagame
content: perezida repubulika paul kagame yatangaje n’ubwo hashize imyaka igera ibiri hari abagerageza guhungabanya umutekano w’igihugu bitabahiriye ndetse ahubwo ubukungu bukazamuka gipimo cy’u igipimo kiboneka hake isi saa tanu z’amaywa zirengaho iminota mike perezida repubulika paul kagame madamu jeannette kagame binjiye kigali convention center ahakoraniye inama y’igihugu y’umushyikirano nshuro iyi nama kuwa kugeza ukuboza ikoraniyemo abasaga barimo abanyarwanda bagera mahanga ikaba ifite umwihariko kuba ipfundikiye icyerekezo mu ijambo rigaragaza ishusho y’uko igihugu gihagaze perezida republika paul kagame yahereye mutekano w’igihugu yashimangiye wifashe neza ndetse agashimira ubufatanye bw’abaturage n’inzego zishinzwe ubusugire bw’ igihugu bwatumye bigerwaho yagize ’’nk’uko bisabwa ndagira mbanze igihugu cyacu gihagaze ndabivuga nshamake ariko nahera kubanza kubabwira gihagaze neza pe ntabwo guhagarara neza amahirwe gusa wenda yaba arimo guhagarara neza mwe mwese biturukaho buri wese afite uruhare rwe mirimo ashinzwe buryo butandukanye inshuti difite dukorana yaba ayandi mahanga cyangwa byaba abantu giti cyabo bafite bakorana n’u rwanda’’ umukuru w’igihugu yakomoje bikorwa by’abagerageza guhungabanya umutekano w’igihugu abakurira inzira murima ibikorwa byabo ntacyo biteze kugeraho ’’ariko n’ibikorwa bake bibi bigaragara nkaho byinshi abagerageza guhungabanya umutekano wacu murabizi tubimazemo nk’imyaka ishize byongeye kugenda bigaragara ariko navuga tubigerereye kandi ngira wenda abantu bafite amatwi barabwirwa ntibumvebafite amaso barerekwa ntibabonengira byari bikwiye kuba byumvwa buri wese byari bikwiye kuba bibonwa buri wese ariko twagiye tubabwira bizagenda ni byagenze bizagenda’’ mu bijyanye n’ubukungu perezida kagame yavuze bwiyongereye bipimo bishimishije n’ubwo igihugu cyahanganye n’ibihe bitoroshye ati ’’ahubwo bikaba binatangaje kuko byazamutse byarihuse kandi ahubwo duhanganye n’ibibazo bitari bike ibibazo mipakabiragaragara ubukungu bwacu bwazamutse nk’ingengo y’imari y’igihugu cyacu biva twe ni byiza ariko ntibihagizeje ndetse ubukungu nisigiyemo ntashatse gukabya umwaka uzarangira dushobora kuba mwaka atwarageze handi biri isi’’ perezida kagame yakomoje nzego nk’ubureziubuhinzi n’ibikorwa remezo yavuze zihagaze neza ariko ashimgangira intambwe imaze guterwa ikwiye kuba imbarutso gukora byinshi kurusho kuba u rwanda ruri mwanya afurika korohereza ishoramari perezida repubulika yabigaragaje nk’igipimo cyiza icyakora avuga guhindura ibigenderwaho byatumye u rwanda ruza mwanya bihugu ijana mirongo isi yakomoje gahunda visit rwanda yerura imaze gutanga umusaruro mwinshi kubahiriza ihame ry’uburinganire perezida kagame yabigaragaje nk’ihame u rwanda rudateze gutezukaho dore ruza myanya mbere isiimyanya avuga yakabaye iza n’imbere kurushahonyuma guhamagarira abagore b’ingeri zitandukanye gukomeza umurego bakora bafatanyije n’abagaboumukuru w’ igihugu yageze n’aho akomoza bijyanye kuba u rwanda rwayoborwa n’umugore ati ’’ariko abadamu mumaze kugira mugeramwongeremo vitessenjya nifuza rimwe yuko mwanya mwampaye ubukurikira uzatwarwa n’umugoreabagabo hano ndi bubakire simbiziariko nabo bashobora kuba bashaka’’ inama y’igihugu y’umushyikirano iteganywa n’ingingo y’itegeko nshinga ry’u rwanda ryo ryavuguruwe itumizwa kdi ikayoborwa perezida repubulika ikitabirwa n’abahagarariye abanyarwanda ngeri zinyuranye haba nzego letaabikorera imiryango itari iya leta ndetse n’abahagarsriye ibihugu n’imiryango mpuzamahanga ikorera rwanda chief editor muhaburarw

title: amerika igitangaza ishusho bikiramariya yabonywe irimo irira amarira y’iroza amafotovideo
content: ishushostatue bikiramariya iherereye kiliziya notre-dame de guadalupe i hobbs new mexico leta zigize leta zunze ubumwe amerika yabonywe irimo kurira amarira yasaga nk’ibara ry’iroza kandi amezi nk’amavuta kuba nk’amazi bisanzwe inkuru dukesha daily mail ivuga abakirisitu mbere babonye shusho irira misa cyumweru cyabanjirije gishize ukuvuga gicurasi iyi shusho cyangwa se ikibumbano mariya nyina yezu cyabonywe n’abakirisitu kirimo kuriraabantu baturutse bice bitandukanye new mexico nkengero zaho baza kureba kwifatanya bikiramariya arirakiliziya yafunguwe amasaha baha umwanya abazaga gusenga gufata ishusho bikiramariya arira padiri jos ’pepe’ segura uyobora kiliziya yavuze umwe bagize paruwasi paroisse yamubwiye iby’uko shusho irimo kurira ndetse abona abantu barimo bayihanagura ariko amarira agakomeza gutemba yagize ubwo nabonye rwose arimobikiramariya arira aganira las cruces sun sentinel padiri yongeyeho ndibwira inyibutsarappel twese twiyegereze imana tureke kuba abanyarugomoabari bahari bavuga bahanaguraga shusho amarira andi yahitaga atemba iyi kiliziya yagumye ifunguye amasaha gihe abantu baturutse imihanda new mexico ndetse kugeza texas bazaga baje kureba abakirisitu bitaga igitangaza umugabo witwa peter mcdonald utuye i midland texas yakuye abana batanu ishuri bajye kureba nyina yezu arira yabwiye kvia-tv ni umugisha udasanzwe kuba turi hano burengerazuba texas kubona ishusho hano irira gutya ibitangaza ku kane w’iki cyumweru gishize diyoseze las cruces new mexico yaje gusuzuma marira kugira imenye koko ikimenyetsofact cy’igitangazaburi wese ategereje abashe kwegera shusho deacon jim winder umuyobozi wungirije diyoseze yavuze bizatwara igihe kinini hakorwa isuzuma yabwiye kob-tv udashobora kugaragaza igitangaza ariko ushobora guhakana ibindi bisobanuro’ kiliziya yafunzwe amasaha ane gihe abayobozi bageranyaga amwe marira’ ngo shusho nayo igomba kunyuzwa cyuma radiographier hakanabazwa abatangabuhamya babonye biba ndetse hakanakurikiranwa inkomoko kugeza shusho yakorewe ibintu bishobora gufata igihe kitari gito ariko byagenda kose abakirisitu babonye biba bavuga abahamya b’igitangaza biboneye laura wright utuye hobbs yagize ibi byari impamo yariraga rwosearababaye kanda hano hasi urebe agace gato k’uburyo byari byifashe

title: bagore mwubahe cyane abagabo banyu
content: bagore mugandukire abagabo banyuabefeso kuki kumvira umugabo akenshi bigorana mu bihugu byinshi umugabo n’umugore bashyingiranywe umugeni ahiga umuhigo avuga azubaha cyane umugabo icyakora uburyo abagabo benshi bafata abagore butuma guhigura muhigo byoroha cyangwa bikagorana ariko umuryango watangiye neza imana yakuye urubavu muntu mbere adamu iruhinduramo umugore adamu yavuganye ibyishimo igufwa ryo magufwa yanjye akara mara yanjyeitangiriro - ni gute bihe vuba inshingano z’abagore muryango ndetse n’uko babona ishyingiranwa byahindutse nubwo umuryango waragize ntangiriro nziza ntangiriro y’imyaka leta zunze ubumwe z’amerika hatangiye poropagande yiswe kwibohoza kw’abagore ukuvuga abagore baharaniraga kwibohoza butegetsi bw’abagabo icyo gihe ugereranyije abagabo mugore bataga imiryango mu mpera y’imyaka mubare warahindutse abagabo bata imiryango mugore muri gihe usanga abagore bavuga amagambo y’urukozasoni bagasinda bakanywa itabi kandi bakiyandarika kimwe n’abagabo none se abagore barushijeho kugira ibyishimo ashwi da mu bihugu bimwe bimwe kimwe kabiri cy’abantu bashyingiranwa amaherezo baratana ese imihati abagore bamwe bashyizeho kugira bakemure ibibazo miryango yaba yaratumye ibintu birushaho kuba byiza cyangwa byarushijeho kuzamba timoteyo - ni ikihe kibazo cy’ibanze kigira ingaruka mbi bashakanye ikibazo cy’ibanze ikihe mu rugero runaka ikibazo cyavutse igihe eva yashukwaga marayika wigometse nzoka kera yitwa umwanzi satani ibyahishuwe timoteyo satani yagoretse imana yigisha urugero satani yatumye abantu babona umuryango ubabuza kwisanzura kandi ugoranye imitekerereze akwirakwiza binyamakuru si ategeka igamije kwereka abantu inama imana itanga atari iz’ukuri kandi zidahuje n’igihe abakorinto ariko nidusuzuma imana ivuga birebana n’inshingano z’umugore muryango ho tubogamiye turasanga inama ijambo ry’imana zihuje n’ubwenge kandi ingirakamaroinama bantu bashinga imiryango a kuki umuntu w’igitsina gore yagombye kwitonda gihe ateganya gushaka b ni umuntu w’igitsina gore yagombye gukora mbere y’uko yemerera umugabo kuzashakana hari umuburo bibiliya itanga ivuga si iyoborwa satani n’abafite ishyingiranwa ryiza bazagira imibabaro bityo nubwo ishyingiranwa ryatangijwe n’imana bibiliya iburira abashyingiranwa umwanditsi umwe wahumekewe yavuze umugore wapfushije umugabo bityo akaba afite uburenganzira kongera gushaka title: allain jupp avuga atahakanye jenoside ahubwo yayemeye kuba
content: jupp avuga mwaka w’ butumwa bw’inteko ishinga amategeko yasobanuye yakoresheje ijambo jenoside kuya gicurasi nama y’abagize akanama k’abaminisitiri b’u burayi yabereye i buruseli bubiligi ikinyamakuru survie dukesha nkuru gitangaza alain jupp yaba yaratangaje nyuma y’uko uwari umunyamabanga mukuru loni gihe boutros boutros ghali yatangaje ibiri kuba rwanda atari ubwicanyi busanzwe ahubwo jenoside iki kinyamakuru gikomeza gitangaza minisitiri jupp yaba yaratangaje gihe jenoside rwanda igeze hagati ikorwa kandi n’igihe cyari gishize kikaba cyari gihe gikomeye cyane kuko aricyo cyishwemo abantu benshi aha bakaba bibaza bitaba ugusubiza ubwenge gihe igihe cyarenze prise de conscience tardive aha bavuga guverinoma y’u bufaransa rwanda gihe jenoside iriho itegurwa kandi ntacyo yakoze ibe yahagarika ubwicanyi bwatangiye tariki mata survie ikomeza ivuga gihe jenoside yakorerwaga abatutsi iriho kuba itariki mata jupp minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga w’u bufaransa hamwe l’lyse ingoro perezida w’u bufaransa bakiriye jrme bicamumpaka minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga w’u rwanda gihe jenoside ndetse jean-bosco barayagwiza umurwanashyaka w’ishyaka cdr aha bakaba bavuga icyiswe opration turquoise yazanywe n’ingabo z’abafaransa itariki kamena yafashije abari bamaze gukora jenoside guhungira cyahoze cyitwa zare akaba repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo muri babashije guhungishwa n’abafaransa havugwamo thodore sindikubwabo umukuru w’u rwanda gihe jenoside ndetse jrme bicamumpaka umaze amezi abiri yakiriwe jupp mu gihe cy’uruzinduko mbere perezida kagame yagiriye bufaransa kwezi gushize jupp yatangaje adashobora guhindura imyumvire jenoside raporo yitiriwe mucyo’ kubera izina ry’uwari umuyobozi w’iyo komisiyo mucyo jean de dieu yerekana alain jupp yagize uruhare bikorwa bitandukanye muri harimo kuba yarakoranye atizigamye guverinoma yakoraga jenoside iyo raporo kandi ivuga kuba tariki mata alain jupp yarakiriye jrme bicamumpaka jean bosco barayagwiza guverinoma y’abatabazi ikibazo gikomeye kuko umuryango mpuzamahanga warafashe icyemezo guha akato guverinoma ndetse u bubiligi leta zunze ubumwe z’amerika bakaba bamaze kubigaragaza bima viza bagabo inkuru dukesha igihecom

title: burera inkomoko y’izina ry’agasantere kiswe kidaho
content: inkomoko y’iri zina nk’uko abasaza n’abakecuru bahatuye babisobanura ryaturutse kuba harabaga ibigega byinshi bahunikagamo imyaka itandukanye babaga bejeje uwabaga yifuza kudahamo imyaka ntibyamusabaga kunama ahubwo yayidahaga ahagaze kubera byahoraga byuzuye mu myaka abahinzi aka gace bakundaga kweza cyane ibinyampeke birimo amasaka ingano uburo babisarura bakabihunika bigega binini babaga bafite wasangaga urujya n’uruza rw’abadahamo hakomotse izina kidaho gakwandi jonas w’imyaka umwe basaza basobanura iby’iri zina yemeza ryakomotse bigega byinshi bahunikagamo imyaka ati aha uhabona myaka mbere jenoside kuzamura twezaga imyaka myinshi cyane tukagira ibigega binini cyane twayihunikagamo umuntu yifuzaga kujya kudahamo imyaka ntibyamusabaga kunama kuko byahoraga byuzuye havuye kidaho ariko iterambere ryaziye dusigaye duhinga kijyambere tukagurisha ubundi tugahunika amafaranga ma banki nyirabirahure donatille w’imyaka yagize twagiraga ibigega binini n’ibindi bitaga imitiba twahunikagamo imyaka twabaga twejeje uwabaga yahinze amasaka akajya kuguranisha wahinze ingano gutyo kidaho yavuye ntibikibaho tureza tukagurisha ubundi tukazigama konti abatuye ako gasantere bakomeza bavuga n’ubwo bezaga cyane bagahunika bahuraga n’ibihombo by’uko imyaka hari yangirikaga bitewe kumara igihe kinini bigega ariko iterambere ryahagereye bigishijwe guhinga kijyambere bakeza byinshi nyuma ubwizigame bwabo kujya bigega bakizigamira bigo by’imari n’ubucuruzi umukozi w’umurenge kagogo ushinzwe imibereho myiza y’abaturage nsengamungu sabin yavuze aka gasantere kamaze kugeramo ibikorwa byinshi by’amajyambere ugereranyije n’igihe cyashize ati aka gasantere cyera terambere ryari rihari muriro bikorwa by’ubucuruzi hari inyubako nyakatsi ariko byose byarahageze ntibacyeza imyaka bahunike bigega nk’uko cyera byari ahubwo bayijyana masoko kuko arahari ubundi bakamenya kwizigamira mabanki kuri aka gasantere kidaho kazwi nanone cyanika hari ibikorwa byinshi by’amajyambere ubucuruzi amashuri n’ibindi abaturage baho bakora ahanini ubuhinzi bibanda buhinzi bw’ibirayi ibigori n’ibishyimbo

title: miliyoni z’amadolari zigiye gushorwa mushinga kwita bidukikije i gicumbi
content: umushinga wiswe uwa gicumbi green gicumbi project uzamara imyaka itandatu uhereye ukwakira ukora ibikorwa kwita bidukikije karere gicumbi arenga miliyoni miliyoni azakoreshwa mushinga wose azajya bikorwa kubungabunga ibishanga inkengero z’imigezi n’ibindi bikorwa byerekeye ubuhinzi umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’akarere gicumbi epimaque mpayimana avuga kubera imiterere y’ako karere imvura igira ingaruka zikomeye buhinzi kubera imisozi itarwanyijeho isuri ati twe tugira umwihariko kuko imisozi miremire ahantu hari imisozi miremire cyane cyane itarwanyijeho isuri duhura n’imyuzure isuri imihanda ikangirika ibiraro bigacika n’amazi menshi ingaruka by’ukuri nyinshi ugereranyije tundi turere imyaka kumanurwa n’isuri abaturage bagahinga ariko bamara gutera isuri ikaza ikabitwara avuga by’ibanze mushinga uzabafasha ugutunganya imisozi ihanamye agira mu buryo bw’ikubitiro azabanza kujya kudufasha gutunganya imisozi ihanamye ukuvuga utunganyije misozi mirima bishanga yajyaga itwikirwa n’isuri uba ukoze buryo itakwangirika ibihinzwemo uba ufite icyizere kuko wahinze ushobora kweza suri ibitwaye ni umushinga ashimangira uziye igihe kuburyo n’abaturage bitezweho kugaragaza ubufatanye bikorwa byawo mu mwaka w’ingengo y’imari ushize akarere gicumbi kabashije gutunganya hegitari z’amaterasi y’indinganire icyakora n’ubundi kugeza hari imisozi itarakorerwaho ubuhinzi kubera imiterere yayo amaterasi namara kugera misozi bizaba byongereye ubutaka buhingwa n’umusaruro uva buhinzi ukaziyongere nkuko mpayimana abisobanura agira ni ukuvuga tubonye izindi hegitari ziyongera zirwanyijeho isuri ziriho amaterasi y’indinganire byukuri kiba igisubizo kirambye baturage bacu kubera ubutaka guhinga buba bwiyongeye hari ahantu imisozi ihanamye kuburyo udashobora gukoreraho imirimo y’ubuhinzi ngubu iyo ukoze amaterasi uba wongeye ubuso buhingwa kandi kongera ubuso buhingwa bisobanuye uba wongereye umusaruro imibare y’ikigo cy’ibarurishamibare rwanda yerekena karere gicumbi amaterasi buso bungana hegitari ubutaka burwanyijeho isuri rusange bungana uyu mushinga wanyujijwe kigega cyita bidukikije n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe rwanda fonerwa umuyobozi w’icyo kigega hubert ruzibiza avuga uzita bindi bikorwa bireba imibereho y’abatuye gicumbi ndetse gutera ibiti ikindi kandi ukazafatwa nk’icyitegererezo kwigiraho kuburyo wazakomereza tundi turere tw’igihugu ati uyu mushinga gicumbi dufatanyije n’ikigega cy’isi cyita bidukikije twafatanyije gushyira amafaranga gicumbi tumaze kubona ibibazo yanyuzemo cyane cyane bireba ibidukikije dushaka kuzamura ubuzima bw’abaturage kureba babaho rusange gutera ibiti icyiciro mbere tuzayifata nk’icyitegererezo gutuma ukomereza tundi duce tw’u rwanda imibare y’ikigo cy’ibarurishamibare rwanda y’igihembwe cy’ihinga -b yerekana buryo kurwanya isuri gicumbi ifite amaterasi y’indinganire kigero y’ubutaka bwahinzwe gihembwe ahateye ibiti n’imiringoti mu buhinzi akarere gicumbi kibanda bishyimbo bishingirirwa ingano ibirayi ibigori n’imyumbati butaka buhujwe burenga hegitari bahinga kawa buso bungana hegitari n’icyayi buso bungana hegitari

title: umuganda inyunganizi ngengo y’imari y’igihugu
content: kimwe n’indi myaka yashize mwaka - wakozwemo ibikorwa binyuranye by’umuganda gihugu hose birimo guhanga imihanda y’imigenderano gutinda amateme kubaka amazu y’abatishoboye kubaka amashuli y’uburezi bw’ibanze bw’imyaka ybe kubaka ubwiherero kubaka ibigega guhunikamo imyaka gucukura imyobo guteramo ibiti gutera ibiti kubaka ibiro by’utugari gucukura ibyobo bifata amazi n’ibindi ibikorwa byose byakozwe bikaba byarahawe agaciro kangana y’amafaranga y’u rwanda nk’uko bigaragara rapport yashyizwe ahagaragara minaloc italiki mbere nzeli n’ubwo ibikorwa byakozwe bifite agaciro kanini gihugu hose ariko ntibyabujije hakorwa ibarura rigamije kumenya ubwitabire buri ntara muri raporo baragaragaza umujyi kigali hamwe n’intara y’uburengerazuba ziri mwanya nyuma n’ubwitabire bungana akaba nazo zifite ubwitabire buri hasi ugereranyije n’izindi ntara gihe intara y’amajyaruguru mwanya mbere n’ubwitabire igakurikirwa n’intara y’amajyepfo ifite intara y’uburasirazuba ikaza mwanya gatatu n’ubwitabire bungana aha intara zititwaye neza zikaba zisabwa kwikubita agashyi nyuma kumenya ubwitabire buhagaze gihugu hose barebye intara yakoze ibikorwa bifite agaciro kanini intara y’iburasirazuba iza isonga n’ibikorwa bifite agaciro kangana z’amafaranga y’u rwanda gihe umujyi kigali uza mwanya nyuma n’ibikorwa bifite agaciro kangana z’amanyarwanda aha kugira agaciro k’ibikorwa ibikorwa by’ingenzi bifitiye abaturage n’igihugu rusange akamaro si gusa ariko byakozwe kuko mpera z’ukwezi werurwe minisiteri y’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu yatangije amarushanwa y’ibikorwa by’umuganda ngororero intara y’uburengerazuba akaba waje mwanya mbere rwego rw’igihugu ubikesha urugomero rw’amashanyarazi rwubatswe n’abaturage bakabasha kwivana icuraburindi ku mwanya kabiri haje umurenge ugaragaza bimwe bimenyetso tugiye kugarukaho nkuru nkuko tubikesha urubuga kidneyorg dore bimwe bimenyetso bishobora kukwereka impyiko zawe zifite ikibazo guhorana umunaniro ukumva mbaraga ufite impyiko zikora akazi gakomeye kuyungurura amaraso zigakuramo imyanda iyo zagize ibibazo ntizishobore gukora neza imyanda iba myinshi maraso bigatera kunanirwa kugira intege nkeya nanone kandi kurwara kw’impyiko bitera kubura amaraso mubiri bityo bigatuma umuntu acika intege cyane kudasinzira neza iyo impyiko zitayunguruye amaraso neza imyanda kugira isohoke maraso iguma mo bituma umuntu ashobora kubura ibitotsi bigatuma adasinzira neza iki nacyo ikimenyetso gishobora kugaragaza impyiko zawe zitari gukora neza gushaka kujya kwihagarika inshuro nyinshi niba ushaka kujya kwihagarika inshuro nyinshi cyane cyane nijoro gishobora kuba ikimenyetso cy’impyiko zidakora neza iyo utuyunguruzo two mpyiko twangiritse bishobora gutera kujya kwihagarika kenshi rimwe rimwe bishobora kuba ikimenyetso kubyimba prostate bagabo kwihagarika amaraso ubusanzwe impyiko nzima ziyungurura amaraso zikuramo imyanda zirinda utunyangingo tw’amaraso blood cells ariko utuyunguruzo tw’impyiko twangiritse twa tunyangingo tw’amaraso dusohokana n’inkari ugasanga urihagarika inkari zivanze n’amaraso iki gishobora kuba ikimenyetso cy’uko impyiko zawe zangiritse kandi bishobora gusobanura ufite utubuye mpyiko cyangwa se ikibyimba mpyiko kubyimba ibirenge ndetse n’amaguru kudakora neza kw’impyiko bituma imyunyu ngugu sodiyumu sodium iba nyinshi mubiri bigatera kwireka kw’amazi menshi birenge ndetse n’amagurugusa kubyimba amaguru n’ibirenge bishobora kuba ikimenyetso cy’umwijima udakora neza kubura ubushake kurya guta ibiro ku bantu bafite ikibazo cy’impyiko umubiri utangira gukora nabi kubera imyanda iba yabaye myinshi mubiri bigatuma ubushake kurya bugenda bugabanyukaibyo bigatera kunanuka buryo budasobanutse kugira ibinya byinshi mubiri iyo impyiko zifite ikibazoimyunyungugu kalisiyumu phosphore iragabanyuka bigatera kumva ibinya mikaya mubirigusa kugira ibinya ntibivuzeko buri igihe uburwayi bw’impyiko niyo mpamvu byiza kujya muganga kugira bapime barebe ikibitera kubabara gice cy’umugongo hasi ububabare mugongo hasi si buri gihe busobanuye uburwayi bw’impyiko gusa impyiko ziri kwangirika umuntu ashobora kubabara umugongo hasi iki nacyo cyaba ikimenyetso ugomba kwitondera jean denys ndorimana

title: urwego rw’ubukerarugendo rwahombye miliyari frw werurwe kubera coronavirus
content: iyi raporo yashyikirijwe ikigo cy’igihugu cy’iterambere mata igaragaza urwego rw’ubukerarugendo rukeneye inkunga gihe nyuma y’icyorezo coronavirus mu gukusanya amakuru bihombo byabayeho werurwe mwaka psf yegereye ibikorwa bingana rwego rw’ubukerarugendo imibare yerekanye abakira mukerarugendo barimo amahoteli werurwe bagize igihombo miliyari frw abatembereza mukerarugendo bahomba miliyari frw abanyamwuga bategura inama bahombye miliyari frw ibindi bigo bifasha mukerarugendo bihomba miliyoni frw ibi bihombo byaje bisanga urwego rw’ubukerarugendo rwanda rufite inguzanyo miliyari frw urwego rw’amahoteli arirwo rwihariye inguzanyo nini kuko rufite izingana miliyari frw ababajijwe bagaragaje nibura by’abakozi rwego rw’ubukerarugendo bahagaritswe kazi ndetse basigaye bagizwe nyir’ibigo bakomeje gukora bijyanye n’igenamigambi kwiga mikorere nyuma y’iki cyorezo amahoteli yakoreweho ubushakashatsi yagaragaje yamaze guhagarika abakozi abatwara mukerarugendo bahagarika abategura inama bahagarika abandi bafasha mukerarugendo bahagarika urebye mishahara yatangwaga n’uru rwego amahoteli yahembaga miliyari frw buri kwezi wateranya n’izindi nzego eshatu bigendana bikaba miliyari frw iyi raporo igaragaza nibura uru rwego ruzakenera miliyari frw kugoboka ibikorwa by’ubukerarugendo kwakira abantu gihe cy’umwaka wose nyuma coronavirus ba nyir’ibi bikorwa bagaragaje kugira bakora bizongere kuzura umutwe bafashwa kubona amafaranga nibura yakwifashishwa kwishyura imishahara n’ibindi ibintu byatuma abakozi bangana bagumana akazi kabo kuba bagakurwaho mwaka mbere nyuma y’icyorezo coronavirus basaba kandi gukorerwa ubuvugizi mabanki hakavugururwa uburyo inguzanyo bafashe zakwishyurwa bitabahenze cyane bakagabanyirizwa cyangwa bagakurirwaho inyungu nguzanyo kubabafasha kuzahura ibikorwa mwaka wose mu bindi basaba basonerwa rwanda revenue authority kwishyura imisoro gihe runaka uretse ibijyanye n’amikoro by’abatanze amakuru bagaragaje banakeneye guhabwa ubundi bufasha bumenyi bwabafasha kuzahura ibikorwa byabo nyuma y’icyorezo coronavirus banki zitandukanye z’ubucuruzi ziheruka kwemerera abakiliya bazo bafite ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi byahungabanyijwe coronavirus guhabwa amahirwe kutishyura inguzanyo gihe gishobora kugera mezi atatu haba mafaranga bagurijwe cyangwa inyungu zayo bitewe n’ikibazo cy’umukiliya gusa psf ivuga banki zitorohereza abanyamahoteli buryo bukwiye buryo ikibazo guhomba hoteli kimaze iminsi gishobora gufata indi ntera raporo ikomeza iti urugero nko myaka ine ishize hoteli zisaga zaguye bihombo zitezwa cyamunara cyangwa zihindurirwa zakoreshwaga hoteli zasimbutse ibihe guhomba cyane zari zigihanganye n’imyenda minini banki buryo kwishyura inyungu zose ibikorwa bizaba bisubukuwe kugeza bisubiye rwego byari ho mbere nyuma covid- bishobora kuzatuma ikibazo kirushaho kuba kibi ibyo bigatuma uru rwego rusaba habaho uburyo koroshya inyungu nguzanyo kugeza ibintu bisubiye murongo kuba leta yabaha inkunga kwishyura imishahara gushyiraho uburyo bwafasha uru rwego kubona amafaranga adahenze yatuma ibikorwa bikomeza nibura gihe cy’amezi umuyobozi ushinzwe ubucuruzi n’imenyekanishabikorwa hilltop hotel innocent tuyishime aherutse kubwira igihe rwego rw’amahoteli ho babara igihombo cy’igihe kirekire kuko n’abari barabateguje mpera z’umwaka batarafata umwanzuro uhamye kuko batazi igihe icyorezo kizarangirira ati igihombo twe mahoteli dufite ntabwo kiri gatatu cyangwa ukwa kane gusa cyamaze gufata n’amezi imbere nk’abari baratwandikiye bagombaga kuzaza cyenda n’ukwa cumi ntabwo barafata umwanzuro ariko batwandikiye minsi ishize bavuga tuzareba tuzavugana igihombo kandi mahoteli gishobora gukomeza kuko n’iyo coronavirus yagabanya umurego itashirira rimwe isi buryo ibihugu bifungura amarembo bitikanga mbere umuryango mpuzamahanga ushinzwe ubukerarugendo the world tourism organization unwto ugaragaza ubukerarugendo buzagira igihombo miliyari ziri hagati z’amadolari

title: byumvuhore agarutse gutaramira i kigali

title: u rwanda ruvuga rushinjwa n’u burundi ’bigamije kurangaza amahanga’
content: leta y’ u rwanda ivuga itatangajwe n’amagambo akomeye leta y’u burundi ashinja u rwanda kugaba igitero burundi ibirego nk’ibyo byahereye mwaka leta y’ u rwanda ivuga itatangajwe n’amagambo akomeye leta y’u burundi ashinja u rwanda kugaba igitero burundi ibirego nk’ibyo byahereye mwaka olivier nduhungirehe umunyamabanga leta minisiteri y’ububanyi n’amahanga y’u rwanda avuga kuba u burundi bwarandikiye ibihugu karere umuryango w’ubumwe bw’afurika onu kimenyetso kimwe butanga biba biteye ikibazo leta y’u burundi yavuze abayiteye ijoro ryo itariki rishyira iya y’uku kwezi baturutse rwanda kandi ho basubiye ndetse bitwaje ibikoresho rwego hejuru prosper ntahorwamiye umunyamabanga leta y’u burundi akaba n’umuvugizi wayo yavuze gikozwe bushotoranyi bw’u rwanda umutekano w’akarere ushobora guhungabana nduhungirehe yabwiye bbc u burundi buvuze hari buba bwirengagije ati mu kuvuga ubusugire bw’igihugu kuvuga kurengera umutekano bibagiwe y’uko mezi ashize hari ibitero bitandukanye byagiye biterwa rwanda n’umutwe witwaje intwaro umutwe w’iterabwoba witwa fln yongeyeho akanama k’impuguke onu kemeje by’ubufasha u burundi bivugwa buha imitwe yitwaje intwaro irimo n’uwa fln urwanya ubutegetsi rwanda mu gihe cyashize u burundi bwahakanye ibyavugiwe rukiko callixte nsabimana ’sankara’ umuvugizi w’uwo mutwe akaza gufatwa akajyanwa rwanda wavuze uterwa inkunga n’u burundi ati ibyo kibazo nyamukuru gihari wenda itangazo ry’ejo leta y’u burundi rikaba ryari rigamije kurangaza amahanga - bita ’diversion’ - kibazo nyamukuru kiri karere yongeyeho nk’uko u rwanda rwabivuze inshuro nyinshi twe turifuza amahoro karere turifuza ubuhahirane n’urujya n’uruza rw’abantu ariko ikintu kimwe gusa dukomeyeho ikijyanye n’ubusugire bw’igihugu ikijyanye n’umutekano w’abanyarwanda kandi ngibyo tukaba tuzabiharanira yavuze baruwa u burundi bwandikiye amahanga mpungenge iteye u rwanda kuko atari ubwa mbere leta y’u burundi iyandikira kandi buri gihe biba bigamije kurangaza

title: madamu jeannette kagame yitabiriye umuhango kumurika filime petit pays-amafoto
content: ku mugoroba werurwe kigali century cinema habereye umuhango kerekana mbere filime petit pays ishingiye gitabo geal faye yise petit pays witabiriwe madamu jeannette kagame ahagana saa moya z’umugoroba ibyumba bitatu byerekanirwamo filime cnetury cinema byari byuzuyemo abantu bafite amatsiko kwirebera mashusho basomye gitabo iyi filime petit pays yakozwe eric barbier umukinnyi wayo w’imena isabelle kabano wanakinnye zindi filime zirimo some times in april operation turquoise uyu mugore uba witwa yvonne abari umubyeyi w’umwana witwa gabriel ugereranywa gael faye yvonne umunyarwandakazi ariko wahungiye i burundi n’umuryango nyuma y’itotezwa ryakorerwaga bwoko bw’abatutsi yvonne yarashakanye n’umugabo w’umuzungu w’umufaransa uba ukora imirimo y’ubwubatsi gahugu gato kitwa u burundi inkuru ivugwa petit pays itangira umwana witwa gabriel abayeho buzima bwiza kimwe n’abandi bana murwa mukuru w’u burundi i bujumbura mu burundi hatangira kuvuka ibibazo politiki bishingiye moko hutu tutsi abanyarwanda bahungiyeyo nabo batangira gutotezwa yvonne agasaba umugabo bahungisha abana bakajya kuba bufaransa yumvaga babona umutekano usesuye umugabo arabyanga nyamara ihohoterwa rigakomeza kwiyongera cyane cyane perezida perezida merchiol ndandaye yicwaga nyuma y’iminsi mike atorewe kuyobora u burundi muri filime kandi herekanwa uburyo rwanda hari ivangura rishingiye moko ryanagejeje jenoside yakorewe abatutsi yahitanye n’abo muryango yvonne filime petits pays yakiniwe rwanda karere rubavu gael faye yavuze by’abayigizemo uruhare haba bakinnyi cyangwa abakora ibya tekiniki abanyarwanda isabelle kabano waranzwe n’amarangamutima menshi n’amarira yavuze yatewe ishema kugaragara filime ifite igisobanuro kinini mateka y’ u rwanda iyi filime yerekanywe bice bitandukanye bufaransa mbere y’uko yerekanwa i kigali biteganyijwe izerekwanwa i paris tariki werurwe igitabo petit pays cyegukanye ibihembo bitandukanye birimo prix goncourt des lycens prix du premier roman prix palissy prix du roman fnac

title: musanze fondation kabeho irakangurira abandi kwitabira gahunda z’icyunamo
content: ukuriye fondation kabeho fidele abimana atangaza bikorwa bitandukanye gufasha gutegura icyumweru kwibuka nk’urubyiruko dusanzwe dukora ibijyanye n’imyidagaduro twifuje gutanga umuganda wacu twifashishije mpano n’ibindi tubona byatuma abantu bitabira birushijeho gahunda kwibuka ibyo bazifashisha harimo indirimbo bakoze n’abahanzi batoranyijwe ntara y’amajyaruguru yabisobanuye magambo kwibuka kimwe bikorwa bikomeye fondation yacu yashyize mategeko atugenga wahimbye indirimbo kwibuka irimo amagambo atwibutsa amateka kandi anahumuriza abarokotse anagarurira abantu icyizere kubaho bakagana imbere mu bundi butumwa yatanze abimana fidele ahamagarira abantu kurushaho kwegera abacitse icumu bakarushaho kubafasha kubereka hari icyizere kwitabira ibiganiro kwirinda imvugo zikomeretsa kwirinda gupfobya amateka yaranze gihugu cyane cyane jenoside yakorewe abatutsi abo bahanzi kandi bazazenguruka hirya hino gihe cy’icyunamo baririmba butumwa bw’ihumure n’icyizere muri gahunda bafite gihe cy’icyunamo harimo kwitabira ubwabo ibiganiro ariko by’umwihariko bakangurira abantu kubyitabira ahenshi byagaragaye urubyiruko rutitabira ibiganiro bitangwa gihe cy’icyunamo kandi rukeneye kumenya amateka mabi ariko umuntu akuramo isomo ryo kubaka ejo hazaza abagize fondation kabeho bavuga baniteguye gutanga ibiganiro gihe biyambajwe abagize fondation kabeho hari umukene bafashije kuvugurura inzu kugwira bakaba bateganya kumuha ubundi bugafasha bugamije gutuma atera imbere ibindi bikorwa bakoze birimo umuganda udasanzwe bakoreye rwibutso kinigi tariki fondation kabeho imaze amezi gusa kugera irimo abanyamuryango n’abandi basabye bagera jean claude hashakineza

title: bugesera nyuma y’inzara yaharanzwe karahahira utundi turere
content: mu myaka yashize cyane cyane umwaka w’ akarere bugesera kagaragayemo ikibazo cy’amapfa akabije hari abantu bicwaga n’inzara abandi bagasuhukamuri gihe uhatembereye ushobora kugira amateka cyangwa se amakabyankuru y’abantu abenshi baturage hari bahatuye nibo bivugira kibazo cy’inzara kihaherutseniyonzima joseph w’imyaka utuye murenge nyamata akagari maranyundo amaze imyaka aka karere avuga inzara yatangiye kugaragara bugesera mpera y’ ariko ikaza gukaza umurego mwaka w’ avuga gihe ibintu byose byari byarabuze biryo mvaruganda kugeza bijumba bihingiragaagira umva ibijumba ibijumba gihe inaha byaribwaga n’umuntu ufite imodoka ndakubwiza ukuri mukene wapfaga kubyigondera niyonzima yongeraho impamvu yateraga byose izuba ryari ryaracanye buryo batirirwaga bahinga n’uwahinganga ntiyeze avuga igihe ahantu hapfaga kwera ibijumba hari bishanga kandi byajyaga kubageraho byahenze yongeraho mwaka w’ abantu bishwe n’inzara buryo bukabije duce twa gashora ngenda gahembe maranyundo abandi barasuhuka ati gihe abagabo benshi barahungaga kubera kubura bagaburira imiryango abagore bakishyira migozi kubera kubura bagaburira abana mukanzaramba feresita umugore w’imyaka y’amavuko atuye murenge mayange avuga ikintu cyaje kubarokora bugesera haje imishinga n’imwe igatangira kubaha imfashanyo z’ibiribwaagira muri gihe tutarabona imfashanyo amahirwe yasekeraga yabonaga rukacarara icyo gihe twayitaga shira umuteto kuko mbere wasangaga hari abantu batarya umutsima w’amasaka gusa abatuye aka gace bavuga ibintu bisa n’ibyasubiye buryo kuko imyaka irera abantu bakabona ibiryo bavuga ufite inoti y’igihumbi urya amanywa n’ijoro nyirabitanga jolie utuye bugesera avuga nzara ikiharangwa aka karere gahagaze neza isoko ibintu biraboneka ibiboneka kurusha ibindi harimo imboga ibishyimbo imyumbati inanasi ibigori n’ibindi ugeze isoko nyamata gice gicururizwamo imboga abacuruzi bazo nabo bemeza imboga ziboneka bwinshi mukarwema annonciata umucuruzi soko nyamata umaze imyaka igera acuruza avuga ibicuruzwa byabonetse nyuma y’aho mbere gucuruza byasaga n’ibigoranye kubera baburaga barangurira agira ibintu biriho ikibigaragaza inyanya intoryi n’izindi kandi urabona hano isoko abacuruza imboga babaye benshi kandi n’abo tundi turere basigaye baza kurangura hano aganira kigalitodaycom rwagaju louis uyobora akarere bugesera avuga icyatumye inzara igabanuka aka karere leta yafashe ingamba gutera ibiti n’amashyamba hirya hino kariya gace avuga iterwa ry’ibiti ryatumye imvura itangira kugwa n’imyaka ikaboneraho gutangira kwera ati ubu hari ibicuruzwa abacuruzi b’ i kigali baza kurangura inaha ndetse nubu dufitanye ubuhahirane n’intara kirundo gihugu cy’u burundi yongeraho byose babigezeho bakangurira abaturage gukora cyane guhinga kuzigama gukora imirimo itegamiye buhinzi gusa muri ako karere hari igihe cyageze bitoroshye kubona n’igiti kubera izuba ryari ryarahibasiye umuntu yashoboraga gusanga amatungo yapfiriye nzira kubera kubura ubwatsi n’amazi kuko hendaga kuba ubutayu egide kayiranga

title: umuhanga stephen hawking yapfuye
content: prof stephen hawking umwarimu w’ubugenge wigishaga cambridge university afatwa nk’umuntu mbere isi kumenya phyisque theorique theoretical-physics yitabye imana myaka yatabarutse munsi umwe ntaramakuru by’abongereza naryo ryemeje urupfu rw’umubyeyi wabo watabarutse gatatu hawking umwongereza wamenyakanye cyane kinyejana kubera ubuhanga bwe bugenge yanditse ibitabo byinshi byamenyekanye harimo nk’icyo yise a brief history of time cyagurishijwe cyane isi kuko cyaguzwe n’abagera miliyoni isi ubushakashatsi bwe bwakundaga kwibanda kubyerekeye isanzure yamenyekanye cyane kubwo kugaragara cyane biganiro bikomeye the simpsons red dwarf nathe big bang theory ku myaka gusa yabwiwe atazamara igihe kinini isi nyuma kubagwa indwara bwonko yari arwaye indwara yitwa charcot lou gehrig imubuza kugenda kuvuga kuva yatangiye kugendera kagare k’abafite ubumuga ndetse gake cyane yavugaga ariwe ubyikoreresheje yavugaga abifashishijwemo mudasobwa voice synthesiser muri kamena umwaka ushize yatangaje kubera kwangirika kw’ikirere ibinyabuzima isi bigenda bicika buryo myaka hagati isi izaba itakibasha guturwaho n’ibinyabuzima prof hawking yavuze isi gihe kitarenze iriya myaka yugarijwe amakenga cyane kuko hari gutuma abantu benshi batakaza akazi bamwe bakiyahura kandi rigatuma isi haba intwaro kirimbuzi nyinshi hawking yavuze ikoranabuhanga riri gutuma abantu batakaza ubumuntu title: covid-abakinnyi musanze fc bemerewe igice cy’umushahara
content: nyuma y’ibiganiro bagiranye n’ubuyobozi bw’ikipe abakinnyi musanze fc bemerewe guhabwa angana y’umushahara wabo usanzwe hari nama yahuje ubuyobozi bw’ikipe n’abakinnyi bayo gatanu tariki gicurasi musanze fc niyo kipe mbere yatangaje ibaye ihagaritse by’agateganyo imishahara y’abakinnyi kubera icyorezo coronavirus covid- tariki mata nibwo musanze fc yandikiye abakinnyi n’abandi bakozi bayo ihagaritse imishahara kugeza igihe shampiyona izasubukurwa hari nyuma y’uko akarere musanze nako kandikiye ubuyobozi bw’iyi kipe gahagaritse amafaranga kabageneraga kugeza shampiyona isubukuwe kuko ntayacyinjira mbere kubera icyorezo coronavirus akarere kemeye kugira gatanga amakuru agera rwandamagazinecom minsi ishize akarere musanze kemeye kugira amafaranga gatanga ubuyobozi musanze fc nabwo bwiyemeza kugira bagenera abakinnyi tuyishimire placide uyobora musanze fc yatangarije rwandamagazinecom nyuma kuganira n’akarere nabo bahisemo kuganira n’abakinnyi bemeranya kubaha igice cy’umushahara ati nibyo inama igamije kureba twagira tubagenera mishahara kubera ibihe turimo twabemereye kubaha by’umushahara wabo n’ubusanzwe ikipe yacu zihembera igihe impinduka zabaye zatewe n’iki cyorezo abakinnyi nabo barabyumva tuyishimire placide uyobora musanze fc ’amafaranga arara konti’ tuyishimire placide yakomeje avuga mafaranga bagomba kurara bayabonye amezi bagomba kwishyurwa bemeranyijwe ukwezi mata gicurasi kamena ati ayo mezi atatu niyo bagomba kubona by’umushahara wose kandi barara bayabonye konti zabo umutoza mukuru ntari buyabone mubagomba kubona mafaranga ariko ntiharimo umutoza mukuru musanze fc adel abdelrahman waraye asezerewe n’iyi kipe kubera kutumvikana n’ubuyobozi bwayo ndetse gushaka kubuteranya n’abakinnyi abakinnyi musanze fc baganiriye rwandamagazinecom bahurije kugushimira ubuyobozi bw’ikipe umwe muribo yagize ni icyemezo twishimiye kuko n’ubundi ntabwo twari tuziko tuzayabona ni amafaranga azadufasha cyane bihe turi zacu tudakora akazi gasanzwe kadutunga turashimira ubuyobozi byibuze bagize bakora kugira badufashe undi yagize ibyo aribyo byose ariya ntabwo angana n’umushahara usanzwe ariko sinamake kuko cyorezo cyatwigishije kumenya gucunga neza make umuntu abonye turashimira perezida wacu placide akora ashoboye twe abakinnyi musanze fc tubeho neza turashimira komite bafatanya kuyobora kipe amakipe yahagaritse imishahara y’abakinnyi shampiyona y’u rwanda rayon sports espoir fc heroes fc mukura vs etincelles fc as muhanga musanze fc ibaye iya kabiri yemeye gutanga igice cy’umushahara nyuma bugesera fc yahisemo kujya ihemba abakozi bayo by’umushahara uhereye mata ubwo shampiyona yahagararaga tariki werurwe musanze fc mwanya rutonde rw’agateganyo n’amanota minisiteri siporo iherutse gutangaza kare hashoboka imikino n’amarushanwa bishobora kongera gutegurwa nzeri gihe imyitozo ishobora gutangira kanama

title: rubavu nyinawimfura rose utuye usa yafashije imiryango yagizweho ingaruka
content: kuri cyumweru taliki mata isaa h zuzzuye karere rubavu umurenge gisenyi kagali mbugangali nyinawimfura rose utuye i texas leta zunze ubumwe z’amerika yatanze ibiribwa gufasha abahuye n’ingaruka z’icyorezo coronavirus gahunda kunganira ubuyobozi bw’urwanda gufasha abanyarwanda batorohewe n’ingaruka z’iki cyorezo cyugarije isi iki gikorwa cyabereye kigo cy’amashuli yisumbuye umubano i mujyi gisenyi karere rubavu ntara y’uburengerazuba bw’urwanda bamwe batabasha kubona ibifungurwa bahawe ibiribwa kubafasha gusunika iminsi bihe guma murugo gikorwa cyari kiyobowe n’umuryango nyinawimfura rose utuye i gisenyi uhagarariwe bwana ngandura munyanziza jean bosco ndetse bwana faustin uwimana umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’akagali mbungangali muri aka kagali mbugangali imiryango yahawe ibiribwa bingana kologarama by’ifu kawunga ibiro by’ibishyimbo litilo z’amavuta guteka ndetse n’isabune buri muryango wagenewe ibiro kawungaibiro by’ibishyimbolitilo z’amavuta n’umuti w’isabune abaturage bahawe nkunga y’ingoboka bashimiye mubyeyi rose bamwifuriza kubona ijuru bitewe n’ineza gufasha abababaye bihe bikomeye kurya kibona umugabo kigasiba mu kiganiro n’umunyamakuru ibyamamare i rubavu mw’ijwi ryuzuye umunezero bashimiye mubyeyi wabibutse bihe bikomeye murekeyiteto beatrice utuye kagali mbugangali wahawe nkunga y’ingoboka usanzwe ufite umugabo ucuruza amatungo magufi ariko bihe umugabo utakibasha gukora aka kazi bitewe n’ibihe turimo yagize turishimye cyane kuba badutekerejeho kubera nti byoroshye ariko kundi byagenda tugomba gukurikiza amabwiriza kuko tuzi agaciro k’ubuzima turishimye cyane ntabirenze gushima kwishima twarenzahoimana ihe umugisha uwadutekerejeho uyu mubyeyi avuga nyuma y’uko akazi gahagaze gucuruza amatungo magufi basigaye barwana n’ubuzima ndetse gushaka ibyarengera umuryango wabo bihe bitoroshye ariko iminsi ishira bizera ibintu bizasubira buryo bakabasha kongera kubaho neza banibutsa abanyarwanda kuzirikana ingamba zashyizweho leta y’urwanda guhangana covid- akazi karahagaze kintu twongeye gukora turi umuryango w’abantu twizera bihe bikomeye turimo bizashiraabanyarwanda twirinde ibyadutera ubwandu kandi dukurikize inama tugirwa n’buyobozi tuzirikane ingamba guhangana n’iki cyorezo tugirwa n’ubuyobozi bw’igihugu kubwa mukeshimana odette umupfakazi ufite abana bane utuye mudugudu nyarubande kagali mbugangali avuga yishimiye nkunga y’ingoboka agasaba abantu kwizera imana kuko igoboka bihe bikomeye twishimiye nkunga y’ingoboka ntago byari byoroshyeuyu mubyeyi wadufashije imana imuhe umugisha mbere byose n’ugusenga kuko usenze imana igenda inyuza maboko y’abantuicyambere n’ugusenge tukubahiriza amabwiriza y’ubuyobozi mubyeyi watwibutse imana izibuke imilimo myiza yakoze imuhe igihembo gikwiriye abizera kanamugire janvier utuye i rurembo byahi wahawe inkunga y’ingoboka yashimiye mubyeyi anavuga minsi itari imworoheye nk’umuntu utunzwe n’akazi k’ubuyede mujyi goma ndashimira mubyeyi wadufashije bihe twugarijwe coronavirustwubahirije guma murugo nkanjye nari umuyedi i goma ibiryo byari byarashize gusa mubyeyi aradufashije imana imuhe umugisha ngandura munyanziza jean bosco avuga mubyeyi witwa nyinawimfura rose utuye usa leta texas yagize igitecyerezo gufasha bene wabo bihe isi yugarijwe n’icyorezo coronavirus ibihugu byose byategetse abaturage kuguma rugo nk’ingamba ikomeye guhangana n’iki cyorezo nk’umuntu usenga ndetse ukunda imana yifuje kuba y’abanyarwanda niyo mpamvu yafashe umwanzuro aravuga bicye mfite nsanzwe mfite muryango reka mbigabe kabiri mbisangire bene wacu batorohewe n’ubuzima bihe kugira turebe icyi cyorezo cyarangira munyanziza akomeza agira nyinawimfura rose bihe bikomeye yageneye ubutumwa bukomeye abantu basenga kugira umutima w’ubutwali kugira babe abantu kandi basangire n’abatishoboye kuko nirwo rukundo imana idukeneyeho gihe mu butumwa bwihariye munyanziza uhagarariye mubyeyi utuye usa yasabye abantu gufashanya bihe bikomeye anibutsa abifite kuzirikana kugoboka abakomerewe n’ibi bihe anasaba abantu kubaha amabwiriza leta kurwanya ubwandu n’ikwirakwira by’iki cyorezo faustin uwimana umunyamabanga nshinwabikorwa w’akagali mbugangali yashimiye mubyeyi wakoze igikorwa cy’ubutwali kugoboka abageramiwe n’ibi bihe anatangaza ibikorwa nk’ibi bikorwa mucyo kandi hashingirwa bababaye kurusha abandi bihereye mw’isibo asaba abaturage kagali ayobora ndetse n’abanyarwanda rusange kubaha amabwiriza yashyizweho leta y’urwanda guhangana coronavirus

title: coronavirus abayanduye barenze miliyoni isi
content: abantu banduye coronavirus isi bamaze kurenga miliyoni nk’uko bitangazwa kaminuza y’ubushakashatsi johns hopkins iki cyorezo kimaze kwica abantu barenga abagerea baragikize nk’uko kaminuza ibivuga leta zunze ubumwe amerika nizo zifite abantu benshi banduye kandi gihugu munsi umwe gusa ushize cyishe abantu iyi coronavirus yahawe izina covid- yabonetse hagati bushinwa mezi atatu ashize nubwo abamaze kumenyekana bayirwaye isi barenze miliyoni abayifite batarayipimwa bikekwa benshi kurushaho mu muryango w’ibihugu afurika y’iburasirazuba yahageze hagati kwezi gishize ariko abamenyekanye bayanduye kenya - rwanda - uganda - tanzania - burundi - sudani y’epfo - ku isi byafashe ukwezi n’igice kugira hamenyekane abantu bayanduye ariko miliyoni yageze nyuma y’uko imibare itumbagiye bidasanzwe cyumweru gishize ubu kimwe kane cy’abanduye usa gihe burayi hose habarwa kimwe kabiri cy’abanduye muri afurika ndwara imaze kwandura abantu malawi kimwe bihugu bicye byari bisigaye cyaraye gitangaje abantu batatu mbere banduye ndwara aho covid- itaraboneka afurika lesotho sudani y’epfo ibirwa comores n’ibirwa sao tome principe amakuru agezweho ayahe ejo kuwa kane espagne hapfuye abantu masaha - biravugwa aribo bantu benshi bishwe n’iyi ndwara munsi umwe gihugu muri espagne imibare y’abanduye kuwa gatatu yavuye igeze abategetsi baho bavuka ndwara igeze gasongero bizeye igiye kumanuka minsi imbere espagne nicyo gihugu kabiri kizahaye bijyanye n’abo ihitana kuko imaze kwica abarenga inyuma y’ubutaliyani imaze kwica abagera twageze dute mu bushinwa mpera z’ukwezi umuganga witwa dr li wenliang w’imyaka yatangiye gutanga impuruza bandi baganga hari virus nshya mujyi wuhan ntara hubei polisi yamugezeho ashinjwa gutera ubwoba dr li yapfuye tariki nyuma y’uko yanduye ndwara ariho avura abayirwaye wuhan ubushinwa bwamenyesheje omswho ikibazo cy’abari kurwara ibihaha itariki tariki bbc dukesha nkuru nibwp yanditse inkuru mbere virus nshya itazwi neza i wuhan icyo gihe hari abantu bamaze kuyibonamo barembye benshi bagize ubwoba ibyabaye virus sars bigiye kongera kuko yishe abantu byageze tariki imaze kwandura abantu ariko abahanga bavuga by’ukuri abari bayanduye hashize iminsi ibiri gusa abantu benshi biteguraga kujya gutangira umwaka mushya bushinwa abayanduye bageze kandi babonetse beijing shanghai shenzhen tariki wuhan yahise itangaza guhagarika ubuzima busanzwe lockdown icyo gihe abantu bamaze gupfa abandi bayifite ndetse yarageze buyapani taiwan thailand korea y’epfo usa hashize iminsi umuntu mbere hanze y’ubushinwa yaramuhitanye philippines hashize iminsi itanu virus yavuzwe iran yakwiriye vuba ikica benshi tariki ubutaliyani bwagize abantu benshi banduye imijyi icumi majyaruguru lombardie yahagaritse ubuzima busanzwe nyuma bikwira igihugu cyose tariki amerika yaciye bushinwa igira abantu benshi banduye virus tariki kenya igihugu mbere afurika y’iburasirazuba habonetse umuntu mbere ufite covid- umukobwa umaze iminsi avuye usa tariki rwanda habonetse umuntu mbere wanduye ndwara umuhinde uherutse iwabo umuntu mbere ufite ndwara yabonetse tanzania tariki umugore w’umutanzania uvuye bubiligi muri uganda umuntu mbere yabonwemo ndwara tariki burundi uwa mbere yabonywemo ndwara kuwa kabiri w’iki cyumweru bbc

content: abapolisi b’u rwanda ejo tariki nzeri basoje amahugurwa agamije kubongerera ubumenyi bujyanye kumenya ndetse gukorana n’abantu bafite imico itandukanye aya mahugurwa yateguwe n’ishami polisi y’u budage rishinzwe ubugenzacyaha bundeskriminalmt bufatanye n’ishami mpuzamahanga ry’amahugurwa gipolisi y’u rwanda asoza mahugurwa mugaragaro umuyobozi w’ishami rishinzwe inyigisho n’amahugurwa polisi y’u rwanda commissioner of police cp cyprien gatete yashimye ubufatanye buri hagati polisi y’ubudage ndetse n’u rwanda yavuze kandi bene mahugurwa inzenzi dore abayarangije bafite ubumenyi buhagije mico itandukanye y’abantu abapolisi n’abaturage basanzwe cp gatete yagize kumenya imico n’imyifatire y’abantu batandukanye ningombwa bapolisi kuko kazi kabo kaburi munsi haba gihugu mubutumwa bw’amahoro bahura n’abantu batandukanye akaba yashimangiye bene bumenyi bufasha abapolisi kugira bakore akazi kabo neza cp gatete yasabye abarangije mahugurwa kuzakoresha neza neza ubumenyi bayakuyemo ndetse banazirikana gusangiza bumenyi abandi bapolisi hirya hino gihugu madamu katja birnfeld-paskin ishami ry’ubugenzacyaha polisi y’ubudage ndetse wanatanze amasomo mahugurwa yashimye uruhare polisi y’u rwanda kugarura umutekano bihugu bitandukanye by’isi yanashimye kandi abapolisi basoje mahugurwa kuba bararanzwe n’umurava disipuline igihe amahugurwa yamaze umwe barangije mahugurwa inspector of police donath nyinawumuntu yavuze mahugurwa yababereye ingirakamaro dore yivigira ubumenyi bayungukiye buzabafasha gukora neza akazi kabo haba rwanda ndetse n’igihe boherejwe butumwa bw’amahoro yanditswe akayezu snappymuhaburarw

title: nyarugenge umugore yafashwe amaze kwiba amafaranga menshi konti itari iye
content: ku mugoroba w’italiki kanama umugore utaramenyekana umwirondoro yafatiwe karere nyarugenge amaze kubikuza amafaranga konti itari iyenk’uko bitangazwa n’umuvugizi polisi mujyi kigali superintendent of police sp emmanuel hitayezu mugore yabikuje amafaranga konti y’uwitwa hakizimana josephine ndetse bakaba batanaziranye sp hitayezu agira atiuyu mugore wanze kuvuga yafatwa kandi n’ibyangombwa twamusanganye yatse impapuro buzuza babikuza azuzuza mazina atari aye anigana umukono nyiri konti ubwa mbere gitondo yaje mujyi barayamwima ajya ishami gikondo abikuzayo akomeza avuga mugore yagarutse mujyi mugoroba ariko noneho ntajye mukozi wayamwimye gitondo yahise ayamuha hakoreshejwe buryo ariko mugenzi wayamwimye aramubona akomeza kugira amakenga kuvuga bamuhagarika ahita afatwa polisi bamusanganye amafaranga aha sp hitayezu yagize atinyiri konti yageze afungiye atubwira azi isura y’uyu mugore yageze acururiza i muhanga ahiba zimwe mpapuro yakoresheje abikuza banki niho yahereye yigana umukono kumenya nimero kontikuri bujura sp hitayezu agira inama abantu gukura amaboko mufuka bagatungwa n’ibyo bakoreye gufata igihe bashakisha amayeri gutwara iby’abandi bavunikiye yagize bimwe polisi ibereyeho uguca intege wese ufite imigambi nk’iyi ubufatanye buri wese ngombwa abakora uburiganya nk’ubu bagende bafatwa turasaba buri wese kugira amakenga cyane abakora serivisi z’amafaranga yarangije avuga mugore akurikiranyweho ibyaha by’impapuro mpimbano ndetse n’ubujura ingingo iteganya ibihano bujura budakoresheje kiboko cyangwa ibikangisho ivuga umuntu wese ukora ubujura budakoreshejwe kiboko cyangwa ibikangisho ahanishwa igifungo mezi atandatu kugeza myaka ibiri n’ihazabu y’amafaranga y’u rwanda yikubye inshuro ebyiri kugeza eshanu z’agaciro k’icyibwe cyangwa kimwe gusa bihano naho iya ivuga guhindura ibirango leta iby’umuntu giti cye iby’ibigo cyangwa imiryango byigenga byemewe n’amategeko ivuga gihe ibyiganywe cyangwa ibyakoreshejwe buryo bunyuranyije n’amategeko iby’umuntu giti cye iby’ibigo cyangwa imiryango byigenga byemewe n’amategeko igihano kiba igifungo myaka ibiri kugeza myaka itanu yanditswe sarongo muhaburarw

title: rusizi abahinga igishanga cyunyu bacibwa amafaranga y’ubukode atagira inyemezabwishyu’
content: abahinzi gishanga cyunyu karere rusizi bishyura amafaranga y’ubukode bw’imirima bavuga bakwa menshi kandi bakayishyura uwitwa bahenda batazi kuko ahagarariwe n’uwitwa gerant’ babwirwa title: ese uzi ibya nyakibi w’i nyarugenge wasuze misango inkomoko y’umugani nyakibi ntirara bushyitsi
content: uyu mugani bawucira muntu utabasha kwihishira yihe akabanga akagaragaza ingeso ze mbi adasanzwe agenda niho bahera bavuga bati burya koko nyakibi ntirara bushyitsi’ wakomotse nyakibi bwanacyambwe rwampara nyarugenge ahasaga nkuko tubikesha igitabo ibirari by’insigamigani mugabo nyakibi bikekwa yaba yarabayeho ngoma yuhi gahima nyakibi umugaragu ruganintwari bukeye sebuja aza kumwohereza musabira umugeni sinayobye i nzaratsi nyakibi arakugendeye arara i mushubati kanyarira bukeye asohora sinayobye sinayobye aravunyisha asanze irembo baramuvunyishiriza aratambuka bararamukanya baramuzimanira yica akanyota ubundi ababwira ikimugenza ruganintwari yantumye mwarabanye murashyingirana none yumvise ufite abakobwa arashaka kubasabamo umugeni sinayobye ntiyazuyaza amwemerera umugeni ariko nyakibi akagira ingeso ebyiri zari zaramubushabushe gusuragura kwiba nyakibi akiganira sinayobye n’umugore wewa sinayobye ingeso iba iranze umusuzi uti bwi kandi kanya nabwo yongera gusura sinayobye n’umugore bararebana batangira kwiciranirana ijisho nyakibi yababonye nk’ejo aratanguranwa abwira sinayobye ruganintwari yantumye mwiciraniraho ijisho ntakirimo mu gihe kuryama nyakibi bamusasira nzu y’abashyitsi gikari hamwe n’abandi ariko nzu ikabamo inzoga ijoro rijigije nyakibi arabyuka ajya gushingamo umuheha aragotomera umunyenzoga uryamye nzu yamwumvishe aramwombokera amucetse urushyi barasakuza nyiri urugo baraza batungurwa gusanga ntumwa yaje kurambagiza nyakibi akubise amaso nyirurugo acika intege abasaba bamugirira ibanga ntibabibwire shebuja bamubera imfura baramusezerera arataha asohoje ubutumwa ababwira umugeni bamumwemereye ruganintwari ashaka inka n’inzoga aziha nyakibi ajye gusaba nyakibi ageze i nzaratsi arasaba baramwemerera amaze gusaba nanone ararara kuko yaturutse kure ijoro rijigije ingeso iranga arabyuka ajya nkono y’inyama ariko asanga umunyagikari yaryamiye amajanja arombotse aramucakiye amuceka urushyi avuza induru basanga nanone nyakibi noneho sinayobye ntiyamwihanganira arategeka baramuboha bamushyira ruganintwari amutumaho nyakibi yaraje mbere aransurira arananyiba ndamwihanganira none yongeye kugaruka hose nyakibi iciro ry’imigani atyo

content: igitabo intwari z’imbanza zubatse u rwanda rugahamya igitinyiro’’ cyanditswe n’umusizi nsanzabera jean de dieu kigaragaza gashyantare rwabugili yafataga umwanzuro kugaba igitero nkore gihe akibaza ibibaye akumva bamufashe mpiri bambambuye imbunda bamucumita n’inkota gituza abandi barimo kubaca imitwe noneho imiriro n’urusaku rw’amasasu rurahagarara humvikana induru z’abarimo gupfa title: indwara kujojoba fistula n’ingaruka zayo buzima bw’uyirwaye
content: fistule cyangwa kujojoba indwara iterwa n’uko haba habayeho gukomereka gice ndangagitsina cy’umubyeyi gihe arimo kubyara ibyo bigaragara cyane babyeyi batabyarira muganga kandi bakeneye kubagwa bigatuma habaho inzira idasanzwe ihuza uruhago rw’inkari inzira y’inkari n’inkondo y’umura cyangwa inkondo y’umura n’urura runiri rusohora umusarani bigatuma umugore ahora asohora imyanda twakwita iba yayobye kuko inyura nkondo y’umura igasohokera gitsina rutangira mpamvu bayita kujojoba kugira ushobore kumenya bihagije iby’iyi ndwara twifashishije ibyatangajwe n’inzobere zitandukanye by’ubuzima mu kiganiro dr gedeon mulumba mukendi yagiranye n’agasarocom yavuze ikibazo cyiganje cyane bihugu biri nzira y’amajyambere muri bihugu usanga abagore benshi bagira ibibazo by’ihohoterwa kubyara bigoranye isuku nke abaganga batahuguwe bihagije n’ibindi ibi byose ibyangiza biriya bice by’umugore ubusanzwe bitajya byihanganira ikintu cyose giturutse hanze yagize umugore watinze nda ubyara umwana ufite umutwe munini cyangwa afite inkari zuzuye uruhago afite ibyago kwangirika kuko umwana atinda arwana gusohora umutwe aziba imitsi y’amaraso nzira z’inkari n’iyo nkondo y’umura cyangwa agatobora uruhago rw’inkari muganga gedeon avuga hari n’igihe urura runini narwo rutoboka cyangwa umwanya hagati y’inkondo y’umura n’ahanyura umusarane ugatanyuka bigatuma imyanda inyura nkondo y’umura iyi ndwara igira ingaruka nyinshi muntu uyirwaye kuko itinze kuvurwa itera ingaruka nyinshi nko guhagarara kw’imihango kugumbaha imibonano mpuzabitsina ntiba igishoboka kuko umubiri w’aho imyanda inyura hamera nk’ahumye buryo ikintu gikozeho ucika nk’urupapuro ishobora gutera cancer cg n’izindi infections zigira ingaruka mbi buzima bw’umuntu akenshi kubera umunuko uhora muntu urwaye ndwara babana baramunena agahezwa akiheza akenshi bene babyeyi bibaviramo gutabwa n’abo bashakanye bikagira n’ingaruka cyane buzima bwe mutwe dr gedeon akomeza atangariza agasarocom fistule akenshi ivurwa bitarenze igihe cy’amezi atatu uhereye igihe umugore yagiriye kibazo iyo kirenze biragorana kubera iriya myanya iba yarorohereye bigasaba ushaka indi kuyisimbuza kandi ntayibaho akomeza asobanura gihe ntacyo ushobora kumumarira uretse ubujyanama kugirango umuvure ihungabana yaratewe kwiheba ndetse kwiyanga kubera uburyo afatwa sosiyete abamo n’ubwo bimeze bityo ariko minisiteri y’ubuzima nayo ntiyicaye nk’uko dr anicet nzabonimpa umuhuzabikorwa gahunda kuboneza imbyaro minisante yabitangarije igihe u rwanda rwafashe ingamba guca burundu ndwara bakangurira abagore kubyarira muganga ministeri y’ubuzima kandi ifatanyije loni bafashe icyemezo kuvura ababyeyi bagaragayeho ndwara gihugu hose bwana cheikh fall ukuriye unfpa kiganiro yagiranye n’igihecom umuryango w’abibumbye ntuzahwema gushyigikira u rwanda nzira hoherezwa impuguke kuvura ndwara izahaza ababyeyi gusa ababyeyi nabo barasabwa kwitabira kwivuriza bigo nderabuzima nako bitabira kwipimisha igihe batwite anne-marie niwemwiza

title: umwana yatabaje polisi ifata umusore wafunguraga ibyuma by’imodoka ashaka kubyiba
content: kuri sitasiyo polisi kacyiru murenge kacyiru akarere gasabo hafungiye umusore witwa niyonsaba faustin kigero k’imyaka akurikiranyweho kujya modoka munyabahigi djuma agafatwa arimo gufungura bimwe byuma biyigize ashaka kubyiba umuvugizi polisi y’u rwanda mujyi kigali senior superintendent of police ssp emmanuel hitayezu yavuze mugoroba gashyantare niyonsaba yacunze umuzamu gipangu munyabahigi yurira urugo agwamo imbere atangira gufungura bimwe byuma bigize imodoka urwo rugo yagize atiku mugoroba gashyantare uriya musore niyonsaba yacunze umuzamu arasimbuka agwa rugo imbere atangira gufungura ibyuma by’imodoka irimo umwana waho aramwumva arebye amubona munsi y’imodoka ariko atinya kumuvugisha ahita ahamagara polisi iratabara ssp hitayezu avuga munyabahigi bakimara gutabaza polisi yahise itabara isanga musore munsi y’imodoka afungura ibyuma byayo ahita afatwa yashimiye umuryango munyabahigi wahise utabaza polisi kuba wamufata ukamwihanirayagize atibari bamufatiye cyuho ndetse rugo rwabo byashoboka guhita bamufata bakamwihanira nubwo bitemewe ariko baraduhamagaye turamufata agiye gukurikiranwa buryo bw’amategeko yakomeje asaba ababyeyi kwita burere bw’abana dore niyonsaba yabikoze avuye iwabo rugo kuko n’ubusanzwe aturanye n’abo agiye kwiba ibyuma basanze niyonsaba amaze gufungura modoka harimo ibyuma bibiri bikoreshwa guhagarika imodoaka igenda bande frein -amortisseur radio n’ikitwa piston polisi y’u rwanda ikaba yahise ibishyikiriza nyiri imodoka munyabahigi djuma washimiye polisi y’u rwanda uburyo yamutabaye vuba ikamufatira igisambo munyabahigi yagize atindashimira polisi y’u rwanda uburyo yatabariye gihetwayihamagaye ihita ihagera ifatira cyuho umujura abana rugo ntibari kumwifatira kubacika cyangwa akaba yabatera ibyuma afite ingingo gitabo cy’amategeko ahana ibyaha rwanda iteganya umuntu wese ukora ubujura budakoreshejwe kiboko cyangwa ibikangisho ahanishwa igifungo mezi atandatu kugeza myaka ibiri n’ihazabu y’amafaranga y’u rwanda yikubye inshuro ebyiri kugeza eshanu z’agaciro k’icyibwe yanditswe niyomugabo albert

title: huye umukobwa w’imyaka yakodesheje inzu ashyiramo bagenzi bafatanya kwicuruza
content: umukobwa w’imyaka karere huye arasaba abayobozi kumusabira imbabazi ababyeyi kugira azasubire kubana nabo atewe ipfunwe n’uko yabataye akajya gukodesha inzu agatangira kwicuruza umukobwa w’imyaka karere huye arasaba abayobozi kumusabira imbabazi ababyeyi kugira azasubire kubana nabo atewe ipfunwe n’uko yabataye akajya gukodesha inzu agatangira kwicuruza ikindi avuga ubuyobozi bwamufasha ukumurihira ishuri ry’imyuga akiga kudoda bukanamuha imashini kuko avuga adashaka gukomeza uburaya kuko yasanze nyungu byamugezaho yatangarije ukwezi umurimo kwicuruzanya bagenzi awumazemo icyemezo kujya kwikodeshereza akiri muto akaninjira buraya yananiranywe nyirakuru kugira age kuba nyirakuru byatewe n’uko se yataye urugo ajya i kigali nyina ata urugo ajya gushaka mugabo karere huye uyu mwana bigoye wabona amarira amutemba maso avuga inkuru y’ubuzima bubi yanyuzemo avuga kimwe asaba ubuyobozi bwamusabira imbabazi ababyeyi agasubira muryango yagize icyo nkeneye kubayobozi ukuba bansabira imbabazi ababyeyi barangiza ngasubira rugo uyu mukobwa uvuga yarerewe nyirakuru se nyina bamaze gutandukana buri umwe agaca ukwe avuga yapfuye nyirakuru atamufata kimwe n’abandi bana title: nyagatare kurya inyama bimusaba kugurisha ibiro by’ibishyimbo
content: aba baturage batanga urugero biciro by’inyama byazamutse cyane buryo umuturage uhinga ibishyimbo bimusaba kugurisha nibura ibiro by’ibishyimbo kugira ashobore kugura ikiro kimwe cy’inyama rutikanga murenge gatunda karere nyagatare yagize nk’inyama ukuzivaho ubundi twazicwa n’inzara uyu muturage yatanze urugero umufuka w’ibiro by’ibishyimbo uhwanye n’ibiro by’inyama si abatuye duce tw’icyaro gusa karere nyagatare bafite kibazo kuko mujyi nyagatare ikiro cy’inyama kigura amafaranga gihe ikiro cy’ibishyimbo bagihaha mafaranga bisobanura uguze ikiro cy’inyama yigomwe ibiro by’ibishyimbo rudahunga ladislas umwe bagize cooperative y’abacuruzi b’inyama mujyi nyagatare yavuze zamuka ry’ibiciro by’inyama ridaterwa kwifuza kunguka menshi ahubwo inka ziyongereye agaciro bityo bakaba bakoreraga gihombo rudahunga akomeza avuga kwiyongera kw’igiciro cy’inyama byatumye abaguzi bagabanuka nubwo kibazo bafite kuko ikigamijwe inyungu atari ugucuruza byinshi safari francis ushinzwe ubworozi murenge nyagatare avuga bacuruzi bajya kongera igiciro babanje kubijyaho inama n’ubuyobozi bukabibemerera kuko igiciro cy’inka cyazamutse niyonzima oswald

title: ikawa n’icyayi ibihingwa bifitiye runini u rwanda
content: nk’uko ntakirutimana corneille umuyobozi mukuru wungurije ushinzwe kuzamura umusaruro w’ibyoherezwa mahanga rwanda kigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe kwita byoherezwa mahanga naeb abitangaza bihingwa nibyo byinjiza amadevize menshi ugereranije n’ibindi byoherezwa mahanga bivuye rwanda ibi bihingwa kandi bigirira akamaro kanini umuhinzi wabyo kuko bimuzanira amafaranga kugeza umuhinzi w’icyayi ahabwa amafaranga ijana kiro cy’amababi y’icyayi kigero cy’ubwiza kiri hagati naho cyayi kiri bwiza kugeza umuhinzi ahabwa amafaranga kiro ariko hari n’inganda zimwe zishobora kuyarenza muri mwaka igiciro cy’ikawa cyavuye mafaranga kiro cy’ibitumbwe kigera mafaranga ibi bikaba biterwa n’uko igiciro cy’ikawa cyagiye kizamuka masoko mpuzamahanga amafaranga avuye bihingwa afasha abahinzi kongera umusaruro ndetse kwikenura kuko umuhinzi aguriwe giciro cyiza agira umwete kongera umusaruro kugira yeze byinshibimwe bihugu kawa ikunze kugurishwamo harimo leta zunze ubumwe z’amarikaubuyapani ndetse bimwe bihugu by’iburayi icyayi gikunze kubona amasoko bihugu by’abayisiramu iby’abarabu ndetse bimwe bihugu by’iburayi nk’uko corneille aritangaza abanyarwanda ntibitabira cyane kunywa icyayi n’ikawa avuga abanyanyarwanda bakwiriye kuba isoko ry’ibyo beza ntibatege amasoko banyamahanga gusa umwaka ushize umusaruro w’icyayi woherejwe hanze urenga toni zinjije akayabo kagera miliyoni z’amadorari y’amerika umusaruro kawa woherejwe hanze ugera toni zinjije miliyoni z’amadorari y’amerika corneille avuga bihingwa bifasha cyane igihugu kuko bituma ubukungu bw’igihugu kuzamuka ndetse bigatuma u rwanda rugira ijambo rwego mpuzamahanga aya madevize kandi afasha u rwanda kugura ibicuruzwa rukura hanze rudahenzwe avuga u rwanda rweza umusaruro muke ugereranyije n’ibihugu duturanye ariko icyari sorwathe karere rulindo mu rwego kongera umusaruro uturuka bihingwa ndetse n’ibindi byoherezwa mahanga imboga imbuto n’ibireti harateganywa kongerwa ubuso bihingwaho gihugu hose urugero ntara title: abana bahura n’ihohoterwa polisi y’u rwanda yabashyiriyeho umurongo utishyurwa kujya batabarizaho
content: uyu murongo watangiye gukora ukaba ukorera cyicaro gikuru polisi y’u rwanda kacyiru ukaba kandi kugira utangire gukora waratwaye amafaranga y’u rwanda miriyoni uyu murongo ukaba kandi ufite ubushobozi kwakira abantu bawuhamagaraho icyarimweni kubufatanye world vision polisi yashyizeho murongo uzajya wifashishwa igihe habayeho ihohoterwa ryakorewe abana umuyobozi mukuru polisi y’u rwanda wugirije ushinzwe ubuyobozi n’abakozi digp juvenal marizamunda tariki ukwakira yagezwagaho n’ubuyobozi world vision bimwe bikoresho bitandukanye byifashishwa n’uyu murongo yashimye imikoranire myiza isanzwe hagati polisi y’u rwanda ndetse world vision gahunda kurwanya ihohoterwa rikorerwa abana ndetse guharanira uburenganzira bw’abana bwubahirizwa rwanda ibi bikoresho birimo mudasobwa n’ibindi bitandukanyedgip marizamunda yakomeje kandi avuga polisi y’u rwanda ikomeje kandi kugira umurava gufasha kurinda abana aricyo cyose cyahungabanya uburenganzira bwabo akaba yakomeje avuga kuba inzego zitandukanye leta zihagurukira kwita bana ikimenyetso kigaragaza ejo haza h’igihugu cyacu hari maboko y’abana uyu mushinga watwaye milliyoni zisaga z’amafaranga y’u rwanda umuyobozi world vision rwego rw’igihugu george gitau yavuze umuryango ayoboye kimwe polisi y’u rwanda basanzwe byuzuzanya cyane cyane bikorwa bijyanye kurinda abana ndetse kubakorera ubuvugizi gitau yasobanuye world vision umuryango mpuzamahanga gikirisitu ukora ibikorwa bijyanye n’iterambere byose bikaba bikorerwa abana imiryango y’abatishoboye hagamijwe kurwanya ubukene chief superintendent of police csp elie mberabagabo uyobora ishami polisi u rwanda rishinzwe ikoranabuhanga yavuze ishyirwaho ry’uyu murongo rizakurikirwa n’ibindi byiciro bibiri birimo guhugura abapolisi bahabwa ubumenyi bujyanye kwita bibazo by’abana bakorewe ihohoterwa ndetse bikazanakurikirwa gukora ubukangurambaga cyaha uyu murongo uje usanga iyindi mirongo butabazi rusange murongo ukaba witabazwaho birebana n’ibyaha cyangwa impanuka mazi nkongi y’umuriro impanuka mihanda ibijyanye n’ihohotera rishingiye gitsina igihe umuturage yakorewe amakosa n’umupolisi bijyanye n’ibyaha ruswa ndetse uherutse gushyirwaho ihohoterwa rikorerwa abana yanditswe ubwanditsimuhaburarw

title: ruhango abaturage bifatanyije n’abandi kwibuka jenoside nshuro
content: uyu muhango karere ruhango watangijwe n’urugendo rwabaye mutuzo rwitabiriwe n’abaturage benshi baturutse mujyi ruhango berekeza rwibutso rw’akarere banaboneyeho umwanya kunamira imibiri isaga ibihumbi ihashyinguye nubwo hari byinshi byagezweho abacitse icumu aka karere basabye bafashwa bijyanye n’ubuvuzi kuko hagenda hagaragara abacitse icumu bagihura n’ibikomere batewe jenoside kuri nshuro hibukwa abazize jenoside yakorerewe abatutsi karere ruhango hazibandwa gufasha abacitse kwicumu babashakira imibereho myiza nk’uko byatangajwe n’umuyobozi karere ruhango mbabazi xavier francois ikindi kizibandwaho minsi kwibuka ugutunganya inzibutso ziri hirya hino karere ruhango zitaratunganywa uhagarariye ingabo z’u rwanda karere ruhango yasabye imbaraga zakoreshejwe guhagarika jenoside nazo zakoreshwa guteza imbere abacitse icumu eric muvara

content: umuntu mbere wanduye icyorezo ebola yagaragaye mujyi goma burasirazuba repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo gtatandatu biravugwa bwandu bushobora kwiyongera kubera abantu batuye mujyi wegeranye n’u rwanda bageranye cyane binashobora gutuma muntu yaba yanduje n’abandi gomani umujyi wegereye ikiyaga utuwe n’abantu bagera miliyoni imweuherereye majyepfo y’ahantu hakabira hagaragaye ebola nyinshi umwaka ushize kuvayo ugera i goma bikaba birometero iyi ndwara yageze majyepfo ifata abantu bagera yica abagera reuters ducyesha nkuru yatangaje abayobozi bavuze bataramenya neza umubare nyawo w’abantu murwayi yaba yahuye nabo abe yabanduza cyangwa umwanya yaba yamaze mujyi uyu murwayi umupasiteri yageze i goma avuye kilometero uvuye i butembo hakaba hari abantu bafashwe n’iyi ndwara umuvugizi minisitiri y’ubuzima yavuze barimo kugerageza gushaka byinshi makuru itangazo ry’iyi minisiteri y’ubuzima kongo rigira riti kubera uburyo murwayi yabonetse akanashyirwa kato vuba ibyago ndwara ikwirakwira mujyi goma biri hasi biravugwa umushoferi n’abagenzi atwaye baza gukingirwa mbere richard kitenge umuyobozi ushinzwe gukurikirana ibibazo by’icyorezo goma yavuze murwayi yavuye ahitwa butembo ati ni ikibazo cyabaye butembomu birometero miles majyaruguru yongeyeho murwayi yahise asubizwa butembo kugira ajye gukurikiranwa n’abaganga goma yiteguye ukuza ebola gihe cy’umwaka bashyizeho abantu bakarabira intoki ndetse banabuza abamotari kutajya batizanya kasike gusa bice byinshi by’icyaro biragoye bwandu bwakwirindwa kuko abantu bashinzwe ubukangurambaga bake uwurwaye ebola arangwa n’impiswikuruka ndetse n’amaraso anyura ahari umwenge hose kandi ishobora kwandura binyuze bitembabuzi byose mubiriiki cyorezo mwaka kugeza kimaze kwica abantu bagera afurika y’uburengerazuba yanditswe habarurema djamali

title: ikawa n’icyayi ibihingwa bifitiye runini u rwanda
content: nk’uko ntakirutimana corneille umuyobozi mukuru wungurije ushinzwe kuzamura umusaruro w’ibyoherezwa mahanga rwanda kigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe kwita byoherezwa mahanga naeb abitangaza bihingwa nibyo byinjiza amadevize menshi ugereranije n’ibindi byoherezwa mahanga bivuye rwanda ibi bihingwa kandi bigirira akamaro kanini umuhinzi wabyo kuko bimuzanira amafaranga kugeza umuhinzi w’icyayi ahabwa amafaranga ijana kiro cy’amababi y’icyayi kigero cy’ubwiza kiri hagati naho cyayi kiri bwiza kugeza umuhinzi ahabwa amafaranga kiro ariko hari n’inganda zimwe zishobora kuyarenza muri mwaka igiciro cy’ikawa cyavuye mafaranga kiro cy’ibitumbwe kigera mafaranga ibi bikaba biterwa n’uko igiciro cy’ikawa cyagiye kizamuka masoko mpuzamahanga amafaranga avuye bihingwa afasha abahinzi kongera umusaruro ndetse kwikenura kuko umuhinzi aguriwe giciro cyiza agira umwete kongera umusaruro kugira yeze byinshibimwe bihugu kawa ikunze kugurishwamo harimo leta zunze ubumwe z’amarikaubuyapani ndetse bimwe bihugu by’iburayi icyayi gikunze kubona amasoko bihugu by’abayisiramu iby’abarabu ndetse bimwe bihugu by’iburayi nk’uko corneille aritangaza abanyarwanda ntibitabira cyane kunywa icyayi n’ikawa avuga abanyanyarwanda bakwiriye kuba isoko ry’ibyo beza ntibatege amasoko banyamahanga gusa umwaka ushize umusaruro w’icyayi woherejwe hanze urenga toni zinjije akayabo kagera miliyoni z’amadorari y’amerika umusaruro kawa woherejwe hanze ugera toni zinjije miliyoni z’amadorari y’amerika corneille avuga bihingwa bifasha cyane igihugu kuko bituma ubukungu bw’igihugu kuzamuka ndetse bigatuma u rwanda rugira ijambo rwego mpuzamahanga aya madevize kandi afasha u rwanda kugura ibicuruzwa rukura hanze rudahenzwe avuga u rwanda rweza umusaruro muke ugereranyije n’ibihugu duturanye ariko icyari n’ikawa by’u rwanda bifite uburyohe kurusha bihugu nk’uko ntakirutimana corneille yabidutangarije ikawa zihingwa gihugu hose ariko zibanze cyane ntara y’amajyepfo ndetse n’iy’iburengerazuba kuko ariho hari ubuso bunini bw’iki gihingwa icyayi kibanze ahanini ntara y’uburengerazuba misozi miremire y’isunzu congo nil ndetse n’iy’amajyepfo y’u rwanda cyane turere twa nyaruguru nyamagabe mu ntara y’iburengerazuba hari inganda esheshatu hakaba hanateganywa kubakwa izindi nganda eshatu rwego kuzamura ubwiza bw’umusaruro w’icyayi mu ntara y’amajyaruguru hari inganda z’icyayi mulindi gicumbi sorwathe karere rulindo mu rwego kongera umusaruro uturuka bihingwa ndetse n’ibindi byoherezwa mahanga imboga imbuto n’ibireti harateganywa kongerwa ubuso bihingwaho gihugu hose urugero ntara mwaka - abaturage bakaba basabwa kuzitabira guhinga bihingwa rwego kurushaho kwizamura kuzamura umusaruro w’ibyoherezwa mahanga rusange imboga imbuto ndetse n’ibireti nabyo bizongererwa ubuso ndetse
