title: allain jupp avuga atahakanye jenoside ahubwo yayemeye kuba
content: jupp avuga mwaka w’ butumwa bw’inteko ishinga amategeko yasobanuye yakoresheje ijambo jenoside kuya gicurasi nama y’abagize akanama k’abaminisitiri b’u burayi yabereye i buruseli bubiligi ikinyamakuru survie dukesha nkuru gitangaza alain jupp yaba yaratangaje nyuma y’uko uwari umunyamabanga mukuru loni gihe boutros boutros ghali yatangaje ibiri kuba rwanda atari ubwicanyi busanzwe ahubwo jenoside iki kinyamakuru gikomeza gitangaza minisitiri jupp yaba yaratangaje gihe jenoside rwanda igeze hagati ikorwa kandi n’igihe cyari gishize kikaba cyari gihe gikomeye cyane kuko aricyo cyishwemo abantu benshi aha bakaba bibaza bitaba ugusubiza ubwenge gihe igihe cyarenze prise de conscience tardive aha bavuga guverinoma y’u bufaransa rwanda gihe jenoside iriho itegurwa kandi ntacyo yakoze ibe yahagarika ubwicanyi bwatangiye tariki mata survie ikomeza ivuga gihe jenoside yakorerwaga abatutsi iriho kuba itariki mata jupp minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga w’u bufaransa hamwe l’lyse ingoro perezida w’u bufaransa bakiriye jrme bicamumpaka minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga w’u rwanda gihe jenoside ndetse jean-bosco barayagwiza umurwanashyaka w’ishyaka cdr aha bakaba bavuga icyiswe opration turquoise yazanywe n’ingabo z’abafaransa itariki kamena yafashije abari bamaze gukora jenoside guhungira cyahoze cyitwa zare akaba repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo muri babashije guhungishwa n’abafaransa havugwamo thodore sindikubwabo umukuru w’u rwanda gihe jenoside ndetse jrme bicamumpaka umaze amezi abiri yakiriwe jupp mu gihe cy’uruzinduko mbere perezida kagame yagiriye bufaransa kwezi gushize jupp yatangaje adashobora guhindura imyumvire jenoside raporo yitiriwe mucyo’ kubera izina ry’uwari umuyobozi w’iyo komisiyo mucyo jean de dieu yerekana alain jupp yagize uruhare bikorwa bitandukanye muri harimo kuba yarakoranye atizigamye guverinoma yakoraga jenoside iyo raporo kandi ivuga kuba tariki mata alain jupp yarakiriye jrme bicamumpaka jean bosco barayagwiza guverinoma y’abatabazi ikibazo gikomeye kuko umuryango mpuzamahanga warafashe icyemezo guha akato guverinoma ndetse u bubiligi leta zunze ubumwe z’amerika bakaba bamaze kubigaragaza bima viza bagabo inkuru dukesha igihecom

title: kicukiro umunyeshuri yafatanwe kashe z’impimbano
content: polisi y’u rwanda ikorera karere kicukiro yafatanywe kashe zitandukanye umunyeshuri witwa tuyishime bernard wiga ibijyanye gukora amazi ishuri ry’ubumenyingiro iprc-kicukiro izi kashe yafatanywe iz’ibigo bitandukanye leta birimo amabanki amashuri ibigo by’ubutabera n’ibindi tuyishime yafashwe tariki mutarama nyuma y’uko umuyobozi w’ishuri yigamo iprc-kicukiro ahawe amakuru y’uko hari umwe banyeshuri ufite kashe z’impimbano umuvugizi polisi y’u rwanda mujyi kigali superintendent of police sp emmanuel hitayezu yagize bamwe banyeshuri babwiye umuyobozi w’ishuri ibijyanye n’uko tuyishime yaba atunze kashe ndetse ashobora kuba azikoresha ibintu bitari byiza ahita abimenyesha polisi y’u rwanda twahise tujya gusaka rugo tuhasanga kashe z’ibigo leta bitandukanye birimo banki amashuri noteri ndetse n’iz’ibigo by’ubutabera yongeyeho iperereza ry’ibanze polisi ryanatahuye anafite mudasobwa ibindi byangombwa by’ibihimbano bimwemerera inguzanyo kwiga n’ibindi bitandukanye umuvugizi polisi y’u rwanda mujyi kigali yihanangirije abantu nk’abo bakora ibyangombwa by’ibihimbano agira ariwe wese utunze ibyangombwa by’ibihimbano byaba bimeze kose amenye amategeko ahari kandi amuhana igihe abifatanwe sp hitayezu yakomeje agira inzego z’umutekano zirakorana neza kandi zihora ziri maso kandi ziteguye gufata ariwe wese ukora icyaha runaka kwigana guhimba ibyangombwa icyaha kandi gihanwa n’amategeko yakomeje avuga icyaha kiramutse kimuhamye igihano yahabwa gikubiye ngingo gitabo cy’amategeko ahana ibyaha cy’u rwanda igifungo kiri hagati y’imyaka itanu n’irindwi ndetse n’ihazabu y’amafaranga y’u rwanda ashobora kugera miliyoni eshatu tuyishime afashwe nyuma y’uko hari hashize ukwezi polisi y’u rwanda yeretse itangazamakuru witwa kubwimana ibrahim wafatanwe ibyangombwa by’ibihimbano icyo gihe kubwimana afatwa kwezi gushize kw’ukuboza afite ibyangombwa by’ubutaka by’ibihimbano iby’amasoko leta n’andi anyuranye indangamuntu amakashe indangamanota nazo z’impimbano n’ibindi mu gufatwa kwe byaje kugaragara yakoraga ndetse akanagurisha ibyangombwa by’ibihimbano by’amasoko leta n’andi bantu bifuzaga umwenda banki sp hitayezu yavuze nyuma guhabwa amakuru yafatiwe cyuho arimo gukora indangamuntu n’amakarita gipolisi yasabye n’abandi bagifite ibitekerezo kwishora byaha kubireka kuko nyungu bakuramo uretse gufatwa bagafungwa bikaba bigira ingaruka miryango yanditswe niyomugabo albertmuhaburarw

title: bugeseraumugabo yatawe yombi nyuma kuvuga amagambo yuzuyemo ingengabitekerezo
content: museruka augustin w’imyaka utuye murenge nyamata akagari kayumba mudugudu murambi yaraye atawe yombi mugoroba kuwa mbere nyuma kuvugira amagambo afatwa nkingengabitekerezo ndetse gupfobya’ jenoside yakorewe abatutsi biganiro byaberaga site’ murambi umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’umurenge nyamata mushenyi innocent yabwiye itangamakuru nyuma y’ibiganiro gicamunsi kuwa mbere museruka augustin yavuze amagambo akomeye aho yavuze abatutsi sibo bababaye gusa kuko n’abahutu barapfuye hari andi makuru avuga museruka augustin yavuze agahinda kadafitwe n’abatutsi gusa yagize abatutsi ataribo bafite agahinda gusa kuko hatabaye jenoside y’abatutsi gusa anavuga congo drc haguye benshi yakomeje avuga umugore w’uyu mugabo banafitanye abana babiri yageraje kumutwama aceceke museruka agahita amubwira amagambo kumukanga ngonikicare dore gasa nagakuye rufunzo umugore yacitse icumu umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’umurenge nyamatamushenyi innocent yavuze mugabo akimara kuvuga abaturage bahise bahamagara polisi iraza ihita imufata akaba afungiye station’ polisi nyamata gihe agikorwaho iperereza mushenyi innocent ubu maboko polisi ariko ubwe yarabyiyemereye yavuze aranabyandika abisubiramo umugore museruka yababajwe cyane n’amagambo y’umugabo buryo byabaye ngombwa hifashishwa abashinzwe gufasha abantu bahura n’ihungabana biganiro amaze gusubirana asubira rugo abajijwe musaza atuye asanzwe agaragaza imvugo nk’izi mushenyi yavuze makuru abifiteho ariko bishoboka yavuze yaba amaze igihe abitekereza akarindira kubivuga bihe nabyo byababaje abaturage bahari kuri ubuyobozi burimo gukurikirana burebe museruka atari yarigeze akatirwa gacaca cyangwa izindi nkiko kuko adakomoka i nyamata yahaje nk’umwimukira uyu muyobozi w’umurenge nyamata avuga ibintu nk’ibi bitari bisanzwe murenge agasaba abaturage bihe nk’ibi kwibuka jenoside yakorewe abatutsi bakwitwarariraka bakirinda amagambo asezereza kandi bakarushaho kwegera abacitse icumu bakabahumuriza ati jenoside yatewe n’ibintu nk’ibi uriya mugabo yagaragaje yagaragaje urwango kugera n’aho abivugira ruhame asaba kandi abantu kwirinda ingengabitekerezo kuko ntaho yageza igihugu ariko n’ababirenzeho hari amategeko azajya abakurikirana bakabiryozwa yanditswe habarurema djamali

title: kugira muzahagararire neza igihugu mugomba kwitanga kwigomwa-igp munyuza abwira abapolisi bagiye
content: umuyobozi mukuru polisi y’u rwanda igp dan munyuza yahaye impanuro abapolisi b’u rwanda bitegura kujya butumwa kubungabunga amahoro gihugu repubulika santarafurika caraho yabasabye kugenda bakarangwa n’ubwitange kwigomwa igp dan munyuza gejeje butumwa bapolisi gitondo cyumweru tariki ukuboza cyicaro gikuru polisi y’u rwanda kacyiru karere gasabo aba bapolisi bagabanyijemo amatsinda abiri rimwe rigizwe n’abapolisi harimo irizaba rikorera murwa mukuru bangui ubwo yaganirizaga bapolisi igp dan munyuza yavuze yizeye bagize igihe gihagije gutegurwa bagasobanurirwa akazi bagiyemo ndetse n’imiterere y’igihugu bagiye gukoreramo yabasabye kuzazirikana umuntu azitwara giti cye bizagaruka isura y’igihugu rusange abasaba kuzaharanira guhesha isura nziza igihugu bagiye bahagarariye yagize mukwiye kumenya muhagurutse hano rwanda mugiye bakubonye bareba igihugu cyawe bataranakuvugisha bareba ibendera bakabona u rwanda muzaharanire guhesha isura nziza igihugu cyanyu nk’uko polisi y’u rwanda isanzwe icyitegererezo mahanga yakomeje abibutsa imirimo bagiyemo itoroshye bakaba bagomba kwitanga cyane kugira bazahagararire neza igihugu ati kugira muzahagararire u rwanda neza mugomba kwitanga ugaragaje isura mbi ntabwo iba iyawe giti cyawe ahubwo bigaruka gihugu cyawe ibikorwa byanyu bigomba kuzaba byiza bitanga isura nziza gihugu ndetse rwego polisi y’u rwanda umuyobozi mukuru polisi y’u rwanda yasabye bapolisi kuzarangwa n’impuhwe kwigomwa kugira abababaye babeho yabibukije n’ubwo bazaba bafite inshingano bahabwa n’umuryango w’abibumbye hari n’izindi z’inyongera bahabwa n’igihugu bahagarariye nko gufasha abatishoboye ubujyanama bintu bitandukanye ndetse gutoza abaturage kugira umuco kudasiganya leta ahubwo bakishakira ibisubizo binyuze gukora umuganda igp dan munyuza yibukije bamwe bapolisi bafite utugeso tutari twiza nko kunywa inzoga n’ibindi bibi bidahesha isura nziza u rwanda ndetse ubwabo kubireka abasaba kuzarangwa n’ubwubahane ndetse gukorera hamwe nk’ikipe asoza ubutumwa yageneye bapolisi yabibukije bagomba kuzajya bamenya kwirengera bakirwanaho igihe bazaba babona basumbirijwe n’umwanzi cyangwa ashaka kugirira nabi abasivili bazaba barinze abapolisi bagiye butumwa bw’amahoro gihugu repubulika santarafurika matsinda abiri itsinda mbere rigizwe n’abapolisi bayobowe assistant commissioner of policeacp uwimana safari akaba icyiciro kigiye gihugu itsinda kabiri riyobowe senior superintendent of policessp antoine munyampundu akaba icyiciro biteganyijwe bapolisi bahaguruka rwanda gitondo mbere tariki ukuboza bakajya gusimbura abandi matsinda abiri muhaburarw

sitade kigali i nyamirambo mikino y’igikombe cy’intwari warangiye ikipe as kigali itsinze apr fc igitego - ni irushanwa ngarukamwaka ritegurwa n’urwego rw’igihugu rushinzwe intwari impeta n’imidari by’ishimwe bufatanye federasiyo y’umupira w’amaguru rwanda rwego kuzirikana intwari z’igihugu amakipe yombi yatangiye asatirana kuburyo bukomeye kuko nko kumunota as kigali yahushije uburyo bwari bwabazwe niyomugabo claude yazamukanye umupira ruhande rw’ibumoso yatanga rubuga rw’amahina hakabura uwukozaho ikirenge ntibyatinze kuko minota micye cyane apr fc nayo yaje kuzamukana umupira isaa bigirimana ahaye umupira hakizimana muhadjil awutera hejuru y’izamu gatonyuma y’iminota micye apr fc yagaragaje ifite ikibazo bwugarizi bwayo nyuma kubura imanishimwe emmanuel fitina ombolenga batakinnye kubera kubera kwitegura kujya gukina hanze y’u rwanda apr fc yakoze impinduka nyinshi cyane mikino kuko abakinnyi basanzwe babanzamo abenshi ntabwo bakinnye mukino byahaye amahirwe ikipe as kigali gukina yidegembya imbere y’izamu apr fc ntibyatinze kwigaragaza kuko munota nshimiyimana ibrahim yatsindiye as kigali igitego burangare bw’ab’inyuma nyezamu fiacre wataye izamu rye igice mbere kitararangira munota umutoza jimmy mulisa yakoze impinduka arebe yishyura igitego akuramo sekamana maxime ashyiramo byiringiro lague gusa mpinduka ntacyo zatanze kuko igice mbere cyarangiye as kigali michel nsengiyumva moustafa asimbura isaa bigirimana gusa mpinduka zose kintu zamariye apr fc kuko umukino waje kurangira as kigali iryamye gitego cyayo kimwe ndetse isimbuza umukinnyi umwe gusa title: amaherezo y’amazi y’imvura asenya ibintu i kigali azaba ayahe
content: mu gihe amazi amanuka misozi ikikije kigali akomeje kwangiza byinshi abantu bakaba bibaza iherezo ryabyo bamwe mpuguke by’imitunganyirize y’imijyi bagaragaje abakora igenamigambi ry’imyubakire mujyi bakwiye kureka gukomeza kugendera kera ahubwo bagatekereza kubaka banashingiye mihindagurikire y’ikirere ndetse n’ubwiyongere bw’abaturage muri minsi ikirere kigali gihindutse bamwe imitima itangira gutera cyane abari bice biruhukiramo amazi y’imvura aturutse dusongero tw’imisozi ikikije kigali ibindi byose barabihagarika bagatangira gutekereza gushyira ibikorwa byabo uko imyaka ihita indi igataha ingano y’amazi amanuka iyimisozi igenda yiyongera aramanukana umuvumba udasanzwe ukangiza byinshi habamenshi abidan avuga imvura igwa iy’iminsi iteye inkeke yangiza ibikorwa by’abantu yagize kubera ruhurura ituruka i nyamirambo amazi aruzura hano ibintu ikabitwara ejobundi yaraguye hano isoko itwara imyenda ibikapu n’ibindi bicuruzwa abantu bacururizaga ahaiyi ruhurura ikwiye kwaguka na ho gakindi erneste avuga umuvumba w’amazi kimntu kimwe usiga inyuma ati hari tank bajyaga bakoresha hariya haruguruimwe ziriya tank nini cyane ubusanzwe zitwara essance mazi yarayimanuye ndetse hari n’inka yamanutsemo iyi rigole biragaragara amazi aza akayirusha ubushoboziikigaragara yakongerwa abatuye misozi kimwe n’ahandi mujyi kigali hari uburyo bavuga bagerageza gufata mazi karasira deo hano amazi tubasha kuyafata gake gakeni ugucukura icyobo kijyamo amazi mabati n’ubwo atari twese impuguke bijyanye n’imitunganyirize y’imijyi zibonera kibazo yindi ndorerwamo bamwe babwiye rba byakabaye bigenda kibazo kigakemuka burundu eng joseph rwigamba avuga ikibazo kiriho umujyi kugeza kugendera plans kera ati ntibigeze batekereza imvura izagwa gutya n’izo rigole zakozwe inyinshi zarasibamye kandi nto na none ugasanga amazi arambukiranya umuhanda bitewe n’uko abubatse umuhanda batatekereje rigole zihagije z’aho mazi yajya niharebwe amazi baturage yakusanyirizwa kuko babikora ubwabo ntibihagije hanyuma hakarebwa mazi y’imvura abaturage batabasha gucontrola yajya kandi bigakorwa vuba ni ikibazo inzego nyinshi kireba zigaragaza hari ibyakozwe ndetse n’ibiri gukorwa janvier muhire ashinzwe amategeko y’imiturire n’imyubakire rwanda kigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe imiturire avuga buri muturage akwiye kumva akamaro gufata amazi y’imvura gusa akanashimangira leta ifite uburyo burambye buzakemura kibazo ati amategeko ahari uno munsi avuga buri wese akwiye gufata amazi ava nzu yifashishije ibigega n’ibindi ariko abaye menshi hari uburyo turi gutegura bwitwa water treatment plant leta ifite gahunda kuyubaka hariya giti cy’inyoni buryo ariya mazi mubona azaba ashobora guhurizwa hamwe ndetse akaba yanakoreshwa nyuma yaho uyu mushinga igihe uzatangirira ntikiratangazwa cyangwa se n’ingengo y’imari izawugendaho mu gihe umujyi kigali abakomeje kuwugana biyongera umunsi munsi hari ababona ingamba zigamije kurengera imiturire zakazwa harimo title: pac yagaragaje ikigo reg kidatanga umusaruro cyasimbura icyahoze ewasa
content: nyuma y’imyaka ine ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe ingufu reg gikora komisiyo y’inteko ishinga amategeko ishinzwe kugenzura imikoreshereze y’umutungo leta pac ivuga musaruro gitanga kubera imiyoborere mibi imicungire mibi y’amasezerano kudakurikiza amategeko agenga amasoko ndetse n’ubugenzuzi reg yashyizweho rwego gufasha kwegereza abaturage amashanyarazi isimbuye icyahoze kitwa ewasa ikigo gishinzwe ingufu amazi isuku n’isukura cyari cyarananiwe kuzuza inshingano zacyo ahubwo kikaba cyarahoraga bihombo reg igizwe n’ibigo bibiribirimo igishinzwe ibikorwa remezo energy development corporation limited -edcl n’igishinzwe gukwirakwiza amashanyarazi energy utility corporation limited -eucl mu gihe leta ishora akayabo k’amafaranga kigo reg kibashe kuzuza inshingano kugeza umuriro w’amashanyarazi baturage raporo y’umugenzuzi mukuru w’imari yagaragarijwe pac kuwa mbere nzeri igaragaza icyari ewasa cyatandukanywa reg itarabasha kugaragaza raporo y’ubugenzuzi bw’imari nk’ibindi bigo iyo raporo y’umugenzuzi mukuru w’imari yagaragarije pac reg igaragaza raporo y’igenzura ry’umutungo umugenzuzi mukuru w’imari leta obadiah biraro avuga reg yakabaye ibarirwa bigo biri isoko ry’imari n’imigabane ariko n’ihererekanyabubasha hagati yayo n’abahoze bayobora ibigo byari biyishamikiyeho ntiriraba agira iki ikigo kinini rwanda ndetse cyakabaye kiri isoko ry’imari n’imigabane ariko cyananiwe kubigeraho ahubwo turacyategereje gukora igenzura ry’umutungo ni ryari bazakora ubucuruzi biraro akomeza avuga nubwo bibazo reg yashyikirijwe ikijyaho harimo n’iby’imicungire mibi hari ibikoresho bibarirwa miliyari z’amafaranga y’u rwanda yashyikirijwe ariko n’ubu ibigo byayo edcl eucl bikaba bitagaragaza bikoresho byarengeye ibintu byafatwa nko kunyereza umutungo umugenzuzi mukuru w’imari leta ashinja makosa inama y’ubutegetsi reg ndetse minisiteri y’ibikorwa remezo raporo y’umugenzuzi mukuru w’imari leta igaragaza masoko atandatu yatanzwe reg yarenze mategeko agenga amasoko igaha isoko umuntu utujuje ibisabwa ndetse utari ugejeje gishoro cyasabwaga muri raporo bigaragara reg yahaye akazi impuguke yaturutse uganda akaba yaragombaga gucunga imishinga itandatu reg gihembo cy’amadorari amerika miliyoni ibi ubwabyo bihabanye n’amabwiriza mpuzamahanga agenga imicungire y’imishinga ndetse n’amabwiriza y’u rwanda asaba umushinga wose urengeje miliyoni z’amafaranga y’u y’umutungo leta depite ngabitsinze jean chrysostome ni nde wavuze tugomba kujya hanze y’u rwanda gushaka impuguke atanaguma y’imishinga akurikirane ibiri gukorwa umunyamategeko reg gutanga ibisobanuro bibazo yavuze reg muntu wigeze amusaba igitekerezo mpungenge pac yaba umunyamabanga uhoraho minisiteri y’ibikorwa remezo patricie uwase n’umuyobozi mukuru reg ron weiss bombi bemeye makosa kandi bizeza azakosoka cyane kigo gishyize imbere kubaka ubushobozi gukosora amakosa yakigaragayemo ron weiss yagize turemera twakoze makosa kandi mutubabarire ntitwakwiregura makosa ariko nitugaruka hano mbere y’uko reg ikemura ibibazo by’imicungire mibi iracyafite urugamba kutajenjekera ibikorwa by’imitegurire n’ibikorwa bitagaragara mpapuro bibarirwa miliyari z’amafaranga y’u rwanda ikigo kitagaragaza by’ukuri bikorwa biri he basimbura icyahoze ewasa pac ivuga reg ifite mukoro gushaka ibyangombwa by’ubutaka bwayo bubarirwa miliyari eshatu z’amafaranga y’u rwanda bunyanyagiye hirya hino gihugu gukemura ibibazo by’amategeko bikiri nkiko bantu bihaye ubutaka bwayo muhaburarw

title: shampiyona apr fc yaratsinze rayon sports fc iratsindwa
content: nyuma gustindira as kigali stade regional i nyamirambo ibitego busa apr fc ikipe irimo guhagarara gikombe shampiyona ibitse yatangiye gusiga amakipe zihanganye ibi ikaba yabigezeho icyi cyumweru ibikesha ibitego by’abasore bahagaze neza minsi olivier karekezi kapiteni w’iyi kipe n’umunya uganda dan wagaluka rayon sport mukeba mbere apr fc yatakaje amanota imbere la jeunesse yiganjemo abakinnyi bakiri bato kandi byagaragaraga bamenyeranye cyane bayitsinda ibitego bibiri kimwe ikindi cyaje gukomeza mukino emmanuel ruremesha umutoza la jeunesse wahoze atoza rayon sport akaba ayizi neza ndetse nyuma y’umukino akaba yaradutangarije yifuzaga gutsinda rayon sport kugirango agaragaze la jeunesse atari ikipe yisukirwa kandi akiri umutoza ukomeye jean marie ntagwabira umutoza rayon sport n’ubwo yatsinzwe ntiyababaye bitewe n’uko hari abakinnyi bakomeye bakina inyuma batagaragaye mukino avuga atarenganya abahakinnye n’ubwo ntandaro gutsindwa twabuze amahirwe menshi imbere y’izamu ariko kandi n’ibitego twatsinzwe byatewe n’abakinnyi bakina inyuma ariko simbabaye kuko abakinnyi nari nizeye bakina iddy nshimiyimana mbanza hussein tambwe floribert munota nyuma byaje guhinduka gusa abakinnye bakoze bashoboye cyane abenshi badasanzwe babanza kibuga gusa ntagwabira yizeye kuzaba afite abakinnyi bakomeye azaba ahanganye apr fc ikipe yanatoje igihe kirekire mukino utaha uzahuza makipe tariki ukwakira stade amahoro police fc indi kipe yatangiye shampiyona ifite umuvuduko inatsinda ibitego byinshi yagaragazaga ishobora kuzahangana apr rayon sport ikazitwara igikombe dore n’umutoza wayo w’umunya serbia goran kuponovic yatakaje amanota abiri i huye imbere mukura vs nyuma kunganya ubusa busa umukino marine etincelles utegerejwe n’imbaga y’abanya rubavu kubera guhangana bitajya bishira hagati y’aya makipe warangiye etincelles atahanye amanota atatu nyuma gusinda marine ibitego busa stade umugandakuri stade mumena kiyovu sport izahagararira u rwanda mikino confederation cup yahatsidiye bitagoranye amagaju ibitego shyaka jean akili mabula serugaba erc barebye ncundura amakipe yazamukiye rimwe cyiciro mbere mwaka ndetse akaba yombi yanatangiye shampiyona yitwara nabi nyanza fc espoir zanganyirije ubusa busa i nyanza ubu apr isonga n’amanota etincelles irayikurikiye n’amanota rayon sport mwanya gatatu ifite amanota gihe police fc iza mwanya kane n’amanota amakipe nyuma marine kumwanya nota rimwe ifite ikaba ibanzirizwa as kigali mwanya n’inota rimwe thoneste nisingizwe

title: abafite amazu i nyagatare barasabwa kwishyura umusoro nyungu y’ubukode vuba

title: ishavu ry’abanyarwanda ritubere umusingi kwiyubaka umuyobozi w’umurenge bwishyura
content: umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’umurenge bwishyura niyonsaba cyriaque wifatanyije n’abaturage b’imidugudu nyarurembo karutete yagize ishavu ry’abanyarwanda ritubere umusingi kwiyubaka aha niyonsaba yungaga nsanganyamatsiko yahariwe mwaka igira iti twigire mateka turusheho kubaka ejo hazaza niyonsaba yaboneyeho akanya kunenga politike yazanywe n’abazungu gushyamiranya abantu yatunze agatoki ababiligi baje rwanda bagasanga abanyarwanda babanye neza bagasiga barukongeje n’ikintu kigaragara barusigiye umuyobozi w’umurenge bwishyura yagize urugero nk’aha kibuye basize bubatse gereza yonyine nk’aho abanyakibuye bakeneye hatanzwe ubuhamya bw’umwe bacitse icumu kibuye mukangoga emelita ufite imyaka gusa igihe jenoside yabaga yari afite ikiniga kinshi ariko yabashije kuvuga make byamugendekeye yabisobanuye magambo ikintu ntazigera nibagirwa igihe papa yampamagaye arangije guteka inkono y’ibijumba nituze aduhe ifunguro nyuma namubajije impamvu atubwiye atyo ambwira bagiye kutwica kuva bahise badutera turatatanangenda nomongana ntazi ngana hashize akanya gato mbona iwacu barahatwitse narinihishe mbona interahamwe zizanye papa kumwe murumuna papa afite bibiliya barayimwaka barayica amanika amaboko hejuru agira mana bantu ubababarire ntibazi barimo gukora ako kanya bahita bamutema amaboko murumuna babatsinda ahonanjye bashatse kunyica inshuro nyinshi buryo nageze mera nk’ikinya nkajya mbabwira nabi nti nimukore mushakaibyambayeho birebire mbivuze bwakwira bugacyagusa ndashimira imana nkiriho nk’uko mukangoga yakomeje abitangamo ubuhamya mukangoga emelita yasigaye wenyine muryango w’abana nyina bamwishe atwite inda cyenda se n’abavandimwe barabamaze ubu umubyeyi w’abana babili umuhungu w’imyaka n’imfura y’umukobwa w’imyaka ubura umwaka umwe angane mama igihe jenoside yabaga nyuma y’ubuhamya mukangoga hatanzwe n’ikiganiro ruhare leta yagize jenoside umwe bacitse icumu watanze ikiganiro yasobanuye ukuntu abatutsi kibuye kimwe n’ahandi hose rwanda bagiye bahezwa gahunda leta y’icyo gihe umuntu akabaho atazi bucya kugeza igihe jenoside ibereye n’uwo bitaga inshuti n’umuturanyi arabahinduka umuhango wabimburiwe n’urugendo rwahereye rwibutso jenoside ruri iruhande rw’ahahoze sitade gatwaro mujyi kibuye kugera mudugudu nyarurembo ahabereye ibiganiro gukurikira ijambo ry’umukuru w’igihugu yahariye munsi radiyo televiziyo abari babashije gukusanya amafaranga ibihumbi gutera inkunga abacitse icumu mu rwego rw’akarere gutangiza icyunamo byabereye murenge mubuga umuyobozi w’akarere karongi kayumba bernard n’abandi bayobozi bagiye kwifatanya n’abandi kwibuka nshuro jenoside yakorewe abatutsi gasana marcellin

title: kongo angola byiyemeje gufasha u rwanda uganda gukemura ikibazo bifitanye
content: mu nama yahuje abakuru b’ibihugu by’u rwanda uganda repubulika demukarasi kongo angola biyemeje gushyigikirana bikorwa bigamije gushakira umuti ikibazo cy’amahoro n’umutekano bihugu n’akarere k’ibiyaga bigari rusange mu nama yahuje abakuru b’ibihugu by’u rwanda uganda repubulika demukarasi kongo angola biyemeje gushyigikirana bikorwa bigamije gushakira umuti ikibazo cy’amahoro n’umutekano bihugu n’akarere k’ibiyaga bigari rusange kuri nyakanga nibwo i luanda gihugu cy’ angola habereye inama yibanze kibazo cy’ umutekano karere iyi nama yahuje bakuru b’ibihugu yatumijwe perezida angola jao laurenco yitabiriwe perezida w’ u rwanda paul kagame uwa uganda yoweli museveni uwa repubulika demukarasi kongo felix tshisekediitangazo ryakurikiye nama rivuga ibiganiro by’ bakuru b’ ibihugu title: ubwiza bw’imideli yamurikiwe birori mercedes-benz fashion week byabereye i kigali amafoto
content: abakunda kurimba kwizihirwa abihebeye kumurika imideli bamaze iminsi bategerezanyije amatsiko ibirori mercedes benz byabereye rwanda guhera gicurasi ni ibirori byihariye kandi bifite izina rikomeye ghana bimaze imyaka myinshi bibera ibyabereye rwanda byari byahuruje abantu b’ingeri zitandukanye baturutse bihugu byose afurika ku kamena ibirori mercedes-benz fashion week byaberaga rwanda nshuro yabyo mbere nibwo byasojwe ibi birori byabimburiwe kwifotoza kw’abanyamideli myambaro isanzwe street style gikorwa cyabereye hanze kigali convention centre mbere y’uko ibirori nyirizina bitangira saa tatu zuzuye nibwo umushyushyarugamba yavuze abahanga imideli bagomba kumurika imyambaro bahanze ku ikubitiro imyambaro yahanzwe rupari designs y’umunyarwandakazi rupari cynthia umaze kubaka izina bikorwa by’imideli niyo yabanje kwerekana imyambaro yayo rupari umwe bahanga imideli babigize umwuga wagiye ahagararira u rwanda imurika ry’imideli bihugu bitandukanye yanaruhagarariye marushanwa arimo miss grand lacs east african model search n’ayandi by’umwihariko yagize amahirwe guhuza imishinga n’umunyamideli wambika umugore perezida cte d’ivoire bigeze guhurira iwabo yaserukiye u rwanda mu yegukanye igihembo gikomeye imurika ry’imideli ryahuje abasaga bakomeye afurika mujyi conakry guine byitwa guss fashion show akimara gusoza kwerekana imyambaro hakurikiyeho imyambaro yahanzwe neopele concepts nigeria ufite imyambaro yihariye ariko y’abagabo gusa abanyamideli batandukanye barimo rwanda bayishinjagiyemo bituma abari bitabiriye gikorwa babasha kunyurwa n’uburyo baserutse uyu yakurikiwe karrsh collections y’umunyarwandakazi ufite imyambaro yihariye irimo iy’abasore n’inkumi yamuritswe buryo butandukanye bwanyuze benshi yakuriwe ingata inkanda fashion house patrick muhire nayo yerekanye imyambaro itandukanye yiganjemo iy’abakunda ibirori george malelu afurika y’epfo wambitse beyonce utegerejwe n’abatari bake gitaramo yerekanye imyambaro ikoranywe ubuhanga buhambaye yatumye akurirwa ingofero benshi uyu musore imyambaro yerekaniwe i kigali iy’abakobwa gusa y’igitsina gabo irimo clavon leonard leta zunze ubumwe amerika bahanga imideli bigaragaje gikorwa yerekanye iyiganjemo amakanzu n’amakositimu y’abagabo iki gitaramo cyagaragarijwemo abanyempano bakomeye kumurika imideli baturuka mfuruka zose z’isi cyashyizweho akadomo quophi akotuah ghana werekanye imyambaro yiganjemo iyambarwa muco w’iwabo yaserutse imbere y’imbaga yarebye mideli ahagana saa tanu zirengaho iminota mike ndayishimiye daniel wagize uruhare rukomeye kugira gikorwa kibe yashimye uburyo cyagenzemo yakomeje ndashima uburyo gitaramo cyabayemo minsi ibiri ntabwo ibintu byoroshye mboneyeho gutangaza kigiye kuba igikorwa ngarukamwaka rwanda tukaba dusaba abantu nzego zitandukanye kudushyigikira kuko dushaka gukora ibyabaye mwaka ibirori mercedes benz fashion week kigali nshuro mbere byari bibereye rwanda rwabaye igihugu kabiri afurika byari bibereyemo nyuma ghana bibera mujyi accra n’ubwo byaberaga rwanda ariko miziki yifashishijwe abanyamideli batambuka birori bitangiye kugeza birangiye ndirimbo y’umuhanzi rwanda yumvikanyemo imideli yamuritswe quophi akotuah ukomoka ghana imideli rupari designs y’umunyarwandakazi rupari cynthia imideli yahanzwe neopele concepts nigeria imideli karrsh collections imideli inkanda fashion house patrick muhire george malelu afurika y’epfo wambitse beyonce imideli clavon leonard leta zunze ubumwe amerika amafoto muhizi serge

title: imikorere y’ikigega kigamije kuzahura ubukungu bw’u rwanda bwazahajwe coronavirus
content: iki kigega kigamije gutera inkunga ibikorwa by’abikorera byahungabanyijwe n’icyorezo coronavirus minisitiri w’imari n’igenamigambi dr uzziel ndagijimana aherutse gutangaza ikigega kizafasha amabanki gutanga inguzanyo iciriritse byiciro byose kugira bigaruke kazi byongere bikore bibyare umusaruro uzagire ingaruka kuzamuka k’ubukungu rusange muri kigega hashyizwemo ingamba zihariye zifasha amahoteli kuvugurura amasezerano y’inguzanyo afite mabanki akaba igihe kirekire n’inyungu zikagabanuka ndetse buryo gihe yatangiye gufungura abona amafaranga aciriritse kugira imirimo yongere ikore imikorere y’iki kigega ireba amabanki y’ubucuruzi n’ibigo by’imari biciriritse banki nkuru y’igihugu niyo izagicunga gusa amafaranga bakiliya azajya atangwa n’amabanki ku ikubitiro leta yemeye gushyiramo miliyari frw ariko hagakomeza gushakwa abandi bashyiramo amafaranga kugira cyaguke usibye mahoteli kizafasha gutanga igishoro bucuruzi bwagizweho ingaruka coronavirus kugira bukomeze gukora kudahagarika abakozi hari kandi inguzanyo bucuruzi buto n’ubuciriritse nabwo bwibasiwe covid- banki nkuru y’igihugu izacunga imikorere yacyo izaguriza amabanki kugira nayo agurize abakiliya bayakeneye gusaba inguzanyo bizakorwa binyuze banki zibishinzwe nazo zizajya zikurikirana ikibazo nyuma zohereza bnr ibyifuzo by’abasabye gufashwa kugira bisuzumwe biganishe cyemezo nyuma nyuma kwemezwa amabanki azatanga amafaranga konte y’uwayasabye hanyuma ibyakozwe bigaragarizwe bnr nayo izatuma amafaranga agera kuwasabye umuyobozi w’urugaga rw’abikorera rwanda robert bapfakurera aherutse kuvuga nk’ubukerarugendo amahoteli byagize ibibazo bikomeye kuko barafunze burundu nubwo rwanda ibibazo coronavirus byarangira ntabwo ibibazo bizaba byarangiye ahandi hose kuko ubukerarugendo bukorana n’amahanga bakeneye gufashwa cyane raporo y’ishami ry’ubukerarugendo rugaga rw’abikorera psf yagaragazaga werurwe bwagize igihombo miliyari frw bivuye nama zasubitswe n’ibindi bikorwa by’ubukerarugendo byahagaritswe ibi bihombo byaje bisanga urwego rw’ubukerarugendo rwanda rufite inguzanyo miliyari frw imibare banki y’isi kuwa mata igaragaza ubukungu afurika munsi y’ubutayu sahara bwagizweho ingaruka coronavirus ndetse buzamanuka kigero - - buvuye bwariho ikigega mpuzamahanga cy’imari isi imf nacyo giherutse gutanga ikigereranyo umusaruro mbumbe w’isi mwaka uzamanuka mpuzandengo - uw’ubukungu bw’ibihugu byateye imbere kurusha ibindi bumanuke kigero - minisitiri w’imari n’igenamigambi dr ndagijimana uzziel ni ibintu bikomeye bidaheruka mateka y’isi muri afurika munsi y’ubutayu sahara hateganyijwe ubukungu buzamanuka - natwe birumvikana ubukungu bwacu butazagenda busanzwe buteganyijwe minisitiri dr ndagijimana yavuze igipimo cy’ubukungu bw’u rwanda kigaragaza butazazamuka kigero nk’uko byari byitezwe imibare yagiye ivugururwa ikava nyuma biramanuka bigera turi nubwo bitari byarangira neza indi nkuru wasoma ikigega miliyari frw ngamba zigiye kwifashishwa kuzahura ubukungu bw’u rwanda

title: banze kureka gucuruza agataro kuko kabatunze
content: abo bacuruzi boherejwe isko nyabisindu ariko banze kurijyamo kuko bakiriya bahaba umwe bacuruzi witwa uwimana jeanne avuga yaranguye kugirango yunguke atunge umuryango yagize aho kwicwa n’inzara nzicwa n’inkoni yakomeje avuga atareka gucuruza agataro kuko ariko kamutunze kuri asanga ubuyobozi bubarenganya kuko bacururiza hanze bagurirwa bikaba bigaragaza abacururiza isoko nabo bahora basaba bantu bakurwa hanze yaryo batabasha guhaza isoko ubuyobozi bw’umurenge nyamabuye buvuga butazihanganira akajagari nk’ako mujyi ariko bakaba barimo kwiga neza byakorwa muturage uhutajwe iyo utembereya mujyi muhanga ugenda uhura n’abantu bikoreye ibicuruzwa by’ubwoko butandukanye ibiribwa n’imyenda bagenda bagurisha baturage batuye duce twa gahogo kibirigi ruvumera n’ahandi ku basanzwe batuye mujyi ubwa mbere byadutse bikaba bituruka kubuzwa gucururiza hanze y’isoko muhanga ahubwo bacuruzi bakoherezwa isoko riri ahitwa i nyabisindu aho bacuruzi bagaragara muhanda uva kaburimbo ujya isoko winjiriye nyubako yitwa lumina muhanda wamabuye imbere bdc muhanga muhanda ugana radio huguka usanga bacuruzi batanditse ibicuruzwa byabo nako bafite ababacungira local defences ziza biruke ernest kalinganire

content: umushinjacyaha w’uru rukiko paul ngarua yasabiye nzabonimana igihano gufungwa burundu buri cyaha jenoside aregwa byaha byose akurikiranyweho n’uru rukiko nzabonimana wize ibijyanye n’ubutaka kaminuza bufaransa ashinjwa kuba bateguye bagaashyira bikorwa akanategeka ubwicanyi bw’abatutsi ndetse kwica abataravugaga rumwe n’ubutegetsi bwariho ashinjwa kandi kuba yarakanguriye agashishikariza abaturage perefegitura zitandukanye gutsemba abatusi kuba yaratanze intwaro nzabonimana wafatiwe gihugu tanzania kwezi kabiri ahakana ibyaha byose aregwa yabwiye urukiko yarahungiye ambasade y’u bufaransa jenoside yatangiraga ariko umushinjacyaha yahakanye ukwiregura kwe avuga abantu barahungiye ambasade bafite uburenganzira gusohoka igihe cyose babyifurije gutanga ibindi bimenyetso biteganyijwe kurangira gatanu abacamanza bakazahita bajya mwiherero gusuzuma ibyatangajwe mpande zombi uru rubanza rwatangiye kwezi cyenda mu kwezi gushize uru rukiko rwari rwakatiye igihano cy’imyaka abandi bahoze minisitiri babiri kubera uruhare bagize jenoside ariko rufungura n’abandi babiri nyuma kubura ibimenyetso bibahama urukiko ictr rwashizweho nyuma jenoside rwanda rwego gukurikirana abantu b’ingenzi bagize uruhare jenoside yakorewe abatusi abantu barenga miliyoni bayiguyemo gihe cy’iminsi emmanuel hitimana

title: legacy xp irigisha abanyarwanda kwizigamira
content: mu turere tw’igihugu bamaze kugeramo bitwaje ababyinnyi n’abakinnyi b’udukinamico duto twigisha abaturage umuco kwizigamira mabanki bigo by’imali iciriritse sacco intego legacy xp ugukangurira buri munyarwanda wese kwizigamira kumenya uburyo bunoze bw’imicungire y’amafaranga kugira bimufashe gutera imbere bukungu n’imibereho myiza nk’uko bisobanurwa eliane umwali umukozi w’iyi sosiyete ubwo karere nyanza tariki eliane umwali yavuze umuco kuzigama umuntu wese ugomba kuwutozwa akiri muto kugira awukurane bityo bizamufashe kugira yigezaho legacy xp yanigishije abaturage mujyi nyanza bashobora gukoresha ibyuma bibikurizwaho amafaranga bita atm machine hamwe n’imikorere konti igendanwa iyo konti igendanwa ushobora kuyikoresha amasaha iminsi irindwi igihe cyose isaha ariyo murongo utonze nk’uko eliane yabisobanuye mukamusoni annonciata umwe baturage bumva bukangurambaga yavuze muntu ushobora gutera imbere adakoresha uburyo kwizigamira abisonabura atya nta muntu wahabwa inguzanyo banki atabanje gutera intambwe kubanza kwizigamira nicyo gituma nihereyeho nafashe iya mbere ngafunguza konti murenge sacco w’umurenge wacu busasamana legacy xp yanatanze udutabo tw’imfashanyigisho baturage mujyi nyanza tubashishikariza kwizigamira kugira bashobore kwihuta iterambere ubukungurambaga nk’ubu legacy xp imaze kubukorera turere twa kamonyi muhanga ruhango nyanza ikaba iteganya kubugeza tundi turere dutandukanye nk’uko eliane umwali umukozi w’iyi sosiyete abitangaza jean pierre twizeyeyezu

title: nyabihu abashumba bahungabanya umutekano w’abaturage
content: bamwe baturage bamaze guterwa impungenge n’imyitwarire y’abo bashumba niyonzima justin umwe batuye ako gace avuga hari abaturage murenge bigogwe bamaze gukubitwa baranakomeretswa ndetse hari n’uwatemwe ajyanwa bitaro tariki abo bashumba akenshi bakunze guhungabanya umutekano w’abaturage usanga abimukira ako gace baraje bashaka akazi abaturage bavuga impamvu bashumba bakomeza gukora urugomo nk’urwo ababikora badahanwa nyabyo iyo hari ufashwe afungwa igihe gito kitarenze ibyumweru bibiri hanyuma bakongera bakamufungura usanga bashumba basa n’abamenyereye gihano kuko usanga bavuga nubwo babafunga bazabafungura abaturage barasaba ubuyobozi bw’umurenge bigogwe gukemura kibazo hataragira n’uwicwa cyangwa agakorerwa ikindi gikorwa cy’ubunyamaswa umuyobozi ushinzwe imibereho myiza y’abaturage murenge bigogwe rwisumbura gerard avuga kibazo cy’abashumba bakizi ariko hari ingamba zikomeye zigiye gufatirwa abashumba ndetse n’aborozi murenge zimwe ngamba zafashwe bagiye gushyiraho ishyirahamwe rihuza aborozi bigogwe buryo buri wese yerekana abashumba agatanga imyirondoro hanyuma bakayandika buryo uzajya akora amakosa azajya akurikiranwa n’amategeko kandi n’ibyo yangije bikabazwa yaragiriraga ikindi abashumba bazajya bagaragaraho imico igayitse nk’iyo uretse gufungwa bazajya basubizwa baturutse kuko usanga abahungabanya umutekano kenshi batanavuka bigogwe abaturage nabo barasabwa kwicungira umutekano gutanga amakuru muntu wese washaka kubahungabanyiriza umutekano kugirango afatirwe ibyemezo safari viateur

title: harateganywa ubushakashatsi dukingirizo tuberanye n’ingimbi
content: ibi bimwe byavugiwe kiganiro n’abanyamakuru kane tariki akaba ikiganiro cyateguwe n’ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe ubuzima ishami rishinzwe kurwanya sida iki kiganiro kikaba cyari kigamije kumenyekanisha ibizigirwa nama y’igihugu ngarukamwaka kurwanya icyorezo sida bana izabera i kigali tariki kugeza ugushyingo mwaka ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe ubuzima rwanda biomedical center rbc kivuga nubwo gahunda gukwirakwiza udukingirizo mashuri yisumbuye igifite ingorane kutumvikanwaho bitazatuma gahunda idashoboka dr anita asiimwe umuyobozi mukuru wungirije rbc avuga kubera imyaka y’abanyeshuri mashuri yisumbuye ibarirwa hagati gahunda gukwirakwiza udukingirizo mashuri yisumbuye niyemerwa hazabaho ubushakashatsi bw’udukingirizo tuberanye n’abo banyeshuri dr anita asiimwe agira hazabaho ubushakashatsi bwihuse hagamijwe kumenya udukingirizo turi isoko dutoya cyangwa tunini bana ubu hari ubushakashatsi dufite bwakozwe minisiteri y’ubuzima buvuga hari abavuga udukingirizo duhari isoko ry’u rwanda tudafite impumuro nziza n’ibi tuzabyigaho hazanwe udukingirizo dufite impumuro zidatuma hari abanga gukoresha udukingirizo ishami ry’umuryango w’abibumbye ryita muryango un family naryo rivuga u rwanda nirwemeza ikwirakwiza ry’udukingirizo mashuri yisumbuye rugomba gukora ubushakashatsi dukingirizo tuberanye n’abanyeshuri mashuri yisumbuye dr landry tsigain akorera un family avuga kumenya udukingirizo tungana kuko hari udukingirizo dushobora kuba tunini bamwe utundi tukaba duto bandi yatanze urugero bihugu by’afurika y’amajyepfo kuko higeze kuza udukingirizo tunini bagabo ubushakashatsi bwakozwe minisiteri y’ubuzima mwaka buzima bw’imyororokere y’ingimbi n’abangavu bugaragaza abakobwa batangira gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina myaka abahungu bagatangira myaka inzego z’ubuvuzi zivuga kuba hari abakobwa batwara inda mashuri yisumbuye ikimenyetso cy’uko hadafashwe ingamba zikomeye habaho ubwiyongere bw’ubwandu sida mashuri yisumbuye rubyiruko rusange jean baptiste micomyiza

title: akarere rubavu karishimira ibikorwa by’amajyambere kagezeho
content: mu bikorwa byamuritswe harimo umuhanda uhuza imipaka yombi y’u rwanda repubulika iharanira demokarasi kongo grande et petite barierre ukazatwara akayabo k’amafaranga akabakaba miliyoni ndetse n’ umuhanda pave ujya biro by’akarere watangiye gukorwa munsi umuyobozi w’akarere sheh bahame hassan yavuze akarere kabwiye rwiyemezamirimo imodoka zikora mihanda zitazasubirayo utugari tutazikoresheje dusane uduhanda tujya hasuwe kandi umusozi wimuweho imiryango kubera ikibazo cy’isuri yicaga abahatuye gihe cy’imvura uyu musozi murenge gisenyi guterwamo ibiti binyuranye bifata ubutaka hakazubakwamo uduhanda intebe n’ibitare kuruhukiramo mukerarugendo iki gikorwa kizatwara amafaranga miliyoni bavuye musozi ubuyobozi b’akarere rubavu bwasuye akagari karukogo umurenge rubavu birebera ibikorwa ndengera foundation uyu muryango wubatse amasoko y’amazi agemurira abaturage amazi meza ndetse n’ibitaro kijyambere umuyobozi w’akarere yasabye umuyobozi ndengera foundation gufatanya n’akarere bakareba masoko y’amazi yakwaguka abaturage benshi bakavomaho abayobozi banagejejwe ahari kubakwa amashanyarazi ako kagali jean berchmas bahige ukuriye ewsa rubavu yasobanuye mashanyarazi azagera baturage tugali twa byahi kanembwe karukogo ibarizwa mirenge rubavu cyanzarwe bahige yashimangiye mashanyarazi afite ingufu zihagije zizafasha abaturage kwivana bukene bahige yagize mushinga wizwe neza ibikoresho byose birahari igikorwa cyose gikoreshwa n’amashanyarazi kizahakora kirahari mpungenge hasuwe n’isoko ryo ako kagali ariko rizatangira gukorerwamo mutarama nyuma y’ubunani uru rugendo rwasorejwe isoko kijyambere ry’akarere rubavu riri kubakwa mujyi rwagati murenge gisenyi imirimo kubaka soko iracyari hasi ariko irimo kwihutishwa kugira rizatangire gukoreshwa aho riri isoko risanzwe rikorera hazazamurwa irindi gorofa hanubakwe imodoka zihagarara asoza gikorwa umuyobozi w’akarere rubavu sheh bahame hassan yibukije inshingano buri wese kurinda gukoresha neza ibikorwa remezo gihe bizaba byuzuye bahame yagize ibikorwa nk’ibi iby’umuturage turifuza buri wese agira uruhare kubibungabunga kubikoresha kuko uburenganzira bweumwe baturage utuye kagari karukogo seth mugema asanga amajyambere kwihuta abagana buryo yiteguye gutangiza umushinga iwabo cyaro nogosha imisatsi mujyi none kubera batuzaniye amashanyarazi ngiye kwimurira salon yanjye karukogo nk’uko byagaragaye akarere rubavu kari kwihutisha ibikorwa remezo bijyanye n’icyerekezo ariko cyane cyane hubakwa imihanda ariko inzira ikiri ndende akarere karateganya kuganira n’abafite amazu mujyi rwego kubafasha kwihutisha bikorwa bakihutisha iterambere aka karere pascaline umulisa

title: papa francis yahinduye musenyeri diyosezi nyundo
content: papa francis umushumba kiliziya gatolika yatoye padiri anaclet mwumvaneza umunyamabanga mukuru caritas rwanda gusimbura musenyeri alexis habiyambere buyobozi diyosezi nyundo nk’uko bitangazwa n’urubuga vatikani newsva musenyeri alexis habiyambere w’imyaka asimbuwe kubera yasabye gusezera kuko ageze bukuru padiri anaclet mwumvaneza yavutse ukuboza avukira i murambi paruwasi rulindo arkidiyosezi kigali hagati yize amashuri abanza i rulindo ayarangije akomeza ajya iseminari nto kabgayi guhera mwaka mu kigero cy’imyaka yaje gusubira iseminari nto i kabgayi cyiciro cy’abigaga bakuze musenyeri habyarimana alexis wasimbuwe kubushumba diyoseze nyundo nyuma y’imyaka yatangiye iseminari nkuru i rutongo - ahavuye yakomeje cyiciro filozofiya - akomereza tewolojiya - seminari nkuru nyakibanda diyosezi butare yahawe isakaramentu ry’ubusaseridoti nyakanga ubutumwa bwe yabukoreye paruwasi kabuye - paruwasi y’umuryango mutagatifu mwaka - yavuye agiye gukomeza amasomo i roma hagati y’umwaka akaba yarahavanye impamyabumenyi y’ikirenga by’amategeko kiliziya mwumvaneza anaclet ugiye kuba umushumba diyoseze nyundo agarutse rwanda yakoze ubutumwa bwe paruwasi kicukiro - akaba n’umwarimu iseminari nkuru nyakibanda yabaye kandi umuyobozi caritas arkidiyosezi kigali hagati y’umwaka guhera mwaka akaba umunyamabanga mukuru caritas rwanda musenyeri alexis habiyambere ucyuye igihe yatangiye kuyobora diyoseze nyundo guhera mwaka yanditswe akayezu snappymuhaburarw

title: i kigali hagiye kubera ibirori bishya by’imideli ikorerwa rwanda
content: ibi birori byiswe cretos fashion experience byitezweho kuzagaragaza imyambaro y’amoko atandukanye ikorerwa rwanda biteganyijwe kuba guhera saa kumi n’ebyiri z’umugoroba itariki nyakanga villa portofino hotel mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru mugabushaka jacqueline hellevik wabiteguye yagarutse bikorwa bitandukanye asanzwe akora yibanda ntego afite kubona uruganda rw’ibijyanye gukora imideli rwanda rwagutse yagize ibi dukora intego njyewe mfite bizajya bijya hanze bikerekana ishusho y’u rwanda kugira bigume dukomeze kwibaza umwambaro runaka umuhanzi runaka umunyamideli runaka ariko rimwe ntihazagire ikintu kigera hanze nifuza kuba umwe bazabiharanira kugira bariya hanze bave hariya baze ahubwo twe tujye tubasangayo tubashyiriye dukora hakizimana abdallah uyoboye imyiteguro y’ibi birori yagize ni ibirori bizaba bifite intego kugaragaza imideli ikorerwa rwanda kuyitangaho amakuru ikindi cy’ibanze hakabamo kwerekana ubushobozi bw’abanyarwanda ruganda rw’imideli ngira nayo ntego kugaragaza dushobora kwikorera imyambaro itaduhenze tutarindiriye iy’abanyamahanga ijya kugera inaha ihenze mugabushaka avuga nubwo hakiri ibikibabera ingorabahizi kuzamura uruganda rw’imideli ariko badacika intege ahubwo bifuza gukomeza gukorana imbaraga bongeramo n’udushya kugira bagere bifuza bamaze kubona abanyamideli umunani basanzwe bazwi rwanda bazamurika imyambaro bakora nubwo batararangiza gutoranya bazakorana ku rundi ruhande yavuze ashaka imyambaro bakora izabasha kuzajya ihatana rwego mpuzamahanga kandi myambaro ikoze buryo bunyuranye butari bitenge gusa nkuko hari abishyiramo ibitege bikoreshwa gusa afurika gukora imyenda uyu mugore avuga yabaye umunyamideli by’igihe kirekire rwanda ndetse akaba n’umwe bamuritse imyambaro itandukanye ibirori by’ubu bwoko bicyaduka gihugu nubwo nyuma yaje kujya gukomereza umwuga i burayi mugabushaka wiyemeje kugaragaza imbaraga z’abanyarwanda gukora imyambaro myiza kandi ihendutse yagarutse rwanda aje gushinga uruganda rwayo yise cretos productions akora imyambaro itandukanye bitambaro biva mahanga ariko akayiha ishusho yifuza n’ibiciro biri hasi y’ibyo mahanga ibijyanye kumurika imideli yabyinjijemo n’umwana witwa roxanne hellevik umaze kugaragaza impano birori bitandukanye bikomeye mugabane w’i burayi paris fashion week london fashion week istanbul fashion week n’ibindi bitandukanye

title: nyabihu amaze imyaka icyenda asaba kurenganurwa nyuma y’aho akarere kamugurishirije inzu
content: habiyambere simeon utuyeumudugudu kazuba akagari kijote murenge bigogwe amaze imyakaicyenda asiragizwa n’akarere kibazo cy’inzu kateje cyamunaraikanagurwa n’abakozi bako uyu wahoze ngabo z’igihugu akaza gusezererwa amazekwandikira inzego zose kugera perezidanzi ubu gihirahiro nyumay’amezi atatu urwego rw’umuvunyi rusabye akarere guha umurongo ikibazo cyenone amaso akaba yaraheze kirere mu ibaruwa urwego rw’umuvunyi rwandikiye akarere tarikiya ugushyingo rwasabaga akarere gutanga raporo y’uburyo kakemuyeikibazo habiyambere uru rwego rwasaba akarere kubikora minsi noneamezi abaye atatu gusa hashize ibyumweru bibiri meya nyabihu avuga koibaruwa yamaze gutegurwa kandi bagiye kuyoherereza urwego rwabandikiye arikoumuturage ntarahabwa kopi rwego rw’umuvunyi ntibaraduhamiriza kobayibonye habiyambere avuga yayubatse inzu kibanzayahawe n’ubuyobozi anayubaka bureba nyuma akarere kanamusabye kuvugururaarabikora iyi nzu yubatse santeri kora muhanda wakaburimbo ugana rubavu yegeranye n’inzu zahoze iz’umunyaburayi witwa pakiwakoraga ibikorwa by’ubuhinzi turere tunyuranye tw’u rwanda nyuma ubuyobozi bw’akarere nyabihu bwaje kwemeza koibikorwa paki bitezwa cyamunara haza kugurishwa miliyoni n’ibihumbimagana abiri mirongo itanu rwfs mu gusohora ibyangombwa by’ubwobutaka habiyambere yisanze inzu n’ubutaka bye nabyo byarahawe uwatsindiyeicyamunara uwagurishije n’uwaguze abakozi b’akarere muri kibazo havugwamo abakozi b’akarere batejecyamunara n’abayitsindiye abameya bamaze kuba batatu basimburana nyamara abobakozi baracyahari nibo babazwa amakuru ajyanye n’ikibazo bagizemo uruhare ndayambaje william niwewahagarariye icyamunara akaba umukozi w’akarere nyabihu ushinzweubutakaland administrator zawadi valentin niwe watsindiyeicyamunara umukozi w’akarere murenge kabatwa nyabihu nyirasafari solange umugore wazawadi cyamunara iba ashinzwe irangamimerere etat civil murenge wabigogwe ahaherereye mutungo ubwo habiyambere asiragira asabakurenganurwa nyirasafari umujyanama w’akarere by’amategeko akaba arinoteri legal advisor and notary twahirwa jean baptiste akora mukarere serivisi z’ubutakaland survey akaba yarandikiye umunyamabanganshingwabikorwa w’akarere nyabihu asobanura cyamunara itakozweneza yitandukanya n’ibyayivuyemo muri baruwa dufitiye kopi kuwa kanama twahirwa avuga ndayambaje william umukuriye yamwangiye kujya terrainngo bagene agaciro k’uwo mutungo scientifiquement anavuga byaribiteganijwe mafaranga ava cyamunara miliyoni eshatu zagombagaguhabwa umwe baturage bafite inzu butaka habiyamberesimiyoni mu gusoza baruwa twahirwa agira nyuma y’iyokinamico narababaye mbwira umuyobozi w’ibiro by’ubutaka bwana ndayambajewilliam ntemera cyamunara ambwira ngomba kubiceceka simbivugengo byatera amakimbirane baturage abatuye kora bavuga cyamunara yariyakusanije imitungo paki ivanze n’iy’abaturage batujwemo nyuma bamwebaza gusakuza bahabwa ibyangombwa by’ubutaka buriho inzu zabo aba barimo nambanzamihigo jerome wanyuze manza n’akarere amaze kugatsinda nawearabihabwa hasigara habiyambere simeon amatakambo habiyambere yageze rwego rw’umuvunyimaze ugushyingo rusaba akarere kubifataho umwanzuro kakarumenyesha mugihe kitarenze iminsi ariko amezi ashize atatu meya antoinette avugayamaze gusubiza uru rwego nubwo yaba yaranatinze ariko kigaragaza ururwego rwabonye baruwa cyane n’umuturage watanze ikibazo avuga koatarayibona karegeya omar

title: hari amadini n’amatorero agiye gufungwa bitarenze gatatu w’iki cyumweru
content: ubuyobozi bw’akarere gasabo bwaburiye amadini n’amatorero buzafunga insengero zitubahirije ibisabwa bitarenze gatatu w’iki cyumweru bubasaba kugira ibyangombwa by’ikigo cy’igihugu cy’imiyoborere rgb icyemezo cy’akarere umuyobozi w’itorero agomba kuba afite uburenganzira bumwemerera guhagararira iryo torero imyubakire y’urusengero igomba kuba itateza ibibazo abaruteraniramo ntibyemewe kandi guteranira nyubako ikirimo kubakwa urusengero rugomba kugira parikingi itarimo umukungu n’icyondo rugomba kuba rwubatse byibura buso bungana hegitare ntibyemewe gusengera shitingi hagomba uburyo kwirinda urusaku rusohoka hanze ntibyemewe gukorera nzu yagenewe guturwamo icururizwamo cyangwa igize umudugudu utuwemo insengero zitegetswe kandi kugira ubwiherero byibura ibyumba bine n’ahantu hafatirwa amafunguro hasukuye mu gusoma amabwiriza umuyobozi w’akarere gasabo stephen rwamurangwa yagize ubwiherero butameze neza bwonyine burahagije kuba itorero ryahagarikwa ati insengero zitubahirije mube muzifunze kugira zibanze zitunganye ibitameze neza gihe tubahaye kuko igenzura rirakorwa kabiri hanyuma gatatu amabwiriza azashyirwa bikorwa ubuyobozi bw’akarere gasabo n’inzego zishinzwe umutekano bavuga hari abantu bashobora guteza umutekano muke bitwaje kujya gusenga rwamurangwa yavuze bazagera bakanereba abantu bigisha kuko hari n’abigisha batazi b’abapagani atiariko murumva bitumvikanye neza kurushaho pasteri ntambara innocent uhagarariye itorero bita success umwe bahagarariye amadini n’amatorero uvuga cyemezo gitunguranye ati ku bijyanye n’insengero zaba zifite virusi guteza umutekano muke gihe zigomba guhabwa ariko turasaba iryo tsinda rigenzura ryagenda gahoro kuko insengero zubahirije muvuze nke cyane ubuyobozi bw’akarere gasabo buvuga gisibya hari insengero zitangira gufungwa bitarenze gatatu tariki gashyantare ku rundi ruhande ikigo gishinzwe imiyoborere rgb nacyo cyahise gitangariza abanyamakuru kigiye kongera ibisabwa amadini n’amatorero rwego gukaza umutekano w’abayasengeramo yanditswe niyomugabo albert

title: intwaro z’ingenzi abanyarwanda bifashishaga guhangana n’ibyorezo by’inzara n’indwara
content: hari ibyorezo bitandukanye byagiye byibasira u rwanda birimo nk’indwara z’umuze gusogobwa byahitanye abatagira ingano iyima mutara semugeshi hari indwara y’ubushita yateye gisaka ngoma mibambwe sentabyo hari ibindi biza byaje u rwanda rwar ruhanganye n’ubukoloni hagati y’umwaka n’uwa muri bihe u rwanda rwibasiwe n’indwara z’amatungo zirimo uburenge iragara muryamo n’amashuya hateye kandi indwara z’abantu zirimo mugiga ubushita n’ibihara haza gutera inzara karundura zahitanye abatagira ingano zirimo muhatibicumuro ruyaga rumanura gakwege rwakayihura ruzagayura n’ubwo byorezo byazaga bikidegembya ndetse hakaba n’ibimara iminsi itari mike ntibyabuzaga abanyarwanda bafata ingamba kubitsinda ubutazagaruka mu murage gihanga yahaye u rwanda ihangwa ry’igihugu gasabo yahaye abazamukomokaho n’umuryango mugari w’abenegihugu umurage ukomeye ugomba kugenga imiyoborere y’igihugu n’imibereho n’imibanire y’abanyarwanda myaka amagana n’amagana azaba atakiriho imitekerereze- murage gihanga yabaga inakubiye mihango y’ubwiru yakorwaga rwego kohera ibiza bizaza gihugu mu rwanda ha mbere bagiraga amahame y’imiyoborere imibereho n’imibanire akurikira gukunda imana yaremye u rwanda n’abanyarwanda gukunda u rwanda nk’umurage ukomeye ugomba kubungabungwa gukunda gukeza umwami cyangwa se kubaha kumvira ubuyobozi kubaha kurengera ikiremwamuntu n’urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima kugendera mahame kirazira kugira utinya n’ibyo wubaha ayo mahame niyo ngenderwaho kwesa imihigo y’ibyo babaga barahize kugeraho ibihe byose muri mahame habonekagamo intwaro zikomeye zifashishwaga guhangana n’ibiza ibyorezo by’inzara n’indwara z’abantu n’amatungo izo ntwaro zarimo gukunda kuramya umwami nubwo mvugo yakoreshwaga ityo bihe ha mbere yabaga ishaka kugaragaza abanyarwanda bahawe umurage w’ihame ryo gukunda kubaha ubuyobozi bwabo ibyo bikabarinda amakimbirane kurwanira ubuyobozi kubangamira gahunda leta iyo ikaba ariyo nkomoko-muzi kumvira abayobozi kw’abanyarwanda nayo mpamvu gihe cy’amatora kubashyiraho biba bimeze nk’ubukwe yandi mahanga amatora akaba intambara zihitana benshi kumvira ubuyobozi kw’abanyarwanda kwababereye intwaro idasaza yabafashije guhangana n’ibyorezo title: u rwanda rwasinyanye amasezerano y’inkunga miliyari banki y’isi
content: leta y’u rwanda banki y’isi basinye amasezerano y’inkunga miliyoni z’amadorali amerika ukuvuga asaga miliyari miliyoni mishinga igamije guteza imbere ibikorwa remezo n’ibindi bikorwa by’iterambere mijyi kabiri amasezerano yasinywe hagati y’impande zombi ateganya miliyoni z’amadorali amerika azakoreshwa mishinga y’iterambere ry’imijyi itandatu yunganira kigali irimo uwa muhanga rubavu rusizi nyagatare huye musanze minisitiri w’imari n’igenamigambi amb getete claver wasinye ruhande leta y’u rwanda yatangaje mushinga uzakemura byinshi bibazo by’ubukungu n’ibikorwa remezo mijyi itandatu yagize uyu mushinga ukubiyemo inkunga gukemura inzitizi zikigaragara mijyi kabiri nk’ibikorwa remezo by’ibanze bizamura imibereho n’ubukungu kuzamura ibice bimwe bimwe by’ibyaro kubaka ubushobozi bw’abakozi b’inzego z’uturere babashe gucunga neza mijyi minisitiri gatete yanavuze ibikorwa by’iterambere bizakorerwa mijyi bigomba kuba bishingiye igenamigambi ry’uturere iherereyemo hakazibandwa cyane kubaka imihanda gukamura ibishanga kubyaza umusaruro imyanda serivisi z’amazi isuku n’isukura yasser el gammal uhagarariye banki y’isi rwanda asanga uretse kuba mafaranga azateza imbere mijyi azanafasha guteza imbere ubukungu bw’abayituye binyuze guhanga akazi yagize banki y’isi yishimiye uruhare igira iterambere rirambye ry’u rwanda binyuze mushinga mushya uzafasha leta gushyira bikorwa gahunda guteza imbere imijyi kabiri ikazanafasha kuzamura imibereho mijyi binyuze itangwa serivisi iterambere bukungu guhanga imirimo mu guteza imbere uturere n’imijyi imihanda guhagarika gukora gihe bagitegereje umunsi w’ubukwe ngo byiza kugira amategeko ugomba kubahiriza mbere y’uko urushinga kuko kwemeranwa muzabana bitavuze mwabanye hari byahinduka uramutse utubahirije bikurikira wikwishyiraho umupaka ngo nyuma kugira umukunzi ndetse mukaba mwaranafashe icyemezo kurushinga n’iby’ingenzi gushyiraho umupaka nshuti zawe zindi ariko ntiwishyireho umupaka utangire kwanga inshuti zawe kuko mwumvikanye bishobora gupfa ni byiza kwitonda ugashishoza gusa ugomba cyane cyane kwirinda umubano n’inshuti zawe cyane mudahuje igitsina hagarika gukora imibonanompuzabitsina n’ibindi bijyanye nayo ni ngombwa kumenya wenda gushinga urugo kandi bikaba byiza ubaye isugiku gitsina gore cyangwa imanziku gitsina gabo kuba wakomeza gukora imibonanompuzabitsina cyane cyane n’izindi nshuti zawe byagusenyera urugo ndetse intego zanyu ntimuzigereho wikumva warushinze byarangiye itonde nibyo rwose wowe n’umukunzi wawe mwamaze gufata icyemezo ariko ntibyari byaba murushinge haracyabura igihe n’iyo cyaba gito wigabanya umubano n’umukunzi wawe wumve byarangiye ahubwo uracyafite byinshi kumenya neza muteganya kurushinga kugira muzabane umuzi neza cyane wikwita kubyo wumva hirya hino ubikurikize iyi n’inama ikomeye benda kurushinga gihe muba mwitegura kubana akaramata uba ugomba kugira byinshi witondera kumva cyane cyane igitsina gore mu gihe wenda kurushinga uzabwirwa byinshi n’abantu batandukanye ugirwe inama n’inshuti zawe ndetse n’abandi itondere inama ugirwa kuko zishobora kugusenyera hagarika kubwira amabanga umukunzi wawe ndetse n’abandi hari amabanga akomeye utagomba kubwira umukunzi wawe bitewe n’imvamvu runaka zishobora kuzana agatotsi mubano wanyu ndetse ntunagomba kubwira amabanga yawe izindi nshuti zawe zose ziteguye kukumva witekereza gukunda byarangiye uterere agati ryinyo si byiza rwose kugabanya gukunda mwemeje kurushinga witurize kumwereka urukundo mbere wiringiye mwafashe icyemezo ahubwo gihe kongeramo umunyu wirekeraho kumuha urukundo ahubwo kora ushoboye kose uzane udushya rukundo wikwemera ibyari byose udafitiye ibimenyesto bifatika kwemera ibyari byose udafitiye gihamya bishobora kukugusenyera rwose gihe witegura kurushinga ubwo ugomba kubaza umukunzi wawe ikintu cyose utumva ukamusobanuza neza kugira muzabashe kubana neza ntawishisha undiibyo bimwe ugomba kwirinda gukora gihe wamaze kufata icyemezo kurushinga kugira umubano wanyu uzagenge neza kugeza mubanyeyanditswe ukurikiyimfura leoncemuhaburarw

title: inama y’umutekano isi yavuze makimbirane y’u rwanda uganda ibya coronavirus n’ibindi
content: inama y’umutekano isi yateranye hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga video conference rwego kwirinda icyorezo coronavirus yagarutse myitwarire y’ibihugu karere k’ibiyaga bigari kwirinda cyorezo cyugarije isi hanagaragazwa ubukungu bw’ibi bihugu bukomeje kuzahabwa n’ingamba zafashwe yavuze kandi mubano w’u rwanda uganda umutekano kongo amatora burundi n’ibindi inama y’umutekano isi yateranye hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga video conference rwego kwirinda icyorezo coronavirus yagarutse myitwarire y’ibihugu karere k’ibiyaga bigari kwirinda cyorezo cyugarije isi hanagaragazwa ubukungu bw’ibi bihugu bukomeje kuzahabwa n’ingamba zafashwe yavuze kandi mubano w’u rwanda uganda umutekano kongo amatora burundi n’ibindi bbc dukesha nkuru ivuga umwanya munini wahawe abahagarariye ibihugu byabo aka kanama k’umuryango w’abibumbye gashinzwe umutekano isi nyuma raporo yasomwe n’intumwa yihariye y’umunyamabanga mukuru onu karere k’ibiyaga bigari bwana huang xia huang xia yabwiye abagize nama ibihugu by’aka karere bigerageza kurwanya icyorezo covid- ndetse imibare y’abandura n’ubwo izamuka ariko idakabije kugeza avuga ingamba zafashwe zizagira ingaruka zikomeye bukungu busanzwe bujegajega bw’ibihugu by’aka karere kuko ubucuruzi inganda ubukererugendo inama mpuzamahanga n’indi mirimo igize ubukungu bw’ibi bihugu byahagaritswe cyangwa bidakorwa nk’uko bisanzwe aka kanama onu kasabye amahanga gufasha ibihugu aka karere guhangana n’ingaruka z’icyorezo covid- kuko zishobora kunaniza umuhate w’iterambere rirambye n’amahoro karere amakimbirane y’u rwanda - uganda bwana huang xia yavuze n’ubwo hari ibitararangira ariko hatewe intambwe gukemura makimbirane bigizwemo uruhare n’abategetsi b’ibihugu angola dr congo intambwe yatewe amakimbirane yashimwe kandi n’abahagarariye u bufaransa amerika tunisia n’abandi gusa basaba ibihugu byombi byatera intambwe irushije kurangiza makimbirane bwana huang yavuze hari ibikorwa by’iterambere bitanga ikizere ibihugu by’akarere biri gufatanya nko kuba mwaka ushize leta z’u burundi dr congo tanzania zarumvikanye gutangira kubaka inzira gari moshi ihuza bihugu kwihutisha ubucuruzi inyeshyamba burasirazuba dr congo bwana huang yavuze inama z’abashinzwe iperereza bihugu by’u burundi tanzania uganda rwanda dr congo zemeje ubufatanye guhana amakuru kurwanya imitwe y’inyeshyamba burasirazuba dr congo yavuze nubwo hakiri imitwe n’imwe ikomeje ibikorwa kwibasira abaturage burasirazuba congo ariko hari intambwe yatewe kurandura bikozwe n’ingabo dr congo ibi byashimangiwe kandi n’uhagarariye dr congo un watumiwe kwitabira nama uhagarariye ubwongereza nama yavuze ikibazo cy’inyeshyamba burasirazuba dr congo hamwe n’iterambere rirambye ry’akarere byakemuka hahagaritswe ubucuruzi butemewe bwambukiranya imipaka bw’imitungo kamere n’amabuye y’agaciro uyu yasabye kandi ingabo monusco ziri burasirazuba congo zitanga raporo aka kanama z’ibyo zimaze igihe kinini zikora ako gace abagize aka kanama bashimye imibanire n’imikoranire rusange leta dr congo n’ibihugu bituranye ndetse gukemura ikibazo cy’umutekano mucye burasirazuba dr congo banavuga ihererekanywa ry’ubutegetsi mahoro ryabaye dr congo urugero rwiza politiki n’ikizere cy’amahoro karere amatora burundintabwo ingingo yagarutsweho byihariye n’intumwa yihariye y’umunyamabanga mukuru onu aka karere gusa bamwe bahagarariye ibihugu byabo nama bayagarutseho uhagarariye ubwongereza yavuze bafite impungenge z’uko ibintu byifashe mbere y’amatora burundi asaba leta guha urubuga itangazamakuru n’abanyapolitiki gihe cy’amatora kugira amatora azabe atabogamye nicolas de rivire uhagarariye ubufaransa yavuze gihugu gitewe impungenge kuba leta yaratsimbaraye amatora azaba bihe by’icyorezo bwana nicolas avuga ubufaransa bufite impungenge z’ubwisanzure n’imigendekere myiza y’amatora agasaba haba ibikorwa kwirinda icyahungabanya amahoro n’umutekano matora kuko byagira ingaruka karere kose kelly craft uhagarariye leta zunze ubumwe amerika yavuze batewe impungenge kuba abaturage bazitabira amatora gihe cy’icyorezo asaba leta kumenya neza amatora abaye buryo budashyira kaga abayitabira madamu kelly yongeyeho amerika ifite impungenge zirushijeho makuru kuniga ubwisanzure bw’ibitekerezo guhitamo kwishyira hamwe bivugwa burundi ati ibyo byiyongera makuru gufunga kunyuruza kwica iyicarubozo n’ihohotera rishingiye gitsina ubutumwa bwacu leta y’u burundi bukomeje gusobanuka amatora mahoro ubwisanzure uburenganzira buri wese kandi agaragaza amahitamo y’abaturage b’u burundi ingenzi mahoro arambye burundi karere dmitry polyanskiy uhagarariye uburusiya nama yavuze ibihugu karere biri bihe bikomeye guha icyerekezo amateka yabyo bimwe nk’u burundi bigiye matora ati nta gushidikanya ibyemezo biganisha mahoro arambye bigira akamaro byafashwe n’ibihugu ubwabyo ibisubizo bitegetswe n’ibindi bihugu bihugu byigenga ikintu kutihanganira uhagarariye ubudage avuga batewe ubwoba kuba amatora agiye kuba gihe cy’icyorezo cyugarije isi akavuga u burundi bukwiye gufashwa n’amahanga kugira hataba ingaruka zitewe nacyo matora asaba leta y’u burundi nayo gukorana neza omswho n’indi miryango nterankunga kubahiriza amabwiriza gufasha kurwanya cyorezo

title: amateka ubutwari n’ibigwi byaranze fred gisa rwigema umwe ntwari zabayeho rwanda
content: gisa fred rwigema intwari rwego rw’imanzi rumwe nzego eshatu z’intwari z’u rwanda izo nzego eshatu imena imanzi n’ingenzi urwego rw’imanzi narwo fred gisa rwigema arimo rushyirwamo abantu baranzwe n’ibikorwa by’ubutwari bihebuje kandi bakaba batakiriho bakaba baratabarutse bitangira igihugu ibi bikorwa birimo kugaragaza ubwitange batizigama kwigomwa inyungu bwite hashyirwa imbere inyungu z’igihugu zifitiye akamaro gahebuje imibereho rusange y’abanyarwanda ubu turi cyumweru cyahariwe kuzirikana intwari z’igihugu kibanziriza umunsi w’intwari nyirizina uba buri mwaka tariki mbere gashyantare kubera ubutwari kwitanga fred gisa rwigema yaguye rugamba ayoboye kubohora u rwanda itariki ukwakira umugaba w’ingabo rpf inkotanyi rwanda patriotic army-inkotanyi yaguye rugamba kubohora u rwanda yatangije ariko ntarusoze n’ubwo abamusimbuye batigeze bamutenguha tariki ukwakira umunsi utazibagirana w’itangizwa ry’uru rugamba kwibohora tariki ukwakira umunsi fred gisa rwigema atabarutseho yaguye i kagitumba karere nyagatare ntara y’uburasirazuba gisa fred rwigema yavukiye i ruyumba tariki mata yavukiye murenge nyamiyaga ho karere kamonyi ntara y’amajyepfo yabyawe anastase kimonyo gatarina mukandirima ahabwa amazina emmanuel gisa yashakanye jeanette urujeni bakora ubukwe tariki kamena nyuma babyarana abana babiri umuhungu n’umukobwa bakaba gisa junior gisa tetaintambara n’imyivumbagatanyo yabaye rwanda mwaka w’ yaranzwe gutoteza kwica abatutsi ndetse anastase kimonyo se gisa fred rwigema aratotezwa aranafungwa amara umwaka wose gereza nyuma y’uko mubyeyi afunguwe umuryango wabanje guhungira paruwasi gaturika kamonyi nyuma bikomeje kuba bibi bahungira gihugu uganda yakuriye bakigera uganda babanje kuba nkambi y’impunzi ankole nyuma mwaka w’ bimurirwa nkambi kankunge gace kitwa toro kumwe n’izindi mpunzi z’abanyarwanda barahunze intambara gutotezwa kwarangwaga rwanda gihe akigera nkambi fred gisa rwigema yahise atangira amashuri abanza ayarangiza mwaka w’ kuva bwana bwe fred gisa rwigema ntiyumvaga neza impamvu ituma ababyeyi n’umuryango rusange bahunze ndetse yahoraga anababaza impamvu badataha bajye kuba iwabo rwanda bave buhunzi ariko bakamubwira rwanda bitoroshye kuko n’abashatse gutahuka bahuye n’akaga gakomeye karimo gutakaza ubuzima bwabo fred gisa rwigema yakundaga akarasisi gisirikare cyane bigatera umuryango impungenge cyane cyane nyina gatarina mukandirima kuko gukunda ibijyanye n’abasirikare cyane byatumaga bacyeka bishobora kuzamuviramo kureka amashuri akigira gisirikare arangije amashuri abanza mwaka w’ yahise akomereza mashuri yisumbuye yatangiye kigo cyitwa mbarara high school ankore n’ubwo akiri umwana yahoranaga inyota kumenya amateka y’u rwanda kandi yakundaga kuganiriza abantu bakuru nabo barahunze bava rwanda batuye y’ishuri akababaza amateka y’u rwanda mu bantu bakomeye gisa fred rwigema yahuriye nabo mashuri ndetse bakaba inshuti zikomeye bagatandukanywa n’urupfu harimo paul kagame wabaye perezida w’u rwanda kugeza n’ubu amateka y’u rwanda n’ay’ibijyanye kubohora u rwanda ntiwayavuga utibanze cyane nshuti buto zaje kuba icyomoro cyomoye imitima y’abanyarwanda benshi dore imitekerereze gukunda igisirikare kwitanga kwanga akarengane ibintu bahuje cyane biganaga bombi baragendanaga kenshi bagasura abakuru bazi amateka y’u rwanda bagahora bafite inyota kurushaho kumenya igihugu cyabo cy’amavuko kandi title: amakosa abantu bakunze gukora mugitondo bigatuma birirwana umunabi icyo wakora
content: hari igihe umuntu ava buriri akiriranwa umushiha kandi atazi neza icyawumuteye n’ikibazo kimwe afite munsi ubushakashatsi bwerekanye akenshi biterwa n’amakosa dukora buri gitondo kandi bamwe bakayakora batayazi tugiye kurebera hamwe amakosa agera wakirinda buri gitondo bigatuma wiriranwa akanyamuneza kuko ibyishimo guseka aribyo soko kuramba kugera munezero w’ubuzima tubayemo gukangurwa n’inzogera isaha reveille abantu benshi bahitamo gukangurwa n’isaha cyane cyane bashyira matelefoni ikagenda ivuga buri minota bitewe isaha kubyukiraho umubiri uba utarayimenyera iki ikintu kibi cyane kinaniza umubiri umunsi wose ahubwo abahanga batubwira umuntu yagombye kumenyereza umubiri igihe kubyukiraho buri munsi kuguma kizima bwacyeye abantu bamwe bahitamo kwijimisha icyumba baryamamo bashyiramo amarido yijimye kugirango urumuri rw’umucyo gitondo rutaza kubakangura ibi sibyo kuko ukuvuna umubiri wacu kandi uba ukeneneye ruriya rumuri gitondo kubyuka vuba vuba igihe ukangutse iri rimwe makosa ananiza umubiri umunsi wose igihe ukangutse ugahita ubaduka vuba bwangu bituma amaraso yirukanyira maguru bikaba byanagutera umuvuduko w’amaraso ukabije isereri n’ibindi tugirwa inama kubanza kwicara buriri gato ukabanza ugatekereza ugiye gukora kunanura umubiri kudakora imyitozo ngororamubiri siporo gitondo niyo iruta izindi twakora yandi masaha y’umunsi kuko ariyo ituma umuntu atiyongera ibiro yiboneye iyi myitozo yoroheje ikorwa igihe uvuye buriri ituma umuntu yiriranwa akanyamuneza umunsi wose kutoza amenyo iri ikosa rikorwa n’abantu batari benshi ariko rikomeye cyane kuko ubyutse ntusukure amenyo wiriranwa uburyaryate kanwa butuma umubiri wirirwa wumva utameze neza koza amenyo ukimara kunywa ibintu byifitemo acide iri ikosa rikorwa n’abantu benshi bamaze gufata ifunguro gitondopetit dejeunner ku bakoresha ikawa amazi arimo indimu n’ibindi biribwa birimo acide ifunguro gitondo bagirwa inama bajya basukura amenyo nyuma nibura y’iminota mirongo ine nyuma y’uko bafata iryo funguro kwihutira kubyukira byuma by’ikoranabuhanga iri ikosa rikorwa n’abantu benshi bitewe n’umuvuduko w’iterambere isi yacu igezemo ariko rimwe makosa akomeye ananiza umubiri wacu harimo kubyukira ako kanya telefoni usoma ubutumwa bugufi mbuga nkoranyambaga mashini y’akazi ukiva buriri ahubwo bushakashatsi bugira inama abantu bagomba kubanza kwitegura umunsi ukabikora aruko kuko akenshi hari igihe umunsi ukwiriraho kintu kimwe ukoze gifatika ubishoboye byuka wandike gapapuro gahunda yawe y’umunsi kubyuka utekereza ibibazo ufite uyu umwitozo twese dusabwa gukora buri title: maj gen ruvusha yaburiye abayobozi biremereza abaturage babatinye
content: umuyobozi w’ingabo ntara y’amajyepfo major general emmanuel ruvusha yasabye abayobozi gukunda bayobora bagaharanira babubaha kubatinya nk’uko bijya bigenda bamwe yabigarutseho gatanu yitabiriye inama mpuzabikorwa karere gisagara yahuje abayobozi rwego rw’umudugudu kugeza karere muri nama hasuzumiwemo abayobozi bageze bafatanya n’abaturage gukemura ibibazo bihari cyane cyane ibibangamiye imibereho myiza y’abaturage gen ruvusha yagarutse myitwarire ikwiye kuranga umuyobozi mwiza asaba abayobozi kubyitaho ati iyo umuyobozi ukigangarika burya uyobora ntabwo bakubaha ahubwo bagutinya muyobozi haranira uyobora bakubaha kugutinya kuko byanze bikunze ninicisha bugufi imbere yawe uzanyubaha kandi nanjye nkubahe ariko ninza nareze igituza njyewe ndi jenerali nca ibiti n’amabuye cyangwa ndi gitifu cyangwa ndi meya gihe ntabwo uzanyubaha ahubwo uzantinya bivuze n’imikoranire hagati yanjye ntabwo izaba iryoshye kuko ngutinya yabasabye gufata abaturage bayobora nk’abana yibutsa umubyeyi afata umwana amwitura ati reka ntange urugero duhere bana bacu burya umwana ubyaye urukundo umuhaye akwitura uzarebe rugo hari ushobora gusanga abana bakunda nyina kurusha se kuyobora neza gukemura ibibazo bihari buryo burambye ati uko guca bugufi ukajya muturage ukinjira nzu ukarya ibijumba ukabisangira ibintu bikomeye cyane kintu twese dukwiye kucyigiraho kwegera tuyobora kandi tubacira bugufi yabagiriye inama kugira umuco gusaba imbabazi igihe bakosheje kandi bakikosora ati wanabakosereza ukabasaba imbabazi hari ijambo rigufi rigira inyuguti enye gusa ryitwa title: aline gahongayire yihagazeho asaba imbabazi nyuma y’amagambo atari meza aherutse kuvuga itangazamakuru
content: aline gahongayire wavuze itangazamakuru ryo rwanda ritari rwego rwe yahinduye imvugo avuga aramutse arisuzuguye yaba yisuzuguye kuko arikoramo ni nyuma y’uko muhanzikazi yishongoye itangazamakuru ryo rwanda yabigaragarije buhamya yatanze gikorwa cyiswe ’because there is hope’ akavuga yatangarije itandukana rye n’umugabo radiyo ijwi ry’amerika kuko cyiciro kimwe itangazamakuru ryo rwanda riri hasi icyo gihe yagize bakambaza bati aline nyuma y’ibyakubayeho uzarongorwa gute ntarongorwa se nabibajijwe hehe radio ijwi ry’amerika bati se ubundi gahongayire avuga kirundi tubwire uburyo nti njye twaratandukanye n’umusore yunzemo njye nari kubivugira radiyo hano ntibishoboka ijwi ry’amerika bakajya bavuga abanyamakuru rwanda bitangazwa n’ijwi amerika nyine nari ndiyo i washington dc ntabwo nari hano isango star niyo mpamvu n’ujya kubimbaza tugomba kuba turi rwego rumwe aya magambo yababaje cyane abanyamakuru n’abandi barikurikira bashinja mugore kwihenura ubwibone n’ubwirasi abandi bemeza afite ihungabana yatewe kubyara agapfusha kunanirwa n’urushako n’ibindi byinshi abantu batandukanye barimo n’umunyamabanga leta minisiteri y’ububanyi n’amahanga amb olivier nduhungirehe bagaragaje wiyita umukozi w’imana adakwiye kuvuga itangazamakuru ryo rwanda riciriritse mu kiganiro yagiranye kiss fm igitangazamakuru avuga babanye gihe kitoroshye yavuze gusugura itangazamakuru bishobora kumugiraho ingaruka kuko yaba kwisuzugura ati ngiye gusuzugura itangazamakuru njye mbere naba ndi kwisuzuguza ntabwo nasuzugura itangazamakuru ntabwo nanga itangazamakuru heza nk’iwacu ibyo kwirata yavugiye radio ijwi ry’amerika gahongayire yabigereranyije kwishimira intambwe yateye kuvugira radiyo ikomeye aboneraho gusaba imbabazi ababyumvise nabi ati uwaba yarabyumvise nabi yaba umunyarwanda yaba umunyamakuru ambabarire nubwo yasabye imbabazi ariko aline gahongayire yihagazeho avuga cyaha yishinja mutima ahubwo ikibazo gifitwe n’abumvise nabi yavuze ati nta kintu kimwe umutima unshinja reka nkubwire ahantu hari ikibazo hari uburyo kuvuga hari n’uburyo kumva uburyo antoinette umunyamakuru n’uburyo njye mbyumva biratandukanye uburyo bw’imyumvire y’abantu nibwo bushobora kuba bwarakomeretse ariko njyewe nyir’ukuvuga navuze nkanjye kuva gihe yikomwe n’abantu batandukanye kugeza n’ubu aline gahongayire yaranze kugira avuga kibazonone yemeye kuvugana radiyo kiss fm avuga gitangazamakuru rukumbi kitigeze kimuvaho bibazo afite yanditswe habarurema djamali

content: iki gitaramo cyateguwe skol cyabereye club universitaire kikaba kandi cyari kinagamije kumenyekanisha nzoga skol kubatari bwakayimenyeuhagarariye skol karere huye nyaruguru nyamagabe maniragaba dieudonn yatangaje bateguye gitaramo kugirango nakire abanyeshuri bashya kaminuza iki gitaramo cyahuriranye n’isozwa ry’ibizamini leta mashuri yisumbuye bibam akarusho usibye ibibazo bijyanye n’ibyuma muzika byagiye bigaragara ubundi abanyeshuri n’abandi bitabiriye gitaramo batangaje baryohewe cyane n’ibyo bateguriwe birimo igabanyirizwa ry’ibiciro skol nini n’intoya tombora ndetse n’umuziki ugezweho dieudonn aravuga ubwitabire yabonye bwari buhagije kuko gikorwa kitanateguwe igihe kinini kuri habonetse abantu atakekaga kandi n’ibinyobwa bye bikaba byaguzwe bihagije ikirutaho akaba yabashije gushimisha abantu akahava atagawe abaturage n’abanyeshuri mujyi huye bitabiriye gitaramo barasaba ibitaramo nk’ibi byajya bibageraho kenshi theogne umwe bitabiriye gitaramo yagize abahatuye tutakidagadura kandi bitaramo bizajya binafasha huye kwivugurura kuko kuvugurura si ukubaka gusa dieudonn aratangaza ibitaramo nk’ibi biteganyijwe aka gace byinshi kandi gihe kitarambiranye ngo bizajya biba birimo tombora nyinshi kuruta izari zirimo joro akaba ahamagarira abantu kuzajya babyitabira benshi iki gitaramo cyatangiye saa kumi n’ebyiri z’umugoroba kikarangira gitondo gatandatu cyitabiriwe n’abantu hagati kwinjira byari amafaranga ugahabwa skol ntoya y’ubuntu muryngo ibihembo byatanzwe tombora byari imipira kwambara amakarito y’ibirahure y’inzoga n’ibirahuri skol clarisse umuhire

title: nzeyimana isidore yahimbye ishyiga kijyambere tekutangije
content: iyo mbabura ishobora guteka ibintu byinshi inshuro ibiryo mashyiga inyotse ziba zashyizwe ifuru ndetse n’amazi umuntu ashobora gushyushya gasiterine uretse kuba tekutangije ishobora guteka ibintu bitandukanye icyarimwe ifite akarusho kurondereza inkwi tekutangije ifite amashyiga abiri kandi buri shyiga rifite bashyira inkwi hagati y’amashyiga hari ifuru inyuma y’ibyo byose hakaba agasiterine gashyushya amazi nyezimana sobanura buri shyiga rijyamo ingeri sentimetero yemeza ingeri esheshatu zigahisha inkono enye ebyiri mashyiga ifuru siterine ikindi cyiza tekutangije umutetsi aticwa n’imyotsi kuko ifite uruhombo rurerure rujyana umwotsi kure akandi karusho shyiga riba riri kumwe n’ubwogerezo bumwe cyangwa bubiri lavabos bitewe n’icyifuzo cy’uyishaka hamwe n’ameza guteguriraho guteka ibyo byose imbabura n’ibiyiherekeje bikoze aluminium nzeyimana asobanura amashyiga akora arimo ibyiciro bitatu bitewe n’ingano y’amazi ashobora gushyushya irinini rishobora gushyushya litiro rikaba rigura hagati irikurikiyeho rishobora gushyushya litiro rikagura hagati y’amafaranga iritoya rishobora gushyushya litiro rikaba rigura hagati y’amafaranga uretse tekutangije nzeyimana isidore akora muvero zifashishwa gutekera abanyeshuri shodiyeri chaudire zikora vaperi vapeurs n’ibindi intego ukurengera ibidukikije nzayimana umwe bitabiriye ibiganiro bushakashatsi mpuzamahanga gukoresha ingufu tubungabunga ibidukikije yateguwe kaminuza nkuru y’u rwanda iherereye karere huye ibi biganiro byatangiye tariki bikazarangira tariki ugushyingo kakunze alfred

title: rubavu abifotoza bashaka indangamuntu baranenga serivisi mbi bahabwa
content: bamwe baturage karere rubavu bavuga abashinzwe irangamimere mirenge bahawe inshingano gufasha abakeneye indangamuntu batabashije kuzuza neza inshingano icyo bashingiraho nu babwira abaturage bafite akazi kenshi bikadindiza imitangire serivisi basaba umurenge gisenyi karere rubavu ukaba umwe mirenge gihugu hose yatoranijwe n’ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe indangamuntu kugira hatangirwe serivisi gufotora abakeneye indangamuntu zegerejwe iyi serivisi ikaba yarashinzwe abakozi bafite nshingano irangamimirere murenge abaturage bakenera serivisi cyane cyane abanyeshuri bavuga bafite ikibazo guhabwa serivisi mbi n’aba bakozi bitewe n’uko bababwira bafite inshingano nyinshi nambajemariya sarah karere rubavu yagize twaje saa kumi n’ebyiri twategereje ariko ntacyo baradukorera bigeze saa tatu turifuza baduha serivisi neza tukajya ishuri tuyishime jean norbert twageze hano gitondo saa kumi n’ebyiri ariko twasanze serivisi zikiri hasiharacyarimo agatotsi ukuntu kuko nk’aha kuba bamaze kudufotora gukorera n’abandi kandi baduha umunsi umwe cyumweru ubwashize byarapfuye n’uyu munsi bigapfa urumva amasomo arikuducika uwase joselyne avuga kuba badahabwa serivisi zihuse bituma bakererwa amasomo ati twarituje kwifotoza abandi baje kwireba irangamimerereariko ntacyo badukorera kandi hari abahageze saa kumi n’ebyiri mpamaze amasaha kudukereza twataye amasomo abandi kwiga amasomo urumva birababaje umukozi ushinzwe irangamimerere murenge gisenyi ndagijimana sebunyenyeri aganira rba dukesha nkuru avuga akazi kenshi bagira akazi gukemura ibibazo by’abaturage serivisi zose z’irangamimirere n’ibindi bikorwa bitegurwa mirenge bakaba baranongerewe n’izi nshingano gufotora ntibiborohera gutanga serivisi nziza bikwiye baturage baturutse karere yagize dukurikije akazi dufite ntabwo kaba koroshye akazi kenshi cyane none akaba umurenge umwe ufotora baturage b’akarere rubavu kose umurenge umwe ufotora ntabwo biba byoroshye bibaye byiza hakiyongeraho murenge byaba byiza
