title: ibirori by’imideli gakondo bizahuza bihugu birindwi
content: muri mwaka ibirori kurimba rwanda cultural fashion show’ byabaye bice bibiri icya mbere cyabaye itariki gicurasi cyari umusogongero kwerekana ibirori nyamukuru kuwa nzeri bizaba biteguwe ibirori nyir’izina bizabera sports view hotel i remera kuwa nzeri bizahuriza hamwe abahanzi b’imideli fashion designers bazava bihugu birindwi birimo rwanda kenya leta zunze ubumwe amerika repubulika iharanira demokarasi congotanzania nigeria uganda abahanzi b’imideli bazerekana ubwoko bw’imideli bugera cumi bubiri byiciro byose haba myambaro y’abagore n’iy’abagabo muri bahanzi b’imideli bitezwe rwanda cultural fashion show harimo batandatu rwanda gusa abandi bazaturuka hanze y’igihugu abo rwanda barimo augustin hakizima azerekana rwanda hambere bambaraga umurerwa jossete inzovu village african print batik odette sch ltd mutuyeyezu marie paule ns creationsni abahanzi bakizamuka bibumbiye hamwe kenya izaba ihagarariwe vinn clizz uzerekana imyenda abagabo barimbana ndetse tanzania izaba ifitemo umwe witwa hameed abdul ugiye kuza rwanda nshuro kabiri igihugu uganda kizaba gihagarariwe robinah u bazerekana ibyiganjemo imirimbo igezweho n’imyambaro y’abana muri leta zunze ubumwe amerika hazaza uwitwa nancy zeller anne dickson nigeria patricia kinga rdc uzerekana imyenda ikunze kwifashishwa birori by’ubukwe mu gutegura rwanda cultural fashion show izaba kuwa nzeri ntawirema celestin umuyobozi w’igikorwa avuga yabanje gukora ingendoshuri bindi bihugu yigira bandi bategura ibikorwa nk’ibi ati igikorwa kirihariye kuko nakoze ingendoshuri bindi bihugu nigira bandi nagiye dubai fashion week singapore hong kong hose narebye ukuntu bakora mu gikorwa twateguye nagerageje gufata abahanga imideli fashion designers b’abahanga bazerekana ibintu bizima ikindi tuzakora ibintu biri murongo yongeraho muri rusange abantu bakwitega bizaba byiza cyane kuko bazabasha kubona imyenda myinshi kandi myiza uburyo kwicara buzaba bumeze neza kuko buri tike izaba irimo kunywa ikindi n’umuntu uzazana n’umuryango twabateganyirije uburyo abantu bane bazicarana ahantu hamwe kandi bakabona kunywa abanyamideli baziyerekana birori harimo bane bazaturuka kenya n’abandi babiri bazava tanzania abasigaye abasanzwe bakora mwuga barimo n’abashya rwanda mu myaka ine ishize atangije rwanda cultural fashion show amaze kuzamura abanyamideli barenga ijana ndetse avuga ashakisha uburyo yabageza rwego mpuzamahanga amafoto y’ibirori by’umusogongero rwanda cultural fashion show byabaye gicurasi amafoto y’umwihariko udasanzwe birori by’imideli y’ibwami ntawirema aherutse gutegura i musanze

content: mu rwandiko perezida w’u bufaransa cyumweru dushoje emmanuel macron yagejeje baturage b’igihugu cye arasaba hategurwa ibiganiro bitandukanye bijyanye n’ibibazo by’igihugu cye byanabaye intandaro y’imyigaragambyo imaze igihe iba ni ibiganiro bizamara ibyumweru umunani kandi bizategurwa gihugu hose iyi myigaragambyo yatangiye tariki ugushyingo gihe gito imaze gukomerekeramo abasaga ijana barimo abashinzwe umutekano abigaragambya bufaransa bariye karungu intego kwari ugusaba umusoro uhanitse bikomoka peteroli ugabanywa perezida macron yazamuye musoro avuga ugamije gukomeza kurengera ibidukikije icyateye benshi uburakari umwanzuro kongera misoro ho modoka zikoresha mazutu zikoresha lisansi ntangiriro zuyu mwaka ni imyigaragambyo yitabiriwe n’abantu bakabakaba nk’uko ijwi amerika dukesha nkuru bitangaje bimwe bibazo yiteguye kuganiraho nabafaransa ibyerekeye imisoro amatagisi ahantu leta ikwiye kwibanda gushyira amafaranga ibidukikije ndetsen’ikibazo cy’abimukira n’ubwo muyobozi avuga gutya ariko ikibazo cyerekeye uburenganzira bw’abimukira basaba ubwenegihugu bw’u bufaransa ntikizagarukwaho cyane biganiro

title: kigali serena hotel nyungwe forest lodge hoteli zifite inyenyeri rwanda
content: mu gikorwa gutangaza uru rutonde cyabereye serena hotel i kigali tariki amahoteli yahawe inyenyeri zitandukanye eshanu hejuru kugera nyenyeri hagendewe ibipimo afurika y’iburasirazuba urwo rutonde ruvuga the manor lemigo mille collines lake kivu serena ziri gice cy’amahoteli afite inyenyeri enye top tower alpha palace virunga musanze amwe hoteli arindwi kigero cy’amahoteli afite inyenyeri eshatu amahoteli niyo yahawe inyenyeri ebyiri relay’s gorilla hoteli niyo yonyine yahawe inyenyeri igenzura n’ishirwa rutonde rw’amahoteli byakozwe n’ikipe y’impuguke by’amahoteri igizwe n’abakozi leta abacuruzi rwanda hamwe n’impuguke karere k’afurika y’iburasirazuba rica rwigamba ushinzwe ubukerarugendo n’ibidukikije rdb yasobanuye isuku umutekano gushimisha umurava kwakira abantu ndetse n’ingano y’ibyumba biri ingingo zakurikijwe gutanga nyenyeri rwigamba yavuze amahoteli atarashyizwe rutonde adahejwe kuko bazayashyiraho nyuma kuzuza ibyangombwa bayasabye birimo kuvugura inyubako yabijeje bazajya rutonde tw’ubutaha perezida w’amahoteli utubari n’amarestora denis karera yasobanuye inyenyeri zirutanwa ubukuru bw’amahoteli burutanwa yabigereranyije n’inyenyeri gisirikare umusirikare yongerwa inyenyeri bitewe n’ibikorwa byiza yakoze monique mukaruliza ministiri ushinzwe ibikorwa by’afurika y’iburasirazuba umushyitsi mukuru yavuze leta y’u rwanda ishyigikiye igikorwa guteza imbere amahoteli rwanda kuko ariyo nkingi y’ubukerarugendo yagize amahoteli soko y’ifaranga ryo hanze rituma amafaranga y’u rwanda agira igihagararo cyiza minisitiri mukaruliza yasobanuye ishyirwa rutonde ry’amahoteli rwanda hakurikijwe ibipimo by’afurika y’iburasirazuba birushaho guha amahoteli nyarwanda uburyo kumenyekana rwego rw’isi john gara umuyobozi w’ikigo cy’igihugu cy’iterambere rdb yavuze gutanga uru rutonde bizatuma amahoteli ahorana ishyaka ryo kunoza serivisi kugira azamuke ntera kandi n’abashyitsi bazajya babasha guhitamo ihoteli bitewe n’urwego bashaka mu byishimo byinshi afite jean luc ushinzwe imurikagurisha nyungwe forest lodge yavuze adatunguwe kuba bahawe inyenyeri eshanu yabivuze magambo twigisha abakozi bacu bihagije kandi tukanakora bwabaga gutanga serivisi nziza buri gace kose kagize nyungwe forest lodge nshimiyimana barthazar nyiri virunga hotel yahawe inyenyeri eshatu yavuze leta y’u rwanda yaramufashije cyane kuzamura serivisi hoteli ahiga mugaragaro agiye kuzamura serivisi ze kugira ubutaha azahabwe inyenyeri enye itangwa ry’inyenyeri ubwa mbere ribaye rwanda akaba n’ubwa kabari afurika y’iburasirazuba kuko tanzania iherutse gukora igikorwa nk’iki jovani ntabgoba

title: menya amagambo meza udakwiye kwibagirwa kubwira umukunzi wawe buri munsi
content: urukundo nk’ubusitani bw’indabo bukeneye kubagarirwa kuhirwa buri munsi kubaka urukundo uguhozaho mpamvu hari amagambo make ushobora gohora ubwira umukunzi wawe akarushaho kugukunda kukwiyumvamo iyemeze igihe cyose uzaba ufite ukunda yaba umuhungu cyangwa umukobwa uzajya umubwira amagambo akurikira bizatuma igihe cyose muzaba kumwe bibanyura mwembi ndagukunda iri jambo ijambo ryoroshye kandi rikwiye kubwira umukunzi wawe gerageza kujya uribwira umukunzi wawe igihe agusekeje cyangwa igihe akoze ikintu cyikwibutsa impamvu kumwe nari ndi kugutekereza ni byiza kubwira umukunzi wawe uba umutekereza n’iyo tari kumwe nubona ikintu kigushimishije munsi kimumenyeshe wiriwe ute imenyereze kubaza umukunzi wawe ibibazo ahura nabyo kazi ke buri munsi mubaze mugenzi bakorana batumvikana cyangwa akazi gakomeye yakoze munsi umuhe umwanya akugezeho ibyifuzo bye nifatanyije humuiza umukunzi wawe umwereka utamuri kure akora kandi ushyigikiye ibyemezo bye mubwire umuri unamwereke mpamvu wamuhisemo mbabarira buri muntu akosa gihe runaka buryo rimwe rimwe twisanga tutari twakoze ibidatunganye impaka mwanya zikwiye guhabwa rukundo rero saba imbabazi igihe ukosheje saba imbabazi z’uko wababaje umukunzi wawe saba imbabazi yewe n’iyo yaba atari ikosa ryaguturutseho ntawe musa umukunzi wawe bisaba inshuti magara yaweniba utifuza gutemberana ntibyagakwiye mugirana title: buravan michal sengazi herv kimenyi bazifashishwa kwezi kwizihiza imyaka oif imaze
content: ni igikorwa cyatangiye nk’uburyo abari muryango oif uhurije hamwe abaturage bavuga igifaransa basaga miliyoni isi bakwishimira ururimi rw’igifaransa rukoreshwa byinshi kuri nshuro mwaka birihariye cyane cyane ambasade y’u bufaransa rwanda ku rwego mpuzamahanga ho hazaba hizihizwa imyaka muryango oif umaze utangijwe iki gikorwa kizabera rwanda bufatanye n’ibigo leta bitandukanye birimo minisiteri y’ububanyi n’amahanga ndetse n’iy’uburezi abadipolomate bahagarariye ibihugu bigize muryango n’abandi bayobora oif muri werurwe hateganyijwe ibikorwa bitandukanye mujyi kigali ndangamuco cy’abafaransa rwanda bazagirana ikiganiro n’itangazamakuru werurwe saa tanu gitondo onomo hotel ibindi bikorwa biteganyijwe harimo igitaramo cy’umuhanzi yvan buravan wegukanye prix dcouverte rfi kizabera serena hotel werurwe guhera saa mbili z’umugoroba kwinjira bizaba ubuntu ikigo ndangamuco cy’abafaransa rwanda cyateguwe n’igikorwa cy’amarushanwa kizahuza abanyempano kuvuga imivugo by’umwihariko rurimi rw’igifaransa kizabera nzu y’imyidagaduro kimisagara werurwe hagamijwe kuzamura impano nshya uzaba uwa mbere umuvugo uzatunganywa werekanwe gitaramo buravan hateganyijwe title: abakozi batsinda leta yabishyuye miliyoni itsindira ebyiri
content: raporo komisiyo ishinzwe abakozi leta igaragaza igihombo leta itezwa n’abayobozi bafata ibyemezo bidakurikije amategeko bigatuma abakozi bagana inkiko muri raporo - manza yatsinzemo ebyiri kwirukana abakozi buryo bunyuranyije n’amategeko gusesa amasezerano y’akazi buryo bunyuranyije n’amategeko kudahembera umwanya w’ubusigire guhagarika umushahara w’umukozi cyemezo cy’umuyobozi ubifitiye ububasha gishingiweho kudaha abakozi bemererwa n’amategeko gihe gufatira abakozi ibyemezo bitubahirije amategeko cyangwa ibyemezo bishingiye mategeko atabagenga kudatanga icyemezo cy’imirimo title: perezida kagame yavuze uganda yamusabye abanyarwanda basubukurayo ingendo akabyanga
content: mu ntangiriro z’uku kwezi nibwo uganda yarekuye abanyarwanda icyenda magana y’abari bafungiye butaka bwayo barimo abari bamaze imyaka igera ibiri bafunzwe byaha bigaragara bashinjwa ahubwo inama abaturage barwo guhagarika ingendo zijya uganda kuko umutekano wabo utizewe kuri gatatu perezida kagame yakiraga meza abahagarariye ibihugu byabo n’imiryango mpuzamahanga rwanda anabifuriza umwaka mushya yavuze uganda iherutse kumusaba kubwira abanyarwanda bakongera gutemberera gihugu yavuze uganda yabihereye banyarwanda icyenda imaze kurekura n’abandi bake barekuwe mbere ikumva yahita abwira abanyarwanda basubire gukorera ingendo uganda bisanzuye ati bahise bambwira bati mukwiriye kugira mukora ngo mubwire abanyarwanda baze uganda uwabimbwiraga naramubwiye nti kibazo ariko se nindamuka mbyemeye munsi n’ejo n’ejo bundi abanyarwanda bakongera bagafungwa n’abafunzwe mbere batararekurwa yakomeje agira murumva nzasubira kubwira abanyarwanda narababeshye nimwongere muhagarike title: kayonzanyamirama abahembwa badakora bafite ubwoba kuzaryozwa n’ibyo batariye
content: mu karere kayonza umurenge nyamirama hari abakozi bamaze umwaka urenga bahembwa buri kwezi ntacyo bakoze ariko amenshi bahembwa bahita bayasubiza umujyanama w’ubuhinzi ubabwira goronome rab yayamutumye iki gisa n’umukino watangiye mpera buryo bakozi bamaze guhembwa buri umwe nibura amezi nyamara bivugira imibyizi bamaze gukora itarenga umunani amafaranga bahemberwa sacco abanzumugayo nyamirama hagati y’ibihumbi buri umwe kwezi buryo nibura buri umwe amaze gufata agera bihumbi gusa igitangaje babanje kubwirwa ayabo ibihumbi bine nyuma bitanu andi bayaha umujyanama w’ubuhinzi uvuga ayashyiriye goronome rab umwe bakozi aragira twategereje batwereka akazi dukora turaheba ahubwo batubwira amafranga yageze konti zacu mbere y’uko akazi gatangira baduhembye mbere ubwoba buradutaha bamwe barayatinya abandi barayafata gusa njye nyamuha umutima udiha bazantereza akadugudu nituriyemo uyu mushinga watangiye nzeri hakorwa itsinda ry’abahinzi rizakora mirima y’ubushakashatsi babwiwe bagombaga gutubura ibihingwa birimo imyumbati soya ibigori n’ibishyimbo itsinda rimaze kujyaho ryatoye ubuyobozi bukuriwe mwarimu nyirishema jean uyu yaje kunanizwa kuko yatowe abakuriye umushinga batamushaka bifuza hayobora mujyanama w’ubuhinzi singirankabo timoteyo uyu wagombaga kuba intumwa nziza ibageza mugambi guhemba abadakora barangiza bagasubiza amenshi bahembwe bidasakuje niko byagenze amabwiriza akajya acishwa singirankabo nyirishema agera yegura uyu musaza w’imyaka agira ntangiriro nijye abaturage batoye nyuma barabivangavanga nyuma nagiye ntara kubaza umufashamyumvire rab yaraduhaye arambwira baransimbuje nawe yemeza bahembwaga badakora ariko nyuma bitangiye kumenyekana bafashe umurima w’umwe bahinzi bakajya bawukoramo rimwe kwezi bagahembwa ibihumbi bine andi bakayasubiza uyu mushinga bivugwa ukorera turere twa kayonza ngoma kirehe ntara y’uburasirazuba amakuru abahinzi bahabwa kayonza ukorera mirenge mukarange ndego murama rukara ndetse nyamirama singirankabo timoteyo babwira mafaranga yaka yayatumwe goronome ukuriye mushinga ntara uyu mugoronome uvugwa kandi abaturage bamuzi isura ariko ntibazi amazina bagira bati ni umugabo ukunda kuza modoka rab ntituzi amazina telefoni izwi timoteyo bavugana twamubajije impamvu baduhemba amafaranga tukayasubiza atubwira kujya guhemba bagenzi ndego murama mukarange urugero rw’umwe bagize tsinda avuga amaze guhembwa amezi agera icumi nyamara ahamya yakoze imibyizi itarenga itanu muri mezi yahembwe ibihumbi yakoreshejemo ibihumbi andi arayasubiza nta masezerano y’akazi bagira gipande kihaba uwaje n’uwasibye bahembwa kimwe kandi udafite umwanya ashobora kohereza umusimbura umwana umugore umugabo cyangwa umikozi hari inzego zitazi iby’iri tsinda timoteyo avuga rikora umuyobozi w’iri tsinda bavuga abaka amafaranga bahembwe ababwira ayashyiriye goronome yemeza itsinda rimaze imyaka nk’ibiri rikora abarigize bagahemberwa konti zabo sacco ati tumaze imyaaakaaaaaharya buriya ingahe raa-abaza uwari umwegereye nk’ibiri twatangiye turi nyuma umwe aza kuvamo ku munsi umukozi kwezi bahembwa imibyizi timoteyo avuga bipande bagira n’amasezerano imibyizi nyandikia ikayi hanyuma nkazatanga raporo kuru rab bakabahemba dufata umurima w’umwe bagize itsinda tukawuhinga tukamuha imbuto n’ifumbire ubushize twahinze ibishyimbo mwa muberarugo vestine ariko kubera rab iba itakodesheje murima ibivuyemo byose biba ibya nyirawo nyamara nk’uko bamwe baturage babyivugira haje abashyitsi batabazi batambagizwa imirima mwenewabo timoteyo ahitwa mataba bakabwirwa ibigori soya birimo ibya rab byahinzwe n’abo baturage kandi bagabana ibivuyemo ku rwego rw’umurenge nyamirama ariko gahunda bavuga batayizi ku murongo telefoni gitifu nyamirama madame nyirabizeyimana immaculee asubiza aseka kubera gutungurwa content: iyi kompanyi iratangaza gihe hari amakuru atangazwa n’ibitangazamakuru bitandukanye isi avuga intambara ibera kongo ishobora kuba yarahungabanyije umutekano rwanda mu itangazo yashyize title: hatanzwe miliyari y’amapawundi igura n’igurishwa ry’abakinnyi arsenal yasohoye menshi
content: abakinnyi baguzwe munota nyuma premier league batumye mpeshyi hasohorwa miliyari miliyoni z’amapawundi habuze gato akureho umuhigo miliyari miliyoni z’amapawundi yatanzwe yabaye mbere menshi igura n’igurishwa ry’abakinnyi ejo kane umunsi nyuma w’igura n’igurishwa ry’abakinnyi mugabane w’uburayi ku munsi w’ejo wonyine amakipe premier league yasohoye miliyoni z’amapawundi - masezerano y’abakinnyi amasezerano y’abakinnyi bacye gutyo munsi nyuma yaherukaga mpeshyi igurwa rutahizamu alex iwobi everton miliyoni z’amapawundi avuye arsenal ryatumye mukinnyi uhenze uvuye ikipe ajya yindi zombi premier league munsi nyuma kuva manchester united ajya inter milan romelu lukaku miliyoni z’amapawundi - harimo igihombo miliyoni y’amapawundi yaguzwe ava everton - kwatumye mukinnyi wahenze mpeshyi avuye premier league arsenal yasohoye akayabo arsenal yasohoye amafaranga menshi cyane kurusha andi makipe bwongereza kugura abakinnyi mpeshyi - miliyoni z’amapawundi ejo munsi nyuma w’igura n’igurishwa ry’abakinnyi yaguze myugariro kieran tierney miliyoni z’amapawundi imukuye celtic igura myugariro david luiz miliyoni z’amapawundi imuvanye chelsea tottenham yaguze nguzanyo umukinnyi hagati giovani lo celso imukuye real betis ndetse igura n’umukinnyi ruhande ryan sessegnon miliyoni z’amapawundi imuvanye fulham ariko kugambirira kugura rutahizamu paulo dybala imukuye juventus - byari byakomeje kuvugwaho cyane munsi w’ejo tottenham ntabwo yabigezeho watford yasohoye avugwa miliyoni z’amapawundi kugura umukinnyi ruhande ismaila sarr imuvanye rennes - amafaranga mbere menshi iguze umukinnyi leicester yaguze umukinnyi hagati ukina asatira izamu dennis praet bivugwa yaguzwe miliyoni z’amapawundi imuvana sampdoria burnley yaguze nguzanyo umukinnyi hagati danny drinkwater avuye chelsea manchester city igura nguzanyo umunyezamu scott carson avuye derby newcastle yongera kugura rutahizamu andy carroll utari ufite ikipe akinira inkuru bbc

content: mu biganiro yagiranye n’abanyamuhanga tariki nyirabahire yasobanuye ihungabana imihindukire y’imyitwarire imiterere iterwa n’ikintu kibi kibaye muntu bimutunguye avuga ihungabana riterwa jenoside yakorewe abatutsi ritagirwa gusa n’abacitse icumu kuko n’abandi bashobora kurigira kubera babonye bakoze cyangwa bumvise gihe jenoside umunyamabanga w’inama njyanama y’akarere muhanga avuga n’abatarahigwaga bashobora guhura n’ikibazo cy’ihungabana gihe cy’icyunamo yagize umuntu ashobora guhungabana bitewe n’ibyo yabonye bakorera abicwaga yarahetse intumbi cyangwa imirambo cyangwa yaragize uruhare bwicanyi umuntu wagize uruhare kwica abantu cyangwa kandi karengane arangwa kwiheba agahora yicira imanza ndetse agahora yifuza uwamubaza byabaye kugira abashe kubivuga abyikurimo nk’uko nyirabahire yakkomeje abisobanura yongeyeho benshi banyarwanda bahuye n’ihungabana ariko ngero zitandukanye abanyarwanda hanze y’igihugu hari ababa bumva buri munyarwanda wese umwicanyi ikaba byatera ihungabana rikomeye nk’uko umunyamabanga w’inama njyanama y’akarere muhanga abyemeza gerard gitoli mbabazi

title: abahindi bifatanyije n’abanyarwanda kwibuka jenoside y’abatutsi
content: icyo gikorwa kwibuka cyabereye ishuri rikuru bangalore murwamukuru new delhi cyitabirwa n’abantu bagera magana ane nyuma y’urugendo kwibuka umuyobozi uhagarariye u rwanda buhindi williams nkurunziza yavuze jenoside yakorewe abatutsi itazongera ukundi ati twibagiwe ubumuntu duhinduka inyamaswa dutsemba abavandimwe bacu iyi inkovu itari ikwiye kubaho turizeza ibyabaye bizasubira ukundi yatangaje u rwanda ruviriye jenoside rwateye intambwe itangaje ubukungu bw’igihugu bwiyongereye kigereranyo ijana ugereranyije n’imyaka ishize n’ubukene bukagabanuka gipimo ijana myaka itanu ishize iterambere u rwanda rwagezeho rurikesha perezida paul kagame nyuma kuyobohoza u rwanda agahagarika jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mwaka yahitanye ubuzima bw’inzirakarengane zisaga miliyoni nk’uko nkurunziza akomeza abitangaza ibikorwa nk’ibyo kwibuka byabereye kandi n’i pune salem kuri cyumweru tariki biteganyijwe abanyarwanda bagera i chidambaram coimbatore bangalore nabo baza kwibuka jenoside yakorewe abatutsi nshimiyimana leonard

title: harateganywa ubushakashatsi dukingirizo tuberanye n’ingimbi

title: umwaka ibyemezo by’inama y’abaminisitiri iyobowe perezida kagame
content: ku kabiri tariki mutarama inama y’abaminisitiri idasanzwe yateraniye village urugwiro iyobowe perezida repubulika paul kagame inama y’abaminisitiri yemeje imyanzuro y’inama y’abaminisitiri itariki ugushyingo ashingiye bubasha ahabwa n’amategeko nyakubahwa perezida repubulika yamenyesheje inama y’abaminisitiri yahaye imbabazi abana bafungiye gereza nyagatare bitwaye neza kandi batsinze neza ibizamini leta inama y’abaminisitiri yemeje itangwa ry’impushya gushakisha gucukura amabuye y’agaciro kariyeri inama y’abaminisitiri yemeje imishinga y’amategeko ikurikira umushinga w’itegeko rihindura itegeko n ryo rigena ingengo y’imari leta y’umwaka umushinga w’itegeko ryemera kwemeza burundu amasezerano y’iyinjizwa ry’u rwanda africa finance corporation yashyizweho umukono kamena hagati africa finance corporation leta y’u rwanda umushinga w’itegeko ryemera kwemeza burundu amasezerano hagati guverinoma y’u rwanda guverinoma y’uburusiya bufatanye kubaka ikigo cy’ubumenyi n’ikoranabuhanga nikeleyeri butaka bw’u rwanda yashyiriweho umukono i sochi umushinga w’itegeko ryemera kwemeza burundu amasezerano avuguruye yerekeye ishyirwaho ry’ihuriro mpuzamahanga mikoreshereze y’izuba yashyiriweho umukono i kigali ukwakira umushinga w’itegeko rigenga serivisi z’umutekano zitangwa n’abikorera inama y’abaminisitiri yemeje amateka perezida akurikira iteka perezida rishyiraho amahoro yakwa serivisi byemezo bitangwa n’inzego z’imitegekere y’igihugu zegerejwe abaturage iteka perezida ryemerera dr nyemazi jean pierre umunyamabanga uhoraho minisiteri y’ubuzima guhagarika akazi gihe kitazwi iteka perezida rizamura ntera abofisiye komiseri abofisiye bisumbuye n’abofisiye bato cumi n’umunani b’urwego rw’igihugu rushinzwe imfungwa n’abagororwa iteka perezida ryirukana ofisiye muto w’urwego rw’igihugu rushinzwe imfungwa n’abagororwa inama y’abaminisitiri yemeje amateka minisitiri w’intebe akurikira iteka minisitiri w’intebe ryirukana burundu bakozi leta bwana gahungu zacharie umujyanama minisitiri w’ubuzima kubera amakosa akomeye yakoze kazi iteka minisitiri w’intebe ryirukana burundu bakozi leta dr ndayisaba gilles franois umuyobozi mukuru w’ishami rishinzwe indwara zitandura kigo gishinzwe ubuzima rwanda rbc kubera amakosa akomeye yakoze kazi inama y’abaminisitiri yemeje amateka minisitiri akurikira iteka minisitiri ryerekeye ubugenzuzi bw’umurimo iteka minisitiri rishyiraho urutonde rw’amakosa akomeye iteka minisitiri rigena uburyo amahugurwa y’abakozi atangwa iteka minisitiri ryerekeye intumwa z’abakozi iteka minisitiri rigena serivisi zidahungabanywa zitagomba guhagarara gihe cy’ihagarikwa ry’imirimo cyangwa icy’ifungwa ry’ikigo iteka minisitiri rigena uburyo amasaha y’akazi cyumweru yubahirizwa nzego z’abikorera iteka minisitiri rigena amafaranga gushyingura n’ay’impozamarira mukozi iteka minisitiri rigena iby’ingenzi bikubiye masezerano y’umurimo yanditse iteka minisitiri rigena imiterere y’amasezerano kwitoza n’ayo kwimenyereza umurimo iteka minisitiri riha bwana nemeye alphonse madamu ingabire nadia bombi bakorera ikigo cy’igihugu cy’imisoro n’amahoro rra ububasha kukiburanira nkiko iteka minisitiri riha madamu uwera pacifique bwana kibogo ndahiro joseph bombi bakorera banki nkuru y’u rwanda bnr ububasha kuyiburanira nkiko iteka minisitiri rizamura ntera abasuzofisiye n’abawada b’urwego rw’igihugu rushinzwe imfungwa n’abagororwa iteka minisitiri ryirukana abasuzofisiye n’abawada b’urwego rw’igihugu rushinzwe imfungwa n’abagororwa inama y’abaminisitiri yemeje bakurikira bahagarira ibihugu byabo rwego rw’abambasaderi n’imiryango mpuzamahanga rwanda a abambasaderi bwana amadou so taal ambasaderi repubulika gambiya rwanda ufite icyicaro i abuja nigeriya bwana mbodou seid ambasaderi repubulika tchad rwanda ufite icyicaro i brazzaville repubulika kongo madamu elin steb johansen ambasaderi w’ubwami norvge rwanda ufite icyicaro i kampala uganda madamu saqlain syedah ambasaderi repubulika kisilamu pakistan rwanda ufite icyicaro i nairobi kenya b uhagarariye umuryango mpuzamahanga madamu julianna lindsey uhagarariye ishami ry’umuryango w’abibumbye ryita bana unicef rwanda inama y’abaminisitiri yashyize myanya abayobozi buryo bukurikira bwana ngabonziza prime umuyobozi mukuru w’ikigo gishinzwe umutungo kamere w’amazi rwanda dr twagirashema ivan umuyobozi mukuru wungirije w’ikigo gishinzwe mine peteroli gazi rwanda mu bindi a minisitiri w’uburinganire n’iterambere ry’umuryango yamenyesheje inama y’abaminisitiri itariki werurwe u rwanda ruzizihiza umunsi mpuzamahanga w’umugore insanganyamatsiko umugore ruhembe iterambere ibirori kwizihiza munsi bizabera rwego rw’umudugudu rwego rw’igihugu bizabera kigali arena karere gasabo b minisitiri w’urubyiruko n’umuco yamenyesheje inama y’abaminisitiri ku itariki gashyantare hazizihizwa umunsi w’intwari z’igihugu nshuro uzizihirizwa rwego rw’umudugudu insanganyamatsiko ubutwari banyarwanda agaciro kacu kuva gushyingo hatangiye igikorwa gutoranya urubyiruko rwakoze ibikorwa by’indashyikirwa kugira ruzahabwe ibihembo youthconnekt champions and celebrating young rwandan achievers ycccyrwa umuhango gutanga ibihembo uteganyijwe kuba tariki gashyantare kuva tariki mutarama kugeza gashyantare minisiteri y’urubyiruko n’umuco ifatanyije n’izindi nzego batangiye gutegura icyiciro kabiri gahunda rubyiruko menya amateka yawe iyi gahunda igamije gutoza urubyiruko indangagaciro gukunda igihugu ubumwe n’ubworoherane icyiciro kabiri gahunda artrwanda-ubuhanzi kizatangizwa mugaragaro tariki gashyantare kikazageza kamena gahunda gushakisha urubyiruko rufite impano gihugu hose izakorerwa duce twatoranyijwe kigali rubavu rusizi huye nyagatare musanze abahanzi b’indashyikirwa bazahabwa ibihembo bitandukanye ku itariki gashyantare u rwanda ruzizihiza nshuro umunsi mpuzamahanga w’ururimi kavukire insanganyamatsiko dukoreshe ikinyarwanda kinoze twese ibirori kwizihiza munsi rwego rw’igihugu bizabera karere kirehe c minisitiri w’ikoranabuhanga inovasiyo yamenyesheje inama y’abaminisitiri ubukangurambaga connect rwanda bwatangijwe tariki ukuboza buzamara amezi atatu kandi bukaba bugamije gukusanya nibura telefoni miliyoni zigezweho smartphones igikorwa gushyikiriza telefoni abazigenewe kizatangira cyumweru kabiri gashyantare d minisitiri w’ibikorwaremezo yamenyesheje inama y’abaminisitiri tariki kugeza gashyantare kigali convention center hateganyijwe kubera inama nyafurika ndege nto zitagira abapilote drones iyi nama izakurikirwa n’amarushanwa kugurutsa drones kiyaga kivu lake kivu drone flying competition ateganyijwe tariki kugeza gashyantare i karongi iri tangazo ryashyizweho umukono kayisire marie solangeminisitiri biro minisitiri w’intebe ushinzwe imirimo y’inama y’abaminisitiri content: yabwiye igihe yahawe gihembo kane tariki gashyantare aka karere akomokamo ati naraye mpawe igihembo cy’indashyikirwa n’akarere kirehe nk’umuhanzi uhavuka ugerageza gushimisha abaturage baho n’utundi turere gahunda z’iterambere ry’igihugu kurinda ibyagezweho kubyongera biciye bihangano by’uburere mboneragihugu yavuze indirimbo zatumye ahabwa gihembo zirimo iyitwa ibidakwiriye nzabivuga’ nta mpamvu n’imwe’ iyo twicaranye’ abanyarwanda twaribohoye’ tuzarinda igihugu’ twambariye gutsinda’ uyu muhanzi yahawe gihembo munsi gusoza ibyitwa open day’ bikorwa n’abatuye aka karere akaba munsi abantu n’ibigo byigenga bakorera karere bahurira imurikabikorwa bakerekana bamaze kugeza baturage hanarebwa gahunda z’ibihe biri imbere senderi aherutse gushyira hanze indirimbo zirimo yise imitako migongo’ ikirashi’ yakoranye intore tuyisenge uyu muhanzi yatangiye kuririmba mbere gato umuziki wiganjemo indirimbo zivuga politiki y’iterambere ry’igihugu isuku kwirinda ibyorezo sida malariya ubukungu urukundo umutekano n’ibindi senderi kandi akunda kwibanda ndirimbo zihumuriza abarokotse jenoside yakorewe abatutsi n’izamagana abahembera amacakubiri reba indirimbo senderi aheruka gushyira hanze yise ikirashi’

title: umuvugabutumwa kwizera yatangije umuryango la kunda foundation’ uzajya ufasha abababaye
content: umuvugabutumwa wamenyekanye cyane rwanda witwa kwizera emmanuel yatangije umuryango yise la kunda foundation’ gukora ibikorwa binyuranye by’ubufasha rwego kwibuka umugore witwa kunda therese witwa kunda therese umaze umwaka yitabye imana iki gikorwa cyakoze mitima benshi kwizera emmanuel yagitangirije rusengero evangelical restoration church kimisagara kanama cyari kitabiriwe n’imbaga ministry aee kwizera emmanuel yatangije muryango yise la kunda foundation’ yavuze uzibanda bikorwa gufasha abakene gufasha abubatse ingo kubana neza kwamamaza ubutumwa mahanga gusengera butarageraho ubwo yatangizaga muryango mugaragaro kwizera emmanuel yavuze igitekerezo kuwushinga cyaturutse bikorwa byiza nyakwigendera therese yasize akoreye isi ashimangira ibikorwa byiza biherekeza title: u rwanda mwanya gatatu bihugu byiza wakoreramo ubucuruzi afurika
content: iyi raporo yakozwe bihugu bikorerwamo ubucuruzi isi yasanze u rwanda ruri mwanya afurika rukaza mwanya rwego rw’isi rukaba rwigiye imbere ho imyanya itanu ugereranyije n’umwaka washize ibyo u rwanda rubikesha kuba rwaraguye ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi kwihangira imirimo rugerageza kugeza umuriro w’amashanyarazi ahatari hake amategeko agenga imisoro nayo yaravuguruwe ndetse runorohereza abashaka inguzanyo bihangire imirimo n’ubwo ariko u rwanda rwateye intambwe igaragara korohereza abashoramari gushora imari rwanda raporo itunga agatoki bimwe bidahagaze neza gihe rwanda cyane cyane bikorwa birimo kwemerera abantu kubaka guha abaturage uburenganzira butaka bwabo gushyiraho amategeko ahamye arengera abashoramari n’ibindi aha bakwiye kwikubita agashyi bityo bikabafasha gukomeza kwitwara neza ruhando rw’amahanga minisitiri w’ubucuruzi n’inganda francois kanimba yavuze asanga mwanya u rwanda ruriho udakwiye gutuma habaho kwirara avuga hakiri byinshi gukorwa birimo kugabanya umwanya ukoreshwa n’abashaka kwandikisha ubucuruzi kugirango abantu barusheho kwihuta bikorwa by’ubucuruzi n’ibindi madamu mimi ladipo umuyobozi banki y’isi rwanda yagize avuga raporo avuga habayeho gutera imbere buryo bugaragara yagize munsi u rwanda ruri mwanya rwego rw’isi bihugu umuntu yashoramo imari ntekereza tugomba gushima ikirenge rwateye kandi twizera ruzakomeza bityo n’ibindi bihugu bikareberaho anne-marie nwemwiza

title: bishop rugagi bagenzi bashyikirijwe parike bakatirwa ikihe gifungo bahamwe n’ibyaha
content: polisi y’u rwanda ntangiriro z’uku kwezi yataye yombi abavugabutumwa batandatu bakurikiranyweho gukoresha inama buryo bunyuranije n’amategeko kurwanya ububasha bw’amategeko abatawe yombi apostle rwandamura charles r pastor nyamurangwa fred bishop rugagi innocent rev ntambara emmanuel pastor dura james pastor kalisa shyaka emmanuel abo batandatu bakaba bamaze igihe bakurikiranwa maboko y’ubutabera ibyaha baregwa biramutse bibahamye bahabwa ibihe bihano iyo uregwa akiburana cyangwa agikurikiranwa n’inzego zinyuranye z’ubutabera akiri umwere kuko urukiko ruba rutaramuhamya icyaha kabone n’iyo yaba yiyemerera icyaha yitwa umunyacyaha urukiko rumaze kukimuhamya buryo ndakuka kandi rukamukatira n’igihano kijyanye n’icyo cyaha kuri bavugabutumwa nabo kugeza abere ariko hakurikijwe ingingo z’amategeko hari ibihano biteganywa n’igitabo cy’amategeko ahana ibyaha rwanda zigaragaza ibihano bahabwa byaha biramutse bibahamye ingingo gitabo cy’amategeko ahana ibyaha rwanda igira iti umuntu wese urwanya ububasha bw’amategeko cyangwa akoshya kuburwanya abigiriye ubugome kandi ruhame ahanishwa igifungo kirenze imyaka itanu kugeza myaka irindwi ibihano bivuzwe gikacya mbere cy’iyi ngingo bikubwa kabiri koshya kwagize ingaruka mbi naho ingingo gitabo cy’amategeko ahana ibyaha rwanda igira iti umuntu wese ukoresha inama mugaragaro cyangwa ukwigaragambya jnzira nyabagendwa content: kubakira byiza mateka y’u rwanda kugira uruhare kubungabunga umutekano hatangwa amakuru gihe muntu wese wahungabanya umutekano bimwe byagarutsweho mahugurwa yateguwe komisiyo gusubiza buzima busanzwe agenewe inkeragutabara n’abafasha yabereye biro by’akarere gakenke ukwakira afungura mahugurwa umuyobozi komisiyo gusubiza buzima busanzwe abahoze rugamba ntara y’amajyaruguru madamu niyonteze clemence yasabye abitabiriye mahugurwa kuyakurikirana neza kuko ingirakamaro mibereho n’abaturanyi yakomeje avuga mahugurwa agamije guhugura cyane cyane abagore b’inkeragutabara bagahugukirwa gahunda leta dore batigeze bahugurwa bagaruka rwababyaye ndetse kumenya ibibazo bafite bwana safali wilson watanze ikiganiro mateka y’u rwanda mahugurwa yasobanuriye abitariye amahugurwa imvano y’amateka yateye jenoside yakorewe abatutsi yavuze abazungu banditse kandi bakigisha amateka y’u rwanda bayagoreka nkana kugira bacemo ibice abanyarwanda babashe kubategeka bise cyongereza divide and rule by’umwihariko ababiligi banditse amateka y’abanyarwanda bagendeye mateka y’amacakubiri gihugu cyabo hagati y’abafurama flamands n’abawaru wallons dore iwabo byacikaga hagati yayo moko n’ubutegetsi bubi bamburaga ubuzima abavandimwe basaga miliyoni asobanura ikigenderewe kwiga amateka yavuze kubaka ejo hazaza bwana safali yagize kumenya amateka yacu bidufasha kwirinda amabi jenoside wagaragaje imbogamizi z’uko atazaboneka amakuru y’isubikwa ry’inama y’abakuru b’ibihugu bigize umuryango afrika y’iburasirazuba eac yamenyekanye nyuma y’uko u rwanda ruri buyobozi bw’uyu muryango gihe rubimenyesheje ibihugu binyamuryango binyuze nyandiko umunyamabanga leta minisiteri y’ububanyi n’amahanga n’ubutwererane ushinzwe ibikorwa by’umuryango afurika y’iburasirazuba amb olivier nduhungirehe yagaragaje gusubika nama byaturutse busabe bw’umwe bakuru b’ibihugu wifuje yakwimurirwa umwaka utahaicyakora yirinze gutangaza munyamuryango yagize ubundi amategeko avuga inama iterana abakuru b’ibihugu bahari ariko udahari akaba ashobora guhagararirwa n’umuminisitiri byanditse masezerano eac ariko akenshi bikorwa bwumvikane umukuru w’igihugu avuga tariki afiteho indi gahunda gihe babyumvikanaho rwose bikaba yindi tariki bisanzwe bikorwa rero hari umukuru w’igihugu kimwe bigize muryango wasabye nyakubahwa perezida pepubulika nk’umuyobozi w’uyu muryango nama yakwimurirwa kwezi mbere cyangwa kwezi umwaka utaha kuko atari buboneke tariki ugushyingo ejo bundi nama perezida repubulika yagiranye n’umunyamabanga mukuru w’uyu muryango village urugwiro yarabimumenyesheje hanyuma nandikira umunyamabanga mukuru menyesha n’abandi minisitiri b’ibihugu bigize muryangoinama y’abakuru b’igihugu eac yasubitswe nanone uretse inama y’abakuru b’ibihugu yasubitswe izindi zari ziteganyijwe zizaba shiti zirimo iy’abaminisitiri iy’abanyamabanga bahoraho ndetse n’indi bucuruzi n’ishoramari izwi business and investment summit icyakora amb nduhungirehe yamaganye ibihuha isubikwa ry’iyi nama byakwirakwijwe bimwe bitangazamakuru gihugu uganda ashimangira gusubika nama ntaho bihuriye n’isubikwa ry’indi nama ishyirwa bikorwa ry’amasezerano luanda hagati y’u rwanda uganda yagize nta n’aho bihuriye kuko gusubika inama kampala byerekeye gushyira bikorwa masezerano luanda ryatewe gahunda y’abagize delegation yacu batari kuboneka mbere tariki ibyo twarabibamenyesheje ariko tubasaba kugena indi tariki twakumvikanaho nama ikaba hanyuma isubikwa ry’inama y’abakuru b’ibihugu eac ryo nubwo ryasabwe n’u rwanda byasabwe n’umukuru w’ikindi gihugu n’ubwo byasabwe uganda gushaka kubihuza binyamakuru uganda ukwigiza nkana gushaka kuvuga byacitse kandi ntaho bihuriye mu kiganiro aheruka kugirana n’abanyamakuru tariki z’uku kwezi k’ugushyingo perezida repubulika paul kagame mukuru w’igihugu uyoboye eac gihe yagaragaje gukemura imbogamizi zikigaragara kwishyira hamwe kw’ibihugu binyamuryango bikwiye gushyirwa imbere kurusha inama ubwazo yagize ubusanzwe ntabwo kuba inama itabaye byakabaye ikintu cyerekana hari ikibazo runaka kuko ibibazo biri ahandi kandi ntibiterwa kuba inama itabaye hari n’igihe twamaze imyaka nama ibaye ariko wenda hari n’impamvu zabiteye ariko njyewe ntangiriro ndabizi neza kwishyira hamwe atari ikintu ujyamo ugahita ubona wifuzaga ibintu tuzi kandi twemera ibintu bidahita bijya buryo ako kanya nk’uko tubyifuza biteganyijwe inama y’abakuru b’ibihugu bigize umuryango afurika y’iburasirazuba izasubukurwa hagati mutarama gashyantare umwaka utaha rba

title: abarenga biga iprc kigali bamaze amezi farg itabaha buruse

title: byinshi ruzagayura inzara yashegeshe u rwanda igahitana abasaga ibihumbi
content: iyo inzara yatangiye ahagana ukwakira itewe n’amapfa yamaze imyaka ibiri ayo mapfa yatangiye nzeri yongera kubaho nyuma gato y’itumba ryo igitabo imizi y’u rwanda cy’umusizi nsanzabera jean de dieu kigaragaza nzara yenyegejwe yatewe n’igabanyuka ry’ibiribwa ryaturutse ndwara y’ibirayi bita mildioumildew ndetse ndwara y’ibishyimbo bita chortophila n’ibijumba bihe byari byibasiwe n’indwara bita rhizoctoniarhizoctonie inzara ruzagayura yongerewe ubukana kandi n’intambara kabiri y’isi ndetse n’uko gihe abanyarwanda bagombaga guha umusanzu abakoroni b’ababiligi bahanganye n’ingabo adolf hitler ntambara kabiri y’isi uwo musanzu ugizwe n’ibiribwa n’amatungo icyo gihe imbuto gakondo z’abanyarwanda nazo zari zishoboye guhangana n’ibihe n’uburwayi bw’ibihingwa zari zimaze gucika bazisimbuje ibirayi imyumbati soya n’ibindi abanyarwanda batangaga inka ibishyimbo amasaka amashaza kugaburira abasirikare b’abanyekongo ndetse n’abakozi birombe congo usibye ibiribwa n’amatungo umusanzu w’abanyarwanda ntambara ugizwe n’imirimo y’agahato irimo guharura imihanda kubumba amatafari gutwara imizigo y’abakoloni gukora birombe zahabu gasegereti wolufuramu guhinga ibireti byakoreshwaga gutunganya umuti wica udukoko inzara ruzagayura yiswe amazina menshi bitewe n’ubukana yagiye igaragaza turere dutandukanye tw’u rwanda mu majyepfo yiswe ruzagayura mu duce dutandukanye tw’iburasirazuba yiswe rujukundi rwanyirarushenyi rwakinyebuye cyangwa se rwakabetezi mu majyaruguru bice rubavu nyabihu burera musanze yiswe amazina rudakangwimishanana rugaragazabadakekwa nyirahuku hagati gihugu ndetse n’amajyaruguru y’iburasirazuba izwi matemane burengerazuba yitwa gahoro iyo nzara yagize ubukana bwinshi majyaruguru burasirazuba majyepfo y’igihugu mu bice rusizi nyamasheke niho honyine hatigeze hahura n’iyo nzara mpamvu z’ikirere cyaho ikindi ntara yegeranye congo mbiligi buryo itari kugira ikibazo kubura ibiribwa ahubwo yakiraga abantu bavuye zindi ntara astrida butare gisenyi mu gihe ruzagayura uduce tw’imisozi ihanamye uduce tw’ubutaka busharira uduce turangwamo isuri nitwo twababaye cyane kurusha utundi muri utwo duce kimwe n’ahandi abaturage barazahaye buryo benshi bamaraga iminsi ibir cyangwa se itatu badakoze munwa benshi inzara yarabicaga abaryaga wasangaga barya inguri imizi y’insina imizi y’ibiti amareberebe umutsima uvuye ifu barakatsi acacia cyangwa se y’intembe y’insina iyo ndyo idasanzwe gushidikanya nayo yishe abantu benshi bihe abafite agatege barasuhukaga bakajya gushaka bakura ibiribwa cyangwa se bagurana ibikoresho byabo n’ibiribwa benshi wasangaga barananutse nk’uko bigaragara mafoto y’icyo gihe babitaga ingarisi kubera babaga barashizemo ni nako bitaga imirambo y’abo yahitanye iyo mirambo yasangwaga y’imihanda mirima mashyamba nkengero z’inzuzi n’ahandi henshi nyuma y’uko hafashwe ingamba zinyuranye kurwanya inzara ruzagayura abaturage babishishikarijwemo n’abategetsi b’abakoloni ndetse n’abatware bahinganye ubwira guhera ntangiriro abanyarwanda bahinze ibishyimbo amashaza ibirayi imyumbati n’ibijumba kubera uburumbuke bw’imvura yaguye buryo buhagije umusaruro wariyongereye ibigega byongera guhunikwamo abari barasuhutse bagaruka zabo ubwo abamisiyoneri bahagaritse gutanga amafunguro inkambi z’ingarisi zirafungwa ahagana nyakanga abategetsi b’abakoloni bahagaritse kohereza amakamyo y’ibiribwa rwanda yavaga kongo mu mpera z’umwaka aribwo hatangazwa inzara yarangiye gihugu nubwo inzara ruzagayura yamaze igihe gito yahitanye abantu benshi cyane abamisiyoneri b’abagatolika batangaje raporo ngarumwaka hagati abagore abarwayi n’abasheshe akanguhe bapfuye cyangwa se bahunze nzara buryo yahitanye bashobora kurenga inzara ruzagayura yangije kandi byinshi itera n’ubujura bukabije gihugu ubwo bujura bwakwiye turere twose tw’u rwanda cyane cyane utwari twarayogojwe n’inzara bwakorwaga n’ingeri zose z’abanyarwanda mu turere tumwe tumwe tw’u rwanda nko teritwari gisenyi bujura bwafashe indi ntera kugera abaturage batatinyaga gutega nzira bagenzi bavuye misiyoni bakabagusha gico cyabo bakabambura ibiribwa bahawe izo ngaruka ruzagayura zateje umutekano muke gihugu bizana urwikekwe n’umujinya mwinshi banyarwanda ahanini mujinya waturukaga bukarihe bw’inzara buremere bw’umusanzu watangwaga n’abanyarwanda

title: ubuhanzi nyarwanda bwahawe umwihariko udasanzwe muganura w’uyu mwaka
content: guhera tariki nyakanga kugeza tariki kanama rwanda hazizihizwa icyumweru cy’umuganura kizarangwa n’ibikorwa bitandukanye minisiteri siporo n’umuco minispoc bufatanye n’inteko nyarwanda title: ingingo ivuga umunyamaguru atagira ikosa ikwiye kwiganwa ubushoshozi ibangamira abashoferi
content: umuyobozi polisi y’ u rwanda ntara y’ amajyepfo commissioner of police rutikanga rogers yavuze atekereza ingingo ivuga umunyamaguru atagira ikosa irimo kwigwaho kugira izakorwe buryo wakoze impanuka akica umuntu kuko bikorwa rwego kumurindira umutekano kugira banyiri umuntu batihorera ngo abapolisi bageze ahabereye impanuka bakusanya amakuru bakanabaza ababonye yagenze bityo title: gael face agiye kuza kwerekana filime ’petit pays’ i kigali
content: gal faye umuraperi w’umunyarwanda ufite ubwenegihugu bw’u bufaransa yatanze integuza agiye kuza i kigali rwanda agiye kumurikira abanyarwanda firime petit pays’ ishatse kuvuga agahugu gato ishingiye gitabo yanditse mbere kuza i kigali firime yerekaniwe mujyi lille gashyantare ejo hashize yerekaniwe i toulouse munsi irerekanirwa i arles ejo izerekanirwa avignon werurwe i nice i toulon werurwe yerekanwe i aix-en province uyu muhanzi ufite indirimbo irruption imaze kurebwa n’abantu barenga miriyoni rubuga youtube yavuze firime izajya isoko werurwe muhango uzabera bufaransa anatangaza mbere y’uko munsi ugera azaba i kigali werurwe azerekana firime yise petit pays muhango uzabera century cinemayavuze nyuma i kigali firime izerekanirwa i reims ahitwa opraims werurwe yerekanirwe mujyi paris ati nzabamenyesha vuba bizabera n’amasaha indirimbo yise petit pays yasohoye werurwe shene youtube imaze kurebwa n’abantu barenga miriyoni enye imaze gutangwaho ibitekerezo abakanze akamenyetso kuyikunda n’ibihumbi uyu muraperi aheruka i kigali gashyantare yamurikaga igitabo ke yise petit pays cyahinduwe kinyarwanda olivier bahizi uwineza firime petit pays irimo nkuru y’ubuzima bw’umwana wavukiye i burundi abyarwa n’umunyarwandakazi w’impunzi n’umuzungu w’umufaransa muri gitabo mwana avuga yabonaga ubuzima gihe ibibazo by’amoko uwo mwana uba ufite hagati y’imyaka yibuka uburyo ubuto bwe bwaje kwicwa n’ibibazo poritike aka karere anavuga kibazo kuvuka babyeyi badahuje uruhu nyuma yaje guhungishirizwa i burayi nabwo yaje kubona kuba imvange bigoye kuko haba i burundi burayi hose abantu bamufataga nk’umunyamahanga amaze gukura yiyemeje kugaruka afurika kuko ariho nibura yumvaga iwabo mu byatumye yumva yigaruriye ikizere ugukunda gusoma kwandika iki gitabo kivuga mateka yaranze u burundi n’u rwanda myaka kugera nyuma yaho guhera tariki mutarama firime ifite iminota yatangiye gukinirwa karere rubavu iyobowe n’umufaransa eric barbier iyi firime yakinwemo n’abana bavutse babyeyi b’abirabura n’abazungu nk’uko bimeze gal faye izagaragaramo kandi nsanzamahoro denis wamenyekanye rwasa sinema nyarwanda akaba yaritabye imana nzeri igitabo petit pays cyaciye uduhigo dutandukanye nko inzu isohora ibitabo yitwa fnac yahembye gal faye nk’umwanditsi mwiza w’umwaka kiciro cy’abanditse ibitabo bwoko roman petit pays’ cyanatoranyijwe bitabo byitabiriye irushanwa mwaka igihembo cyatanzwe hagendewe matora y’abasomyi barenga batoranyije petit pays’ nk’igitabo gikubiyemo inkuru iryoshye kandi y’umwimerere kurusha ibindi gel faye yanegukanye igihembo prix goncourt des lycens abikesha igitabo ke petit pays’ chief editor muhaburarw

title: burera bacuruza kanyanga kuko idasaba amafaranga menshi
content: inzego zishinzwe umutekano munsi ushira zidafashe abantu bikoreye kanyanga bayikuye uganda bayizana rwanda abari kuyinywa cyangwa se abayicuruza bakabahana kanyanga babafatanye bakayimena ariko ntibabireka nkurunziza jean baptiste avuga impamvu abantu bamwe bajya bucuruzi kanyanga ugushaka imibereho agira ino niyo itunze abantu bayikuramo amafaranga menshi nyamara bashoye makeya nshimiyimana protais avuga kuba rumwe rubyiruko rujya gucuruza kanyanga kandi ikiyobyabwenge mafaranga y’igishoro ahagije bafite gucuruza ibindi agira niyo waba ufite ibihumbi bibiri ujya bugande ukarangura ukaza ugacuruza yongera ho usibye kuba urubyiruko rucuruza kanyanga runakora akazi kujya kuyikura uganda rukorera abandi aho umuntu afite uwamutumye yagaruka akamuha amafaranga bumvikanye avuga urubyiruko rubonye abarutera inkunga rutasubira gucuruza kanyanga iradukunda viateur avuga abajya bucuruzi kanyanga mafaranga menshi bafite gucuruza ibindi ngo ukubura bagira tariki rvlien avuga hari abayicuruza kuko bafite abayinywa batari bake ako gace agira barayicuruza kuko abantu bayinywa bavuga bayinyweye inzoka zicurama inzoka nda akomeza avuga gace atuyemo kuyicuruza ndetse kuyinywa byabaye nk’umuco hari twaganiriye ariko utarashatse izina rye ritangazwa adutangariza gihe kanyanga abayinywa badahita babona ingaruka mbi zayo ako kanya batazareka kuyinywa agira iyaba umuntu wanywaga kanyanga yahitaga abona ingaruka mbi zayo ako kanya abantu bareka kuyinywa n’abayicuruza bakabireka hagati ubuyobozi burakora ibishoboka ibiyobyabwenge birimo kanyanga bicike kimwe bikorwa bishya abayobozi karere burera bakoze ugushyiraho ikigega cy’amafaranga ahabwa abantu bareka gucuruza kanyanga akabafasha gukora indi mishinga norbert niyizurugero

title: ikiganiro n’abana muhanda cyamuhaye inganzo- ben nganji
content: bisangwa nganji benjamin wamenyekanye ben nganji yasohoye indirimbo nshya yise struggle’ avugamo ubuzima bw’abana muhanda babayemo bushobora kubashora bishuko byatuma ubuzima bwabo burangirira agira asaba leta igitekerezo cy’iyi ndirimbo cyashibutse kiganiro yagiranye bariya bana iyi ndirimbo njyana reggae ben nganji atangamo urugero rugaragaza ibyihebe byashimuse bana bikabigisha kwiba kwica gusahura ariko umwe akabyanga nubwo mahitamo afite akababwira adashobora kubikora mu kiganiro kihariye yagiranye n’umuseke yavuze igitekerezo gukora ndirimbo cyavuye kiganiro n’abana muhanda bamubwira ubuzima babayemo bituma yumva yabikoraho indirimbo ati bambwiye amayeri bakoresha babone amaramuko bamwe bambwiye bashobora guhemuka ariko ntibicwe n’inzara bariho buzima batahisemo mbona nubwo tubanyuraho ntitubyiteho ariko ikibazo kitureba twese avuga nyuma kuganira bariya bana yahise yumva yagaragaza buzima abicishije ndirimbo ati nashatse kugaragaza kugera kure kubi cyangwa kubaho ubuzima bubi bitavuga kwishora byaha muri ndirimbo nagaragaje umwana washorwaga bugizi nabi akabyanga iyi nirimbo ndimi ebyiri ikinyarwanda n’icyongerezo ben nganji avuga yabikoze kuko nabonaga ubutumwa butagenewe abanyarwanda gusa kuko kibazo cy’abana b’inzererezi isi by’umwihariko mugabane mvukamo ben nganji asaba leta y’u rwanda gukumira ikibazo cy’abana muhanda ibinyujije gukemura ibibazo bituma bajyayo ati ni ugukomeza gushyira imbaraga duhereye myumvire y’igituma abana bayoboka imihanda hari ibitera abana kujya muhanda hari amakimbirane miryango kubyara imburagihe ubukene kubyara badashoboye kurera twe dutanga ubutumwa dukoresheje ibihangano ariko ntitwizera bugera bose nk’uko bikwiye ibihango nk’ibi bifasha guhindura imyumvire y’abaturage leta yagakwiye kubishoramo amafaranga ariko natwe turacyagerageza dushoboye dutange umusanzu gufasha abaturage bacu ben nganji yamenyekanye ndirimbo nyinshi zitandukanye harimo mbonye umusaza nsazanye inzara rehema habe n’akabizu n’izindi jean paul mugabeumusekerw

title: mgr rukamba yavuze biganiro bishobora kugeza kwemerera abafite abagore kuba abapadiri
content: mu byumweru bitatu biri imbere uhereye ukwakira abasenyeri bagera amerika y’epfo bazigira hamwe ibibazo bijyanye n’ihindagurika ry’ikirere abimukira n’ivugabutumwa inyandiko igaragaza ibizaganirwaho izwi instrumentum laboris iriho n’igitekerezo gikomeje kugibwaho impaka hibazwa amazonie bishobora kwemerwa abagabo bakuze kandi bafite abagore bakwemererwa guhabwa isakaramentu ry’ubusaserdoti ni igice cyugarijwe n’ubuke bw’abapadiri kugeza abaturage badahabwa misa bikwiye umushumba diyosezi gatolika butare akaba perezida w’inama y’abepiskopi rwanda mgr philippe rukamba yavuze nubwo ibiganiro bigikomeza uburyo bushoboka ahamaze kugaragara ikibazo cy’ubuke bw’abapadiri ati ni ibintu abantu batekerezaho cyane gihe kubera u burayi amerika y’epfo batangiye kugira ikibazo gikomeye cy’abapadiri bato ubundi kuba umupadiri ubutumwa umuntu agira akoherezwa kwigisha ijambo ry’imana gutagatifuza abantu kuyobora kiliziya buriya hari n’aho abapadiri bahari barashatse cyane nko mico aziya hari abapadiri bafite abagore gusa babyemera kare bagashyingirwa ni ibintu bivugwa cyane kubera kibazo abantu bamwe bakavuga bati ariko turabura abapadiri kandi hari abantu wenda bashaka kuba abapadiri abantu bakuru’ noneho ntabwo biremezwa ibintu abantu batekerezaho kuko kudashaka umuntu ashobora kuba padiri yaranashatse nk’uko mico n’imwe liban n’ahandi bagatolika ihari ariko kintu cyari cyagerwaho ibitekerezo gusa musenyeri rukamba yavuze hari kenshi biba nk’abapasiteri b’abaporoso bahinduka abagatolika hari bihugu bimwe bemererwa kugumana abagore kandi bakaba abapadiri byemewe cyangwa bagashakirwa izindi nshingano kiliziya gusa gice kiliziya gatolika u rwanda ruherereyemo umuco uhari uw’uko abapadiri badashaka abagore mgr rukamba yakomeje nko minsi ishize habaye ikibazo gikomeye bangilikani kiliziya ibemerera kuza bafite n’abakirisitu bazanye barakomeza bababera abashumba barashatse gusa ingingo kwemerera abantu bafite abagore kuba abapadiri ntaho iragera yemezwa yumvikana nk’ishishikaje abantu cyane ariko n’iyo abasenyeri amazonie babyemeza bizasaba papa abiha umugisha abanje gutumiza sinode yagutse igizwe n’abasenyeri bahagarariye abandi bihugu byose isi mgr rukamba bishobora kuba bibera gice kimwe runaka ariko isi igomba kubimenya bigomba kwemezwa papa murimo guhuza abantu gutuma habaho ubumwe hagati y’abakristu kandi bigenze bityo urabona bavuye buryo title: ibintu by’ ingenzi umusore agomba kuba afite kugirango inkumi zimukunde
content: n’ubwo bisanzwe bizwi buri wese agira akunda bitandukanye n’iby’abandi hari bimwe bintu bigagara iby’ibanze musore w’umunyarwanda akundwe n’abakobwa ndetse bifuze banarushingana bakibanira akaramata kuba umusore afite akazi nk’uko benshi nkumi babyitangarije bagize bati umugabo akwiye kuba umutware w’urugo kandi akaba anafite ubushobozi kurutunga n’ubwo n’umufasha agomba kumufasha ariko nta je t’aime inzara igutema amara burya mukobwa wakwifuza kubana n’umusore ubwe buzima yifitiye akazi cyangwa akura nicyo cyumvikana ubunyangamugayo kwiyubaha n’ubwo umusore yatunga ibya mirenge burya umunyamanyanga umusambanyi agira umwanda cyangwa atazi kwiyitaho nko myambarire byose bituma nkumi imwifuzaho yayibera umugabo bivuga umusore ugaragara neza kandi wiyubaha ariwe nzozi z’umukobwa wifuza barushingana imibanire gusabana n’abandi nta gushidikanya umusore uzi kuganira gusetsa gukora utundi tuntu dushimisha benshi akundwa n’abakobwa batari bake ibi kandi ho hanagaragara imitoma kuryoshyaryoshya magambo bityo umukobwa akabonamo umusore nk’uwashobora gutetesha gususurutsa urugo rugahoramo akanyamuneza kuba umuntu uzi gufata ibyemezo gushyira gaciro nk’uko umugabo umutware w’urugo ngombwa agira ubushobozi kwifatira ibyemezo kuba ashyira gaciro buryo ashyira buri kintu mwanya wacyo akagira gahunda kandi akagaragaza ibitekerezo byateza urugo imbere burya kandi kugira igitsure kidakabije mugabo abakobwaabagore batari bake barabikunda kugira inzu kubamo iki gikunze kugaragara basore byaro hirya hino rwanda hose ku nkomi cyaro ndetse kugira inzu nicyo kibanze musore wifuza rushinga kuko binamenyerewe buri wese nzu bitandukanye mujyi usanga abenshi bibera nzu bakodesha gusa mijyi cyane cyane ntara abakobwa benshi ntibishimira kuba babana n’umusore udafite inzu bakajya bahora babunza akarago gusa mijyi ikomeye hano rwanda nko mujyi kigali ho icy’ingenzi ukuba umusore afite akazi kuburyo afite ubushobozi gukodesha inzu kubamo n’ubwo nyine kubafite inzu zabo bwite biba akarusho olivier ndikumana

title: bugesera nyuma y’inzara yaharanzwe karahahira utundi turere
content: mu myaka yashize cyane cyane umwaka w’ akarere bugesera kagaragayemo ikibazo cy’amapfa akabije hari abantu bicwaga n’inzara abandi bagasuhukamuri gihe uhatembereye ushobora kugira amateka cyangwa se amakabyankuru y’abantu abenshi baturage hari bahatuye nibo bivugira kibazo cy’inzara kihaherutseniyonzima joseph w’imyaka utuye murenge nyamata akagari maranyundo amaze imyaka aka karere avuga inzara yatangiye kugaragara bugesera mpera y’ ariko ikaza gukaza umurego mwaka w’ avuga gihe ibintu byose byari byarabuze biryo mvaruganda kugeza bijumba bihingiragaagira umva ibijumba ibijumba gihe inaha byaribwaga n’umuntu ufite imodoka ndakubwiza ukuri mukene wapfaga kubyigondera niyonzima yongeraho impamvu yateraga byose izuba ryari ryaracanye buryo batirirwaga bahinga n’uwahinganga ntiyeze avuga igihe ahantu hapfaga kwera ibijumba hari bishanga kandi byajyaga kubageraho byahenze yongeraho mwaka w’ abantu bishwe n’inzara buryo bukabije duce twa gashora ngenda gahembe maranyundo abandi barasuhuka ati gihe abagabo benshi barahungaga kubera kubura bagaburira imiryango abagore bakishyira migozi kubera kubura bagaburira abana mukanzaramba feresita umugore w’imyaka y’amavuko atuye murenge mayange avuga ikintu cyaje kubarokora bugesera haje imishinga n’imwe igatangira kubaha imfashanyo z’ibiribwaagira muri gihe tutarabona imfashanyo amahirwe yasekeraga yabonaga rukacarara icyo gihe twayitaga shira umuteto kuko mbere wasangaga hari abantu batarya umutsima w’amasaka gusa abatuye aka gace bavuga ibintu bisa n’ibyasubiye buryo kuko imyaka irera abantu bakabona ibiryo bavuga ufite inoti y’igihumbi urya amanywa n’ijoro nyirabitanga jolie utuye bugesera avuga nzara ikiharangwa aka karere gahagaze neza isoko ibintu biraboneka ibiboneka kurusha ibindi harimo imboga ibishyimbo imyumbati inanasi ibigori n’ibindi ugeze isoko nyamata gice gicururizwamo imboga abacuruzi bazo nabo bemeza imboga ziboneka bwinshi mukarwema annonciata umucuruzi soko nyamata umaze imyaka igera acuruza avuga ibicuruzwa byabonetse nyuma y’aho mbere gucuruza byasaga n’ibigoranye kubera baburaga barangurira agira ibintu biriho ikibigaragaza inyanya intoryi n’izindi kandi urabona hano isoko abacuruza imboga babaye benshi kandi n’abo tundi turere basigaye baza kurangura hano aganira kigalitodaycom rwagaju louis uyobora akarere bugesera avuga icyatumye inzara igabanuka aka karere leta yafashe ingamba gutera ibiti n’amashyamba hirya hino kariya gace avuga iterwa ry’ibiti ryatumye imvura itangira kugwa n’imyaka ikaboneraho gutangira kwera ati ubu hari ibicuruzwa abacuruzi b’ i kigali baza kurangura inaha ndetse nubu dufitanye ubuhahirane n’intara kirundo gihugu cy’u burundi yongeraho byose babigezeho bakangurira abaturage gukora cyane guhinga kuzigama gukora imirimo itegamiye buhinzi gusa muri ako karere hari igihe cyageze bitoroshye kubona n’igiti kubera izuba ryari ryarahibasiye umuntu yashoboraga gusanga amatungo yapfiriye nzira kubera kubura ubwatsi n’amazi kuko hendaga kuba ubutayu egide kayiranga

title: covid- gusohoka rugo mpamvu yumvikana birabujijwe keretse abajya gutanga gusaba serivise z’ingenzi
content: guhera ijoro ryo gatandatu u rwanda rwashyizweho ingamba nshya gukumira virusi corona zirimo kubuza abantu gusohoka mpamvu zihutirwa itangazo guverinema y’u rwanda ryashyizweho umukono ministiri w’intebe edouard ngirente rivuga bashyingiye ntera icyorezo virusi corona kimaze gufataku isi buryo ibindi bihugu bihangana n’icyorezo virusi corona bikavuga ngombwa hakwiriye kongera ingamba ndetse n’imbaraga gukumira ikwirakwizwa ry’icyorezo virusi corona rwanda iryo tangazo rivuga guhera gatandatuisaa tanu n’iminota z’ijoro ngamba zishyizweho kandi zizamara igihe cy’ ibyumweru bibiri gishobora kongerwa mu ngamba zashyizweho leta y’u rwanda isonga ingendo zitari ngombwa zirabujijwe kandi gusohoka rugo mpamvu yumvikana birabujijwe keretse abajya gutanga gusaba serivise z’ingenzi harimo kwivuza guhaha serivise banki n’izindi hongeye gushimangirwa kandi kwishyurana hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga bigomba gukoreshwa ahashoboka hose kurusha kujya banki atm ukuvuga byuma bashyiramo ikarita bigasohora amafaranga ingamba gatatu irareba abakozi leta n’abikorera basabwa gukorera akazi zabo keretse abatanga services z’ingenzi zavuzwe haruguru imipaka kandi irafunzwe keretse banyarwanda bataha ndetse n’abandi batuye rwanda byemewe n’amategeko abo bakaba bazashyirwa kato gihe cy’ibyumweru bibiri ahantu ibiro minisitiri w’intebe bivuga hateganyijwe gusa ubwikorezi bw’ibicuruzwa byinjira cyangwa bisohoka rwanda burakomeza indi yafashwe ngamba gatanu ivuga ingendo hagati y’imijyi n’uturere tw’igihugu zitemewe keretse bajya kwivuza cyangwa bafite impamvu zihutirwa aha ho ubwikorezi bw’ibicuruzwa burakomeza bisanzwe nk’uko iryo tangazo ribigaragaza amasoko n’amaduka byafunzwe keretse abacuruza ibiribwa ibikoresho by’isuku farumasi essence mazutu n’ibindi bikoresho by’ibanze ku batwaraga abagenzi motontibyemewe iryo tangazo rigira riti keretse izigemuye ibicuruzwa bivuga imodoka zitwara abagenzi mijyi zikomeza gukora hubahirijwe intera metero hagati y’abagenzi utubari twose turafunga ariko resitora zirakomeza gukora hatangwa serivisi guha kurya abakiriya bakabitahana ibizwi take away’ rurimi rw’icyongereza leta yasabye abayobozi b’inzego z’ibanze zikora buzima bwose bw’igihugu birasa n’aho u rwanda rwinjiye bihe bidasanzwe izi ngamba zije ziyongera zindi zafashwe minsi mike ishize zirimo gufunga insengero kiliziya n’ibindi bikorwa bihuza abantu benshi chief editor muhaburarw

title: gishwati residents decry delayed land compensation
content: the affected residents who were evacuated from kanama nyakiriba and kanzenze sectors to pave way for the re-forestation of gishwati forest have expressed concern over delayed compensation for their land residents claim that they were promised to paid in a period of one month during presidential paul kagame’s visit to nyabihu district in this issue for paying residents affected expropriation is still in the process what i say is that concerned government departments are soon to finalise the process residents should wait a little bit longer as the issue is being resolved says hassan bahame the mayor of rubavu district the mayor said that issue has reached to the ministry of finance and economic planning to the affected residents gishwati area in nyabihu district has been divided into different parts including the crop farming area with terraces the animal farming area with cattle farms in place and the wilderness area where re-forestation is taking place

title: rubavuumuyobozi w’itorero ry’abadivantisiti yahaye u rwanda umugisha
content: umuyobozi w’itorero ry’abadivantisiti b’umunsi karindwi ted wilson yahamije umugisha imana yahaye ubutaka bw’u rwanda ruzinduko yagiriye karere rubavu guhera gatanu ted wilson wageze rwanda guhera mugoroba wok u kane yakiriwe bidasanzwe karere rubavu azamara ibyumweru bibiri ivugabutumwa rigamije gukangurira abanyarwanda kugandukira imana bumvira amategeko yayo n’ay’igihugu iri vugabutumwa riteganyijwe turere tw’u rwanda rizakorerwa duce dusaga akigera karere rubavu gatanu ted wilson yakiranywe ibyishimo byinshi n’imbaga y’abadivantisiti bamaze iminsi myinshi bamwiteguye cyane ibikorwa kumwitegura byari bimaze igihe kitari gito bikorwa ted wilson yavuze yashimishijwe n’uburyo yakiriwe n’abakirisito anavuga ubutaka bw’u rwanda bwahawe umugisha ndetse yongera gusaba imana gukomeza kurwongerera imigisha yahamije kuba u rwanda rufite ibyiza nyaburanga byinshi n’umutekano usesuye gisa mufite igihugu cyiza gituje ahantu nabonye heza ho kuba abanyamugisha banyarwanda naje kubasura ngira tumarane ibyumweru bibiri nabakunze cyane kandi nakunze igihugu cyanyu muratekanye ubutumwa nzatanga mfite icyizere buzacengera imitima kuko ibisabwa byose mubyujuje murusheho gukundana abakirisito b’abadivantisite bavuga uku gusura u rwanda n’akarere rubavu by’umwihariko hari umusaruro mwinshi bizatanga yaba ivugabutumwa ndetse bikorwa bifatika dore hazabaho kuvura abaturage buntu kuremera abatishoboye n’ibindi murenzi janvier umuyobozi w’akarere rubavu wungirije ushinzwe iterambere imari n’ubukungu yishimiye uru ruzinduko anavuga amahirwe menshi baturage rusange yagize uyu umugisha udasanzwe rwanda cyane abakiristo kuko amahirwe adapfa kubonwa n’igihugu aricyo cyose uru ruzinduko ruzafasha iyogezabutumwa buzima busanzwe bwongera ubukungu bw’akarere rusange iirimo kwitegura yakozwe neza kandi yatanze akazi abaturage barinjiza amahoteli agiye kwakira abashyitsi turabona inyungu zizagera bantu benshi rusange yakomeje ashimira uburyo abadivantisiti bakomeje gufasha iterambere ry’ibikorwa remezo karere rubavu gihugu rusange biteganyijwe ted wilson azigishiriza itorero y’abadiventiste ryitwa gate of hope riri mujyi gisenyi i rubavusrcimvahoyanditswe ubwanditsimuhaburarw

title: iby’ingenzi wamenya gisibo cy’ukwezi ramadhan abayoboke b’idini islam batangiye

content: umuyobozi w’akarere nyaruguru habitegeko francois avuga abajyaga bavuga aka karere ak’inzara n’ubukene bibeshyaga ahamya kaziraga imiyoborere mibi uyu munsi nzara n’ubukene bitewe title: sobanukirwa n’ibijyanye indwara y’igicuri
content: igicuri ndwara ki igicuri indwara ifata bwonko nyirizina umurwayi wayo agaragaza ibimenyetso bikurikiranye kandi ikaba ishobora kwigaragaza bitewe n’ubwoko bwayo kuko igira amoko menshi indwara y’igicuriimenyerewe cyane rwanda igira ibimenyetso nko gufata umuntu akitura hasi akagagaraagakubita umutwe hasiakarashya amaboko n’amaguru ariko hari n’ubundi bwoko bw’igicuri butamenyerewe abantu bagombye kumenya nk’uko musabyemeriya rosine ushinzwe service kwita buzima bitaro kabgayi abivuga icyo gicuri ntigitura umuntu hasi ariko gifata bwonko kirangwa n’uko umurwayi wacyo atakaza ubwenge yicaye cyangwa ahagaze buryo kumwe bashobora kubibona cyangwa akabyiyumvaho abutakaje akaba yamara igihe gito abutakaje nyuma bukagaruka ubwoko gatatu igicuri kidafata ibice byose by’umubiri nacyo gifata bwonko ariko bitewe n’agace k’ubwonko kafashwe hakagagara nk’igice kimwe cy’umubiri hari usanga bagagara nk’ibice by’intoki urugero nk’igikumwe ibiganza akaboko cyangwa igice kimwe maso n’ahandi muri rusange indwara y’igicuri ntivukanwa ahubwo hari bimwe bituma ifata umuntu ese ndwara yaba iterwa niki kimwe by’ingenzi bituma indwara y’igicuri ifata umuntu harimo kuba yakora impanuka ituma akomereka mutwe akaba yakwangirika bwonko kuburyo byakuviramo igicuri hari n’abandi barwara igicuri bitewe n’uburyo bavutsemo urugero nk’abana bato bakivuka hari ukuntu umubyeyi ashobora gutinda nda umwana akavuka yananiwe agatinda kurira rosine avuga hari igihe avuka yababaye bwonko akaba yakurizamo igicuri hari abakirwara bitewe n’uburwayi bahuye nabwo aha rosine atanga urugero rw’indwara mugiga ndwara ishobora gusigira uwayirwaye ubusembwa bwagera bwonko buryo byamuviramo indwara y’igicuri nzeyimana vincent ushinzwe kwita buzima mutwe bitaro kabgayi yongeraho har’abashobora kuvuka nko muryango umwe bakaba bafite udutsi tudatunganye neza bwonko bikaba byabaviramo uburwayi igicuri abarwara ibibyimba bwonko nabo bishobora kubatera ubumuga bwabaviramo igicuri hari n’izindi mpamvu z’imbere mubiri zishobora gutera igicuri ariko zitagaragaye inyuma umurwayi w’igicuri yafatwa ate kutita murwayi w’igicuri nibyo bituma adakira cyangwa indwara ikiyongerakenshi kenshi banyarwanda usanga umurwayi w’igicuri adakunze guhabwa agaciro nk’abandi barwayi basanzwe usanga kandi bakunze kunenwa kubera ibimenyetso bagaragaza hari nabumva amacandwe y’urwaye igicuri cyangwa umusuzi hari ingaruka byagira buzima bwabo vincent akomeza avuga bene myumvire atari ahubwo umurwayi w’igicuri umurwayi nk’abandi igifasha umurwayi w’igicuri kurusha ibindi yitabwaho akavuzwa gihe adatindijwe kuko atindijwe indwara ifata intera ndende ikarushaho kugenda ikomera gusa umurwayi w’igicuri akurikiraniwe maguru mashya ashobora gukira neza si byiza ufashwe n’indwara imutura hasiituma azana amacandwe cyangwa avugaguzwa yafatwa nk’uwafashwe n’abadayimoni cyangwa amashitani kuko hari abafite umuco kujyana abantu nk’abo nsengero kubasengera kandi rimwe rimwe igicuri barwaye ugasanga indwara irushijeho kwiyongera ni ngombwa abantu nk’abo bagomba kujyanwa muganga bagasuzumwa indwara bafite ikindi kandi si byiza urwaye igicuri yakwegerezwa umuriro kuko iruhande rw’umuriro mwuka mwiza mwinshi uhaba bikaba bishobora kugira ingaruka murwayi buryo yanakwituramo urwaye igicuri si byiza yakurira ahantu harehare yubaka cyangwa akora ibindisi byiza yatwara imodoka cyangwa ibindi binyabiziga kuko uburwayi bumufashe bishobora kugira ingaruka zikomeye abarwaje igicuri bakwiriye kwitabira kujyana abarwayi bitaro bitandukanye kuko imiti yabonetse hirya hino buryo umurwayi w’igicuri yahita yitabwaho ababyeyi bakwiye kwitabira kubyarira muganga buryo batagira ingorane z’uko umwana yavuka atinze buryo yaba afite umunaniro wamuviramo kuba yakwangirika bwonko bikaba impamvu kuba yarwara igicuri ni byiza kuvuza abana bafite umuriro hakiri kare kugira bitabaviramo kugagara bikaba byaba inkomoko y’igicurisi byiza kandi kunywa ibiyobyabwenge kuko nabyo bishobora kwangiza title: harateganywa ubushakashatsi dukingirizo tuberanye n’ingimbi
content: ibi bimwe byavugiwe kiganiro n’abanyamakuru kane tariki akaba ikiganiro cyateguwe n’ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe ubuzima ishami rishinzwe kurwanya sida iki kiganiro kikaba cyari kigamije kumenyekanisha ibizigirwa nama y’igihugu ngarukamwaka kurwanya icyorezo sida bana izabera i kigali tariki kugeza ugushyingo mwaka ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe ubuzima rwanda biomedical center rbc kivuga nubwo gahunda gukwirakwiza udukingirizo mashuri yisumbuye igifite ingorane kutumvikanwaho bitazatuma gahunda idashoboka dr anita asiimwe umuyobozi mukuru wungirije rbc avuga kubera imyaka y’abanyeshuri mashuri yisumbuye ibarirwa hagati gahunda gukwirakwiza udukingirizo mashuri yisumbuye niyemerwa hazabaho ubushakashatsi bw’udukingirizo tuberanye n’abo banyeshuri dr anita asiimwe agira hazabaho ubushakashatsi bwihuse hagamijwe kumenya udukingirizo turi isoko dutoya cyangwa tunini bana ubu hari ubushakashatsi dufite bwakozwe minisiteri y’ubuzima buvuga hari abavuga udukingirizo duhari isoko ry’u rwanda tudafite impumuro nziza n’ibi tuzabyigaho hazanwe udukingirizo dufite impumuro zidatuma hari abanga gukoresha udukingirizo ishami ry’umuryango w’abibumbye ryita muryango un family naryo rivuga u rwanda nirwemeza ikwirakwiza ry’udukingirizo mashuri yisumbuye rugomba gukora ubushakashatsi dukingirizo tuberanye n’abanyeshuri mashuri yisumbuye dr landry tsigain akorera un family avuga kumenya udukingirizo tungana kuko hari udukingirizo dushobora kuba tunini bamwe utundi tukaba duto bandi yatanze urugero bihugu by’afurika y’amajyepfo kuko higeze kuza udukingirizo tunini bagabo ubushakashatsi bwakozwe minisiteri y’ubuzima mwaka buzima bw’imyororokere y’ingimbi n’abangavu bugaragaza abakobwa batangira gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina myaka abahungu bagatangira myaka inzego z’ubuvuzi zivuga kuba hari abakobwa batwara inda mashuri yisumbuye ikimenyetso cy’uko hadafashwe ingamba zikomeye habaho ubwiyongere bw’ubwandu sida mashuri yisumbuye rubyiruko rusange jean baptiste micomyiza

title: amataragiti abiba urwango batutsi
content: amataragiti ibipapuro bidafite umukono abiba urwango batutsi yadutse gicurasi aya mataragiti bitazwi abayandikaga yandikwaga n’abantu byagaragara ishyaka aprosoma association pour la promotion de la masse umwanditsi antoine mugesera gitabo cye imibereho y’abatutsi kuri repubulika ya mbere n’iya kabiri avuga umuporosoma gihe byabaga bivuze umwanzi w’umwami ni ingingo isunikira usomye itaragiti kabuza abatutsi bashyigikiye umwami bayanditse imwe taragiti yahamagariraga abantu intambara kurwanya aprosoma yagiraga iti aprosoma irwanya kalinga izatsindwa n’imbaga y’inyabutatu aprosoma yanga u rwanda n’umwami warwo izatsindwa taragiti zahamagariraga abahutu kwanga abatutsi muri taragiti nk’uko gitabo gikomeza kivuga hari iyabonetse ndiza nzeri iyi kandi yanabonetse ruhengeri gisenyi yitirirwa yanditswe n’abatutsi mugesera avuga taragiti zari zaranditswe n’abaparmmehutu bagamije gushyushya imitwe y’abahutu bakunde bange abatutsi taragiti y’ i nyanza kuwa ukwakira yitirwe abarunar ishyira hanze yitaga abanzi b’u rwanda aba barimo p bwanakweri l ndazaro muhikira aloys b murangwa a makuza n’abandi iyi taragiti yavugaga banga umwami kandi bagomba gushakirwa hasi kubura hejuru kuwa ukwakira taragiti yabonetse isoko ry’i rwamagana iyi yamagananaga umucuruzi witwa munyabuhoro isaba abantu batazongera kugurira iduka rye kuko umwanzi w’umwami ibi byose byandikwaga bigamije kubiba urwango batutsi bitanga ubutumwa bafite umugambi kwibasira abahutu bitwaga abanzi b’umwami uku kuvuga hari abahigwa bukware hari abatazongera kugurirwa ibicuruzwa ikintu cyatuma abahutu banga abatutsi muri gitabo antoine mugesera abigarukaho p avuga parmehutu aprosoma banditse amataragiti bakayanyanyagiza ahantu byari bzwi hatuwe cyane myaka atanga urugero rw’ahantu taragiti zatanzwe bitewe n’uko habaga abantu besnhi harimo kabgayi kigali ruhengeri gisenyi kandi hose bikitwa zanditwe n’abatutsi taragiti rusange n’ubwo bigoye kwemeza abazandikaga bizwi bumwe buryo bwakoreshejwe kugeza ubutumwa bantu benshi hagamijwe guhembera urwango batutsi

title: incamake gitabo stop working for uncle sam gikebura abahora barambirije mushahara
content: abafite akazi bararira bamwe binubira umushahara w’intica ntikize bahabwa abandi barambiwe guhora bafatirwa imyanzuro y’icyo bakora igihe bagikorera n’uko bagikora ruhare babigizemo sunday adelaja umupasiteri nigeria yabavunnye amaguru gitabo cye stop working for uncle sam’ cyasohotse ni igitabo kigaragaza inzira zose wanyuramo ukareka gukorera abandi gukoreshwa ugatangira gukoresha abandi iki gitabo kigereranya abakorera umushahara nk’abacakara bahorana ubukene bw’amafaranga bagenerwa utuvungukira murundo w’ibyo babiriye icyuya kandi hari uburyo nabo bakwiteza imbere umwanditsi asobanura uncle sam nk’ahantu hose ujya gushaka akazi cyangwa uburyo bw’imikorere imibereho yawe uyikesha muntu cyangwa urwo rwego ruguha umushahara kubaho ukorera abandi sunday abigereranya nk’ubucakara buburizamo ubwigenge bw’umuntu ukora bakubwiye cyose mwanya gutekereza cyangwa gukora ibintu nk’uko wowe ubishaka ati mu gihe ukorera uncle sam uba wishyira bucakara bushake bwawe kubera akwishyura udufaranga tw’intica ntikize kubera utwo tuntu duke uremera ukagurisha ubuzima bwawe ukagurisha ukwishyira ukizana kwawe uba uboshye udashobora guhindukira ugane iburyo cyangwa ibumoso ntushobora kuvuga ugiye biruhuko igihe ushakiye umukoresha wawe atabyemeye ntushobora kwihitiramo ngiye n’aha gihe wenda cy’ukwezi uba uziritswe ni igitabo kigaragaza uburyo guhunga ubucakara kuba umukozi ahubwo ukaba umukoresha ukareka kuba muntu uhorana ubukene kandi ukora buri munsi iki gitabo kigaragaza kandi abantu badakwiye kumva bakwikorera ahubwo bashobora gukorera abandi bakitanga bishoboka ariko batameze nk’abacakara agira inama abantu bakwiriye kwirinda kuguma kazi banga kuko kukagumamo bituma bagakora nabi kurusha bikarangira bashwanye n’abakoresha ingingo gukoresha igihe neza nayo umwanditsi ayigarukaho asobanura igihe kigereranywa n’ubuzima kugikoresha nabi bikaba bisa kwangiza ubuzima bwawe asobanura kandi ibyiza kwiga ariko bundi buryo usanga abantu benshi bumva kwiga bakaminuza bihagije kugira babeho buzima bwiza bifuza avuga atari ndetse bitanahuye iki gitabo cy’amapaji kiboneka amazon

biro nshingwabikorwa y’itorero inkuru nziza rwanda igaragaza impamvu enye zishimangira pasiteri ngaboyisonga adakwiye kuguma nshingano bavugamo umwiryane n’ibibazo uruhuri bikomeje kuba torero ahanini bituruka mashusho y’urukozasoni ataravuzweho rumweumuvugizi w’itorero inkuru nziza rwanda pastor ngaboyisonga theoneste wagaragaye mashusho y’urukozasoni yasabwe kwegura maguru mashya izindi nkuru wasoma bombori bombori itorero inkuru nziza umuvugizi waryo wagaragaye yikinisha ntiyoroheweiby’umuyobozi w’itorero inkuru nziza wagaragaye yikinisha byahagurukije komite idasanzwe rgb yahagurukiye ibibazo biri itorero inkuru nziza byazamuwe n’umuvugizi waryo ingingo mbere baruwa igira iti dushingiye bibazo by’urudaca bikomeje kugaragara itorero inkuru nziza rwanda bishingiye mwuka n’ibice itorero vdeo y’urukozasoni yagaragaye ikaba ikomeje kugarukwaho ahantu hose hagaragaye ibibazo kandi komite nyobozi nama yayo itariki twashakishirizaga hamwe umuzi nyamukuru w’ibibazo byari itorero bantu bayirimo bakemeza video ariwo muzi nyamukuru muri baruwa yashyizweho umukono n’abayobozi b’iri torero barimo pastor ngendahayo juvenal umuvugizi mukuru wungirije w’iri torero pastor kagumya alfred umunyamabanga ndetse n’umubitsi w’itorero pastor nizeyimana jean de dieu aho bagaragaza basaba ngaboyisonga umuyobozi mukuru wabo yakwegura rwego kurengera itorero kristo aba bakozi b’imana kandi bavuze bandikiye ibaruwa mugenzi wabo bamusaba kwegura bashingiye nama bahawe rgb nyuma y’ibiherutse kubera kamembe rusizi kuwa gicurasi abakirisitu bashyamiranye ndetse banarwanira rusengero bakavuga byaturutse nzandiko ngaboyisonga yagiye yandikira bamwe bapasiteri none uru rusengero rw’itorero inkuru nziza i kamembe rukaba rwarafunzwe gihe kitazwi mu kiganiro yagiranye n’ikinyamakuru ukwezicom umuvugizi mukuru wungirije w’itorero inkuru nziza rwanda pastor ngendahayo juvenal yavuze matora yabaye tariki mbere ndetse n’imyanzuro y’inama ikaba yarasinyiwe igisigaye ugushyikirizwa n’ubwo atari yayitabiriye pasiteri jvenal kandi yavuze rgb iherutse gutanga iminsi gusa kugira torero ribe ryamaze gukemura ibibazo rifite nayo mpamvu bashe umwanzuro ikitaraganya kweguza babonaga nk’izingiro ry’ibyo bibazo pastor juvenal yakomeje avuga bashaka kugarura isura nziza y’itorero ry’imana kugeza twari tuvuye n’aho tugeze ntabwo itorero ry’inkuru nziza ryumvikanaga neza ariko tugiye gukora ukugarura ubumwe itorero

content: bagosora nsengiyumva barajuririra igihano cy’igifungo burundu bahawe kubera ibyaha jenoside n’ibindi byaha byibasiye inyoko muntu ntawukulilyayo yajuririye igihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka yakatiwe kubera uruhare yagize jenoside ku itariki ukuboza nibwo bagosora wahoze ayobora ibiro minisitiri w’ingabo yakatiwe nyuma guhamwa n’ibyaha jenoside ibyaha byibasiye ikiremwamuntu n’ibyaha by’intambara birimo kwica uwari minisitiri w’intebe agathe uwilingiyimana n’abandi basirikare b’ababiligi onu bagosora anashinjwa kugira uruhare ishyirwaho bariyeri hirya hino kigali gisenyi hagati y’itariki mata nsengiyumva ukuriye ibikorwa gisirikare gisenyi yahamijwe ubwicanyi bakorewe kaminuza mudende paruwasi nyundo ndetse n’ubwicanyi bwakorewe abasivili gice ayoboye yanahamijwe kandi kuba yarohereje ibitero by’interahamwe bisesero kwica abatutsi bagosora nsengiyumva baburanishirijwe igihe kimwe hamwe n’abandi basirikare babiri aribo brigadier-general gratien kabiligi major aloys ntabakuze kabiligi yahisevarekurwa ntabakuze ajurira rubanza rwabaye itariki werurwe urubanza ntabakuze rwaje gutandukanywa n’urwabandi nyuma y’aho uwamwunganiraga mategeko umunyamerika peter erlinder ananiriwe kwitaba urukiko tariki werurwe ubujurire bwe bwaje gusomwa tariki nzeri na nubu buracyakomeza ntawukulilyayo yakatiwe igihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka kubera uruhare yagize bwicanyi bwakorewe kibuye n’i butare umunyamakuru kigali today

title: izindi mpunzi zageze rwanda ziturutse libya
content: u rwanda rwakiriye icyiciro kabiri cy’impunzi zaturutse libya nshuro rwakiriye bageze rwanda basanga abandi bahageze kwezi gushize u rwanda rwakiriye icyiciro kabiri cy’impunzi zaturutse libya nshuro rwakiriye bageze rwanda basanga abandi bahageze kwezi gushize izi mpunzi zageze kibuga mpuzamahanga cy’indege kigali i kanombe ahagana saa sita n’igice gatanu tariki ukwakira impunzi z’abimukira b’ abanyafurika zizanwa rwanda zikuwe libya zituzwa nkambi gashora ubu hamaze kugera ku nzeri nibwo guverinoma y’u rwanda umuryango afurika yunze ubumwe au n’ishami ry’umuryango wabibumbye ryita mpunzi unhcr bashyize umukono masezerano y’ubufatanye azatuma gihugu cyakira impunzi zizaturuka libya zahageze zishakisha amayira yazambutsa mditerrane zikagera i burayi aya masezerano azatuma rwakira impunzi zigera yasinyiwe i addis ababa cyicaro au nyuma y’ubushake perezida paul kagame yagaragaje bw’uko u rwanda rwakwakira mpunzi z’abanyafurika mu mpunzi zageze rwanda harimo ab’igitsina gabo b’igitsina gore harimo abagera batarageza imyaka y’ubukure bakomoka bihugu bitatu bitandukanye harimo bava eritrea bava somalia babiri bakomoka sudani nk’uko minisiteri ishinzwe ibikorwa by’ubutabazi minema yabitangaje twitter yavuze bazacumbikirwa nkambi y’agateganyo gashora iherereye karere bugesera itsinda ry’impunzi zahageze mbere zicumbikiwe tariki ukwakira perezida kagame yaganiraga n’ urubyiruko youth connekt yavuze mpunzi zijya kuzanwa rwanda hagendewe mahitamo

title: sosiyete nshya y’ubwishingizi igiye gutangira
content: iyi sosiyete ivukiye cogear isanzwe ikora ibijyanye n’ubwishingizi butandukanye izaba ikora sosiyete ukwayo ifite umugabane shingiro ungana miliyari y’amafaranga y’u rwanda frw umuyobozi mukuru cogear alain kabeja avuga gahunda gushinga sosiyete nshyashya y’ubwishingizi yigenga igamije gushyira bikorwa basabwe banki nkuru y’igihugu agira tubaye abambere gushyira bikorwa twasabwe bnr yuko tugomba gutandukanya ubwishingizi bw’ubuzima n’ubundi bwishingizi dutanga kabeja ntabwo yavuze neza igihe sosiyete izatangirira ariko yavuze vuba abafatabuguzi cogear baniteguye gukorana n’iyi sosiyete nshya basabye bashyirirwaho agasanduku k’ibitegerezo umurongo telefone utishyurwa ndetse n’ibihembo bafatabuguzi bitwara neza gatoto eugene umwe bafatabuguzi yavuze abafatabuguzi bifuza serivisi zitangwa cogear zagaragara interineti ndetse n’impapuro zuzuzwa zikajya zishyirwa kinyarwanda cyongereza sosiyete y’ubwishingizi cogear yafunguye imiryango mwaka w’ jean noel mugabo

title: nyamashekepadiri nambajimana yasezeye murimo w’ubupadiri
content: nyuma y’imyaka isaga itanu ahawe isakaramentu ry’ubusaserdotipadiri nambajimana donatien wakoreraga ubutumwa paruwasi nyamasheke diyosezi cyangugu yasezeye murimo w’ubupadiri mpamvu ziswe ize bwite padiri nambajimana uzwi izina mushi yasezeye gicamunsi cy’ejo kabiri tariki ukuboza umwe bapadiri babanye wifuje amazina atajya nkuru yemeje amakuru ariko avuga impamvu yatumye mugenzi asezera batarayimenya ati twahawe ubutumwa padiri mukuru paruwasi nyamasheke atubwira mugenzi wacu yasezeye atakiri murimo w’ubupadiri kiliziya gatolika kubera impamvu ze bwite yakomeje agira donatien twaganiraga nk’abihaye imana ariko yakuye igitekerezo bupadiri sinahamenya kuko wabonaga afite umuhamagaro’’ nshimiyimana alexis padiri mukuru paruwasi nyamasheke yirinze kugira avuga kubivugwa nambajimana yasezeye mirimo ati ibyo sinjye ubitangaza mwabaza nyir’ubwite cyangwa musenyeri diyosezi gikongoro gusa kugeza magingo padiri nambajimana ntabwo aratangaza neza icyatumye afata icyemezo gusezera murimo w’imana w’ubupadiri yanditswe habarurema djamali
