title: nange nigeze kuba umukanishi minisitiri johson busingye
content: minisitri w’ubutabera akaba n’intumwa leta yatekereje urubyiruko rwamutuye ikibazo kubura akazi yitwaye nyuma kurangiza amashuri yisumbuye agategereje johnston busingye yaganirizaga urubyiruko rw’impfubyi jenoside yakorewe abatutsi minisiteri ayoboye yazisuraga karere huye murenge ngoma zicumbitse bifatanye bihe by’iminsi mikuru ni rugo rurimo abahungu n’abakobwa bageze bagiye bakurwa ahantu hatandukanye mashuri yisumbuye bitewe n’uko bajyaga babura bataha bihe by’ibiruhuko nyuma haza gutekerezwa kubashakira icumbi bahuriyeho yabwiye basore n’inkumi amwe mateka gushaka akazi nyuma kurangiza amashuri yisumbuye arusaba rutagomba kwicara rutegereze akazi imfubyi jenocide zatujwe nzu i huye minisitiri busingye yagize njyewe nakoze igaraje ndagije kwiga amategeko abantu bakandeba bakabona ndi umukanishi usobanutse ariko nkavuga umwanya kwirirwa nicaye rugo njye njya hariya nibabwira jya kuzana icyuma nkizane nisabwa gusunika imodoka nyisunike’ yakomeje agira ubu nzi kuvana ipine modoka kurusha abakanishi babaho ariko byatumye abantu benshi cyane bamenya ntangira kubona akazi muri bwana bwiza bwanyu ngeso nziza zanyu mugukundana kwanyu mukunde umurimo umurimo niwo ugutoranya akeshi cyane umurimo uragutoranya si wowe uwutoranya minisitiri busingye yabwiye uru rubyiruko n’abanyaburayi bafatwa nk’abateye imbere abakora mahoteli abana biga kaminuza b’abazungu uku yabivuze magambo bwite tujya i burayi kenshi usanga mahoteli hose abana b’abazungu babakora mahoteli abana biga kaminuza ni bacuranga batuma isoko bagabura kandi mbantekerezako bafite imiryango bakomokamo yakomeje agira niba ushaka akazi ntako ufite ntutangira ugira uti ndashaka kuba meya cyangwa umwungirije cyangwa ndashaka kuba mwarimu nintakabona ntabwo nzakora avuga abafite akazi myanya itandukanye bafite amateka y’ibyo batangiriyeho bitandukanye kandi niyo nzira kugera kazi ikoreshwa isi hose muri bana batangira imiryango bahungu banamubwiye n’uwagira amikoro make kubaka bitamworohera kubera kubura inkwano minisitiri yavuze bishimishije kuko bana bageze bakenera inkwano kuri twe byinshimo bikomeye cyane rwose nagira n’ikibazo cy’inkwano muzakidushinge ntabwo dushaka abasore n’inkumi bajyaho bakifuza kubana ariko inkwano ikababera ikibazo avuga kibazo uzajya akigira azajya akibamenyesha bakakigaho kuko bagiye bazingwa byaba bibi minisitiri kandi yanabasezeranyije kubafasha kurangiza ikibazo cy’abagikurikiranye imitungo yangijwe jenoside itarishyurwa ku kibazo cy’abatsindwa bakabura amafaranga kwishyura ibizimani batsinzinzwe nk’uko bitegenywa minisiteri y’uburezi minisitiri yabasabye kwiga bashyizeho umwete bakirinda gutsindwa yanditswe ubwanditsimuhaburarw

title: amashyaka rud urunana rnc yashyizwe majwi kugira indiri uganda
content: u rwanda rurasaba uganda gusenya indiri z’amashyaka rnc rud urunana uganda ikavuga hari abaturage bayo bafungiwe rwanda binyuranije n’amategeko ni nama gatatu komisiyo gusuzuma ishyirwa bikorwa ry’amasezerano luanda agamije kugarura umubano hagati y’u rwanda uganda yabereye i kigali gatanu taliki gashyantare muri biganirointumwa z’ibihugu byombi zagaragaje ibikoma nkokora umubano wabyo uganda izana ikibazo gishya cy’abagande bafungiye rwanda buryo bunyuranije n’amategeko umunyamabanga leta minisiteri y’ububanyi n’amahanga amb olivier nduhungirehe uyoboye itsinda ry’u rwanda yagarutse mitwe y’iterabwoba ifite indiri uganda iyo mitwe igamije guhungabanya umutekano w’u rwanda irimo rnc rud-urunana u rwanda rukaba rusaba uganda guhagarika ibikorwa gushyigikira mitwe ndetse igafatira ibihano abayobozi nzego z’icyo gihugu bakomeje kuyitera inkunga nduhungirehe yavuze u rwanda rusaba uganda gusenya ibikorwa rnc rud urunana ugandagufata ndetse ikohereza rwanda abarwanyi bateye kinigi bahungiye butaka bwayo mu bindi u rwanda rusaba uganda harimo guhagarika pasiporo uganda no a yahawe charlotte mukankusi usanzwe komiseri rnc ushinzwe dipolomasi imufasha kugenda yamamaza amatwara rnc ikindi ugukurikirana abantu bakorana rnc rud urunana barimo umunyamabanga leta philemon mateke brig gen abel kandiho uyobora cmi brig gen fred karara col sike asiimwe major fred mushambo col kaka bagyenda n’abandi bayobozi bagira uruhare bikorwa kohereza rwanda umubiri samuel mageza gutanga ibisobanuro rupfu rwe kimwe n’abandi banyarwanda babiri sendegeya theogene rwembo mucyo boherejwe bitaro butabika bavanwe cmi nyuma bakaza kuburirwa irengero ikindi ukwemerera umunyarwandakazi julienne kayirere kongera guhura n’umwana joanna imanirakiza umaze ukwezi kumwe nyuma kubatandukanyiriza uganda yafatwaga ugushyingo karere mubende nduhungirehe yasoje asaba uganda kurekura mananiza abanyarwanda bafungiwe uganda buryo bunyuranyije n’amategeko leta y’u rwanda yongeye gushimangira igisubizo bibazo biri mubano w’ibihugu byombi bitazava nama nyinshi zikorwa gihe uganda bushake igaragaza guhagarika imigambi mibisha rwanda n’abanyarwanda batuye n’abagenda gihugu ku ruhande uganda minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga uganda sam kutesayavuze ntangiriro z’uyu mwaka barekuye abanyarwanda bafungiwe uganda ndetse n’abandi bafunzwe bagiye kugezwa imbere y’ubutabera kutesa agasaba u rwanda kurekura abanya uganda rufunze buryo budakurikije amategeko ibi birego byahise biterwa utwatsi amb olivier nduhungirehe uyoboye intumwa z’u rwanda biganiro washinje uganda kuyobya uburari kibazo ambnduhungirehe olivier yavuze abanya uganda maboko y’ubutabera bw’u rwanda nyuma gukatirwa n’inkiko kandi abadipolomate uganda n’abandi babyifuza bakaba bemerewe kubasura nkomyi nduhungirehe yagaragaje kandi amasezerano luanda yashyirwaho umukono abanya-uganda maboko y’ubutabera barekuwe nyuma kuburanishwa n’inkiko biteganyijwe tariki z’uku kwezi abakuru bine bazahurira mupaka gatuna karegeya omar

content: mu bihe by’imvura aribyo tunarimo rwanda usanga aribwo hamera ibigunda nkike z’ingo nyinshi cyane biturage nk’uko mukambungo esperance umujyanama w’ubuzima mudugudu rubugurizoumurenge shyogwe title: eu yashyizeho ambasaderi uzayihagarira bwongereza nyuma brexit
content: umuryango w’ubumwe bw’u burayi eu wamaze guhitamo umunya-portugal joao vale de almeida kuwubera ambasaderi wawo mbere bwongereza nyuma y’aho gihugu kigiye kuwuvamo joao vale de almeida umudipolomate ubimazemo igihe kuko yagiye ahagararira muryango i washington leta zunze ubumwe amerika loni mu gihe biteganyijwe u bwongereza buzava muryango tariki mutarama mwaka eu yahisemo mugabo kuzaba ambasaderi ufite icyicaro i londres joao vale de almeida azatangira imirimo tariki gashyantare mwaka nyuma y’umunsi umwe u bwongereza buvuye eu abayobozi eu bavuze bamaze kumenyesha leta y’u bwongereza iby’uyu muyobozi mushya joao vale de almeida yavutse i lisbon portugal akaba yize ibijyanye n’amateka yabaye umunyamakuru mbere y’uko ajya muryango mu joao vale de almeida yabaye ambasaderi mbere eu amerika aza guhagarira muryango loni hagati nyuma gutoranywa mwanya joao vale de almeida yagize ni iby’agaciro kuba ngiye mwanya niteguye gukomeza guteza imbere inyungu z’uyu muryango kwitegura imibanire mishya hagati y’u bwongereza eu tariki mutarama mwaka nibwo umuyobozi komisiyo y’umuryango w’ubumwe bw’u burayi n’uw’akanama k’uwo muryango bashyize umukono masezerano yemerera u bwongereza gusohoka eu ibi biraharurira inzira u bwongereza gusohoka muryango mutarama umuyobozi komisiyo eu ursula von der leyen ndetse n’uw’akanama kayo charles michel nibo bashyize umukono masezerano kumwe n’intumwa ihagarariye u bwongereza rugendo brexit michel barnier gushyira umukono masezerano bisobanuye akomereza nteko ishinga amategeko eu mutarama akemezwa burundu byitezwe kizatuma masezerano atemezwa burundu ku kane nibwo umwamikazi w’u bwongereza elizabeth ii yemeje burundu ibikubiye masezerano kwivana eu gusa minisitiri w’intebe boris johnson ntarasinya inteko ishinga amategeko eu niyemeza amasezerano avana u bwongereza muryango buzahita buwuvamo mutarama icyakora buzahita bwinjira gihe cy’inzibacyuho kizageza ukuboza muri gihe u bwongereza eu bagomba kwemeranya umubano wabyo urimo umutekano amategeko gusangira amakuru bagomba kandi kwemeranya bijyanye n’ubucuruzi

title: sinzatuza umugabo wanjye adahawe ubutabera - umupfakazi hategikimana wishwe cmi uganda
content: hategekimana yagejejwe rwanda nyuma y’amezi atatu bagenzi batotezwa cmi murwa mukuru kampala bashinjwa kuba intasi z’u rwanda bahageze kamena bacishijwe mupaka kagitumba nyirahabimana w’imyaka yavuze umugabo wapfuye nyuma y’iminsi mike ageze rwanda yishwe cmi kuko raporo muganga zagaragaje urupfu rwe ingaruka z’ibyo yakorewe yagize cmi yishe umugabo wanjye ntabwo nshobora kugoheka kugeza abonye ubutabera n’ubwo atakiri kumwe natwe hategekimana umwe banyarwanda bafunganywe itorero adepr uganda umugore yabwiye the new times bagezwa mupaka kagitumba bafite ibikomere mutwe hategikimana ageze rwanda yatangiye kubabara gituza ajyanwa bitaro kacyiru babonye uburwayi bwe bukomeye abaganga bemeje yoherezwa bitaro gisirikare kanombe kugira akorerwe irindi suzuma umupfakazi hategikimana yavuze umugabo afite ikibazo kubabara gituza iburyo ibintu atari yarigeze agira buzima bwe myaka namumenye ageze bitaro kanombe umuganga wamusuzumye yasabye anyuzwa cyuma ivuriro legacy clinics gusa bw’amahirwe make yaje guhita apfa isuzuma rikorerwa uwitabye imana ryagaragaje hategikimana yari afite imvune y’urubavu rwego gatanu n’ikibazo cy’amaraso yarikusanyirije hagati y’igituza n’ibihaha hemothorax hamwe kwangirika ibihaha yari afite kandi ikibazo cy’impyiko y’ibumoso yangiritse n’ibikomere nda raporo y’isuzuma yaasinyweho n’abaganga b’inzobere batanu igaragaza urupfu hategekimana atari urusanzwe’ rwatewe gukubitwa cyane gituza nda hategikimana yasize umugore n’abana batatu barimo abakobwa babiri n’umuhungu umwe bashakanye babanza gutura karere musanze nyirahabimana yatangaje umugabo umuntu mwiza wita muryango kandi usenga mu gahinda kenshi yagize yari yariyeguriye gukorera itorero kwita bana dufite ikibazo cy’uburyo tuzabaho kuko nzu twagiraga yakomeje umugabo wanjye yashinjwe kuba intasi y’u rwanda ikinyoma gikomeye kuko yakoraga kampala byari ukwigisha ijambo ry’imana gukora ubumotari ntabwo yigeze ajya politike n’inyungu abifitemo mbere y’uko apfa hategekimana bagenzi barindwi barajyanye leta uganda rukiko rw’umuryango afurika y’iburasirazuba basaba kurenganurwa iyicarubozo bakorewe yapfuye mbere y’uko ahabwa ubutabera mu nibwo umuryango hategikimana wageze uganda ndetse nyirahabimana avuga baje kubona ubwenegihugu uganda yavuze ibintu byaje guhinduka werurwe abantu bambaye imyenda gisirikare bashimutaga hategikimana n’abandi bagenzi bakoranaga adepr bakorerwa iyicarubozo ryaje kumuviramo urupfu

title: ingengo y’imari y’u rwanda iziyongeraho miliyari frw
content: ingengo y’imari izagera miliyari frw ivuye frw yakoreshejwe mwaka w’ingengo y’imari ushize byatangajwe minisitiri w’imari n’igenamigambi dr ndagijimana uzziel yagezaga nteko ishinga amategeko imitwe yombi imbanzirizamushinga y’ingengo y’imari izakoreshwa mwaka iyi ngengo y’imari yaje gihe u rwanda n’isi rusange bihanganye n’icyorezo coronavirus cyatumye bimwe bikorwa by’ubukungu n’iterambere bisubira inyuma minisitiri dr ndagijimana yavuze kubera guhungabana kw’ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi byavagamo imisoro bizagira ingaruka misoro yakusanywaga buryo imisoro izinjizwa izagabanuka ikagera miliyari frw ugereranyije miliyari frw yakusanyijwe ngengo y’imari gusozwa mu kuziba icyuho cy’imisoro kuzakusanywa dr ndagijimana yavuze guverinoma izongera inguzanyo ziva hanze gihugu hibandwa zihendutse kandi hubahirizwa igipimo ntarengwa cy’umwenda w’igihugu amafaranga akomoka imbere gihugu habariwemo n’inguzanyo z’imbere gihugu azaba miliyari frw bingana by’ingengo y’imari inkunga z’amahanga zizaba zingana miliyari frw ukuvuga by’ingengo y’imari gihe inguzanyo z’amahanga zizaba miliyari frw bingana by’ingengo y’imari muri rusange amafaranga ava imbere gihugu wongeyeho inguzanyo z’amahanga igihugu kizishyura afite uruhare rungana ngengo y’imari itaha dr ndagijimana yavuze amafaranga menshi azakoreshwa ngengo y’imari isanzwe ibikorwa bihora bigaruka kuko angana miliyari frw azakoreshwa mishinga y’iterambere azagera miliyari frw miliyari frw azakoreshwa bikorwa by’ishoramari leta muri bikorwa by’ishoramari leta harimo gushyigikira ibikorwa by’abikorera guhangana n’ingaruka z’icyorezo coronavirus kwagura ibikorwa rwandair kongerera ubushobozi banki y’igihugu itsura amajyambere brd minisiteri y’imari n’igenamigambi igaragaza guverinoma izibanda cyane cyane ngamba kuzahura ubukungu kubaka urwego rw’ubuzima rukomeye hibandwa kongera ibikorwa remezo kongera umusaruro w’ibikomoka buhinzi n’ubworozi kongera imbaraga gahunda kuzamura imibereho myiza y’abaturage kongera imirimo hihutishwa imishinga y’ibikorwa remezo n’ibindi ubukungu buzazamukaho kubera icyorezo coronavirus ubukungu isi hose buzagabanuka ubw’u rwanda byitezwe buzazamuka gipimo mwaka buvuye bwazamutseho umwaka ushize icyakora minisitiri ndagijimana yavuze kubera ingamba zafashwe kuzahura ubukungu biteganyijwe ubukungu bw’u rwanda mwaka buzazamuka gipimo mu mwaka u rwanda rwohereza hanze bizagabanukaho rutumizayo bigabanukeho iterambere ry’urwego rw’ubuhinzi riziyongera gipimo ibihingwa ngandurarugo biziyongera gipimo urwego rw’inganda ruzazamuka gipimo urw’ubwubatsi ruziyongera gipimo urwego serivisi ruzamukeho kubera ingaruka coronavirus cyane cyane bukerarugendo kwakira inama umusaruro w’amahoteli resitora uteganyijwe kugabanuka kigero - uw’ubwikorezi ukazamanuka gipimo - ku ngengo y’imari yateganyirijwe umwaka hagaragajwe imaze gukoreshwa gipimo kandi ukurikije ibikorwa guverinoma izishyurwa kamena umwaka w’ingengo y’imari uzarangira ikoreshejwe neza

title: paruwasi rwamagana yizihije yubile y’imyaka
content: byabaye gatandatu tariki nzeri birori byabanjirijwe n’umutambagiro mutagatifu n’igitambo misa byitabiriwe n’abayobozi batandukanye haba nzego leta buyobozi bukuru kiliziya byabereye imbere y’iyi kiliziya iherereye mujyi rwamagana byitabirwa n’abasenyeri barimo arikiyepisikopi kigali musenyeri antoine kambanda musenyeri filipo rukamba butare musenyeri anaclet mwumvaneza nyundo musenyeri kizito bahujimihogo hari kandi guverineri mufulukye fred senateri mukabaramba alvera n’abandi bayobozi bakuru nzego leta kiliziya rwamagana yaragijwe umwamikazi w’imitsindo iherereye diyosezi kibungo ikaba iya zashinzwe mbere rwanda nyuma save yashinzwe zaza nyundo rwaza mibirizi kabgayi runda rulindo kansi kigali rambura yihariye amateka arimo kubyara izindi paruwasi zikomeye cyane zirimo kiziguro musha mukarange rukara n’izindi yihariye kandi amateka kubakwa butaka bwari ubw’umutware wategekaga igice cy’ubuganza witwaga rwabutogo francisco akaba yaranayitundiye amatafari gihe yubakwagwa mu ijambo yagejeje bakristu bitabiriye muhango arikiyepisikopi kigali akanaba n’umuyobozi diyosezi kibungo antoine kambanda yashimiye abakristu bitabiriye muhango abasaba gukomeza kwita title: gakenke inkeragutabara n’abafasha barahuguwe mateka
content: kubakira byiza mateka y’u rwanda kugira uruhare kubungabunga umutekano hatangwa amakuru gihe muntu wese wahungabanya umutekano bimwe byagarutsweho mahugurwa yateguwe komisiyo gusubiza buzima busanzwe agenewe inkeragutabara n’abafasha yabereye biro by’akarere gakenke ukwakira afungura mahugurwa umuyobozi komisiyo gusubiza buzima busanzwe abahoze rugamba ntara y’amajyaruguru madamu niyonteze clemence yasabye abitabiriye mahugurwa kuyakurikirana neza kuko ingirakamaro mibereho n’abaturanyi yakomeje avuga mahugurwa agamije guhugura cyane cyane abagore b’inkeragutabara bagahugukirwa gahunda leta dore batigeze bahugurwa bagaruka rwababyaye ndetse kumenya ibibazo bafite bwana safali wilson watanze ikiganiro mateka y’u rwanda mahugurwa yasobanuriye abitariye amahugurwa imvano y’amateka yateye jenoside yakorewe abatutsi yavuze abazungu banditse kandi bakigisha amateka y’u rwanda bayagoreka nkana kugira bacemo ibice abanyarwanda babashe kubategeka bise cyongereza divide and rule by’umwihariko ababiligi banditse amateka y’abanyarwanda bagendeye mateka y’amacakubiri gihugu cyabo hagati y’abafurama flamands n’abawaru wallons dore iwabo byacikaga hagati yayo moko uretse bakoroni safali yakomeje avuga natwe ubwacu twabigizemo uruhare cyane cyane ubutegetsi butandukanye bwagiye busimburana bwahembereye macukubiri kugeza abanyarwanda barangajwe imbere n’ubutegetsi bubi bamburaga ubuzima abavandimwe basaga miliyoni asobanura ikigenderewe kwiga amateka yavuze kubaka ejo hazaza bwana safali yagize kumenya amateka yacu bidufasha kwirinda amabi jenoside tukubakira mateka meza bidufasha kandi kumenya twatsinzwe n’aho twatsinze nk’abanyarwanda ni byiza kwiga amateka kuko ushaka kwiyibagiza amateka ashaka kuyasubiramo ibyo bigamije kubaka ejo hazaza h’igihugu cyacu kizira amacakubiri n’ingengabiterezo jenoside umutekano isoko y’iterambere lt muhozi charles ubarizwa batayo ikorera karere gakenke watanze ikiganiro mutekano yavuze iterambere u rwanda rwagezeho rurikesha umutekano niyo mpamvu tugomba kuwubungabunga kugira tutazasubira inyuma yibukije abitariye amahugurwa batagomba kwirara bagomba gutanga amakuru gihe muntu wese ushobora kuhungabanya umutekano koloneli karegeya claudien komisiyo gusubiza buzima busanzwe witandukanyije fdlr yabasabye gukangurira abavandimwe ndetse n’inshuti zabo zikiri mashyamba kongo gutahuka bagafatanya n’abandi banyarwanda kubaka igihugu cyabo kandi abizeza kuzabafasha kubagezaho butumwa izo nkeragutabara zitandukanyije fdlr zinjijwe gahunda zitandukanye z’iterambere barihirwa amashuri y’imyuga barubakiwe bavanwa nyakatsi ndetse baninjizwa gahunda gira inka mushimiyimana jeannette umwe mubakurikiranye mahugurwa avuga mahugurwa yayungukiyemo byinshi yavuze yasobanukiwe imvano jenoside amateka yagoretswe akaba agiye gufata iya mbere akayarwanya avuga amateka y’ukuri kandi agomba kubaka igihugu cy’u rwanda ayo mahugurwa yitabiriwe n’inkeragutabara hamwe n’abafasha basaga baturutse turere twa rulindo gakenke batahutse bava mashyamba repubulika iharanira demokarasi kongo guhera kugeza mwaka turimo nshimiyimana leonard

title: umunyamakuru christelle yabaye iciro ry’imigani kubera kuza kiganiro televiziyo y’igihugu yasinze
content: kabagire christelle umunyamakurukazi usanzwe akorera ikigo cy’igihugu cy’itangazamakuru rba akomeje kuba iciro ry’imigani nyuma yaho agaragaye televiziyo y’igihugu agwirirana anavuga amateshwa kandi ururimi rudasohoka kubera isindwe ibi byabaye mugoroba gatanu tariki mata kiganiro the jam asanzwe akorana dj bissossokabagire ntiyorohewe mbuga nkoranyambaga abari bakurikiye kiganiro batunguwe kubona munyamakurukazi atungutse kiganiro atangira kuvuga ahuzagurika anavuga ibintu bidahuye muri kiganiro batumiye itsinda ry’abanyarwenya day makers christelle yavuze inkuru nyinshi azivangavanga gihe gito ariko yitsa cyane diamond zari yavuze uburyo zari umugore udasobanutse mbere yaho yabanje akomoza dj bissosso turi kumwe dj bissosso ukora akazi kadasanzwe asetsa abantu buryo budashobotse agasetsa abantu badashaka guseka ariko akabasetsa ngufu ururimi rudasohoka yongeye mbere y’uko dukomeza reka tugaruka zari umugore udasobanutse yakundanye n’umuntu bita diamond platnumzariko aramuhiga hejuru hasi hirya y’ejo yerekanye amafoto y’ukuntu afite umugabo mushya umuha indabyo cheri uzi gutanga indabyo ugatanga n’ibihumbi by’amadorali byaraducanze ariko ndavuga nti ariko se zari bimeze gute aravuga umugabo yarankunze arashaka kuzankoresha ubukwe ariko ndacyabitekerezaho ubukwe bwanjye nzabuhe valeur agaciro y’amafaranga angana gute yahise abaza umwe tsinda ry’abanyarwenya urumva zari amafaranga yaha valeur y’ubukwe bwe bwaba buhagaze gute tubwire byinshi ndabizi zari bashobora kuba bafite piscine rugo iwe ziriya ndabyo zizakura zishobora kubyara abana uyu munyamakurukazi yabaye iciro ry’imigani hari amakuru kigali post ifite avuga christelle yageraga kazi yangiwe gukora kiganiro kuko abakiyobora babonaga yaganjwe manyinya ariko akomeza guhatiriza ndetse abaca rihumye ikiganiro cyarimo kiba live abatumirwa kumwe dj bissosso arahasesekaye afata micro mu mashusho yashyizwe mbuga nkoranyambaga benshi bagaragaje banenze cyane munyamakuru utiyubashye ntiyubahe televiziyo y’igihugu kugeza ubuyobozi bw’ikigo cy’igihugu cy’itangazamakuru rba natacyo buratangaza byabaye

title: singapore abanyarwanda bifatanyije kwibuka jenoside yakorewe abatutsi biyemeza kurwanya abayihakana
content: ni igikorwa cyabimburiwe gufata umwanya kwibuka kwenyegeza urumuri rw’icyizere guha icyubahiro abasaga miliyoni bazize jenoside yakorewe abatutsi ni igikorwa cyitabiriwe n’abanyarwanda basaga bihugu singapore australie nouvelle zelande indonesia hamwe n’abari rwanda n’ahandi mu buhamya yatanze umuhoza frida warokotse jenoside utuye mujyi melbourne australie yavuze urugendo yanyuzemo jenoside nk’umwana w’umukobwa ufite imyaka nyuma y’ibihe byabanjirije jenoside byaranzwe kubiba urwango amacakubiri n’itotezwa byakorerwaga abatutsi ibintu yabonye afite imyaka itandatu agitangira amashuri yavuze nubwo umuryango wishwe jenoside agasigarana ihungabana rikomeye ndetse yihebye yabonye akibyibuka nk’ibyabaye ejo buryo bibabaje kuba hari abagerageza guhakana jenoside yakorewe abatutsi yavuze inshingano buri wese kurwanya ingengabitekerezo jenoside kimwe n’abagerageza kuyihakana yasabye abanyarwanda mahanga kugerageza gufasha abarokotse jenoside yakorewe abatutsi batorohewe bihe bikomeye kurwanya coronavirus kuko igikorwa cyose nko kubahamagara telefoni ubihanganisha unababaza babayeho gisobanuye byinshi mu ijambo yagejeje banyarwanda ambasaderi w’u rwanda singapore ushinzwe ibihugu australia new zealand indonesia amb jean de dieu uwihanganye yavuze ubuzima umuhoza yabayemo abarokotse jenoside benshi babunyuzemo aboneraho umwanya kubihanganisha anabizeza umuryango mugari w’abanyarwanda ukomeza kubazirikana yasabye urubyiruko kurushaho kugira uruhare guhangana n’abagihakana bakanapfobya jenoside yakorewe abatutsi yakomeje agira bikwiye kutwibutsa uruhare tugomba kugira guhangana n’abagerageza kugoreka amateka jenoside yakorewe abatutsi bagamije izindi nyungu twifashishije ibimenyetso bihari dukwiye kubirwanya binyuze kwamagana mugaragaro abagerageza kubiba urwango haba mbuga nkoranyambaga cyangwa muryango wacu ndifuza gusaba by’umwihariko urubyiruko abenshi turi kumwe hano uyu munsi mwe cyizere n’ahazaza h’u rwanda mu myaka ishize ingabo zari iza rpa ziyobowe nyakubahwa perezida paul kagame zahagaritse jenoside irimo gukorerwa abatutsi kandi turabibashimira bari bafite imyaka ingana n’iyanyu twe yavuze bagize uruhare guhagarika jenoside kubaka u rwanda rushya yakomeje natwe nk’urubyiruko rw’abanyarwanda mahanga dukwiye kugira uruhare rugamba kurwanya ingengabitekerezo jenoside kimwe n’abahakana jenoside benshi benegihugu abazize jenoside kwihanganisha abayirokotse banagaragaje uburyo hakenewe guhuza imbaraga gutsinda abakomeje gushaka kugoreka amateka y’u rwanda bagamije kuyobya abatazi ukuri jenoside yakorewe abatutsi umuyobozi uhagarariye inyungu z’u rwanda australie michael roux yavuze nubwo jenoside yakorewe abatutsi yatangiye mata byari nk’iherezo y’ibindi bikorwa byari bimaze imyaka myinshi kwibasira abatutsi gucura imigambi kubarimbura muri gihe isi yatereranye u rwanda kugeza minsi gusa abatutsi barenga miliyoni bamaze kwicwa yavuze hari abantu benshi australia nouvelle zelande bahakana bakanapfobya jenoside bafite ibikorwa bitesha agaciro abazize jenoside abayirokotse n’abanyarwanda rusange yasabye bene bantu bakwiye gushyirwa ahabona ndetse imvugo zabo zikamaganwa ibinyoma byabo bigatsindishwa ibimenyetso by’ukuri mateka y’ibyabaye rwanda lady clare de lore mckinnon uhagarariye inyungu z’u rwanda nouvelle zelande yahaye icyubahiro abazize jenoside anifatanya n’abarokotse kimwe n’abanyarwanda rusange yagarutse buryo nubwo habayeho intabaza ambasaderi w’icyo gihugu umuryango w’abibumbye amb collin keating wasabaga muryango kugira ukora byabaga rwanda cyakozwe kandi byari gutabara ubuzima bw’ibihumbi bwari kaga yavuze gihe covid- atari virusi yonyine nouvelle zelande avuga hari abantu bahakana jenoside bashaka gutesha agaciro abayirokotse hamwe n’imiryango binyuze guhakana ukuri kw’ibyabaye jenoside yakorewe abatutsi muri muhango kandi hanifashishijwe ubutumwa kwibuka bukubiye ndirimbo zitandukanye hagamijwe guha icyubahiro abazize jenoside yakorewe abatutsi kwifatanya n’abayirokotse

title: uburengerazuba ibinyabiziga bigiye gusuzumwa imiterere yabyo hifashishiwe imodoka
content: abatunze ibinyabiziga karere rubavu n’abatuye nkengero zako ibinyabiziga byabo bizasuzumwa imiterere yabyo minsi mike imbere kuko imodoka polisi y’u rwanda isanzwe irimo ibikoresho byose bipima imiterere y’ibinyabiziga izaba aka karere gihe cy’imisi icumi chief superintendent of police csp emmanuel kalinda uyobora ishami polisi y’u rwanda rishinzwe gupima imiterere y’ibinyabiziga yavuze modoka irimo ibikoresho byose bipima imiterere y’ibinyabiziga igenda yoherezwa buri ntara ikaba yarashyizweho gahunda polisi y’u rwanda yiyemeje kwegereza guha serivisi nziza abaturage yagize itariki nzeri nibwo modoka izatangira gusuzuma imiterere y’ibinyabiziga ntara y’i burengerazuba n’abegeranye izaba karere rubavu turasaba abatunze ibinyabiziga ntara gukoresha neza mahirwe babonye bakaza gusuzumisha ibinyabiziga byabo bakamenya imiterere yabyo iyi modoka irimo ibikoresho bipima imiterere y’ibinyabiziga yunganira ibindi bigo polisi bisanzwe bikora aka kazi ipima imiterere y’ibinyabiziga hirya hino gihugu cyane cyane ariko igafasha abatuye kure y’umujyi kigali kuko ibasanga iwabo bityo ikabarinda gukora urugendo rurerure bajya gupimisha imodoka zabo csp kalinda yavuze modoka ifite ubushobozi gusumuma imodoka ijana buri munsi yagize intara y’uburengerazuba ifite imodoka nyinshi zikora ibikorwa bitandukanye by’ubucuruzi nk’uko bizwi modoka zikorerwa isuzumwa buri mezi atandandu mwaka kuzizana i kigali twasanze byabahenda cyane bityo akaba ariyo mpamvu twahisemo kubegereza serivisi tujya iwabo gusuzumirayo ibinyabiziga byabo polisi y’u rwanda yatangiye gahunda gusuzuma imiterere y’ibinyabiziga mwaka w’ hakaba haratangiye imirongo ibiri ipima imodoka kigo cyayo mic kiri i remera karere gasabo buryo gihe imodoka zapimwaga munsi muri gihe imodoka zisuzumwa imiterere yazo zariyongereye cyane kubera imirongo isigaye itatu kigo mic kiri i remera hari kandi imodoka irimo ibikoresho bipima imiterere y’ibinyabiziga ndetse n’undi murongo umwe ishuri polisi y’u rwanda pts riri i gishali karere rwamagana ntara y’i burasirazuba ubu buryo kwegereza guha serivisi nziza abaturage bifuza byagiye byongera umubare w’imodoka zisuzumwa umwaka ushize imodoka zasuzumwe imiterere yazo ziyongereyeho ugereranyije n’umwaka wawubanjirije ni ukuvuga mwaka hasuzumwe imodoka gihe mwaka w’ hari hasuzumwe imodoka mu mezi atandatu abanza y’uyu mwaka imodoka zimaze gukorerwa isuzumwa ry’imiterere yazo mu kwezi kw’ugushyingo mwaka polisi y’u rwanda ifite gahunda gushyira indi mirongo ibiri kigo cyayo mic kiri i remera karere gasabo ikaba yiyongera yindi isanzwe ikoreshwa title: inama yiga dosiye rugamba sipiriryani n’buryo ashobora kugirwa umutagatifu yatangiye mugaragaro
content: kurimiyi tariki nzeri i kigali hatangijwe mugaragaro umuhango w’ab’ukwemera gatolika kugira umuntu wapfuye umutagatifu bica nzira y’itsinda ry’ababisabye n’abatanga ubuhamya kitwa urukiko n’urubanza kubumva mu nteko y’urukiko iyobowe musenyeri arikediyoseze kigali thadeo ntihinyurwa izaba inteko igizwe n’itsinda ry’abasabiye rugamba daphrose umugorewe bashyirwa rwego rw’abahire n’abatagatifu ndetse n’itsinda ry’abashinzwe kwiga mibereho n’imigenzereze uru rubanza ruzakomeza minsi imbere kugeza rubonye umwanzuro ushingiye buhamya buzatangwa n’abazi neza rugamba n’umugore hazabaho impaka zizavanwamo igikwiriye nacyo kuzafatwaho umwanzuro uzohererezwa roma nk’uko twabitangarijwe padiri jean bosco ntagungira intumwa musenyeri ruriya rukiko urubanza ruzakomeza humvwa abatangabuhamya ngeri zoseati hagomba kumvwa abatangabuhamya benshi hari ababa barateganijwe hari nabazizana baaba ababishimangira cyangwa ababitambamira kandi hazaba harimo n’umurengezi w’ubutabera yavuze kandi kugira umuntu ashyirwe rwego rw’ abahire n’urw’abatagatifu hadashingirwa gusa bimenyetso by’abatangabuhamya ngo hagomba kuba n’igitangaza ndashidikanywa giturutse ijuru ati kugira umuntu agere urwo rwego rw’abahire hagomba igitangaza cyemezwa n’abantu babishinzwe bakavuga bati habaye igitangaza n’iki n’ubwo inzira ndende padiri ntagungira yatanze ikizere kuzumva abatagatifu rugamba cyprien daphrose bishoboka kuko kugera ntambwe yatewe ikintu gikomeye ikirego gutangiza inzira kwiga balayiki’ bashyirwa rwego rw’abahire n’abatagatifu kikaba cyaratanzwe n’umuryango communaut de l’emmanuel ukaba warashinzwe rugamba cpryien daphrose mukansanga inteko y’urukiko yemeje izatangira kumva abatangabuhamya rubanza rugamba mbere tariki nzeri saa tatu gitondo naho urubanza daphrose mukansanga umutangabuhamya mbere akaba azumvwa tariki ukwakira saa tatu gitondo izo manza zombi umunsi mbere kumva umutangabuhamya zikaba zizabera rukiko paruwasi mutagatifu bikira mariya umubyeyi w’impuhwe kacyiru umutangabuhamya manza zombi uzumvwa kw’ikubitiro rugamba olivier umwana rugamba cyprien daphrose mukansanga muri kiriziya gatolika abatagatifu abantu byapfuye barakoze imirimo myiza itangaje biyambazwa n’abasenga babafashe kubasabira mana yumve amasengesho wwwmuhaburarw

title: bishop rugagi yikomye umusaza wiyise umubyeyi akanamusebya anagaruka kuzura abapfuye
content: bishop rugagi innocent uyobora itorero abacunguwe redeemed gospel church uzwi cyane nk’umunyabitangaza bihambaye yavuze musaza wamwiyitiriye avuga se umubyara akamusebya bikomeye asobanura ataribyo ahubwo abamurwanya bashaka kumugabaho ibitero kuko papa yapfuye mwaka rugagi kandi yanakomoje kubyo kuzura abapfuye yavuze bishoboka ahubwo ikibazo baramuzanira umurambo ananirwe kuwuzura yikomye bikomeye musaza wamwiyitiriye avuga ntaho amuzi ndetse imyitwarire yamubonanye atigeze ayibona se umubyara akiriho kuko yapfuye mwaka w’i yagize uko mwumvise iby’uwo musaza niko nanjye nabyumvisedata yapfuye tariki tumushyingura gihugu congo yafashwe n’uburwayi minsi arapfuye uwaje akavuga data navuka sinigeze mbona data arya bombo kanwa nabonye umusaza yirira bombo y’agati avuga wigiriye gisirikare akanaba afite ipeti majoro ngabo z’u rwanda rugagi yanavuze kubyo kuba yazura abantu bapfuye abona kuba atarabikora ntawe uramuzanira umurambo awusengere yange kuzuka cyangwa azuke content: abana babiri bafite ababyeyi bava inda baguye cyobo gicukurwamo zahabu barapfa abacukuye byobo biri mirima y’ abaturage bivugwa babicukuye buryo butemewe n’amategeko bahise batoroka abana ruharambuga karere nyamasheke intara y’ iburengerazuba havugimana pierre nyirarume w’ bana yabwiye ukwezi bana baguye gisimu barimo bakina yagize kumwe abana bagenda baramanutse bagera ahantu hari aba bacukuzi bacukuye byobo bakora badafite uburenganzira uyu muryango usaba bacukuzi babuzwa gucukura cyangwa bakajya basiba ibyobo bacukura umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’ umurenge ruharambuga anne title: shampiyona apr fc yaratsinze rayon sports fc iratsindwa
content: nyuma gustindira as kigali stade regional i nyamirambo ibitego busa apr fc ikipe irimo guhagarara gikombe shampiyona ibitse yatangiye gusiga amakipe zihanganye ibi ikaba yabigezeho icyi cyumweru ibikesha ibitego by’abasore bahagaze neza minsi olivier karekezi kapiteni w’iyi kipe n’umunya uganda dan wagaluka rayon sport mukeba mbere apr fc yatakaje amanota imbere la jeunesse yiganjemo abakinnyi bakiri bato kandi byagaragaraga bamenyeranye cyane bayitsinda ibitego bibiri kimwe ikindi cyaje gukomeza mukino emmanuel ruremesha umutoza la jeunesse wahoze atoza rayon sport akaba ayizi neza ndetse nyuma y’umukino akaba yaradutangarije yifuzaga gutsinda rayon sport kugirango agaragaze la jeunesse atari ikipe yisukirwa kandi akiri umutoza ukomeye jean marie ntagwabira umutoza rayon sport n’ubwo yatsinzwe ntiyababaye bitewe n’uko hari abakinnyi bakomeye bakina inyuma batagaragaye mukino avuga atarenganya abahakinnye n’ubwo ntandaro gutsindwa twabuze amahirwe menshi imbere y’izamu ariko kandi n’ibitego twatsinzwe byatewe n’abakinnyi bakina inyuma ariko simbabaye kuko abakinnyi nari nizeye bakina iddy nshimiyimana mbanza hussein tambwe floribert munota nyuma byaje guhinduka gusa abakinnye bakoze bashoboye cyane abenshi badasanzwe babanza kibuga gusa ntagwabira yizeye kuzaba afite abakinnyi bakomeye azaba ahanganye apr fc ikipe yanatoje igihe kirekire mukino utaha uzahuza makipe tariki ukwakira stade amahoro police fc indi kipe yatangiye shampiyona ifite umuvuduko inatsinda ibitego byinshi yagaragazaga ishobora kuzahangana apr rayon sport ikazitwara igikombe dore n’umutoza wayo w’umunya serbia goran kuponovic yatakaje amanota abiri i huye imbere mukura vs nyuma kunganya ubusa busa umukino marine etincelles utegerejwe n’imbaga y’abanya rubavu kubera guhangana bitajya bishira hagati y’aya makipe warangiye etincelles atahanye amanota atatu nyuma gusinda marine ibitego busa stade umugandakuri stade mumena kiyovu sport izahagararira u rwanda mikino confederation cup yahatsidiye bitagoranye amagaju ibitego shyaka jean akili mabula serugaba erc barebye ncundura amakipe yazamukiye rimwe cyiciro mbere mwaka ndetse akaba yombi yanatangiye shampiyona yitwara nabi nyanza fc espoir zanganyirije ubusa busa i nyanza ubu apr isonga n’amanota etincelles irayikurikiye n’amanota rayon sport mwanya gatatu ifite amanota gihe police fc iza mwanya kane n’amanota amakipe nyuma marine kumwanya nota rimwe ifite ikaba ibanzirizwa as kigali mwanya n’inota rimwe thoneste nisingizwe

title: gisupusupu agiye kuzenguruka igihugu bitaramo byamenyeshejwe inama y’abaminisitiri - video
content: inama y’abaminisitiri idasanzwe yateraniye village urugwiro kuwa gatanu tariki kamena iyobowe nyakubahwa perezida repubulika paul kagame yamenyeshejwe ibitaramo bizazenguruka intara zose z’u title: hakenewe urubyiruko rukora kandi rwumva rukanashyira bikorwa gahunda leta
content: ibi ibikubiye butumwa umuyobozi w’akarere kayonza wungirije yageneye urubyiruko rwari rwitabiriye ihuriro ngarukamwaka rihuza abahagarariye urubyiruko aka karere kayonza ryabaye gicurasi harerimana jean damascene umuyobozi w’akarere wungirije ushinzwe imibereho myiza y’abaturage yabibukije imbaraga z’igihugu n’ahazaza heza h’u rwanda hashingiye nayo mpamvu bakwiye gukura amaboko mifuka bakitabira umurimo nako bashyira bikorwa gahunda leta muri huriro ngarukamwaka ryahuje abahagarariye urubyiruko mirenge igize akarere kayonza ndetse n’abafatanyabikorwa hagarutswe mihigo urubyiruko rwari rwarahize kuzahigura mwaka ushize w’imihigo gusa hakaba hagaragajwe zimwe mbogamizi zikomeje kudindiza urubyiruko iterambere harimo nko kutizerwa n’ibigo by’amari aha urubyiruko rukaba rwasabye ubuyobozi bw’akarere kayonza n’ubwo hari gahunda zagenewe gufasha urubyiruko hakwiye kujyaho uburyo bwihariye gukurikirana ishyirwa mubikorwa by’izo gahunda zigamije gufasha urubyiruko iterambere gakumba geofrey umuhuzabikorwa w’urubyiruko yavuze kugeza usibye kuba hari imbogamizi nkeya bagenda bahura nazo nayo mpamvu haba hagiyeho gahunda nk’iyi y’ihuriro kugirango bahurize hamwe ibitekerezo rwego kwishakamo ibisubizo bibaye ngombwa bagakora ubuvugizi cyateza imbere urubyiruko rusangentaganda innocent ushinzwe ibikorwa by’itorero n’ubukangurambaga yavuze urubyiruko rukwiye kumenya arirwo rufite imbaraga kubaka igihugu nayo mpamvu bakwiye kurangwa guharanira gukoresha imbaraga zose kubaka igihugu nk’uko babisabwa n’intore izirusha intambwe ariwe nyakubahwa perezida repubulika paul kagame harerimana jean damascene umuyobozi w’akarere kayonza wungirije ushinzwe imibereho myiza y’abaturage yabwiye urubyiruko handi u rwanda rw’uyu munsi ruteze imbaraga n’iterambere atari rubyiruko n’ubwo abenshi mwe urubyiruko mwavutse bihe by’ingaruka jenoside igihugu cyarasenyutse ariko kugeza dufite ubuyobozi bw’igihugu cyacu bushyigikiye iterambere kandi burangajwe imbere kubaka igihugu nayo mpamvu mwe urubyiruko mukwiye guharanira gufasha ubuyobozi bw’igihugu cyacu cyane arimwe mbaraga z’ejo hazaza visi meya kandi yasabye urubyiruko gushyira bikorwa gahunda leta ati urubyiruko rutari rwinshi ariko rufite imitekerereze igomba guhinduka kandi igahindurwa namwe bagenzi nidukunda umurimo tukumva kandi tugashyira bikorwa gahunda leta byose bizagerwahosrcukwezicom title: umunyamakuru linda melvern yasohoye igitabo gihishura umugambi w’abahakana jenoside yakorewe abatutsi
content: umunyamakuru w’umwongerezakazi linda melvern yasohoye igitabo gishya kivuga uburyo abacuze umugambi jenoside yakorewe abatutsi n’ababashyigikiye bakomeje kuyihakana uyu munyamakuru wemeza content: umuyobozi w’ibitaro bikuru kibuye dr ayingeneye violette atangaza bitaro bitagitanga serivisi kubaga byihuse bitewe n’inyubako y’ahatangirwa serivisi yubatse nabi buryo izamo imyanda ivuye title: rdc perezida tshisekedi yaba atizeye abashinzwe umutekano yasigiwe kabila
content: perezida repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo felix tshisekedi yatangije amavugurura yimbitse bashinzwe umutekano agamije kwisubiza ububasha serivisi ziyobowe n’abizerwa joseph kabila yasimbuye butegetsi pera z’umwaka ushize benshi bakurikiranira politiki congo bakomeje kwemeza tshisekedi yajya butegetsi azakomeza gukorera kwaha kabila ndetse bigashimangirwa kuba uruhande politiki rushyigikiye kabila rugifite ijambo guverinoma rufitemo intebe nyinshi kurusha uruhande tshisekedi ibi bikaba bivuze hari ibyemezo bimwe bimwe perezida ashobora gufata bikabura ubwiganze guverinoma bubishyigikira bigateshwa agaciro ariko kugirango ahangane n’iki kibazo tshisekedi akaba ashaka kubanza kwizera umutekano akesha abahoze bahembwa n’uwo yasimbuye amakuru yizewe aturuka perezidansi agera jeune afrique aravuga by’ukuri perezida tshisekedi arimo gutekereza kuvugurura serivisi zishinzwe umutekano ndetse n’umuryango zigizwe n’abashinzwe kurinda ahantu h’ingenzi nk’ibibuga by’indege radiyo televiziyo by’igihugu n’ahandi bikavugwa igihe tshisekedi azizera umutekano ashobora gutangira guhangana n’ibisigisigi kabila biri butegetsi garde rpublicaine congo yaba ikigenzurwa kabila scurit prsidentielle’ itagenzurwa fardc ahubwo igenzurwa n’umukuru w’igihuguingingo y’ y’itegeko rigenga igisirikare n’ubwirinzi ivuga tegeko ririmo riteganya garde rpublicaine nk’indi mitwe igize igisirikare congo muri gashyantare nibwo joseph kabila yashyizeho itegeko rigena umugaba mukuru garde rpublicaine gr akuraho andi avuguruza iryo rye gr igizwe n’abasirikare babarirwa hagati y’ibihumbi umutekano w’igihugu ndetse zagiye zikoreshwa guhangana n’abataravugaga rumwe kabila garde rpublicaine yagiye ishinjwa leta zunze ubumwe amerika loni n’imiryango itandukanye iharanira uburenganzira muntu kubangamira inzira demokarasi gihugu itoteza abatavuga rumwe n’ubutegetsi yibasira amashyaka atavuga rumwe n’ubutegetsi guhohotera abanyamakuru gufunga binyuranyije n’amategeko kwica abasivili burenda padiri yigeze kuvuga garde rpublicaine igisirikare cyigenga kindi kandi abakirimo bakomoka ntara katanga kabila akomokamo kuwa kugeza kuwa werurwe bamwe komando bagize umutwe ushinzwe kurinda perezida boherejwe rugamba guhangana n’igitero mai-mai ntara katanga umutwe mai-mai kata katanga gihe wifuzaga intara katanga iba igihugu cyigenga bivugwa hantu basirikare gr bahakoreye amarorerwa bayakorera abaturage ndetse n’abakozi b’umuryango w’abibumbye naho gitero cy’i kinshasa ukuboza basirikare bagize uruhare guhangana n’umutwe w’intagondwa zigendera mahame y’iyobokamana byigeze kuvugwa kandi garde rpublicaine congo yigeze kohereza centrafrica abakomando hagati kujya gufasha guverinoma perezida francois bozize igeze aharindimuka mu brigadier general dieudonne banze lubundji niwe komanda garde rpublicaine mu kugeza umugaba mukuru wungirije fardc ushinzwe ibikorwa mu yazamuwe ntera agirwa major general agirwa umugaba mukuru w’ingabo zirwanira butaka uwari wamubanjirije buyobozi gr jean-claude kifwa waje kugirwa komanda w’akarere gisirikare ntara y’uburasirazuba komanda gr gihe ugushyingo gen de brigade ilunga kampate wanashyiriweho ibihano nubumwe bw’u burayi kubera ibyaha title: minisiteri eshanu perezida w’imitwe yombi y’inteko biruta umunyapolitiki wadomye mfuruka zose
content: ni umwe bagabo bayoboye nzego zitandukanye kandi zikomeye gihugu kuko usibye kuba minisitiri yicaye mwanya kabiri ukomeye gihugu perezida sena gihe cy’imyaka umunani ni umugabo wubatse amateka kera kuko yize ibijyanye n’ubuganga ndetse abikora bihe u rwanda rwari rukomerewe yatanze umusanzu ukomeye kuvura ingabo rpa zari cnd gihe n’umuryango bahahungiye afite ubunararibonye politiki y’u rwanda dr biruta usanzwe perezida w’ishyaka psd amaze kuyobora minisiteri eshanu kandi zifite inshingano zitandukanye ndetse zinahabanye gusa zihuriye kubaka u rwanda kuva kugera yinjiye guverinoma minisitiri w’ubuzima nyuma yaho amara umwaka umwe kugera minisitiri w’imirimo rusange gutwara abantu n’itumanaho yayoboye kandi inteko ishinga amategeko gihe cy’inzibacyuho myaka itatu hagati yavuye perezida sena kugera mu ukuboza yagizwe minisitiri w’uburezi kugeza nyakanga nyuma yaho agirwa minisitiri w’umutungo kamere yaje guhindurwa minisiteri y’ibidukikije kugera kane ugushyingo yagirwaga minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga yahise minisitiri uyoboye minisiteri y’ububanyi n’amahanga u rwanda rwabona ubwigenge n’uwa nyuma jenoside yakorewe abatutsi ni umwe bayoboye minisiteri batarigeze ambasaderi b’u rwanda n’uwa cyenda uyiyoboye yarabaye umuyobozi w’izindi minisiteri avuga neza indimi mpuzamahanga kimwe by’ingenzi kuyobora minisiteri ukuba uyihabwa agomba kuba azi nibura indimi ebyiri mpuzamahanga zikoreshwa cyane bubanyi n’amahanga igifaransa n’icyongereza izi ndimi zikenewe ruhando mpuzamahanga hafatiwe miryango u rwanda rubarizwamo runafitemo inshingano biruta waminuje bijyanye n’ubuganga universit libre de bruxelles avuga neza igifaransa hamwe n’icyongereza bimugira umugabo ushoboye ngingo yanditse izina rwego mpuzamahanga inama mpuzamahanga nyinshi zigamije kwiga bijyanye kubungabunga ibidukikije zabaye dr biruta yarazitabiriye ahagarariye u rwanda akanatangamo ibitekerezo bifatika ni ibintu byatumye amenyekana cyane bijyanye gahunda u rwanda rwimakaje kurengera ibidukikije binyuze guca ibikoresho pulasitiki n’ibindi bifitanye isano n’imyuka yangiza ikirere amasezerano mpuzamahanga u rwanda rwasinyaga ngeri niwe wayashyiragaho umukono akayobora n’inama nyinshi rwabaga rwahawe urugero nk’ijyanye n’amasezerano kigali kigali amendment ibi bituma ruhando mpuzamahanga izina rye ritumvikana nk’irishya matwi y’abandi bayobozi kuko abenshi title: ivugururwa ry’umujyi huye rigeze kure
content: muri minsi aharimo kuvugururwa agace k’ubucuruzi kazwi izina ryo mucyarabu akabarizwamo amahoteli ibisi faucon ndetse n’amabanki ecobank kbc ahandi harimo kuvugururwa ahahoze sitade huye harimo gusizwa neza hazubakwe indi nziza iyi gahunda kuvugurura igamije gusenya inyubako zishaje kandi zubatswe buryo butakigezweho zigasimbuzwa izijyanye n’igihe turimokuvugurura inyubako z’uyu mujyi tangiranye n’umwaka bikaba kandi bigikomeza ubu hoteli ibis hamwe banki ecobank bikaba byaramaze gusenywa kugirango hubakwe amazu agezweho pascal sahundwa umunyamabanga mpuzabikorwa w’umurenge ngoma karere huye avuga hari ibikorwa by’iterambere biri gukorwa kandi hari n’ibindi byinshi biteganyijwe avuga uretse amazu harimo kuvugururwa imihanda duce dutandukanye tw’uwo mujyi hamaze kuvugurwa ibirometero umunani by’imihanda gace kwitaba kandi nyuma yaho hazavugururwa imihanda ijya tundi duce ngoma matyazo hazakorwa kandi amatara mihanda ndetse haterwe ubusitani n’ibiti by’imirimbo rwego kongera ubwiza nyaburanga ndetse n’isuku y’uyu mujyi pascal asobanura ivugururwa ry’uyu mujyi inyungu buri muturage uwutuyemo ndetse n’igihugu rusange uyu mujyi murangiza kuvugururwa abaturage bazabona ibikorwa by’amajyambere birimo imihanda myiza n’amazu y’ubucuruzi yagutse ibi bizatuma haboneka abacuruzi baturutse bihugu bigize umurwango w’afrika y’iburasirazuba eac habeho ubuhahirane hagati y’uyu mujyi n’ibyo bihugu n’ubwo ubuyobozi bw’umujyi huye butegeka abafite amazu mujyi kuyavugurura bamwe banyiri mazu ntibabyumva kimwe n’ubuyobozi kuko bavugako basabwa kubaka amazu badafitiye ubushobozi umunyamabanga nshingwa bikorwa huye avuga ubuyobozi bw’uyu mujyi bugerageza kubavuganira banki kugirango babone inguzanyo buryo bworoshye hari kandi n’abavuga amwe mazu adakwiye gusenywa kuko afatwa nk’inzibutso z’uwo mujyi umuyobozi hotel ibis yagize kuvugurura ntibivuga gukuraho ibyagakwiye twibutsa ibihe byiza byashize twagiriye hoteli ibis pascal ariko avuga hakiri imbogamizi nyinshi iterambere ry’umujyi huye kuko abagafashije mujyi gutera imbere aribo bawusubiza inyuma aha aragaya abashoramari babona amafaranga nk’aho bayashoye iwabo huye bakajya i kigali n’ahandi bavugako i huye ntakigenda aranenga kandi igikorwa kwimurira amashami amwe n’amwe kaminuza nkuru i kigali abivuga magambo hari ikibazo cy’inyubako kaminuza niyubake kwimura mashami ahamya title: menya pariki y’igihugu nyungwe
content: iryo shyamba riri misozi ifite ubutumburuke buri hagati m m kandi ririmo amoko menshi y’ibimera abana n’amoko anyuranye y’inyamaswa agizwe ahanini n’inyoni n’ingunge nk’uko bitangazwa wikipedia ishyamba cyimeza nyungwe kimwe bigega by’amazi y’u rwanda ritanga by’amazi y’u rwanda kandi isoko ry’uruzi nili iryo shyamba pariki nyungwe igiwze n’urunyurane rw’ibimera ishyamba rigizwe n’amoko arenga y’ibiti n’urwunge rw’ibiti by’indabyo harimo n’igiti cy’inganzamarumbo lobelia n’izindi zitatse amabara menshi umubare w’abanyarwanda basura pariki nyungwe uragenda wiyongera bitewe n’uko pariki nyungwe hubatswe urutindo kirere canopy walk ugenda witegeye ishyamba ryose nk’uko byatangajwe n’ubuyobozi pariki nyungwe iryo teme ryubatse metero uvuye butaka rikaba rireshya metero ni ryo mbere riri afurika y’uburasirazuba rikaba ndetse irya afurika nyuma gana afurika y’epfo iryo teme rifasha abasura pariki kuyireba bayihereye hejuru buryo bifasha kureba amaso yandi utunyoni ndetse n’inkende biba iryo shyamba iri shyamba ricumbikiye amoko agera y’inyoni inyoni z’akataraboneka ziri nyungwe harimo ikinyoni kinini cy’ubururu bita turaco inyoni ziteye ubwuzu z’ubururu umutuku ndetse title: minisante yashyizeho itsinda ryo kuvura abanyarwanda icyenda batoterejwe uganda
content: mu ijoro ryo gatatu rishyira kuwa kane nibwo abanyarwanda icyenda bamaze imyaka igera itatu bafungiye uganda bageze mupaka gatuna nyuma y’uko barekuwe n’urukiko gisirikare makindye kabiri abarekuwe rene rutagungira herman nzeyimana nelson mugabo etienne nsanzabahizi emmanuel rwamucyo augustin rutayisire adrien munyagabe gilbert urayeneza claude iyakaremye bose bahuriza buryo bafashwe nabi gereza bakorerwaga iyicarubozo buryo ubuzima bwabo buri kaga nubwo barekuwe minisante ibinyujije twitter yatangaje yashyizeho itsinda ry’abaganga bakurikirana ubuzima bw’abarekuwe bagize bati minisiteri y’ubuzima yashyizeho itsinda ry’abaganga batangiye gusuzuma kuvura abanyarwanda icyenda barekuwe uganda rutagungira banyarwanda mbere bashimutiwe i kampala yavuze yafashwe nyakanga afungwa amezi atatu gereza z’urwego rushinzwe iperereza gisirikare cmi aho yaje kuhava ajyanwa rukiko aregwa hamwe n’abandi ariko gihe cyose yamaze afunzwe iminsi yakorewe iyicarubozo rikomeye ati baraje bansanga gisivili gisivili ntibahuza neza kubera amakosa bakora bazanye abaganga b’abasivili n’abasirikare baza kwemeza nakorewe iyicarubozo cyane mugabo nelson karere nyagatare murenge tabagwe yavuze yafatiwe uganda tariki mutarama mu gihe cyose yamaze afunzwe yakorewe iyicarubozo kugeza hari igihe bagombaga kumuterura kuko atari akibasha kwigenza aganira igihe yagize badukoreye byinshi njye ndi umwe bakorewe byinshi mu guhera kwezi mbere kugera kane ntabwo nagendaga naraterurwaga nararemaye kubera ingaruka z’inkoni ubuzima ntabwo mbwizeye neza bamwe bagiye batoterezwa uganda bagiye basigarana ingaruka z’iryo yicarubozo bamwe bagapfa abandi bakamugara silas hategekimana umunyarwanda wamaze ibyumweru atoterezwa maboko y’urwego rushinzwe ubutasi gisirikare uganda cmi yapfuye nzeri umwaka ushize azize iryo yicarubozo yakorewe afunzwe raporo muganga zagaragaje nyakwigendera afite imvune y’urubavu rwego gatanu ndetse n’ikibazo cy’amaraso yarikusanyirije hagati y’igituza n’ibihaha hemothorax hamwe kwangirika ibihahayari afite kandi ikibazo cy’impyiko y’ibumoso yangiritse n’ibikomere nda raporo y’isuzuma yakorewe igasinywano n’abaganga babiri igaragaza urupfu rwe atari urusanzwe’ ahubwo rwatewe gukubitwa cyane gituza nda

content: iki cyemezo cyafashwe tariki ukwakira n’umucamanza khalida rachid khan uyobora urukiko mpuzamahanga mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho u rwanda tpir gusaba irekurwa bagaragaza michel wakatiwe igihano gufungwa imyaka mwaka ushize amakuru kigalitodaycom gikesha itangazo ry’uryo rukiko aravuga mpamvu zatanzwe kumurekura harimo kuba urukiko mpuzamahanga mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho yougoslavia tpiy rufite imikorere ijya gusa n’iya tpir ruteganya imfungwa zakatiwe zishobora kurekurwa nyuma kumara bitatu kane by’igifungo barakatiwe kandi bagaragaza amaze imyaka afunze ukuvuga by’imyaka umunani yakatiwe izindi mpamvu michel bagaragaza ubwe yiyemeje kwishyikiriza urukiko akanemera yashinjwaga ndetse akerekana azi uburemere bwabyo akanabyicuza kuba yararanzwe n’imyitwarire myiza afungiye sude mugabane w’u burayi nyakanga umunyarwanda michel bagaragaza yahoze umuyobozi mukuru w’ikigo ocir- ishami ry’icyayi akaba yarafatwaga nk’umwe nkoramutima juvnal habyarimana perezida w’u rwanda yamaze igihe ashakishwa tpir byaha kunoza umugambi jenoside yakorewe abatutsi kugira uruhare jenoside n’ubufatanyacyaha jenoside tariki kanama bagaragaza yishyikirije tpir bwende bwe yitaba urukiko munsi uruhare ruziguye jenoside kuko yaremeye intwaro zari zigenewe gukora jenoside zibikwa ruganda rw’icyayi rubaya ndetse akaba yaranaguriraga interahamwe inzoga akanaziha amafaranga yemereye urukiko title: igihugu gihagaze neza pe-perezida kagame
content: perezida repubulika paul kagame yatangaje n’ubwo hashize imyaka igera ibiri hari abagerageza guhungabanya umutekano w’igihugu bitabahiriye ndetse ahubwo ubukungu bukazamuka gipimo cy’u igipimo kiboneka hake isi saa tanu z’amaywa zirengaho iminota mike perezida repubulika paul kagame madamu jeannette kagame binjiye kigali convention center ahakoraniye inama y’igihugu y’umushyikirano nshuro iyi nama kuwa kugeza ukuboza ikoraniyemo abasaga barimo abanyarwanda bagera mahanga ikaba ifite umwihariko kuba ipfundikiye icyerekezo mu ijambo rigaragaza ishusho y’uko igihugu gihagaze perezida republika paul kagame yahereye mutekano w’igihugu yashimangiye wifashe neza ndetse agashimira ubufatanye bw’abaturage n’inzego zishinzwe ubusugire bw’ igihugu bwatumye bigerwaho yagize ’’nk’uko bisabwa ndagira mbanze igihugu cyacu gihagaze ndabivuga nshamake ariko nahera kubanza kubabwira gihagaze neza pe ntabwo guhagarara neza amahirwe gusa wenda yaba arimo guhagarara neza mwe mwese biturukaho buri wese afite uruhare rwe mirimo ashinzwe buryo butandukanye inshuti difite dukorana yaba ayandi mahanga cyangwa byaba abantu giti cyabo bafite bakorana n’u rwanda’’ umukuru w’igihugu yakomoje bikorwa by’abagerageza guhungabanya umutekano w’igihugu abakurira inzira murima ibikorwa byabo ntacyo biteze kugeraho ’’ariko n’ibikorwa bake bibi bigaragara nkaho byinshi abagerageza guhungabanya umutekano wacu murabizi tubimazemo nk’imyaka ishize byongeye kugenda bigaragara ariko navuga tubigerereye kandi ngira wenda abantu bafite amatwi barabwirwa ntibumvebafite amaso barerekwa ntibabonengira byari bikwiye kuba byumvwa buri wese byari bikwiye kuba bibonwa buri wese ariko twagiye tubabwira bizagenda ni byagenze bizagenda’’ mu bijyanye n’ubukungu perezida kagame yavuze bwiyongereye bipimo bishimishije n’ubwo igihugu cyahanganye n’ibihe bitoroshye ati ’’ahubwo bikaba binatangaje kuko byazamutse byarihuse kandi ahubwo duhanganye n’ibibazo bitari bike ibibazo mipakabiragaragara ubukungu bwacu bwazamutse nk’ingengo y’imari y’igihugu cyacu biva twe ni byiza ariko ntibihagizeje ndetse ubukungu nisigiyemo ntashatse gukabya umwaka uzarangira dushobora kuba mwaka atwarageze handi biri isi’’ perezida kagame yakomoje nzego nk’ubureziubuhinzi n’ibikorwa remezo yavuze zihagaze neza ariko ashimgangira intambwe imaze guterwa ikwiye kuba imbarutso gukora byinshi kurusho kuba u rwanda ruri mwanya afurika korohereza ishoramari perezida repubulika yabigaragaje nk’igipimo cyiza icyakora avuga guhindura ibigenderwaho byatumye u rwanda ruza mwanya bihugu ijana mirongo isi yakomoje gahunda visit rwanda yerura imaze gutanga umusaruro mwinshi kubahiriza ihame ry’uburinganire perezida kagame yabigaragaje nk’ihame u rwanda rudateze gutezukaho dore ruza myanya mbere isiimyanya avuga yakabaye iza n’imbere kurushahonyuma guhamagarira abagore b’ingeri zitandukanye gukomeza umurego bakora bafatanyije n’abagaboumukuru w’ igihugu yageze n’aho akomoza bijyanye kuba u rwanda rwayoborwa n’umugore ati ’’ariko abadamu mumaze kugira mugeramwongeremo vitessenjya nifuza rimwe yuko mwanya mwampaye ubukurikira uzatwarwa n’umugoreabagabo hano ndi bubakire simbiziariko nabo bashobora kuba bashaka’’ inama y’igihugu y’umushyikirano iteganywa n’ingingo y’itegeko nshinga ry’u rwanda ryo ryavuguruwe itumizwa kdi ikayoborwa perezida repubulika ikitabirwa n’abahagarariye abanyarwanda ngeri zinyuranye haba nzego letaabikorera imiryango itari iya leta ndetse n’abahagarsriye ibihugu n’imiryango mpuzamahanga ikorera rwanda rba

title: ndashima imana yaradutije kizito mihigo ariko none ikaba inamwisubije- umubyeyi kizito mihigo
content: kuri gatandatu tariki gashyantare habaye umuhango gusezera kizito mihigo wabereye rugo karere kicukiro umurenge ndera kagari busanza misa kumusabira yabereye paruwasi gatulika ndera ndetse kumuherekeza irimbi rusororo iyi mihango yitabiriwe n’abagize umuryango nyakwigendera inshuti ze bahuriye mwuga guhanga kuririmba ndetse n’abihaye imana mu butumwa umubyeyi yatanze yavuze ashima imana kuba yaramuhaye kizito myaka ishize ariko none ikaba yongeye kumwisubiza yagize mbere mbere ndashima imana yaradutije kizito mihigo imyaka ariko none ikaba inamwisubije numva iby’agaciro imwisubije tukimukunze kandi tumushaka n’ikimenyimenyi namwe muteraniye hano murabigaragaza ndongera gushima imana kuba imwisubije akaba nayo mpamvu namwe mbasaba mumurekure kuko nanjye namurekuye namuhaye imana ati ndashima mwese muteraniye hano mungana kuba hano mwankundiraga umwana ndashaka kubabwira turi kumwe haba byiza bibazo gusa murabizi uragiye inka nyirayo aje urayimusubiza ukamubwira uti yakire databuja nanjye ndamumuhaye nk’uko yaramumpayeiribagiza kandi yabwiye abitabiriye gushyingura kizito kujya basaba imbabazi kuzitanga kizito mihigo yavutse tariki nyakanga murenge kibeho karere nyaruguru yahoze perefegitura gikongoro ntara y’amajyepfo ni umwana gatatu bana batandatu babyawe buguzi augustin iribagiza placidie mihigo afite imyaka yatangiye guhimba uturirimbo tw’abana nyuma y’imyaka itanu aza kuvamo umuhanzi w’indirimbo kiliziya gatulika mu mwaka w’ se yishwe jenoside yakorewe abatutsi kizito mihigo yigeze kuvuga amateka jenoside yakorewe abatutsi byamuhaye inganzo y’ubutumwa yaririmbaga ku myaka yigaga mwaka mbere seminari nto karubanda i butare yahimbye indirimbo nyinshi ziririmbwa kiliziya gaturika rwanda tariki z’uku kwezi kabiri urwego rw’ubugenzacyaha rwanda rwari rwatangaje inzego z’umutekano zarushyikirije kizito mihigo yafatiwe karere nyarurugu ashaka kwambuka buryo bunyuranyije n’amategeko ajya i burundi agamije kwifatanya n’imitwe y’iterabwoba irwanya u rwanda rib yavugaga iperereza ryatangiye byaha cyaha ruswa ashyikirizwe ubucamanzayari yakomeje ivuga nk’umuntu warekuwe mbabazi perezida yategekwaga kujya yiyereka ubushinjacyaha buri kwezi gusohoka gihugu agomba kubiherwa uruhushya n’urwego rushinzwe ubucamanza nyuma yaho polisi y’u rwanda yatangaje umuhanzi kizito mihigo ufungiwe sitasiyo polisi remera gitondo mbere tariki gashyantare yasanzwe yiyahuye agapfa mu itangazo polisi yashyize ahagaragara ryagiraga riti mu rukerera mbere tariki gashyantare ahagana saa kumi n’imwe kizito mihigo w’imyaka ufungiwe sitasiyo polisi remera yasanzwe yiyahuye arapfa muhaburarw

title: hasigaye iminsi guma rugo irangire haribazwa byinshi
content: minisiteri y’ubuzima rwanda iravuga gahuda guma rugo izakomeza gushyirwa bikorwa kugeza igihe cyose ibipimo by’icyorezo covid bizaba byerekana bwandu bw’icyo cyorezo bukigaragara gihugu kandi rwego kwirinda icyorezo koronavirusi zizarangira itariki z’uku kwezi zishobora kurangira mbere cyangwa hazongerwaho indi minsi ariko minisitiri w’ubuzima dr ngamije daniel kiganiro aherutse guha rba ukuyobya abaturage’’ umuyobozi w’ishami ry’umuryango w’abibumbye ryita buzima dr tedros adhanom agira inama ibihugu gusuzuma neza ibijyanye gukuraho gahunda ’guma rugo’’ bidashingiye ngaruka zaturuka ngamba ati’ turabizi neza tuzatakaza byinshi ariko byaba byinshi kurushaho gihe tutitaye ngamba dufata bihe mu kugabanya cyorezo bimwe bihugu byafashe ingamba zidasanzwe zifite zivuze mibereho ku mugabane afurika abantu bamaze kwandura coronavirus abamaze gupfa abakize akaba afurika y’epfo imaze kugira benshi banduye kuko gihe abamaze gupfa ikurikirwa misiri ifite abanduye abapfuye algeria ho hamaze gupfa abantu benshi afurika kuko gihe abamaze kwandura muri afurika y’iburasirazuba kenya habonetse abanduye gihe abamaze gupfa icyenda rwanda hamaze kuboneka abantu banduye abamaze gukira uganda habonetse tanzania hamaze kuboneka abantu hamaze gupfa batatu burundi habonetse batanu hamaze gupfa umwe gihe sudani y’epfo bane ku rwego rw’isi icyorezo covid kimaze kwandurwa n’abantu basaga bamaze gupfa gihe abasaga bakize ni icyorezo kimaze kuboneka bihugu isi ku bijyanye gufata ingamba z’ibihe bidasanzwe usa guverineri leta new york ifite abantu benshi bamaze gupfa gihugu andrew cuomo title: guverineri gatete arasaba ubufatanye gufasha abatishoboye

title: abanyarwanda norvge bibutse jenoside yakorewe abatutsi
content: umuhango kwibuka nshuro wabaye buryo budasanzwe bitewe n’ingamba zafashwe n’ibihugu bitandukanye isi kurwanya ikwirakwira ry’icyorezo covid- giterwa n’agakoko coronavirus muri norvge gikorwa cyateguwe n’umuryango urukundo w’abanyarwanda norvge usanzwe utegura igikorwa kwibuka kuri nshuro umuhango kwibuka wabaye hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga wanyujijwe page facebook urukundo rwandisk organisasjon norway’’ whatsapp group kwibuka norway wakurikiwe n’abantu uyu muhango watangijwe hatangwa ubutumwa kwibuka kwihanganishanya ndetse n’isengesho pasiteri aloys munyeshyaka uba norvge abawitabiriye banakurikiye ubutumwa bw’ijambo ry’umukuru w’igihugu rijyanye n’umunsi kwibuka ryakurikiwe n’umuhango kwenyegeza urumuri rw’icyizere gushyira indabo rwibutso jenoside kigali ruri gisozi mata perezida w’umuryango urukundo muhigana marie chantal watangije igikorwa kwibuka norvge iwe rugo bitewe n’ingamba kwirinda coronavirus yashimiye abaharanira jenoside itagira abayipfobya barebera kuko bitinza umurindi ingengabitekerezo yayo ati ndashimira mwese muzirikana jenoside yakorewe abatutsi icyaha ndengakamere mwese muharanira iteka kurwanya kuvuguruza abapfobya jenoside yakorewe abatutsi kuko gupfobya uburyo kuyikomeza gukomeretsa abayirokotse’’ yavuze urumuri rw’icyizere rushushanya urukundo imbaraga n’ukwigira byaranze abarokotse jenoside n’icyizere gukomeza kubaho kwirinda yakongeraho kubaho ukundi yagize dufite inshingano kwigisha abato amateka kugira bajye bahora baharanira ibyabaye bitazasubira ukundi tugomba guharanira tutazazima’’ mu butumwa bwatanzwe n’abana bato bashimangiye bidakwiye abantu bazira bavutse umwe yagize turibuka jenoside yakorewe abatutsi akaga abantu ntibakwiye gupfa kubera tuzaharanira bitazongera kubaho ukundi’’ perezida w’ ihuriro ry’abanyarwanda norvge arc-norway mugisha peter yavuze mwaka kwibuka byakozwe buryo budasanzwe ariko bihora ngombwa yagize turibuka nshuro jenoside yakorewe abatutsi twibuke twiyubaka uyu umunsi ukomeye ubaye bihe bidasanzwe kwibuka biri nshingano buri wese ni ngombwa kwibuka abatuvuyemo kurwanya ingengabitekerezo jenoside kuko hari abashaka kuyihindura bishakiye’’ abitabiriye gikorwa banasangijwe ubuhamya muhire veronique uyu munyarwandakazi wagize amahirwe kuba akiriho ahamya jenoside y’abatutsi yatangiye igasozwa yatanze ubuhamya bw’uburyo inkuru y’ihanurwa ry’indege yabasanze bicaye nzu bavuga bashize ati twahise tuzimya televiziyo abakuru turarira’’ yaje guhungira st paul mujyi kigali aza kuharokokera nyuma kwisanga maboko y’inkotanyi ijoro ryo rishyira kamena hanatanzwe ubuhamya umugiraneza lontine warokotse jenoside bwakurikiwe n’ubutumwa bw’abana bwihanganisha ababyeyi bunizeza kuzaharanira u rwanda rwiza ruzira jenoside ukundi mu gihe ibikorwa kwibuka bizamara iminsi haracyatangwa ubutumwa bunyuze biganiro bijyanye kwibuka ubutumwa bwihanganishanya cyane cyane gusurana buryo usanga abantu hamwe umuhango kwibuka wasojwe n’igikorwa gukusanya inkunga izafasha intwaza n’abandi bacitse icumu jenoside bafite n’ubumuga bunyuranye

title: uburusiya bwatewe ubwoba nibutareka syria butazakira igikombe cy’ isi
content: bidashidikanywaho irushanwa ry’ igikombe cy’ isi birori bikomeye by’ imikino bikurikiranwa n’ imbaga bikinjiriza amamiliyari y’ amayero igihugu cyaryakiriye bidashidikanywaho irushanwa ry’ igikombe cy’ isi birori bikomeye by’ imikino bikurikiranwa n’ imbaga bikinjiriza amamiliyari y’ amayero igihugu cyaryakiriye nyuma y’ imyaka ine burusiya habereye imikino olympic gihugu cyakiriye imikino y’ igikombe cy’ isi ikinyamakuru africainfos kimenyereweho kwandika inkuru zicukumbuye cyatangaje cyamenye ishyirahamwe ry’ umupira w’ amaguru isi ryateye ubwoba uburusiya nibutareka syria buzamburwa kwakira igikombe cy’ isi nubwo fifa yohereje burusiya itsinda ryo gutera ubwoba uburusiya buve syria mugambi basabaga byatewe utwatsi uburusiya bwakira igikombe cy’ isi kandi buguma ntambara syria uburusiya iran biri kuruhande guverinoma syria iyobowe bashar al assad ntambara gisivile imaze igihe syria iyi ntambara imaze imyaka yatangiye abaturage syria bigaragambiriza ibura ry’ akazi ruswa butegetsi assad wagiye butegetsi asimbuye se hafez al assad leta syria yakoresheje imbaraga z’ umurengera guhosha myigaragambyo bituma hapfa abantu benshi hahita haduka intambara gisivile yakomeje gufata indi ntera uburusiya bushyigikira leta syria ibihugu birimo leta zunze ubumwe amerika turikiya leta zunze ubumwe abarabu bishyigikiye abatavugarumwe bashar al assad

title: umunsi mukuru w’umuganura muco mateka y’u rwanda
content: nk’uko tubikesha igitabo umuco buvanganzo’’ n’icyitwa intwari z’imbanza zubatse u rwanda rugahamya igitinyiro’’ byombi nsanzabera jean de dieu inzobere muco amateka n’ubuvanganzo tugiye kubatekerereza amateka y’umunsi mukuru w’umuganura n’ibyo wasobanuraga muco n’amateka y’u rwanda umuganura watangiye kwizihizwa rwanda ngoma gihanga ngomijana kinyejana cumi kimwe uza kongera guhabwa imbaraga ruganzu ii ndoli - yabohoraga u rwanda nyuma y’imyaka irenga ruri maboko y’abanyamahanga abanyoro abanyabyinshi n’abanyabungo umuganura wabaye nzira z’ubwiru kenshi kenshi dufata nk’itegeko nshinga ryo rwanda hambere ni umwe byafatirwagaho ibitaramo nyarwanda kuko nawo ufite umwanya bitaramo bitanu byari bikomeye rwanda ha mbere mu munsi mukuru w’umuganura ibwami hazaga imyaka y’amoko menshi yabaga yeze bihe ariko kuwutegura kuwizihiza hakifashishwa imbuto nkuru y’amasaka nayo bengagamo amarwa n’inturire ubundi bagasangira bishimira ibyiza byagezweho mbere y’uko habaho umuganura nyirizina kamena kugeza nzeri hari munsi mukuru wabaga gashyantare witwaga umurorano’’ benshi bakunze kwita umuganura w’uburo’’ uwo munsi mukuru wasobanura nk’uko izina ryawo riri wavugaga gusogongera umuganura’’ nabwo abashinzwe umuganura batangiraga kuwuhinga mu gukora muhango w’umurorano uvuze gusogongera umuganura uzaba kamena kugeza nzeri kenshi kenshi bifashishaga imbuto nkuru gihanga ariyo y’uburo dore buhingwa bihe bwabaga bweze kandi nabwo bugomba guhabwa ikuzo bumwe mbuto mbere z’ibanze z’abanyarwanda uburo inzuzi isogi ibikoro n’amasaka zahanganywe n’u rwanda ku rwego rw’igihugu umuganura wayoborwaga n’umwami afashijwe n’abanyamihango b’umuganura bakomoka rutsobe gihanga rwego rw’umuryango umukuru w’umuryango n’abagize muryango nabo barahuraga bakizihiza umuganura kugera hasi miryango mito ibirori by’umuganura gihe kera byizihizwaga mwero w’amasaka umunsi mukuru w’umuganura watangiraga kamena ugasoza nzeri umunsi mukuru waheraga ibwami ukabona gusesekara rubanda baganuzaga umwami amata amasaka n’izindi mbuto nkuru uburo inzuzi n’isogi ariko bakongeraho n’ibindi byose byabaga byeze gihe umwami yafataga umwuko agatangiza umuhango kuvugira umutsima rubanda baje kuganuza akawuvuga apfukamye yerekana icyubahiro ayobora ndetse n’igihugu nyuma y’umuhango kuganura hakurikiragaho ibirori by’umuganura byasozwaga n’igitaramo cy’imihigo muri birori umwami yamurikirwaga umusaruro unyuranye w’abanyarwanda bavuye impande zose z’igihugu hakaba amarushanwa y’ indashyikirwa kuri munsi kandi imiryango nayo yarateranaga umutware w’umuryango akayobora imihango n’ibirori byayikurikiraga umuganura kimwe byatumye u rwanda ruba igihugu gikomeye kitavogerwa kuko watumye abanyarwanda bunga ubumwe umuganura wasobanuraga byinshi buzima bw’igihugu bimwe nibyo dusanga mateka n’umuco by’abanyarwanda byatumaga munsi mukuru ubaho iby’ingenzi byagendeweho kugira hagenwe umunsi mukuru w’umuganura bigatuma ushyirwa itegeko nshinga ryo rwanda ha mbere bikurikira umuganura cyari igikoresho cy’ibarabihe mateka y’u rwanda kuko babaraga imyaka y’ubukure y’umunyarwanda bagiraga bati kanaka yariye imiganura n’iyi umunsi w’umuganura wizihizwaga kubera impamvu gushimira imana y’i rwanda yabahaye amagara mazima imyaka ikaba yihiritse umuganura umunsi kwishimira uburumbuke bw’imyaka abantu n’amatungo abanyarwanda babaga barungutse mwaka wose umuganura niwo umunsi w’ubunani bihe ha mbere kuko umwaka w’abanyarwanda watangiraga nzeri ukarangira n’ubundi nzeri w’umwaka ukurikiyeho umuganura rwari urubuga abanyarwanda bahuriragamo bategura igenamigambi ry’umwaka ukurikiyeho cyane cyane igihembwe mbere cy’ihinga aricyo cy’umuhindo gitangirana nzeri kigasozanya n’ukuboza mu ihururu ry’umwaduko w’abakoroni umunsi mukuru w’umuganura byashegeshwe n’abakoroni b’ababirigi mu mavugurura yakozwe kwangiza umuco w’abanyarwanda harimo n’umuganura mu adiminisitarateri nyanza yafashe icyemezo guca gashamura rukangirashyamba umutware w’abiru umwiru w’ijambo amucira i gitega burundi bamuzizaga afite uruhare mitegekere mibanire y’ibwami n’abazungu muri bihe nibwo banakuyeho umuganura n’abahinzi bawo musenyeri lon paul classe mugambi kwigizayo gashamura awurimo baciye umuganura bitwaje ariwo abanyarwanda bahuriramo bagasangira imihango itsindira igihugu rwampungu umuhungu gashamura bahise bamushyira ishuri riyoborwa n’umubiligi bityo ubwiru burazima kuko babuciye umutwe umuganura kimwe mihango y’ubwiru yabashaga kugira byinshi isobanura ubwami n’abaturage basangiye uzima utyo kwizihiza umuganura gihe byarenze imbibi kwita musaruro w’ubuhinzi n’ubworozi gusa ahubwo bigera zindi nzego zireba ubuzima n’iterambere by’abanyarwanda kwizihiza umuganura ugusubira isoko y’umuco wacu tukavomamo bimwe bishobora kudufasha gukemura ibibazo duhura igihugu kigenda gitera imbere umuganura isoko y’ubuhuza n’umuco kwigira kw’abanyarwanda

title: gasabomuri adepr bemeza bamaze gusobanukirwa kwibuka igikorwa k’ingenzi n’imana yategetse abayisilaheri
content: mu gikorwa kwibuka nshuro jenoside yakorewe abatutsi itorero adepr remera ryibutse abari abayobozi ndetse n’abakirisitu baryo bazize jenoside yakorewe abatutsi bagaragaje mbere batumvaga neza igikorwa kwibuka ariko magingo bemeza bahinduye imyumvire cyane n’imana yategetse abayisilaheri kwibuka ni gihe bihe byahise hari bamwe itorero adepr bafataga igikorwa kwibuka nk’icyaha buryo babonaga yagiye bikorwa kwibuka bamubonaga nk’umuntu unyuranyije n’amategeko y’imana ndetse bakamubwira icyaha umushumba w’itoro adepr paruwasi remera akaba akuriye n’abandi karere gasabo kayiranga theophile avuga byabayeho ariko nkabakirisitu adepr babashije gusoma ijambo ry’imana basanga kwibuka nabyo biri bintu imana yategetse abayisilaheri kugira babashe kurema amateka y’ahazaza atinko madini mwanya kwibuka wagiye ufata umwanaya muremure abantu babyumve ariko twe adepr twagerageje kubyumva tugerageza gusoma ijambo ry’imana dusanga mpamvu umuntu atakwibuka amateke y’ibyabaye akomeza agira umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’umurenge remera kalisa jean sauveurashima intambwe amatorero n’amadini amaze gutera mukumva neza gusobanukirwa ibyabaye rwanda kuko mbere ntibabashaga kuvuga habaye jenoside yakorewe abatutsi ahubwo ahubwo ugasanga bakabyita amahano n’ibindi bitandukanye ati ubundi wasangaga babyitaga andi mazina amahanoibyagwiririye igihugumbese ntibabivuge mazina yabyo bikwiriye kwitwanoneho tubona nk’ubuyobozi batangiye gutinyuaka bakabivuga mazina yabyo jenoside yakorewe abatutsi ntabwo itsimba stembani ibikwereka imyumvire iginda ihinduka avuga kandi adepr ryagize uruhare rukomeye gufasha leta bikorwa bitandukanye birimo n’ibyo gutera inkunga abarokotse jenoside yakorewe abatutsi kuko karere gasabo yashoboye kubakira imiryango y’abarokotse jenoside yakorewe abatutsi amazu murenge gikomero ndetse kugira urahare gutangira abatishoboye ubwisungane kwivuza yanditswe habarurema djamali

title: covid fao iraburira ibihugu kutirara kaga k’inzara
content: mu gihe isi ikomeje guhangana n’icyorezo koronavirusicovid ishami ry’umuryango w’abibumbye ryita biribwa n’ubuhinzi fao yashyize hanze raporo iburira ibihugu kaga gashobora guterwa n’inzara yitezwe fao iraburira ibihugu kutirara kaga k’inzara fao iravuga bihugu bikennye abaturage basanzwe batunzwe n’ubuhinzi ndetse n’ubucuruzi buciciritse bikaba bitarimo gukorwa neza nk’uko byari bisanzwe kubera cyorezo dominique bourgeo umuyobozi w’ishami ryita biza fao avuga mbere y’uko icyorezo covid cyaduka isi hari miriyoni z’abaturage bahanganye n’ikibazo kutabona kurya bihagije fao itangaza n’ubwo mugabane n’umwe wakwirara kaga k’inzara gashobora guterwa n’iki cyorezo ariko nko afurika ibihugu birimo ethiopia kenya somalia byari bisanzwe byarazahajwe n’amapfa atewe n’inzige aha ho fao ihera ivuga nibura miriyoni z’abaturage bashobora kuzahara birushijeho bitewe n’icyorezo koronavirusi nko karere afurika hagati n’igice cy’aho u rwanda ruherereye fao ihangayikishijwe kandi n’ibihugu bikunda kurangwamo imirwano centre afrique repubulia iharanira demokarasi kongo ndetse sudani y’epfo ariko kubera ingaruka zishobora guterwa n’icyorezo koronavirusi ri shami loni ryatangiye kusanya miriyari z’amadorari y’amerika baterankunga bayo guteganya kugoboka abashonje mu gihe ingendo kirere hirya hino zahagaritswe fao ivuga yatangiye gukorana n’abafatanyabikorwa rwego kurebera hamwe bizagenda n’ubwo ibihugu bisanzwe bitanga inkunga nyinshi muryango nterankunga nabyo byibasiwe n’icyorezo koronavirusi fao kandi itangaza ikibazo gikomeye ariko yatangiye kubona ibihugu bikize isi bifite ubusake gukomeza gutanga nkunga nubwo bizahajwe n’iki cyorezo ni gihe imibare y’abantu bakomeza kwandura kwicwa koronavirusi isi ikomeje kwiyongera ndetse n’ibihugu bigakomeza gufata ingamba ziremereye zirimo gufunga imipaka yabyo bidasize guhagarika urujya n’uruza rw’abaturage fao ishami loni rikurikirana ubuhinzi n’ibiribwa riraburira ibihugu kudafunga imipaka yabyo bijyanye n’ubwikorezi bw’ibiribwa raporo fao kaga k’inzara ishobora kwibasira abatuye isi gihe n’ubundi isi kaga k’icyorezo covid ije gihe umuryango w’abibumbye loni nawo watangaje ingaruka z’ubukungu zizaterwa n’ cyorezo zishobora gusiga abantu bagera miriyoni isi bukene ikigo ntaramakuru cy’abongereza bbc cyanditse cyumweru imiryango irenga isi yasabye ibihugu biri nzira y’amajyambere byakurirwaho amadeni bifite bikaba byafasha bihugu kubona nibura miriya z’amadolari yafasha ubukungu bwabyo bihe idasanzwe indatwaorg

title: imfubyi jenoside zirasaba kurushaho kwegerwa
content: nubwo u rwanda rufite rugeze guhangana n’ingaruka jenoside abana bagizwe imfubyi baracyakeneye inama urukundo gusurwa kwitabwaho kuko abakagombye kubibaha batagihari nk’uko byatangajwe n’uhagarariye ibuka karere rubavu kabanda innocent kabanda yasabye abanyarubavu kwita bana ndetse n’abapfakazi kabanda yongeyeho ubupfura batojwe butabemerera kwangana mpamvu biteguye gutanga imbabazi babiciye babishaka yagize ntabwo tuzizirika muntu watwiciye uzashaka imbabazi azatwegere tuzazimuha uyu munsi kwibuka tariki wabimburiwe n’urugendo ruva murenge rugerero rujya rwibutso rw’uwo murenge wanaranzwe n’indirimbo z’abana barokotse jenoside yakorewe abatutsi bibumbiye itsinda ryitwa imanzi’ ubuhamya gushyira indabo rwibutso rugerero ku isaha saa sita abanyarubavu bunamiye inzirakarengane iminota itatu hanyuma bakurikirana radiyo ijambo nyakubahwa perezida repubulika yavugiye sitade amahoro mujyi kigali umuyobozi w’akarere rubavu sheikh bahame hassan yashimiye abaturage b’ako karere kuba bitabiriye gahunda benshi anabasaba kuzitabira gahunda z’icyumweru cy’icyunamo zizaba zirimo ibiganiro yongeyeho kwegera abacitse icumu ingenzi bagahumurizwa urwibutso rugerero rushyinguyemo imibiri y’abatutsi gusoza icyumweru cy’icyunamo karere rubavu bikazabera murenge mudende tariki mata kugeza imibare yavuye bushakashatsi bwakozwe ibuka yerekana abazize jenoside bangana rwanda hose pascaline umulisa

title: uburwayi umutwe indwara nk’izindi kandi buravurwa
content: mu kiganiro yagiranye n’abanyamakuru kabiri tariki ukwakira dr kayiteshonga yvonne ukuriye ishami rishinzwe iby’ubuzima mutwe minisiteri y’ubuzima yagaragaje intera urwanda rumaze gutera mubijyanye guteza imbere ubuzima umutwe ugereranije n’ibindi bihugu karere hakaba harimo politiki nshya kwegereza abanyarwanda ubuvuzi bujyanye n’indwara umutwe kuburyo nibura byazagera kurwego rw’ibigo nderabuzima kuko kugeza hari abaganga b’ubuvuzi bw’uburwayi umutwe rwego rw’akarere gusa hashyizweho kandi serivisi yakira ikanasuzuma abafite ibibazo by’uburwayi umutwe yunganira ibitaro by’indera hatanzwe ibitabo bifasha abunganira ibikorwa by’ubuzima habayeho gufatanya n’izindi nzego leta guhangana niki kibazo igihe bibaye ngombwa nko gihe cy’inkiko gacaca gufatanya komisiyo ishinzwe gusezerera gusubiza mubuzima busanzwe ingabo zavuye kurugeroyasobanuye kandi uburwayi umutwe uburwayi nk’ubundi ndetse hari n’ubushobora kuvurwa bugakira ikibazo cy’uburwayi mumutwe rwanda kigenda gifata intera umwaka utashye nkuko imibare y’abitabira servise z’ubu buvuzi ibigaragaza mwaka umubare w’abagannye buvuzi abantu mwaka mwaka bamaze kugera umwaka ushize abagannye serivisi uretse kuba u rwanda rwarahuye jenoside ndetse n’ingaruka zayo zimwe muzindi mpamvu zitera kuzamuka kw’iyi mibare abanyarwanda bamaze gukangukira kwitabira gahunda z’ubuvuzi cyane cyane kuko banafite ubwisungane kwivuza ikindi imyumvire igenda ihinduka kuko ubundi wasangaga abafite burwayi barafungiranwaga bagahezwa bagahishwa cyangwa bakavurizwa mubavuzi gihanga mubapfumu bumwe buvuzi buhabwa abafite burwayi harimo imiti gufashwa buryo bw’ibiganiro hamwe kubafasha kwongera gusubira buzima busanzwe buryo butatu hari ushobora kubuhabwa bwose hari n’ushobora guhabwa bumwe cyakora uburyo gusubizwa buzima busanzwe bakaba babuhuriraho nubwo ariko hari ibyakozwe nibiteganywa gukorwa inzitizi ziracyahari izagarutsweho nk’ikibazo cy’imyumvire itari myiza ndwara mumutwe abantu bagitekereza uzirwaye atakiri umuntu muzima wagira akamaro bityo agahabwa akato imyumvire nimwe ijyana n’umuco ndetse n’imyizerere benshi bazita amarozi bagahitamo kugana abapfumu cyangwa hakaba abazifata nk’amadayimoni bakaguma nsengero ntibavuzwe ikindi umubare w’inzobere buvuzi ukiri muto rwanda mu butumwa bwatanzwe harimo kumva ikibazo cy’uburwayi umutwe icya buri wese kandi uwahuye nabwo akitabwaho mumuryango hakabaho guhindura imyumvire ndwara hakorwa ubukangurambaga buhagije kugira imikoranire hagati ministeri y’ubuzima n’abavuzi gihanga kuko usanga abafite burwayi abenshi ariho babanza bigatuma bagera kubuvuzi nyabwo batinze ikindi nabagize ibyago kuzirwara bakwiye gufashwa bakanitabwaho muryango nyarwanda kuko uburwayi umutwe nabwo uburwayi nkubundi ndetse nuwahuye nabwo akongera kwakirwa buzima busanzwe marie jose ikibasumba

title: covid- ibiciro peteroli byahanantutse idolari riratumbagira
content: zimwe ngaruka nshya covid- zitangiye kwigaragaza ibicio lisansi mazutu byahanantutse mbere mateka bikagera munsi y’idolari ibi byatumye idolari naryo ritumbagira mbere rica iyero abakozi ntibakijya kazi imodoka n’indege biraparitse amakamyo n’amabisi kiva imihanda irera deee gahunda guma rugo kuba ukwezi kurenga gushize ibinyabiziga bitajya muhanda kindi byari gusiga usibye guta agaciro peteroli ku isoko amerika igiciro cy’akagunguru lisansi cyagiye munsi y’idolari kamanutseho amadolari mbere ibigega lisansi biracyuzuye abayikoreshaga ntabo amasezerano n’abakiriya bayo amerika agomba kurangira none kandi igihari icyihutirwa ukugabanuka kw’ibiciro ariko nanone bigaha amahirwe idolari america kuzamuka cyane ejo satanu z’ijoro idolariryari risanzwe munsi y’iyero ryari rimaze kurirengaho uko inkuru le figaro ibivuga ubukungu bw’isi ntibushobora kuzahuka ubw’amerika bukiri hasi kuko idolari ryo ribitse ubudahangarwa bw’icyo gihugu cy’igihangange inzobere by’ubukungu kathy lien bk asset management america ivuga ubushake prerezida trump kongera ishoramari kurushaho kwezi gutaha gatanu inganda nshya zigafungura zisanga izari zisanzwe ibi bikazatuma amadovize y’ibihugu bifite ubukungu buringaniye kandi bushingiye biciro peteroli ahungabana cyane nk’irubule ry’abarusiya ikorone norvege ipeso mexique ndeste n’idolari canada abaguzi basakiwe le figaro ikomeza ivuga idolari canada rishobora guhanantuka bitarenze cyumweru nk’uko amakuru bukungu abivuga ibi bizaterwa n’ubucuruzi budandaza buzagabanuka kubera covid- ibi binemezwa n’ikigega mpuzamahanga cy’imari fmi byose ingaruka covid- ariko kandi guhanantuka kw’ibiciro peteroli isoko ry’america gusa ntibuvuga ibindi bihugu bizadamarara kuko rwego rw’isi igiciro cyagabanutseho akagunguru kakagura amadolari ibi ntibisanzwe haba itandukaniro ringana ritya masoko yombi kuko ubusanzwe byabaga bigendana ubu harimo intera y’amadolari ane kagunguru ariko umushakashatsi francis perrin anavuga amasoko yombi afite amasezerano azarangira vuba kandi cyizere kubona abandi bakiriya mbere y’uko covid- iva nzira magingo barashaka abaguzi babasha kumara vuba peteroli ibitse bigega ariko ntibyoroshye nyine kubera guma rugo ibi biratuma bagabanya ibiciro babashe kurangiza bigega habone kujyamo indi buryo banifuza kwishyura uwabasha kuyikuramo ibigega bibonekeingamba kugabanya ibiciro hose mu bihe bisanzwe imodoka zigenda abakoresha peteroli benshi ariko ibihugu biyicuruza birasabwa kumanura ibiciro uyu umwanzuro wamaze gufatirwa hamwe n’ibihugu bigize umuryango pep ihuza ibihugu bisarura bikanacuruza peteroli biyobowe arabiya sawudite n’uburusiya aya masezerano azatangira kwezi gutaha gatanu arareba utugunguru miliyoni munsi gusa tungana y’umusaruro peteroli isi ikigo mpuzamahanga cy’ingufulagence internationale de l’nergie -aie kivuga uku kwezi kane utugunguru twakoreshejwe isi twamanutseho buri munsi ugereranije mbere nabyo ubwa mbere bibaye karegeya omar
