title: twakomeje kubaka ubushobozi butuma tubasha gukora ubucuruzi kureshya ishoramari- perezida kagame
content: mu gihe habura amezi atandatu isoko rusange afurika ritangire perezida repubulika paul kagame asanga ibihugu afurika byiteguye kubyaza umusaruro mahirwe azatuma ubucuruzi hagati yabyo bwikuba inshuro zirenga ibi umukuru w’igihugu mbere yabigaragarije i londres nama ishoramari ihuza gihugu n’umugabane afurika izwi uk-africa investment summit i londres perezida kagame yabanje kugirana ibiganiro minisitiri w’intebe w’u bwongereza boris johnson ibiganiro byibanze mubano n’ubutwererane hagati y’ibihugu byombi yanaganiriye kandi n’igikomangoma cy’u bwongereza william ibiganiro by’aba banyacyubahiro bombi bikaba byabereye ngoro y’ubwami bw’u bwongereza mu kiganiro bucuruzi n’ishoramari perezida kagame yakomoje mahirwe isoko rusange afurika rizatangira gukora buryo bweruye nyakanga mwaka muri kiganiro yahuriyemo bagenzi barimo peter mutharika malawi alpha cond guinea ndetse n’umunyamabanga leta y’u bwongereza ushinzwe ubucuruzi n’ishoramari liz truss perezida kagame yavuze ibihugu afurika byamaze kwitegura kubyaza inyungu iryo soko kuko rizatuma ubucuruzi hagati yabyo bwikuba inshuro bukava bubarirwaho bukarenga aha yagaragaje u rwanda rukomeje kubaka ubushobozi bw’abarutuye kugira bagire ubumenyi butuma bahatana isoko rigari ndetse rukaba rukomeje umurego kurushaho korohereza abifuza kurushoramo imari ati ku ruhande rwacu twakomeje kubaka ubushobozi butuma tubasha gukora ubucuruzi kureshya ishoramari uko rutonde doing business banki y’isi yashyize u rwanda bihugu biri isonga korohereza abashoramari mu mwaka ushize u rwanda rwari mwanya afurika ndetse n’uwa isi ibyo byose tubikorera kureshya ishoramari koroshya ubucuruzi burimo n’ubwambukiranya imipaka kandi imibare yerekana isoko rusange afurika rizatuma ubucuruzi hagati y’ibihugu afurika bwiyongera gipimo kirenga ibyo birerekana amahirwe akomeye u rwanda n’ibindi bihugu afurika twiteguye kubyaza umusaruro gutangamo umusanzu iyi nama mbere ihuje u bwongereza afurika ikaba ibaye gihe u bwongereza bwitegura muryango w’ubumwe bw’u burayi bitarenze uku kwezi mutarama minisitiri w’intebe w’u bwongereza boris johnson watangije nama yagaragaje u bwongereza bubona afurika nk’umufatanyabikorwa w’ingirakamaro bucuruzi n’ishoramari mpamvu bwateguye nama rwego kurushaho kunoza ubufatanye hagati y’impande zombi bwana boris johnson yagaragaje igihugu cye cyifuza kubaka ubufatanye buhamye by’ubucuruzi n’ishoramari buzanira inyungu umugabane afurika ndetse n’u bwongereza kuko asanga impande zombi magirirane muri koroshya ubucuruzi n’ishoramari hagati y’impande zombi leta y’u bwongereza yavuze iteganya korohereza abanyafurika kubona icyangombwa kibemerera kwinjira gihugu cyizwi visa kuko butwererane hagati y’impande zombi abantu bagomba kuba isonga hatekerezwa kandi ibijyanye kugabanya imisoro bihugu byohereza ibicuruzwa gihugu impuguke bukungu alex nkurunziza yemeza byatuma u bwongereza bwigarurira isoko afurika byumwihariko iry’ibihugu afurika y’iburasirazuba muri nama bufatanye banki y’isi leta y’u rwanda yashyize isoko ry’imari n’imigabane londres impapuro mvunjwafaranga z’imyaka itatu zifite agaciro miliyoni z’amadolari amerika ni gihe kandi ibigo bitandukanye bikorera rwanda byitabiriye nama rwego kurushaho kureba uburyo kwagura ishoramari ryabyo u bwongereza buza mwanya bihugu bifite ishoramari ryinshi rwanda nko myaka ishize ishoramari rituruka gihugu riza rwanda ribarirwa agaciro miliyoni z’amadorali ukuvuga asaga miliyari z’amafaranga y’u rwanda ibihugu afurika byitabiriye nama bikaba bihagarariwe n’abakuru b’ibihugu title: ibintu byakwereka umuhungu akunda umukobwa by’ukuri cyangwa yishakira kuryamana
content: ni gute wowe mukobwa cyangwa mugore wamenya umugabo agukunda by’ukuri iki ikibazo gikomeye ku gisubiza kuko hari bamwe bagabo benshi bifitiye irari ryo gukunda abagore ariko bakaba bafite umugambi kuryamana nabo atari ukugira bashyingiranwegusa hari n’abandi bakunda abakobwa babafitiye umugambi rushinga ndetse rugakomera buryarya mukobwa ibi ibimenyetso byakwereka umuhungu agukunda by’ukuri cyangwa yishakira muryamana gusa iyo ashishikajwe kumenya umunsi wawe wagenze bivuze ashaka mukundana bizira uburya bitagamije ukuryamana iyo akwandikiye cyangwa akaguhamagara gitondo bisobanuye ikintu cyambere atekerezaho igihe cyose bivuze agukunda by’ukuri ndetse anacyeneye mwazashyingiranwa iyo akwandikiye ariko akabikora ninjoro yishimiye cyangwa ashishikajwe kuryamana by’ ukuri ntabwo agambiriye mwazashyingiranwa usibye gukorana imibonano mpuzabitsina gusa uko akwita bishobora kukugaragariza agukunda by’ukuri cyangwa ashaka mwiryamaniraakenshi azakwita amazina wumva ntakizere atanga k’umubano wanyu w’ahazaza mwembi usibye y’amazina ashirana n’agahararo iyo agusabye umwoherereza amafoto yawe agaragaza umbwambure bwawe ukoresheje telefone yishimira ku kwamamaza gusa rukundo agufitiye ruzatuma mushyingiranwa usibye kuryamana ikintu kibaho kumwe cyerekana agukunda by’ukuri cyangwa mukundana kuryamanaiyo ashaka mugirana ikiganiro kizaicyo gihe muba mukundana bifite intego kurushingaariko akora byose biganisha kuba yagukorakora ku mabuno kukwitegereza cyane cyangwa ku kwiyegereza cyane muhagaze ntakabuza acyeneye biba ukuryamana gusa iyo yohereje ubutumwa ategura byose bikaba ukukubona kandi akavuga n’ibintu bidasobanutse byose ashaka kuba ukwiryamanira gusa iyo ahora aguhamagara cyangwa akakwandikira bikaba ikiganiro kirekire kidafite kigamije burya agukunda nyabyo gushidikanyaaha bisobanurwa n’uko akenshi ashaka muryamana akuganiriza avuga ndagukumbuye mukunzi ndetse n’ibindi byinshi mu gihe gukorana ikiganiroiyo kuvuga byose biba byerekeranye n’ibice bigize umubiri wawe kandi atari si abashaka akumenye nezaicyo ashaka kindi usibye kuryamana iyo ashaka kumenya byinshi wowe biganiro byose mugiranaicyo gihe agukunda bitagira amacyemwa kandi bishobora kurangira mushyingiranywe yanditswe habarurema djamali

title: kwibuka amb yasmin amri sued yasabye urubyiruko kurushaho gukurikirana amateka y’u rwanda
content: ni ubutumwa amb yasmin amri sued yahaye urubyiruko rwitabiriye umuhango kwibuka nshuro jenoside yakorewe abatutsi wabereye koreye y’epfo cyumweru tariki mata witabiriwe n’abanyarwanda gihugu n’abo cambodia hamwe bagera nyuma guhurizwa ikoranabuhanga kuko guhurira hamwe bitashobokaga kubera covid- ibiganiro byatangijwe n’umunota kwibuka umuyobozi w’umuryango w’abanyarwanda koreya y’epfo abdul karim uzabakiriho yavuze hakiri ikibazo cy’abakoze jenoside bakidegembya kandi bakomeje gukwirakwiza ubutumwa bw’urwango yavuze imiryango mpuzamahanga irimo umuryamgo w’abibumbye umuryango w’ubumwe bw’u burayi umuryango uharanira ubufatanye bukungu n’iterambere oecd n’indi ifite inshingano gufatanya guverinoma y’u rwanda n’abanyarwanda kurwanya bikorwa bibi mu buhamya alex rugamba wacitse icumu jenoside akaba asoje amasomo kaminuza konkuk yavuze afite imyaka itandatu y’amavuko jenoside yakorwaga yabonye se n’abavandimwe batandatu bicwa n’interahamwe yasangije abandi amateka y’inzira ikomeye yanyuzemo kugeza ingazo rpa zihagaritse jenoside akarokoka rugamba yashimiye guverinoma y’u rwanda gahunda yashyizeho gufasha abarokotse jenoside agaruka kigega farg kinyuzwamo ubufasha burimo kubakira amacumbi abarokotse kwishyurira abana amashuri gutanga ubuvuzi girinka barokotse n’izindi amb yasmin amri sued u rwanda rwafashe igihe kumva imizi y’icyateye jenoside gusesengura ibikorwa biganisha jenoside asaba urubyiruko kwihatira kubimenya ati rubyiruko rw’u rwanda ndabasaba mushyireho mubyumve munabisangizanye mumenye amateka yacu ni mwe musingi kugira ibyabaye myaka ishize bitazongera kubaho rwanda n’ahandi isi abahagarariye inyungu z’ibuhugu byabo koreya y’epfo bifatanyije n’abanyarwanda batanga ubutumwa butandukanye ambasaderi hazem fahmy uhagarariye misiri i seoul yifurije abanyarwanda amahoro n’uburumbuke ambasaderi sylvestre kouassi bile cte d’ivoire ashimangira urumuri rw’icyizere rugomba guhora rwaka kugira jenoside itazongera rwanda n’ahandi isi amb matilda masuka tanzania yagize twifatanyije n’abavandimwe b’abanyarwanda kuvuga ntibizongere kubaho ukundi’ mu gihe dukomeje kubaka ibihugu byacu tuzi ntacyo twageraho tudafatanyije perezida kagame yabyerekanye bikorwa bye hari kandi ambasaderi shiferaw shigute wolassa ethiopia washimye abanyarwanda n’abayobozi barwo bagezeho nyuma y’amateka mabi jenoside yakorewe abatutsi

title: akarere rubavu karishimira ibikorwa by’amajyambere kagezeho
content: mu bikorwa byamuritswe harimo umuhanda uhuza imipaka yombi y’u rwanda repubulika iharanira demokarasi kongo grande et petite barierre ukazatwara akayabo k’amafaranga akabakaba miliyoni ndetse n’ umuhanda pave ujya biro by’akarere watangiye gukorwa munsi umuyobozi w’akarere sheh bahame hassan yavuze akarere kabwiye rwiyemezamirimo imodoka zikora mihanda zitazasubirayo utugari title: bugeserabarishimira bagiye gutera imyaka nk’abandi nyuma y’ibihuha by’uko imvura bayibuzwa n’iyubakwa ry’ikibuga
content: abaturage karere bugesera bahawe imbuto y’ibigori ku kugira binjire gihembwe k’ihinga bitabagoye dore n’imvura imaze kuboneka bayitegeranyije amatsiko menshi kuko ikunze kubura aka karere bakabihuza n’ibihuha by’uko abazungu bubaka ikibuga k’indege bugesera aribo bayibuza kugwa bamwe bahinzi baganiriye muhaburarw bavuga bishimiye imvura yaguye bakaba banahawe n’imbuto y’ibigori bityo biragaragara nabo bazasarura bakabona ikibatunga nzayikorera damien utuye murenge ririma avuga igihe cyari kibaye kirekire bategereje imbuto ndetse n’imvura kugira batere yagize atiimvura yatinze kugwa bityo duhinga nyuma ariko yarabonetse buryo bugaragara none tukaba turi guhinga tunashyira ibigori butaka bavuga bashimira leta y’u rwanda ibicishije ministeri y’ubuhinzi ifatanyije n’ikigo cy’ubuhinzi rab mukubashakira imbuto y’ibigori kandi yatoranyijwe mugenzi witwa mujawamariya drocella avuga bibazaga uburyo bazabaho bikabayobera yagize atitwumva abandi bateye imyaka kera twe twibazaga bizagenda gute bikatuyoberaariko byakemutse kuko imvura iragwa neza ndetse tukaba turi gushyira ibigori butaka kibazo kandi tukaba twiteguye kuzasarura natwe umuyobozi w’akarere bugesera mutabazi richard yavuze gikorwa gikomeje mirenge y’akarere bugesera kugira abaturage bahinge hakiri kare yagize atinta murenge tuzasiga tudatanze imbuto y’ibigori dore n’imvura kugwa ku buryo bugaragara igihembwe cy’ihinga kizagende neza n’umusaruro uzaboneke ni gihe bamwe baturage b’akarere bugesera bagize impungenge zivanze n’ibihuha bavuga kubura kw’imvura aka karere bishobora kuba biterwa n’iyubakwa ry’ikibuga cy’indege bugesera bavuga abazungu bazanye icyuma gisubiza imvura hejuru cyikayibuza kugwa itabangiririza imirimo gusa kugeza ibyishimo byose kuko basanze bibwiraga atari dore imirimo y’iyubakwa ry’icyo kibuga igikomeje ndetse nabo bazungu bakaba bakiri kucyubaka ndetse n’imvura ikaba igwa kibazo imbuto y’ibigori bahawe ikizere nabo bagiye guhinga bakabona ikibatungaabahinzi bavuga bafite ikizere imvura izabereza imyaka bitewe n’uko igwa nk’uko bisanzwe denis fabrice nsengumuremyimuhaburarw

title: imbuto foundation yatangije umushinga ugamije gukumira inda ziterwa abangavu nyagatare burera
content: uyu mushinga watangijwe mugaragaro kane tariki mutarama karere nyagatare witezweho gufasha abana hagati y’imya icumi gusobanukirwa ibijyanye n’ubuzima bw’imyororokere hifashishijwe ababyeyi zigabanuke kayiranga yakomeje avuga bazafasha urubyiruko ruri matsinda buzima bw’imyororokere kubona ibiganiro serivisi bigo nderabuzima n’amavuriro y’ibanze bazakoresha imikino ibiganiro rusange ndetse banapime abana kubushake indwara zitandukanye umuyobozi w’akarere nyagatare wungirije ushinzwe imibereho myiza y’abaturage murekatete julliet yashimiye imbuto foundation gikorwa cyiza izanye karere kabo avuga kuba bafite imibare myinshi y’abana batwara inda imburagihe usanga ababyeyi n’abana badafite ubumenyi buzima bw’imyororokere bakaba bazahita bahera babyeyi nteko z’abaturage kugira babigishe yakomeje agira amakimbirane miryango niyo ntandaro mbere abenshi batarahindura imyumvire buringanire muryango umuyobozi w’urwunge rw’amashuri rwempasha yavuze hakenewe imikoranire mwarimu n’umubyeyi kuganiriza umwana w’umukobwa buzima bw’imyororokere ati umuntu mukuru wese akwiye kumva abonye umwana agiye gutatira igihango nshingano akwiye kongera kumukumira nk’umwana cyangwa benshi batewe inda byibuze mwaka ushize abangavu batewe inda imburagihe nkuko bitangazwa n’umuyobozi w’akarere nyagatare wungirije

title: ahantu umunani ho kwibandaho isuku rugo
content: abantu bagakwiye kwibanda buryo kwirinda ’microbes’ zigira ingaruka mbi buzima zikwirakwira zabo kwibanda gusukura ahagaragara hasa nabi ibi ibikubiye bushakashatsi bushya bw’ikigo cyigenga cyita buzima bwongereza ubu bushakashatsi bw’ikigo royal society for public health rsph buvuga gukaraba intoki kumesa ibitambaro guhanagura amasahani n’ibindi byombo koza ahategurirwa amafunguro byose bikozwe gihe nyacyo ingenzi isuku ariko ubushakashatsi bw’iki kigo buburira umuntu umwe buri bantu bane atekereza atari ingenzi kwita isuku neza bishobora kugabanya indwara zandura ndetse guha ubushobozi n’imiti iba itagishobora indwara nkuko bushakashatsi bubivuga kandi suku ikabije ibaho ubu bushakashatsi buvuga hari urujijo baturage itandukaniro hagati y’umwanda ’microbes’ gucya n’isuku mu bantu bakoreweho bushakashatsi batekereza abana bacyeneye gushyirwa ’microbes’ zagira ingaruka mbi buzima bwabo hubakwe ubwirinzi bw’umubiri wabo ariko impuguke zakoze bushakashatsi zivuga imyumvire ishobora kugira ingaruka mbi igatuma bishoka indwara zahitana ubuzima bwabo izi mpuguke zisaba ahubwo abantu bakwiye kwibanda gusukura ahantu h’ingenzi bihe by’ingenzi nubwo haba hagaragara nk’ahasukuye kurinda ’microbes’ ’mbi’ zikwiragira ni ibihe bice kwibandaho isuku mu gutegura kugabura amafunguromu kurisha intokiigihe abantu bakorora bitsamura cyangwa bakura umwanda mazurumu gihe gukoresha kumesa ibitambaro byanduye bikoreshwa nzumu gihe kwita mbwamu kwegeranya kumena imyandamu kwita muntu muryango wanduye indwara runakaubu bushakashatsi buvuga ingenzi by’umwihariko gukaraba intoki nyuma gufata ibiribwa uvuye bwiherero umaze gukorora kwitsamura kwita murwayi kwita mbwa bwongeraho ingenzi gusukura igikoni n’aho gukatira ibiribwa bibisi nk’inyama n’ibikomoka nkoko n’ibindi muryango wazo cyangwa mbere guteka ibiryo byoroheje nk’imigati ubu bushakashatsi buvuga hasi nzu hashobora kugaragara handuye ariko haba hari ’microbes’ akenshi zidashobora kugira ingaruka nini buzima gusukura bikuraho ’bactrie’ gute koza ahantu buso runaka ndetse n’ibikoresho gikoni ugakoresha amazi y’akazuyaza kandi arimo isabune bikuraho udukoko twa ’bactrie’ tukajyana n’ayo mazi gihe koza ununyuguza ariko kugira ’bactries’ zipfe neza neza bisaba kuzitwikisha amazi ashyushye kigero kirenga dogere c kandi woza ukabimaza akanya mazi nkuko bivugwa n’ikigo food standards agency cyita buziranenge bw’ibiribwa bwongereza profeseri sally bloomfield kaminuza london school of hygiene and tropical medicine avuga abantu bakwiye gusobanukirwa n’itandukaniro riri hagati y’isuku kuba ahantu cyangwa umuntu agaragara acyeye mu gihe gusukura bivuze gukuraho umwanda ’microbes’ isuku umuco ugusukura ahantu ha ngombwa bihe ngombwa kwirinda kwandura indwara nko gihe hategurwa amafunguro gihe gukoresha ubwiherero profeseri lisa ackerley impuguke isuku y’ibiribwa kigo rsph cyakoze bushakashatsi yavuze isuku buzima buri munsi ifasha kugabanya indwara zandura kandi ingenzi cyane kurinda abana bacu chief editor muhaburarw

title: gufungura umupaka uganda n’ u rwanda bizaganirwaho ubutaha
content: ibiganiro byahuje itsinda ryaturutse uganda n’ itsinda ryari rihagarariye guverinoma y’ u rwanda byarangiye impande zombi zemeranyije ingingo gufungura urujya n’ uruza izaganirwaho nama itaha izabera uganda ibiganiro byahuje itsinda ryaturutse uganda n’ itsinda ryari rihagarariye guverinoma y’ u rwanda byarangiye impande zombi zemeranyije ingingo gufungura urujya n’ uruza izaganirwaho nama itaha izabera uganda muri nama yabereye i kigali guverinoma y’ u rwanda ihagarariwe n’ umunyamabanga leta minisiteri y’ ububanyi n’ amahanga ushinzwe afurika y’ iburasirazuba amb olivier nduhungirehe guverinoma uganda ihagarariwe minisitiri w’ ububanyi n’ amahanga sam kutesa nk’ bigaragara myanzuro y’ nama u rwanda rwashyikirije uganda urutonde rw’ abanyarwanda bafungiyeyo buryo bunyuranyije n’ amategeko ibihugu byombi byemeranyije guhagarika ibikorwa bihungabanya umutekano buri ruhande impande zombi kandi zemeranyije zigiye kurangiza amasezerano guhererekana abanyabyaha n’ abakekwaho ibyaha iyi nama kwiga ishyirwa bikorwa ry’ amasezerano luanda ibaye gihe abaturage b’ ibihugu byombi babangamiwe kuba umubano w’ ibihugu byombi wazamo agatotsi imigenderanire n’ ubucuruzi bitagikorwa neza hagarikwa ry’ binyamakuru ukwiyongera ikwirakwizwa ry’ icengezamatwara ’proganda’ zanyuzwaga binyamakuru mu nama yabereye i kigali impande zombi zemeranyije guhagarika propaganda mbuga nkoranyambaga content: liyetona generali carlos alberto dos santos cruz umaze imyaka isaga ayoboye ingabo monusco zagiye congo butumwa bw’amahoro kugarura umutekano gihugu yavuye mirimo munsi w’ejo tariki ugushyingo gihe ubutumwa muzanye agiye ntakintu cyari cyakorwa kuko amahoro atari yaboneka cyane duce twinshi twa kivu y’amjyaruguru mu nama yanyuma nk’umuyobozi monusco dos santos yatangarije abanyakuru n’ubwo agiye ariko ubutumwa bw’amahoro muzanye kintu yageraho kuko hari byinshi l’onu ifite gukorera abaturage harimo kurwanya akarengane kabakorerwa umutekano mukeya urangwa gihugu ndetse kurinda abaturage imitwe y’iterabwoba irangwa repubulika iharanira demukarasi congo n’ubwo agiye dos santos byinshi afatanije monusco bagezeho harimo nko kugarura amahoro ndetse kugarura miryango igizwe n’abantu hagati y’ibihumbi yarakuwe byayo n’inyeshyamba duce twa kivu y’amajyepfo gice pinga cyari cyarazahajwe n’inyeshyamba igihe kirekire akaba atangaza monusco yagerageje kugarura amahoro utu duce gihe cy’imyaka ibiri n’igice uyu dos santos ukomoka brezil yagizwe umukuru w’ingabo monusco ban kii moon umunyamabanga kuru w’umuryango w’abibumbye kwezi mata asimbuye generali chander prakash ukomoka gihugu cy’ubuhinde yanditswe sarongo richardmuhaburarw

content: u rwanda rufite abagore nteko ishinga amategeko gihe guverinoma nama njyanama z’inzego z’ibanze ntirwirengagijwe uruhare rw’umugore kwagura ubukerarugendo mu bufatanye bw’u rwanda leta zunze ubumwe z’abarabu uae abagore bakora serivisi kwakira neza ababagana hoteli abayobora mukerarugendo n’abandi bahawe ubumenyi buzabafasha kugendana n’ibipimo mpuzamahanga uru rwego aya mahugurwa yakozwe guha abagore ubushobozi buzabaremamo abayobozi b’ahazaza rwego rw’ubukerarugendo’’ umwiza joana utwara imodoka zitembereza abakerarugendo yavuze ubumenyi yungutse bwatumye bagenzi biyemeza gukora cyane batarebwa nk’abadashoboye yagize hari batubwiye dusanga hari impinduka n’inyongera ikenewe twungutse dukwiye kwakira neza abatugana binyuze gutegura neza igihe guhura n’umukiliya serivisi umuha n’akarusho karengaho birenze yiteze batubwiye kumenya umuntu yakongera serivisi iryohere uwamugannye hari abakobwa bitinyutse ndetse bikanabakura bibasubiza inyuma’’ umuyobozi wungirije palast rock hotel i nyamata kamikazi aurore wahuguwe yavuze bukerarugendo hari amahirwe menshi ati aya mahugurwa n’amahirwe ahari tuyakoreshe twerekane dushoboye turi gushaka ibisubizo gukuraho imbogamizi kwitinya kumva udashoboye twize kwihutisha serivisi kubikora tubikunze’’ abahuguwe bemeza gihe serivisi zizanozwa abakiliya bazahora babagana banakangurire bagenzi kuza bwinshi ambasaderi uae rwanda hazza mohammed falah kharsan al qahtani yavuze amahugurwa yatanzwe ashushanya uruhare rw’ubukerugendo bukungu ati imikoranire uae n’u rwanda yatangiye kera bikorana mishinga itandukanye ibihugu byacu byizera ubukungu buhamye buzagerwaho binyuze mikoranire hagati y’umugore n’umugabo’’ u rwanda rwizeye kwinjiza miliyoni avuye bukerarugendo minisitiri w’uburezi dr mutimura eugne yavuze urwego rw’ubukerarugendo rwakuze myaka ibiri ishize umusaruro mbumbe w’igihugu wazamutse ugera miliyoni ati u rwanda rwiyemeje guteza imbere ubukerarugendo bushingiye nama ibyo bizabaho gihe ababakira bafatwa nk’urumuri bafite ubushobozi rwego mpuzamahanga dushimishijwe n’ubumenyi abagore bahawe buzabafasha guteza imbere ubukerarugendo turabashishikariza kugira intego gukora cyane ndizera imbuto zavuye hano zizagira akamaro’’ mu mitangire serivisi rusange u rwanda ruhagaze gipimo gihe rwifuza kugera umuyobozi ushinzwe ubukerarugendo kigo cy’igihugu cy’iterambere rdb belise kariza yavuze amahugurwa yateguwe guha umwihariko ab’ingeri zitandukanye kugaragaza amahirwe bukerarugendo yagize urwego rw’ubukerarugendo rumwe zizana amadevise menshi ni ugutangira gutekereza abari n’abategarugori babyaza umusaruro amahirwe aburimo iyo ureze umugore biba iby’agaciro gakomeye tuzakomeza ubukangurambaga kandi tugomba gutanga serivisi zihanitse’’ aya mahugurwa y’iminsi itatu title: gicumbi uhagarariye ishyirahamwe ryazimye arasaba gusarura ishyamba leta
content: dukundinzuki icyahoze ishyirahamwe ry’abavumvu murenge rukomo karere gicumbi ku butaka bugizwe n’ishyamba iryo shyirahamwe ryahawe rikibaho ryiyongereyeho ubungana nabwo kandi gatashya damien urihagarariye asaba kurisarura ingingo kwigarurira imitungo leta zagarutsweho nteko y’abaturage y’akagari cyeya murenge rukomo yanitabiriwe kuwa kabiri ushize ministiri w’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu prof shyaka anastase icyari akarere rebero - ntara byumba niko kahaye ubutaka bw’ishyamba ishyirahamwe dukundinzuki mbere gato y’umwaka ubwo butaka bwari gukoreraho ibikorwa by’umuvumvu bungana metero metero iryo shyirahamwe ryakoreraga i karambi segiteri cyuru akarere rebero murenge rukomo akarere gicumbi gatashya damien uhagarariye shyirahamwe avuga ryatangiye ririmo abaturage benshi segiteri cyuru rifite imizinga nyamara avuga basigaye abantu muzinga n’umwe rifite biro rigira rikoreramo gihe amashyirahamwe yaje guhindurwa koperative ntiribikore mu gihe kubaruza ubutaka ishyirahamwe ryiyongereye ubundi leta zari zihinduka icyangombwa kirasohoka magingo iryo shyirahamwe hagaragara urihagarariye gusa gatashya damien ucunga butaka buriho ishyamba niwe urisarura igihe kigeze niwe ugurishamo igiti bibaye ngombwa gatashya avuga ishyirahamwe batigeze koperative ati tuzashakana dukore inama duhindure ibikorwa tuve buvumvu ubutaka leta yaduhaye bugizwe n’ishyamba ariko bigeze kuvuga twarengereye akarere kari karaduhaye metero niho twororeraga kirimo n’ibiti barabyiba tariki nzeri komite ishinzwe ubutaka kagari munyinya umurenge rukomo wakoze igenzura uvumbura nubwo shyirahamwe ritakibaho ubutaka rifitiye icyangombwa bwikubye kabiri ryahawe leta ndlr kuba ritagikora ryagombaga gusubiza ubutaka ryahawe kubikora ahubwo ryiyongeza ubundi nubwo gatashya avuga bivugwa barengereye ubuyobozi bw’umurenge rukomo bwamwandikiye ibaruwa itariki nzeri imusaba gusubiza icyangombwa cy’ubutaka upi kugira hakurweho ubwa leta barengereye iyi baruwa y’uwari umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’umurenge rukomo mbarushimana prudence isoza igira iti mboneyeho kukumenyesha cyangombwa ugomba kuba wagishyikirije umukozi ushinzwe ubutaka bitarenze tariki nzeri utabyubahiriza ugakurikiranwa n’amategeko ahana abigabiza imitungo leta ubwo twavuganaga gatashya murongo telefoni mpera gashyantare yavugaga atazi neza koko bararengereye ahubwo bategereje ubuyobozi bubereke barengereye nyamara buyobozi bwari bumaze amezi arenga ane bubimumenyesheje bunamusaba gusubiza icyangombwa amakuru aturuka cyahoze segiteri cyuru avuga gatashya yaba yaratangiye inzira gusaba ibyangombwa gusarura shyamba hakaba n’abavuga yarigurishije n’undi muntu w’umunyamategeko ukomoka segiteri ubwo yagendereraga umurenge rukomo kuwa kabiri ushize minisitiri w’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu prof turaza kuzana imbaraga z’amategeko n’izindi zose zishoboka turasaba akarere kugaruza imitungo leta yigaruriwe n’aba bantu ibya leta bisubizwe leta iby’abigira kaganga byararangiye gihugu cyacu title: indwara kujojoba fistula n’ingaruka zayo buzima bw’uyirwaye
content: fistule cyangwa kujojoba indwara iterwa n’uko haba habayeho gukomereka gice ndangagitsina cy’umubyeyi gihe arimo kubyara ibyo bigaragara cyane babyeyi batabyarira muganga kandi bakeneye kubagwa bigatuma habaho inzira idasanzwe ihuza uruhago rw’inkari inzira y’inkari n’inkondo y’umura cyangwa inkondo y’umura n’urura runiri rusohora umusarani bigatuma umugore ahora asohora imyanda twakwita iba yayobye kuko inyura nkondo y’umura igasohokera gitsina rutangira mpamvu bayita kujojoba kugira ushobore kumenya bihagije iby’iyi ndwara twifashishije ibyatangajwe n’inzobere zitandukanye by’ubuzima mu kiganiro dr gedeon mulumba mukendi yagiranye n’agasarocom yavuze ikibazo cyiganje cyane bihugu biri nzira y’amajyambere muri bihugu usanga abagore benshi bagira ibibazo by’ihohoterwa kubyara bigoranye isuku nke abaganga batahuguwe bihagije n’ibindi ibi byose ibyangiza biriya bice by’umugore ubusanzwe bitajya byihanganira ikintu cyose giturutse hanze yagize umugore watinze nda ubyara umwana ufite umutwe munini cyangwa afite inkari zuzuye uruhago afite ibyago kwangirika kuko umwana atinda arwana gusohora umutwe aziba imitsi y’amaraso nzira z’inkari n’iyo nkondo y’umura cyangwa agatobora uruhago rw’inkari muganga gedeon avuga hari n’igihe urura runini narwo rutoboka cyangwa umwanya hagati y’inkondo y’umura n’ahanyura umusarane ugatanyuka bigatuma imyanda inyura nkondo y’umura iyi ndwara igira ingaruka nyinshi muntu uyirwaye kuko itinze kuvurwa itera ingaruka nyinshi nko guhagarara kw’imihango kugumbaha imibonano mpuzabitsina ntiba igishoboka kuko umubiri w’aho imyanda inyura hamera nk’ahumye buryo ikintu gikozeho ucika nk’urupapuro ishobora gutera cancer cg n’izindi infections zigira ingaruka mbi buzima bw’umuntu akenshi kubera umunuko uhora muntu urwaye ndwara babana baramunena agahezwa akiheza akenshi bene babyeyi bibaviramo gutabwa n’abo bashakanye bikagira n’ingaruka cyane buzima bwe mutwe dr gedeon akomeza atangariza agasarocom fistule akenshi ivurwa bitarenze igihe cy’amezi atatu uhereye igihe umugore yagiriye kibazo iyo kirenze biragorana kubera iriya myanya iba yarorohereye bigasaba ushaka indi kuyisimbuza kandi ntayibaho akomeza asobanura gihe ntacyo ushobora kumumarira uretse ubujyanama kugirango umuvure ihungabana yaratewe kwiheba ndetse kwiyanga kubera uburyo afatwa sosiyete abamo n’ubwo bimeze bityo ariko minisiteri y’ubuzima nayo ntiyicaye nk’uko dr anicet nzabonimpa umuhuzabikorwa gahunda kuboneza imbyaro minisante yabitangarije igihe u rwanda rwafashe ingamba guca burundu ndwara bakangurira abagore kubyarira muganga ministeri y’ubuzima kandi ifatanyije loni bafashe icyemezo kuvura ababyeyi bagaragayeho ndwara gihugu hose bwana cheikh fall ukuriye unfpa kiganiro yagiranye n’igihecom umuryango w’abibumbye ntuzahwema gushyigikira u rwanda nzira hoherezwa impuguke kuvura ndwara izahaza ababyeyi gusa ababyeyi nabo barasabwa kwitabira kwivuriza bigo nderabuzima nako bitabira kwipimisha igihe batwite anne-marie niwemwiza

title: ingaruka ziri kugaragara isi zitewe n’ihindagurika ry’ibihe

title: south african airways yasubukuye ingendo zayo rwanda
content: itangazo kompanyi yashyize ahagaragara rivuga ngendo zigamije gushyigikira kwagura ubuhahirane afurika kuko zije ziyongera zindi ikorera hirya hino mugabane w’afurika ndetse gufasha abakiliya bayo kugera hirya hino hatakunda kugaragara ingendo z’indege hari hashize imyaka itanu south african airways ihagaritse ingendo zayo rwanda byari biteganyijwe ngendo zisubukurwa kwezi cumi umwaka ushize ariko ntibyakunda kubera umubano utari umeze neza hagati y’u rwanda n’afurika y’epfo iki gikorwa kuzisubukura cyirerekana intambwe ikomeje guterwa gutsura umubano hagati y’ibihugu byombi ingendo south african airways rwanda zizajya ziba gatatu cyumweru kuwa kabibi kuwa gatanu cyumweru indege zajya iva johannesburg h igere rwanda h hanyuma ive rwanda h yerekeze i burundi ikazajya ihagera h ingendo zijya johanesbourg ruzajya ziba kuwa mbere kuwa gatatu kuwa gatandatu izajya ihagurukira i burundi inyure i kigali ibone kwerekeza johanesbourg urugendo johannesburg- kigali-bujumbura rukazajya rukorwa n’indege saa’s a ifite ubushobozi gutwara abantu marie josee ikibasumba

title: ishavu ry’abanyarwanda ritubere umusingi kwiyubaka umuyobozi w’umurenge bwishyura
content: umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’umurenge bwishyura niyonsaba cyriaque wifatanyije n’abaturage b’imidugudu nyarurembo karutete yagize ishavu ry’abanyarwanda ritubere umusingi kwiyubaka aha niyonsaba yungaga nsanganyamatsiko yahariwe mwaka igira iti twigire mateka turusheho kubaka ejo hazaza niyonsaba yaboneyeho akanya kunenga politike yazanywe n’abazungu gushyamiranya abantu yatunze agatoki ababiligi baje rwanda bagasanga abanyarwanda babanye neza bagasiga barukongeje n’ikintu kigaragara barusigiye umuyobozi w’umurenge bwishyura yagize urugero nk’aha kibuye basize bubatse gereza yonyine nk’aho abanyakibuye bakeneye hatanzwe ubuhamya bw’umwe bacitse icumu kibuye mukangoga emelita ufite imyaka gusa igihe jenoside yabaga yari afite ikiniga kinshi ariko yabashije kuvuga make byamugendekeye yabisobanuye magambo ikintu ntazigera nibagirwa igihe papa yampamagaye arangije guteka inkono y’ibijumba nituze aduhe ifunguro nyuma namubajije impamvu atubwiye atyo ambwira bagiye kutwica kuva bahise badutera turatatanangenda nomongana ntazi ngana hashize akanya gato mbona iwacu barahatwitse narinihishe mbona interahamwe zizanye papa kumwe murumuna papa afite bibiliya barayimwaka barayica amanika amaboko hejuru agira mana bantu ubababarire ntibazi barimo gukora ako kanya bahita bamutema amaboko murumuna babatsinda ahonanjye bashatse kunyica inshuro nyinshi buryo nageze mera nk’ikinya nkajya mbabwira nabi nti nimukore mushakaibyambayeho birebire mbivuze bwakwira bugacyagusa ndashimira imana nkiriho nk’uko mukangoga yakomeje abitangamo ubuhamya mukangoga emelita yasigaye wenyine muryango w’abana nyina bamwishe atwite inda cyenda se n’abavandimwe barabamaze ubu umubyeyi w’abana babili umuhungu w’imyaka n’imfura y’umukobwa w’imyaka ubura umwaka umwe angane mama igihe jenoside yabaga nyuma y’ubuhamya mukangoga hatanzwe n’ikiganiro ruhare leta yagize jenoside umwe bacitse icumu watanze ikiganiro yasobanuye ukuntu abatutsi kibuye kimwe n’ahandi hose rwanda bagiye bahezwa gahunda leta y’icyo gihe umuntu akabaho atazi bucya kugeza igihe jenoside ibereye n’uwo bitaga inshuti n’umuturanyi arabahinduka umuhango wabimburiwe n’urugendo rwahereye rwibutso jenoside ruri iruhande rw’ahahoze sitade gatwaro mujyi kibuye kugera mudugudu nyarurembo ahabereye ibiganiro gukurikira ijambo ry’umukuru w’igihugu yahariye munsi radiyo televiziyo abari babashije gukusanya amafaranga ibihumbi gutera inkunga abacitse icumu mu rwego rw’akarere gutangiza icyunamo byabereye murenge mubuga umuyobozi w’akarere karongi kayumba bernard n’abandi bayobozi bagiye kwifatanya n’abandi kwibuka nshuro jenoside yakorewe abatutsi gasana marcellin

title: muhungu menya amagambo ukobwa ashobora kubwira ugakeka ukurinyamara atariko
content: ikintu gitangaje bakobwa kimwe bashobora kuvuga ikintu nyamara ataricyo bagamije ndetse bamwe batabizi bashobora kubifata umukobwa abivuze nyamara muhanga akamenya urwo rurimi rusobanura igihe kinini imvamutima z’abakobwa zikunze gutuma avuga ibintu nyamara atari yashakaga gusobanura ese byaba byarakubayeho wabyitwayemo ute ntago bitangaje rwose kuko bitewe n’aho umutima uba ndetse n’ibyiyumviro bye ntibyagutangaza umubajije uti urankunda agasubiza oya ushobora gutekereza ibisubizo umukobwa aguhaye aribyo oya dore bimwe bintu umukobwa ashobora kukubwira ukamenyako ataribyo yasobanuraga bitewe n’igihe arimo ndakwanga haba hari umukobwa waba warigeze kukubwira gutyo kukubwira ndakwanga bifite byinshi bisobanura mu byukuri ntago ashaka kukubwira akwanga ahubwo ashobora kuba ashaka kukubwira acyeneye uhindura uburyo wamufataga mbese ukamufata neza cyane kurushaho akubwiye aragukunda hari abashaka kukubwira utakwitayeho neza cyane ubwo jya witondera amagambo akubwira ntago ngukeneye iri jambo ryo abakobwa bakunze kurivuga bitewe n’igihe barimo amagambo bavuga gihe gito ntagutekereza mbese imitima idahari akenshi azabikubwira igihe murimo gukora utuntu dutandukanye wenda muganira mwenyine ahantu hiherereye mbese igihe mwageze isi y’urukundo ntacyo bimbwiye iri jambo ryo ntukarifate arivuze uveho wanamurakarira buri kintu cyose kigira kivuze mukobwa bitandukanye n’abahungu badakunze kwita bintu cyane hari uzakora ikintu akubwire ntacyo bimutwaye nyamara nyuma y’icyumweru ubone cyamugizeho ingaruka ubwo jya umenya witwara gihe ndakwizera ohhh ndakwizera nubwo yaba koko akwizera ntago byamubuza kukugenzura amenye waba ufite indi nshutu y’umukobwa ubwo ntukabifate nk’uko abikubwiye ntago ndakaye iki kimwe bintu buri mukobwa wese azi kuvuga ashobora kukubwira atarakaye nyamara yenda guturika ushobora kuba ubibona kandi ariko wamubaza oya ntago ndakaye gerageza kumushimisha kugeza ubibonye n’ubwo yabikubwiye reka tube inshuti bisanzwe iyi mvugo ikunze gukoroga umubare utari muke w’abahungu ndetse ikanababaza cyane ari mubyukuri binababaza umutima pe ubwo ashobora kubikubwira ashaka kukwerereka hari utarimo gukora neza cyangwa se yagize amasoni guhita akwemerera ntibindeba iki iki ayo magambo yituma wibazo byinshi kuko abivuze siko biba bimeze ahubwo biba bimureba cyane ndetse abyitayeho gusa akakubwira gutyo dukeneye kuvugana ho gato ikintu mu binzwi umuntu akubwiye afite kukubwira agifite koko kandi akakubwira ikintu gifatika ariko kumukobwa si bimeze ahubwo ashaka kukubwira hari ibitagenda neza mubano wanyu ubwo ujye ugenda uzi agiye kukubwira ntago unkunda ashobora kukubazo kibazo ugakeka akeneye kukubaza umukunda koko nyamara abashaka kukubwira agukundankunda uriya mukobwa mwarimo kuganira niba umugabo uzi ubwenge menya impamvu akubwiye magambo ube witegura gusobanura warimo uganira n’uwo mukobwa mwari kumwe kandi utamubeshye ibuka abakobwa bakunda gufuha cyane ndetse bakanabigaragaza icyitonderwa ibyo byose twavuze jya ubyemera bitewe n’aho abikubwiriye ndetse n’uko umubona maso biriya rwose bibaho cyane kuko murabizi abakobwa bagira amasoni ashobora kwanga ariko kwemera kwe yandanditswe ukurikiyimfura leoncemuhaburarw

title: akarere rubavu karishimira ibikorwa by’amajyambere kagezeho
content: mu bikorwa byamuritswe harimo umuhanda uhuza imipaka yombi y’u rwanda repubulika iharanira demokarasi kongo grande et petite barierre ukazatwara akayabo k’amafaranga akabakaba miliyoni ndetse n’ umuhanda pave ujya biro by’akarere watangiye gukorwa munsi umuyobozi w’akarere sheh bahame hassan yavuze akarere kabwiye rwiyemezamirimo imodoka zikora mihanda zitazasubirayo utugari birebera ibikorwa ndengera foundation uyu muryango wubatse amasoko y’amazi agemurira abaturage amazi meza ndetse n’ibitaro kijyambere umuyobozi w’akarere yasabye umuyobozi ndengera foundation title: ikipe y’u rwanda yasezerewe beach volleyball
content: muri mikino ikinwa n’abakinnyi babiri babiri buri gihugu gihagararirwa n’amakipe abiri buri kipe ikina imikino ibiri ibiri u rwanda rwari ruhagarariwe emilienne uwineza hakizimana judith bagize ikipe mbere hamwe mutatsimpundu denise nzayisenga charlotte mu mikino ine yahuje amakipe y’u rwanda n’aya afurika y’epfo u rwanda rwasabwaga gutsinda nibura imikino itatu ine kugira rwizere gukomeza cyiciro gikurikiyeho ariko ntibyakunze kuko afurika y’epfo kugeza mwanya kabiri afurika yatsinze imikino itatu ine bakinnye n’u rwanda emilienne uwineza umukinnyi w’ikipe mbere y’u rwanda yavuze gutsindwa byatewe n’uko afurika y’epfo ibarusha inararibonye yagize afurika y’epfo yaturushije kubera bamenyereye cyane amarushanwa buryo usanga bazi amayeri menshi gusa n’ubwo badutsinze natwe twageragaje kugaragaza ubuhanga bwacu kandi nk’uko byagaragaraga badutsindaga ariko dufite amanota menshi ibyo buvuze hari urwego rwiza natwe tugezeho gutsindwa afurika y’epfo bivuze u rwanda ruvuye ruhando guhatanira itike kuzakina imikino olympique ndetse n’igikombe cy’isi ariko christian hatuminana ushinzwe tekinike ishyirahamwe ry’umukino volleyball rwanda yadutangarije u rwanda rugifite tariki hakinwa imikino cy’irangiza afurika y’epfo ikina n’ibirwa maurice byasezereye rdc mozambique yasezereye algeria irakina kenya gihe u rwanda ruzahatanira umwanya gatanu rukina algeria iyi mikino izasozwa gatandatu ikipe izaba yabaye iya mbere izahita ibona itike kuzakina imikino olympique izabera bwongereza nyakanga mwaka iya kabiri n’iya gatatu zikabona itike kuzakina igikombe cy’isi title: kwitwara neza buroko gufasha urukiko bimwe bitumye bagaragaza agiye kurekurwa
content: iki cyemezo cyafashwe tariki ukwakira n’umucamanza khalida rachid khan uyobora urukiko mpuzamahanga mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho u rwanda tpir gusaba irekurwa bagaragaza michel wakatiwe igihano gufungwa imyaka mwaka ushize amakuru kigalitodaycom gikesha itangazo ry’uryo rukiko aravuga mpamvu zatanzwe kumurekura harimo kuba urukiko mpuzamahanga mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho yougoslavia tpiy rufite imikorere ijya gusa n’iya tpir ruteganya imfungwa zakatiwe zishobora kurekurwa nyuma kumara bitatu kane by’igifungo barakatiwe kandi bagaragaza amaze imyaka afunze ukuvuga by’imyaka umunani yakatiwe izindi mpamvu michel bagaragaza ubwe yiyemeje kwishyikiriza urukiko akanemera yashinjwaga ndetse akerekana azi uburemere bwabyo akanabyicuza kuba yararanzwe n’imyitwarire myiza afungiye sude mugabane w’u burayi nyakanga umunyarwanda michel bagaragaza yahoze umuyobozi mukuru w’ikigo ocir- ishami ry’icyayi akaba yarafatwaga nk’umwe nkoramutima juvnal habyarimana perezida w’u rwanda yamaze igihe ashakishwa tpir byaha kunoza umugambi jenoside yakorewe abatutsi kugira uruhare jenoside n’ubufatanyacyaha jenoside tariki kanama bagaragaza yishyikirije tpir bwende bwe yitaba urukiko munsi ukurikiyeho ariko ahakana byaha byose yashinjwaga nyuma y’aho bidashobokeye yoherezwa kuburanishirizwa rwanda nyuma kugirana imishyikirano yihariye n’ubushinjacyaha bagaragaza yemeye kuba yaragize uruhare ruziguye jenoside kuko yaremeye intwaro zari zigenewe gukora jenoside zibikwa ruganda rw’icyayi rubaya ndetse akaba yaranaguriraga interahamwe inzoga akanaziha amafaranga yemereye urukiko kandi yahaga interahamwe imodoka z’uruganda bazikoreshe ngendo zabo ariko yongeraho yabikoraga akiza amagara n’umuryango uko gufasha interahamwe bikaba aribyo byatumaga ubushinjacyaha buvuga yazorohereje akazi bigatuma zibasha kwica abantu bahungiye musozi kesho kiliziya nyundo utwo duce twose turi karere rubavu kubera kwemera yaregwaga kubisabira imbabazi imbere y’urukiko tariki ugushyingo bagaragaza yakatiwe igifungo cy’imyaka umunani kandi urukiko rutegeka hakurwamo igihe yafunzwe michel bagaragaza azafungurwa itariki ukuboza bivuze ashigaje ukwezi kumwe n’iminsi itandatu buroko ernestine musanabera

title: umupadiri yahagariswe murimo w’ubusaserdoti kubera kwiyandarika

title: agatabo gafasha umuturage gusobanukirwa n’ingengo y’imari kashyizwe ahagaragara
content: christophe nsengiyaremye umukozi minisiteri y’imari n’igenamigambi avuga aka gatabo kateguwe kugirango kabe igikoresho gifasha abaturage gusobanukirwa n’uburyo ingengo y’imari y’igihugu itegurwa inakoreshwa kandi ikanagenzurwa nsengiyaremye asobanura aka gatabo kagamije gutanga amakuru yumvikana kandi anyuze mucyo yerekana ingengo y’imari igenewe ubuyobozi bukuru leta n’inzego z’ibanze zegerejwe abaturage umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’ impuzamiryango iharanira uburenganzira muntu cladho safari emmanuel avuga abaturage bafite uburenganzira kumenya amafaranga y’ingengo y’imari ava ibikorwa amafaranga azakoreshwa n’imicungire yayo ubushakashatsi bwakoze bwagaragaje bamwe baturage batarasobanukirwa n’imikorere y’ingengo y’imari usanga bamwe bavugako uretse kumva minisitiri w’imari n’igenamigambi abivuga radio ahandi babizi ingengo y’imari y’igihugu y’umwaka yiyongereyeho uyigereranyije n’uyu mwaka ikaba igeze giteranyo rusange miliyari by’amafaranga y’u rwanda kugeza hamaze gusohorwa udutabo tugera bihumbi tuzajya duhabwa abaturage midugudu nyuma y’igikorwa cy’umuganda eric muvara

title: igishushanyo mbonera gishya cy’ubutaka ubuso bw’imijyi buzongerwa intara ebyiri ziharirwe ubuhinzi
content: mu u rwanda rwiyemeje kuba bihugu biteye imbere isi umunyarwanda azaba yinjiza amadolari mwaka ni inzira igoye ariko ishoboka kandi uburyo bwose bwakoreshwa imikoreshereze y’ubutaka igomba kubigiramo uruhare ubutaka umwe mitungo igihugu gifite itarakunze kuvugwaho rumwe buryo ikoreshwa cyane cyane bijyanye n’ubwubatsi ndetse n’ubuhinzi igishushanyo mbonera cy’ubutaka cyemejwe cyagombaga kubahirizwa kikageza u rwanda ariko nticyubahirijwe bikwiriye kuva ugushyingo ministeri y’ibidukikije ibinyujije kigo gishinzwe imicungire n’imikoreshereze y’ubutaka rwanda rlmua batangije mugaragaro kuvugurura igishushanyo mbonera cy’imikoreshereze y’ubutaka rwego rw’igihugu gisimbura rlmua itangaza gishushanyo mbonera kirimo gutegurwa kigeze rwego nyuma kwemezwa ikigo gishinzwe imicungire n’imikoreshereze y’ubutaka rwanda cyatangaje igishushanyo mbonera gishya kizagaragaramo impinduka zijyanye n’icyerecyezo gishya kimwe n’ibisubizo mpungenge z’inzego zitandukanye haba miturire ubuhinzi n’ibindi ubuso bw’imijyi buzongerwa mu bijyanye n’imiturire igishushanyo mbonera gishya kizagaragaza ibyiciro by’imijyi bigera bitanu hashingiwe mubare w’abaturage servise zizaba zikenewe guteza imbere imibereho y’abatuye imijyi bazaba bageze kigero y’abanyarwanda bavuye bayituye hateganyijwe umujyi kigali uzakomeza kuba umujyi mukuru kandi munini mu rwego kwirinda wakomeza kuba mujyi ukomeye gusa igishushanyo mbonera cyagaragaje indi mijyi ifite ubushobozi bwinshi gutera imbere aho harimo imijyi muhanga nyamata rwamagana hari kandi imijyi umunani yegereye imipaka izarushaho kuzamuka ariyo nyagatare musanze rubavu karongi rusizi huye kirehe kayonza hagaragaramo n’uburyo indi mijyi mito hirya hino gihugu izakomeza gutezwa imbere bivuye bucuruzi ahanini bushingiye buhinzi ikindi kintu gishya kiri gishushanyo mbonera ubuso imijyi iriho bungana by’ubuso bw’igihugu bugomba kongerwa bukagera ibyo bizajyana kandi n’uko by’abaturage bazaba basigaye cyaro bazatura site nke zikava site z’imidugudu zigasigara zitarenga ibihumbi bine buri mujyi uzaba ufite ubwoko bw’inzu zigomba kubakwamo hashingiwe bawutuye n’ubucucike umuyobozi ushinzwe ishami ry’imikoreshereze y’ubutaka kigo cy’ubutaka alexis rutagengwa yabwiye igihe bizafasha buri wese kumenya urwego rw’umujyi n’ibisabwa mibereho y’uwo mujyi bikamufasha guhitamo umujyi yabamo cyangwa yahuza n’ubushobozi bwe ati igishushanyo kiraduha igihugu giteye imbere kigomba kuba ifite imijyi imeze ite kigomba kuba gifite ubuhinzi bumeze gute inganda byose cyamara kubireba kikanatanga ubutaka ese butaka buri he turabufite se niba tutabufite turabigenza gute ubuhari bukoreshwe neza mu mujyi kigali niho hazibanda inzu ndende zituwemo n’abantu buryo rusange kimwe yindi mijyi minini cyaro hazaba higanje inzu zifatanye zishobora guturamo abantu benshi mu gihe cyaro wasangaga urugo rumwe ruri ukwarwo gishushanyo mbonera si bizaba bimeze abantu bazaba batuye hamwe ahasigaye hahingwe hashingiwe bihingwa byagenewe ako gace igishushanyo mbonera kandi cyagennye ubutaka n’inzira zizakoreshwa gutwara abantu n’ibintu harimo imihanda inzira gari moshi imihanda yihuta n’ibindi intara ebyiri zagenewe ubuhinzi by’umwihariko abanyarwanda basaga bakora ubuhinzi nyamara uruhare rwabwo musaruro mbumbe guverinoma ishaka umubare w’abakora mwuga ugabanyuka ariko umusaruro ukiyongera kugira uzabashe guhaza miliyoni zizaba zituye igihugu kugeza ubutaka buhingwa rwanda bungana by’ubuso bw’igihugu kugira bigerweho igishushanyo mbonera cyateganyije ubutaka bwinshi guhinga bwibanda cyane ntara y’iburasirazuba majyepfo ashyira iburasirazuba impamvu ariho haba ubutaka bwera kandi byoroshye kugeza uburyo kuhira buryo hahingwa bihe byose rutagengwa yagize ubutaka bwacu nabwo usanga utuntu tudatatanye usanga byibura buri muturage afite ubutaka butageze gice hegitali ntabwo twakomeza gutyo tuzagere cyerekezo biradusaba kongera ikoranabuhanga kuvanaho ibyabangamiraga ubuhinzi ka karima gato gahuzwe n’utundi mu rwego rw’ibidukijkije n’umutungo kamere ubutaka buteyeho amashyamba bugize by’ubuso bw’igihugu biteganyijwe buzakomeza kubungabungwa igishushanyo mbonera cy’igenamigambi ry’imikoreshereze y’ubutaka title: ibibanza by’abashoramari bitubatse biri mujyi kigali amaherezo yabyo ayahe
content: mu gihe umujyi kigali uvuga bitarenze gashyantare mwaka ikibanza kizaba kitubatse leta izakisubiza bamwe bashoramari bafite bibanza barasaba bakoroherezwa kubona inguzanyo y’igihe kire kire kugira babashe kubyubaka mu mujyi kigali rwagati ahazwi nko quartier commercial ibikorwa kuvugurura inzu zashaje birarimbanyije iz’imiturirwa zirimo kuzura hirya hino murwa w’u rwanda abakurikiranira mpinduka myubakire bavuga kigali myaka imbere uzaba umujyi ujyanye n’icyerekezo u rwanda rwihaye gusa n’ubwo bimeze bityo ariko duce dutandukanye tw’umujyi kigali haracyagaragara ibibanza bimaze igihe kire kire bitubatse bizitijwe amabati byaramezemo ibyatsi bamwe baturage bavuga bibanza bikwiye kubakwa kuko bituma umujyi usa nabi bitaba hagashakwa indi mishinga yakorerwamo uwimpuhwe innocent habayeho ikosa ryo gufunga ahantu bataramenya hakorerwa ukuntu igihugu cyacu gikeneye isuku ahantu kamara imyaka icumi hadakorerwa akajagari kandi ikosa babikoze iyakaremye jmv nkurikije ukuntu abantu bangeraho babuze baparika imidoka zabonk’ubu bakuyemo myanda abantu bakahaparika akarere kaba kinjiza amafaranga ibyinshi bibanza iby’abashoramari bishyize hamwe bakabigura kugira babikoreremo imishinga minini y’ubucuruzi ubuyobozi bw’umujyi kigali buvuga icyadindije iyubakwa ry’ibi bibanza ubwumvikane buke nyirabyo bugashimangira igihe kigiye kugera leta ibyisubize umuyobozi wungirije mujyi kigali ushinzwe imiturire n’ibikorwa remezo izo projects zirimo abantu benshi zagiye zikunda kugira ibibazo usanga abantu batandatu ugasanga abantu babiri batangiye kuzana ibibazo niba ufite ikibanza ahantu hari amazi hari amashanyarazi hari igihe ntarengwa wagombye kuba wubatse kibanza mu gihe gishize umujyi watanze iminsi y’uko bibazo byose byagombye kuba byarangiye twahereye kugeza minsi irangiye hakurikizwa itegeko confiscation kugira ntibibangamire iterambere ry’umujyi umushoramari mironko francois umwe bafite imigabane mushinga amarembo ufite ikibanza mujyi rwagati avuga ikibazo kitabaye ubushobozi ahubwo byatewe n’ubwumvikane buke bafatanyije mushinga ni gihe umuvugizi kompanyi catch up rudasingwa james avuga ubushake n’ubushobozi buhari ariko akagira asaba asaba leta n’umujyi kigali by’umwihariko mironko burya kubwira abantu bafatanye harimo abazungu harimo abanyarwanda harimo abahinde umuntu agomba gufatanya n’abantu bisanganamo nonese umuntu mutigeze muganira umuntu mutaziranye kandi bucuruzi murabizi habamo ibibazo kuko twagiye dukora inyigo zitandukanye ariko ntizemewa ubundi koko amategeko leta ntawe utayakurikiza ariko ruhande rwanjye tegeko rindeba kuko ntacyo ntakurikije ntegereje uburenganzira nkubaka na ho rudasingwa ubushobozi twebwe turabufite ariko wenda ibyaza nyuma kubaka nibyo kibazo abacuruzi benshi ntibarumva bacururiza etage gatatu iya kane n’iya gatanu bashaka gucuruza bareba muhanda inyubako nyinshi zifite bibazo kandi wemeranyije banki biba icyo twasaba umujyi kigali udufashe kugendana n’amikoro buryo kutuba kutugira inama banki inguzanyo baduha iz’igihe kigufi twasaba leta yatuvuganira amabanki akajya aduha inguzanyo z’igihe kirekire mu mujyi kigali habarirwa ibibanza birimo birimo kubakwa imishinga kubyubaka yadindiye bishobora gusubizwa leta itegeko ry’ubutaka ngingo igika gatatu rivuga ubutaka buri mbago z’umujyi igishushanyo cy’ikatwa ry’ibibanza cyemejwe n’inzego bireba ariko bukaba bumaze imyaka itatu ikurikiranye budakoreshwa bwamburwa nyirabwo muhaburarw

title: ishavu ry’abanyarwanda ritubere umusingi kwiyubaka umuyobozi w’umurenge bwishyura
content: umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’umurenge bwishyura niyonsaba cyriaque wifatanyije n’abaturage b’imidugudu nyarurembo karutete yagize ishavu ry’abanyarwanda ritubere umusingi kwiyubaka aha niyonsaba yungaga nsanganyamatsiko yahariwe mwaka igira iti twigire mateka turusheho kubaka ejo hazaza niyonsaba yaboneyeho akanya kunenga politike yazanywe n’abazungu gushyamiranya abantu yatunze agatoki ababiligi baje rwanda bagasanga abanyarwanda babanye neza bagasiga barukongeje n’ikintu kigaragara barusigiye umuyobozi w’umurenge bwishyura yagize urugero nk’aha kibuye basize bubatse gereza yonyine nk’aho abanyakibuye bakeneye hatanzwe ubuhamya bw’umwe bacitse icumu kibuye mukangoga emelita ufite imyaka gusa igihe jenoside yabaga yari afite ikiniga kinshi ariko yabashije kuvuga make byamugendekeye yabisobanuye magambo ikintu ntazigera nibagirwa igihe papa yampamagaye arangije guteka inkono y’ibijumba nituze aduhe ifunguro nyuma namubajije impamvu atubwiye atyo ambwira bagiye kutwica kuva bahise badutera turatatanangenda nomongana ntazi ngana hashize akanya gato mbona iwacu barahatwitse narinihishe mbona interahamwe zizanye papa kumwe murumuna papa afite bibiliya barayimwaka barayica amanika amaboko hejuru agira mana bantu ubababarire ntibazi barimo gukora ako kanya bahita bamutema amaboko murumuna babatsinda ahonanjye bashatse kunyica inshuro nyinshi buryo nageze mera nk’ikinya nkajya mbabwira nabi nti nimukore mushakaibyambayeho birebire mbivuze bwakwira bugacyagusa ndashimira imana nkiriho nk’uko mukangoga yakomeje abitangamo ubuhamya mukangoga emelita yasigaye wenyine muryango w’abana nyina bamwishe atwite inda cyenda se n’abavandimwe barabamaze ubu umubyeyi w’abana babili umuhungu w’imyaka n’imfura y’umukobwa w’imyaka ubura umwaka umwe angane mama igihe jenoside yabaga nyuma y’ubuhamya mukangoga hatanzwe n’ikiganiro ruhare leta yagize jenoside umwe bacitse icumu watanze ikiganiro yasobanuye ukuntu abatutsi kibuye kimwe n’ahandi hose rwanda bagiye bahezwa gahunda leta y’icyo gihe umuntu akabaho atazi bucya kugeza igihe jenoside ibereye n’uwo bitaga inshuti n’umuturanyi arabahinduka umuhango wabimburiwe n’urugendo rwahereye rwibutso jenoside ruri iruhande rw’ahahoze sitade gatwaro mujyi kibuye kugera mudugudu nyarurembo ahabereye ibiganiro gukurikira ijambo ry’umukuru w’igihugu yahariye munsi radiyo televiziyo abari babashije gukusanya amafaranga ibihumbi gutera inkunga abacitse icumu mu rwego rw’akarere gutangiza icyunamo byabereye murenge mubuga umuyobozi w’akarere karongi kayumba bernard n’abandi bayobozi bagiye kwifatanya n’abandi kwibuka nshuro jenoside yakorewe abatutsi gasana marcellin

title: i kigali hateguwe ibirori kwerekana imideli bubiligi
content: umuhanzi w’imideli ukomeye bubiligi an buermans yaje i kigali ntangiriro z’iki cyumweru agomba gukorera ibikorwa bitandukanye kwamamaza kumenyekanisha imideli ahanga nzu yitwa an buermans fashion house’ mu kiganiro igihe an buermans yavuze aje rwanda nshuro kabiri yahaherukaga aje kuherekanira imideli kigali fashion week ni umwe bagomba kwerekana imideli cyumweru cyahariwe imideli i kigali gusa yifuje kuhava akoze igikorwa cyagutse cyerekana ubuhanzi bwe akora nk’akazi gahoraho yagize ni inshuro kabiri nje hano by’ukuri navuga nahageze umwaka ushize ngahita nkunda uburyo abashyitsi bakirwa uhereye kibuga cy’indege kugeza ugeze hoteli wakiranwa urugwiro narabikunze cyane nshaka kubibyaza umusaruro an buermans afatanyije mugenzi bavanye bubiligi bateguye igikorwa kwerekana imideli cyitwa the show room’ kizaba kuwa gatandatu tariki kamena ati mu mwaka ushize nerekanye nkora ariko twahuriraga kigali fashion weeek bambazaga bagura ibintu byanjye nkabura igisubizo mbaha muri the show room bazabibona n’amaso hazaba hari n’amahirwe kubigura bakunda imideli buermans yavuze migambi yagutse afite yifuza kuzashinga iduka ry’imideli mujyi kigali ndetse yifuza kugirana ubufatanye burambye n’abari mwuga w’imideli rwanda ati ndabyifuza ndumva nazakorera hano ndifuza kubikora nibigenda neza avuga gikorwa yagitewemo inkunga ambasaderi w’u bubiligi rwanda ukunda gutera inkunga ibirori by’imideli iki gikorwa bise the show room’ kizabera mujyi kigali impact hub kiyovu guhera saa cyenda z’amanywa kugeza saa kumi n’ebyiri z’umugoroba imideli bakora an buermans

title: mu zisaga zipfuye mezi abiri ashize izazize ’rift valley fever’ ntizirenga
content: inka zisaga zapfiriye rimwe karere gatsibo umurenge rwembogo mpera kamena ifoto umworozi gatsibo kuva gicurasi mwaka havuzwe impfu z’inka cyane duce tw’iburasirazuba n’amajyepfo byazanye n’indwara y’ubuganga kibaya rift valley rift valley fever indwara yica inka idakira kuko iterwa virusi gusa ikigo gishinzwe guteza imbere ubuhinzi n’ubworozi rab kivuga umubare munini w’inka zapfuye utatewe n’iyi ndwara ahubwo indwara zikwirakwizwa n’uburondwe rab ivuga ubukana bw’indwara zikwirakwizwa n’uburondwe bwatewe ahanini n’imiti y’imyiganano yinjiye gihugu igacuruzwa nk’indi miti yemewe solange uwituze umuyobozi wungirije rab agira byumvikane neza rift valley fever rvf iterwa virusi ikwirakwizwa n’imibu hakaba n’indwara ziterwa n’udukoko dukwirakwizwa n’ibirondwe ariyo mpamvu ibirondwe birwanywa hifashishijwe imiti itandukanye ikoreshwa gufuherera irimo amitix itari inyiganano amitraz akomeza agira harakekwa miti y’imyiganano yagize uruhare mpfu z’inka zazize indwara zikwirakwizwa n’uburondwe kuko utabashaka kubwica kuva kwezi gicurasi n’ukwa kamena hapfuye inka zizize indwara zikwirakwizwa n’uburondwe zazize rvf rwanda hosesolange uwituze yitabiriye imurikagurisha ry’ubuhinzi n’ubworozi tariki nyakanga imiti y’amatungo itemewe yarahagurukiwe mu kiganiro n’itangazamakuru mbere tariki nyakanga peter karake umuyobozi mukuru wagateganyo kigi gishinzwe ubugenzacyaha rib ushinzwe gukurikirana ibyaha bisanzwe nibishingiye iterabwoba avuga bufatanye rab hakozwe igenzura hagafatwa imiti y’amatungo itemewe gucuruzwa rwanda n’indi yarengeje title: nyuma arsenal u rwanda rwatangiye gukorana paris saint germain gahunda visit rwanda
content: nyuma y’umwaka u rwanda rugiranye amasezerano y’imikoranire arsenal fc bwongereza ikaba igenda neza kandi inyungu zikaba zikomeje kuba nyinshi ruhande rw’u rwanda hakurikiyeho ikipe paris saint germain bufaransa gihe cy’amasezerano y’imyaka itatu y’imikoranire gahunda visit rwanda mu mukino uteganyijwe kuri gatatu ikipe paris saint-germain iza kuba ikina nantes shampiyona haraza kuba hatangazwa mugaragaro ubufatanye hagati y’ikipe paris saint germain ndetse n’u rwanda igikorwa biteganyijwe kibera i parc des princes kibuga kipe isanzwe ikiniraho umuyobozi w’ikigo cy’igihugu cy’iterambere rdb gihagarariye u rwanda masezerano kimwe n’aya arsenal claire akamanzi yatangarije ikinyamakuru le figaro bufaransa bahisemo gukorana paris saint germain rwego kugaragaza ubwiza bw’u rwanda yagize twahisemo paris saint-germain kuko ifite izina rikomeye kuruta kuba ikipe y’umupira w’amaguru ni ikipe imaze igihe gito nyamara makipe y’ibihangange i burayi kandi ndangagaciro zayo ifite nyinshi zihura n’iz’u rwanda ishyaka kwagura imikoranire n’isi gukorana n’urubyiruko guharanira kuba indashyikirwa mu bikubiye masezerano harimo kuba paris saint germain izajya yambara visit rwanda myenda yishyushyanya mbere y’umukino kuzana bamwe bakinnyi b’ibihangange paris saint germain rwanda ndetse gushinga ishuri ry’umupira w’amaguru rwanda byanatanga umusaruro ufatika banyarwanda bakaba babona n’amahirwe kujya gukina bufaransa by’umwihariko paris saint germain benshi visit rwanda imaze kugira uruhare rugaragara gukurura mukerarugenda baturutse bice bitandukanye by’isi barimo n’ibihangange bimaze gusura u rwanda twavugamo umukinnyi tennis ukomeye isi maria sharapova david luiz ukinira arsenal didier drogba luis van gal watoje manchester united hakaba hanitezwe ibindi title: ibintu gandhi yemeraga byahindura isi
content: mahatma gandhi ubarwa ntwali zabayeho isi yakunze kugira nta muntu ukwiriye gutakaza icyizere cy’ ubumuntu kuko ubuzima bugereranywa n’ inyanja amazi amwe ashobora kuba yanduye ariko bitavuga yanduye’’ yakomeje kandi yerekana itandukaniro hagati y’ turi n’icyo dushoboye gukora bihagije kugira duhindure isi zimwe ndangagaciro mahatma gandhi yagenderagaho gushishikariza abantu kubanza guhinduka ubwabo gandhi yashishikarizaga abantu bagomba kubanza kubera abandi urugero sosiyete kugira nayo ibe nk’ bayifuza kuri ngingo gandhi agira mu gihe cyose sosiyete yawe izagutanga guhinduka birumvikana wowe uzasigara wundi ndetse uhore bibazo byawe uyu muhanga yashimangiye muntu wakagombye kumukomeretsa atabimuhereye uburenganzira busesuye ati n’ubwo bimeze bityo umuntu aguhemukiye mbere kumusubiza ugomba kwitonda kugira udahubuka ugasa kubarira kwibagirwa ibibi byagukorewe gandhi yitwazaga umugani ugira uti nta munyantege nkeya ubabarira kubabarira ikimenyetso cy’imbaraga mu buzima bwe gandhi yarimye umwanya amagambo kuko azi neza byoroshe kuvuga kuruta gukora aho yagiraga igitabo gishobora kuguha ubumenyi utashyize bikorwa wasomye bigomba kukubera impfabusa umuntu wese ushaka kugira icyerekezo ntakwiriye kwibanda ejo hazaza ahubwo agomba gukora munsithe future depends on what do in the present kuri ngingo gandhi asaba umuntu wese guca bugufi kumenya azapfa kumenya gusaba ibyo ntibikuraho umuntu nyawe agomba kutabura izima persistence cyane cyane bantu bakurwanya iyi niyo mpamvu gandhi bagenzi babashije kugera ntego politiki kandi batamenbye amarasomethod of non-violence ni byiza cyane kureba ibyiza by’abandi ahubwo ukareba ibibi byawe ukanigaya iyo ubigenjeje utyo bituma uha abantu amahirwe ndetse nabo bakakwizera kugeza igihe ushobora kubabera umuyobozi umunezero igihe uvuga utekereza ndetse nibyo ukora bijyana ndetse binahura neza kuri gandhi asanga amagambo yuzuzanyije n’ ibitekerezo bigaragaza ukuri ati iyo ibikorwa byawe bitajyanye n’ uvuga nabwo bishobora kugufasha gutangira kwigaya bityo ukikosora maguru mashya gukomeza gukura gutera imbere gukomeza gutera imbere itegeko rihoraho ry’ ubuzima ndetse n’ umuntu uhora ashaka kuguma agaragara nk’ umunebwe cyangwa umupfapfa gaston rwakabwizacom

title: kutubahiriza amabwiriza kurwanya covid nko kwenyegeza umuriro kuzima-impuguke
content: hari abaturage bakigaragara mihanda barenze amwe mabwiriza yashyizweho gukumira ikwirakwizwa covid ibi impuguke guhangana n’ibyorezo zibisanisha kwenyegeza umuriro warazimye abagabo batanu bikorwa by’ubwubatsi karere nyarugenge birimo guponda sima bakayikorera bakayigeza bubaka muri umwe rukumbi wambaye agapfukamunwa abatatwambaye ntibabura impamvu batanga umwe yagize ’’ndagafite ni tuba turi kazi umunyamakuru none se kazi ntabwo bakambara umukozi eeeh barakambara ahubwo nagashyize mufuka ndibeshya ariko gahunda kukambara twarayimenye’ uretse abari mirimo inyuranye hari n’abagenda muhanda batambaye udupfukamunwa hamwe n’abatubahiriza izindi ngamba zashyizweho gukumira koronavirusi umwe bafashwe batakambaye yagize ’’ngeze hariya telefoni yanjye barampamagara yikubita hasi nkakuramo nkashyira ngaha nagendaga mpanagura gutya polisi ihita impamagara’’ undi ’’ngira ikibazo cy’uko nkambaye numva ntahumeka neza nk’umuntu wanshyize urushyi munwa n’iminwa ikababuka kubera umwuka ushyushye nkumva iminwa yababutse nk’umuntu urwaye malaria’’ abantu batubahiriza amabwiriza yashyizweho polisi y’u rwanda irabafata ikabakusanya ikabashyira bice bitandukanye birimo stade bagahabwa ubutumwa bubibutsa kubahiriza mabwiriza agamije guhashya covid - title: ivugururwa ry’umujyi huye rigeze kure
content: muri minsi aharimo kuvugururwa agace k’ubucuruzi kazwi izina ryo mucyarabu akabarizwamo amahoteli ibisi faucon ndetse n’amabanki ecobank kbc ahandi harimo kuvugururwa ahahoze sitade huye harimo gusizwa neza hazubakwe indi nziza iyi gahunda kuvugurura igamije gusenya inyubako zishaje kandi zubatswe buryo butakigezweho zigasimbuzwa izijyanye n’igihe turimokuvugurura inyubako z’uyu mujyi tangiranye n’umwaka bikaba kandi bigikomeza ubu hoteli ibis hamwe banki ecobank bikaba byaramaze gusenywa kugirango hubakwe amazu agezweho pascal sahundwa umunyamabanga mpuzabikorwa w’umurenge ngoma karere huye avuga hari ibikorwa by’iterambere biri gukorwa kandi hari n’ibindi byinshi biteganyijwe avuga uretse amazu harimo kuvugururwa imihanda duce dutandukanye tw’uwo mujyi hamaze kuvugurwa ibirometero umunani by’imihanda gace kwitaba kandi nyuma yaho hazavugururwa imihanda ijya tundi duce ngoma matyazo hazakorwa kandi amatara mihanda ndetse haterwe ubusitani n’ibiti by’imirimbo rwego kongera ubwiza nyaburanga ndetse n’isuku y’uyu mujyi pascal asobanura ivugururwa ry’uyu mujyi inyungu buri muturage uwutuyemo ndetse n’igihugu rusange uyu mujyi murangiza kuvugururwa abaturage bazabona ibikorwa by’amajyambere birimo imihanda myiza n’amazu y’ubucuruzi yagutse ibi bizatuma haboneka abacuruzi baturutse bihugu bigize umurwango w’afrika y’iburasirazuba eac habeho ubuhahirane hagati y’uyu mujyi n’ibyo bihugu n’ubwo ubuyobozi bw’umujyi huye butegeka abafite amazu mujyi kuyavugurura bamwe banyiri mazu ntibabyumva kimwe n’ubuyobozi kuko bavugako basabwa kubaka amazu badafitiye ubushobozi umunyamabanga nshingwa bikorwa huye avuga ubuyobozi bw’uyu mujyi bugerageza kubavuganira banki kugirango babone inguzanyo buryo bworoshye hari kandi n’abavuga amwe mazu adakwiye gusenywa kuko afatwa nk’inzibutso z’uwo mujyi umuyobozi hotel ibis yagize kuvugurura ntibivuga gukuraho ibyagakwiye twibutsa ibihe byiza byashize twagiriye hoteli ibis pascal ariko avuga hakiri imbogamizi nyinshi iterambere ry’umujyi huye kuko abagafashije mujyi gutera imbere aribo bawusubiza inyuma aha aragaya abashoramari babona amafaranga nk’aho bayashoye iwabo huye bakajya i kigali n’ahandi bavugako i huye ntakigenda aranenga kandi igikorwa kwimurira amashami amwe n’amwe kaminuza nkuru i kigali abivuga magambo hari ikibazo cy’inyubako kaminuza niyubake kwimura mashami ahamya kaminuza mubiha agaciro mujyi huye clarisse umuhire

karere muhanga abivuga yongeraho bihuru bishobora kuba indiri y’imibu ishobora kurya abantu ikabanduza malariya niyo mpamvu asanga abaturage bakwiye kugira ingamba nshashya kwirinda indwara zabo bihe by’imvura iyo imvura igwa usanga imyanda izanwa n’imvura yakwiriye hamwe hamwe ni nayo mpamvu asanga isuku ikwiriye kurushaho kwitabwaho cyane gihe cy’imvura kuko usanga gihe haboneka indwara nyinshi abantu batirinze zimwe ndwara nk’uko abivuga harimo choleraumusongainzoka ndetse malaria kubera ndwara zangiza umubiri w’uzanduye buryo hari n’ubwo zamwica ziramutse zitavuwemukambungo esperance nk’umujyanama w’ubuzima aboneraho gukangurira abaturage kwita gutema ibihuru bishobora kwihishamo imibu itera maralia uyu mujyanama w’ubuzima akomeza avuga kwirinda ibinogo birekamo amazi nabyo ngombwa kuko indiri y’inzoka zinjirira birenge igihe umuntu ayakandagiramo iyo umuntu abyirinze hakiri kare ndiri z’inzoka ntizibasha kuboneka rugo rwe ikindi ugutema ibihuru bizengurutse ingo title: perezida kagame yavuze impamvu zatumye abiciwe jenoside batarakoze ibikorwa kwihorera babiciye
content: perezida paul kagame yavuze icyatumye hakumirwa ibikorwa kwihorera nyuma jenoside yakorewe abatutsi hataba ukwihanga nubwo bitari byoroshye ubwicanyi bwari kubaho ubuziraherezo umukuru w’igihugu yabivuze kane tariki ugushyingo kiganiro yagiranye n’abanyeshuri kaminuza cornegie mellon university africa imaze gutangizwa mugaragaro i kigali umunyeshuri wiga kaminuza witwa david butera yamusabaga kuha ubuhamya bwe igihe bageraga i kigali bagasanga imiryango yishwe nyamara agaharanira hatagira abihorera n’ababikoze bakabiryozwa birumvikana byari bikomeye bantu bageze murwa mukuru bagasanga interahamwe leta yariho gihebamaze kwica ababyeyi baboabavandimwe ndetse n’inshuti zabo kuri ibiperezida kagame yavuze u rwanda rwanyuzemo bitandukanye siyansi kuko yigisha umuntu ashobora gutsindwa ntagere ntego akongera akagerageza ariko rwanda ingaruka zari kuba nyinshi kurushaho aha umukuru w’igihugu yatanze urugero marangamutima y’abari bavuye rugamba bagasanga imiryango yishwe byongeye bagasanga uwabiciye ahari buryo ibikorwa kwihore byari hejuru cyane ndetse rimwe rimwe ukaba wanabumva yakomeje iyo twemera bibaho kugeza n’uyu munsi twari kuba tugifite ubwicanyi bukomeza kubera bihinduka uruhererekane rudashira buri wese akajya abona impamvu ituma agirira nabi ugasanga ntabwo bigira iherezo yunzemo atihari n’abihoreye ukuri kamere muntu iteye hari dusubiza amaso inyuma tukavuga tubarenganya ariko nari mfite ishingiro gihe nk’umuntu wapfushije abantu kimwe n’abandi ariko nanone nk’umuntu ufite inshingano mutwe kuvuga turabyitwaramo gute perezida kagame yavuze gihe yikoreye umutwaro kugenzura abasirikare barenga bihe kuko bitaba ingaruka zari kuba mbi kurushaho ati nagombaga gufata ibyemezo nk’abo basore bato bihoreye njye nkumva bifite ishingiro ariko nagombaga kuvuga oya ntabwo mugomba kubikora kandi nzirikana ninemera biba bikarangirira buri wese aratangira kubikora byangombaga kuyoberana yakomeje avuga cyari ikibazo kubera nk’umuntu wapfushije abantu jenoside yashoboraga kumva ishingiro ry’umuntu wihorera ariko akanazirikana kubirebera byagira ingaruka mbi kurushaho ati ufite umuryango wose wishwe ufite n’umuntu wabikoze none umusore warwaniraga igihugu cye aragarutse asanga umuryango ntugihari uwabikoze arahari kubera afite intwaro akamwica nagombaga guhagarara mo hagati nkavuga nti ntabwo ukwiye kubikora ukavuga kugira hatagira ubikora urajya gereza kugeza igihe tuzagirira ubutabera ariko gihe nabwo ntibwari buhari kubera inzego zabwo ntazari zihari yavuze yabwiraga abantu bazategereza inzego z’ubutabera zice imanza ariko title: amaherezo y’uduhanga bivugwa utw’abanyarwanda twajyanywe budage
content: umwaka ugiye gushira umuryango prussian cultural heritage foundation ucunga inzu ndangamurage z’i berlin utangaje ubitse uduhanga dusaga igihumbi tw’abanyarwanda twajyanywe u budage bwari bukolonije u rwanda mu duhanga muryango watangaje ubitse harimo kandi n’udusaga twaturutse tanzania u budage bwakolonije u rwanda mwaka kugeza bivugwa utwo duhanga twajyanwaga budage hakorwe ubushakashatsi bwoko bw’abantu inkuru yagaragaye mbere binyamakuru abayobozi batandukanye budage basaba utwo duhanga dusubizwa bihugu twaturutsemo mu kiganiro igihe dukesha nkuru ambasaderi w’u rwanda budage igor csar yatangaje hari byinshi bigikorwaho ubushakashatsi mbere kuba utwo duhanga twagarurwa rwanda kuko nubwo haremezwa koko utw’abanyarwanda umuryango prussian cultural heritage foundation wavuze kibazo kiri gusubiza utwo duhanga bihugu twaturutsemo ariko hazabanza kwerekanwa ibyangombwa koko bantu bahoze abaturage b’ibyo bihugu ambasaderi csar yatangaje baganiriye n’uwo muryango bakemeranya kubanza gukora ubushakashatsi kugira hemezwe koko bantu barakomokaga rwanda ati ikintu cy’ibanze kandi cyihutirwa twibanzeho ugushaka kumenya neza koko utwo duhanga utw’abanyarwanda n’uburyo twageze budage twaganiriye n’ubuyobozi bw’inzu ndangamurage y’aho utwo duhanga tubitse twemeranya hakwiye gukorwa ubushakashatsi bugamije kumenya amakuru y’impamo bijyanye n’inkomoko y’abo bantu prussian cultural heritage foundation yamenyesheje ambasade y’u rwanda budage myiteguro y’ibanze y’igikorwa cy’ubushakashatsi kizahuza inzobere budage n’izo rwanda hagamijwe kumenya inkomoko bene utwo duhanga utwo duhanga turi tubitse nzu ndangamurage ariko igihugu kigaragaje utwacyo gishobora kudukoresha ikindi nko kudushyingura ambasade y’u rwanda budage ivuga ibiganiro bitaragera rwego kumenya uduhanga tuzakoreshwa ariko nibirangira inzego leta bireba zizagena tuzakorerwa deutsche welle umwaka ushize yatangaje utwo duhanga utw’inyeshyamba zabaga zigometse bakoloni b’abadage hanyuma bakazica kuri ambasaderi csar yagize twe gihamya dufite bishwe twumva hari uduhanga tw’abantu bivugwa bafite inkomoko rwanda twizeye ubushakashatsi buzatugeza kw’amateka y’utwo duhanga u budage bumaze gutsindwa intambara mbere y’isi bihano bwahawe harimo kwamburwa ibihugu bwari bukolonije u rwanda rwahise ruhabwa ababiligi kugeza rubonye ubwigenge srcigihe

title: bpr plc yavuguruye inguzanyo mushahara gutunga inzu n’iyo kugura imodoka
content: ku bijyanye n’imodoka banki y’abaturage isanzwe itanga inguzanyo kuyigura itarengeje imyaka itandatu ikozwe yatangaje yaje gusanga abashoboye kugura modoka bake kubera inshya ihenda ibyo byatumye bahindura bashyiraho guha umuntu inguzanyo kugura imodoka imaze imyaka ikozwe igihe kwishyura kiva myaka ine gishyirwa myaka itanu banki y’abaturage itangaza bizorohereza abakiliya kuko imodoka nyinshi zinjira rwanda ziri cyiciro kandi zikaba ziri cyiciro ibigo by’ubwishingizi byishingira inguzanyo kugura cyangwa kubaka inzu yakuwe myaka ishyirwa myaka amezi umushahara ugomba kuba umaze unyura konti wikurikiranya kugira umuntu ayemererwe yakuwe mezi ashyirwa mezi atandatu ni gihe inguzanyo mushahara yashyizwe miliyoni frw zidafite ingwate avuye miliyoni frw igihe kwishyura cyongerewe kigera myaka itanu kivuye ine umuyobozi ushinzwe ubucuruzi bpr mugisha shema xavier yavuze bahinduye kugira bajyanishe n’impinduka zabayeho buzima bw’abaturage gukomeza kuba banki y’abaturage koko kandi yumva abakiliya ati hari impamvu nyinshi zatumye tuvugurura ziriya serivisi iya mbere ibihe byagiye bihinduka mugisha yatanze urugero nguzanyo mushahara avuga bakurikije ibibazo uyifata agiye gukemura n’uburyo ibiciro byahindutse isoko basanze batangaga mbere adahagije yagize kenshi ugiye kuyifata uba ugiye gukemura ibibazo byawe nko kugura ibikoresho nzu kugura imodoka se cyangwa kugura ikibanza ibintu nk’ibyo ariko wajya kureba ugasanga ibiciro bihagaze isoko ugasanga miliyoni frw twatangaga mbere ntabwo zihagije dusanga tugomba guhindura kugira dukomeze tube banki y’abaturage yumva ibyifuzo by’abakiliya bacu ku mwihariko korohereza abantu bijyanye n’inguzanyo ibafasha gutunga inzu mugisha yavuze bizatuma abafite imishahara iringanirye n’iciriritse b’abakiliya banki y’abaturage bamwe bazungukira gahunda leta gufasha abantu gutunga inzu zabo ni gihe banki y’abaturage y’u rwanda ifite gahunda gutera inkunga umushinga leta kubaka inzu ziciriritse kandi abagenerwabikorwa bawo bakazaba abantu bafite imishahara iringaniye cyangwa iciriritse

title: ubupfura n’ubworoherane indangagaciro z’amahoro

title: indwara kujojoba fistula n’ingaruka zayo buzima bw’uyirwaye
content: fistule cyangwa kujojoba indwara iterwa n’uko haba habayeho gukomereka gice ndangagitsina cy’umubyeyi gihe arimo kubyara ibyo bigaragara cyane babyeyi batabyarira muganga kandi bakeneye kubagwa bigatuma habaho inzira idasanzwe ihuza uruhago rw’inkari inzira y’inkari n’inkondo y’umura cyangwa inkondo y’umura n’urura runiri rusohora umusarani bigatuma umugore ahora asohora imyanda twakwita iba yayobye kuko inyura nkondo y’umura igasohokera gitsina rutangira mpamvu bayita kujojoba kugira ushobore kumenya bihagije iby’iyi ndwara twifashishije ibyatangajwe n’inzobere zitandukanye by’ubuzima mu kiganiro dr gedeon mulumba mukendi yagiranye n’agasarocom yavuze ikibazo cyiganje cyane bihugu biri nzira y’amajyambere muri bihugu usanga abagore benshi bagira ibibazo by’ihohoterwa kubyara bigoranye isuku nke abaganga batahuguwe bihagije n’ibindi ibi byose ibyangiza biriya bice by’umugore ubusanzwe bitajya byihanganira ikintu cyose giturutse hanze yagize umugore watinze nda ubyara umwana ufite umutwe munini cyangwa afite inkari zuzuye uruhago afite ibyago kwangirika kuko umwana atinda arwana gusohora umutwe aziba imitsi y’amaraso nzira z’inkari n’iyo nkondo y’umura cyangwa agatobora uruhago rw’inkari muganga gedeon avuga hari n’igihe urura runini narwo rutoboka cyangwa umwanya hagati y’inkondo y’umura n’ahanyura umusarane ugatanyuka bigatuma imyanda inyura nkondo y’umura iyi ndwara igira ingaruka nyinshi muntu uyirwaye kuko itinze kuvurwa itera ingaruka nyinshi nko guhagarara kw’imihango kugumbaha imibonano mpuzabitsina ntiba igishoboka kuko umubiri w’aho imyanda inyura hamera nk’ahumye buryo ikintu gikozeho ucika nk’urupapuro ishobora gutera cancer cg n’izindi infections zigira ingaruka mbi buzima bw’umuntu akenshi kubera umunuko uhora muntu urwaye ndwara babana baramunena agahezwa akiheza akenshi bene babyeyi bibaviramo gutabwa n’abo bashakanye bikagira n’ingaruka cyane buzima bwe mutwe dr gedeon akomeza atangariza agasarocom fistule akenshi ivurwa bitarenze igihe cy’amezi atatu uhereye igihe umugore yagiriye kibazo iyo kirenze biragorana kubera iriya myanya iba yarorohereye bigasaba ushaka indi kuyisimbuza kandi ntayibaho akomeza asobanura gihe ntacyo ushobora kumumarira uretse ubujyanama kugirango umuvure ihungabana yaratewe kwiheba ndetse kwiyanga kubera uburyo afatwa sosiyete abamo n’ubwo bimeze bityo ariko minisiteri y’ubuzima nayo ntiyicaye nk’uko dr anicet nzabonimpa umuhuzabikorwa gahunda kuboneza imbyaro minisante yabitangarije igihe u rwanda rwafashe ingamba guca burundu ndwara bakangurira abagore kubyarira muganga ministeri y’ubuzima kandi ifatanyije loni bafashe icyemezo kuvura ababyeyi bagaragayeho ndwara gihugu hose bwana cheikh fall ukuriye unfpa kiganiro yagiranye n’igihecom umuryango w’abibumbye ntuzahwema gushyigikira u rwanda nzira hoherezwa impuguke kuvura ndwara izahaza ababyeyi gusa ababyeyi nabo barasabwa kwitabira kwivuriza bigo nderabuzima nako bitabira kwipimisha igihe batwite anne-marie niwemwiza

title: icyo impuguke zivuga mahanga akomeje kwiyegereza afurika

havugimana yavuze umutungo kamere hirya hino isi kugenda ukendera usigaye afurika buryo usanga hari ibihugu bimwe bimwe repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo ifite amabuye y’agaciro centrafrique guine nzirabatinya yavuze bageze bikorera isuzuma basanga abashinwa barabirangije kare abanyaburayi barabibonye kare nk’ubu tuzi neza ntangiro igihugu cy’u bwongereza kizakorana inama afurika afurika umugeni kureshywa muri kinyejana ibihugu bikomeye isi biri gushakira isoko afurika nk’u burusiya nicyo gihugu mbere gitanga ingano nyinshi isi ariko nabwo hari budafite birimo n’ikawa n’ibindi title: indwara zandurira mibonano mpuzabitsina zitari sida zikomeje kwiyongera
content: oms ivuga abantu barenga miliyoni barwaye ndwara zandurira mibonano mpuzabitsina zitari sida muri abagera miliyoni bakaba abarwara inzoka tirikomunase trichomonase abagera miliyoni barwara indwara yitwa chamydiase miliyoni zikarwara uduheri tutandukanye dufata myanya y’igitsina imitezi buri mwaka rwego rw’isi yandurwa n’abantu bagera miliyoni ibibembe bifata gitsina bikibasira miliyoni mburugu igeza miliyoni gihe indwara z’umwijima bwoko b hpatite b zandurwa n’abantu basaga miliyoni ku ndwara sida nk’uko bitangazwa oms abayandura bagera miliyoni buri mwaka isi yoseubushakashatsi bwakozwe myaka cumi n’itatu ishize bwagaragaje indwara zendaga gucika ziyongera kubera abantu batagikora imibonano mpuza bitsina ikingiye mbere ibi biterwa habonetse imiti igabanya ubukana sida indwara zandurira mibonano mpuzabitsina ziterwa n’udukoko duto bactries nko mitezi cyangwa se none tugaterwa virusi nko ndwara z’umwijima bita hpatite b sida zikaba zishobora kandi guterwa n’indiririzi champignon ou parasite nko ndwara tirikomunase mu bisobanuro bitangwa n’impuguke zakoze igenzura zivuga icyerekana indwara zandurira mibonano mpuzabitsina maladies sexuellement transmissibles usibye sida zikiriho hari ibimenyetso byazo biranga abazirwaye afrika irugarijwe umugabane afurika kimwe bice by’isi byibasiwe bitewe n’uko ibihugu byishi bigize mugabane bikiri nzira y’amajyambere nko ndwara y’imitezi afurika yonyine ifite by’umubare twavuze haruguru w’abantu bayandura buri mwaka ahanini bantu bayirwaye abakora umwuga w’uburaya ku ndwara mburugu afurika ifite ibipimo ibibembe bifata gitsina ikagira imibare iteye inkeke ndwara z’umwijima zandurira mibonano hpatite b kuri ndwara afurika ikubye inshuro zose umubare w’abazandura burayi bitewe n’uko bihugu by’uburayi babona inkingo z’izo ndwara gihe afurika bagitangira kuzitanga atari bihugu byose kuri sida afurika abagore bibasiwe cyane kuko bagore bakora umwuga w’uburaya byabo bafite ubwandu sida muri rusange by’abagore bakomoka afurika munsi y’ubutayu sahara bafite ubwandu sida dr nyatanyi thierry ushinzwe gukumira indwara z’ibiza indwara zidakira kigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe ubuzima rbs yavuze u rwanda kimwe bihugu bike afurika bikingira abana bavutse indwara z’umwijima harimo n’izo twavuze zandurira mibonano mpuzabitsina idakingiye avuga abibwira sida yonyine ikomeye ndwara zandurira mibonano mpuzabitsina bakwiriye kumenya hari n’izindi nyinshi kandi mbi cyane ngo umuntu yandura ndwara niko byorohera sida kwinjira bitewe n’ibisebe biza gitsinabimwe bimenyetso biranga uwanduye indwara zifata imyanya ndangagitsina ukuribwa myanya bagore kubona ibimenyetso bigenda bitandukana bitewe n’ubwoko bw’indwara umuntu yanduye ku bagore ho akenshi uburwayi buboneka bubobere buba gitsina scrtions vaginales ariko hakabaho n’ibindi bimenyetso nko kuribwa kuzana udusebe kwishimagura kuzana ubushye guhinda umuriro ndetse kubabara igihe bakora imibonano mpuzabitsina akenshi abagore hari n’igihe batabimenya banduye ndwara bakabibwirwa muganga ariko bagiye kwivuza ntibibuza ariko bazanduza ubonanye nabo aramutse adakoresheje agakingirizo avuga ndwara zandurira mibonano mpuzabitsina zishobora kwirindwa abantu bareka ubusambanyi gihe byananiranye kwifata bagakoresha agakingirizoikindi uzirwaye yivuje kare kandi muganga akira ariko gihe uzirwaye ativuje ndwara zimunga umubiri zikangiza imyanya ndangagitsina bikaba byanavamo ubundi bumuga buzageza gucika igitsina cyangwa gupfa ernestine musanabera

title: bishop rucyahana yikomye bikomeye pasiteri wasebeje abagore’kuri radio
content: bishop john rucyahana wacyuye igihe buyobozi bw’itorero ry’abangilikani rwanda akaba perezida komisiyo y’iguhugu y’ubumwe n’ubwiyunge yamaganye bikomeye pasiteri wavuzweho gusebya abagore radio ubuntu butangaje amazing grace radiyo ikaba yaranahagaritswe gukorera miringo hano rwanda bishop john rucyahana wacyuye igihe buyobozi bw’itorero ry’abangilikani rwanda akaba perezida komisiyo yikomye muvugabutumwa gatanu tariki gicurasi nama mpuzamahanga buringanire bw’umugabo n’umugore iteraniye i kigali ubwo kiganiro cyagarukaga gushyira imbaraga guteza imbere uburinganire hagati y’umugabo n’umugore iki kiganiro cyari kiyobowe fatou lo uhagarariye u rwanda muryango w’abibumbye cyari kirimo umuyobozi w’ikigo gishinzwe kugenzura iyubahirizwa ry’ihame ry’uburinganire gender monitoring office madame rwabuhihi rose abandi kiganiro umuvugabutumwa akaba perezida komisiyo y’ubumwe n’ubwiyunge rwanda nurc bishop rucyahana john umuhuzabikorwa ipad rwanda kayitesi eugenie ndetse euthlie nyirabega umudepite nteko ishinzwe amategeko y’u rwanda bishop rucyahana wagaragaje abakozi b’imana bakwiye kuba umusemburo mwiza kubahiriza hame ry’uburinganire yaboneyeho kwamagana kunenga bikomeye pasiteri yagize birababaje cyane muntu w’imyitwarire nk’iriya gusebya bikomeye yagakwiye kuba akorera twbabajwe kumva yabikoze bishop rucyahana kandi yavuze imiryango gikirisitu igira akamaro gakomeye kwimakaza ihame ry’ubiringanire n’ubwuzuzanye atitwigisha abagabo n’abagore kuzuzanya kubahana umwe akubaha mugenzi ubwo pasiteri niyibigira nicolas yatangaga ikiganiro radiyo ubuntu butangaje minsi ishize umuvugabutumwa nicolas niyibikora yatutse abagore abita indaya abita abicanyi n’abagizi nabi avuga ibibi byose isi biturukaho ndetse ashimangira bibiliya bagaragazwa nk’inkomoko
