title: loni yahishuye byinshi buzima bw’umutegarugore ssp urujeni uyoboye abapolisi b’u rwanda loni
content: loni yatangiye kugaragaza inkuru z’abagore butumwa bw’amahoro ihereye munyarwandakazi senior superintendent of police ssp urujeni jackeline w’imyaka y’amavuko umubyeyi w’abana wagaragaje inkuru y’ubuzima bwe sudani y’epfo amaze igihe kiyingayinga umwaka butumwa kubungabunga amahoro unmiss tariki kamena ssp urujeni jackline yayoboye itsinda ry’abapolisi biganjemo abagore berekeje butumwa bw’amahoro i juba sudani y’epfo bafite inshingano kurinda inkambi z’impunzi ibikorwaremezo n’ubutabazi mu kiganiro yagiranye n’umukozi loni ssp urujeni yahishuye byinshi buzima bwe bugaragaza ishusho rusange y’abapolisi b’u rwanda kumwe butumwa bw’amahoro loni ushobora gutangira utwibwira nshamake urujeni amazina nge urujeni jackline nturuka rwanda mfite imyaka y’ubukure ndubatse mfite umugabo n’abana batatu maze imyaka ndi umupolisi mfite ipeti senior superintendent loni kuri uherereye he urujeni ndi umuyobozi w’itsinda ry’abapolisi b’u rwanda riri butumwa bw’amahoro i juba sudani y’epfo loni ni izihe nshingano ufite butumwa urujeni inshingano zange nyinshi itsinda ryacu rigizwe n’abapolisi kimwe kabiri cyabo abagore ndabayobora ngakurikirana n’akazi kabo buri munsi mpuza ibikorwa ngategura gahunda gucunga umutekano mujyi nkambi zicumbikiye abaturage bakuwe byabo idp muri bice turinda amarembo magari tugaherekeza abakozi b’imiryango itabara imbabare n’abakozi loni tugategura n’ibikorwa gufata intwaro ibiyobyabwenge n’ibindi bintu byose biri baturage buryo bunyuranyije n’amategeko tugira n’ibikorwa n’ubukangurambaga bugamije kongerera ubushobozi abaturage bacumbitse turinda cyane cyane ab’igitsina gore loni umunsi wawe usanzwe uba umeze ute urujeni ntangira umunsi wange saa kumi n’imwe gitondo niruka ibirometero byibuze gatatu cyumweru mu kazi nge uyobora gahunda gutegura akazi buri munsi saa tubanza gusubira byabaye masaha yashize tukungurana ibitekerezo gukemura ibibazo bishobora kubangamira akazi kacu tugasubiramo inshingano buri munsi tukanazigabana buri munsi nshyira ruhande isaha akenshi biba hagati saa yine saa tanu mugitondo ngasura buri ofisiye wifuza guhura nge by’umwihariko tukaganira ngingo zitandukanye uhereye bijyanye n’akazi ukageza buzima bwacu bwite igihe kinini nkimara biro ariko buri gihe mba nkurikiranye icyombo numva akazi karimo kugenda ngafata ibyemezo igihe biri ngombwa loni igihe cyawe utari kazi ugikoresha ute urujeni iyo mbonye agahenge nkunda kujya gym inzu ikorerwamo imyitozo ngororamubiri cyangwa nkavugana n’umuryango nge wasigaye rwanda ikindi nsabana bagenzi bange nkagira uruhare siporo zitandukanye ibirori n’ibindi bikorwa biduhuza bitegurwa rwego kutwongerera imbaraga morali n’ubuzima buzira umuze loni umaze igihe kingana butumwa bw’amahoro bw’umuryango w’abibumbye byagenze gute ube umwe babugize urujeni nageze hano i juba guhera kamena ariko mbere kuza sudani y’epfo hagati - nagiye butumwa bw’amahoro mbere i darfur sudani kubera nigeze kubona imibabaro myinshi gihugu cyange nkanyurwa n’uburyo abantu cyane cyane ubuyobozi bw’igihugu bakoze itandukaniro rifatika bagahindura igihugu paradiso ndetse ubuzima bw’abantu bukarushaho kuba bwiza nakuye isomo bikorwa by’indashyikirwa mfata umwanzuro nge ngomba kugira ikintu nkorera abandi gisobanutse by’umwihariko nk’umugore ndashaka kugaragaza uburyo abagore dufite imbaraga kandi dushoboye kubaka amahoro n’ubumwe loni ni umuryango n’inshuti zawe batekereje kemezo wafashe gihugu ugiye butumwa bw’amahoro loni urujeni ubwo nabibwiraga umuryango wange ntibabashije kubyizera baratunguwe birabayobera ndetse ntibishimiye kemezo gato byansabye igihe kubasobanurira agaciro kabyo kugira basubire murongo narababwiye nti murebe hari benshi bakoze nk’ibi mbere nge kandi byagenze neza nabasobanuriye mbifata kujya butumwa bw’amahoro mahanga bimwe bigize akazi kange nyuma y’igihe batangiye kunyumva ubu barishimye kandi baterwa ishema n’ibyo nkora loni ni ibihe bintu by’ingenzi wishimira butumwa bw’amahoro urimo urujeni nkunda mbasha kugaragaza itandukaniro buzima bw’abantu ndaguha urugero nyuma y’igihe gito tugeze kamena twoherejwe kurinda inkambi mpageze nabonye mbere hantu ho kwisukurira hahabaga by’umwihariko bagore n’abakobwa bityo nge bagenzi nge twiyemeje kububakira ubwiherero bugikoresha kugeza n’ubu loni ni ibihe bintu ukunda cyane butumwa gihugu ukoreramo urujeni nkunda ukwihangana n’urugwiro byabaturage sudani y’epfo nubwo bamaze igihe kinini makimbirane n’intambara baracyafiteurukundo ndetse bagerageza guhora bareba ruhande rwiza nkunda ibiganiro tugirana n’abagore bacumbikiwe nkambi kumva ikizere bagore badufitiye ikintu cy’agaciro gakomeye akenshi ntibanadufata nk’abapolisi-twahindutse inshuti n’abavandimwe ahubwo abenshi baduhamagara bakuru barumuna sisters noneho hari n’akana gato k’agahungu kabo kanyita mama loni ni hehe ubona ibyago nshingano zawe kubera urujeni ibyago mbere mugenzi wange ahohotewe cyangwa agakomeretswa turi hano dukora ibyiza ariko umwe twe ahohotewe bidushyira bihe bikomeye nge biranambabaza cyane guhohotera bagenzi nge bimwe bituma twe nk’abari butumwa bw’amahoro by’umwihariko abagore dukaza umurego ndetse tukarushaho gukorana n’abaturage bikorwa biduhuza uko duhura kenshi tuzigarurira imitima bitume twumvisha buri umwe impamvu twaje sudani y’epfo rusange by’umwihariko muu nkambi loni utekereza abagore butumwa bw’amahoro bashobora kuba bandebereho urujeni tugira uruhare rukomeye cyane kugarurira ikizere abagore n’abakobwa hano ibihugu byinshi by’afurika n’imico yabyo usanga iyobowe n’abagabo n’abantu benshi abagore title: rusizi abana b’abakobwa hagati batwara inda zitateganijwe buri mwaka
content: ubuyobozi bw’akarere rusizi buvuga buhangayikishijwe bikomeye n’abana b’abakobwa bakomeje gutwara inda zitateganijwe n’ingaruka ubwabo n’abo babyayeaho buvuga buri mwaka abari hagati bazitwara kandi abenshi batazi n’uburenganzira bwabo bikabakururira imibereho mibi byatangajwe n’umuyobozi wako wungirije ushinzwe imibereho myiza y’abaturagensigaye emmanuel kabiri tariki gashyantare abakobwa babyariye iwabo bagera mirenge bugaramakamembemururu gihundwa y’aka karere bagiranaga ibiganiro by’umunsi umwe n’umushinga ’baho neza’ ukorera muryango nyarwanda uharanira iterambere ry’abaturage bijyanye n’ubuvuzi kubakorera ubuvugizi by’ubuzima bufatanye minisante nkunga imbuto foundationaho baganirizwaga bijyanye n’uburenganzira bwabo n’ubw’abo babyaye n’ubuzima bw’imyororokere mu bibazo bakobwa bakomeje guhura nk’uko babigaragaza hari mo kubyara imburagihe kuko abenshi batagejeje myaka y’ubukurehakaba abazitwara mashuri abanza n’ayisumbuye kindi bashobora kwikorera barere bana gutereranwa kwihakanwa n’abazibateye bakanababuza kubavuga babakangisha bazabagirira bi kutita kwandikisha bana bitabo by’irangamimererekumva banze ubuzima bigeza n’aho bakumva bakwiyahura n’ibindi bavuga bifuza harimo kurusha ho kwgerwa n’ubuyobozi bunyuranye bukumva ibibazo byabokubashakira imishinga yabafasha nibura kubonera bana mituweli kuko abenshi baziterwa babana nyirakuru batishoboye cyangwa bakabajyana gukodesha amazu bashobora guhurira mo n’ibindi bibazo biruta ibya mbere bamwe bakemeza baramutse bategerewe hari n’ abashobora kubona ubuzima bubarambiye bakaba babwiyambura uzayisenga chantal w’imyaka y’amavuko afite umwana umaze icyumweru gusa avutse avuga yatewe inda n’umumotari w’imyaka utuye murenge gihundwe mujyi rusizi ayimutera yiga w’amashuri abanza amushukishije amafaranga y’amanyarwanda kandi afite abana barimo abamuruta n’abo banganaubu yu mugabo yaracitseundi yabuze epfo ruguru yabwiye bwizacom ati’’ nasanze umugore nibura anderane n’umwana wanjye bana arangaumugabo wayinteye naramubuzesinzi ikindi nakora kuko polisi nagiye bambwira bazakomeza kumushakisha kandi mbana nyogokuru ushaje kindi nshobora kwikorera uretse kumesera abantu imyenda bakampa turarira kandi ntiyambonera mituweli y’umwana nkifuza ubuyobozi bwamfasha umugore w’uwo mugabo akagira amfasha’’ impuguke bijyanye n’ubuzima bw’imyororokere n’ubuzima rusangemporanyi thobald umwe bahaye bana ibiganiro avuga kibazo gihangayikishije cyane kuko myaka ishize gihugu hose habarurwaga abana munsi y’imyaka y’amavuko bagera batewe inda zitateganijweikibabaje kikaba abazibatera babihanirwa bakiri bake kubera akenshi kubahishira kubyungira miryangoimigirire nk’iyi ikaba ikwiye gucika kugira uburenganzira bw’aba bana n’abo babyaye bubashe kubahirizwa avuga kandi kwihanaka abana kw’abagabo n’abasore bamwe bitazajya biborohera kuko uburyo gupima adn se w’umwana amenyekana rwanda bwatangiye gukoreshwa gusa bakobwa bagasabwa kwitabira gahunda kuboneza urubyaro gukomeza kubyara batazashobora kwita ho ubuyobozi bw’aka karere buvuga ariko nubwo ababyarira iwabo mubare munini abahanwa bazibatera bakiri bake cyane kuko abashyikirijwe ubutabera bakanakatirwa title: rubavuabaturage beretswe imirambo y’abarwanyi bicyekwa fdlr baguye gitero bagabyereba amafoto
content: nyuma y’imirwano hagati y’ingabo z’u rwanda n’abarwanyi bikekwa fdlr abaturage mudugudu cyamabuye kagari rusura murenge busasamana bateraniye nama y’umutekano bahumurizwa n’abayobozi abaturage beretswe barwanyi bishwe bambaye imyenda gisirikari banavuga mirwano yamaze nk’iminota kuko batangiye kumva amasasu saa sita n’iminota z’ijoro agacogora ahagana saa saba zirenga vestine nyabirayi mudugudu avuga atari ubwa mbere bumvise amasasu aka gace gusa joro yatinze akabona ibyabaye bukeye abarwanyi yita fdlr baguye bane patrick twiringirimana kumwe bagenzi babiri irondo kandi bamaze kuvugana n’abasirikare nabo irondo maze bagenzi babona abantu bikoreye utuzigo bafite n’imbunda bambuka kibaya baza rwanda bayobowe n’umuturage wambaye ikoti ryera umwe bagenzi patrick irondo niwe wahise ajya kubwira abasirikare batewe babibonye bahita batangira kurasa ati baje ikirongo buri umwe yikoreye agatwaro afite n’imbunda batangiye kurasasaa sita z’ijoro amasasu yacecetse saa saba ziri kuzura neza umuyobozi w’umudugudu byabereyemo gahungu theoneste yavuze amasasu yatangiye kumvikana cyane saa sita n’iminota ahita ahamagara umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’umurenge mu gitondo hakozwe inama y’umutekano hazanwa imirambo ine y’abarashwe mirwano bagapfa gusa herekanwe imirambo ine ariko abateye basubiranyeyo indi mirambo itatu abapfuye hamwe bateye barindwi nk’uko byavuzwe nama col muhizi pascal uyobora brigade ikorera nyabihu rubavu yabwiye abaturage umutekano uhari kandi uzawuhungabanya ingabo zihari ati ndabasaba mwakomeza gahunda zanyu mwanzi wahungabanya umutekano w’u rwanda nabaje mubonye isomo bahaboneye n’iyo bagaruka bikubye inshuro ntacyo badutwara ingabo zacu zirakomeye aka gace gahana imbibe n’agace k’ikirunga nyiragongomuri congo barwanyi bateye baturutse bakanasubirayo umwe bishwe icyangombwa kimuranga cyerekanweabaturage batangaje bantu barashwe n’umwe bazi cyangwa bigeze babona aka gace mbereaba barwanyi bishwe bambaye imyenda gisirikari abishwe bahise bashyingurwa hano yanditswe habarurema djamali

title: kigali ikamyo itwara peterole yaturitse bayisudira ihitaha babiri
content: abantu babiri bahitanywe n’ iturika ry’ ikamyo itwara amavuta yasudirwaga n’ abakanishi mujyi kigali karere kicukiro i gikondo ababibonye bavuga mpanuka yatewe n’ uburangare bw’ abakanishi abantu babiri bahitanywe n’ iturika ry’ ikamyo itwara amavuta yasudirwaga n’ abakanishi mujyi kigali karere kicukiro i gikondo ababibonye bavuga mpanuka yatewe n’ uburangare bw’ abakanishi iyi mpanuka yabaye nyakanga masaha y’ igicamunsi imodoka yasudirwaga ifite plaque rada uretse babiri bapfuye hari wakomeretse abapfuye umushoferi w’ kamyo gakwandi jean claude w’imyaka hejuru y’ itanki yereka umukanishi ahari imyenge wapfuye kamudra mitanyurwa w’imyaka ufite ubwenegihugu bw’u rwanda n’ubwa repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo yahiriye kigega umurambo uhita ujyanwa bitaro kacyiru kumudra niwe wasudiraga uwakomeretse nahayo emmanuel umukozi igaraje wahise ajyanwa kuvurirwa bitaro chuk abaturage bavuga mpanuka yatewe n’ uburangare bw’ abakanishi kuko ubundi mbere gusudira ikigega cy’ imodoka itwara essence babanzaga kucyoza n’ amazi kugira ibishashi by’ umuriro bidateza inkongi

title: ikipe y’u rwanda y’abagore izaserukira afurika brazil
content: ikipe y’u rwanda y’abagore yabonye itike kuzitabira imikino paralempike izabera brazil nyuma kwegukana umwanya mbere mikino y’afurika sitting volleyball ikipe y’u rwanda y’abagore yatsinze misiri maseti - mukino nyuma marushanwa yiswe para volleyball africa sitting volleyball championships yasojwe kabiri tariki nyakanga ikipe misiri yatsinze iseti mbere manota -u rwanda rutsinda iseti kabiri manota -misiri itsinda iseti gatatu manota -u rwanda rutsinda iseti kane manota - n’iya gatanu nayo nyuma manota - umutoza w’ikipe y’igihugu gakwaya eric avuga mateka barifuje babigezeho nubwo bitari byoroshye kuko rushanwa ryari rikomeye cyane yagize ikipe misiri inshuro kabiri duhura rushanwa ariko umukino ubanza twabatsinze bitworoheye ariko munsi ikomeye cyane kuko yazanye imbaraga zidasanzwe mukobwankabo liliane kapiteni w’ikipe y’igihugu sitting volleyball bagore avuga kuba babonye intsinzi mukino nyuma intambwe ishimishije bateye kandi bagiye gukomeza kwitegura kugira bazabashe kwitabira imikino paraleympike izabera i rio brazil umwaka utaha mu bagabo ikipe misiri niyo yabonye itike nyuma gutsinda ikipe y’u rwanda maseti - kalisa eduard umunyamabanga uhoraho minisiteri siporo n’umuco yabwiye abanyamakuru kuba amakipe y’u rwanda akomeye sitting volleyball bigaragaza shampiyona ikomeye ku bijyanye n’ishimwe ry’abakinnyi kalisa yavuze bazicara bakabyigaho nzeyimana clestin umuyobozi komite y’igihugu y’imikino y’abafite ubumuga npc rwanda yabwiye ikinyamakuru izuba rirashe kwakira mikino y’afurika sitting volleyball bisigiye igihugu kumenya gutegura abatekinisiye bariyongereye kuko babaye amahugurwa y’abasifuzi buryo abitwaye neza bazajya basifura imikino mpuzamahanga nzeyimana avuga ikindi gikomeye ukubona itike kuzitabira imikino paralempike izabera i rio brazil umwaka utaha ibihugu bitandatu nibyo byitabiriye marushanwa y’afurika yabereye rwanda harimo misiri kenya u burundi congo kinshasa algeria n’u rwanda rwakiriye amarushanwa indatwanet

title: inkuru ndende y’urukundo amaherezo igice
content: akenshi rukundo habamo ibyishimo bidasanzwe kimwe n’uko ibigeragezo byageze rukundo ahanini usanga bake aribo babasha kubyihanganira kubyakira ariko ugasanga abandi bikabananira guhagarara mpamvu twakomeje n’igice gikurikira sifa si kwizerwa ariko nyine jado akumva kuba umuntu kandi muntu udahinduka nyine mpamvu gukomeza ibintu ahubwo umukobwa azahinduka kandi jado azabigeraho ubwo nyine bakomeje kubana gutyo nyine telephone ariko nyine ako kantu kuruhande jado abacuti ntan’umwe washimaga sifa kuko baziko umukobwa w’insazi nyine udashobotse habe mba gusa hari n’abandi bageraga bati mpamvu ugomba mugira kwirira gukemura ibibazo mpamvu kumuha urukundo rwawe ahubwo uze umuryarya gusa burya abahanga bajya bavuga imana ikora ibyayo n’ubwo twe nk’abantu tuba dufite imigambi yacu ariko imana nayo iba ifite iyayo migambi kandi itandukanye cyane n’iy’abantu nibwo sifa jado ibyabo byakomeje kugenda bikomera yewe jado akajya ahora agerageza kugira inama sifa nyine amwumvisha ubryo kwitwara neza byiza cyane ndetse kubaha ibintu byose mbese sifa akagerageza kumvisha jado agomba guhinduka mbese akamwumvira ndetse akagerageza kujya akora jado ashaka gusa kandi abona byamugirira akamaro rero birumvikana iminsi yakomeje kugenda yigira imbere nibwo twaje kugera minsi mikuru noheri n’ubunani nabwo byari biteganijwe jado sifa bazahura amaso maso nyine kuko sifa iwabo hari ntara jado akabayari kigali birumvikana kuko umwe yagombaga gufata umwanya agasanga gusa byaje koroha cyane kuko sifa yaje kugira gahunda ituma aza i kigali mpera z’umwaka kuko nyine ahafite gahunda ndetse famille yagombaga kuza gusura ubwo nyine jado yavuye ishuli aza aje biruhuko by’iminsi mikuru ariko nyine yaje habura iminsi nkibiri noheri ibe sifa atari yaza i kigali bahite babonana kuko iwabo bakomeje kujya bamwima uruhushya kuba yajya i kigali avuye iwabo muntara byakomeje gutyo bagenda baganira kandi jado yaramaze gutandukana n’umukunzi mbere umwe babanaga ishuli nyuma sifa yaje kubona uruhushya rutuma aza i kigali nabwo arubona bunani nabwo yabonanye mbere jado amaso maso kuko munsi stade amahoro hari hari bubere ibirori by’abahanzi kandi jado akaba yarakundaga umuziki yagiye sitade kureba bahanzi mugoroba nawo sifa buzemo i kigali sifa yaturutse iwabo bwije cyane kuburyo byageze saa tanu z’ijoro atari yagera i kigali ariko jado kubera agace gakurikira ntucikwe yanditswe akayezu snappymuhaburarw

title: amakipe polisi yegukanye ibikombe n’imidali mikino eapcco
content: ikipe polisi y’u rwanda ikina umukino njyarugamba uzwi izina karate yitwaye neza marushanwa ahuza amakipe y’ibihugu bihuriye muryango w’akarere k’iburasirazuba eapcco iyi kipe polisi y’u rwanda yegukanye ibikombe bitatu ndetse n’imidali zahabu fezasliver y’ umulinga bronze muri mukino polisi y’u rwanda yaserukiwe n’amakipe abiri abagabo n’abagore hamwe rusange buri mukinnyi yashoboye kwegukana umudali mu irushanwa ry’u mukino w’amaboko handball ikipe police hc nayo yegukanye igikombe nyuma gutsinda ikipe y’igipolisi k’igihugu kenya n’icya uganda mu mukino ubanza kipe police hc yatsinze gihugu kenya ibitego gitondo police hc y’u rwanda itsinze iya uganda ibitego muri mukino rwamanywa viateur police hc yatsinze ibitego tuyishime zacharie atsinda ibitego cpl mutuyimana girbert yatsinze ibitego ni gihe mukino uherutse kuba tariki kanama police hc yatsindiwe rwamanywa viateur cpl mutuyimana girbert hategekimana fideli buri umwe yatsinze ibitego umutoza police hc inspector of police ip antoine ntabanganyimana yashimiye byimazeyo abakinnyi uburyo bagaragaje ishyaka n’ubwitange rushanwa ati ndashimira cyane abakinnyi banjye uburyo bitwaye twatangira rushanwa bagaragaje ishyaka ryo gukomeza kubika gikombe kuko n’umwaka ushize nibo bagitwaye ku rundi ruhande ikipe polisi y’u rwanda ikina umukino njyarugamba karate nayo imaze guhigika amakipe bahanganye nayo yatwaye ibikombe ndetse n’imidali iyi ntsinzi igezweho nyuma y’aho kanama kipe itsindiye amakipe y’ibihugu bahanganye aribyo uganda kenya burundi tanzania sudani y’epfo umutoza w’ikipe polisi y’u rwanda mukino karate chief inspector of policecip sylivestre twajamahoro avuga n’ubwo rushanwa ryoroha ariko amakipe bahuye yaraboroheye cyane kuko bayarushije buryo bugaragara yagize ubusanzwe irushanwa riba irushanwa ntiwarijyamo usuzugura mugiye guhangana ariko abakinnyi biriya bihugu twakinnye nabyo ntabwo batugoye rwose twarabarushije cyane abatoza b’amakipe yagiye aserukiye u rwanda mikino gipolisi bahurizaho uburyo ubuyobozi polisi y’u rwanda bwari bwarateguye abakinnyi mbere y’uko irushanwa ritangira cip twajamahoro yagize dushimira ubuyobozi polisi yacu y’u rwanda uburyo bwateguye amakipe yitabiriye marushanwa kimwe mubyatumye dutanga umusaruro haba mubikoresho ndetse gutegura abakinnyi mutwe rwanda ujya kenya ubundi hari urugendo rurerure ukoresheje imodoka ariko kuba twaragendeye ndege biri mubyatumye abakinnyi bagerayo batananiwe babasha kwitwara neza muri rushanwa abakobwa b’ikipe polisi y’u rwanda karate begukanye ibikombe harimo kimwe baherewe kwiyerekana neza kata n’ikindi batsindiye nyuma kurwana kumi ni gihe bagabo habonetse igikombe kimwe bahembwe kubera kurwana neza imidali u rwanda rwegukanye yahabwaga buri mukinnyi bitewe n’uko yitwaye itsinda ry’abo bakinnyi bagaragaje ubuhanga kuko buri umwe yashoboye kwegukana umudali zahabu aya marushanwa eapcco yatangiye tariki kanama bikaba biteganyijwe arangira kanama u rwanda ruhagarariwe n’amakipe ariyo title: abanyarwanda batuye canada bibutse abazize jenoside yakorewe abatutsi
content: igikorwa kwibuka kitabiriwe kandi n’abahagarariye ibihugu byabo canada n’izindi nshuti uyu muhango watangijwe n’urugendo walk to remember rwatangiriye nteko ishingamategeko canada rugera biro by’umujyi ottawa ahabereye imihango kwibuka nyuma y’indirimbo zubahiriza ibihugu byombi hakurikiyeho umunota kwibuka inzirikarengane zishwe jenoside padiri callixte kabalisa wayoboye isengesho yasabiye abahuye n’ibibazo binyuranye harimo abafashwe ngufu asaba imana gukomeza impfubyi n’abapfakazi n’abandi bagize ibibazo bikomeye uhagarariye u rwanda canada edda mukabagwiza perezida w’ishyirahamwe ry’abacitse kw’icumu rizwi kw’izina humura alain ntwali bagaragaje bibuka amateka jenoside yabaye rwanda bagamije gufata ingamba ibyabaye ntibizongere kuba ukundi nk’uko itangazo ambasade y’u rwanda canada ribivuga berekanye umuhango ukorwa ugamije kwibuka ariko abantu bakanatekereza uburyo gufasha abacitse icumu bagarutse nsanganyamatsiko y’uyu mwaka twigire mateka twubaka ejo hazaza bavuga genoside yakorewe abatutsi mateka y’ubu n’ejo hazaza itazibagirana mu muhango kwibuka kandi hatanzwe ibiganiro bibiri l’historique de l’impunit des crimes haineux au rwanda et les signes avant-coureurs du gnocide contre les tutsis cyatanzwe bwana richard nsanzabaganwa les mots qui tuent cyatanzwe prof philippe basabose nsanzabaganwa yerekanye ubwicanyi bwagiye buba ariko ubutegetsi ntibuhane abakoze ibyaha kwica aha yavuze uduce tunyuranye ubwoko bw’abatutsi bwagiye bwicwa yerekanye kwica byagiye bishyigikirwa n’ubutegetsi kurengera abatutsi babaga bibasiwe prof basabose yerekanye amagambo yagiye akoreshwa rwanda yagize uruhare ishyirwa bikorwa ry’ubwicanyi yakoze isesengura ry’ijambo ryavuzwe leon mugesera i kabaya yakanguriye abanyamuryango mrnd abereka umwanzi wabo umututsi n’abahutu mashyaka ataravugaga rumwe mrnd gahunda ziteganijwe zijyanye kwibuka zizagera kwezi gatanu zirimo amasengesho ikiriyo n’ibiganiro bizatangwa taliki mata abanyarwanda n’inshuti zabo bongeye guhura gitambo misa kwibuka cyabereye paruwasi mutagatifu yozefu gatineau quebec

title: abanyamadini barasabwa gukomeza kwamagana abayoboke baryabatanga ruswa
content: mu gahunda y’icyumweru cyahariwe gukumira kurwanya ruswa kane urwego rw’umuvunyi rwaganiriye n’abanyamadini banyuranye rubibutsa bafite inshingano kwigisha abakristu kwirinda ruswa ariko n’ufite amakuru muyoboke wijanditse ruswa mpamvu kumuhishirabernadette kanzayire umuvunyi mukuru wungirije avuga bateguye kuganira n’abanyamadini byari bigamije gufasha abanyamadini kubona umwanya gusuzuma uruhare rwabo gukumira kurwanya ruswa n’ibyaha bifitanye isano nabyo yavuze bashaka abanyamadini bareba ese urwo ruhare rurahagije hanyuma bafate ingamba kugira urwo ruhare rukomere bafashe abayoboke b’amadini kurushaho kumva bafite inshingano gukumira kurwanya ruswa atari ukuyanga kuyivuga magambo gusa ahubwo bagakora ibikorwa bifatika kandi bagahora bakangurira abayoboke ruswa n’ibyaha bifitanye isano nabyo icyaha nk’uko bigaraga bitabo bitagatifu bagenderahoati bagiye gukora cyatuma noneho bamwe batuye uru rwanda bagaragara hari umusanzu ufatika bagize ese hari ibimenyetso bajya batanga ruswa yatanzwe bamwe banyamadini ku birebana n’amakuru byaha abayoboke bakoze abanyamadini bakayamenya ariko ntibayahe leta umuvunyi kanzayire avuga hagomba kurebwa hari amategeko abategeko ababuza kuba batanga ikimenyetso runaka ati nk’abenegihugu nabo bafite inshingano gutanga ibimenyetso nibakomeza bakayihishira ruswa kandi babimenye ejo izatera ibibazo kandi nabo izabagiraho ikibazo nabo niba tuvuga hari kubakwa amashuri hakubakwa abiri kubera ruswa yatanzwe ukuvuga abana b’igihugu bazaba batabonye amashuri meza bakwiye kubera ruswa yatanzwe gihe bayimenye babimenye akazi kabo nibo bariburebe ingamba nyazo z’uko bazabikora kandi batishe n’umurongo w’idini umuvunyi akavuga abanyamadini bashobora kwifashisha itegeko rirengera umuntu watanze amakuru bakajya batanga amakuru rwego rw’umuvunyi cyangwa izindi nzego zikorana narwo atagaragaye padiri etienne mucyeragabiro umupadiri diyoseze nyundo ushinzwe komisiyo y’ubutabera n’amahoro diyoseze yabwiye umuseke ruswa icyaha nk’ibindi amadini yigisha abayoboke bayo kureka ati dufite uruhare rukomeye cyane kwigisha abayoboke b’ayo madini abanyarwanda rusange kugira bacike ruswa nk’icyaha ariko noneho bihe n’uburyo igihugu gutera imbere kuko umutungo kiba gifite ukoreshwa neza buri wese agahabwa afitiye uburenganzira ahabwa n’amategekoku birebana n’amakuru byaha abayoboke bakoze babaha gihe bihana padiri mucyeragabiro avuga umupadiri yakiriye amabanga ntebe penetensiya cyangwa umuntu aje kumugisha inama muntu ashaka ugukiranuka ugutunganira imana ati icyo gihe biganiro ukumvikanisha umuntu ushaka gukira neza buryo bwuzuye yiyunga n’imana aca ukubiri n’icyaha yakoze ariko rundi ruhande akaba agomba kwiyunga n’igihugu n’abo yahemukiye niba umuntu yarariye ruswa umufasha kumva ububi ruswa akumva icyaha gikomeye niba asabye imbabazi ntebe penetensiya umuntu akaba yamubwira imana ihora ibabarira ariko none imana yifuza abantu bubahiriza amategeko ukuvuga yaribye yaratwaye iby’abandi umuntu yamusaba abisubizwa umuntu akagira uburenganzira kubyo yaravukijwe ubundi noneho agashobora kubura amaso akabona yiyunga n’imana neza musenyeri innocent byakatonda umusenyeri orthodox karere avuga gihe umuyoboke yireze akemera icyaha akwiye kubanza kuganirizwa akagirwa inama gusa hari n’aho biba ngobwa bamugira inama kujya kwirega nzego z’umutekano nk’iyo yakoze icyaha gikomeye cyangwa yarananiwe kwihana yamditswe ubwanditsimuhaburarw

title: shampiyona apr fc yaratsinze rayon sports fc iratsindwa
content: nyuma gustindira as kigali stade regional i nyamirambo ibitego busa apr fc ikipe irimo guhagarara gikombe shampiyona ibitse yatangiye gusiga amakipe zihanganye ibi ikaba yabigezeho icyi cyumweru ibikesha ibitego by’abasore bahagaze neza minsi olivier karekezi kapiteni w’iyi kipe n’umunya uganda dan wagaluka rayon sport mukeba mbere apr fc yatakaje amanota imbere la jeunesse yiganjemo abakinnyi bakiri bato kandi byagaragaraga bamenyeranye cyane bayitsinda ibitego bibiri kimwe ikindi cyaje gukomeza mukino emmanuel ruremesha umutoza la jeunesse wahoze atoza rayon sport akaba ayizi neza ndetse nyuma y’umukino akaba yaradutangarije yifuzaga gutsinda rayon sport kugirango agaragaze la jeunesse atari ikipe yisukirwa kandi akiri umutoza ukomeye jean marie ntagwabira umutoza rayon sport n’ubwo yatsinzwe ntiyababaye bitewe n’uko hari abakinnyi bakomeye bakina inyuma batagaragaye mukino avuga atarenganya abahakinnye n’ubwo ntandaro gutsindwa twabuze amahirwe menshi imbere y’izamu ariko kandi n’ibitego twatsinzwe byatewe n’abakinnyi bakina inyuma ariko simbabaye kuko abakinnyi nari nizeye bakina iddy nshimiyimana mbanza hussein tambwe floribert munota nyuma byaje guhinduka gusa abakinnye bakoze bashoboye cyane abenshi badasanzwe babanza kibuga gusa ntagwabira yizeye kuzaba afite abakinnyi bakomeye azaba ahanganye apr fc ikipe yanatoje igihe kirekire mukino utaha uzahuza makipe tariki ukwakira stade amahoro police fc indi kipe yatangiye shampiyona ifite umuvuduko inatsinda ibitego byinshi yagaragazaga ishobora kuzahangana apr rayon sport ikazitwara igikombe dore n’umutoza wayo w’umunya serbia goran kuponovic yatakaje amanota abiri i huye imbere mukura vs nyuma kunganya ubusa busa umukino marine etincelles utegerejwe n’imbaga y’abanya rubavu kubera guhangana bitajya bishira hagati y’aya makipe warangiye etincelles atahanye amanota atatu nyuma gusinda marine ibitego busa stade umugandakuri stade mumena kiyovu sport izahagararira u rwanda mikino confederation cup yahatsidiye bitagoranye amagaju ibitego shyaka jean akili mabula serugaba erc barebye ncundura amakipe yazamukiye rimwe cyiciro mbere mwaka ndetse akaba yombi yanatangiye shampiyona yitwara nabi nyanza fc espoir zanganyirije ubusa busa i nyanza ubu apr isonga n’amanota etincelles irayikurikiye n’amanota rayon sport mwanya gatatu ifite amanota gihe police fc iza mwanya kane n’amanota amakipe nyuma marine kumwanya nota rimwe ifite ikaba ibanzirizwa as kigali mwanya n’inota rimwe thoneste nisingizwe

title: akarere rubavu karishimira ibikorwa by’amajyambere kagezeho
content: mu bikorwa byamuritswe harimo umuhanda uhuza imipaka yombi y’u rwanda repubulika iharanira demokarasi kongo grande et petite barierre ukazatwara akayabo k’amafaranga akabakaba miliyoni ndetse n’ umuhanda pave ujya biro by’akarere watangiye gukorwa munsi umuyobozi w’akarere sheh bahame hassan yavuze akarere kabwiye rwiyemezamirimo imodoka zikora mihanda zitazasubirayo utugari tutazikoresheje dusane uduhanda tujya hasuwe kandi umusozi wimuweho imiryango kubera ikibazo cy’isuri yicaga abahatuye gihe cy’imvura uyu musozi murenge gisenyi guterwamo ibiti binyuranye bifata ubutaka hakazubakwamo uduhanda intebe n’ibitare kuruhukiramo mukerarugendo iki gikorwa kizatwara amafaranga miliyoni bavuye musozi ubuyobozi b’akarere rubavu bwasuye akagari karukogo umurenge rubavu birebera ibikorwa ndengera foundation uyu muryango wubatse amasoko y’amazi agemurira abaturage amazi meza ndetse n’ibitaro kijyambere umuyobozi w’akarere yasabye umuyobozi ndengera foundation gufatanya n’akarere bakareba masoko y’amazi yakwaguka abaturage benshi bakavomaho abayobozi banagejejwe ahari kubakwa amashanyarazi ako kagali jean berchmas bahige ukuriye ewsa rubavu yasobanuye mashanyarazi azagera baturage tugali twa byahi kanembwe karukogo ibarizwa mirenge rubavu cyanzarwe bahige yashimangiye mashanyarazi afite ingufu zihagije zizafasha abaturage kwivana bukene bahige yagize mushinga wizwe neza ibikoresho byose birahari igikorwa cyose gikoreshwa n’amashanyarazi kizahakora kirahari mpungenge hasuwe n’isoko ryo ako kagali ariko rizatangira gukorerwamo mutarama nyuma y’ubunani uru rugendo rwasorejwe isoko kijyambere ry’akarere rubavu riri kubakwa mujyi rwagati murenge gisenyi imirimo kubaka soko iracyari hasi ariko irimo kwihutishwa kugira rizatangire gukoreshwa aho riri isoko risanzwe rikorera hazazamurwa irindi gorofa hanubakwe imodoka zihagarara asoza gikorwa umuyobozi w’akarere rubavu sheh bahame hassan yibukije inshingano buri wese kurinda gukoresha neza ibikorwa remezo gihe bizaba byuzuye bahame yagize ibikorwa nk’ibi iby’umuturage turifuza buri wese agira uruhare kubibungabunga kubikoresha kuko uburenganzira bweumwe baturage utuye kagari karukogo seth mugema asanga amajyambere kwihuta abagana buryo yiteguye gutangiza umushinga iwabo cyaro nogosha imisatsi mujyi none kubera batuzaniye amashanyarazi ngiye kwimurira salon yanjye karukogo nk’uko byagaragaye akarere rubavu kari kwihutisha ibikorwa remezo bijyanye n’icyerekezo ariko cyane cyane hubakwa imihanda ariko inzira ikiri ndende akarere karateganya kuganira n’abafite amazu mujyi rwego kubafasha kwihutisha bikorwa bakihutisha iterambere aka karere pascaline umulisa

title: ikinyarwanda gishobora kuvanwa ndimi z’ubutegetsi zemewe
content: umushinga w’itegeko nshinga rivuguruye kuganirwaho komisiyo politiki n’imiyoborere myiza nteko ishinga amategeko umutwe sena ngingo uteganya itegeko ngenga rishobora kongera cyangwa kugabanya indimi zemewe butegetsi ikinyarwanda akaba rumwe ndimi zirebwa n’iyo ngingo nk’uko bisanzwe itegeko nshinga ry’u rwanda ururimi rw’ igihugu ikinyarwanda gihe indimi zemewe butegetsi ikinyarwanda icyongereza n’igifaransa iyi ngingo yagiweho impaka senateri jean de dieu mucyo yavugaga ngingo hari igika cyamuteye impungenge kigaragaza ururimi rw’ubutegetsi rushobora kuvanwamo cyangwa rukongerwamo n’ itegeko ngenga kandi n’ ikinyarwanda kigaragara ndimi ku kijyanye kuba indimi z’ubutegetsi zishobora kugabanywa senateri tito rutaremara yavuze ngingo ifite ishingiro yagize niba basanze wenda abanyarwanda batagikoresha igifaransa igishinwa aricyo kivugwa cyane bazabireba bigomba kujyana n’inyungu mbere kubera twakolonijwe n’abafaransa abanyamerika bakoloniza isi ariko hari igihe abashinwa wenda aribo bazaba badufitiye inyungu yakomeje agira igihe abanyarwanda bazavuga bati ntitugishaka ikinyarwanda hazaba hari impamvu ariko sinzi bizabavisi perezida sena gakuba jeanne d’ arc yasobanuye ikinyarwanda gishobora kuvanwa ndimi z’ubutegetsi kigasigara ururimi rw’igihugu bityo mpungenge bikwiye gutera visi perezida w’umutwe w’abadepite ushinzwe ibikorwa by’inteko jeanne d’ arc uwimanimpaye yavuze bateganya iyongerwa cyangwa igabanywa ry’ indimi z’ubutegetsi batekerezaga hakwiyongeramo igiswahili yagize igihe hazaba ho igisekuru kizemeza ikinyarwanda kitaba ururimi rw’ ubutegetsi bazabikore ariko ruzaba ururimi rw’igihugu ubwo twatekerezaga ngingo twatekereje giswahili tuvuga tuti tugeze eac tugasanga bikenewe twacyongeramo kubijyaye n’imyandikire y’inyandiko z’ubutegetsi senateri bernard makuza yavuze uburyo ngingo yanditse vugurura ikuraho urujijo kuko ivuga inyandiko z’ubutegetsi zishobora kuba rurimi rumwe cyangwa ebyiri cyangwa zose zemewe butegetsi senateri rutaremara yavuze kwandika ndimi cyangwa rumwe biboneye hakwiye kuzajya harebwa itsinda ry’ abantu rigiye kwandikirwa kubera ugiye nko kwandikira abantu mudugudu hakoreshwa ikinyarwanda mu gusobanura visi perezida w’ umutwe w’abadepite jeanne d’ arc uwimanimpaye yagize ikindi twagendeyeho igikorwa gukurura abashoramari ntabwo hari nk’ abashoramari baje twabategeka inyandiko zabo bazihindure gifaransa cyangwa cyongereza yakomeje agira ntabwo twabihuza n’ imitangire serivisi kuko nko kwandika igazeti leta ababikora bazakurikiza bigenewe ariko ntabwo twabategeka bakoreshe indimi runakakomisiyo politike n’ imibereho myiza ikomeje kuganira mushinga w’ itegeko nshinga rivuguruye mbere tariki ugushyingo ikaba yasuzumye ingingo zibanza mbere saa sita yanditswe title: araharanira abagore baryoherwa n’ imibonano mpuzabitsina kandi agenda abigeraho
content: umugore gihugu ghana witwa nana darkoa sekyiamah yagize ishyaka ryo kuvuganira abagore uburenganzira bwabo kuryoherwa n’ imibonano mpuzabitsina bwubahirizwe umugore gihugu ghana witwa nana darkoa sekyiamah yagize ishyaka ryo kuvuganira abagore uburenganzira bwabo kuryoherwa n’ imibonano mpuzabitsina bwubahirizwe iyi mpirimbanyi y’ uburenganzira bw’ abagore yashinze urubuga rwigisha abagore bagomba guharanira uburenganzira bwabo kuryoherwa n’ imibonano mpuzabitsina kuko avuga ngingo ubusanzwe itari yitaweho uru rubuga ruhuza abagore bakaganira birebana n’ ibitsina bisanzuye sekyiamah butumwa burebure yashyize rubuga yashinze avuga abagabo bashyirirwaho amahirwe menshi atuma bashaka gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina binyuze matangazo yamamaza atambuga bitanyamakuru avuga gihugu cye hari amazu acuruza imiti ituma abagabo bashaka gutera akabariro cyane kugeza hari umugore wabajije umugabo saa sita ngutegurire umugabo agasubiza ndashaka wowe sekyiamah avuga nubwo ingingo kuryoherwa kw’ abagore gihe cy’ imibonano mpuzabitsina ititabwaho ntikwiye kwirengagizwa kuko bantu ghana abitwa akan abagore benshi baka gatanya bitewe kutaryoherwa gihe cy’ imibonano mpuzabitsina title: tariki ukwakira intangiriro y’indunduro mobutu sese seko zare
content: ni intambara ikomeye kuko niyo yashyize iherezo butegetsi bw’umunyagitugu mobutu sese seko umaze imyaka ayoboye zare nk’urugo rwe kugeza hari bamwe baramufashe nk’imana cyangwa se umuntu utazapfa akabyuririraho akiyita umwami zare imyaka butegetsi mobutu yayimaze yishakira abanzi nabo bamurunduye haba imbere gihugu rwego mpuzamahanga mu myaka ubukungu zare bwari aharindimuka umuturage yabonaga nibura amadolari atagera magana atatu mwaka ugize imyaka akiriho akaba umurame muri myaka kandi mobutu gitutu mpuzamahanga ibihugu bikomeye byifuzaga kandi bigashyigikira impinduka n’amaraso mashya buyobozi bw’ibihugu afurika byasaga n’ibiyobowe cyami jambo abaturage bafite ibihugu leta zunze ubumwe amerika n’u bufaransa byashyigikiye mobutu mizo mbere byari bitangiye kumukuraho amaboko bimutegeka gukuraho ubutegetsi bw’ishyaka rimwe akemera amashyaka menshi igisirikare zare faz nacyo cyari aharindimuka kuko imyitwarire mibi ikigeze kure ahanini kubera kudahembwa kutagira ubuyobozi buhamye byatumaga bahuka baturage gusahura bikongera isura mbi mobutu baturage binavugwa hari mobutu yigeze kubaza abasirikare uburyo bataka kudahembwa kandi yarabahaye imbunda jenoside yakorewe abatutsi imbarutso y’indunduro mobutu nyuma y’uko ingabo zari iza fpr inkotanyi zihagarikiye jenoside yakorewe abatutsi rwanda interahamwe n’ingabo leta bayishyize bikorwa bahise bahungira burasirazuba zare y’imbibi z’u rwanda ubusanzwe amategeko mpuzamahanga ntabwo yemera impunzi zishyirwa y’umupaka w’igihugu zahunze nyamara izavuye rwanda zahawe rugari ingabo zahoze iza leta y’u rwanda yakoze jenoside abahoze butegetsi n’abandi batangira kwisuganyiriza butaka zare mobutu bagaruke kugaba ibitero leta nshya imaze kujyaho rwanda inkunga ikomeye yatangwaga ivuye guverinoma zare iyobowe mobutu sese seko u rwanda rwamenyesheje imiryango mpuzamahanga kibazo ibyima amatwi rufata umwanzuro kwambuka zare gusenya inkambi impunzi zisuganyirizagamo zigabe ibitero rwanda banashishikariza impunzi zabyifuzaga gutaha kuza uko kwinjira k’u rwanda zare kwahaye ingufu indi mitwe itaravugaga rumwe leta mobutu nibwo umutwe alliance des forces dmocratiques pour la libration du congo afdl uyobowe laurent-dsir kabila watangije ibitero bihereye burasirazuba zare ukomeza ujya gufata ubutegetsi i kinshasa intambara yahise yanzika afdl ishyigikiwe n’u rwanda uganda angola eritrea ethiopia zambia zimbabwe n’inyeshyamba spla yashakaga ubwigenge sudani y’epfo kubera ubukene ruswa n’ubwirasi guverinoma mobutu abaturage benshi bagiye ruhande rw’inyeshyamba biba impinduramatwara kurusha byari intambara uruhande mobutu rwagerageje kwirwanaho rushyigikiwe sudani ndetse n’inyeshyamba unita zashakaga ubutegetsi angola ni nabyo byatumye angola ishyigikira uruhande rwashakaga gukuraho mobutu dore yaninjiyemo nyuma mobutu bihe bibi arembejwe kanseri yahaye ibiraka abacanshuro benshi kumufasha gusubiza inyuma inyeshyamba n’abari bazishyigikiye ariko biba iby’ubusa kuko umunsi munsi barushagaho kwegera umurwa mukuru kinshasa kwinjira angola ntambara noneho kongereye ingufu uruhande kabila rwarwanyaga mobutu buryo bugaragara barusha ingabo leta imbaraga mu mezi nyuma y’urugamba ingabo mobutu ntizari zigiteye ikibazo inyeshyamba ahubwo ikibazo cyasigaye ibikorwa remezo bike nk’imihanda byorohereza inyeshyamba kugera i kinshasa tariki gicurasi mobutu wasaga n’uwabuze epfo ruguru yahunze igihugu bucya laurent desire kabila n’ingabo ze batangaza bafashe igihugu bashyiraho guverinoma nshya mobutu yabanje guhungiro togo avayo ajya maroc yaje kugwa nyuma y’amezi ane azize kanseri y’ubugabo bw’epfo prostate cancer tariki nzeri kabila amaze kujya butegetsi yahindutse u rwanda atangira gukorana n’abasize bakoze jenoside atangira kubafasha bazagaruke gutera u rwanda nibyo byagejeje ntambara kabiri congo

title: minisitiri gashumba yasabye abanyarwanda kwirinda ingendo zitari ngombwa i goma kubera ebola
content: minisitiri w’ ubuzima dr diane gashumba yasabyea abaturarwanda kwirinda gukorera mujyi goma ingendo zitari ngombwa rwego kwirinda bakwandurayo ebola minisitiri w’ ubuzima dr diane gashumba yasabyea abaturarwanda kwirinda gukorera mujyi goma ingendo zitari ngombwa rwego kwirinda bakwandurayo ebola mu mpera z’ icyumweru gishize nibwo mujyi goma y’ akarere rubavu hagaragaye umurwayi ebola ni umupasiteri uvuye i butembo nk’ byatangajwe minisiteri y’ ubuzima repubulika demukarasi kongo minisitiri w’ ubuzima dr diane gashumba yasuye imipaka i rubavu ihuza u rwanda goma asaba abanyarwanda kwitwararika yagize ntabwo wabwira abantu ntimwongere kwambuka umupaka ariko buri wese agomba kuganira n’umutimanama akumva ubusugire bw’igihugu bumureba yahahiraga hariya yashobora kubibona hano yareka kujyayo kugeza cyorezo kirangiye’’ mu rwego kwirinda ebola yinjira rwanda abaturutse hanze y’ imipaka bapimwa umuriro itangazo ryashyizweho umukono minisitiri w’ ubuzima dr diane gashumba nyakanga rihumuriza abanyarwanda ribabwira ebola iragaragara rwanda muri tangazo minisitiri gashumba yasabye abanyarwanda kwirinda ingendo zitari ngombwa ahagaragagaye ebola kwirinda kwakira abaturutse ahagaragaye ebola gutanga amakuru y’ gihugu hose kwihutira kwipimisha umuriro igihe uturutse ahagaragaye ebola kumenyesha polisi uhamagaye minisiteri y’ ubuzima imirongo itishyurwa igihe ubonye umuntu uturutse ahari ebola minisitiri gashumba akomeza asaba abaturage uwakumva afite ibimenyetso ebola yakwihutira kujya muganga kwirinda gukora matembabuzi cyangwa ibikoresho byakoreshejwe n’ umurwayi ebola kwirinda gukora muntu wishwe ebola cyangwa gukora kurya inyamaswa ishyamba zipfushije gukomeza umuco gukaraba intoki hakoreshejwe amazi meza n’ isabune amakuru aturuka i goma aravuga abagenzi bagendanye taxi n’ mupasiteri wagaragayeho ebola bamaze gukingirwa ndetse mupasiteri yasubijwe i butembo kuko ariho hari ivuriro ebola rifite imbaraga u rwanda rumaze igihe rwarafashe ingamba zikomeye kwirinda ebola zirimo gupima abinjira rwanda baturutse bice birimo ebola kamera zipima abantu kivunge zikamenya harimo ufite umuriro mwinshi ku mupaka uzi petite barriere uhuza uhuza u rwanda kongo hashyizwe kamera ebyiri zipima abantu binjiye mukivuge haba harimo ufite umuriro mwinshi zigata impuruza uretse buryo kandi hari gahunda ibaho gukirangira ebola abantu bahawe amahungurwa guhanga ebola ndetse n’ abajyanama b’ ubuzima turere twegereye imipaka

title: kigali serena hotel nyungwe forest lodge hoteli zifite inyenyeri rwanda
content: mu gikorwa gutangaza uru rutonde cyabereye serena hotel i kigali tariki amahoteli yahawe inyenyeri zitandukanye eshanu hejuru kugera nyenyeri hagendewe ibipimo afurika y’iburasirazuba urwo rutonde ruvuga the manor lemigo mille collines lake kivu serena ziri gice cy’amahoteli afite inyenyeri enye top tower alpha palace virunga musanze amwe hoteli arindwi kigero cy’amahoteli afite inyenyeri eshatu amahoteli niyo yahawe inyenyeri ebyiri relay’s gorilla hoteli niyo yonyine yahawe inyenyeri igenzura n’ishirwa rutonde rw’amahoteli byakozwe n’ikipe y’impuguke by’amahoteri igizwe n’abakozi leta abacuruzi rwanda hamwe n’impuguke karere k’afurika y’iburasirazuba rica rwigamba ushinzwe ubukerarugendo n’ibidukikije rdb yasobanuye isuku umutekano gushimisha umurava kwakira abantu ndetse n’ingano y’ibyumba biri ingingo zakurikijwe gutanga nyenyeri rwigamba yavuze amahoteli atarashyizwe rutonde adahejwe kuko bazayashyiraho nyuma kuzuza ibyangombwa bayasabye birimo kuvugura inyubako yabijeje bazajya rutonde tw’ubutaha perezida w’amahoteli utubari n’amarestora denis karera yasobanuye inyenyeri zirutanwa ubukuru bw’amahoteli burutanwa yabigereranyije n’inyenyeri gisirikare umusirikare yongerwa inyenyeri bitewe n’ibikorwa byiza yakoze monique mukaruliza ministiri ushinzwe ibikorwa by’afurika y’iburasirazuba umushyitsi mukuru yavuze leta y’u rwanda ishyigikiye igikorwa guteza imbere amahoteli rwanda kuko ariyo nkingi y’ubukerarugendo yagize amahoteli soko y’ifaranga ryo hanze rituma amafaranga y’u rwanda agira igihagararo cyiza minisitiri mukaruliza yasobanuye ishyirwa rutonde ry’amahoteli rwanda hakurikijwe ibipimo by’afurika y’iburasirazuba birushaho guha amahoteli nyarwanda uburyo kumenyekana rwego rw’isi john gara umuyobozi w’ikigo cy’igihugu cy’iterambere rdb yavuze gutanga uru rutonde bizatuma amahoteli ahorana ishyaka ryo kunoza serivisi kugira azamuke ntera kandi n’abashyitsi bazajya babasha guhitamo ihoteli bitewe n’urwego bashaka mu byishimo byinshi afite jean luc ushinzwe imurikagurisha nyungwe forest lodge yavuze adatunguwe kuba bahawe inyenyeri eshanu yabivuze magambo twigisha abakozi bacu bihagije kandi tukanakora bwabaga gutanga serivisi nziza buri gace kose kagize nyungwe forest lodge nshimiyimana barthazar nyiri virunga hotel yahawe inyenyeri eshatu yavuze leta y’u rwanda yaramufashije cyane kuzamura serivisi hoteli ahiga mugaragaro agiye kuzamura serivisi ze kugira ubutaha azahabwe inyenyeri enye itangwa ry’inyenyeri ubwa mbere ribaye rwanda akaba n’ubwa kabari afurika y’iburasirazuba kuko tanzania iherutse gukora igikorwa nk’iki jovani ntabgoba

title: abakandida bahatanira kuba abasenateri bagiye gutangira kwiyamamaza
content: komisiyo y’ igihugu cy’ amatora yatangaje mbere w’icyumweru gitaha abahatanira kuba abasenateri batazatangira kwiyamamaza abaziyamamaza barasabwa kuzirinda gusebya bagenzi cyangwa kubiba amacakubiri ahubwo bakagaragaza imigabo n’imigambi igamije kugeza u rwanda byiza komisiyo y’ igihugu cy’ amatora yatangaje mbere w’icyumweru gitaha abahatanira kuba abasenateri batazatangira kwiyamamaza abaziyamamaza barasabwa kuzirinda gusebya bagenzi cyangwa kubiba amacakubiri ahubwo bakagaragaza imigabo n’imigambi igamije kugeza u rwanda byiza nec yagiranye ibiganiro n’abemerewe kwiyamamaza matora y’abasenateri byibanze gahunda y’ibikorwa kwiyamamaza bizatangira kanama kugera nzeri aba bakandida bazatorwamo barimo ntara y’amajyaruguru intara y’amajyepfo iy’uburasirazuba n’iy’iburengerazuba hazatorwa abasenateri batatu batatu ho mujyi kigali hatorwe umusenateri umwe aba bazatorwa n’inteko itora igizwe n’inama njyanama z’uturere n’abagize biro z’inama njyanama z’imirenge ifasi biyamamarijemo harimo kandi abakandida bazatorwamo abasenateri umwe uhagarariye kaminuza n’amashuri makuru leta n’undi yigenga perezida komisiyo y’igihugu y’amatora prof kalisa mbanda asaba abakandida kuziyamamaza buryo budahungabanya igihugu cg babangamire bagenzi yagize basabwa kwiyamamaza gipfura batavuga nabi abandi umuntu akavuga imigabo n’imigambi ubushobozi bwe imbaraga afite yamarira igihugu ariko ntajye kuvuga uriya mugenzi wanjye ntabishoboye kuko yaba amwinjiriye amugabanyiriza agaciro abandi banyarwanda bamuha ikindi amagambo cyangwa ibikorwa byerekeza macakubiri n’ingengabitekerezo rwanda ibyo byose turabibabuza kugira bagire amahirwe angana biyamamaze bareshya nk’abanyarwanda bagatandukanwa n’ubushobozi abaturage babumvamo bababonamo amatora y’abasenateri batorwa hakurikijwe inzego z’imitegekere y’igihugu ateganyijwe nzeri gihe amatora y’umusenateri uhagarariye kaminuza n’amashuri makuru leta ateganyijwe ho ay’umusenateri uhagarariye kaminuza n’amashuri makuru byigenga akazaba ubusanzwe sena y’u rwanda igizwe n’abasenateri kuko hari n’abandi basenateri bashyirwaho perezida repubulika bashyirwaho n’ihuriro ry’igihugu title: muhanga abaturage begerejwe serivise z’ubuzima buntu bakorera
content: bamwe baturage murenge nyamabuye karere muhanga bavuga bishimiye begerejwe serivizi z’ubuzima zirimo gupimwa indwara zitandura ndetse kuboneza urubyaro kandi bakabihabwa buntu ubusanzwe bajyaga bazishyura amafaranga muri gare muhanga hamwe hakorewe gikorwa gusuzuma gupima indwara bamwe bitabiriye gikorwa bavuga cyabafashije kumenya bahagaze kuko ubusanzwe bitewe n’akazi bakora bibagora kubona umwanya kujya kwisuzumisha muganga mukamutesi odette umwe bakorera umwuga w’ubudozi nyubako gare muhanga avuga bushake yajyaga agira kwipimisha uretse igihe atwite yagize akazi dukora umuntu ntaruhuka ukarangiza nijoro uhita ujya rugo kubona umwanya kujya i kabgayi ngiye kwisuzumisha umuvuduko w’amaraso diyabete ntabyo nanatekerezaga uretse wenda ntwite nipimisha sida bipimo bapima abagore batwite ariko nabyipimishije kuko bansanze nkorera mwanya natakaje hategekimana simon umuyobozi w’abakora imideri avuga nk’abantu bakorera hamwe biba byoroshye bakwanduzanya indwara zirimo nk’igituntu ariko bipimishije bakamenya bahagaze bituma wizera mukorana bazima ndetse n’uwarwaye agahabwa imiti ntabe yakwanduza abandi tuba duhumeka umwuka umwe umuntu ashobora kurwara indwara ntabone ajya kuyisuzumisha ugasanga iramuzambije gikorwa kiza iyaba cyahoragaho gusanga abaturage kazi bakabapima basanze yaranduye akaba yahabwa imiti umutoniwase kamana sosthne umuyobozi w’ishami ry’ubuzima aka karere avuga gikorwa cyakozwe rwego gufasha abaturage kumenya bahagaze ariko kuzamura imihigo y’akarere barahize y’ibyo bazakorera abaturage bijyanye n’ubuzima yagize igikorwa kirimo gukorwa mirenge y’akarere barapimwa indwara zitandura harimo hepatite diyabete umutima umuvuduko w’amaraso agakoko virus itera sida ndetse n’abafata imiti kuboneza urubyaro nabo barayibona uyu muyobozi kandi avuga bahisemo kujya ahahurira abantu benshi rwego kwirinda bakwanduzanya uretse gutanga inama abapimwe bagasanga barwaye bahita boherezwa muganga kujya gufata imiti nibura munsi biteze bazajya bakira abantu barenga baje gusaba serivise

title: menya impamvu zituma abakunzi bawe mwashwanye bakomeza kugaruka
content: kubona abantu bakundana bahagarika urukundo ibintu bibahocyera kabaye nyuma y’amezi n’amezi cg iminsi myinshi ukabona umwe agerageje kugaruka nabwo umwe atangira kwibaza icyatumye bashwana kandi mbere barakundanagaakibaza impamvu yatumye barekana ndetse bakemera guhagarika urukundo nuwo bakundanaga kandi atarabyifuzaga impumvu nyinshi zitandukanye zituma mwahoze mukundana agaruka ariko bikaba ingenzi kumva neza nubwo urukundo buri gihe ukuri kwizera bishoboka atarirwo rutumye agaruka ahubwo hari ikindi kibyihishe inyuma gishobora kuba kiza cg kibi aha hari impamvu zituma mwahoze mukundana bakomeza kugaruka gukunda imibonano mpuza bitsina cyane abarenga kimwe kabiri cy’abantu bagaruka gukundana nabo bakundanaga bakuruwe kwikundira imibonano mpuza bitsina rwego hejuruiyo bibutse uburyo abakunzi ukuntu beza gitanda cg uburyo bahoraga babacyemurira ibyifuzo byabo bijyanye guhuza ibitsina igihe cyose babishatsebityo bagahita bagaruka bihuta bizeye ibintu bizajya bigenda neza nkuko byahozeicyo mwamenya ikiba kibagaruye atari urukundo ahubwo ukuba imbata y’imibonano mpuza bitsina ishyari riteye ubwoba hari abantu bagira ishyari rikabije kuburyo badashobora kukubona kumwe n’undi muntu nubwo muba mwarashwanye bwose bityo bakagaruka ndetse bakagerageza kukwigarurira ukaba utabava nzara aha itonde kuko si urukundo ahubwo icyavuye kukubonana n’abandi muntu cg umukunzi mushya nanone hariho igihe mwakundanaga bagaruka kugirango basenye umaze kugerahonk’igihe babonye wishimanye nuwo mukundana batishimye ntibashaka wishima ubwigunge bivugwa ubwigunge butuma abantu bagera batifuzaga kubaabo mwakundanaga bashobora kugaruka bitewe bonyine kandi bacyeneye bagendana cg baganira birumvikana utaba ugiye kuba gutemberana ahubwo bakumva wagaruka nanone mubuzima bwabo mukongera gukundana kurya umutugo wawe muba mwarashwanye bakagusiga wenyine ukaba warabaye umuherwe wifashije kubijyanye n’amafarangahanyuma bitunguranye bakaza bitwaje urukundo ndetse bagashaka kugaruka buzima bwaweurukundo ntacyo rukora kugaruka kwabo ahubwo nukuza kunyunyuza ibyiza ugezeho ndetse ngufu wakoresheje ubigerehosi abagabo bahura nicyo kibazo gusa kuko hari bagore bahura nacyo kudafata umwanzuro guhubuka kudafata umwanzuro bibaho bantu kuko hari igihe batazi neza bashaka buzima bwabo bigatuma bisanga basubiranye nuwo bahoze bakunda kandi atakibishaka cg yarabonye baba bagarutse nyabyo iyi mpamvu ntabwo ikunze kubaho kuko ibaho gacye cyane gihe bigaragaye igice kimwe cy’ abatandukanye kitashakaga ubutane bityo bakongera gukundanagusa rundi ruhande biragoye abashwanye bakongera gukundana kuko batagifitanye ibyiyumvo by’urukundo inama igihe bikubayeho ugomba gushishoza neza ukareba kugaruka kwabo mwakundanye mutagikundana atari mpyisi yiyambitse uruhu rw’intama rwera kuko baje kwangiririza ubuzima ndetse kukubuza amahoro wifitiye bitewe n’inyugu zabo bwite atari urukundo rubibateye yanditswe habarurema djamal

title: gushyigikira umuhanzi bobi wine byakomeje kwiyongera kuburyo bu komeye
content: imiryango iharanira uburenganzira muntu kenya yakoresheje imyigarambyo i nairobi imbere y’urukiko rw’ikirenga n’inteko ishinga amategeko basabye depite w’umuganda robert kyagulanyi aka bobi wine n’abo bafatiwe hamwe bagera barimo abandi badepite batanu bafungurwa basabye kandi leta kenya kwamagana ifungwa ryabo naho umuryango mpuzamahaganga uharanira uburenganzira bw’itangazamakuru cpj ufite icyicaro i new york leta zunze ubumwe z’amerika uramagana wita igitero banyamakuru batanu i kampala uganda batawe yombi kuwa mbere italiki barimo bakora akazi kabo myigaragambyo y’abaturage bashyigikiye bobi wine cpj iremeza abapolisi bakubitaguye banyamakuru babambura ibikoresho byabo by’akazi kandi barabyangiza irasaba abapolisi babikoze babiryozwa abo banyamakuru nk’uko cpj ibivuga james akena alfred ochwo b’ikigo ntaramakuru cy’abongereza reuters umunyamakuru cpj itavuga izina the observer nacyo bwongereza ronald galiwango juma kirya televiziyo ntv uganda urukiko gisilikali rwabanje kuburanisha depite bobi wine kuwa kane rwamukuyeho icyaha gutunga imbunda atabifitiye uruhushya ruramurekura ariko agisohoka bobi wine yahise none atabwa yombi noneho n’ubucamanza gisivili bwo bumurega kugambanira igihugu niyomugabo albert

title: inzitane emmalito yanyuzemo mbere kuba umunyamakuru uhamye
content: murenzi emmanuel uzwi emmalito umunyamakuru kugaragaza impano mwuga ariko kugera ageze yaciye byinshi by’inzitane byari kumubuza gukomeza mwuga abirenza amaso niba ukunda kureba ibiganiro binyura televiziyo rwanda gitondo byanze bikunze uzi bita the sun up’ gica royal tv gikorwa emmalito afatanyije yvonne mu kiganiro yagiranye rwandamagazinecom emmalito yanyuzemo make yabanje gushaka abanyamakuru kubaha inkuru zitandukanye radiyo flash fm city radio contact fm nyuma nibwo yaje kubona akazi royal fm ikivugira gukora atari umukozi uhoraho avuga byamugoraga rimwe rimwe akifuza kubivamo ati nkikora freelancer byarangoye cyane pe kuko akenshi nabaga najya terrain’ nakoresheje amafaranga yanjye naza bakaba bakwanga amashusho nakoze cyangwa amajwi nafashe nkumva nabivamo rimwe rimwe nkumva arinko kudaha agaciro nakoze kandi byangoye kubibona ikindi cyandushyaga karita y’akazi nagiraga kubona inkuru bikambera ikibazo emmalito avuga hari byageraga yakwaka amakuru bakayamwima kuko ntacyangombwa yabaga afite kigaragaza umunyamakuru ariko akanga agakomeza kugira umuhate kugira agere nzozi ze kazi kazi’ kuba umushyushyarugamba nibyo byamuhesheje kuba umunyamakuru w’umwuga gutanga inkuru binyamakuru emmalito yabifatanyaga kuba umushyushyarugamba bitaramo binyuranye by’amasosiyeti y’itumanaho n’ibindiyatangiye akorera rwandatel nyuma ihita ifunga yanabaye umushyushyarugamba mtn tigo bralirwa cyane cyane bikorwa kwamamaza coca cola emmalito avuga yagendaga akora aka kazi byamuhaga amahirwe kumenyana n’abantu batandukanye gutinyuka kuvugira ruhame nyuma biza kumuhesha akazi k’umunyamakuru uhoraho ati rimwe umuyobozi royal tv yansanze concert miss mr mount kenya university ndi mc aranshima cyane ndabizi nyuma ansaba tuganira tubonanye ambaza narigeze ngerageza gukora radio mubwira nahakoze ariko nimenyereza umwuga w’itangazamakuru bitari akazi gahoraho icyo gihe nibwo yambwiye yambonyemo icyizere mba ntangiye gutyo kuba umunyamakuru uhamye ukora akazi gahoraho emmalito yvonne bakorana kiganiro ’the sun up’ icyo gihe emmalito avuga aribwo inzozi ze yahoze arota kera aribwo zabaye impamo nyuma y’inzitane nyishi yahuye nazo yatangiye akora radio royal fm kiganiro mugitondo ramuka nyuma aza gutangira gukora nicya nimugoroba cyitwaga royal smack’ royal tv ifunguye aribwo atangira gukora the sun up’ nubu agikora buri gitondo itangazamakuru ryamwunguye byinshi ariko cyane cyane abantu’ emmalito ahamya akazi ke kamwunguye byinshi cyane ariko kuba byaratumye amanyena n’abantu b’ingeri zose ntakibiruta ati uretse kuba kantunze ariko akazi k’itangazamakuru akazi keza kaguhuza n’abantu benshi kandi b’ingeri zose mukaba inshutiburiya buzima ubukire mbere ukugira abantu kuruta ibintu abantu kandi ninabo bamufasha kunoza akazi ke kuko bagenda bamubwira akora akazi ke bakamugira n’inama y’ibyo yakosoraatifeedback nziza pe kandi bituma numva nakora ibyiza kurushaho kuzamura career yanjye mwuga witangazamakuru ikindi niko binezaza kurushaho mbonye harumbwira wakongeramo nibi wahindura aka biraneza kuko sinkunda nanone uwambwira ibyiza gusa atananyereka bimwe bipfira yakorewe surprises’ munsi w’amavuko tariki ukwakira nibwo emmalito yagize isabukuru y’amavuko kuba aziranye n’abantu benshi kandi b’ingeri zose byatumye abantu batandukanye bamutegurira surprise’ inshuro zitandukanyeati byarantunguye kandi biranshimisha byatumye nkunda kurushaho akazi nkora umunsi munsi ngenda menyana n’abantu benshi kandi bakambera inshuti nziza mu buzima nibwo mbere nari nkorewe surprises zingana kuriya inama agira uryubyiruko rufite impano emmalito avuga amaze kugeraho bikiri rugero hasi kubwe akaba agomba gukora cyane akagera rundi rwegoati the sky is the limit njye numva nzagera kure kuko mbona ntarageza yibyo nshaka aha navuga imana ariyo itanga kuko njye ubushake ndabufite avuga nama yagira urubyiruko rugenzi rwe emmalito yatangaje gushaka ugushobora ati mubyukuri inama yambere natanga gushaka ariko gushobora urubyiruko rufite impano zitandukanye ariko ruzira kudatinyuka biyushye akuya icya mbere ukudasuzugura akazi nkanjye nashatse kuba umunyamakuru ariko ntibimbuze kuba mc nyamara nibyo byaje kungeza nzozi zanjye ikibi ukwiyicarira ukumva ushaka bizakwizanira kuva rugo ugashakisha kandi ugaharanira kumenyana n’abantu benshi ntakabuza bigufasha kugera kucyo warose kera

content: gukunda akenshi usanga byoroshye kubigenga bityo ukamenya umutima wawe wishimiye gukundwa usanga bamwe biba ingorabahizi mugihe hari abandi wakeka bagira inzaratsi baha buri wese bahuye ifuni ibagara ubucuti akarenge ntiwasura umuntu udafitiye igihe mu gihe witwa ukunda utamufitiye igihe bizamugora kugukunda igihe utaye kubera ukunda burya igishoro kinini uba ushoye urwo rukundo rwawe haranira kubwira ukunda ibyiza umubonaho ubimubonyehobenshi biragora cyane kumva impamvu abahanzi n’abasizi bakunda gukundwa cyane ibanga rindi babasha kuvuga ibyiza babonye muntu byaba ngombwa bagakabya kugirango yishime nubona icyiza kuwo ukunda yaba imyambaro inseko ingendo yagutekeye n’ibindi ntugatinde kumubimubwira kubibika mutima kandi wabishimye ntacyo bimaze dore niyo ubivuze bishimisha ubibwiye gerageza kumva uw’agaciroigihe cyose wisuzugura wumva ntacyo uricyo kandi ntawagutaho igihe n’abandi niko bazagufata niwumva agaciro kawe bizatuma utoza n’abandi kumva uwagaciro bityo iteka bajye bihutira kugusanga kukuba gerageza kuba umuntu ucyeye mutima useka kandi usetsausibye burya n’uwo ukunda n’undi muntu wese mudafitanye urukundo azagukunda akugera iruhande ukamuruhura umusetsa niba umuntu akwegereye asanga maganya azakugendera kure kuko iteka azirinda maganya yawe wayamwanduza cyangwa akaba yanagutazirira umunyamushiha kandi wenda urengana ihingemo inseko byibura gusetsa abandi bitakoroheye iga gusaba ukundaiyi ngingo ingenzi cyane buzima bw’ushaka gukundwa kugaragaza cyane ntacyo ukeneye bandi usanga nabo bagerageza kukwima byose bityo umuntu ubona utamukeneye ntibizatinda kukujya kure yisangire umukeneye aha ukubikorana ubwitonzi kuko hari wabyitwaramo nabi ugahinduka nk’umusabirizi ukabyangirwa ariko nanone tukamenya gusaba ingenzi wowe utishimira wihuzagurika umucira urubanza kumucira urubanza uzasanga akenshi ushobora kwibeshya kumutekerereza ibitaribyo bityo bikaba byatuma urukundo agufitiye rwagabanuka yanditswe akayezu content: bishop rugagi innocent uyobora itorero abacunguwe rwanda redeemed gospel churchyavuze atigeze ahanurira miss shanitah azaba nyampinga w’u rwanda ahubwo yamusabiye umugsiha yanasonanuye bibazo biri politiki byari gutuma ahunga igihugu nk’uko byavuzwe cyane yagiye kenya bishop rugagi innocent uyobora itorero abacunguwe rwanda redeemed gospel churchyavuze atigeze ahanurira miss shanitah azaba nyampinga w’u rwanda ahubwo yamusabiye umugsiha yanasonanuye bibazo biri politiki byari gutuma ahunga igihugu nk’uko byavuzwe cyane yagiye kenya tariki gashyantare nibwo ubuyobozi bw’umurenge nyarugenge bufatanyije n’inzego z’umutekano bwafunze urusengero rw’ itorero abacunguwe rwanda redeemed gospel church riyobowe bishop rugagi innocent ifungwa ry’itorero abacunguwe ryakurikiwe n’urugendo rw’uyu mushumba waryo kenya gahunda y’ivugabutumwa ibintu bamwe bahereyeho bavuga ashobora kuba ahunze igihugu nyuma y’uko urusengero rwe rufunzwe ibi ariko byaje nyuma gato y’izindi nkuru zari zimaze iminsi zivuga iby’uko bishop rugagi yahanuriye umukobwa witwa umunyana shanitah ariwe wagombaga kwegukana ikamba nyampinga w’u rwanda mu kiganiro n’itangazamakuru gatatu tariki gashyantare bishop rugagi yavuze ibyavuzwe irushanwa miss rwanda bitandukanye cyane n’ukuri ahamya atigeze ahanurira miss shanitah ahubwo yamusengeye rwego kumusabira umugisha yagize tariki gashyantare nibwo nahamagaye umukobwa witwa shanitah shanitah umwana wanjye aririmba angels korali itorero abacunguwe papa umujyanama rusengero niwe wansabye nsengere umukobwa irushanwa nyampinga w’u rwanda mu by’ukuri njyewe nakoze ukumusabira umugisha ntabwo ukumuhanurira yakomeje avuga asanzwe akunda gushyigikira abanyarwanda biyumvamo impano zitandukanye atanga urugero rw’umuhanzi alpha rwirangira watwaye irushanwa task project yahise avuga muhanzi yatwaraga rushanwa bishop rugagi kenya kandi yaramusengeye ndetse aranamushyigikira cyane yagize mba numva nashyigikira umunyarwanda wese ufite impano runaka kandi agashaka kuyigaragaza nahamagaye belinda shanitah ndanabasengera bombi ariko ntabwo nigeze mbahanurira uruzi imana iba yampaye buhanuzi mba narabahanuriye ifungwa ry’urusengero ryabaye buryo butunguranye bishop rugagi yavuze iby’ifungwa ry’itorero abacunguwe’ bisa nk’ibyamutunguye dore uru rusengero rwari rwarabanje gufungwa nyuma umuyobozi w’akarere nyarugenge aza kumuha urwandiko rumwemerera gufungura biza kugera nyuma ubuyobozi bw’umurenge buragaruka bufunga urusengero yavuze bijya gutangira abazungu b’abahinde bakorera y’urusengero rwe ahamya bagejeje ikibazo cyabo buyobozi bw’umurenge nyarugenge nabwo ubuyobozi bwaje kumusaba yashyiramo ibyuma birinda urusaku sound proofibi byuma bishop rugagi yabishyizemo nyuma umuyobozi w’umurenge araza aramufungira birangije ajya karere bamuha urupapuro rumuha uburenganzira gufungura ariko nyuma umurenge uragaruka uramufungira bishop rugagi yabajijwe impamvu atagiye kurega ubuyobozi bw’umurenge dore bwamufungiye kandi afite ibyangombwa yahawe n’ubuyobozi bw’akarere bumwemerera kuba akorera hantu avuga yanze kugonganisha inzego yagize ikintu ugomba kubanza kureba ukureka ikintu kitwa igonganisha ry’inzego ugatwara ibintu mahoro komanda polisi turi kumwe akaba kubwira gitifu afite urwandiko rw’iminsi ine kugira abe yimutse mwamuretse gitifu oya bishop rugagi yavuze yifuje kujya gukodesha icyumba kimwe nyubako makuza nyuma ubuyobozi bw’akarere nyarugenge buza kumuhakanira bumubwira cyumba kiri hejuru igorofa ibintu bishobora guteza ingorane gihe haba habayeho impanuka yavuze kandi yatangiye kuvugana n’ubuyobozi kaminuza y’u rwanda kugirango abe yatizwa gusengera kaminuza ahazwi kigali conference and exhibition village’ ibyo guhunga igihugu bishop rugagi innocent yasobanuye atigeze ahunga igihugu nk’uko byakunze kuvugwa yasobanuye yateguye urugendo kujya kenya mbere y’uko urusengero rwe rufungwa agiye giterane atagombaga gusiba kubw’impamvu zoroheje nk’izi gufunga urusengero rwe yashimangiye title: umunyarwenya mbere burundi yatsindiye igihembo gikomeye mpuzamahanga
content: michael sengazi umuhanga gusetsa burundi rwanda yatsindiye igihembo cyitiriwe ’rfi talent du rire’ gitanzwe nshuro gatanu michael sengazi umuhanga gusetsa burundi rwanda yatsindiye igihembo cyitiriwe ’rfi talent du rire’ gitanzwe nshuro gatanu sengazi umuhanga gusetsa wavukiye i gitega burundi se w’umurundi nyina yavukiye i burundi ariko akomoka rwanda igihembo rfi talent du rire cyatangijwe n’umuhanga gusetsa witwa mamane ukomoka niger mamane kandi asanzwe ategura amakuru asekeje radiyo y’abafaransa rfi gondwana rfi talent de rire’ igihembo gihabwa umuhanga gusetsa wahize abandi iki gihembo kijyana n’ama azagishyikirizwa gutaha sengazi iki gihembo njyewe ikintu gikomeye cyerekana babonye kandi bemeye akazi kanjye ngakora neza kandi nshobora kugera kure harenza muri afurika gihembo gitanzwe nshuro gatanu michael sengazi niwe watowe rwego afurika umunyarwenya sengazi yize amashuri abanza burundi n’ayisumbuye michel archange i bujumbura yiga amategeko kaminuza ulk i kigali rwanda arangije kwiga yahisemo gukora umwuga gusetsa avuga impamvu yasemo gukora umwuga guse ariyo mpano yasanze imana yaramuhaye ababyeyi babona ariko arononango hari abantu bataramenya gusetsa nawo umwuga arabumva kuko gusetsa atari ibintu bimenyerewe cyane michael yinjiye neza neza mwuga akina theatre nyuma ahura bagenzi bahita batangiza gahunda gukora gusetsa i kigali agitangura ababyeyi nabo ntibabyumvaga ariko nyuma baje kubyumva baramushyigikira ati umubyeyi yumvise mvuye by’amategeko ngiye gukina gusetsa yahise abona ngiye konona amafaranga y’ ishuri yantangiye akomeza agira ku mubyeyi kugira umuntu atere imbere akora akazi k’abantu bakomeye kazi abantu benshi bazi ako kazi gashya ntibashoboye kugasobanukirwa ariko nagerageje kubibumvishamichael asaba abandi babyeyi gushyigikira abandi bana bashobora kuba bafite icyerekezo bashaka kujyanamo ubuzima bwabo gihe atari ikintu kimwicira ubuzima cyangwa gituma amera nabi

content: mu matora yabaye mwaka abakandida nibo bashakwagamo babiri bagombaga guhagararira urubyiruko manda y’imyaka itanu izageza kamanzi ernest yabonye amajwi maniriho clarisse abona amajwi kamanzi title: patient bizimana wasezeranye n’umukunzi ibanga aritegura kurushinga
content: muri gitaramo cyabereye parking stade amahoro munyaribanje yemereye bizimana inka ariko anamusaba gushinga urugo bitarenze yagize ndashimira patient n’abo bafatanyije badushimishije umwaka ushize gitaramo cyawe cyabereye kigali convention centre mata naguhaye inka konsa ngiye kuguha indi ariko ndashaka uyibyaza umusaruro tuzajya tuza tuvuga tugiye rugo patient’’ kuva gihe patient bizimana wakunze kugira ibintu bye ubwiru cyane bijyanye n’urushako ntiyigeze agaragaza gahunda gushyira bikorwa ubusabe se uwamubazaga ngingo igisubizo yatangaga kimwe ngomba kubahiriza yansabye turabyizera bizaba amakuru yizewe avuga muhanzi rukundo gentille karamira uwera ndetse bitegura kurushinga mu minsi yashize havuzwe amakuru ngendo z’uyu muhanzi i burayi yakoreye ibitaramo yabaga agiye gusura umukunzi amakuru afitiwe gihamya umukobwa ukundana patient bizimana atuye leta tennessee amerika igihe yamenye patient bizimana yamaze gusezerana uwera ndetse umuryango wafashe irembo patient bizimana umugabo byemewe n’amategeko kuko yasezeranye uwera kamena karere rubavu ni umuhango wabaye bwiru bukomeye uhezwamo itangazamakuru buryo kubona ifoto byagoranye nta tariki y’igihe patient bizimana azakorera ubukwe ariko amakuru ava bantu ashyira kuba bushobora kuba mpera coronavirus nitanga agahenge twagerageje kuvugana patient ariko ntiyafataga telefoni ndetse n’ubutumwa bugufi twamwandikiye ntacyo yabusubijeho patient bizimana yavuzwe nkuru z’urukundo bamwe bakobwa barimo n’abo basengana uwa vuba baciye amarenga gukundana deborah uwamahoro masasu warushinze akaba umukobwa aptre yoshua ndagijimana masasu uyobora itorero restoration church isi uwamahoro yaje nyuma y’andi makuru yavugaga patient bizimana yagiranye ibihe byiza rukundo ruhishe gaby kamanzi ariko yatangaje amufata nk’umuvandimwe yubaha basangiye itorero ndetse n’umuhamagaro murimo w’imana uyu muhanzi kandi yanavuzwe rukundo miss rwanda kundwa doriane avuga batagiranye ubucuti bwimbitse patient bizimana umuramyi umaze gushinga imizi ndirimbo kuramya guhimbaza imana umuziki yawutangiye akiri muto akiyumvamo impano yatangiye kwihatira kwiga gucuranga piano rusengero hanyuma bigeze asohora indirimbo bwite yitwa andyohera’ nabwo benshi batangiye kumubwira afite ijwi ryiza yakunzwe bidasanzwe ndirimbo ze iyo neza’ amagambo yanjye’ menye neza’ ikimenyetso’ ubwo buntu ndaje’ n’izindi nyinshi azwiho gutegura ibitaramo ngarukamwaka easter celebration’ byitabirwa rwego hejuru n’ibihumbi by’abakunda umuziki yabiteguye ahereye yitaga poetic evening of worship’ nyuma bibyara easter celebration iba buri mwaka kwizihiza pasika yihariye kuba ariwe muhanzi rukumbi wateguye ibitaramo byinshi rwanda ahereye igitaramo mbere cyabereye sports view hotel remera kibera serena hotel mu nibwo hatangiye ibitaramo ngarukamwaka easter celebration kwizihiza pasika icyabimburiye ibindi cyabereye serena hotel mu cyabereye ihema expo ground gitumirwamo umunyafurika y’epfo pastor solly mahlangu watuye amagambo y’ubutsinzi patient bizimana yafatanyije n’abaramyi barimo aptre habonimana w’i burundi n’umunya-kenya marion shako gitaramo cyabereye kcc umwaka wakurikiyeho yatumiye umunya-nigeria w’icyamamare osinachi joseph sinach wataramiye parking stade amahoro imvura ijojoba mu mwaka ushize patient bizimana yatumiye alka mbumba rdc n’itsinda redemption voice ry’i burundi gitaramo cyahembuyemo imitima benshi

title: minisiteri y’urubyiruko yatangije amarushanwa mishinga y’ikoranabuhanga
content: minisiteri y’urubyiruko n’ikoranabuhanga yatangije amarushanwa agamije kugaragaza imishinga y’ikoranabuhanga yerekeye ubuzima ndetse n’ibidukikije rwego guhindura ubuzima bw’urubyiruko ikoranabuhangaubuzima ndetse n’ibidukikije iki gikorwa cyabereye kaminuza y’u rwanda ishami gikondo cbe riherereye mujyi kigali gicurasi bufatanye minisiteri ifite nshingano urubyiruko n’ikoranabuhanga nkunga unicef iyi gahunda izwi izina pich night igamije gushishikariza urubyiruko ruri munsi y’imyaka kugaragaza ibitekerezo by’imishinga irebana n’ibidukikishe ubuzima ndetse n’ikoranabuhanga ibinyujije marushanywa ahuriza hamwe imishinga itandukanye imurikwa uwaye uwambere ugahembwa muri gikorwa irere claudette umunyamabanga minisiteri w’urubyiruko n’ikorabuhanga ufite ikoranabuhanga nshingano n’umushyitsi mukuru yavuze minisiteri yiteguye gufasha gushyigikira urubyiruko rufite ibitekerezo by’imishinga yabateza imbere irere claudette yagize urubyiruko gishoro rubinyujije bitekerezo rufite twe minisiteri y’urubyiruko n’ikoranabuhanga twiteguye gushyigikira gufasha urubyiruko rufite imishinga yaruteza imbere ndetse igateza imbere igihugu rusange cyane cyane ikoranabuhanga uyu munyamabanga minisiteri y’urubyiruko n’ikoranabuhanga kandi yashimiye abafatanyabikorwa b’iki gikorwa bateguye ikigikorwa bakanagishyira bikorwa ndetse abizeza bazakomeza gufatanya guteza imbere gikorwa aha yagize ndashimira cyane abafatanyabikorwa batekereje gikorwa gutegura marushanywa afasha urubyiruko rw’u rwanda kwishakamo ibisubizo by’ imishinga yabateza imbere ndetse n’igihugu rusange binyuze ikoranabuhanga ubuzima ndetse n’ibidukikije natwe minisiteri y’urubyiruko n’ikoranabuhanga dushyigikiye gikorwa kandi turacyishimiye mu mishanga itanu yerekanywe gikorwa uwitwa my green home wakozwe n’abanyeshuri babiri kepler university niwo wegukanye igihembo mbere pich night ukaba warakozwe muhoza losette ndetse mugenziwe kinzuzi davide uyu mushinga ugamije kubyaza umusaruro imyanda ijugunwa hirya hino mujyi ikazajya ikorwamo ibindi bintu bikenerwank’uko muhoza yabisobanuye iri stinda ryabaye irya mbere ryahawe akayabo k’amadorale ndetse bahabwa telefone ndetse mudasobwa kwifashisha gushyira bikorwa mushinga yanditswe ukurikiyimfura leoncemuhaburarw

title: akarere rubavu karishimira ibikorwa by’amajyambere kagezeho
content: mu bikorwa byamuritswe harimo umuhanda uhuza imipaka yombi y’u rwanda repubulika iharanira demokarasi kongo grande et petite barierre ukazatwara akayabo k’amafaranga akabakaba miliyoni ndetse n’ umuhanda pave ujya biro by’akarere watangiye gukorwa munsi umuyobozi w’akarere sheh bahame hassan yavuze akarere kabwiye rwiyemezamirimo imodoka zikora mihanda zitazasubirayo utugari tutazikoresheje dusane uduhanda tujya hasuwe kandi umusozi wimuweho imiryango kubera ikibazo cy’isuri yicaga abahatuye gihe cy’imvura uyu musozi murenge gisenyi guterwamo ibiti binyuranye bifata ubutaka hakazubakwamo uduhanda intebe n’ibitare kuruhukiramo mukerarugendo iki gikorwa kizatwara amafaranga miliyoni bavuye musozi ubuyobozi b’akarere rubavu bwasuye akagari karukogo umurenge rubavu birebera ibikorwa ndengera foundation uyu muryango wubatse amasoko y’amazi agemurira abaturage amazi meza ndetse n’ibitaro kijyambere umuyobozi w’akarere yasabye umuyobozi ndengera foundation gufatanya n’akarere bakareba masoko y’amazi yakwaguka abaturage benshi bakavomaho abayobozi banagejejwe ahari kubakwa amashanyarazi ako kagali jean berchmas bahige ukuriye ewsa rubavu yasobanuye yagize mushinga wizwe neza ibikoresho byose birahari igikorwa cyose gikoreshwa n’amashanyarazi kizahakora kirahari mpungenge hasuwe n’isoko ryo ako kagali ariko rizatangira gukorerwamo mutarama nyuma byagaragaye akarere rubavu kari kwihutisha ibikorwa remezo bijyanye n’icyerekezo ariko cyane cyane hubakwa imihanda ariko inzira ikiri ndende akarere karateganya kuganira n’abafite amazu mujyi rwego title: umuganda inyunganizi ngengo y’imari y’igihugu
content: kimwe n’indi myaka yashize mwaka - wakozwemo ibikorwa binyuranye by’umuganda gihugu hose birimo guhanga imihanda y’imigenderano gutinda amateme kubaka amazu y’abatishoboye kubaka amashuli y’uburezi bw’ibanze bw’imyaka ybe kubaka ubwiherero kubaka ibigega guhunikamo imyaka gucukura imyobo guteramo ibiti gutera ibiti kubaka ibiro by’utugari gucukura ibyobo bifata amazi n’ibindi ibikorwa byose byakozwe bikaba byarahawe agaciro kangana y’amafaranga y’u rwanda nk’uko bigaragara rapport yashyizwe ahagaragara minaloc italiki mbere nzeli n’ubwo ibikorwa byakozwe bifite agaciro kanini gihugu hose ariko ntibyabujije hakorwa ibarura rigamije kumenya ubwitabire buri ntara muri raporo baragaragaza umujyi kigali hamwe n’intara y’uburengerazuba ziri mwanya nyuma n’ubwitabire bungana akaba nazo zifite ubwitabire buri hasi ugereranyije n’izindi ntara gihe intara y’amajyaruguru mwanya mbere n’ubwitabire igakurikirwa n’intara y’amajyepfo ifite intara y’uburasirazuba ikaza mwanya gatatu n’ubwitabire bungana aha intara zititwaye neza zikaba zisabwa kwikubita agashyi nyuma kumenya ubwitabire buhagaze gihugu hose barebye intara yakoze ibikorwa bifite agaciro kanini intara y’iburasirazuba iza isonga n’ibikorwa bifite agaciro kangana z’amafaranga y’u rwanda gihe umujyi kigali uza mwanya nyuma n’ibikorwa bifite agaciro kangana z’amanyarwanda aha kugira agaciro k’ibikorwa by’umuganda karusheho kuzamuka abakoze raporo berekanye hari ibintu by’ingenzi bitatu bigomba kwitabwaho ubwitabire bw’abaturage umurava buri wese witabiriye igenamigambi rinoze kandi risesengura neza ibikorwa by’ingenzi bifitiye abaturage n’igihugu rusange akamaro si gusa ariko byakozwe kuko mpera z’ukwezi werurwe minisiteri y’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu yatangije amarushanwa y’ibikorwa by’umuganda nshuro kabiri akaba yarashyiriweho kugirango atere imbaraga n’ubushake abaturage barusheho gukunda kwitabira ibikorwa by’umuganda benshi binyuze muco guhiga guhanga udushya umurenge kavumu karere ngororero intara y’uburengerazuba akaba waje mwanya mbere rwego rw’igihugu ubikesha urugomero rw’amashanyarazi rwubatswe n’abaturage bakabasha kwivana icuraburindi ku mwanya kabiri haje umurenge musange karere nyamagabeintara y’amajyepfo wahinze inanasi buso bungana ha bikazabafasha kwikura bukene ku mwanya gatatu hari umurenge manyagiro karere gicumbi intara y’amajyaruguru abaturage bawutuyemo bubatse amazu y’abahejwe inyuma n’amateka rwego kubafasha kwiteza imbere batura heza uretse ibikorwa byakozwe muganda rusange kandi raporo irerekana ibindi byakozwe n’ingabo polisi cyumweru army week police week n’ibindi byakozwe n’abanyarwanda banyuranye nzego zitandukanye hari kandi n’ibyakorewe mahanga babaga butumwa rwego kumenyekanisha umuco mwiza igihugu cyacu gifite aha twavuga ingabo z’u rwanda butumwa bw’amahoro bw’umuryango w’abibumbye majyaruguru darfur ahitwa el-fasher batangizaga umuganda buri kwezi bafatanyije n’ingabo z’ibindi bihugu ziri butumwa nyuma y’umuganda hagendaga habaho ibiganiro bitandukanye bigamije gukangurira abaturage kwitabira gahunda leta hamwe kugira uruhare bikorwa bibakorerwa batanga umusanzu wabo rwego kwiyubakira igihugu cyane cyagerwaho batabigizemo uruhare anne niwemwiza

content: afungura imurikagurisha minisitiri w’ubucuruzi n’inganda francois kanimba yashimiye urugaga rw’abikorera ntara y’amajyaruguru n’ubuyobozi bw’uturere bwabigizemo uruhare kugira ishobore gutangira yavuze imurika gurisha rigaragaza abanyarwanda bageze iterambere kuko rituma abantu bashobora kungurana ibitekerezo rikaba n’ishuri benshi baboneramo batari bazi bagashobora kwiga kubikora abitabiriye imurikagurisha bavuga bishimiye umwanya bahawe kugaragaza bakora ndetse bagashobora kubona ibyahandi bashobora kwigiraho bakora ibintu byiza kanimba yasobanuye leta gushyira ingufu kongerera ubushobozi ibigo bito n’ibiciriritse hihutishwa serivise bacyenera ikoranabuhanga kubafasha gushaka isoko ry’umusaruro bakora abaturage hamwe n’abikorera ntara y’amajyaruguru baratangaza aribwo bagira imurikagurisha ryitabirwa n’abanyamahanga bavuye bihugu muryango w’afurika y’iburasirasuba eac n’abashoramari bihugu asiya repubulika iharanira demokarasi kongo abanyarwanda bakaba bagomba guhangana n’isoko rinini u rwanda rwagiye ry’umuryango w’ibihugu by’iburasirazuba eac yves hirwa akora top sai ikora ibijyanye n’ubugeni yvuze ibikorwa byabo byatunguye benshi kuko ababasura hari batari bazi yemeza kuba ibikorwa byabo bimenywa n’abantu benshi bizongera umubare w’ababagurira ubuyobozi bw’uturere bwitabiriye imurika gurisha bukaba buvuga bwasanze umwanya kumenyekanisha ibikorerwa turere iri murikagurisha riteganyijwe gusoza taliki ugushyingo cyakora hari imbogamizi imvura nyinshi ikunze kugwa ntara y’amajyaruguru ishobora kuzangiza ibicuruzwa n’ibimurikwa nkuko byagenze cyumweru yagwaga nyuma gufungura imurika gurisha sylidio sebuharara

title: cristiano ronaldo yegukanye ballon d’or kane
content: france football bufaransa yamaze gutangaza rutahizamu real madrid n’ikipe y’igihugu portugal cristiano ronaldo ariwe wegukanye umupira zahabu w’uyu mwaka nk’uko byari byitezwe benshi cristiano wafashije real madrid kwegukana champions league nshuro akanahesha igihugu cye igikombe cy’u burayi euro mbere mateka yegukanye igihembo cy’umukinnyi mwiza isi ahigitse lionel messi bahora bahanganye ndetse n’umufaransa antoine griezmann wageze mikino nyuma y’ibi bikombe ronaldo yatwaye ariko akahatsindirwa cristiano w’imyaka amaze kwegukana ballon d’or enye lionel messi wamuguye ntege mwaka afite eshanu bombi bihariye gihembo kuko umunya-brazil kaka yacyegukana wundi mukinnyi urabasha kugikura hagati y’aba basore babiri bafatwa nk’abami ruhago kinyejana ni nshuro mbere ikinyamakuru france football gitanze gihembo kidafatanyije fifa basinyanaga amasezerano y’ubufatanye yarangiranye n’umwaka ushize ntiyongerwa fifa nayo igomba kuzatangaza umukinnyi wayo w’umwaka mutarama igihembo nacyo gishobora kwegukanwa cristiano ronaldo wagize umwaka mwiza w’imikino yatwaraga ibikombe bibiri bikomeye mugabane w’u burayi incamake y’amateka ballon d’or ballon d’or yatanzwe mbere yegukanwa sir stanley matthews wakiniraga blackpool atsinze umunyabigwi real madrid alfredo di stefano wabicaga bigacika gihe igitangira gutangwa abakinnyi bakomoka mugabane w’u burayi babaga bemerewe guhanganira gihembo ugitwara agatorwa hifashishijwe abanyamakuru b’imikino mu nibwo imiryango yafunguwe bakinnyi bakomoka yindi migabane bemererwa kuba bahatanira ballon d’or nabwo umunya-liberia george weah wabicaga bigacika ac millan yahise ayegukana ahigitse umudage jrgen klinsmann akaba mukinnyi rukumbi afurika ufite gihembo kuva france football yahise yifatanya fifa gutanga gihembo umukinnyi ucyegukana agatorwa n’abanyamakuru b’imikino abatoza b’amakipe y’ibihugu n’aba kapiteni bayo amateka y’umukinnyi mwiza w’umwaka fifa fifa world player of the year iki gihembo cyatangiye gutangwa nshuro mbere cyegukanwa n’umudage lothar matthus wakiniraga inter de millan butaliyani fc barcelona niyo yagize abakinnyi benshi begukanye gihembo barimo romrio ronaldo rivaldo ronaldinho lionel messi nabwo cyaherukaga gutangwa abakinnyi real madrid bacyegukanye inshuro enye kimwe juventus inter de millan kimwe ac millan bacyegukanye gatatu gihe manchester united psv eindhoven paris saint-germain zagize umukinnyi umwe wacyegukanye muhaburarw

title: ibikorwa ntampaka leta habyarimana itegurwa jenoside yakorewe abatutsi

title: sobanukirwa neza itandukaniro operating system’ zikoreshwa mudasobwa
content: mu ntangiriro z’ikinyejana umwongereza charles babbage wakoze mudasobwa mbere ifatwa nk’iyahereweho hahimbwa izindi zirimo n’izo dukoresha bishingiye nyota kongera ubushobozi mudasobwa
