ntizitange n’umusaruro ujyanye n’ubumenyi bwari bugezweho gihe uramutse ukoresha mudasobwa kazi kawe cyangwa buryo busanzwe birashoboka waba warumvise ijambo operating system’ rimwe cyangwa inshuro iterambere ry’ikoranabuhanga ryazanye n’ubucuruzi bujyanye ryo abakora porogaramu mudasobwa softwares bakoze operating system’ nke ugereranyije n’ubwinshi bw’izindi porogaramu zikora ibintu bimwe ndetse kuba iboneka kiguzi windows mudasobwa nyinshi kurusha izindi zose isi bituma izwi n’abantu benshi cyane ikoreshwa mudasobwa z’amoko atandukanye usibye apple ndetse ikagira ubushobozi gukorana nyabagendwa benshi rubyiruko bahuye n’ubukene ubushomeri buriyongera ubwo rukundo landry umunyamakuru wigenga ubarizwa itsinda yaga bloggeur yatemebereraga komini bugabira yasanze urubyiruko rwicaye gasanteri rwikinira amakarita abandi biganirira iby’imipira can bugabira komini y’intara kirundo ihana umupaka n’akarere bugesera rwanda abaturage bayo bamenyereye kugenda rwanda baje gucuruza kwiga byombi akaba bifuza muyobozi uzasimbura petero nkurunziza matora y’uyu mwaka umwe urangije amashuri yisumbuye asanga ubushomeri bubugarije buterwa kuba bucuruzi bwambukiranya imipaka bugishoboka hagati y’u burundi n’u rwanda agira mbere tukibanye neza n’u rwanda umuntu yashoboraga kunyarukira hajya ajanye ibiribwa akazana amahera akarorero ngaha anye ikilo c’imyumbati yumye kiragura amarundi title: akarere rubavu karishimira ibikorwa by’amajyambere kagezeho
content: mu bikorwa byamuritswe harimo umuhanda uhuza imipaka yombi y’u rwanda repubulika iharanira demokarasi kongo grande et petite barierre ukazatwara akayabo k’amafaranga akabakaba miliyoni ndetse n’ umuhanda pave ujya biro by’akarere watangiye gukorwa munsi umuyobozi w’akarere sheh bahame hassan yavuze akarere kabwiye rwiyemezamirimo imodoka zikora mihanda zitazasubirayo utugari tutazikoresheje dusane uduhanda tujya hasuwe kandi umusozi wimuweho imiryango kubera ikibazo cy’isuri yicaga abahatuye gihe cy’imvura uyu musozi murenge gisenyi guterwamo ibiti binyuranye bifata ubutaka hakazubakwamo uduhanda intebe n’ibitare kuruhukiramo mukerarugendo iki gikorwa kizatwara amafaranga miliyoni bavuye musozi ubuyobozi b’akarere rubavu bwasuye akagari karukogo umurenge rubavu birebera ibikorwa ndengera foundation uyu muryango wubatse amasoko y’amazi agemurira abaturage amazi meza ndetse n’ibitaro kijyambere umuyobozi w’akarere yasabye umuyobozi ndengera foundation gufatanya n’akarere bakareba masoko y’amazi yakwaguka abaturage benshi bakavomaho abayobozi banagejejwe ahari kubakwa amashanyarazi ako kagali jean berchmas bahige ukuriye ewsa rubavu yasobanuye mashanyarazi azagera baturage tugali twa byahi kanembwe karukogo ibarizwa mirenge rubavu cyanzarwe bahige yashimangiye mashanyarazi afite ingufu zihagije zizafasha abaturage kwivana bukene bahige yagize mushinga wizwe neza ibikoresho byose birahari igikorwa cyose gikoreshwa n’amashanyarazi kizahakora kirahari mpungenge hasuwe n’isoko ryo ako kagali ariko rizatangira gukorerwamo mutarama nyuma y’ubunani uru rugendo rwasorejwe isoko kijyambere ry’akarere rubavu riri kubakwa mujyi rwagati murenge gisenyi imirimo kubaka soko iracyari hasi ariko irimo kwihutishwa kugira rizatangire gukoreshwa aho riri isoko risanzwe rikorera hazazamurwa irindi gorofa hanubakwe imodoka zihagarara asoza gikorwa umuyobozi w’akarere rubavu sheh bahame hassan yibukije inshingano buri wese kurinda gukoresha neza ibikorwa remezo gihe bizaba byuzuye bahame yagize ibikorwa nk’ibi iby’umuturage turifuza buri wese agira uruhare kubibungabunga kubikoresha kuko uburenganzira bweumwe baturage utuye kagari karukogo seth mugema asanga amajyambere kwihuta abagana buryo yiteguye gutangiza umushinga iwabo cyaro nogosha imisatsi mujyi none kubera batuzaniye amashanyarazi ngiye kwimurira salon yanjye karukogo nk’uko byagaragaye akarere rubavu kari kwihutisha ibikorwa remezo bijyanye n’icyerekezo ariko cyane cyane hubakwa imihanda ariko inzira ikiri ndende akarere karateganya kuganira n’abafite amazu mujyi rwego kubafasha kwihutisha bikorwa bakihutisha iterambere aka karere pascaline umulisa

title: ngo u rwanda rutoza abasirikare bazatera u burundi iyi kinamico irasekeje
content: umwe bakunzi b’ikinyamakuru ukwezicom witwa gatera yatwandikiye inyandiko igaragaza igitekerezo cye ndetse n’uko afata inkuru raporo zishinja u rwanda gutoza abasirikare bagamije gutera u burundi bagahirika ubutegetsi perezida pierre nkurunziza ku bwe asanga ikinamico isekeje ndetse buri wese asesenguye akaba yabyibonera iyi nyandiko iragira iti sindi umunyapolitiki ariko kandi nkurikiranira ibijyanye n’imiyoborere y’ibihugu karere u rwanda ruherereyemo iyo nsomye inkuru zivuga raporo z’umuryango w’abibumbye zishinja u rwanda gutoza abarundi bifuza kujya gutera igihugu cyabo bahirike pierre nkurunziza mbona ikinamico isekeje kurusha izindi numvise mbere zose ikinamico idafite yigisha usesengura ugasanga ibabaje kandi igamije guteranya abarundi n’abanyarwanda munyumve neza njyewe ndi umunyarwanda ariko sinakwemera gushyigikira amakosa y’igihugu cyanjye ndamutse mbona ahari kuko nzi n’urubyiruko hambere kuba rwarashyigikiye amakosa y’abayobozi bariho gihe byatumye jenoside iba ndamutse mbona ubuyobozi bw’u rwanda burimo kwatsa umuriro sinabishyigikira kuko naba nzi nanjye umuriro ushobora kuzanyotsa ibyo mvuga sinshingira mwuka mubi hagati y’ibihugu byombi si marangamutima cyangwa ikindi ahubwo njyewe nshingiraho ibimenyetso bigaragazwa raporo z’umuryango w’abibumbye bavuga twagenderaho twemeza u rwanda rutoza abarwanyi bashaka kuzatera u burundi munyemerere namwe mutekereze ngiye kubabwira murasanga rwose harimo kwigiza nkana ikimenyetso simusiga raporo zishingiraho ukuba hari abarwanyi b’abarundi mpuguke z’umuryango w’abibumbye zivuga zasanze repubulika iharanira demokarasi kongo bakitangira ubuhamya baherewe imyitozo rwanda kandi batojwe n’abasirikare bakuru b’u rwanda reka tuhatekerezeho kandi dushyire gaciro dufatanyije gusesengura nk’abantu bafite ubwenge wenda n’iyo twaba tutazi ibya politiki abo bantu babajijwe n’ubwo ntakwemeza bahari inshuti z’u rwanda zatewe inkunga leta y’u rwanda kandi zigiterwa inkunga zizasohoze umugambi wazo niba ukuri se ibicucu bingana kuburyo batangaza ibanga ry’uko hari urimo kubashyigikira baba se ibigoryi bitagira ubwenge kihe kigero kuburyo bakwemera kuvuga imbaraga bazifashisha batera u burundi zishingiye ubwose bumva bazakomeza kubona inkunga z’u rwanda kandi bamena ibanga ry’akazi ubwo koko si ikinamico niba rundi ruhande tuvuge bantu atari inshuti z’u rwanda kandi bakaba batarukunda rwose sinza kuhatinda nyine wanga umugerekaho icyamuhesha isura mbi cyose nk’uko gihugu isi kitabura abatavuga rumwe n’ubutegetsi bwacyo kandi utavuga rumwe n’ubutegetsi wese usanga abuvuga nabi icyiza cyose bukora agashaka isura mbi abiganishamo urwanya ntibishoboka wamugaragaza neza waba utsinzwe ese ubundi ababajijwe kuki bataba abanyarwanda basanzwe mashyamba repubulika iharanira demokarasi kongo kuki bataba interahamwe fdlr zirwanya ubutegetsi buriho leta y’u rwanda kandi byumvikana icyavuga nabi u rwanda cyose bagisamira hejuru izo mpuguke zakoze raporo zabanje gusaba ibihe byangombwa zemere zabajije abarundi koko ko hari n’abarundi bavugwaho gufatanya fdlr kurwanya ubutegetsi bw’u rwanda cyatwemeza batabeshya aha muhatekereze murasanga abavugwa babajijwe ubwabo ikimenyetso raporo ikinamico zisekeje kandi zidashingiye bimenyetso bifatika abanyarwanda n’abarundi turi abavandimwe kandi ibibazo by’imiyoborere burundi tutabyitondeye twazisanga tumeze kumwe koreya ruguru n’iy’epfo bitajya bicana uwaka ugasanga tugendeye raporo duhise twangana nk’abaturage kandi ibivugwa uguharabikana gushingiye nyungu politiki y’abari butegetsi burundi ikitonderwa iyi nyandiko yanjye ibitekerezo byanjye gatera ariko buri wese ashobora kugira igitekerezo ayitangaho tukungurana ibitekerezo bigamije kubaka amahoro n’ubumwe bw’abanyarwanda n’abarundi

content: abakinnyi cross country bagiye guhagararira u rwanda afurika y’epfo kajuga robert sec nzabonimpa evariste apr nizeyimana alexis kamonyi sebahire eric apr uwajeneza jmv nas rutayisire godefrey apr abandi bakinnyi berekeje i roma isiganwa ryise marathon international de rome ninyirabarame epiphanie mvuyekure jean pierre ntirenganya felix twahirwa fred aba bakinnyi bagiye marathon y’i roma bazasiganwa banashaka itike minima izabahesha kujya mikino olympique izabera i londres nyakanga mwaka nubwo bakinnyi boherejwe bihugu kugeza ntibizeye bazakirwa neza kuko rwanda hakiri ikibazo cy’amacakubiri arangwa ishyirahamwe ry’uwo mukino rwanda fra abo bakinnyi bagiye boherejwe komite iyoborwa lieutenant alexandre kayitsinga wemerwa minisiteri siporo n’umuco ndetse komite olympique gihe itemerwa n’ishyirahamwe ry’imikino ngororamubiri isi iaaf kandi ryo ryateguye mikino iaaf ivuga kugeza yemera ubuyobozi rurangirwa louis ufite ibiro bureau bye ruhande ndetse ahamya yandikirana umunsi munsi iaaf avuga minisiteri sport nikomeza kumwambura ubuyobozi ishyirahamwe ry’umukino ngororamubiri rizafatirwa ibihano theoneste nisingizwe

title: dore abagore bafite ibyago byinshi byo kurwara ibibyimba cyangwa kanseri zo mu nzira z’imyororokere
content: dore abagore bafite ibyago byinshi byo kurwara ibibyimba cyangwa kanseri zo mu nzira z’imyororokere kuruyu munsi ibyo twerekezaho urwungano rw’imyororokere ariko gitsina goreaho turibanda ndwara z’ ibibyimba bikunze kwibasira nzirambere byose tugire tunibutsa izo nzira zose zigomba kuba nzima kugirango uru rwungano ruzakore akazi karwo neza nkuko bigombakandi igihe cyose hagize imbogamizi ziboneka nzira zose bishobora kuba imbogamizi kugubwa nabi gitsina gore ashobora kugira gahunda mbi mihango ashobora guhora akuramo inda kwiyadukizamo kw’ibibyimba guhora aguwe nabi aribwa nda kuko dushaka gutinda bibyimba kuzirikana ibibyimba bishobora gufata ariho hose nziraikibyimba gishobora kuba kanseri cyangwa kikaba atariyoakenshi kanseri iba irangwa nuburyane ndetse cyaneee ikaba yanakwirakwira bindi bice by’umubiriariko ikibyimba kitari kanseri kiba kiri hamwe gikura gahoro ariko ntacyo si cyizamuzumva kanseri y’imirerantanga iyanyababyeyi iyinkondo y’umura n’izindi byose kandi nako biteye ubwoba abantu ibibyimba bitari kanseri bizwi cyane bikunze kwibasira nyababyeyi uterus muzindi ndimi byitwa fibroids myomes ibyo bishobora kubuza umudamu kubyara guhora akuramo inda n’izindi ngorane zitandukanye kaanseri izwi cyane nkondo y’umura ubushakashatsi bugaragaza ko nibura buri minota ibiri hapfa uumudamu azize kanseri y’umura cervical cancer mu rwanda kanseri kugira amazi mpyiko hydronephrosis impyiko zikora nabi n’ibindi byinshi tuzabigarukaho nkuru zacu zitaha

title: abakoresha ururimi rw’ikirera bafite impungenge rushobora gucika
content: nk’uko byemezwa bamwe baturage batuye turere dukoresha urwo rurimi rw’ikirera musanze burera bicaye hamwe baganira uru rurimi bumva bisanzuye cyane bagasabana nyirakagori thacienne umukecuru w’imyaka y’amavuko utuye karere musanze avuga ururimi bavuga rurimo ikinyarwanda cyiza n’ubwo hari abacyumva baruvuga bakabaseka yagize iyo tugeze ahantu hatari iwacu nko yindi ntara uragambagauravuga bagahita bamenya uturuka hari n’ibyo tugamba ukabona badufashe nk’abanyamahanga nk’ubu umusore yazanye umugore tubyitaga gusohoza gihe usanga hari abagamba yasezeranye yarongoye n’ibindi akomeza nk’ubu bita gukubura twe tubyitaga gukondora umubyeyi yabyaye abazwe twe tuvuga yashyizwe ndiga kuko abandi bitaga icyuma tukita indiga iyo turi hamwe dukoresha ikirera cyacu tuba twisanzuye kandi twumva ikinyarwanda cy’umwimerere munyazikwiye rabani yagize ubu nganiriye n’umuntu nkumva ururimi agambaavuga mpita menya akomoka nkamenya akomoka nduga gisenyi n’ahandi dukunze kugamba twongeraho ga ndabiryaga amazi garabuze guhamagara umuntu tugamba kwakura umuntu n’ibindi ubundi ikinyarwanda cyumvikana n’ubwo bavuga guhurira rurimi rwabo gakondo rw’ikirera bituma bumva bisanzuye haracyari bimwe bimenyetso bibagaragariza rushobora kuzacika burundu birimo kuba abana babakomokaho basigaye bagira ipfunwe ryo kurukoresha biga mashuri bitewe n’uko hari bagenzi babaseka ibi bituma babasetse bagerageza kugorora imvugo y’abo bigana bagenzi bigatuma noneho barwica kurushaho ikindi kuba haragiye haza gutura abantu baturutse zindi ntara nabyo kimwe byatumye ururimi rwabo rukendera bikaba bibateye impungenge ururimi rwabo rushobora gusigara bakuze gusa rubyiruko rukibagirana kandi ariho bakagombye kurubungabungira ibi kandi babihuza kuba ntaho wasanga rwigishwa cyangwa rube rufite rwanditse bitabo ibintu babona kubungabunga ururimi rwabo bitakoroha gato bagasaba rwahabwa agaciro yaba nyandiko kurwigisha mashuri n’ibindi inteko nyarwanda y’ururimi n’umuco ralc iherutse gutangaza indimi shami zishamikiye kinyarwanda nk’ikigoyi ikirera n’izindi zikwiye kwitabwaho kuko umutungo w’igihugu ushobora kugira akamaro rwego gukungahaza ikinyarwanda ralc ivuga ndimi shami nk’ikigega cyajya cyitabazwa kongera andi magambo kinyarwanda kujya kuyatira ndimi z’amahanga inteko nyarwanda y’ururimi n’umuco itangaza ifite ikigega cy’amagambo ibihumbi akoreshwa myuga inyuranye kigenda gikurwamo amagambo ashyirwa nkoranyamagambo

title: umuturage niwe washingiweho hashyirwaho igishushanyo mbonera cy’umujyi-busabizwa parfait
content: umuyobozi w’umujyi kigali wungirije ushinzwe iterambere ry’ubukungu parfait busabizwa yemeza hashingiwe burenganzira bw’umuturage n’icyamuteza imbere ishyirwaho n’ishyirwa bikorwa ry’igishushanyo mbonera cy’umujyi kigali busabizwa parfait yatangaje mahugurwa y’umunsi umwe yagenewe abanyamakuru mbere tariki gicurasi agamije kubahugura ndetse kubasobanurira byimbitse igishushanyo mbonera cy’umujyi kigali myaka - iterambere u rwanda rwihaye muri gishushanyo mbonera cy’umujyi kigali hagaragazwa uburyo myaka buri muturage azaba atujwe buryo bujyanye n’igihe yaregerejwe ibikorwa remezo nk’amazi n’amashanyarazi rwego kugira umujyi urangwa n’isuku n’iterambere rirambye parfait yagize ubusanzwe igishushanyo mbonera cy’umujyi kigali ntago kireba abayobozi cyangwa ikiciro runaka ahubwo kireba umutura rwanda wese by’umwihariko abatuye umujyi kigali niyo mpamvu tujya gushyiraho igishushanyo mbonera twifashishije ibitekerezo by’inzego zitandukanye zivugira umuturage ariko nanone umuturage yagize uruhare ishyirwaho ry’iki gishushanyo mbonera abanyamakuru basobanuriwe kandi uburyo gishushanyo mbonera kizashyirwa bikorwa banerekwa uburyo babwirwa bitazahera magambo bagaragarijwe bimwe bikorwa byari biteganijwe kugerwaho gice mbere cy’iki gishushanyo mbonera nk’imihanda imirimo batuye i kigali n’inkengero ibikorwa remezo n’ibindi ubusanzwe igishushanyo mbonera cy’umujyi kigali cyatangiye mwaka kikaba giteganije kuzarangira mwaka buri turage utuye umujyi kigali nkengero azaba afite amazi amashanyarazi n’ibindi bikorwa remezo aha kandi ikindi nyamukuru imiturire izira akajagari igamije gutuza abaturage benshi buso buke izaba igaragara mujyi kigaliyanditswe akayezu snappymuhaburarw

title: abanyabugeni b’abagore bahawe umwihariko kwizihiza umunsi mpuzamahanga w’ingoro ndangamurage
content: buri mwaka tariki gicurasi isi yizihiza umunsi mpuzamahanga wahariwe ingoro ndangamurage hazirikanwa umuco amateka n’imibereho gakondo by’abatuye isi u rwanda narwo rwifatanya n’amahanga kwizihiza munsi ushimangira agaciro guhererekanya amateka guteza imbere umuco ufatwa nk’umusingi w’imibereho y’igihugu urwa gasabo rubarizwa muryango mpuzamahanga w’ingoro ndangamurage icom uhuriyemo abanyamuryango basaga bakora ngoro ndangamurage bihugu muri mwaka munsi wahawe insanganyamatsiko ivuga kugira ingoro ndangamurage zigamije uburinganire ubudasa kudaheza’’ kuri nshuro gikorwa cyateguwe buryo bwihariye hazifashishwa ikoranabuhanga bitewe n’ingamba zashyizweho guhangana n’ikwirakwira ry’icyorezo covid- ni urwo rwego ingoro ndangamurage bihugu binyamuryango icom zasabwe kucyizihiza hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga ikigo cy’ingoro z’igihugu z’umurage w’u rwanda inmr cyizizihiza birori hafungurwa mugaragaro imurika rishya ngoro y’ubugeni n’ubuhanzi iherereye i kanombe gicurasi iri murika ry’ibihangano by’ubugeni ryahawe insanganyamatsiko ivuga iti ubutumwa bw’abanyabugeni b’abanyarwandakazi uburinganire bose’’ ni insanganyamatsiko yagenwe munsi mpuzamahanga w’abari n’abategarugori yasubitswe kubera ingamba guhangana coronavirus ariko inahurirana n’iyatanzwe icom mwaka iyo urebye byiciro bitandukanye bibarizwamo abari n’abategarugori rwanda usanga baragize uruhare bikorwa by’iterambere ry’ubukungu n’imibereho myiza y’abaturage nyuma jenoside yakorewe abatutsi ariko basigara inyuma bijyanye n’ubugeni bitewe n’impamvu zirimo ubushobozi buke kubura amahugurwa ahagije bijyanye n’ubugeni n’izindi mbogamizi buzima busanzwe ushingiye bihangano bimuritse ngoro y’ubugeni n’ubuhanzi y’i kanombe hari icyuho kinini hagati y’ibihangano by’abagore n’abagabo ibi ntibisobanuye badashoboye bafite impano kuko bake mwuga bakora ibihangano byiza cyane bimwe bifite ubwiza burenze ibya basaza babo’’ imurika rizakorwa nk’uburyo gukora ubukangurambaga n’abategarugori binyuze butumwa bukubiye nsanganyamatsiko y’imurika bihangano byabo byateguwe kandi bizamurikwa bakangurirwa kwigirira icyizere gutinyuka kugaragaza impano bafite by’ubugeni iri murika ryateguwe hagamijwe gufasha abahanzikazi bato kubaharurira inzira kungukira bikorwa byabo gufasha abanyabugeni b’abagore gutegura ibikorwa kumurika ibihangano byabo kwerekana agaciro gushora bushobozi bw’umugore kubafasha kugeza imishinga rwego mpuzamahanga byanafasha abandi kubigiraho rizahuza abanyabugeni b’abari n’abategarugori bihugu bitandatu birimo u rwanda amerika u bufaransa u bubiligi serbia repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo inmr yateguye murika ifatanyije n’ikigo ndangamuco cy’abadage goethe institut-kigali ibyo bigo byombi byafashije abari n’abategarugori b’abanyabugeni kuritegura kubaha amahugurwa n’ubushobozi gukora ibihangano byabo gutunganya imurika riboneye umuhango kwizihiza umunsi mpuzamahanga w’ingoro ndangamurage uzanyuzwa murandasi webex gicurasi saa cyenda abifuza kuwukurikirana baziyandikisha bohereza ubutumwa email protected cyangwa bakandikira ikigo banyuze mbuga nkoranyambaga biteganyijwe umukozi w’ingoro ndangamurage azasobanurira abazakurikira gikorwa ibijyanye n’imurika ababwira ubutumwa bukubiye bihangano bigize imurika nkuko bigenda gihe gusura bisanzwe u rwanda rufite ingoro z’umurage umunani zimuritse umurage n’amateka by’igihugu mibereho y’abagituye imyemerere imyidagaduro imyambarire imiziro n’imiziririzo amateka yacyo nyuma gahunda guma rugo yashyizweho kwirinda ikwirakwira covid- ibikorwa gufungura imiryango basura ingoro ndangamurage byarasubukuwe gicurasi

content: iyi kompanyi iratangaza gihe hari amakuru atangazwa n’ibitangazamakuru bitandukanye isi avuga intambara ibera kongo ishobora kuba yarahungabanyije umutekano rwanda mu itangazo yashyize ntabwo ibibera kongo byigize biteza umutekano muke kandi rwanda akazi karakomeje nk’uko bisanzwe nk’uko ambasade amerika rwanda ibyemeza akomeza avuga hagize igihinduka rwanda thousand hills expeditions yaba iya mbere kubimenyesha abakiriya bayo kuko ntibifuza kuba babazana ahantu hadatekanye thousand hills expeditions iza makompanyi mbere rwanda afata neza mukerarugendo abatembereza ahantu nyaburanga rwanda ibyo byatumye mwaka ikigo cy’igihugu cy’iterambere rdb kiyiha igihembo kubera yabaye indashyikirwa bijyanye guteza imbere ubukerarugendo rwanda parike y’ibirunga iratekanye rdb nayo ibwira mukerarugendo n’abandi bantu bagana u rwanda parike y’ibirunga iherereye majyaruguru y’u rwanda itekanye nubwo kongo igihugu gihana imbibi n’u rwanda hari intambara rica rwigamba ukuriye ishami ryita bukerarugendo rdb avuga ubukerarugendo rwanda bujyana n’amahoro ndetse n’umutekano agira umutakano w’abadusura twawugize intego turamenyesha abasura u rwanda hano umutekano nk’uko title: drc babanza gutanga umusoro fdlr kugirango babashe kugira bakorera butaka bwabo
content: aba baturage bavuga gihe umwe aramutse yanze cyangwa akabura barwanyi fdlr bahita bamufata bunyago aba baturage bakaba bashinja ingabo z’igihugu cyabo zibatererana bikabije kuburyo babona muntu wita mutekano w’abaturage umuturage w’umugore kigero cy’imyaka aravuga yibuka ibyamubayeho mezi abiri ashize yanze kubahiriza amabwiriza atangwa n’abarwanyi fdlr gihe yahingaga umurima uherereye ahitwa i mukongo parike y’igihugu y’ibirunga abana bagerageje kurwana n’umwe barwanyi fdlr babasha kumwambura imbunda afite bayishyikiriza ingabo z’igihugu cyabo fardc agira nyuma y’iminsi mike bibaye umuntu ntazi yaje murima wanjye avuga yoherejwe nyiri mbunda twatwaye kugirango ntavaho mbura ubuzima bwanjye byabaye muha amadorari y’amerika bitaba sinari kuzongera gukandagira ukundi ikinyamakuru syfia grand lacs dukesha nkuru gitangaza barwanyi fdlr aka gace basanzwe batunzwe n’ibikomoka mirima y’abaturage aha buri muhinzi cyangwa wese ufite akora agomba kugira yishyura kugirango abashe kuba yagira akorera butaka bwe tuba dusabwa kugira dutanda twarabimenyereye kuko nibo bayoboye aka gace kose hari badusubiza amafaranga tubagurire bakeneye tutabikoze twaba tudashaka kugaruka bukaba ubuhamya bw’umwe batuye ako gace abasirikare congo n’imiryango yigenga bahora basubiranamo bitana bamwana batumye aka karere kagira umutekano mukemu mnsi ishize ingabo fardc ziherutse gushyira mugaragaro abaturage bagera b’abanyekongo bakorana n’umutwe fdlr gace kiwanjank’uko colonel wilson komanda wungirije ushinzwe ibikorwa gisirikare bita segiteri avuga bafatiye abaturage batari bake gace k’imirwano basanze hari abafashaga umutwe fdlr wilson avuga abenshi baturage bafashwe bunyago n’uyu mutwe kugirango bajye babafasha bikorwa gisikare umuyobozi w’agace kiwanja mahano avuga atapfa guhamya neza abamaze igihe barabibasiye abarwanyi fdlr kuko aka gace hari urubyiruko ruba rushaka gukira byihuse bityo bakaba aribo boherezwa fdlr nyuma bakagabana inyungu mahono agira mezi atatu ashize twanditse abantu batatu bishwe nyuma y’iperereza twaje gusanga bazize baranze kumvira abatumwe n’uwo mutwe bagabane inyungu y’ibyabo fdlr umutwe w’inyeshyamba usigaye ufatwa nk’umutwe w’iterabwoba karere ukaba ugizwe ahanini n’abanyarwanda bahunze mwaka uyu mutwe ukaba ubarizwa mashyamba congo gerard gitoli mbabazi

title: rurangirwa yavuze misifurire rwanda penaliti police fc ivuga yibwe apr fc
content: ngo uhiriye nzu ntaho adapfunda imitwe iyi imvugo abanyarwanda bakoresha umuntu ashobora kwifashisha uvuga magambo y’abatoza batandukanye aha ariko ushobora guhuza ntero n’indi igira iti nduru ivugira ubusa dore hari abasifuzi bigaragara koko bakoze amakosa kazi kabo bakabihanirwa icyumweru turi gusoza cyavuzwemo imisufirire mibi mikino itandukanye irimo uwahuje rayon sports etincelles fc umutoza mushya w’ikipe y’i rubavu yavuze myaka amaze mupira ubwa mbere abonye imisifurire itari myiza abanya-rusizi ntibishimiye kubona espoir fc itsindirwa rugo gicumbi fc bahitamo kwandikira ferwafa bagaragaza bibwe ndetse bashinja abasifuzi gufata ruswa gicumbi fc umukino wahuje apr fc police fc gatatu wavuzweho byinshi nyuma y’uko umusifuzi twagirumukiza abdul karim adatanze penaliti mupira wakozwe n’ukuboko myugariro apr fc buregeya prince nyuma guhindurwa iyabivuze ose police fc yandikiye ferwafa bukeye bwaho isaba abayoboye mukino wayihuje apr fc bahanwa gihe byagaragara banze gutanga penaliti imisifurire rwanda mibi cyangwa amakipe akabya rurangirwa louis umuyobozi rugende wfc ndetse yabaye umusifuzi mpuzamahanga kugeza mu kiganiro yagiranye igihe yavuze umwuga w’ubusifuzi ugoranye bitewe n’igihe gito abawukora bafite mbere gufata ibyemezo yakomeje avuga atari rwanda gusa imisifurire inengwa ariko asanga bigoye bizarangira bitewe n’imiterere y’uyu mwuga ati imisifurire abantu bagomba kumenya umwuga mubi umwuga usaba gushishoza umwuga usaba gufata icyemezo ako kanya rimwe rimwe hari igihe nk’abafana cyangwa abakunzi b’amakipe batabivugaho rumwe n’ibyemezo yagiye afata imisifurire ntiyakunze kuvugwa rumwe haba rwanda afurika isi hose kandi ntibizahinduka kuko ibintu umuntu afata ako kanya kandi akoresheje ubwenge gihe kitarenze amasegonda atatu rurangirwa yakomeje avuga kuba umunsi munsi hari ikoranabuhanga rigenda ryongerwa misifurire ukugira rifashe abasifuzi biba ngombwa umukino uhagarara hagafatwa umwanzuro hifashishijwe amashusho video assistant referee var ati umusifuzi umuntu ashobora kwibeshya n’i burayi bibaho turabibona mashampiyona akomeye bibaho icya kabiri tumenye n’amategeko yagiye ahinduka kuko umupira w’amaguru ugenda utera imbere rurangirwa penaliti police fc ivuga ntabwo yariyo igihe yabajije mugabo avuga ikosa ryashoboraga kuvamo penaliti ikipe police fc yavuze yibwe rurangirwa yavuze ruhande rwe itari penaliti kuko uburyo myugariro apr fc yakozemo umupira atabishakaga buryo ukuboko ariko gukoresha ahagarika umupira ati ibyo bisaba ubushishozi bwinshi cyane cyane ukuboko kutavuye mwanya wako bwanjye numva penaliti yakagombye kubaho simbizi mwarabonye amashusho akaboko birasa gahinnye ntibivuze ukuboko kose kwazamutse ako kanya biba penaliti rurangirwa wabaye umusufizi hagati kibuga asanga umusifuzi twagirumukiza abdul karim ahagaze neza kosa ryabaga yemeje bimwemerera kuba yahagarara cyemezo yafashe ati kuba narabaye umusifuzi hagati biranyorohera guhita mibona ikosa ikosa cyangwa atari ryo sinzi mwarabibonye uriya musifuzi arihuta ukuvuga ikosa ryabaye arireba hari igihe umuntu adasifura ikintu kubera kure na umusifuzi mpuzamahanga erega akoze ikosa baramuhana kandi ugeze rwego guhamagarwa gikombe afurika hari udukosa utakora njye mushimira y’aho byabereye uyu mugabo wigeze kugaragaza ubushake kuyobora ishyirahamwe ry’umupira w’amaguru rwanda ferwafa yatanze ingero z’ahandi hagiye habaho amakosa y’abakinnyi bakina inyuma bakoze imipira rubuga rw’amahina ariko ntihatangwe penaliti ati bikimara kuba nahise mfata telefoni ndareba nsanga bimeze neza nk’ibyabaye mukino manchester city liverpool ejo bundi rwose muze kureba noneho bafite var kandi ntibateye penaliti ese yaba amakipe cyangwa abafana bakabya rurangirwa avuga akenshi igitutu abatoza bariho cyangwa intego amakipe yariyemeje atuma ntaho badapfunda imitwe akavuga yibwe yakomeje avuga umufana w’ikipe ajya kibuga yifuza ikipe itsinda buryo gihe idatsinze bigoye yakwishima cyangwa anyurwe n’ibyabaye mukino yasabye ishyirahamwe ry’umupira w’amaguru rwanda guhugura amakipe rihereye batoza n’abakinnyi kuko umutoza aramutse amenye amategeko y’imisifurire byajya byoroha n’abakunzi b’umukino bakira ibyawuvuyemo ati njyewe inama nagira komisiyo y’imisifurire rwanda bigeze bahugure abantu harageze n’abatoza bahugurwa bakanakora ibizamini bajye makipe bereke abakinnyi amategeko mashya ubundi bizahora akaduruvayo umuntu nahugurwa ntazasagarira umusifuzi namusagarira bizaba gitutu cy’abakinnyi cy’amakipe agiye kumanuka cyangwa ashaka igikombe namwe abanyamakuru kuko mushobora kuvuga mubibona kandi amategeko yarahindutse cyane mu mezi atanu shampiyona y’u rwanda imaze itangiye hamaze guhagarikwa abasifuzi batatu ngabonziza dieudonn yahaniwe kwanga igitego heroes fc yatsinze mukino wayihuje bugesera fc rulisa patience yahaniwe kudatanga penaliti mukino kiyovu sports yanganyijemo gasogi united gihe umutoni aline yahagaritswe kubera kudatanga penaliti mukino gasogi united gicumbi fc

content: mu buzima bw’urukundo biba byiza cyane abakundana badaterwa ipfunwe kuba rukundo ndetse inshuti z’umukobwa zikamenya umuhugu bakundana ndetse n’iz’umuhungu bikaba bityo bikunze kuvugwa ushaka inkuru igera kure ayibwira umugore cyangwa umukobwa kuko abakobwa bazwi nk’abatabika ibanga nk’uko tubikesha urubuga elcrema inyarwandacom yabakusanyirije ukuri bintu by’amabanga umukobwa akwiye kubika rukundo ndetse n’inshuti magara ntabe yayibwira mabanga mukunzi ibijyanye n’imibonano mpuzabitsina mukobwa ntuzigere rimwe ubwira inshuti zawe ibijyanye n’imibonano mpuzabitsina wagiranye n’umugabo wawe abikora cyangwa biba bimeze si byiza ndetse bishobora kugukururira ibibazo rukundo rwanyu kuko ubwiye nshuti zawe umukunzi wawe gukora imibonano abikora neza cyane bashobora guharanira kumugeraho bamenye bimeze unababwiye abikora nabi bashobora gutangira kumusebya tuza menya kuganira n’ibyo kwibikira ibanga utigiriye wuzarikubikira amakosa utazigera uganira n’inshuti zawe uzibwire amakosa y’umukunzi wawe n’ubwo yaba ay’ahashize kuko sintekereza mukunzi wawe yabyishimira abyumvise ahandi niba ushaka kubahisha umukunzi wawe ugashaka yubahwa n’inshuti zawe uzamwubahe wowe ubwawe unamwubahishe bandi umubikira ibanga wirinda kuvuga amakosa utazahabwa urw’amenyo dore bavuga amafuti y’umugabo buryo bwe’ ubukene bwe abagore benshi n’abakobwa bakunze gusangiza bagenzi makuru bakavuga mitungo y’abakunzi ibintu bitari byiza gato kuko bituma umukunzi wawe agawa bikomeye n’inshuti zawe zigahora zimusuzugura kandi zimufata nk’udashoboye ntizibe zanatinya kuvuga atagukwiye nyamara wowe uba uzi impamvu wamuhisemo bandi ukamukunda cyane urukundo atari amafaranga mwayashakana kandi mugakundana rugakomeraimyitwarire idahwitse bamwe nshuti zawe bashobora kwibonera myitwarire y’umukunzi wawe idahwitse kuko wutagira ikosa wasanga ugira amakosa nk’uko nabo bayagira biri kose ariko kuba waramukunze myitwarire ayifite wenda wowe nzira kuyicikaho afite nutangira kujya uganiriza nshuti zawe myitwarire mibi uzaba umubereye nk’umugambanyi kandi ntuzaba ukemuye ikibazo ahubwo uzaba uteje byinshi aho kumuteza isi adashobotse mubere umuyoboro gushoboka bityo mukundane neza ahubwo muzahore munezerewe kandi ntazanigera yibagirwa hari wamukuye habi intonganya hagati yanyu niba habayeho ikintu runaka utumvikanyeho n’umukunzi wawe mushake mubikemure kuko urukundo rwanyu mwembi si urw’isi wundi kububakira umubano uzaturuka hanze mwikishyira rubanda si ngomba nshuti zanyu zose zimenya utubazo utwo two twose twabayeho rukundo rwanyu nk’uko twabivuze haruguru bishobora gutuma inshuti zawe zitangira gutakariza icyizere umukunzi wawe ndetse zikanamusuzugura cyane uzazibwira zizumva zikabogamira ruhande rwawe gusa nyamara gihamya amakosa atari ayawe kuko wivuga amabi mu rukundo byiza inshuti zawe zimenya umuntu mukundana kuko bigaragaza umwishimiye pfunwe bigutera kumugira nk’umukunzi wawe ariko none si byiza kwishyira karubanda bidakwiye gushyirwa hanze mukobwa itoze kwigirira ibanga unarigirire umukunzi wawe hanze nshuti zawe n’inshuti ze urukundo urwa babiri abandi inyunganizi nubaho buzima bizagufasha kubaka urugo rwiza kandi rukomeye

abaryitabiriye amahirwe y’ubukerarugendo rwanda n’uko igihugu cyahanze uburyo bworohereza ishoramari ryabwo umuyobozi mukuru w’ishami ry’ubukerarugendo kubungabunga pariki rdb kageruka ariella yavuze ibyiza kunoza serivisi baza basanga kugira u rwanda rukomeze rureberwe ndorerwamo’’ yashimangiye ubukerarugendo bugezweho bundi buhindura ubuzima bw’uwafashe umwanya agatembera ati ubukerarugendo burahinduka buryo abakerarugendo batakijya gusa gusura ahantu ahubwo bifuza n’aho hantu habasigira ikintu cyubaka ubuzima bwabo mitekerereze cyangwa myumvire’’ abenshi basuye ibigo rwanda byamurikiye serivisi bitanga abenshi babazaga amakuru ajyanye n’ibiciro cyangwa ibindi bintu bakora birenze gusura ingagi n’izindi nyamaswa ziboneka pariki zitandukanye gihugu kageruka yavuze bafite ishimwe cyane iminsi bamaze i cannes bufaransa yatanze umusaruro rugendo guverinoma y’u rwanda guteza imbere ubukungu bushingiye bukerarugendo imibare rdb igaragaza u rwanda rwinjije miliyoni zivuye bukerarugendo bijyanye n’intego guverinoma yihaye inyungu ruvana bukerarugendo igomba kwikuba kabiri ikagera miliyoni abitabiriye ibiganiro bisoza imurikagurisha ryabereye mujyi cannes babajije ibibazo bitandukanye zinoze abayobozi baserukiye ibigo rwanda biganjemo urubyiruko imigirire itanga icyizere hazaza h’ubukerarugendo rwubakiye bakiri bato ibigo byitabiriye imurikagurisha ry’i cannes birimo ibitanga title: ababikira babiri bibye amadorari bayajyana gukina urusimbi

title: intambara kongo ntabwo yigeze ihungabanya umutekano w’u rwanda
content: iyi kompanyi iratangaza gihe hari amakuru atangazwa n’ibitangazamakuru bitandukanye isi avuga intambara ibera kongo ishobora kuba yarahungabanyije umutekano rwanda mu itangazo yashyize ahagaragara andrew nganga umuyobozi mukuru thousand hills expeditions ahumuriza mukerarugendo abashishikariza kuza rwanda kuko hari amahoro n’umutekano agira bijyanye n’imikorere yacu turi i kigali ntabwo ibibera kongo byigize biteza umutekano muke kandi rwanda akazi karakomeje nk’uko bisanzwe nk’uko ambasade amerika rwanda ibyemeza akomeza avuga hagize igihinduka rwanda thousand hills expeditions yaba iya mbere kubimenyesha abakiriya bayo kuko ntibifuza kuba babazana ahantu hadatekanye thousand hills expeditions iza makompanyi mbere rwanda afata neza mukerarugendo abatembereza ahantu nyaburanga rwanda ibyo byatumye mwaka ikigo cy’igihugu cy’iterambere rdb kiyiha igihembo kubera yabaye indashyikirwa bijyanye guteza imbere ubukerarugendo rwanda parike y’ibirunga iratekanye rdb nayo ibwira mukerarugendo n’abandi bantu bagana u rwanda parike y’ibirunga iherereye majyaruguru y’u rwanda itekanye nubwo kongo igihugu gihana imbibi n’u rwanda hari intambara rica rwigamba ukuriye ishami ryita bukerarugendo rdb avuga ubukerarugendo rwanda bujyana n’amahoro ndetse n’umutekano agira umutakano w’abadusura twawugize intego turamenyesha abasura u rwanda hano umutekano nk’uko title: sobanukirwa inkomoko y’umugani yagosoreye rucaca amagambo kimenyi yabwiye ndabarasa yaje kuba insigamigani
content: uyu mugani ukunda kuvugwa cyane babonye umuntu ubwira amagambo adashaka kumva kuko atamunogeye nibwo bavuga aragosorera rucaca ayo magambo yavuzwe kimenyi umwami w’i gisaka ahayinga umwaka w’i ubwo rwanda hari himye cyilima rujugira yohereza umuhungu ndabarasa kurererwa kimenyi by’imitsindo dore nyirarume nyina rwesero umukobwa muhoza se wabo kimenyi nyine ndabarasa agezeyo abana nyirarume kimenyi aramukunda cyane ndetse bigeze igihe gusezera atahe kimenyi aramwangira naguhawe so nkurere none ntiyakunyatse kandi dore umaze gukura ndashaka kukubakira nkagushyingirandabarasa araceceka ntiyongera kugira amusubiza haciyeho iminsi aramubaza ko wambwiye uzanyubakira ukanshyingira ukampa umunani none byaheze he ati nyubakira utanyubakiye ngiye iwacu bazanyubakira ntakihabuze kimenyi yitegereza ndabarasa umutota yitotomba namwubakire amenya ashakakugeraho bumenyi bwe amenya iby’imitsindo aramubwira mwana wanjye burya ndagosorera rucaca ndabarasa arita gutwi araceceka haciyeho iminsi kimenyi aramuhamagara ngwino njye kuguha imisozi uziyubakire ubwo ashyizemo imitsindo yanze kumwubakira ataba ahinduye i gisaka umugaragu w’u rwanda baraboneza bagenda bashagawe ajya kumwereka imisozi amuhaye amwereka umusozi witwa rundu dore umusozi nguhaye ndabarasa abaza kimenyi ni uku umuntu umwana kandi atabuze ibintu mu by’imitsindo kimenyi yongera kubwira ndabarasa ni nguhaye niho uzagarukira ndabarasa biramubabaza na yongera kuvuga indi mitsindo yereka nyirarume imisozi ayimwerekesha umuheto wampaye hariya hose kimenyi abibonye ararakara kandi mwana abanyarwanda mugira ubwira urangaruriza igihugu uruhembe rw’umuheto ahera arakara yohereza ndabarasa se i shengero rye rimubajije igitumye arakarira umwana nagende igihamihami kimenyi nagende asange se sinshoboye kugumya kugosorera rucaca nuko iryo jambo ryo kugosorera rucaca barisamira hejuru riraganirwa bishyize kera rihunduka umugani baca babonye umuntu ubwira amagambo adashaka kumva mbese bashaka kumwumvisha ahondoga bat i rekera uragosorera rucaca ni wumva bavugango naka yagosoreye rucaca kugosorera rucaca guhondoga kubwira utari bukumve wwwmuhaburarw

lt gen henry tumukunde wahoze minisitiri w’umutekano gusa haracyategerejwe amazina akomeye agomba kwigaragaza kuko amashyaka menshi gihugu ataragaragaza abagomba kuyahagararira matora lt gen tumukunde minisitiri guverinoma museveni kugera uherutse gutangaza agomba kuziyamamaza agakura museveni butegetsi amazeho imyaka isaga itegeko rigenga amatora y’umukuru w’igihugu uganda ryo riteganya umuntu wese ushaka kwiyamamariza kuyobora uganda agomba gutangira inzira itegura kuzahagararira ishyaka rye mezi abanziriza itariki y’amatora ingingo mbere y’iri tegeko ivuga gihe ushaka kwiyamamaza yemerewe kuzenguruka igihugu cyose akoresha ibiganiro banyamuryango b’ishyaka rye abasaba kumushyigikira agategura imigabo n’imigambi agategura n’ibindi bikoresho ndetse agakusanya n’inkunga y’amafaranga azakoreshwa kwiyamamaza binyuze buryo bwemewe n’amategeko n’inama zemewe zatumijwe n’abamuhagarariye gihugu hose umuyobozi komisiyo y’amatora uganda simon mugenyi byabakama yatangarije daily monitor abashaka kwiyamamaza bemerewe gutangira gukora ibiganiro gushaka ababashyigikiye ariko yongeraho bagomba kubikora bagendeye murongo uteganywa n’amategeko asanzweho atandukanya biganiro n’ibikorwa kwiyamamaza byabakama yakomeje avuga bagira inama abashaka kuziyamamaza kutazahirahira bakora ibisa kwiyamamaza bazenguruka mihanda bitwaje nama z’ibiganiro gushaka bahagararira amashyaka kuko bizaba bihabanye cyane n’ibiteganywa n’ingingo gatatu y’itegeko rigenga amatora ryo mu bihe bitandukanye polisi yabangamiye inama nk’izi zategurwaga bobi wine imushinja atigeze akurikiza ibisabwa n’amategeko ajyanye n’umutekano bamwe bashaka kuziyamamaza nyero francis elton lakelle uyu yagerageje inshuro nyinshi kujya nteko ishinga amategeko ahagarariye agace acholi ariko bikanga ntiyemerewe kwiyamamaza matora y’abadepite bagombaga guhagararira agace arua y’amajyaruguru nyuma kunanirwa kwishyura miliyoni z’amashiringi yasabwaga yemezwe nk’umukandida lt gen henry tumukunde yasezerewe ngabo uganda updf afite ipeti lieutenant-general yarwanye intambara yagejeje museveni butegetsi hagati - yahawe kuyobora myanya itandukanye irimo kuba minisitiri w’umutekano kuyobora urwego rushinzwe umutekano imbere gihugu ndetse ahagararira n’igisirikare nteko ishinga amategeko hagati robert kyagulanyi azwi cyane kazina yavanye muziki bobi wine yagaragaje azahangana museveni w’imyaka matora ubu umudepite uhagarariye agace kyadondo y’iburasirazuba gaherereye karere wakiso ahanganye museveni yitwaje itsinda rye yise people power ndetse yahanganye n’inzego z’umutekano inshuro nyinshi zimubuza gukora content: kugira ishoramari rigende neza ngombwa urikora agira amakuru nyayo y’aho ashobora gushora imari ibi byagarutsweho ejo hashize ugushyingo i kigali hari hateraniye inama ihuje abashoramari cyanyuzemo nko afurika y’epfo harimo abazi u rwanda rutari bibaza baza kuhakorera ishoramari babaza hatakiri abantu bicana abantu baracyafite amakuru kera bakeneye andi mashya bamenye u rwanda ruhagaze ngu’ubu yongeyeho ruhande rw’u rwanda hari abashobora gutinya gukorera ishoramari afurika y’epfo bitewe n’uko hari amakuru bumvise ati hari ababa barumvise abacuruzi afurika y’epfo bakorerwa ibyaha bamburwa amafaranga iyo ufashe abantu batandatu icumi ukababaza amakuru buri umwe akubwira yibwe nzira rugo n’ahandi dufashe makuru yonyine byaduca intege kandi ntibyatuma tudakorana kandi title: ibiribwa bitumizwa karere biri bituma ifaranga ry’u rwanda rikomeza guta agaciro
content: mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru kabiri nyuma kugeza raporo y’ingengo y’imari yakoreshejwe umwaka ushize imbere y’inama y’abaminisitiri john rwangombwa yavuze ibituruka hanze bikomeza gutuma ibintu rwanda bizamba asubiza ikibazo abajijwe bantu benshi bakomeza kwibaza uburyo litiro lisansi hagabanutseho amafaranga ariko ibiciro bigakomeza kuzamuka yasubije n’ubwo lisansi yagabanyutse ariko ifaranga ryo ritigeze rireka guta agaciro ati ibiribwa bitumizwa hanze nko kenya bigira uruhare izamuka ry’ibiciro guta agaciro kw’ifaranga ryacu kuko nabyo biba byaguzwe mafaranga atagifite agaciro yagaragaje ingero z’uburyo u rwanda rufite ifaranga rikigerageza kugira agaciro karere n’ubwo umwaka ushize guta agaciro ifaranga ry’u rwanda byari uku kwezi bikaba bigeze nyuma y’u rwanda kenya nicyo gihugu kigerageza aka karere kuko ifaranga ryacyo ryataye agaciro kugeza hejuru muri kiganiro kizajya kibaho buri gihe minisitiri w’imari amaze gushyikiriza raporo inama y’abaminisitiri rwangombwa yasobanuye u rwanda rwabonye amafaranga angana miliyari ugereranyije miliyari rwabonye mwaka kuba mafaranga yariyongeryeho byaturutse bikorerwa imbere gihugu byatanze amafaranga y’u rwanda miliyari zingana y’inyungu miliyari z’ayaturutse hanze zingana by’inyungu emmanuel hitimana

title: ingabo z’abafaransa zari ziri rwanda zigiye gukorerwa iperereza
content: imiryango iharanira uburenganzira muntu irasaba ingabo z’abafaransa zari rwanda zakorwaho iperereza ryimbitse ruhare zikekwaho kugira jenoside ibi bishingiye ahanini iperereza ryatangiye ngabo z’abafaransa zari opration turquoise’ ariko kugeza ibyarivuyemo bikaba bikomeje kugirwa ubwiru n’ubwo hari bimwe biherutse kubanyura rihumye bigashyirwa ahabona ingabo z’abafaransa zari zarezwe n’imiryango y’abarokotse ubwicanyi bisesero bazishinja kubageraho tariki kamena zasanga ibintu bimeze nabi zikabizeza kubarengera ariko zikigendera zikagaruka tariki kamena interahamwe zimaze kumara benshi ibiro ntaramakuru by’abongereza reuters bivuga u bufaransa bwari inshuti ikomeye y’u rwanda gihe buherutse kwanga kwitabira umuhango kwibuka jenoside yakorewe abatutsi nshuro nyuma y’aho bongeye kwibutswa hari uruhare bashobora kuba bafite bwicanyi bw’iki gihe iyi miryango ivuga hari amadosiye yashyizwe ahabona agaragaza ingabo z’abafaransa mpera z’ukwezi kamena zitererana abatutsi bihishe misozi bisesero burengerazuba bw’u rwanda bakicwa ikimenyetso miryango iharanira uburenganzira muntu ivuga simusiga hari ubutumwa fax bwagaragaye bw’icyo gihe buvuguruza ibyigeze kuvugwa bamwe bakuru b’ingabo bavugaga batigeze bamenyeshwa hari itsinda ry’abatutsi bashobora kwicwa ahantu runaka hegereye ubu butumwa bwoherejwe n’undi musirikare igice kimwe cy’amadosiye aherutse gucika abayafite avuguruza musirikare yaba yaratabaje avuga abatutsi kaga ishyamba basaba kurindwa n’ingabo z’abafaransa itangazo ryashyizwe ahagaragara n’impuzamashyirahamwe y’imiryango iharanira uburenganzira muntu bufaransa survie riragira riti bamwe bagize umutwe wihariye w’ingabo z’abafaransa bafite ubutumwa guhagarika ubwicanyi baherereye birometero bitanu uvuye ubwicanyi bwakorewe kandi bafite amakuru bafite ibikoresho by’itumanaho n’ibindi bikenerwa gutabara ubuzima gihe kihuse ariko ntibyakozwe iyi miryango ikomeza isaba ubutabera bw’u bufaransa bwatagiye iperereza myaka ishize bwakwita busabe bwabo kandi bagashyiraho igitutu kugira hamenyekane uruhare rw’ingabo z’u bufaransa bwicanye ndetse n’ababyihishe inyuma reuters ivuga yagerageje kuvugana minisiteri y’ingabo bufaransa birego ariko gisubizo umunyamakuru yahaweyanditswe ubwanditsimuhaburarw

title: umwami ntiyica hica rubanda
content: byakomeza kunanirana urubanza rukagenda rukagera i bwami iyo umwami yashakaga yagishaga inama ibyegera bye ubundi akaruca akurikije ibimenyetso yahawe rimwe rimwe umwami yajyaga atanga abagome cyangwa se muntu wese wabaga yagomeye ingoma akicwa n’ubwo umwami yajyaga afata bwe ibyemezo bikomeye ntawe abajije rimwe yigeze atwara u rwanda adafite abajyanama usibye kuba rwari runini politiki n’imiyoborere yarwo byari bikomatanye n’urugamba ruhoraho kurinda ubusugire bw’igihugu kandi umurimo utoroshye kugeza magingo busugire buracyabungwabungwa kuko impamvu nto ariyo yatuma bujegajega yageza igihugu icuraburindi urugero irondakoko n’irondakere byubatsweho umusingi gutegura jenoside yakorewe abatutsi uko perezida repubulika ashyirwa butegetsi kuko atorwa n’abaturage nako ashyiraho bamufashe kuzuza inshingano ze abaturage babashyizeho kuko abaturage shingiro umuyobozi wese uyoboye abaturage neza akabageza iterambere rijyanye n’ibyo bifuza kugeraho abikoze cyimbo perezida repubulika kuko nicyo abaturage baramutoreye ni kenshi bavuga ijambo ryabo imbere y’abaturage twumva bashima perezida wabatumye begere baturage ukuboko kwe kugaragarira kuko muyoboro w’imirongo migari y’icyerekezo cy’igihugu mu minsi ishize uturere twatangiye gahunda kwegera abaturage rwego gukusanya ibyifuzo by’ingingo zazashyirwa imbere igenamigambi - ni ukuvuga icyerekezo abaturage bazahitamo kizashingirwaho n’abayobozi batandukanye kuzuza neza imihigo bagirana perezida repubilika ni kenshi dusanga mirongo migari iba yatanzwe n’igihugu urwego perezida ahagarariye itubahirijwe mu buryo butaziguye perezida wabatumye uba yatengushywe ariko buryo buziguye abaturage batenguhwa mbere y’undi wese ibitagenze neza twe bigiraho ingaruka mbi mbere perezida wabatumye kandi bigenze neza natwe bigirira inyungu mbere perezida repubulika abo bayobozi indorerwamo zifite ibirahure tuba tugomba kwibonamo iyo ubonyemo umuyobozi wowe ntiwibone uba wayirebyemo impindurize cyangwa intambike iyo utibonyemo wayifashe neza umuyobozi ubonamo yirunzemo ubwe agashyira inyungu ze imbere izawe azakazipfukirana ibyo badukorera byose biba bigomba kugira ingaruka nziza cyangwa mbi ariko mbere mbere twe abaturage niyo mpamvu twumva kenshi nyakubahwa perezida abashishikariza gushyira umuturage isonga byabananira bagaha umwanya ababishoboye ibigenda neza bikwiye kudutera ishema nk’abaturage kuko biduha amanota kuba twaratoye umuyobozi w’igihugu uduha yadusezeranyije binyuze mfura yaratugeneye zituyobore bwe hari n’abo twitoramo ubwacu batuyobore bamwe bakadukundira abandi bakatugomera ibitaragenze neza nabyo biba byagenze nabi kubera impamvu ebyiri cyangwa eshatu hari ibituruka bayobozi barabaye imfura z’umutima muke nanze kubita ibigwari hari ibituruka byinshi igihugu kidafiteho ububasha nk’ubushobozi by’umutungo cyangwa se ibituruka miterere y’aho igihugu giherereye ariko kandi hari n’ibituruka baturage ubwabo harimo kwinangira umutima imyumvire mibi n’umutima muke gushyira imbere guhinyuza uko byagenda kose kimwe n’ibyagenda neza nsorejeho biba byagenze nabi kidafite cyabazwa mbere y’uko kibazwa nyakubahwa perezida repubulika n’ubwo mwanya muke agira atega amatwi abaturage haba ngendo agirira hirya hino gihugu cyangwa se binyuze itumanaho rigezweho ibibazo byose yakemura ubwe bipfa kuba bivuye muturage hari uba yarabirengeje ingohe uwo umuyobozi uhura cyangwa se wagahuye n’uwo muturage buryo bworoshye kuko aricyo yashyiriweho ndetse ahemberwa abihutira kunenga nyakubahwa perezida repubulika biba bitagenze neza abatazi inzego zakabaye zikora imirimo zishinzwe n’abo abaturage batishimira imiyoborere cyangwa se bakora andi makosa n’iyo abaturage batabimenya perezida akabakuraho icyizere abikoze nyungu z’abaturage ubwo nk’aho abaturage bakanabakuyeho ibyo perezida yarubatse abaturage babigerekeho amabuye bubake ibirenzeho wabisenya tureba iyo nzira itazima turwana kubaka u rwanda ikwiye kutubera indi mpamvu kudashyigikira uwatuyobora yishakiye nyungu zitandukanye n’izishyira umuturage isonga utuyobora neza abikoze izina nyakubahwa perezida repubulika ariko ubikoze nabi ahindanyije izina ry’umukuru w’igihugu wamutumye kugawa ugaya uwamutumye yitwaje kinyarwanda tuvuga zitukwamo nkuru ariko n’izo nto zitutswe zijye zibuka zizize muturage kuko umwami atica hica rubanda imyenda yanduye imeserwa gikari mu gusoza umuntu uzi ikinyarwanda neza twamunenga rufaransa cyangwa urwongereza hari uwasubiza wenda nizo ndimi ziba zorohewe nyakunenga ariko simbibonamo ubupfura noneho cyane cyane hanengwa inzego zashyizweho zibe umuyoboro w’ubuyobozi twihitiyemo iki igitekerezo bwite ntwari pie kicukiro

title: indwara kujojoba fistula n’ingaruka zayo buzima bw’uyirwaye
content: fistule cyangwa kujojoba indwara iterwa n’uko haba habayeho gukomereka gice ndangagitsina cy’umubyeyi gihe arimo kubyara ibyo bigaragara cyane babyeyi batabyarira muganga kandi bakeneye title: ibikorwa by’abanyarwanda malawi byibasiwe bimwe bicuruzwa birasahurwa
content: ibikorwa by’ubugizi nabi byibasiye abanyamahanga biganjemo abanyarwanda murwa mukuru malawi lilongwe bihungabanya ubucuruzi bigizwemo uruhare n’abaturage babarakariye ibi bibazo byatangiye cyumweru tariki gashyantare havugwaga urupfu rw’abantu umunani gace biwi i lilongwe bwicanyi byavuzwe bwibasiye abamotari ku ikubitiro habanje kuboneka imirambo ibiri abaturage batangira gusaka ako gace byatumye bigabiza ibikorwa binyuranye cyane cyane iby’abanyamahanga bakunda kwita amaburundi ako gace kakaba gatuwe cyane n’abanyarwanda bahakorera ubucuruzi buciriritse umuyobozi diaspora y’abanyarwanda malawi ndatinya juvnal yabwiye igihe ibikorwa by’abanyarwanda byahise byibasirwa ibicuruzwa bimwe bigasahurwa yakomeje abanyarwanda batuye ako gace kandi bahafite ibikorwa byinshi ndetse bagaragara bukungu bw’ako gace ibyo bigatera ishyari abanyagihugu baturanye nabo nyuma haje gutabwa yombi abanyamalawi bagize uruhare rupfu bamwe barimo uwitwa blessings lifa w’imyaka shadrack ndalama w’imyaka magingo ibintu bisa n’ibyatuje ariko ibikorwa by’abanyarwanda byarasahuwe rwego rukomeye n’itangazo ryamagana bibazo ryakozwe buryo bweruye bimwe byasahuwe maduka byiganjemo ibintu bikenerwa buzima buri munsi nk’isukari umunyu isabune n’ibindi umwe banyarwanda uba malawi yabwiye igihe ahanini hohoterwa riterwa n’ishyari abanyarwanda bafitiwe yakomeje kuko abari inyuma biriya si abaturage ibirara n’abahezanguni bitwaza babatwarira imirimo nyuma y’ibyo bikorwa abapolisi n’abasirikare bakoze ibishoboka guhosha bugizi nabi mu kiganiro yahaye abanyamakuru gatatu visi perezida malawi dr saulos chilima yamaganye bikorwa avuga bidashobora kwihanganirwa kugeza muyobozi mukuru wabyamaganye mugaragaro avuga kwibasira abanyamahanga bidakwiye malawi abarundi n’abanyarwanda abavandimwe b’abanyafurika kandi uburenganzira muntu ubwa muri malawi hari umwuka mubi nyuma y’uko mbere w’iki cyumweru urukiko rwategetse amatora perezida aheruka yabayemo uburiganya bityo agomba gusubirwamo minsi itarenze perezida peter mutharika uyobora malawi watsinze amatora yabaye gicurasi umwaka ushize yagize amajwi gihe umukandida w’abatavuga rumwe n’ubutegetsi lazarus chakwera yagize amajwi mutharika yatangaje agiye kujuririra cyemezo cyafashwe n’urukiko inkuru igihe

title: abakinnyi batanu fc barcelone banduye coronavirus bigirwa ibanga
content: radiyo rac mur catalonia yabitangaje binyuze kiganiro cyayo tu diras gihe fc barcelone n’andi makipe asigaye yitegura gusubukura shampiyona tariki kamena abakinnyi batanu banduye coronavirus ntibatangajwe kiganiro ariko hemejwe bimenyetso bagaragazaga byagaragaye bamaze gufatwa ibizimini by’amaraso amakuru rac yahurijweho kandi n’aya el chiringuito de jugones avuga hari n’abandi babiri batoza fc barcelone banduye coronavirus abakinnyi batanu barwaye barakize ndetse byizerwa bamaze kugaruka myitozo n’abandi gihe abayobozi b’ikipe bahangayikishijwe n’uko bashobora kwibasirwa n’imvune fc barcelone ifite igikombe shampiyona espagne giheruka yirinze kugira ivuga makuru gihe ikinyamakuru as cyatangaje kipe yizeye icyemezo kubitangaza kizafatwa la liga mu cyumweru gishize kapiteni fc barcelone lionel messi yavuze nk’abakinnyi bamaze iminsi bafite impungenge z’uko buri kimwe kizaba kimeze bitewe n’ibyabaye bice bitandukanye by’isi kubera coronavirus fc barcelone izasubukura shampiyona tariki kamena ihura mallorca espagne bihugu byugarijwe bikomeye coronavirus handuye abantu bagera bihumbi abasaga ibihumbi bamaze kwicwa n’icyo cyorezo ku mbere byatangajwe abandi bantu bahitanywe covid- babonetse bikaba ubwa mbere byari bibaye werurwe

title: ingano y’umwuka co umunyarwanda yohereza kirere
content: ubushakashatsi bwakozwe oxfam bwatangajwe cyumweru bwagaragaje umuntu umwe bwongereza bizamufata iminsi itanu kugira agire uruhare bikorwa bituma haboneka co gihe ngano y’uyu mwuka muntu rwanda bizamufata umwaka ku cyumweru gitaha tariki mutarama nibura umwongereza azaba amaze kohereza kirere umwuka co ungana n’uzoherezwa umwaka wose n’umuturage bihugu birimo madagascar malawi ethiopia uganda guinea burkina faso ubu bushakashatsi bwagaragaje ingano y’uyu mwuka woherezwa kirere batuye rwanda toni malawi burkina faso zigeze toni mwaka bwagaragaje umuturage nigeria agira uruhare bikorwa byohereza kirere mwuka uhumanya ungana toni buri mwaka buhinde akaba ikigereranyo rusange isi kiri toni muntu buri mwaka mu bwongereza honyine umuturage abarirwa toni abongereza benshi bavuze hakwiye kugira byinshi bikorwa kurwanya ikibazo cy’imihindagurikire y’ikirere cyane kugabanya umwuka uhumanya woherezwa kirere ubwiyongere kirere bw’uyu mwuka co bugira ingaruka bidukikije zirimo ubushyuhe bukabije isi imyuzure n’ibindi mu myaka ishize ibikorwa muntu byongereye ubushyuhe isi ho dogere celcius uko kwiyongera k’ubushyuhe isi kwagiye gutera ibibazo bitandukanye birimo ihindagurika ry’ibihe imyuzure hato hato kuzimira kw’inyamaswa n’ibimera bitandukanye n’ibindi mu myaka myinshi ishize ibikorwa muntu byakomeje kugira uruhare iyangirika ry’urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima ndetse n’ihindagurika ry’imiterere y’isi ahari ubutayu sahara hahoze ibyatsi amazi ndetse n’amashyamba nkuko byatangajwe n’umushakashatsi dr curt stager kaminuza smith college nyamara byaje guhindurwa n’imyuzure agace gasigara kambaye ubusa kubera ubushyuhe ibikorwa muntu n’ibindi amoko y’inyamswa yarimutse ajya gushaka ahandi andi menshi yarazimiye mu myaka imbere isunzu ry’umusozi kilimanjaro rizwiho urubura rizaba ryambaye ubusa ubushakashatsi bwagaragaje ubushyuhe bw’isi buri gutuma urubura musozi rushonga bidasanzwe uyu mwuka co ugira ingaruka nyinshi buzima muntu zirimo kurwara umutwe kugira umunaniro kubura ibitotsi kugira ibibazo by’ubuhumekero kimwe gututubikana ndetse wongera uburyo umutima utera umuntu akaba yarwara indwara y’umuvuduko ukabije w’amaraso cyangwa se akaba yajya coma buryo butunguranye kubera kubura umwuka mwiza ubushakashatsi buherutse kugaragaza ingaruka z’imihindagurikire y’ibihe bukungu bw’u rwanda zishobora kugera kigero by’umusaruro mbumbe w’igihugu mwaka ubu bushakashatsi bwakozwe n’itsinda ry’ibihugu bihuriye kuba bisangiye ingaruka bigirwaho n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere v bwerekanye ingaruka z’imihindagurikire y’ibihe buzima bw’abanyarwanda zishobora kurushaho gukomera harimo ukwiyongera malaria ndetse n’ibyorezo bituruka bukonje ndetse n’ubushyuhe bw’ikirere ubushakashatsi bw’ikigo cy’igihugu kubungabunga ibidukikije rema gicurasi bitera ihumana ry’umwuka n’iyangirika ry’ikirere bwagaragaje ibintu biza isonga guhumanya umwuka uhumekwa rwanda harimo umwotsi w’imodoka imyotsi y’amakara n’inkwi n’ibindi bwanerekanye uduce duto duto tutabonwa n’amaso twivanga n’umwuka uhumekwa tubangamiye bikomeye ubuzima bw’abaturarwanda bishobora gutera indwara z’ubuhumekero n’umutima bwanagaragaje bice bituwe hari ikigero cy’utwo tuvungukira kirenga urugero rwemewe ahanini kubera imyuka ikomoka gukoresha ibicanwa bikomoka biti gutwika ibyatsi ibiyorero n’amashyamba hari ibice bimwe bimwe byagaragayemo mpeshyi metero kibe y’umwuka usangamo hagati mikorogarama microgram z’utwo tuvungukira gihe ikigero cyemewe kitagomba kurenga mikorogarama meterokibe y’umwuka mu guhangana n’ingaruka ziterwa n’ihindagurika ry’ibihe n’iyangirika ry’ikirere u rwanda rwashyizeho ingamba nyinshi zitandukanye zirimo gutera ibiti byinshi bitanga umwuka mwiza buso bungana bw’igihugu harimo kandi gukumira imodoka zisohora imyuka ihumanya ihumanya binyuze isuzuma zikorerwa kwimakaza ikoreshwa ry’ingufu zidahumanya ibi bijyanye n’uko isoko ry’u rwanda hagejejwe imodoka moto zikoresha amashanyarazi

title: muhanga abanyamaguru bavuga uburenganzira bwabo buhutazwa n’abakoresha umuhanda
content: bamwe bagenda n’amaguru mujyi muhanga ntara y’amajyepfo barinubira kubangamirwa n’abatwara ibinyabiziga batubahiriza amategeko agenga inzira z’abanyamaguru kuko usanga abenshi batajya bahagarara babareke bambuke aba banyamaguru batangaza kutubahiriza amategeko agenga inzira zabagenewe zizwi zebra crossing bituma barushaho kugira impungenge kuhambukira kuko batinya kuhagongerwa kandi nyamara byitwa ariho bagenewe kwambukira bakaba basaba inzego bireba guhagurukira kibazo kugira abatwara ibinyabiziga barusheho kubahiriza amategeko y’umuhanda uwamahoro anita umugore w’imyaka atuye kagali gahogo umurenge nyamabuye avuga agorwa cyane kwambuka umuhanda imbere y’ahakorera radiyo huguka ajya isoko muhanga ati abatwara ibinyabiziga bajya bubahiriza inzira z’abagenzi babareke bambuke buryo hari n’abahagongerwa iyo abona ugiye kwambuka ntibahagarara wambuke ahubwo bavuza amahoni menshi umuntu akaba yata n’umutwe uwamungu yohani avuga abatwara moto aribo bakunze kutubahiriza title: allain jupp avuga atahakanye jenoside ahubwo yayemeye kuba
content: jupp avuga mwaka w’ butumwa bw’inteko ishinga amategeko yasobanuye yakoresheje ijambo jenoside kuya gicurasi nama y’abagize akanama k’abaminisitiri b’u burayi yabereye i buruseli bubiligi ikinyamakuru survie dukesha nkuru gitangaza alain jupp yaba yaratangaje nyuma y’uko uwari umunyamabanga mukuru loni gihe boutros boutros ghali yatangaje ibiri kuba rwanda atari ubwicanyi busanzwe ahubwo jenoside iki kinyamakuru gikomeza gitangaza minisitiri jupp yaba yaratangaje gihe jenoside rwanda igeze hagati ikorwa kandi n’igihe cyari gishize kikaba cyari gihe gikomeye cyane kuko aricyo cyishwemo abantu benshi aha bakaba bibaza bitaba ugusubiza ubwenge gihe igihe cyarenze prise de conscience tardive aha bavuga guverinoma y’u bufaransa rwanda gihe jenoside iriho itegurwa kandi ntacyo yakoze ibe yahagarika ubwicanyi bwatangiye tariki mata survie ikomeza ivuga gihe jenoside yakorerwaga abatutsi iriho kuba itariki mata jupp minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga w’u bufaransa hamwe l’lyse ingoro perezida w’u bufaransa bakiriye jrme bicamumpaka minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga w’u rwanda gihe jenoside ndetse jean-bosco barayagwiza umurwanashyaka w’ishyaka cdr aha bakaba bavuga icyiswe title: amerika yateye u rwanda inkunga miliyoni frw kugoboka abazahajwe n’ibiza byibasiye igihugu
content: peter h vrooman ambasaderi leta zunze ubumwe amerika rwanda yatangaje igihugu cye cyatanze inkunga ingana miliyoni zisaga frw gukoresha kugoboka abanyarwanda basenyewe n’ibiza bimaze iminsi byibasiye igihugu cy’u rwandaibi yabitangaje kane kiganiro cyihariye yagiranye minisitiri ushinzwe imicungire y’ibiza n’impunzi de bonheur jeanne d’arc ibi bikaba bibaye nyuma y’uko u rwanda ruri bihe content: kigalitoday yegereye itsinda bamwe bakorera uburaya i nyamirambo bayibwira bamenye ububi sida bakurikije babona sida imerera nabi bamwe bagenzi itsinda ry’indaya z’i nyamirambo ryemeye z’imibonano mpuzabitsina idakingiyeabagabo badakoresha agakingirizo bafite virusi itera sidaiyo yanze dukoresha agakingirizo acaho njye nkacaho nubwo ariko bamwe bakora uburaya i nyamirambo bavuga batacyemerera gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina abakiriya banga gukoresha agakingirizo hari abakora uburaya bageraho bakemera gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina gakingirizo kubera ubukene kubura abakiriya itsinda ry’indaya z’i nyamirambo riti hari bagenzi bacu bageraho bakemera gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina gakingirizo kubera ategereza umwanya munini umukiriya wemera agakingirizo akamubura kandi yenda abana baburaye ubushakashatsi bwakozwe n’ikigo cy’igihugu cy’ubuvuzirwanda bio-medical center bugashyirwa ahagaragara mwaka buragaragaza bakora uburaya umuntu umwe babiri yanduye virusi itera sida umukozi rbc dr mwumvaneza mutagoma uyoboye itsinda ry’ubushakashatsi bwagaragaje imibare y’ubwandu virusi itera sida rwanda dr mwumvaneza avuga imibare yavuye bushakashatsi bakoze igaragaza gihugu indaya itsinda ry’abantu rifite ibyago byinshi kwandura virusi itera sida kurusha andi matsinda ibi biterwa indaya abantu bakora imibonano mpuzabitsina inshuro nyinshi kandi n’abantu batandukanye title: rusizi ikibazo cy’ibiraro byacitse bikomeje guhitana ubuzima bw’abantu
content: umugabo witwa habyarimana zachee w’imyaka utuye mudugudu kanoga akagari nyamigina murenge gikundamvura ho karere rusizi yatwawe m’uruzi ibi bikaba byarabaye ku’itaki z’ukwambere ahagana sa cyenda z’amanywa muruzi rubyiro yageregezaga kurwambuka aturutse ’isoko ry’ ahitwa cimerwa ni nyuma yaho tariki z’uku kwezi imvura yihariye umunsi wose gihugu bikaba byarabaye karere rusizi by’umwihariko inzuzi zikuzura zigasenya ibiraro bikaba arinayo ntandaro y’urupfu habyarimana zachee n’ubwo ubuyobozi bw’akagari bwavuze urupfu rwe amazi yarufatanyije n’ubusinzi nk’uko byemejwe n’umuyobozi uyobora akagali yaratuyemo ibi kandi bibaye nyuma y’igihe gito ibiza bihitanye abandi bantu umwe baturage byiboneye imbona nku bone kuko kumwe yahamirije muhaburarw nyakwigendera bagiye kwambuka uruzi nk’uko bisanzwe ariko zachee akabanza imbere uruzi rukamwuzuriraho yagize atitwarituvuye isoko ryo cimerwa dushaka mbuka uruzi kuko ikiraro cyacitse ariko nyakwigendera arabanzaubwo akigera mazi mbona haruguru haturutseyo amazi menshi n’uko ahita amutura ruzi ruramujyana nsubira inyuma ruka ndatabaza aya makuru yahamijwe n’umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’akagari nyamigina banyangiriki alphonse yabwiye muhabura nkuru nabo bayimenye ahagana i saa kumi n’imwe z’umugoroba yagize atiuwo muturage namuyoboraga kagari yatwawe n’uruzi ariko abari kumwe bavuze uruzi rwamufatanyije n’ubusinzi kuko yagasomye akayoga uyu muyobozi yakomeje avuga ibikorwa gushakisha umurambo nyakwigendera bigikomeje hashize iminsi karere rusizi hagaragara ibiza hato hato biterwa n’igwa ry’imvura nyinshi ikangiza ibikorwa by’abaturage bimo imirima ndetse inzuzi zigatwara amateme n’ ibitaro bikaba byaramaze kwangiza imigenderanire baturage dore binamaze guhitana ubuzima inzego z’ubuyozi hejuru leta bugire bukora ubuzima bw’abaturage bwarusha ho kugana ahabi n’uko bitangazwa nabo denis fabrice nsengumuremyi

title: remera bamwe bakobwa bemeza amafaranga kintu mbere bakundira abahungu
content: amafaranga imodoka kwitabwaho kwambara neza n’inzu bimwe bintu bamwe bakobwa batuye i remera bakundira abahungu cyangwa abagabo bamwe bakobwa batandukanye batuye gace remera mujyi kigali bemeza amafaranga kintu mbere abakobwa bahatuye bakundira abahungu amafaranga abenshi bakobwa basabwe muhaburarw kugaragaza urutonde rw’ibintu bashingiraho gukunda abagabo cyangwa abahungu bagaragaje n’ibindi bikorwa gihanzi dady de maximo yabwiye umuseke kumurika imideri yabyigiye itsinda ry’uwitwa rosalie gicanda rose kabuye iriya myaka atangiza kompanyi yise dadmax agency ho yahimbiye imyambaro title: imfubyi jenoside zirasaba kurushaho kwegerwa

title: u rwanda rwakuye amata munwa abanya-maurice rwasoneraga imisoro
content: kuvanaho gusoresha kabiri kwirinda forode n’ihishwa ry’imisoro byakorwaga n’abashaka gukwepa imisoro musaruro w’ibyo bakorera rwanda bitwaje abasezerano hagati y’u rwanda n’igihugu maurice abasonera bigiye gukurwaho n’itegeko ryemerejwe umushinga n’umutwe w’abadepite kuwa mbere tariki ukuboza uyu mushinga w’itegeko wemeza burunda masezerano yashyiriweho umukono i washingitoni dc leta zunze ubumwe z’amerika mata hagati repubulika y’u rwanda repubulika maurice gukuraho iryo sonerwa aya masezerano kabiri hagati y’ibi bihugu byombi aje nyuma yaho mwaka u rwanda rwasanze rugira igihombo kutabona misoro bacuruzi baturutse repubulika maurice mu rwego kwirinda gihombo kwezi kukuboza u rwanda rwabaye ruhagaritse masezerano rusaba yahinduka kugira gihombo kiveho amasezerano ariho mbere yatanganga uburenganzira sosiyete zikorera bihugu byombi ntizigire misoro zitanga nyugu y’umusaruro zabonye none bigiye guhinduka nyuma yaho itegeko ryemerera kwemeza burundu amasezerano mashya rizaba ritangiye gukurikizwa mu gusuzuma mushinga w’itegeko abadepite bagize impungenge u rwanda rwaba rufite andi amasezerano nkaya atuma ruhomba minisitiri w’imari n’igenamigambi ambasaderi claver gatete asobanura andi masezerano nkaya u rwanda rufitanye n’ibihugu bibiri afurika yepfo n’u bubiligi ameze neza kuko gihombo aruteza ambasaderi claver gatete yavuze kwemeza mushinga w’itegeko rihagarika gusonera abanya-maurice bigiye gukuraho igihombo u rwanda rwagiraga bikazafasha kuzamura ubuhahirane hagati y’ibihugu byombi yagize kwemeza masezerano bigiye gukuraho igihombo cyaterwaga kompanyi zitishyuraga imisoro ibi bizatuma habaho ubuhahirane hagati y’ibihugu byombi hari uburyo buzwi bwumvikanweho n’ibihugu byacu butuma muntu utanga imisoro kabiri kuba abaturutse repubulika maurice bakoreraga rwanda batishyura misoro byatumaga bamwe bandi banyamahanga bashaka gukorera rwanda bajya kwandikisha amasosiyete repubulika maurice kugira bizaborohere gukorera rwanda none mpinduka zikaba zigiye kubihagarika kuko nabo bagiye kugenda basora nk’abo bindi bihugu inkuru igihe

title: drc babanza gutanga umusoro fdlr kugirango babashe kugira bakorera butaka bwabo
content: aba baturage bavuga gihe umwe aramutse yanze cyangwa akabura barwanyi fdlr bahita bamufata bunyago aba baturage bakaba bashinja ingabo z’igihugu cyabo zibatererana bikabije kuburyo babona muntu wita mutekano w’abaturage umuturage w’umugore kigero cy’imyaka aravuga yibuka ibyamubayeho mezi abiri ashize yanze kubahiriza amabwiriza atangwa n’abarwanyi fdlr gihe yahingaga umurima uherereye ahitwa i mukongo parike y’igihugu y’ibirunga abana bagerageje kurwana n’umwe barwanyi fdlr babasha kumwambura imbunda afite bayishyikiriza ingabo z’igihugu cyabo fardc agira nyuma y’iminsi mike bibaye umuntu ntazi yaje murima wanjye avuga yoherejwe nyiri mbunda twatwaye kugirango ntavaho mbura ubuzima bwanjye byabaye muha amadorari y’amerika bitaba sinari kuzongera gukandagira ukundi ikinyamakuru syfia grand lacs dukesha nkuru gitangaza barwanyi fdlr aka gace basanzwe batunzwe n’ibikomoka mirima y’abaturage aha buri muhinzi cyangwa wese ufite akora agomba kugira yishyura kugirango abashe kuba yagira akorera butaka bwe tuba dusabwa kugira dutanda twarabimenyereye kuko nibo bayoboye aka gace kose hari badusubiza amafaranga tubagurire bakeneye tutabikoze twaba tudashaka kugaruka bukaba ubuhamya bw’umwe batuye ako gace abasirikare congo n’imiryango yigenga bahora basubiranamo bitana bamwana batumye aka karere kagira umutekano mukemu mnsi ishize ingabo fardc ziherutse gushyira ashize twanditse abantu batatu bishwe nyuma y’iperereza twaje gusanga bazize baranze kumvira abatumwe n’uwo mutwe bagabane inyungu y’ibyabo fdlr umutwe w’inyeshyamba usigaye ufatwa nk’umutwe w’iterabwoba karere ukaba ugizwe ahanini n’abanyarwanda bahunze mwaka uyu mutwe ukaba ubarizwa mashyamba congo gerard gitoli mbabazi

content: kuwa ukwakira perezida idi amin dada yagiye kigo gisirikare masaka suicide revolutionary mechanised specialist reconnaissance regiment’ agiye kwizihiza isabukuru y’intumwa muhammad yari aherekejwe n’umugore sarah kyolaba n’abahungu aliga mwanga bageze kigo gisirikare bakiriwe n’uwari komanda w’agateganyo wacyo maj nasur ezaga hari kandi gen mustafa adrisi minisitiri w’ingabo abdel abdul kisuule wayoboraga regiment masindi lt col adek wayoboraga simba mechanised regiment mu ijambo rye amin warakaye yitotombeye kuba mufuka n’umwe sima bwagezwe gasozi old kampala ahateganywaga kubakwa umusigiti mukuru w’igihugu kandi amafaranga yaramaze gusohorwa atanzwe n’abagande ndetse guverinoma z’amahanga zirimo iya libya arabia saoudite centrafrica qatar irak leta zunze ubumwe z’abarabuuae amin yavuze nyuma kumenya abayobozi bamwe nama nkuru kisilamu uganda banyereje amafaranga yagombaga gukoreshwa bwubatsi bw’umusigiti old kampala yafashe icyemezo guhagarika miliyoni z’amashilingi umwami arabia saoudite yatanze yanahishuye yumvise ikimwaro imbere y’umuyobozi libya col muammar khadafi kubera amafaranga yageneye imishinga y’abasilamu uganda ariko nayo akanyerezwa n’abagize inama nkuru ikinyamakuru new vision kikaba cyibutsa umubano amin khadafi watangiye gashyantare nyuma y’aho guverinoma y’u budage bw’u burengerazuba bwitambitse inama mbere i tripoli libya ni gihe amin yafataga ubutegetsi kuwa mutarama ahiritse milton obote khadafi atabyishimiye kubera ahuje obote ingengabitekerezo socialism nubwo batari inshuti by’umwihariko ubwo bageragezaga kubaka umubano wabo khadafi yahaye ikibanza uganda i tripoli kubakamo ambasade yayo kubera mpamvu amin yasuye libya ajyana n’itsinda ry’abantu yizeraga bagiye gutangiza ambasade uganda i tripoli mu bamuherekeje harimo uwitwa amin mutyaba wavugaga icyarabu neza ndetse hajj habib kagimu wavugaga icyarabu neza kuko yize libya uyu wabaye umusemuzi gihe akazi ke nk’umusemuzi bivugwa katumye khadafi amwiyumvamo cyane ndetse gushidikanya wahuje ibikorwa gushinga ambasade uganda libya nyuma y’aho umutekamutwe algeria yibiye amin yabanje gutanga gushinga ambasade muri werurwe amin yagize mutyaba charge d’affaires libya nyuma arazamurwa agirwa ambasaderi inkunga nini mbere khadafi yateye abasilamu uganda n’iyo ukuboza yatangaga miliyoni z’amashilingi azihaye inama nkuru y’abasilamu sheki yashyikirijwe sheikh abdulzaak matovu ayihawe minisitiri w’ibibazo by’imbere gihugu libya maj himed khiwildi kubera inkunga nk’izo zakomezaga kwinjira amin nibwo yagize igitekerezo kubaka umusigiti title: burera akarere kagiye kwiyuzuriza hoteli miliyoni
content: uyu mwaka urasiga akarere burera kiyujurije hoteli nkengero z’ikiyaga burera ifite agaciro miliyoni iyo hoteli yitwa burera beach resort hotel’ kubukwa ahazwi nko mu gitare’ murenge kagogo nkengera z’ikiyaga burera uruhererekane rw’ibirunga igishanga cy’urugezi n’ibiyaga burera ruhondo byanya bikomeje gusurwa n’abakerarugendo karere burera aka karere kagaragaza ubukerarugendo bugenda burashaho gutera imbere burera beach resort hotel’ kubakwa murenge kagogo nkengera z’ikiyaga bureraifotoumurengezi r icyakora ubuyobozi bw’akarere burera ntibwahwemye kugaragaza impungenge iyakirwa ry’abo banyamahanga basigira igihugu by’umwihariko ako karere amadovise aha bitekerezo by’ubuyobozi bw’akarere burera kimwe n’abafatanyabikorwa b’ako karere bagiye bahuriza kuvuga hakenewe hoteli ariko gitekerezo ntigishyirwe bikorwa kubera amikoro macye sembagare samuel umuyobozi w’akarere burera yabwiye izuba dukesha nkuru nk’akarere byabaye ngombwa twubaka hoteli kubera kugeza urwo rwego rw’amahoteli tugira abatugana bacumbika habiri gusa agaruka mvano y’iyubakwa ry’iriya hoteli sembagare ahamya ifitanye isano n’ubukerarugendo bukomeje gufata isura nziza’ karere abereye umuyobozi ariko hakaba hakiri imbogamizi bijyanye n’amacumbi yakira mukerarugendo virunga lodge hotel montana vista niho hantu honyine kugeza hifashishwa kwakira abasura akarere burera gusa ubuyobozi bw’ako karere buvuga hantu hadahagije rwego guha serivisi inoze abasura ibyiza nyaburanga bigaragara ako karere sembagare akomeza agira abasura urugezi ibirunga muhabura n’ibiyaga burera ruhondo babura bacumbika bakajya karere musanze n’ahandi kubaka iriya hoteli rwego guha serivisi nziza abatugana by’umwihariko abagenzwa gusura ibyiza nyaburanga byacu meya sembagare asobanura burera beach resort hotel’ yubatswe ntumbero guha serivisi nziza abakerarugendo basura akarere bureraifotoumurengezi r umuyobozi w’akarere burera ahishura burera beach resort hotel’ izaba yuzuye yitezweho kuba umusemburo w’iterambere ry’abaturage binyuze rujya n’uruza rw’abacyerarugendo bazajya basura ako karere bagakenera kuruhuka ati iriya hoteli izadufasha cyane rwego rw’umuco birumvikana mukerarugendo bazacyenera kuririmbirwa kandi bizakorwa n’abaturage bacu abakora imitako bazahabwa rugari ndetse n’abandi bakora ibikorwa bitandukanye by’ubukorikori abaturage biteze impinduka nyinshi mibereho mu makuru atangwa n’ingeri zitandukanye z’abatuye akarere burera bahuriza gushimangira biteguhiye guhindurirwa imibereho hoteli igiye kuzura karere kabo baturage bagaragaza biteguye gutangiza ibikorwa by’amajyambere bizajya bibinjiriza amafaranga kubera abacyerarugendo bazajya babasura burera beach resort hotel’ kubakwa n’akarere burera kubufatanye sosiyete y’abayapani noghuchi holdings ltd’ sosiyete isanzwe n’ubundi ifatikanya n’akarere bikorwa by’iterambere bitandukanye birimo n’iyubakwa ry’udukiriro amakuru atangwa n’ubuyobozi bw’akarere burera agaragaza hari abashoramali umunani bamaze kugura ibibanza nkengero z’ibiyaga ruhondo burera buri umwe ateganya kuhazamura ihoteli ahereye umuyobozi w’akarere burera ahamya ako karere gakomeje gukora gashoboye byose korohereze abashoramali gukorera ibikorwa birambye burera imirimo kubaka igeze kuru meya sembagare agira mperutse gukoresha inama abashoramali bagera makumyabiri bafite ibibanza baguze umunani bariteguye bagiye kubaka buri wese azubaka ihoteli bazakikiza biriya biyaga nk’akarere twasabwaga byose twarangije kubikora twamaze gukata imihanda amashanyarazi n’amazi birahari ahasigaye umwanya uw’abashoramali bahawe ikaze abaturage b’akarere burera bashishikarizwa guharanira kubyaza umusaruro iriya hoteli kubakwa n’ubuyobozi bwabo ababishoboye basabwa gushyira imbere kwihugura by’amahoteli kugira bazabashe guhabwamo akazi ubwo twatunganyaga nkuru imirimo kubaka burera beach resort hotel’ igeze isakara hoteli ifatwa by’umwihariko nk’umuhigo w’akarere burera biteganyijwe izuzura ukuboza mwaka ubuyobozi bw’akarere burera buvuga izuzura itwaye amafaranga y’u rwanda asatira miliyoni bakunzi fidel indatwanetindatwa

title: uganda ifite ubushake kongera kubana mahoro n’u rwanda-minisitiri sam kutesa
content: minisititi w’ububanyi n’amahanga uganda sam kutesa yavuze igihugu ke gifite ubushake kongera kubana mahoro n’u rwanda dore ibihugu bihana imbibi kandi bifitanye amateka akomeye umunyamabanga title: ibimenyetso bigaragaza ufitanye umubano udasanzwe n’uwo mutashakanye
content: muri minsi ufitanye umubano udasanzwe n’umuntu mudahuje igitsina kandi ufite umugabo cyangwa umugore mwashakanye mwembi mubwirana byose mukinganye azi kugutega amatwi ushobora kwibwira mufitanye ubucuti busanzwe nyamara mwashakanye atari yabibona aramutse amenye muganira uko bigaragara ubucuti mufitanye bugeze kure ukurikije bimeze uba ubona kurengera kandi urumva wifuza icyabuhagarika icyakora ugomba kubanza kumenya impamvu zishobora kuba zaratumye ugirana ubucuti budasanzwe n’uwo muntu ibimenyetso bigaragaza umubano mufitanye udasanzwe kugira umenye umubano mufitanye wihariye kandi udakwiriye umuntu washatse umubwira ibibazo mfitanye n’uwo twashakanye ukora nshoboye kose mube kumwe imishyikirano ufitanye n’uwo muntu uyihisha twashakanye uhorana urwicyekwe mwashakanye aramutse akubonanye n’uwo muntu wakumva bikubangamiye ndetse aramutse yumvise ibiganiro mugirana yakumva ushobora kuba umuca inyuma ni iyihe mpamvu ibitera gushaka kwitabwaho ubusanzwe kwitabwaho n’umuntu mudahuje igitsina birashimisha iyo umuntu aduhaye agaciro biradushimisha kandi tukumva turi beza iyo umaze igihe runaka ushatse ushobora gutangira gushakira ihumure wundi muntu mudahuje igitsina ariko ugomba kumenya gushakira ihumure muntu utari mwashakanye bizakugiraho ingaruka iyo utangiye kujya ubwira umuntu mudahuje igitsina wiyumva imishyikirano ufitanye n’uwo mwashakanye irahazaharira ni nk’aho uba umwibye urukundo rumukwiye ukaruha icyo ukwiriye kwibaza niki naburanye twashakanye kuburyo najya kugishakira ahandi ese umuti ugushaka indi nshuti ruhande cyangwa tugomba kwicara tukaganira bitagenda neza kugirana ibibazo n’uwo mwashakanye hari igihe wumva mwashakanye ataguha agaciro cyangwa atakwitaho nk’uko ubyifuza nanone ushobora gukomeza kubika inzika bitewe n’ikibazo mufitanye kitakemutse uwo mwashakanye ashobora kuba yanga muganira kibazo mufitanye bikaba byakubabaza bigatuma ushaka watakira hari impuguke zivuga kwanga kuganira n’uwo mwashakanye bibazo mufitanye bishobora kuba ikimenyetso gikomeye cy’uko mubanye nabi cyangwa mushobora kuzatana wakora ukemure kibazo menya urimo ukina bikomeye kugirana ubucuti n’undi muntu kandi waramaze gushaka birashyira bikabyara ibibazo utazapfa kwikuramo ndetse bikaba byatuma urugo rwanu rusenyutse ingaruka zabyo ntizishidikanywaho kuko zimwe zatangiye kukugeraho kugirana ubucuti n’umuntu mutashakanye byatumye wima mwashakanye urukundo akwitezeho reka inzozi iyo ufitanye agakungu n’umuntu bituma utekereza ubuzima bwari kuba bumeze aza kuba mwashakanye nyamara ugereranya ubushobozi bw’uwo mwashakanye n’ubw’uwo muntu uba wibeshya cyane nanone ujye wibuka umunezero wumva ufite utekereje ncuti yawe wagiraga wabaga utekereje mwashakanye ishyirireho imipaka kugira abantu birinde abajura bashyira intabazaalarme modoka zabo cyangwa mazu nawe ushobora kugira ukora kugira ubungabunge imishyikirano ufitanye n’uwo mwashakanye niba hari umuntu mufitanye agakungu gahagarike mu gihe wumva bitakoroheye wagombye nyine kumva harimo ikibazo aho gukomeza kwihagararaho utanga impamvu zituma ushyikirana shyigikira mwashakanye ukore ibishoboka byose ugire urugo rwiza kugira ibishimo muryango cyangwa kwitabwaho biraharanirwa kandi bisaba mwembi mubigiramo uruhare wikumva mugenzi wawe agomba gutuma unezerwa wowe ntacyo ushaka gukora uwo mufitanye ubucuti agahararo ntabwo ukundo niyo rwaba kandi warahiriye kubana n’uwo mwashakanye byiza bibi wamaze guhitamo byararangiye

title: nyamagabe ba gitifu beguye imirenge idafite abayobozi ibaye
content: kuri mutarama abayobozi babiri bayoboraga imirenge bandikiye inama njyanama basaba guhagarika imirimo kuri mutarama abayobozi babiri bayoboraga imirenge bandikiye inama njyanama basaba guhagarika imirimo eliezel nyandwi wayobora umurenge kitabi epaphrodite niyitegeka gitifu w’umurenge uwinkingi karere nyamagabe bagejeje nama njyanama amabaruwa kwegura nshingabo barimo nk’abayobozi ho mayor nyamagabe avuga basezeye akazi iriya nama yateranye gitondo mutarama niho bariya abanyamabanga nshingwabikorwa batangiye ariya mabaruwa bivugwa nyandwi yagiye biro by’akarere nyamagabe ahura n’abajyanama bagira baganira ariko baza kumubwira bamuha amahirwe nyuma agakosora ibitagendaga neza kazi ke ahitamo kwandika kwegura nyuma y’inama eliezel nyandwi yajyanye n’abandi bayobozi kwakira abadepite basuye akarere nyamagabe epaphrodite niyitegeka gitifu w’umurenge uwinkingi yeguye nshingano ze mayor nyamagabe uwamahoro bonaventure yabwiye umunyamakuru w’umuseke bariya bayobozi bateguye ahubwo bahagaritse akazi ati umunyambanga nshingwabikorwa w’umurenge uwinkingi yagiye kwiga uwa kitabi yagiye kwita muryango mayor avuga imirenge itanu karere ke idafite abanyamabanga nshingwabikorwa irimo mugano kibumbwe kitabi uwinkingi umwe baturage kitabi bakurikiranira ubuzima bw’uriya murenge yabwiye umuseke nyandwi yagiye asabwa kwegura agatakamba akavuga ibitagenda neza agiye kubikosora eliezel nyandwi umurenge wazaga nyuma gukemura ibibazo by’abaturage harimo kubashishikariza gutanga ubwisungane buzima ndetse habonekaga inzu zimeze nyakatsi nyinshi uwo muturage utashatse amazina tuyatangaza mbere yabanje gukorera kaduha ariko aza kwimurirwa inaha kitabi icyo gihe bwari uburyo kureba yagira akosora ariko nanone byaranze nyirubwite eliezel nyandwi twamuhamagaye agire atubwira yumvise umunyamakuru umuhamagaye arasubiza buretse gato ndaje umuseke wahamagaye perezida w’inama njyanama y’akarere nyamagabe fiacre ndahindurwa tumubaza bakiriye ibaruwa y’ubwegure nyandwi atubwira amaze iminsi atari kazi kandi atwaye byinshi yatubwira’ visi perezida njyanama kariya karere mathias ngezenubwo arangije kumva ikibazo twamubajije gisa n’icyo twabajije perezida njyanama yahise adukupa’ umurenge kitabi ufite utugari dutanu aritwo mujuga kagano mukungu shaba uwingugu umwe mirenge y’u rwanda yeramo icyayi kinshi kurusha ahandi

content: jupp avuga mwaka w’ butumwa bw’inteko ishinga amategeko yasobanuye yakoresheje ijambo jenoside kuya gicurasi nama y’abagize akanama k’abaminisitiri b’u burayi yabereye i buruseli bubiligi ingoro perezida w’u bufaransa bakiriye jrme bicamumpaka minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga w’u rwanda gihe jenoside ndetse jean-bosco barayagwiza umurwanashyaka w’ishyaka cdr aha bakaba bavuga icyiswe
