content: uyu mugani baca yakoze bwabaga cyangwa yakoze bwabaga wakomotse nkoma nkondogoro sekirasanyi ikirozi marangara kitarogera ubusa uretse abagihaye ihene n’intama ahasaga umwaka w’i bawuca babonye umuntu wacogoye ariko asanganywe imbaraga babona ananiwe yahoraga ashobora bakamubwira bati kora bwabaga naho usanzwe atagira imbaraga gukora n’iki kimunaniye bagira bati gerageza iryo jambo ryo gukora bwabaga hari abaryita ubugabo ubutwari ubu bimeze ariko ubundi inkomoko uburozi byatangiye hagati y’ingoma ndahiro n’iy’umuhungu ndoli hariho umugabo witwa nkoma nkondogoro ikirozi marangara nyina maduna bari abagaragu cyamatare bakomeye baraturutse i bunyabungo baza ibwami bafite umuhango kuroga gucuragura ariko bakagira n’ubundi burozi busanzwe aho shebuja apfiriye yishwe n’abakongoro bamutsinze i rubi rw’i nyundo bugamba gisenyi ndoli amaze gucikira i karagwe k’abahinda tanzaniya rubanda bahinduka abari abatoni b’ibwami barabahiga barabahashya kugira batagira bavuga ndoli kuko bamwe bakekaga akiriho abandi bati yapfanye se ubwo abanyamarangara batera nkama baramunyaga baramusenyera iwe bahagira imara ibyeso byarimo uburozi barabijanjagura ubwo i nduga riba ryifashe itangira n’isozwa ry’ukwezi ramadhan rigenwa n’igaragara ry’ukwezi ijoro ry’imbaraga cyangwa se ijoro ry’imigisha raila tul kadir niryo joro rifatwa nk’ijoro rikomeye kuruta andi majoro title: nyagatare guverineri w’uburasirazuba yasuye uruganda rw’amakaro ruzakorera

title: hari impungenge ijambo ’kurangiza’ rizazimira kubera ibisobanuro bariha bitari
content: impuguke ndimi akaba ntebe y’inteko nyarwanda y’ururimi n’umucoprof niyomugabo cyprien ashyira majwi abiganjemo urubyiruko akavuga hari imvugo bagenda badukana bigatuma imvugo n’amagambo ijambo gusoza’ nyamara ibisobanuro byayo atari bimwe prof niyomugabo asobanura ijambo ’gusoza’ rikoreshwa gihe igikorwa umuntu yarimo akora adateganya kugisubiraho naho ijambo kurangiza’ ryo rikoreshwa gihe igikorwa umuntu arimo gukora agisubitse ateganya kongera kugikora urugero rw’aho umuntu uvuga ’ashoje’ kurya atari kuko asa n’uvuze atazongera kurya ahubwo bikaba byashoboka iryo jambo yaba arikoresheje neza igihe wenda muntu yapfuye prof niyomugabo urangiza kurya ejo ukabikomeza igihe kikazagera ugasoza kurya utakiri buzima nanone yatanze urugero rw’umuntu uboha umusambiicyibo title: abakoze jenoside bahindanyije abanyarwanda twese- guverineri uwamariya

title: abasore n’inkumi baziyerekana mideli kigali fashion week
content: ni nshuro gatandatu ibirori kigali fashion week bigiye kongera kuba nyuma y’ibyabaye myaka itanu ishize bikagaragaza intera ikomeye abanyamideli rwanda bamaze kugeraho ugereranyije n’abo bindi bihugu kigali fashion week izabera century park hotel i nyarutarama ahazaba hateraniye abahanzi b’imideli bagera bazaba baturutse bihugu cumi bibiri umuyobozi kigali fashion week john bunyeshuri yavuze mwaka bakiriye abanyamideli n’abahanzi b’imideli fashion designers bihugu bitandukanye haba mugabane afurika aziya n’u burayi yagize kigali fashion week igitangira iy’abanyarwanda gusa mbere abanyamideli b’u rwanda muri mwaka hari impinduka zikomeye abitabira bariyongereye ibihugu nabyo byinshi mu birori gusoza tuzaba dufite abanyamideli bihugu birenga icumi urumva abanyamideli igikorwa cyerekana twakuze ibihugu byitabiriye imurikamideli rikomeye kigali fashion week baturutse bihugu birimo uganda kenya leta zunze ubumwe amerika sudani y’epfo u bushinwa u buyapani afurika y’epfo rwanda ghanau burundi repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo n’u buhinde kuri kabiri tariki kamena kiganiro cyahuje abanyamakuru n’abanyamideli bazitabira ibirori gusoza kigali fashion week benshi title: imikorere rssb yanenzwe n’abadepite
content: abayobozi rssb bisobanuye imbere y’abadepite bagize komisiyo gukurikirana imari leta makosa yagaragajwe n’umugenzi w’imari leta ajyanye gucunga nabi mitungo y’iki kigo ibarirwa miliyari z’amafaranga y’u rwanda ibibazo bikomeye cyane byagaragajwe n’umugenzuzi mukuru w’imari leta kuri gatatu tariki nzeri uburyo rssb yashoye imari kubaka inzu ndende zikabura abazikoreramo ziri hirya hino gihugu umwenda w’igihe kirekire umujyi kigali ufitiye kigo ungana miliyoni z’amafaranga y’u rwanda akaba agiye kumara imyaka nyungu atangwaho rssb ibazwa umwenda miliyoni iberewemo minisiteri y’ubuzima ugeze wishyurwa n’andi agera miliyari minisiteri y’ibikorwa remezo igomba kwishyura ariko nayo akaba atishyurwa kigo gikoresha amafaranga y’ubwizigame bw’abanyarwanda ibindi bisobanuro byari bikenewe nzu zubatswe i batsinda gasabo ariko zimwe bene kuzifata bakaba faranga rimwe barageza rssb hari inzu ebyiri z’ubatswe i nyagatare n’iki kigo zibura abazijyamo miliyari eshatu z’amafaranga y’u rwanda kigo cyashoye akagera game lodge akandi byari byagaragaye hari igihombo miliyoni zisaga kigo andi makosa ay’abantu giti cyabo n’ibibazo by’imiyoborere byagiye birangwa kudahuza igenamigambi buyobozi kugira hirindwa bihombo byoseabayobozi rssb ntibahakana ishoramari bakozi cyane nyubako habayemo kudashishoza neza kumenya abazayakoreramo bazava ariko ubuyobozi bwumvikanye n’umuntu uazazicunga nibura kuwa gicurasi mwaka kugera mwaka utaha akazaba yabonye abazijyamo kugera nyubako ziri ntara nyubako kigali izo nyubako yaba i rwamagana i karongi i nyanza nyarugenge zose n’imwe abakiliya barayifatamo imyanya gusa hari uburyo bw’uko uwashaka kugura nyubako yakumvikana rssb cyangwa ushaka kugura inzu zayo niveau cyangwa ebyiri akaba yazigura umuyobozi rssb jonathan gatera yavuze kigo gifite ubushake guhindura amakosa yabaye akagaragazwa n’umugenzuzi w’imari leta ibikosoka gihe kigufi bigakorwa n’ibikosorwa gihe kirekire bikazakorwa ati ntabwo twishimira kumva ijambo imiyoborere idahwitse rssb buri gihe ibintu bigomba guhinduka rssb dukorera abanyarwanda ntabwo twakwishimira kuba iciro ry’imigani yavuze imyenda ivugwa n’umugenzuzi w’imari leta rssb minisiteri y’ubuzima bumvikanye uzishyurwa vuba ku mwenda miliyoni umujyi kigali ufitiye rssb ukaba umaze imyaka bumvikanye bazabishyura bitaba bakazakizwa n’inkiko rssb yasobanuye hari bimwe bigo yashoyemo amafaranga ariko bikaba bidakora neza ikaba izabivamo yirinda igihombo bigera ahandi ikazasigarana imigabane itarenze nk’uko biteganywa n’itegeko ariko bigomba gukorwa bidahubukiwe umugenzuzi w’imari leta yagaragaje nshingano rssb ifite leta yayihaye gucunga imitungo ibarirwa miliyari zisaga mafaranga y’u rwanda bityo kugira acungwe bisaba uruhare n’ubwitange buri weseperezida w’inama y’ubutegetsi rssb gakwaya innocent yagaragaje kigo gihuje inshingano nyinshi dore kireba ibya nssf rama ikigega kishingira abagaore kiruhuko kubyara n’ubwisungane kwivuza mutuelle de sante yavuze hakwirengagizwa ibyabaye mbere micungire mibi kigo kikagira autonomie’ kwigenga bumwe burenganzira gufata ibyemezo ariko hari abatabyumva bayobozi rssb ikigo kibarwa nk’iki munsi minisiteri y’imari n’igenamigambi ibyinshi bisobanuro bisa n’ibyanyuze abadepite ariko impungenge yasigaye ukumenya abakozi bashoboye bazava kugira bakore mirimo rssb ivuga bakozi bafite ubumenyi kuyikora bahari kuko abenshi barigendera irindi hurizo ryasigaye ukumenya abakozi kigo gifite gihawe mutuelle de sante icyakabaye inyungu kitazasigara mishahara y’abakozi n’ibindi bibagenerwa ibibazo by’igihombo bikazaba akarande ibyo byose bizigwaho action plan’ ubuyobozi rssb buvuga buri gutegura yanditswe ubwanditsimuhaburarw

title: dr bizimana yavuze by’abiciwe bagize ubutwari kubabarira
content: ubushakashatsi bwagaragaje by’abiciwe ababo jenoside yakorewe abatutsi bagize ubutwari kwiyunga kubabarira ababiciye umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa komisiyo y’igihugu kurwanya jenoside cnlg dr jean damascene bizimana yagezaga ijambo bateraniye rwibutso jenoside gisozi mata yagaragaje ikigero cy’ubumwe n’ubwiyunge banyarwanda kiri ntera ishimishije ushingiye bushashatsi bwakozwe mwaka ibi dr bizimana yabivuze abakuru b’ibihugu babiri perezida paul kagame n’uwa tanzania dr john pombe magufuli yifatanyaga n’abanyarwanda n’abari bamaze gushyira indabo ahashyinguwe inzirakarengane gucana urumuri rw’icyizere rumara iminsi ijana rwibutso kigali gisozi dr bizimana yavuze banyarwanda kugarura ubumwe n’ubwiyunge bitagarukiye yagaragaje abakoze jenoside abenshi basabye imbabazi bakagaraza bafite ikimwaro gukora amahano bahabwa imbabazi ubushakashatsi buheruka gushyirwa ahagaragara n’iyo komisiyo bw’umwaka bwagaragaje ingengabitekerezo jenoside igihari ariko yagiye igabanuka kigero kiri hejuru yavuye kikaba kiri munsi uno munsi bijyana n’ikigero cy’ubumwe n’ubwiyunge kiri hejuru yavuze kandi bushakashatsi bwakozwe minisiteri y’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu minaloc bwagaragaje jenoside yakoranywe ubugome bw’indengakamere buri muvuduko utarigeze uboneka ahandi isi minsi ijana hapfuye inzirakarengane z’abatutsi bigaragara abantu bicwaga buri munsi bakicwa buri munota yavuze kandi gihe abanyarwanda bakomeje inzira y’ubumwe n’ubwiyunge kugeza hakiri ibihugu bigicumbikiye abahakana bakanapfobya jenoside yakorewe abatutsi birimo nk’u bufaransa igihugu repubulika iharanira demokarasi kongo n’u burundi bigicumbikiye abakoze jenoside rwanda bibumbiye mutwe fdlr kandi bikaba bikibashyigikiye dr jean damascene bizimana yashimye uruhare rw’u budage rukomeje kugaragaza kwima umwanya abasize bakoze jenoside ashimira intera bateye gucira imanza babiri boinsanganyamatsiko kwibuka nshuro igira iti twibuke jenoside yakorewe abatutsi turwanya ingengabitekerezo jenoside yanditswe ubwanditsimuhaburarw

title: my airtel app uburyo bworoshye kwishyura serivisi nyinshi ukoresheje telefone yawe
content: igitangaje ntabwo benshi bifashisha gikoresho nkoranabuhanga gihe bishyura amafaranga internet ituma gikoresho gikora turacyahata inzira amaguru tujya maduka kugura ama-inite gukoresha tukirirwana amafaranga mufuka hato akaba yanakwibwa tugiye guhaha airtel guhindura migirire kera itangiza uburyo myairtel app serivisi zose ushobora kuzishyurira telefone yawe bitabaye ngombwa uva serivise ziri my airtel app’ zirimo kugura ama-inite internet kwishyura ukeneye byose nk’amazi amashanyarazi ifatabuguzi televiziyo kohereza amafaranga haba rwanda mahanga byose bigakorwa hifashishijwe ikarita banki cyangwa airtel money iyi porogaramu telefone ikumenya guhera munsi mbere ukiyikoresha ibiri nimero yawe telefone ibimenya biri kose buryo igihe ugiye kuyikoresha bitakugora iyi porogaramu ibika wayikoreyeho bitewe n’icyo wishyuye cyangwa waguze wohereje n’ibindi buryo wongeye kugira ukoraho wakoreyeho ubushize ikwereka ibisigaye urugero uguze megabytes gukoresha internet zishira uzireba buryo utajya ihurizo ryo kwisanga internet yashize ni uburyo bukorwa kanya gato kurusha kubikorera internet hari n’uburyo kwiyoherereza inyemezabwishyu y’icyo umaze kugura ukoresheje porogaramu iyi porogaramu myairtel app ikomeje gushimwa benshi batangiye kuyikoresha ntabwo ngombwa gukoresha ubundi buryo kwishyura urenze telefone yawe manura porogaramu ubuzima bworohe my airtel app’ ikora igihe cyose amasaha minsi inafasha abayikoresha gukurikirana buri gihe ibibera konti banki airtel money bitabagoye gato ndetse ikaba idasaba kuba umuntu afite internet gihe kuyikoresha umutekano w’iyi application’ wizewe rwego hejuru kuko itemerera muntu kuba yakoresha imyirondoro yawe agamije kwiba amafaranga ufite konti cyangwa gukora ikindi kintu cyabangamira umukiliya airtel uyikoresha akarusho kandi kugura ama-inite ukoresheje porogaramu biguhesha uburenganzira guhabwa inyongera ndetse koherereza muntu bikaguhesha inyongera by’ama-inite wohereje iyi porogaramu izorohereza abajyaga bagorwa gufata mutwe kode zitandukanye kugura cyangwa gukoresha serivise airtel kuko buri kimwe cyose cyorohejwe my airtel app’ igisigarana umuntu ukeneye gukoresha porogaramu ajya ’play store’ kubakoresha telefoni ’android’ cyangwa ’app store’ bakoresha ios ukandika ishakiro my airtel hakaza ifite amagambo ’airtel africa’ ubundi ukayishyira telefone yawe nk’uko bikorwa zindi porogaramu umaze kuyishyiramo urayifungura ukuzuzamo nomero yawe ubundi ugakurikiza amabwiriza ajyanye n’ibyo bagusaba

title: huye polisi yafashe abacuruzi b’ibiyobyabwenge
content: muri gikorwa gufata bacuruzi b’ibiyobyabwenge ubuyobozi bw’akagari cyimana gaherereye nkengero z’umujyi butare butangaza bamaze igihe bahanganye n’aba bacuruzi b’ibiyobyabwenge umunyamabanga nsingwabikorwa w’aka hagari vestine nyirahabimana avuga akagari ke gakabije kugira ibyaha bikomoka bucuruzi bw’ibiyobyabwenge kuko abenshi basa n’ababikora mugaragaro ntacyo bikanga nyirahabimana avuga gihe cyose yagerageje gufata abakora biyobyabwenge bamuteye ubwoba nafashe inzoga z’inkorano z’uwitwa kazungu nzigejeje cyicaro cy’akagari ahita azifata ngufu agerekaho kuntera ubwoba ambwira amagambo mumureke mukorere ibya mfura mbi mpite mpunga igihugu itegeko rivuga uwafashwe acuruza inzoga z’inkorano acibwa amande y’amafaranga ibihumbi nyamara nyirahabimana avuga gihe kagari ke bafashwe batajya batanga mande kuko babeshya ntayo bafite bagahita bafungurwa bitarenze iminsi itatu nyuma gufungurwa bagaruka bishyizemo abantu bagize uruhare ifatwa ryabo umuyobozi w’umudugudu kamuhoza denis sibomana umudugudu wiganjemo biyobyabwenge ndetse n’urugomo ruterwa n’ababinyoye avuga bacuruzi bahora bamutera ubwoba bazamwica bidatinze sibomana agatsiko kayobowe n’uwitwa sebagabo muhire eric bakunda kwita rukamya bazanye imihoro bashaka kunyica ariko imana ikinga akaboko kuko baje bambwira bazanyica kandi nibambura bazica abana banjye n’umugore none ndishinganisha kuko babivuze ruhame theogene ndungutse kazungu wafatanwe biyobyabwenge akaba ashyirwa majwi n’abayobozi kubatera ubwoba myaka y’amavuko afite itanu muriyo ayimaze acuruza biyobyabwenge yatawe yombi inshuro eshanu kubera ibiyobyabwenge kazungu ashyira majwi ubuyobozi kuba ntabireka abayobozi bacu babitera kuko banze njya koperative ncuruza ibiyobyabwenge nkaho ntari umuntu nk’abandi kandi muntu urapfira iwange nanjye ubinywa ntacyo birantwara kandi mbinywa buri munsi umuyobozi w’akarere huye eugene kayiranga muzuka avuga aka kagali cyimana gasanzwe kazwiho bikorwa gucuruza ibiyobyabwenge kuko atari inshuro mbere bafashe ababicuruza muzuka avuga abacuruza n’abanywa ibiyobyabwenge aka kagari kahagurukiwe n’inzego z’ubuyobozi bw’ibanze ndetse n’iza polisi cyumweru kwita muryango kubera bihungabanya imiryango myinshi aka karere mayor muzuka abana batari bake aka kagari cyimana bavuye ishuri kubera ababyeyi bahora barwana basinze ntibabone uburere bw’ababyeyiakomeza avuga bafashwe bagiye gukurikiranwaho ibyaha baregwamuri bafashwe bacuruza biyobyabwenge harimo n’umwana wiga cyiciro rusange cy’amashuri yisumbuye cyimana si abacuruzi b’inzoga z’inkorano gusa barangwa aka kagari gusa kuko ubuyobozi buvuga aka kagari kabamo imburamukoro nyinshi zigizwe ahanini n’abandi gerard gitoli mbabazi

title: ikipe y’u rwanda yasezerewe beach volleyball
content: muri mikino ikinwa n’abakinnyi babiri babiri buri gihugu gihagararirwa n’amakipe abiri buri kipe ikina imikino ibiri ibiri u rwanda rwari ruhagarariwe emilienne uwineza hakizimana judith bagize ikipe mbere hamwe mutatsimpundu denise nzayisenga charlotte mu mikino ine yahuje amakipe y’u rwanda n’aya afurika y’epfo u rwanda rwasabwaga gutsinda nibura imikino itatu ine kugira rwizere gukomeza cyiciro gikurikiyeho ariko ntibyakunze kuko afurika y’epfo kugeza mwanya kabiri afurika yatsinze imikino itatu ine bakinnye n’u rwanda emilienne uwineza umukinnyi w’ikipe mbere y’u rwanda yavuze gutsindwa byatewe n’uko afurika y’epfo ibarusha inararibonye yagize afurika y’epfo yaturushije kubera bamenyereye cyane amarushanwa buryo usanga bazi amayeri menshi gusa n’ubwo badutsinze natwe ruhando guhatanira itike kuzakina imikino olympique ndetse n’igikombe cy’isi ariko christian hatuminana ushinzwe tekinike ishyirahamwe ry’umukino volleyball rwanda yadutangarije u rwanda rugifite title: gakenke inkeragutabara n’abafasha barahuguwe mateka
content: kubakira byiza mateka y’u rwanda kugira uruhare kubungabunga umutekano hatangwa amakuru gihe muntu wese wahungabanya umutekano bimwe byagarutsweho mahugurwa yateguwe komisiyo gusubiza buzima busanzwe agenewe inkeragutabara n’abafasha yabereye biro by’akarere gakenke ukwakira afungura mahugurwa umuyobozi komisiyo gusubiza buzima busanzwe abahoze rugamba ntara y’amajyaruguru madamu niyonteze clemence yasabye abitabiriye mahugurwa kuyakurikirana neza kuko ingirakamaro mibereho n’abaturanyi yakomeje avuga mahugurwa agamije guhugura cyane cyane abagore b’inkeragutabara bagahugukirwa gahunda leta dore batigeze bahugurwa bagaruka rwababyaye ndetse kumenya ibibazo bafite bwana safali wilson watanze ikiganiro mateka y’u rwanda mahugurwa yasobanuriye abitariye amahugurwa imvano y’amateka yateye jenoside yakorewe abatutsi yavuze abazungu banditse kandi bakigisha amateka y’u rwanda bayagoreka nkana kugira bacemo ibice abanyarwanda babashe kubategeka bise cyongereza divide and rule by’umwihariko ababiligi banditse amateka y’abanyarwanda bagendeye mateka y’amacakubiri gihugu cyabo hagati y’abafurama flamands n’abawaru wallons dore iwabo byacikaga hagati yayo moko uretse bakoroni safali yakomeje avuga natwe ubwacu twabigizemo uruhare cyane cyane ubutegetsi butandukanye bwagiye busimburana bwahembereye macukubiri kugeza abanyarwanda barangajwe imbere n’ubutegetsi bubi bamburaga ubuzima abavandimwe basaga miliyoni asobanura ikigenderewe kwiga amateka yavuze kubaka ejo hazaza bwana safali yagize kumenya amateka yacu bidufasha kwirinda amabi jenoside tukubakira mateka meza bidufasha kandi kumenya twatsinzwe n’aho twatsinze nk’abanyarwanda ni byiza kwiga amateka kuko ushaka kwiyibagiza amateka ashaka kuyasubiramo ibyo bigamije kubaka ejo hazaza h’igihugu cyacu kizira amacakubiri n’ingengabiterezo jenoside umutekano isoko y’iterambere lt muhozi charles ubarizwa batayo ikorera karere gakenke watanze ikiganiro mutekano yavuze iterambere u rwanda rwagezeho rurikesha umutekano niyo mpamvu tugomba kuwubungabunga kugira tutazasubira inyuma yibukije abitariye amahugurwa batagomba kwirara bagomba gutanga amakuru gihe muntu wese ushobora kuhungabanya umutekano koloneli karegeya claudien komisiyo gusubiza buzima busanzwe witandukanyije fdlr yabasabye gukangurira abavandimwe ndetse n’inshuti zabo zikiri mashyamba kongo gutahuka bagafatanya n’abandi banyarwanda kubaka igihugu cyabo kandi abizeza kuzabafasha kubagezaho butumwa izo nkeragutabara zitandukanyije fdlr zinjijwe gahunda zitandukanye z’iterambere barihirwa amashuri y’imyuga barubakiwe bavanwa nyakatsi ndetse baninjizwa gahunda gira inka mushimiyimana jeannette umwe mubakurikiranye mahugurwa avuga mahugurwa yayungukiyemo byinshi yavuze yasobanukiwe imvano baturutse turere twa rulindo gakenke batahutse bava mashyamba repubulika iharanira demokarasi kongo guhera kugeza mwaka turimo nshimiyimana leonard

title: coronavirus abayanduye isi bamaze kurenga miliyoni enye
content: abantu barenga miliyoni enye isi bamaze kwemezwa banduye coronavirus nkuko imibare kaminuza johns hopkins amerika ibigaragaza abo imaze kwica isi bamaze kurenga amerika iracyari igihugu mbere yashegeshe kurusha ibindi byose isi ikaba yihariye abarenga kimwe kane cy’abamaze kwemezwa bayanduye isi kimwe gatatu cy’abo imaze kwica isi impuguke ziburira umubare nyakuri w’abamaze kwandura coronavirus ushobora kuba munini cyane kurushaho kubera ibihugu byinshi bigifite ubushobozi buri hasi kuyipima bigatuma bidatanga imibare yuzuye abo coronavirus yica munsi bakomeje kugenda bagabanuka bihugu bimwe espagne ariko hari impungenge koroshya ingamba ’guma rugo’ bishobora gutuma habaho kongera kwiyongera k’ubwandu ikindi cyiyongera leta ziri kwitegura ibihe bikomeye by’ihungabana ry’ubukungu gihe cyorezo kiri gushegesha amasoko isi ndetse n’uburyo gucuruzanya hagati y’ibihugu umutegetsi mukuru leta y’ubushinwa yabwiye ibitangazamakuru byaho cyorezo ikizamini gikomeye cyashyize karubanda intege nke z’iki gihugu rwego guhangana n’ibiza uku kwemera ibitagenda kudakunze kubaho bategetsi b’ubushinwa k’umukuru w’akanama k’ubuzima bushinwa li bin kuje gukurikira ukuntu ubushinwa bukomeje kunengwa bikomeye mahanga bijyanye n’uko bwitwaye cyorezo kikihagaragara mu yandi makuru muri cyumweru ingamba zimwe ’guma rugo’ zatangiye kudohorwa butaliyani bwahoze izingiro ry’iki cyorezo isi abataliyani bashoboye gukora imyitozo ngororangingo hanze y’ingo zabo ndetse basura benewabo karere batuyemo mu gihe cy’ukwezi kurenga kwari gushize ubufaransa bwageze mubare muto cyane w’abamejwe bishwe coronavirus munsi abantu bakaba yishe masaha ashize abategetsi kwitegura guhera ejo mbere bazoroshya ingamba ’guma rugo’ leta espagne bihana imbibi nayo ikaba ibiteganya hagati ingamba ’guma rugo’ zirakomeje bihugu nk’afurika y’epfo nubwo amashyaka atavuga rumwe n’ubutegetsi akomeje gusaba zihagarara muri koreya y’epfo ingamba nshya ziri gushyirwaho tubari nzu z’utubyiniro clubs nyuma yaho habayeho urukurikirane rw’ubwandu bufitanye isano n’imyidagaduro karere k’umurwa mukuru soul uburusiya nabwo bwaburijemo akarasisi gisirikare murwa mukuru moscou kari gateganyijwe kuba bijyanye n’umunsi mukuru kwizihiza intsinzi y’intambara kabiri y’isi aho gukora ako karasisi perezida vladimir putin yakoresheje ibirori bidakomeye ejo gatandatu ashyira indabo roza rwibutso rushyinguyemo abaguye ntambara ariko nubwo hari gihamya ishingiye bumenyi siyansi abategetsi b’ibihugu byinshi bakomeje kuvuga badashira amakenga virusi ndetse bumva gahunda ’guma rugo’ atari ngombwa muri belarus abasirikare babarirwa bihumbi bakoze akarasisi kwizihiza intsinzi y’intambara kabiri y’isi gihe perezida alexander lukashenko akomeje kwamagana ifatwa ry’ingamba zikaze kurushaho ikinyamakuru cy’ubushakashatsi by’ubuvuzi bw’abantu bwongereza the lancet cyatangaje inkuru inenga bikomeye perezida jair bolsonaro brazil kivuga ubangamiye bikomeye ubushobozi bw’icyo gihugu guhagarika coronavirus kugeza brazil ifite umabare munini cyane w’abemejwe banduye coronavirus karere k’amerika y’amajyepfo - ikaba ifite abarenga bashya munsi w’ejo gatandatu hamwe gihugu bakaba bamaze kurenga nubwo biri perezida bolsonaro akomeje kuvuga ikibazo cy’iyo virusi kidakaze ndetse yagiye agirana ibibazo guverineri gahunda y’ingamba ’guma rugo’ uburakari butewe n’iki cyorezo bwajemo urugomo afghanistan abantu bagera batandatu barapfa abigaragambya bashyamiranaga n’inzego z’umutekano ibyo bikorwa by’urugomo byatangiye abigaragambya ahitwa firozkoh umujyi mukuru w’intara ghor bahuriye hamwe binubira igifatwa nko kunanirwa leta gufasha abakene gihe cy’icyorezo bbc

title: rura igiye gushyiraho uburyo kwirinda coronavirus modoka zitwara abagenzi
content: byatangajwe cyumweru nyuma y’uko inzego zitandukanye zikomeje gufata ingamba zigamije guhashya coronavirus ikomeje guhitana imbaga hirya hino isi nyuma y’uko umujyi kigali usohoye itangazo rihagarika ibitaramo n’ibindi bikorwa bihuza abantu benshi hirindwa coronavirus bamwe batangiye kugaragaza hakwiriye n’ingamba modoka zitwara abagenzi kuko hamwe hahurira abantu benshi kandi byoroshye kuba uwarwaye yakwanduza abandi rura ibinyujije twitter yatangaje guteganya gushyiraho uburyo abinjira modoka rusange babanza gukaraba umuti wica udukoko igira iti mu rwego gukomeza kwimakaza isuku kwirinda cyorezo minsi vuba turateganya gushyiraho uburyo bufasha abagenzi gukaraba alcool ntoki mbere kwinjira modoka nubwo rura itatangaje igihe bizatangirira yagaragaje bakiri kunoza gahunda buryo izatangira minsi vuba coronavirus nshya icyorezo gihangayikishije isi cyatangiriye bushinwa mpera z’ukuboza muri gihugu abamaze kucyandura gihe abapfuye hanze y’u bushinwa hamaze kwandura abantu ndetse abagera bamaze gupfa mu ngamba guverinoma y’u rwanda yafashe gukumira coronavirus harimo gupima abagenzi banyura kibuga mpuzamahanga cy’indege kigali i kanombe gushishikariza abanyarwanda kwirinda kuramukanya abantu bahana ibiganza cyangwa bahoberana kugabanya ingendo zitari ngombwa bihugu byagaragayemo cyorezo hari kandi kwirinda gukorora cyangwa kwitsamura iruhande rw’abandi gukaraba intoki hakoreshejwe amazi asukuye cyangwa ubundi buryo gusukura intoki kwirinda kwegera abandi igihe cyose warwaye ibicurane inkorora cyangwa ufite umuriro mwinshi kuri gatandatu kiliziya gatolika rwanda nayo yashyizeho amabwiriza mashya agomba kubahirizwa n’abayoboke bayo gihe bagiye gusenga mu mabwiriza mashya yashyizweho harimo guhana amahoro kirisitu mutima gusa guhana ibiganza cyangwa guhoberana ubusanzwe misa gihe gutura igitambo ukarisitiya kigana musozo umusaseridoti asaba abakirisitu guhana amahoro kirisitu agasuhuza ababa bamwegereye abandi nabo bagasuhuza begeranye byakorwaga umuntu mugenzi ikiganza cyangwa ahobera begeranye amubwira akira amahoro kirisitu ubu gikorwa gusuhuzanya guhoberana ntikizongera gukorwa rwego kwirinda cyorezo irindi bwiriza rijyanye n’igihe guhazwa inama nkuru y’abepisikopi yemeje gihe guhazwa ugutega ibiganza guhazwa rurimi kuri kiliziya zitandukanye rwego kwirinda cyorezo mbere y’uko umuntu yinjira azajya abanza gutega ibibanza ducupa turi miryango turimo umuti wica udukoko ubundi akarabe

title: yatangiye gucuranga iningiri afite imyaka amaze kuzuza imyaka akiririmbira igiceri cy’ijanavideo

title: sobanukirwa n’imiterere y’ababa gereza mbere itinyitse isi
content: kuri si dutuye hagenda havugwa ibintu bitandukanye biba bitangaje cyangwa wumva ukumva bisa nk’ibikanganye uyu munsi turabagezaho imiterere y’ababa gereza mbere mbi kandi itinyitse isi doreko n’abarinzi bayo badashobora kwinjiramo penas ciuda barrios magereza arangwamo ubugome bukabije isi bishingiye ahanini kubaba bahafungiwe n’ibyaha barakoze iyi gereza iherereye gihugu el salvador abayifungiyemo usanga umubiri wabo wuzuyeho ibishushanyo n’amagambotatto akenshi bivuga amateka y’ibyaha bikomeye barakoze ndetse cyubahiro cy’abo babikoreye abafungiwe gereza usanga ahanini ri abacuruzi bakomeye b’ibiyobyabwengeabicanyi kabuhariwe ndetse n’abacuruza intwaro muburyo butemewe ahagana kwezi nzeli gereza yakiriye umubare munini w’abicanyi nyuma y’intambara imaze kuba gihugu bituma irushaho kuba gereza irangwamo ubugome budasanzwe ndetse bigatuma yewe n’abarinzi badashobora kwinjiramo imbere kabone niyo haba habayemo ikibazo runaka ingabo z’igihugu ziba ziryamiye amajanja hanze y’iyo gereza ziteguye guhangana n’ikibazo aricyo cyose gishobora gutezwa n’abahafungiye mu mwaka nibwo gafotozi w’umwongereza adam hinton yahawe amahirwe akabash kwinjira gereza akanafata amafoto y’abahafungiwe uyu mugabo nyuma gereza yatanze ubutumwa avuga abagabo bayifungiyemo akurikije yabonye mibiri abagabo badafite kimwe batinya ahubwo barangajwe imbere kwica ndetse gukora ibindi bikorwa bigayitse salongo richard

title: itegurwa jenoside yakorewe abatutsi ibyaranze amatariki - werurwe -
content: turi bihe bidasanzwe guhangana n’icyorezo covid- cyugarije isi kandi rukaba urugamba tugomba gutsinda dufatanyije tugomba gukomeza kuzirikana amateka y’igihugu cyacu by’umwihariko minsi twitegura kwibuka nshuro jenoside yakorewe abatutsi niyo mpamvu gufasha abanyarwanda n’amahanga kwitegura kwibuka mateka komisiyo y’igihugu kurwanya jenoside cnlg ikomeje kugaragaza bimwe bikorwa byaranze umugambi gutegura jenoside yakorewe abatutsi ibikorwa bikurikira ibyaranze amatariki - werurwe - minisitiri w’intebe nsengiyaremye dismas yamaganye ikwirakwizwa ry’intwaro ntibyagira icyo bitanga tariki werurwe minisitiri w’intebe dr nsengiyaremye dismas ishyaka mdr yandikiye mugenzi minisitiri w’ingabo dr james gasana ishyaka mrnd ryari butegetsi yamagana ibikorwa gukwirakwiza imbunda baturage byari birimo gukorwa n’ubutegetsi hirya hino gihugu gahunda y’ubwicanyi yariswe auto-defense civile iyo baruwa iya kabairi dr nsengiyaremye yanditse agaragaza impungege bikorwa gutegura ubwicanyi byakorwaga mrnd nk’uko yarigeze kubigaragaza ibaruwa yandikiye minisitiri w’ingabo james gasana tariki gashyantare asaba gukora amalisiti y’abo habyarimana yitaga ibyitso by’inkotanyi bihagarara nanone yamaganye igikorwa gukwirakwiza imbunda baturage kubaha amahugurwa gisirikare ayo mahugurwa agamije kwica abatutsi kuri munsi nanone prudence bushnell umunyamabanga wungirije leta zunze ubumwe amerika ushinzwe ibibazo afurika yahuye perezida habyarimana i kigali yamushyizeho igitutu ashyireho buryo bwihuse guverinoma y’inzibacyuho anamubwira igihugu cye gihangayikishijwe kubona ibikorwa by’urugomo bikorwa leta byiyongera rwanda uwo munsi habyarimana yaburijemo irahira guverinoma y’inzibacyuho tariki werurwe jenerali romeo dallaire yasabye umuryango w’abibumbye kugena uburyo gutabara byihuse igihe byaba bibaye ngombwa nta gisubizo yabonye bikaba byerekana uburyo umuryango w’abibumbye wabaye ikigwari nshingano zawo gukumira jenoside rwanda minisitiri w’ingabo n’intagondwa z’abasirikare bakuru b’u rwanda bamenyesheje minuar ko hazakorwa jenoside lt colonel beaudouin jacques-albert umwunganizi tekiniki w’umubiligi umujyanama jenerali kabiligi gratien g buyobozi bukuru bw’ingabo z’u rwanda far yumviswe n’ubushinjacyaha gisirikare bw’u bubiligi itariki gicurasi iperereza ryabwo iyicwa ry’abasirikare minuar b’ababiligi yagaragaje minisitiri w’ingabo w’u rwanda augustin bizimana yaravuze hagombaga kubaho jenoside gihe fpr idahagaritse intambara dore ubuhamya bwe ukwezi kumwe cyangwa abiri mbere y’ihanuka ry’indege nagiye mugoroba gusabana jenerali nsabimana hamwe ambasaderi w’u bubiligi colonel vincent ukuriye ubutwererane bw’u bubiligi n’u rwanda gisirikare colonel marshal minuar colonel le roy perezida habyarimana bizimana minadef n’abandi basirikare bakuru b’abanyarwanda nyuma gusangira champagne augustin bizimana yambwiye yiteguye kugaba abasirikare fpr itemeye guhagarika intambara iminsi mbere y’ihanuka ry’indege uwa gatanu nyuma werurwe colonel vincent ukuriye ubutwererane gisirikare hagati y’u rwanda n’u bubiligi yatumiye iwe rugo jenerali nsabimana colonel kabiligi g na none nama bongeye gushimangira amasezerano y’amahoro arusha atashoboraga gushyirwa bikorwa kandi nibakomeza guhatirwa iby’amasezerano y’amahoro arusha bizaborohera gutsemba fpr kandi bitagombaga gutwara igihe kirenze iminsi babivugaga babyemera batyo ferdinand nahimana yasabye abategetsi bo hejuru gukorana n’abo hasi mu gushishikariza abaturage gukora jenoside tariki werurwe nahimana ferdinand yakwirakwije bategetsi hejuru igitekerezo cye autodfense cyari cyaratangajwe mbere gashyantare asaba hatangwa ibitekerezo kugira haboneke igisubizo rurangiza cy’ikibazo gihari muri nyandiko yahamagariraga igihugu cyose gushyira hamwe akanenga ukwihuriza hamwe kw’abatutsi mugambi wabo gukora ubwami bw’abami bw’abahima ndetse akanasaba abategetsi hejuru kutaba ntibindeba ahubwo bagafatanya n’abayobozi hasi bagakangura abaturage bakamenya ibibi by’intambara abahagarariye ibihugu byabo mu rwanda basabye habyarimana kubahiriza amasezerano y’amahoro arabyangira ku bushake tariki werurwe habyarimana yongeye kuburizamo ishyirwaho guverinoma y’inzibacyuho kuri munsi abahagarariye ibihugu byabo rwanda bahuriye biro ambasade y’ubufaransa rwanda baganira ishyirwa mubikorwa ry’amasezerano y’amahoro yashyizweho umukono jacques roger booh-booh intumwa papa rwanda ndetse ambasaderi b’ubufaransa leta zunze ubumwe amerika ububiligi ubudage tanzaniya zayireuganda burundi aba bashyize umukono masezerano basabye impande zombi gukemura batumvikanaho kubahiriza amasezerano basabye amashyaka politiki yemewe rwanda gihe hasinywaga agace k’amasezerano kerekeye kugabana ubutegetsi ndetse fpr yahagararirwa nzego z’inzibacyuho ibyo basabye ntabwo leta habyarimana yigeze ibyitaho ahubwo ikomeza gutegura jenoside umwanzuro mu byumweru bike mbere y’uko jenoside yakorewe abatutsi itangira habyarimana n’abakuru b’ingabo bakoreshaga imvugo yeruye bazarimbura abatutsi kandi batari biteguye gushyira bikorwa amasezerano y’amahoro y’arusha abari bahagarariye ibihugu byabo rwanda bagerageje kumvisha habyarimana agomba kubahiriza masezerano nyamara abereka gaciro afite kandi yiteguye gukora jenoside bikorewe i kigali werurwe dr bizimana jeandamascne umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa

title: menya bimwe mubitero byabaye ku’itariki mata mateka jenoside yakorewe abatutsi rwanda
content: tariki mata jenoside yakorewe abatutsi imaze iminsi itangiyeibitero byakomeje kwiyongerakuri taliki ibihumbi n’ibihumbi by’abatutsi barishwe buryo butandukanye hirya hino gihugu ibi bimwe bitero byatwaye ubuzima bw’abatutsi taliki myaka ishize ku itariki mata abatutsi barenga biciwe kiliziya gatorika cyahoze komini kanombe ku itariki mata abatutsi barenga bicirwa i karembure ku itariki mata abasirikare barindaga perezida juvenal habyarimana barashe ibisasu bikomeye bitaro byitiriwe umwami faysal bica abarwayi abandi bagera barakomereka ku itariki mata abarwayi biciwe bitaro kaminuza kigali chuk bishwe n’abasirikare leta y’uwari perezida w’u rwanda juvenal habyarimana ku itariki mata abatutsi bahungiye bitaro kiziguro barishwe ku itariki mata imibiri ivangavanze n’inkomere bagera batoraguwe mihanda kigali bajyanwa bitaro binyuranye ku itariki mata interahamwe komini ngororero giciye gisenyi zishe abatutsi barenga bahungiye ngoro muvoma mrnd palace harokoka abantu gusa abatutsi bahungiye biro komine gashora mui isar karama barishwe abatutsi bagera biciwe kiliziya ruhuha nkengero zayo komini ngenda bugesera bishwe n’impuzamugambi ndetse n’interahamwe ambasade leta zunze ubumwe amerika usa yarafunzwe abari abadiplomate bayo bahunga u rwanda ingabo zari iza rpa zageze cnd ziturutse i byumba zije gutabara abatutsi bicwaga hano mujyi kigali hirya hino rwanda hishwe abatutsi benshi taliki mata si bonyine bamwe twabashije kukubwira niyomugabo albert muhaburarw

content: kuri gatatu bwongereza hagaragaye abigaragambya kubera iyicwa ry’umwirabura amerika witwa george floyd ahitwa hyde park ho hagaragaye abigaragambya bafatanyije n’imbaga y’abantu bice batandukanye amerika aha habonetse icyamamare boyega yanagaragaye atanga imbwirwaruhame marangamutima yifashishije indangurura majwi igendanwa ubuzima bw’abirabura bwahoranye agaciro twahoze dufite akamaro twahoze dufite dusobanuye twahoze tugira intsinzi hatitawe cyose iki gihe ntabwo ntegereza ntabwo ntegereza amagambo yumvikanye avugwa john boyega umukinnyi filime ufite inkomoko nigeria nkuko bikubiye nkuru dukesha cnn n’ ikirere kitari cyiza abariho bigaragambya bahanganye nabyo babasha gukora icyabazinduye bwongereza hagati nabo bafatanyije amerika bamagana irondaruhu ryaje kuvamo iyicwa ry’umwirabura w’umunyamerika george floyd maboko y’umupolisi minneapolis boyega yanatanze igisa nk’urutonde rw’amazina y’abirabura bagiye bicwa n’abapolisi leta zunze ubumwe amerika ndetse n’abandi harimo stephen lawrence mark duggan boyega ibi ingenzi cyane ndifuza mwumva uburyo biteye uburibwe yakomeje ni ingenzi dukomeza kugenzura bikorwa ndetse tukanamenya byagenze mahora bishoboka kosa yakomeje ashishikariza abirabura b’ abagabo byihariye bakwiye kwita bagore b’ abirabura nyuma y’iyicwa floyd habayeho imyigarangambyo amerika ndetse bice by’uburayi n’ibindi bihugu bitandukanye isi ahanini bihangana n’ibikorwa by’irondaruhu biboneka bihugu byabo bimwe bice byifatanyije n’imbaga amerika harimo u bwongereza ubudage u bufaransa denmark u butariyani syria brazil mexico ireland new zealand canda poland australia u buyapani ndetse n’ahandi hatandukanye iyi myigaragambyo kuba bice batandukanye isi ihuriranye n’ibihe bitari byiza isi guhangana n’indwara y’icyorezo covid- imaze kwandurwa n’abantu barenga miliyoni john boyega umwe bababajwe nurupfu george floyd

title: abandi bantu bafashwe bakurikiranyweho kwiba umuriro w’amashanyarazi
content: ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe ingufu reg cyatangaje mukwabu wakozwe cyumweru nzeri hafashwe abantu bakekwaho kwiba amashanyarazi bakoresha zabo cyangwa bikorwa by’ubucuruzi ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe ingufu reg cyatangaje mukwabu wakozwe cyumweru nzeri hafashwe abantu bakekwaho kwiba amashanyarazi bakoresha zabo cyangwa bikorwa by’ubucuruzi ni umukwabu wakozwe reg ifatanyije n’inzego zirimo urwego rw’igihugu rw’ubugenzacyaha rib polisi y’u rwanda n’abaturage ku nzeri hafashwe nsanzabera daniel n’umuyobozi koperative ceptl mirenge gahunga cyanika karere burera bakekwaho kwiba amashanyarazi bakoresha zabo kuri tariki kandi murenge gahunga hafatiwe kanani benjamin n’umuhungu nsanzabera daniel bakekwaho kwiba umuriro bakoresha nzu ebyiri ikorerwamo ububaji n’indi irimo icyuma gishya naho nzeri hafashwe ndadaye melchior rutazihana damascne sibomana jean claude murenge nduba karere gasabo bakekwaho kwiba ibikoresho by’amashanyarazi reg hanafashwe nzamurambaho felicien niyonzima joseph hitimana eugene ayirwanda benoit bakekwaho kwiba amashanyarazi bakoresha zabo murenge tumba karere huye ku nzeri hategekimana jean baptiste yafashwe akekwaho kwiba amashanyarazi centre y’ubucuruzi gaseke murenge kabaya karere ngororero hanafatwa bigirimana lonard uhakorera ubucuruzi ku nzeri murenge kamembe karere rusizi hafatiwe nshimiyimana emmanuel wafatanywe ibikoresho byifashishwa kwiba amashanyarazi nzeri i kabuga murenge rusororo karere gasabo hafatirwa kubwimana eric akekwaho kwiba amashanyarazi akoresha nzu atuyemo muri abantu barafunzwe ndetse amadosiye gukurikiranwa rib abandi babiri aribo kanani benjamin n’umuhungu nsanzabera daniel baratorotse gushakishwa umuyobozi ushinzwe kurwanya ibihombo eucl-reg nkubito stanley yamaganye ubujura bw’amashanyarazi avuga butazihanganirwa kandi ingamba kuburwanya zakajijwe yongeyeho bujura bukoma nkokora iterambere ry’igihugu kandi bushobora guteza ibibazo bitandukanye nkubito yavuze abenshi bafashwe byashobotse bufatanye bw’abaturage n’amatangazo yatanzwe ahamagarira abaturage gufatanya n’inzego z’umutekano kugaragaza abiba amashanyarazi kuva ukuboza reg ikoresha uburyo butandukanye gutahura abakora ubujura bw’amashanyarazi kugira bagezwe butabera imibare reg yerekana igihombo bucuruzi bw’ingufu z’amashanyarazi kikiri hejuru kuko kingana ijana by’ingufu zitunganywa gihugu hose kandi ahanini giterwa n’ubwo bujura imibare y’umwaka ushize igaragaza umuriro wibwe ufite agaciro miliyari frw itegeko rigenga amashanyarazi rwanda nk’uko ryahinduwe kugeza riteganya umuntu winjira mubazi buryo butemewe ukoresha uburyo butemewe gufata gukururakuyobya gutuma hafatwa havanwa muyoboro w’umuriro w’amashanyarazi cyangwa ukoresha umuriro w’amashanyarazi yahawe buryo bw’uburiganya cyangwa butemewe n’amategeko akoze icyaha iyo abihamijwe n’urukiko ahanishwa igifungo kitari munsi y’amezi atandatu ariko kitarenze umwaka umwe n’ihazabu y’amafaranga y’u rwanda atari munsi frw ariko atarenze frw cyangwa kimwe gusa bihano

title: ti-rwanda igiye gukurikiranira umushinga gicumbi uzatwara miliyoni
content: umushinga kwita bidukikije karere gicumbi uzamara imyaka itandatu ukazakorerwa mirenge itandatu y’ako karere ariyo rubaya cyumba kaniga mukarange rushaki shangasha imibare y’ubushakashatsi bwakozwe n’umuryango urwanya ruswa n’akarengane yerekana imishinga yerekeye imihindagurikire y’ikirere yabayeho rwanda yagiye irangwa n’ibura ry’uruhare rw’abaturage rimwe rimwe n’abayobozi nzego z’ibanze ugasanga batayizi ibyo bigatuma abayishyira bikorwa bakoresha ingengo y’imari yayo buryo abagenerwabikorwa badasobanukiwe umuyobozi nshingwabikorwa ti rwanda mupiganyi apolinaire asobanura imibare yerekana abaturage batari bazi iby’iyo mishinga ndetse hari n’abayobozi nzego z’ibanze bagera nabo ntibagishijwe inama harebwe ariyo bakeneye cyangwa bamenye uruhare rwabo ati hari imbogamizi twabonye mishinga itandukanye biogaz n’indi mishinga igerageza kugabanya kwangiza ibidukikije dushingiye bibazo twabonye isesengura twakoze yindi mishinga yabanje twafashe iya mberengo turebe twatera ingabo bitugu gahunda y’igihugu cyacu guha uruhare umuturage kugira amenye ibimukorerwa avuga bizatuma bagira uruhare rukomeye bafatanyije n’indi miryango inzego n’umuturage kugira ibipimo by’abagenerwabikorwa bavugaga batazi ibikorerwa bigabanyuke ati turemera tuzamuye imyumvire y’umuturage gukorera mucyo kubaza utanga serivisi yakoze atabikurikiranye akabibazwa bizafasha kugira uriya mushinga w’icyitegererezo gicumbi uzagere ntego twifuza hanyuma bishobore gukorerwa tundi turere yongeyeho bagendeye babonye bushakashatsi bakoze mushinga munini mbere fonerwa ikoze ugomba kurindwa rusahurira nduru umuyobozi mukuru fonerwa hubert ruzibiza yavuze binjiye bufatanye ti rwanda kugira uzabafashe ikurikiranabikorwa bityo abagenerwabikorwa abafatanyabikorwa n’igihugu bawitezeho bizagerweho ati mu by’ukuri amafaranga menshi kandi ibyitezwe biri hejuru cyane yaba muturage yaba twebwe leta cyangwa n’ikigega cyita bidukikije cyateye inkunga mushinga yongeyeho hari uburyo butandukanye burimo ikoranabuhanga buzatuma umuturage ashobora gutanga igitekerezo abona umushinga gukorerwa buryo makuru yagera bafatanyabikorwa b’umushinga mahanga biteganyijwe myaka itandatu mushinga uzafasha abaturage kugabanya imyuka gaz carbonique co ingana toni uzagera baturage ugirire akamaro abarenga rusange

title: umunyamideli alexia mupende yunamiwe birori rwanda fashion week amafoto
content: ibi birori byabereye kaminuza y’u rwanda ishami ry’ikoranabuhanga school of architecture and environment sabe mugoroba kamena ni nshuro kane byari bibaye by’umwihariko n’iya mbere bifashe izina rwanda fashion week dore imyaka yindi yabanje byitwaga collective rwanda fashion week ni ubwa mbere kandi byari bibereye ahantu hadatwikiriye outdoor runway ndetse abamurika imideli bakoraga urugendo rujya kuba rurerure baca imbere y’abantu babarirwa baje kwihera ijisho ahagana saa moya n’igice abantu benshi bamaze kugera myanya ubanyujijemo ijisho abenshi ab’igitsina gore kandi bambaye neza bigaragara kurimba babisobanukiwe aba barimo abana perezida repubulika y’u rwanda paul kagame barimo ange ingabire kagame n’umukunzi bertrand ndengeyingoma uwari uyoboye birori kwizera arnold yatangiye avuga munsi udasanzwe kuko itariki nk’iyi myaka itandatu ishize aribwo nyina yashyinguwe igikorwa nyirizina kumurika imideli cyatangijwe sonia mugabo itsinda collective rwanda imideli yerekanye iyambarwa n’abagore igizwe n’amakanzu amakabutura n’ibisurubeti jumpsuit imideli yerekanwaga n’abakobwa bafite izina mwuga fiona muthoni umutoni georgette neza rachel isheja morella umutoniwase belise belinda impanga zahatanye miss rwanda n’abandi inzu y’imideli imaze imyaka irindwi ikorera rwanda rwanda clothing niyo yakurikiyeho mbere y’uko abanyamideli batambuka kwizera uyoboye ibirori yasabye ababyitabiriye guhaguruka bagafata umwanya kwibuka alexia mupende umunyamideli wubatse izina wishwe mutarama n’abantu bataramenyekana alexia mupende yakoranaga rwanda clothing kwamamaza imideli ndetse yafashije benshi banyamideli bigaragaje birori rwanda clothing yerekanye imideli y’abagabo n’abagore yambarwa birori igizwe n’amakote amakanzu n’amashati y’ubwoko butandukanye umunya-nigeria emmanuel okoro washinze inzu y’imideli emmy nesbit yanambitse minisitiri w’intebe w’u bwongereza theresa may yerekanye imideli mwanya gatatu imideli igizwe n’iy’abagabo n’abagore yari yanditseho amagambo rurimi rw’iwabo maison aline lisa b marler berekanye imideli y’abagore igizwe n’amakanzu magufi n’amaremare ibara ry’umweru n’umukara gusa abanyamideli babaga bafite amasakoshi yakorewe rwanda house tayo mathew rugamba yerekanye imyenda y’abagabo n’abagore igitekerezo cyayo akaba yaragikomoye bashumba b’inka inzu y’imideli k’tsobe yatangijwe sarah legrand yerekanye imideli igaragaza umuco afurika abakobwa bambaye amakanzu akoze bigaragara nk’ibishura bakenyereye hejuru y’amabere n’abahungu bakenyereye gice hasi hejuru bambaye ubusa bose nkweto bambaye abahanzi b’imideli bane bakizamuka ingabire claudine falon rusamaza grace emmanuel bahawe umwanya berekana imyenda buri umwe yagendaga yerekana imideli ibiri ibiri nyuma y’aba bahanzi b’imideli bakizamuka hafashwe akaruhuko abantu bica icyaka babifashijwemo n’ikinyobwa gishya mutzig class bralirwa iheruka gushyirwa isoko cyagenewe by’umwihariko abiganjemo urubyiruko n’abakuze bakunda ibirori inzu y’imideli moshions niyo yatangiye igice kabiri moses turahirwa yerekanye imideli yise inkingi mu banyamideli berekanye imideli moshions harimo cedric amizero usanzwe umuhanzi w’imideli wafatanyije n’umukinnyi w’ikipe mukura vs iradukunda bertrand inzuki designs yakurikiyeho yerekana imirimbo irimo amaherena inigi udukapu two ntoki ydukoze migwegwe n’inkweto zifunguye sandals ziriho imitako ikoze migwegwe munezero jean vainqueur washinze inzu y’imideli maison munezero ugaragaye nshuro mbere rwanda fashion week yerekanye amakanzu y’abakobwa magufi uzi collection yinjiye ihuriro collective rwanda yerekanye amakanzu maremare yagenewe kwambarwa birori bikomeye nk’ubukwe n’imyenda y’abagabo inzu y’imideli haute baso yerekanye imideli itandukanye irimo amashati amakoti amapantalo amasarubeti jumpsuit bagore n’abagabo inzu y’imideli orange culture nigeria niyo yasoje birori yerekana imideli yiganjemo igaragaza imyambarire igezweho gihugu amafoto serge muhizi

title: kugirango perezida ucyuye igihe ajye sena azajya amanza kwandika abisaba
content: nk’uko ingingo itegeko nshinga nk’uko ryavuguruwe uvuga kugirango perezida repubulika uzajya uva butegetsi buryo bwiza kugirango yemererwe kuba umu senateri azajya kumanza akandikira inteko sena ayisaba yakwinjira sena hanyuma nteko ikabyigaho ikabona kumusubiza nyuma y’iminsi yaba yemerewe akabona kuba yaba umusenateri itegeko nshinga u rwanda rugenderaho riteganya perezida ucyuye igihe yemerewe ubusenateri ariko akagomba kwandikira perezida w’urukiko rw’ikirenga abisaba urukiko rukabyigaho abadepite batoye yego watoye oya haboneka imfabusa ayo matora yabaye nyuma nyuma y’impungenge babanje kugaragaza bavuga gutegeka perezida repubulika kwandika asaba asanzwe ayobora ukumusuzuguza kutazirikana yakoze depite eugene barikana ntibyumvikana neza kumva perezida repubulika n’ibyo yarakoze kujya gusaba asanzwe ayobora kuki atabyemererwa atabanje kubisaba depite niyonsenga kimwe n’abandi badepite batandukanye bavuze ngingo yunze barikana kuri ubundi perezida repubulika yakarangije manda bushake bwe agahita aza sena akandikira perezida repubulika aje sena ntajye kwandikira perezida sena depite muhongayire kumvikanisha impungenge ze yibukije abadepite bagenzi umuntu asabye ashobora kwemererwa cyangwa guhakanirwa akavuga byaba bibabaje perezida aramutse asabye kuba umusenateri akabyangirwa ingingo isobanura ibyiciro bitatu abasenateri barimo abatowe abashyizweho n’abahoze abakuru b’igihugu ahereye depite mujawamariya yavuze uwahoze umukuru w’igihugu yemerewe guhita umusenateri kuko cyiciro gatatu kubisaba ntabwo bikwiye nyuma y’ibyo bitekerezo by’abadepite batandukanye visi-perezida w’inteko ishinga amategeko ushinzweamategeko madame uwimanimpaye yabamaze impungenge ababwira ahubwo inzira zateganywaga n’itegeko nshinga ririho ziremereye kurushaho bityo byorohejwe yagize ndagira mbibutse itegeko nshinga ririho rivuga perezida repubulika ucyuye igihe agomba kwandikira urukiko rw’ikirenga rugaca urubanza byari biremereye kuza nteko uburenganzira ahabwa n’itegeko nshinga ariko bikwiye kugira inzira bicamouburyo abadepite batoye ingingo bugaragaza banyuzwe cyane n’ibisobanuro madame uwimanimpaye kuko hagaragaye imfabusa abandi bayitoye wayanze nyuma content: murangwa asimbuye uwamurera salama watowe minsi ishize urukiko rw’ikirenga rukanga kumwemeza kubera ubunararibonye afite butamwemerera kujya mwanya amatora gusimbura uwamurera yabaye kane cyicaro cy’ihuriro ry’imitwe politiki yemewe rwanda giherereye kacyiru hiyamamaje abakandida batatu hatorwa murangwa hadidja pdi majwi athanase nahimana ps imberakuri yagize amajwi ane masozera icyizanye jacky democratic green party of rwanda agira amajwi n’impfabusa perezida pdi harerimana fazil yashimiye abahagarariye imitwe politiki bagiriye icyizere ishyaka ayoboye ashingiye bunararibonye bwe yavuze hadidja azafatanya n’abandi neza sena ati twakiriye neza icyizere abahagarariye amashyaka baduhaye turabashimira kandi tubizeza tuzakomeza gushaka abakandida beza igihe cyose bizaba bikenewe umuyobozi w’ihuriro ry’imitwe politiki mukabunani yavuze bujuje inshingano zabo azamezwa n’urukiko rw’ikirenga kandi avuga kuba barasabwe gutora mukandida kibazo ahubwo byemeza buri rwego ruba rwakoze inshingano zarwo ati abanyarwanda bumve inzego zifite zikora kuba twasubiyemo amatora ntabwo igitangaza gusa buri rwego ruba rwakoze inshingano zarwo murangwa ndangiza hadija inzobere bijyanye n’imisoro akaba n’umunyamategeko bijyanye n’imisoro ni umwe bagize inama y’ubutegetsi banki nkuru y’igihugu bnr ni umunyamuryango w’ikigo mpuzamahanga cy’ubukemurampaka kigali kiac yakoze mishinga itandukanye yiga misoro n’ubucuruzi yabaga ihuriweho n’imiryango mpuzamahanga ndetse guverinoma y’u rwanda yakoze akazi k’ubujyanama bigo mpuzamahanga international finance corporation ifc umushinga guhuza imisoro eac n’ibindi kuri yakoraga nk’impuguke ishinzwe igenamigambi n’iterambere ry’ikigo kigo cy’ababaruramari b’umwuga rwanda icpar yagiye nama z’ubutegetsi z’ibigo bitandukanye rwanda nko banki itsura amajyambere brd ishami rishinzwe ubuvuzi gisikare mmi kigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe ubuzima rbc murangwa asanze nkusi juvenal w’ishyaka psd wamaze gutorerwa guhagararira ihuriro ry’imitwe politiki sena

nshimyumuremyi umuyobozi wungirije kaminuza izo nterahamwe zahabwaga kandi inkunga n’ubuyobozi bwazo rwego rw’igihugu ndetse abakuru bazo barimo kajuga robert mbonabaryi leoni mudahinyuka jean marie title: abarokotse ibitero by’abacengezi i nyange basabye leta kubafasha kwivuza ibikomere by’intambara
content: intwari z’imena z’i nyange zagaragaje hari zimaze kugera ziyubaka ariko zisaba leta gufasha bamwe kwiga amashuri atandukanye kuvuza abafite ibikomere bikeneye abaganga b’inzobere buvuzi buteye imbere mu biganiro byahuje ntwari n’inzego zitandukanye leta kabiri tariki ukuboza bavuze ibikomere kudindira batewe n’intambara y’abacengezi byatumye bamwe batabasha gukomeza kwiga kaminuza n’andi mashuri bityo bakaba bagowe guhatana isoko ry’umurimo banagaragaje kandi hakenewe ubuvuzi bantu bakomeretse buryo bukomeye kuko hari abagifite ibisigazwa by’amasasu mibiri bakeneye kubagwa ubumenyingiro bwabafasha guhatana isoko ry’umurimo bityo babashe gukomeza kubaho kuri byifuzo minisitiri w’umuco siporo uwacu julienne yabwiye itangazamakuru bufatanye minisiteri y’uburezi harebwa bafasha ntwari z’imena kwiga yagize bamwe bagaragaje bashaka kwiga imyuga abandi gukomeza kwiga kaminuza hazabaho ubufatanye kugira abashaka kwiga bakomeze bige n’abashaka gukora imishinga ibafasha title: ikawa n’icyayi ibihingwa bifitiye runini u rwanda
content: nk’uko ntakirutimana corneille umuyobozi mukuru wungurije ushinzwe kuzamura umusaruro w’ibyoherezwa mahanga rwanda kigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe kwita byoherezwa mahanga naeb abitangaza bihingwa inkuru y’ubuzima bwe sudani y’epfo amaze igihe kiyingayinga umwaka butumwa kubungabunga amahoro unmiss tariki kamena ssp urujeni jackline yayoboye itsinda ry’abapolisi biganjemo abagore berekeje butumwa bw’amahoro i juba sudani y’epfo bafite inshingano kurinda inkambi z’impunzi ibikorwaremezo n’ubutabazi mu kiganiro yagiranye n’umukozi loni ssp urujeni yahishuye byinshi buzima bwe bugaragaza ishusho rusange y’abapolisi b’u rwanda kumwe butumwa bw’amahoro loni ushobora gutangira utwibwira nshamake urujeni amazina nge urujeni jackline nturuka rwanda mfite imyaka y’ubukure ndubatse mfite umugabo n’abana batatu maze imyaka ndi umupolisi mfite ipeti senior superintendent loni kuri uherereye he urujeni ndi umuyobozi w’itsinda ry’abapolisi b’u rwanda riri butumwa bw’amahoro i juba sudani y’epfo loni ni izihe nshingano ufite butumwa urujeni inshingano zange nyinshi itsinda ryacu rigizwe n’abapolisi kimwe kabiri cyabo abagore ndabayobora ngakurikirana n’akazi kabo buri munsi mpuza ibikorwa ngategura gahunda gucunga umutekano mujyi nkambi zicumbikiye abaturage bakuwe byabo idp muri bice turinda amarembo magari tugaherekeza abakozi b’imiryango itabara imbabare n’abakozi loni tugategura n’ibikorwa gufata intwaro ibiyobyabwenge n’ibindi bintu byose biri baturage buryo bunyuranyije n’amategeko tugira n’ibikorwa n’ubukangurambaga bugamije kongerera ubushobozi abaturage bacumbitse turinda cyane cyane ab’igitsina gore loni umunsi wawe usanzwe uba umeze ute urujeni ntangira umunsi wange saa kumi n’imwe gitondo niruka ibirometero byibuze gatatu cyumweru mu kazi nge uyobora gahunda gutegura akazi buri munsi saa tubanza gusubira byabaye masaha yashize tukungurana ibitekerezo gukemura ibibazo bishobora kubangamira akazi kacu tugasubiramo inshingano buri munsi tukanazigabana buri munsi nshyira ruhande isaha akenshi biba hagati saa yine saa tanu mugitondo ngasura buri ofisiye wifuza guhura nge by’umwihariko tukaganira ngingo zitandukanye uhereye bijyanye n’akazi ukageza buzima bwacu bwite igihe kinini nkimara biro ariko buri gihe mba nkurikiranye icyombo numva akazi karimo kugenda ngafata ibyemezo igihe biri ngombwa loni igihe cyawe utari kazi ugikoresha ute urujeni iyo mbonye agahenge nkunda kujya gym inzu ikorerwamo imyitozo ngororamubiri cyangwa nkavugana n’umuryango nge wasigaye rwanda ikindi nsabana bagenzi bange nkagira uruhare siporo zitandukanye ibirori n’ibindi bikorwa biduhuza bitegurwa rwego kutwongerera imbaraga morali n’ubuzima buzira umuze loni umaze igihe kingana butumwa bw’amahoro bw’umuryango w’abibumbye byagenze gute ube umwe babugize urujeni nageze hano i juba guhera kamena ariko mbere kuza sudani y’epfo hagati - nagiye butumwa bw’amahoro mbere i darfur sudani kubera nigeze kubona imibabaro myinshi gihugu cyange nkanyurwa n’uburyo abantu cyane cyane ubuyobozi bw’igihugu bakoze itandukaniro rifatika bagahindura igihugu paradiso ndetse ubuzima bw’abantu bukarushaho kuba bwiza nakuye isomo bikorwa by’indashyikirwa mfata umwanzuro nge ngomba kugira ikintu nkorera abandi gisobanutse by’umwihariko nk’umugore ndashaka kugaragaza uburyo abagore dufite imbaraga kandi dushoboye kubaka amahoro n’ubumwe loni ni umuryango n’inshuti zawe batekereje kemezo wafashe gihugu ugiye butumwa bw’amahoro loni urujeni ubwo nabibwiraga umuryango wange ntibabashije kubyizera baratunguwe birabayobera ndetse ntibishimiye kemezo gato byansabye igihe kubasobanurira agaciro kabyo kugira basubire murongo narababwiye nti murebe hari benshi bakoze nk’ibi mbere nge kandi byagenze neza nabasobanuriye mbifata kujya butumwa bw’amahoro mahanga bimwe bigize akazi kange nyuma y’igihe batangiye kunyumva ubu barishimye kandi baterwa ishema n’ibyo nkora loni ni ibihe bintu by’ingenzi wishimira butumwa bw’amahoro urimo urujeni nkunda mbasha kugaragaza itandukaniro buzima bw’abantu ndaguha urugero nyuma y’igihe gito tugeze kamena twoherejwe kurinda inkambi mpageze nabonye mbere hantu ho kwisukurira hahabaga by’umwihariko bagore n’abakobwa bityo nge bagenzi nge twiyemeje kububakira ubwiherero bugikoresha kugeza n’ubu loni ni ibihe bintu ukunda cyane butumwa gihugu ukoreramo urujeni nkunda ukwihangana n’urugwiro byabaturage sudani y’epfo nubwo bamaze igihe kinini makimbirane n’intambara baracyafiteurukundo ndetse bagerageza guhora bareba ruhande rwiza nkunda ibiganiro tugirana n’abagore bacumbikiwe nkambi kumva ikizere bagore badufitiye ikintu cy’agaciro gakomeye akenshi ntibanadufata nk’abapolisi-twahindutse inshuti n’abavandimwe ahubwo abenshi baduhamagara bakuru barumuna sisters noneho hari n’akana gato k’agahungu kabo kanyita mama loni ni hehe ubona ibyago nshingano zawe kubera urujeni ibyago mbere mugenzi wange ahohotewe cyangwa agakomeretswa turi hano dukora ibyiza ariko umwe twe ahohotewe bidushyira bihe bikomeye nge biranambabaza cyane guhohotera bagenzi nge bimwe bituma twe nk’abari butumwa bw’amahoro by’umwihariko abagore dukaza umurego ndetse tukarushaho gukorana n’abaturage bikorwa biduhuza uko duhura kenshi tuzigarurira imitima bitume twumvisha buri umwe impamvu twaje sudani y’epfo rusange by’umwihariko muu nkambi loni utekereza abagore butumwa bw’amahoro bashobora kuba bandebereho urujeni tugira uruhare rukomeye cyane kugarurira ikizere abagore n’abakobwa hano ibihugu byinshi by’afurika n’imico yabyo usanga iyobowe n’abagabo n’abantu benshi abagore n’abagabo bumva umugore ataba umupolisi adashobora kwikorera ibiremereye cyangwa afate imbunda abagore hano bambajije ibibazo byinshi acyane cyane igihe bamenyaga nge uyoboye itsinda rinini ry’abapolisi bamwe barambajije bati ni gute wabaye umuyobozi w’abapolisi ese gihugu cyawe mugira abagabo byanyeretse abagore n’abakobwa hano batangiye gusobanukirwa uburenganzira bwabo kuba bashaka kuba kuri bumva abakobwa batabaho gusa bazashyingirwe babyare turagenda dufungurira amaso kubona andi mahirwe n’amahitamo mashya bakwiye kuba bemererwa gufata loni ni wabwira abagore bifuza kujya butumwa bw’amahoro urujeni iteka nkangurira abagore kuba abarinzi b’amahoro kandi mbonesha amaso nge abagore dukenewe cyane kandi twagaragaza itandukaniro rikomeye hari ibintu byinshi twakemura nk’abagore abagabo bagenzi bacu batashobora cyangwa bashobora kubona nk’ibibagoye urugero nko kugira n’abagore n’abakonwa bahohotewe babagirire ikizere icyo kizere kivamo amakuru menshi adufasha kurushaho kunoza akazi kacu kubarinda guhindura imibereho ikarushaho kuba myiza chief editor muhaburarw

title: uruganda master steel rwabaye umushoramari w’umwaka bihembo rdb business excellence awards
content: ikigo cy’igihugu cy’iterambere rdb nshuro karindwi cyahembye abashoramari babaye indashyikirwa mwaka igihembo nyamakuru cy’umushoramari w’umwaka cyegukanywe master steel ltd rukora ibikoresho by’ubwubatsi ibi bihembo bizwi rdb business excellence awards byatanzwe ijoro ryo mutarama gikorwa cyabereye kigali convention centre muri rusange hatanzwe ibihembo icyenda igihembo cy’umushoramari w’umwaka cyahawe master steel ltd yahembwe kuzatembereza abakozi batanu b’iki kigo bakajya gusura ingagi birunga rwiyemezamirimo w’umugore wahize abandi yabaye bufcoffee ltd ikigo cyagaragaje agashya gikora cyabaye sosiyete y’itumanaho mtn rwanda rwiyemezamirimo ukiri muto yabaye awesomity lab wahawe miliyoni ebyiri z’amafaranga y’u rwanda rwiyemezamirimo ukora ubucuruzi buto n’ubuciritse yabaye kwitabira ishoramari rihuriwehomu ishoramari rihuriweho n’abanyarwanda n’abanyamahanga ryihariye y’ishoramari ryose by’umwihariko ibigo bito n’ibiciriritse smes minisitiri w’intebe ndabizeza guverinoma y’u rwanda izakomeza kunoza korohereza ishoramari kugira abashora imari imbere gihugu barusheho kwiyongera guverinoma y’u rwanda yiyemeje gushyigikira kongerera ubushobozi urubyiruko hagamijwe kurufasha kwihangira imirimo yashishikarije kandi rwiyemezamirimo b’urubyiruko kubyaza umusaruro amahirwe atandukanye igihugu cyabahaye kugira barusheho guteza imbere ibikorwa n’imishinga umuyobozi mukuru rdb claire akamanzi yashimiye buri wese wagiye yitabira marushanwa myaka irindwi ishize avuga iby’agaciro yagaragaje uburyo ishoramari ry’igihugu cyarazamutse riva miliyari ebyiri z’amadorali ryariho rigera miliyari yavuze byose byagiye bigirwamo uruhare guverinoma iyobowe perezida repubulika paul kagame byatumye hashyirwaho uburyo bufasha ishoramari gukora neza yagize ni buryo hari impinduka zatumye u rwanda ruza bihugu by’imbere afurika gufasha ishoramari kuko turi maywa kabiri mwanya isi u rwanda kandi nicyo gihugu cyonyine bihugu bikiri nzira y’amajyambere kigaragara bihugu akamanzi yavuze leta izakomeza gufasha abagitangira ubucuruzi n’ibigo binini kugira bikomeze gutera imbere uyu munsi bitwara gusa amasaha atandatu kugira umuntu yandikishe ikigo kandi abashoramari bashobora gusura rdb buri gatanu hagati saa tatu kugeza saa sita bakaba bafashwa gukemurirwa ahari ikibazo

content: jeannette kagame avuga ubuzima bw’abakecuru n’abasaza barokotse jenoside ariko ikabatwarira ababo bureba buri munyarwanda yabivugiye muhango kwibuka nshuro jenoside yakorewe abatutsi umuhango bukomeze kuba bwiza tubatuza neza arongera mboneyeho kwibutsa abanyarwanda ubuzima bw’aba babyeyi butureba twese ndasaba buri wese kubabera ijisho urumuri n’akabando kazabasindagiza yakomeje avuga unity club intwararumuri abereye umuyobozi mukuru bazakomeza kubaba babakorera ubuvugizi kugira babone ibyangombwa bakenera umwe ntwaza ukomoka karere ruhango witwa azela nyirangirumwami yavuze urwo title: imvano y’igitutu cy’u burayi amerika rwanda habyarimana yacudikaga koreya ruguru
content: iyo koreya isa n’iyitajwe n’ibihugu yabaye inshuti ikomeye y’u rwanda butegetsi perezida habyarimana juvnal gihe cy’intambara y’ubutita kugeza leta zunze ubumwe amerika n’u burayi zari zimurabye ivu bikamusaba amayeri atabizira habyarimana yashatse gukina amayeri amerika n’u burayi bamuha gasopo ikibazo kutavuga rumwe koreya ruguru n’iy’epfo zacikagamo kabiri cyakomeje gukururuka kigeza habyarimana yafataga ubutegetsi rwanda nk’umuntu ugiye butegetsi vuba yagombaga gushaka ibihugu by’inshuti ariko agahera bitari bisanzwe bifitanye ubushuti n’u rwanda kugira inkunga iva hanze yiyongere koreya ruguru ishyigikiwe n’ibihugu by’u bushinwa leta zunze ubumwe z’abasoviyeti iy’epfo ishyigikiwe n’u burayi leta zunze ubumwe amerika ibihugu byinshi afurika byari byarahisemo guca umubano n’ibindi bikoresha communisme nacyo gice koreya ruguru yabarizwagamo kugira shebuja b’i burayi amerika babirebe neza hato badakoma rutenderi ingoma zabo zigahirima leta habyarimana yashakaga ubufasha kwimenyekanisha mahanga yatangiye kugenda rwihishwa ikorana n’ibihugu bikoresha communisme dore bihe byatangaga inkunga itubutse kandi itariho amananiza menshi nk’ayo amerika n’u burayi bashyiragaho u rwanda rwatangiye kwiyegereza koreya ruguru nayo irarukundira umubano uratangira tariki mata rwanda haje itsinda ryo koreya ruguru riyobowe n’uwari minisitiri wungirije w’ububanyi n’amahanga chun nyung soo ryakirwa perezida habyarimana icyo gihe radio rwanda yatangaje koreya ruguru yemeye gufasha u rwanda bijyanye n’amahugurwa y’urubyiruko kubaka inzu mberabyombi y’urubyiruko n’ibindi radio rwanda kandi yavuze iryo tsinda ryashyikirije habyarimana ubutumwa buvuye perezida kim il song koreya ruguru inyandiko z’ibanga ambasade leta zunze ubumwe amerika rwanda bihe zashyizwe hanze n’urubuga wikileaks zigaragaza koreya ruguru nyuma yaje kwemera guha imyitozo urubyiruko rw’ishyaka mrnd ryari butegetsi gutoza abasirikare ibijyanye n’akarasisi n’ibindi uruzinduko rw’intumwa koreya ruguru rwanda rwaje gihe koreya zombi zari biganiro kwiyunga ariko bigatambamirwa n’ibindi bihugu bikomeye abasesenguzi gihe bavugaga koreya ruguru gihambaye yashakaga rwanda kitari ijwi ryarwo muryango w’abibumbye habyarimana gihe yabwiye itsinda koreya ruguru u rwanda rufata ikibazo kiri hagati koreya zombi nk’icy’imbere gihugu gikwiriye gukemurwa hatajemo ukuboka kw’amahanga umubano w’ibihugu byombi warakuze ndetse koreya ruguru ifungura ambasade yayo i kigali mu ukwakira inyandiko z’ibanga ambasade amerika zigaragaza habyarimana afatanyije ambasade koreya ruguru bashyizeho komite yiga kongera kwiyunga koreya zombi inama yabereye nyubako z’uwari uhagarariye koreya ruguru rwanda iyo komite igizwe n’abajyanama mrnd umuyobozi mukuru ushinzwe ububanyi n’amahanga perezidansi minisiteri y’ububanyi n’amahanga n’abandi iyo nama yabaye buri buke umunyamabanga mukuru mrnd wafatwaga nk’umuntu kabiri ukomeye butegetsi ajye ruzinduko i pyongyang iyo komite yashimwe cyane djeun yeung oun ushinzwe ibikorwa ambasade koreya ruguru i kigali yavuze gushyiraho komite bizongera ubushuti n’umubano by’ubukungu w’ibihugu byombi nubwo u rwanda rwakoraga ibishoboka byose rushimishe title: uretse sida menya indwara umubyeyi yakwanduza umwana gihe amutwite
content: iyo umwana nda nyina atungwa n’ibiturutse nyina akenshi bica ngobyi umwana arimo placenta nayo imuhitiramo ibigomba kumutunga akure ndetse ikanamurinda ibyamugirira nabi ariko kandi hari indwara zimwe zimwe ngobyi idashobora kurwanya izibuze kwinjira ngobyi twaganiriye dr rulisa umuganga w’inzobere kuvura indwara z’abagore gynecologue atubwira zimwe dr rulisa ni nyinshi ariko wenda mpereye hano rwanda hari vihsida hepatite ndetse bushakashatsi twakoze twasanze malaria umubyeyi ashobora kuyanduza umwana nda hari infections zandura nk’izitwa toxoplasmose rubeoleiseru ariko ziriya abagore bakunze kugira gitsina ntabwo zanduza umwana nda nyamara nubwo muganga yatubwiye ndwara umubyeyi ashobora kurwara gitsina zidashobora kugera mwana ababyeyi benshi bavuga hari umwana avukana ibibazo by’uburwayi bw’amaso abaforomo bakamubwira yabitewe bene ndwara gitsina kuri ngingo dr rulisa yadusobanuriye agira iyo yarwaye bene ndwara gitsina umwana akavuka buryo busanzwe abantu bakunzwe kwita kubyara neza ariko umuganga wamubyaje atabanje kubitegura amuhe umuti nibyo ashobora kumwanduza ariko ntaba yamwanduje akiri nda ahubwo umwana yandura ageze gice ndwara irimo nta handi hantu umwana ashobora kurwara mavangingo yanduye gitsina cy’umugore umwana aca ntashobora kwanduza uruhu cyangwa ahandi keretse maso gusa dr rulisa kandi yatubwiye n’igihe umuganga wabyaje umwana atabashije guha umubyeyi umuti arinde umwana kwandura avuka hari umuti uhabwa umwana agakira gihe gito yagize aya maso arakira iyo muganga yabiketse umubyeyi afite burwayi akamubyaza neza hanyuma akamuhanagura hari umuti dutanga gushyira maso witwa tetracycline kugira umwana atazahura n’ibibazo bikomeye by’amaso akenshi bitaro abana bavutse bakunda kubaha muti kugira umwana yanduye abe yakira kuko ntabwo uburwayi bukomeye akenshi bihita bikira hari n’ubwo umwana atabona muti ariko kubera ubwirinzi bw’umubiri bikikiza twasuye n’urubuga passeportsantenet bavuga izindi ndwara umubyeyi ashobora kwanduza umwana gihe amutwite harimo diyabete niyo mpamvu buri gihe umubyeyi utwite agomba kwisuzumisha kenshi gashoboka yaba yumva muzima cyangwa atameze neza kugira ubuzima bwe bubungwabungwe ariko kandi hanitabwe cyane kubw’uwo atwite arindwe kuzavukana bimwe bibazo

title: covid- minagri yasabye abahinzi guhinga bivuye inyuma
content: musabyimana jean claude umunyamabanga uhoraho minagri minisiteri y’ubuhinzi n’ubworozi irasaba abahinzi kutagira umwanya n’umwe batakaza ibasaba guhinga byinshi bishoboka rwego kongera umusaruro uzafasha abantu kwihaza gihe isi ihanganye n’icyorezo coronavirus musabyimana jean claude umunyamabanga uhoraho minisiteri y’ubuhinzi n’ubworozi minagri yavuze guhangana n’icyorezo coronavirus cyugarije isi umuhinzi asabwa guhinga byinshi hagamijwe kongera umusaruro yagize umuhinzi agomba guhinga izuba ryava imvura yagwa umwuzure watera umuhinzi agomba guhinga kuko utuma babaho ahubwo bagomba guhinga ibiruta bahingaga minsi ishize kuko ibintu biri guhinduka uwo muyobozi yavuze ibiribwa rimwe bimwe byagurirwaga bihugu bituriye u rwanda none ntibishoboka kubera coronavirus akaba mpamvu asaba abaturage kubyaza umusaruro ubutaka bwabo kuko igihugu gitezeho byinshi bikenewe bizafasha abantu gihe guhangana coronavirus ati niba twaguraga ibigori rimwe rimwe tukajya kubishaka tanzaniya ubunyobwa tukabushaka hanze amasaka n’ibindi ibintu biri guhinduka ni ukuvuga dusaba abahinzi uguhinga byinshi bishoboka arongera hari ibihingwa twahisemo guteza imbere minisiteri babihinge bwinshi n’ibindi bakeneye buzima buri munsi ahasigara ho bakahahinga ndetse y’urugo duhinge imboga duhinge byinshi dukeneye bizadufasha kugira twihaze biribwa n’ukeneye kugura abone agura mu kureba uburyo icyifuzo minisiteri y’ubuhinzi gishyirwa bikorwa bihe igihugu gihanganye covid- kigali today yageze turere tunyuranye iganira n’abahinzi ndetse bamwe bakora ubuhinzi bw’umwuga bahuriye mishinga itubura imbuto n’abafite inganda zitunganya umusaruro ibishanga bisaga gihugu bikomeje guhingwa hagamijwe kongera umusaruroibishanga bisaga gihugu bikomeje guhingwa hagamijwe kongera umusaruroniyibizi vincent ukora koperative y’abahinga abasarura bakanatunganya icyayi karere rutsiro avuga n’ubwo hari ikibazo coronavirus imirimo y’ubuhinzi ikomeje biteguye kongera umusaruro w’ubuhinzi kuziba icyuho cyaterwa n’icyo cyorero agira imirimo irakomeje umusaruro w’icyayi ntiwigeze udindira toni munsi uruganda rwajyaga rutunganya n’ubu cyahindutse ziraboneka ndetse gahunda dufite ukugera toni munsi kuko abakozi dukoresha gusaruro guhinga ntaho bagiye baracyakora mu kubarinda kwandura cyorezo dushyiraho gahunda y’isuku buryo babanza gukaraba tukanabasaba guhana intera bakubahiriza n’andi mabwiriza anyuranye leta kigali today kandi yegereye n’abahuriye mushinga horeco ushinzwe kubyaza umusaruro ibyanya ibishanga n’imisozi byuhirwa bigera gihugu nyuma y’amasezerano mushinga wagiranye minagri binyuze kigo cy’igihugu cy’ubuhinzi n’ubworozi rab nyuma y’uko byanya bitunganyijwe leta ni umushinga uhuriwemo n’abaminuje bijyanye n’ubuhinzi bagera nyuma y’uko bavuye kwihugura gihugu israel kugeza bafite abakozi bagera bihumbi bibumbiye makoperative bakorana n’abagoronome b’uwo munshinga ndayizigiye emmanuel umuyobozi horeco avuga bakomeje kongera umusaruro guhangana n’inzara yaterwa coronavirus agira turi gukora nanjye sinshobora kuruhuka ndi murima abakozi bacu ibihumbi kazi urumva se twabahagarika kandi dutekereza imana nidufasha cyorezo kikarangira hagomba kuboneka ibitunga abantu bihagije bitagenze gutyo hakurikiraho icyorezo cy’inzara ahubwo n’agataka kasigaraga kadahinze byanya duhingamo turi kugashakisha gahingwe bihe biri imbere uzasanga igihugu gitungwa n’ibyo cyizigamiye

title: south african airways yasubukuye ingendo zayo rwanda

title: leta uganda yemeje cyumweru gitaha izarekura abanyarwanda bafungiwe magereza atandukanye
content: kuri kane tariki kamena intumwa z’u rwanda n’iza uganda zakoranye inama komite igizwe n’intumwa z’angola repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo yashyiriweho gufasha rugendo gukemura amakimbirane hagati y’ibihugu byombi muri biganiro byabaye hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga leta uganda yahishuye ifunze abanyarwanda barimo byitezwe bazarekurwa cyumweru gitaha intuma z’u rwanda zayobowe minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga n’ubutwererane dr biruta vicent ruhande uganda ziyoborwa minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga sam kutesa ku ruhande rw’abahuza repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo rdc yahagarariwe minisitiri wungirije ushinzwe umutekano n’imibereho y’abaturage gilbert kankonde malamba ho angola ihagarariwe minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga tete antonio leta uganda yemeje cyumweru gitaha izarekura abanyarwanda bafungiwe magereza atandukanye gihugu nk’uko byashimangiwe minisitiri sam kutesa nama minisitiri kutesa yavuze nyuma y’iperereza ryakozwe banyarwanda bafungiwe magereza atandukanye uganda basanze abagera bagomba gushyikirizwa u rwanda bitarenze cyumweru gitaha muhango ukazabera mupaka kagitumba milama yakomeje avuga hari abandi banyarwanda bagifunzwe bakurikiranywe n’ubutabera uganda iyo nama ibanze gusuzuma intambwe imaze guterwa n’ibihugu byombi kubahiriza amasezerano luanda angola yashyizweho umukono perezida repubulika y’u rwanda paul kagame mugenzi uganda yoweri kaguta museveni kanama ibyo biganiro biharurira amayira inama yitezwe guhuza bakuru b’ibihugu n’abahuza ikurikira iheruka kubera i gatuna gashyantare tariki minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga w’u rwanda dr biruta vincent yagaragaje u rwanda rutewe impungenge kuba leta uganda ikomeje kurenga nkana myanzuro yafatiwe nama zabanje kugaragaza gukemura ikibazo kiri mubano w’ibihugu byombi minisitiri biruta yatanze urugero rw’aho itariki z’ukwezi gushize gicurasi abanyarwandakazi babiribajugunywe mupaka w’ibihugu byombi nyuma guhohoterwa n’inzego z’umutekano uganda uganda kandi ikomeje kwinangira kuko kugeza magingo yanze kurekura amagana y’abanyarwanda bar gereza zitandukanye buryo bunyuranyije n’amategeko ikindi kandi uganda inashinjwa guha urwaho kwanga kwitandukanya n’imitwe yitwaje intwaro igamije guhungabanya umutekano w’u rwanda chief editor muhaburarw

title: mu ruhuri rw’ibibazo the ben yakirijwe n’abanyamakuru harimo n’impamvu yatorotse u rwanda- icyo yabivuzeho
content: ubwo yasubizaga uruhuri rw’ibibazo yahaswe n’abanyamakuru i kigali the ben yavuze meddy bajyaga leta zunze ubumwe amerika bahisemo gusigarayo bw’impamvu yita zabo bwite baganiriyeho bombi bakazemeranyaho ibi the ben yabivuze akigera i kigali ukuboza kiganiro n’abanyamakuru yavugaga gitaramo yajemo rwanda east african party kizaba tariki mutarama stade amahoro i remera uyu muhanzi umaze imyaka irenga amerika kuko yagiyeyo tariki nyakanga akigera rwanda yasubije byinshi bibazo yabajijwe n’itangazamakuru haba mugenzi meddy bajyanye amerika yasubizaga itangazamakuru avangavanga indimi cyane avuga ahanini kinyarwanda ariko agakoresha icyongereza n’igifaransa gike gikeku kibazo yagarutseho cyane cyamubazaga impamvu yahisemo kuguma amerika the ben yagisubije adashaka kugira byinshi yerura yagize gusa twahisemo gusigara bw’impamvu zanjye hagati yanjye meddy ariko nyine byari ikosa ntabwo twigeze tuvuga bitari ikosa ariko bitewe dufite umubyeyi mwiza gihugu baranyakiriye none ngarutse rugo ati turi isi y’ibyemezo nakwita bihutiyeho ushobora kwihuta cyane ugahita ufata icyemezo ariko amaherezo ufite umubyeyi mwiza agera akakwemerera kugaruka gihugu cyanjye the ben ariko yagaragaje gihe cyose hanze bakomeje kugaragaza gukunda igihugu gukora ibikorwa bibahuza n’abafana rwanda akerekana nubwo amerika umutima iwabo ati niba mwarakurikiranye mwese twebwe turi abana b’igihugu kuva munota twasohotse gihugu kugeza iherezo rimwe twabaye abandi bantu icyo nemeranya n’umutima wanjye rimwe nigeze nifuza kuba muntu utari ndiwe kuko ndi umunyarwanda kindi kintu cyambuza kuba mushyoma joseph umuyobozi east african promoters bateguye gitaramo gifungura umwaka yavuze byose biri buryo yasobanuye impapuro zibemerera kugitegura zose bazibonye ndetse n’abahanzi bazacyitabira bahari kibazo yagize uko turi gutegura gitaramo igitaramo kizaba kirimo abahanzi b’abanyarwanda gusa nk’uko mubizi nk’igitaramo gitangirira ibindi byose mwaka kabuza kigomba kuba kandi kigomba kuba cyiza kuko turi kugitegura rwego hejuru natwe kugira abanyarwanda babone ahantu umuziki wacu ugeze n’ingufu ufite uretse the ben gitaramo hazaririmbamo yvan buravan charly nina bruce melody yanditswe akayezu jean de dieumuhaburarw

title: binyavanga impirimbanyi y’uburenganzira bw’abatinganyi kenya yapfuye
content: umwanditsi w’umunya-kenya ikimenyabose kubera ahanini ijwi riranguruye kurengera abiyumvanamo bahuje igitsina abatinganyi binyavanga wainaina yapfuye gitondo gatatu tariki gicurasi uyu mugabo w’umunyafurika ndetse anamenyekana nyandiko yise ’how to write about africa’ wainaina n’umwe bantu bashyizwe rutonde time magazine rw’abavuga rikijyana ’time magazine’s most influential people’ kubera guhirimbanira kuvugira ababana bahuje ibitsinamu bantu bazwi kenya yabaye uwa mbere watuye umutinganyi binyavanga wainaina kandi umwe bantu bazwi cyane kenya wafashe iya mbere kwemerera ruhame akavuga umutinganyi umunditsi chimamanda ngozi adichie avuga wainaina ’yagerageje kumvikanisha ubutinganyi abugaragaza nk’ibintu bisanzwe kiremwa muntu’ uyu mwanditsi kandi avuga mugabo yiyumvishemo inshingano kugabanya ikimwaro batinganyibinyavanga wainaina umwanditsi uzwi cyane kubera kuvuganira abatinganyi undi mwanditsi akanaba umusesenguzi w’umunya-kenya witwa nanjala nyabola yavugaga title: perezida kagame yitabiriye inama y’iminsi ibiri ihuza afurika n’u burusiya
content: perezida repubulika paul kagame i sochi burusiya yifatanyije n’abandi bakuru b’ibihugu guverinoma afurika nama ihuje nshuro mbere u burusiya afurika perezida kagame ndetse n’abandi bakuru atangiza inama mugaragaro perezida w’u burusiya vladimir putin yagaragaje u burusiya bushishikajwe gufatanya n’ibihugu afurika guteza imbere ubucuruzi ibikorwaremezo ingufu umutekano ikoranabuhanga senateri bishagara kagoyire bihe bitoroshye anawifuriza gukomera perezida w’ u rwanda paul kagame ashingiye mirimo itandukanye senateri bishagara yakoreye igihugu yavuze u rwanda rugize igihombo gikomeye yongeraho n’ umuryango bifatanyije n’ umuryango senateri bishagara kagoyire bihe bitoroshye anawifuriza gukomera mu gitondo nyakanga nibwo umurambo senateri bishagara kagoyire thrse wakuwe bitaro byitiriwe umwami faisal imihango kumusezeraho cyubahiro ikomereza atuye mudugudu kiyovu akagari kiyovu murenge nyarugenge karere nyarugenge mujyi kigali uyu muhango wakomereje nteko ishinga amategeko y’ u rwanda ahatangiwe ubutumwa bunyuranye bugaruka bigwi nyakwigendera senateri bishagara ubutumwa perezida kagame bwasomwe minisitiri perezidanse hon judith uwizeye yagize tugize igihombo gikomeye tubuze umuyobozi wakungaga igihugu n’ abanyarwanda mu izina ryanjye bwite n’ iry’ umuryango wanjye nifatanyije n’ umuryango hon senateri kagoyire bihe by’ akababaro kandi awifurije gukomera senateri bishagara umurwanashyaka fpr inkontanyi umunyamabanga mukuru rpf inkotanyi francois ngarambe yakomoje bigwi senateri bishagara rugamba kubohora igihugu kugeza avuga atashye ataragawa yagize yafatanyije n’ abandi murimo igamije gushyigikira urugamba kubohora igihugu aho agereye rwanda yashinzwe imirimo itandukanye itoroshye kandi bihe bikomeye mu mirimo yashinzwe nzego zitandukanye senateri bishagara kagoyire yaranzwe kugunda umurimo guharanira buri gihe kuzuza inshingano yahawe akabikorana ubwitange ubuhanga ubwitonzi gukorana neza n’ abandi atabarutse atari yagawa mu izina ry’ abagize umutwe sena perezida sena bernard makuza yavuze abakoranye senateri kagoyire bazi uburyo yakundaga igihugu yakomeje agira mu gihe nk’iki tubuze twakundagaburi wese yisangagaho umuntu abura amagambo akwiye abagize sena tuzakomeza kubanira asize nk’uko yabikoreye benshi yakoranye cyangwa yabanye nabo rwanda muri mwanya dusezera cyubahiro hon bishagara kagoyire therese twakundaga kwita maman tereza turazirikana twishimira ibyamuranze asize nk’umurage senateri bishagara yitabye imana tariki nyakanga aguye bitaro leta zunze ubumwe amerika mbere gushyingura senateri kagoyire byabanjirijwe kandi n’ igitambo misa kumusabira cyabereye paruwasi regina pacis rwanda amateka senateri kagoyire senateri bishagara kagoyire thrse yavutse kuwa ukuboza akaba umusenateri uhagarariye intara y’uburengerazuba yari afite impamyabumenyi y’icyiciro kabiri kaminuza bijyanye n’ibinyabuzima molecular biology sciences nyuma kwiga amashuri abanza kugeza yize amashuri yisumbuye lycee de amani i goma muri repubulika iharanira demokarasi kongo mu mirimo yakoze senateri bishagara kagoyire thrse yayoboye itsinda ry’ubushakashatsi pnlscnls hivaids center - yabaye umuyobozi khi - umwarimu udahoraho yahoze kaminuza nkuru y’u rwanda nur - mu kandi yabaye umujyanama tekiniki save the children-uk perezida profemmes twese -hamwe cocafem great lakes - hagati - yabaye umuyobozi rwego rw’igihugu w’umuryango jhpiego mchip ushamikiye johns hopkins university usaid umujyanama tekiniki gahunda psi - yabaye nama y’ubutegetsi y’icyari ikigega gishinzwe gutera inkunga ibikorwa by’iterambere nzego z’ibanze cyaje guhinduka ikigo gishinzwe iterambere nzego z’ibanze loda - mu - yabaye umwe bagize inama y’ubutegetsi kaminuza yigenga kigali ulk umwe bashinze akaba nama y’ubutegetsi fawe rwanda kuva - kandi yabaye umwe bagize inama y’ubutegetsi white ribbon alliance igamije kurengera ubuzima bw’abagore n’abana senateri kagoyire umusenateri nteko ishinga amategeko y’ u rwanda kugeza atabarutse tariki nyakanga
