title: ngoma polisi yafashe moto imaze amezi abiri yaribwe
content: polisi y’u rwanda ikorera karere ngoma murenge jarama iravuga gatanu tariki ukwakira yafashe umuntu waribye moto akayimarana amezi abiri yarayihinduriye ibyapa biyirangaplaque umuvugizi polisi ntara y’iburasirazuba chief inspector of police cip hamdun twizeyimana avuga umuturage witwa maniraho joseph utuye murenge rukumberi cyumweru cyatangiye tariki ukwakira yatabaje polisi y’u rwanda hashize amezi abiri abuze moto ifite icyapa kiyiranga rct ariko akaba afite amakuru uwayibye yayijyanye murenge jarama yagize maniraho yatubwiye hashize amezi abiri abuze moto aduha nomero zayo moteri kuko afite makuru bayikuyemo ibyuma bakabishyira yindi twahise dutangira igikorwa kuyishaka cip twizeyimana avuga igihe polisi gikorwa kuyishaka habonetse umukanishi atanga amakuru y’uko hari umuntu utuye jarama aherutse guhindurira moto ayimushyiriramo ibindi byuma atitwifashijije makuru y’umukanishi atugeza muntu yahinduriye moto koko tumugezeho tureba nomero moteri dusanga zirahura n’izo maniraho yaduhaye moto amaze amezi abiri yarabuze umuvugizi polisi ntara y’iburasirazuba akomeza avuga bahise bafata uwitwa ufitubuzima eugene ufite imyaka polisi isanganye moto bahamagaye maniraho joseph asanga koko moto iye usibye hari bimwe byuma barayikuyemo ariko nomero moteri zari cip twizeyimana yaboneyeho gusaba abatunze ibinyabiziga kwirinda kubisiga ahabonetse hose batizeye umutekano wabyo yanasabye abagifite ingeso mbi kwiba kubicikaho kuko mahirwe bazabigiriramo atiturakangurira abantu batunze ibinyabiziga cyane cyane biriya bihenze kwirinda kujya babisiga babonye hose title: abahindi bifatanyije n’abanyarwanda kwibuka jenoside y’abatutsi

content: fistule cyangwa kujojoba indwara iterwa n’uko haba habayeho gukomereka gice ndangagitsina cy’umubyeyi gihe arimo kubyara ibyo bigaragara cyane babyeyi batabyarira muganga kandi bakeneye title: stroame yavuye bitaro
content: paul van haver benshi bazi stromae amaze iminsi ubuzima bwe butameze neza kubera ikibazo cy’uburwayi yagize bitaramo afurika yatangiye gutora agatege mu mpera z’icyumweru gishize nibwo stromae yafotowe n’umunyamakuru w’ikinyamakuru het laatste nieuws atembera ahitwa avenue louise mujyi bruxelles ubona ubuzima bwe bwatangiye kuba bwiza sur itangaza stromae yavuye bitaro kuwa gatatu w’icyumweru gishize ndetse itsinda rishinzwe kureberera inyungu ze ryatangiye kwitegura gukomeza urugendo rw’ibitaramo muhanzi yatumiwemo hirya hino isi ibitaramo muhanzi yagombaga gukorera afurika mbere y’uko arwara harimo n’icyo yagombaga kwitabira i kigali kugeza bisa n’ibyamaze gusubikwa burundu ndetse itsinda rireberera inyungu stromae ntacyo ribivugaho byari biteganyijwe muhanzi ufite inkomoko rwanda yagombaga gutaramira i kigali sitade amahoro i remera tariki kamena iki gitaramo kimwe n’ibindi yagombaga gukora kugeza kanama yarabihagaritse mpamvu y’uburwayi nk’uko abashinzwe kureberera inyungu ze babitangaje

title: jurgen kloop yatunguwe n’icyo yise kubyina mbere y’umuziki villareal
content: ni mikino y’igikombe gifatwa murumuna champions league aricyo uefa europa league ikipe liverpool fc iraza kwakira villareal yomuri espanye ni umukino kwishyura kuko ubanza villareal yatsinze - munota wanyuma ikipe villareal yasaga nk’iyatangiye kwizera gukomeza ariko umutoza liverpool yabasetse cyane abibutsa ibyabaye kuyandi makipe yaje kukibuga anifield gikombe mu mukino ubanza wabereye espanye ikipe liverpool yagerageje kwihagararaho nako ihiga igitego hanze ariko biranga umukino ujya kurangira ikipe yavillareal yaje kubona igitego cyayo yabaye impamba nziza kipeyo espanye cyane kuba yarabashije kwirinda gutsindwa igitego hanze ibi nibyo bamwe bakunzi villareal bagendera ho bavuga amahirwe menshi ayabo baranabihuza nabagenzi espanye atletico madrid bagendeye gitego kimwe rugo bakajya gusezerera abadage buyern munich hari champions league umutoza abakinnyi hamwe n’abafana liverpool rusange si babibona baributsa kipe batangira imikino gukuranamo bajyiye bakatishiriza itike yogukomeza kibuga cyabo anifield babanje kuhatsindira manchester united - ku wundi mukino bahasezerereye ikipe wolfsburg kugitego - umukino uhaheruka agatangaza kuko kipe yaje kwishyura dortmund ibitego - yahatsinze umukino ukarangira liverpool istnze mukino kubitego - kuri liverpool umutoza abakinnyi hamwe n’abafana byose birashoboka cyane ataba ubwa mbere iyi kipeya liverpool iherutse gutsindwa swansea umukino shampiyona - umutoza yaruhukije abakinnyi ku mukino mone inkuru nziza umukinnyi emre can araba yagarutse gufatanyana james milner kibuga hagati yanditswe rukundo xavermuhaburarw

title: inkomoko y’insigamugani ’ntibigira rutangira’
content: wakomotse mushambo rutangira w’i nduba butare bwanacyambwe kigali ahagana mwaka ubwo hari ngoma cyilima rujugira asimbuye karemera rwaka ngoma kuko imurashe yamuteye ubumuga guhuma kuko yayihawe itari iye by’irage karemera afite umugaragu witwa rutangira agatura i nduba bwanacyambwe yari yaramugize umutware batoni haciyeho iminsi rwaka arahuma ndetse nyina rukoni arasara rubanda bavuga ingoma yabarashe abiru rubanda babonye rwaka ahumye nyina asaze batumira rujugira aze kwima ingoma y’u rwanda yari yarahungiye se gisaka amaze kumwicira impfizi yitwaga ruhashya rujugira amaze kugera rwanda baramwimika yitwa cyilima amaze kwima se mazimpaka aratanga rutangira ariwe utegeka urugo rw’ibwami n’umuryango w’abashambo barakize baradendeza rujugira amurekera butware nuko bibaho kugeza abanzi rutangira bamuteranyije n’ibwami nyuma y’igitero cy’abarundi mutaga ubwe yatabayemo by’ihururu ubundi abapfumu bamuraguriye azatera u rwanda ruhira abonye ingabo ze ziteye agira ubwuzu bwazo yiyemeza kuzitabaramo atwikisha inzu n’ivu rihowe imaze kuzima abyita uruhira yambara inkindi ajya itabaro ageze rugamba arukomerekeramo akomeretswa n’umunyarwanda wiguze kuzamwica uwo munyarwanda rugira shaza w’i ntora bwanacyambwe yibwe kiraro baramufata bamuzanira cyilima amuhane baramuboha ingoyi imaze kumurembya nimureke nigure’’ bati urigura tukubohore’’ abwira cyilima mpa umuheto n’imyambi ine nzakwicira mutaga’’ cyilima aramwemerera baramubohora bamuha umuheto n’imyambi aratabara koko urugamba rw’abarundi n’abanyarwanda rwabaye rucyambikana rugira amaze kuhagera ahubirana n’abandi bagiye gucurangisha arahagarara araruhuka abaza abandi mutaga aha’’ mutaga aramwumva asohoka rugamba rugamba afite ingabo rwamu rw’abahizi n’amacumu ingabo ayishinga hagati y’ingamba zombi ndahari sembyariyimana bibero bikingira abarwanyi’’ rugira yashyizemo umwambi ararekera ingabo mutaga arayibarura amurasa gatuza mutaga yifungurire yaraye kandi irataha kure rwamu rw’abahizi’’ rugira amurasa umwambi kibero utunguka kindi aramujisha mutaga baramuraha baramuheka aratabaruka ubwo araneshejwe ingabo z’u rwanda zohereza abavuzi b’amacumu abagiye kuvuga amacumu abanzi rutangira babagambanaho bati nimugera ibwami muzavuga abanyarwanda babaye abagabo uretse rutangira wenyine wabaye ikigwari bitavugwa’’ abavuzi b’amacumu koko baragenda babivuga gutyo cyilima abyumvise akubitiyeho n’ibindi birego basanzwe bamumuregaho biramurakaza araritsira ingabo ziratabaruka barara inkera barahiga rutangira agiye guhiga baramuseka bati uyu aragira ibiki’’ inkwenene bayivaho bamuha inkwekwe bavuga gitero yakigizemo ubwoba akaba ikigwari cyilima uretse kugira ubwoba ntazi n’imirimo y’ibwami yashinzwe’’ amunyagira ibye bigabanywa rubanda nuko rutangira amaze kunyagwa ahinduka umukene karahava bene wabo b’abashambo ibyabo bibura kirengera bigenda nyomberi baratindahara rubanda rw’i nduba bakajya babazanya kubannyegura anyazwe n’umuryango wose uhinduka imbwa ibyo bashambo bimaze kuba umwaku rubanda babifatiraho babona abantu makuba y’amaburantsinzi bati ibyabo bigiye nyomberi ntibigira rutangira’’ kubura rutangira kubura kirengera n’intsinzi

title: ivugururwa ry’umujyi huye rigeze kure
content: muri minsi aharimo kuvugururwa agace k’ubucuruzi kazwi izina ryo mucyarabu akabarizwamo amahoteli ibisi faucon ndetse n’amabanki ecobank kbc ahandi harimo kuvugururwa ahahoze sitade huye harimo gusizwa neza hazubakwe indi nziza iyi gahunda kuvugurura igamije gusenya inyubako zishaje kandi zubatswe buryo butakigezweho zigasimbuzwa izijyanye n’igihe turimokuvugurura inyubako z’uyu mujyi tangiranye n’umwaka bikaba kandi bigikomeza ubu hoteli ibis hamwe banki ecobank bikaba byaramaze gusenywa kugirango hubakwe amazu agezweho pascal sahundwa umunyamabanga mpuzabikorwa w’umurenge ngoma karere huye avuga hari ibikorwa by’iterambere biri gukorwa kandi hari n’ibindi byinshi biteganyijwe avuga uretse amazu harimo kuvugururwa imihanda duce dutandukanye tw’uwo mujyi hamaze kuvugurwa ibirometero umunani by’imihanda gace kwitaba kandi nyuma yaho hazavugururwa imihanda ijya tundi duce ngoma matyazo hazakorwa kandi amatara mihanda ndetse haterwe ubusitani n’ibiti by’imirimbo rwego kongera ubwiza nyaburanga ndetse n’isuku y’uyu mujyi pascal asobanura ivugururwa ry’uyu mujyi inyungu buri muturage uwutuyemo ndetse n’igihugu rusange uyu mujyi murangiza kuvugururwa abaturage bazabona ibikorwa by’amajyambere birimo imihanda myiza n’amazu y’ubucuruzi yagutse ibi bizatuma haboneka abacuruzi baturutse bihugu bigize umurwango w’afrika y’iburasirazuba eac habeho ubuhahirane hagati y’uyu mujyi n’ibyo bihugu n’ubwo ubuyobozi bw’umujyi huye butegeka abafite amazu mujyi kuyavugurura bamwe banyiri mazu ntibabyumva kimwe n’ubuyobozi kuko bavugako basabwa kubaka amazu badafitiye ubushobozi umunyamabanga nshingwa bikorwa huye avuga ubuyobozi bw’uyu mujyi bugerageza kubavuganira banki kugirango babone inguzanyo buryo bworoshye hari kandi n’abavuga amwe mazu adakwiye gusenywa kuko afatwa nk’inzibutso z’uwo mujyi umuyobozi hotel ibis yagize kuvugurura ntibivuga gukuraho ibyagakwiye twibutsa ibihe byiza byashize twagiriye hoteli ibis pascal ariko avuga hakiri imbogamizi nyinshi iterambere ry’umujyi huye kuko abagafashije mujyi gutera imbere aribo bawusubiza inyuma aha aragaya abashoramari babona amafaranga nk’aho bayashoye iwabo huye bakajya i kigali n’ahandi bavugako i huye ntakigenda aranenga kandi igikorwa kwimurira amashami amwe n’amwe kaminuza nkuru i kigali abivuga magambo hari ikibazo cy’inyubako kaminuza niyubake kwimura mashami ahamya kaminuza mubiha agaciro mujyi huye clarisse umuhire

title: ecobank yorohereje abafunguza konti z’amanyarwanda n’amadovize guhabwa ikarita atm ako kanya
content: ni uburyo ecobank ivuga bugiye gukuraho imbogamizi bajyaga batinya gufungura konti gushyiraho amafaranga mahanga nk’amadorali amayero cyangwa amapawundi kubera karita bajyaga bahabwa uzafunguza konti azajya ahita ahabwa ikarita visa cyangwa mastercard izajya imufasha kwishyura yahahiye internet maguriro atandukanye kubikuza mafaranga hanze y’igihugu bitamusabye kubanza kuvunjisha ni umwihariko banki ivuga uzarushaho gufasha abakiliya bayo kunogerwa serivisi zitandukanye zibasaba gukoresha ubwoko bunyuranye bw’amafaranga mahanga bitabagoye umuyobozi w’ishami rishinzwe kwamamaza ibikorwa ecobank rwanda mana dsir yabwiye igihe buri mafaranga yemerewe gufungurizwa konti rwanda nyiri konti ahita ahabwa ikarita ijyanye nayo yagize wafunguza konti y’amanyarwanda amadorali amayero cyangwa amapawundi ecobank uhita uhabwa ikarita ako kanya konti ushaka mana yakomeje avuga abantu benshi bajyaga bagorwa kubona ikarita ibafasha kubikuza amafaranga y’amanyamahanga bidasabye kubanza kuvunjisha by’umwihariko babaga mahanga iyi karita itangwa ecobank yemerera buri wese kubikuza amadorali amayero cyangwa amapawundi bitewe konti yafunguje byuma atm bitanga ubwoko bw’ayo yahisemo isi hose ku muntu ufite konti y’amafaranga mahanga ariko akaba yifuza kubikuza byuma rwanda ntagorwa gato kuba konti itariho amanyarwanda kuko ibyuma bikuraho amanyamahanga ahwanye neza n’amafaranga y’u rwanda yabikuje ecobank ivuga gushyiraho serivisi bigamije kongerera abakiliya bayo n’abandi bayigana kugira uburyo bwinshi guhitamo kuko ahandi ho basabwa gutunga konti y’amanyarwanda kugira bahabwe ikarita atm gufunguza konti y’amafaranga mahanga cyangwa amanyarwanda ugahabwa n’ikarita yayo bikorerwa mashami ecobank rwanda rusizi huye nyamirambo chic cyicaro gikuru kigali heights remera kicukiro sonatubes mu rwego kugera benshi bishoboka ecobank yagabye amashami bihugu mugabane afurika aribyo togo gabon congo brazzaville centrafrique sudani y’epfo repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo u rwanda uganda burundi kenya tanzanie zambie malawi zimbabwe mozambique cape verde senegal guine mali gambia guinea-bissau sierra leone liberie cte d’ivoire burkina faso ghana bnin niger nigrie content: abatubuzi b’imbuto y’imyumbati izwi izina naser namuungi selection yakuwe uganda bararirira myotsi nyuma y’uko ibahombeye kuko nayo yafashwe n’uburwayi hamwe hamwe nubwo yazanywe ije gusimbura indi yarwaye kabore abahinzi bagategekwa kuyirandura bivugwa indwara kabore yatumye imbuto mbere irandurwa yibasiye uturere twa ruhango nyanza kamonyi muhanga gisagara ukongeraho bugesera nk’uko bitangazwa mukabatsinda bernadette umwe batubuzi b’imyumbati murenge nyamiyaga karere kamonyi imbuto nshya y’imyumbati bahawe n’ikigo cy’igihugu cy’ubuhinzi rab yahombeye abatubuzi bayihawe ikubitiro imbuto nshya y’imyumbati yatewe n’iburwayi kuri mbuto yamuteye igihombo kitavugwa kuko yagujije amafaranga miliyoni icyenda banki y’u rwanda itsura amajyambere brd agahinga imyumbati buso hegitari ategereje inyungu izamufasha kwishyura inguzanyo banki ariko akaba yaratunguwe kubona imyumbati yahinze iterwa n’uburwayi atarasobanukirwa kugeza ubwo buso bwose yahinze yavanyemo amafaranga agera miliyoni eshatu z’amafaranga y’u rwanda rwiririza jean marie umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’umurenge nyamiyaga asanga burwayi buteye igihombo ati twari twateye imyumbati buso hegitari ariko izigera zose zimaze gufatwa n’uburwayi ikibazo gikomeye harerimana martin uhagarariye abatubuzi b’imbuto rwanda avuga burwayi bwagaragaye turere twose twari dusanzwe dukungahaye gihingwa nk’aka ruhango kamonyi nyanza bugesera kuko mbuto ihombeye abatubuzi nabo bayihawe bayitubure igezwe bahinzi basabwe kurandura iya mbere iki kibazo ariko rab ntikibona kimwe n’abatubuzi b’imbuto kuko isanga atari igikuba cyacitse kandi burwayi budakanganye gasana parfait umukozi rab ushinzwe umusaruro yagize ubu burwayi ntibukanganye kuko bwafashe umwumbati umwe n’umwe ahubwo abahinzi bafite ubwoba kubera igihombo bagize imyumbati yaterwaga n’indwara kabore gasana yavuze bagiye kureba uburyo basaba brd yabagurije ikigiza inyuma igihe kwishyura bw’iki kibazo kuko bitashoboka rab ibafasha kwishyura srcimvaho

content: igicuri ndwara ki igicuri indwara ifata bwonko nyirizina umurwayi wayo agaragaza ibimenyetso bikurikiranye kandi ikaba ishobora kwigaragaza bitewe n’ubwoko bwayo kuko igira amoko menshi title: huye polisi yafashe abacuruzi b’ibiyobyabwenge
content: muri gikorwa gufata bacuruzi b’ibiyobyabwenge ubuyobozi bw’akagari cyimana gaherereye nkengero z’umujyi butare butangaza bamaze igihe bahanganye n’aba bacuruzi b’ibiyobyabwenge umunyamabanga nsingwabikorwa w’aka hagari vestine nyirahabimana avuga akagari ke gakabije kugira ibyaha bikomoka bucuruzi bw’ibiyobyabwenge kuko abenshi basa n’ababikora mugaragaro ntacyo bikanga nyirahabimana avuga gihe cyose yagerageje gufata abakora biyobyabwenge bamuteye ubwoba nafashe inzoga z’inkorano z’uwitwa kazungu nzigejeje cyicaro cy’akagari ahita azifata ngufu agerekaho kuntera ubwoba ambwira amagambo mumureke mukorere ibya mfura mbi mpite mpunga igihugu itegeko rivuga uwafashwe acuruza inzoga z’inkorano acibwa amande y’amafaranga ibihumbi nyamara nyirahabimana avuga gihe kagari ke bafashwe batajya batanga mande kuko babeshya ntayo bafite bagahita bafungurwa bitarenze iminsi itatu nyuma gufungurwa bagaruka bishyizemo abantu bagize uruhare ifatwa ryabo umuyobozi w’umudugudu kamuhoza denis sibomana umudugudu wiganjemo biyobyabwenge ndetse n’urugomo ruterwa n’ababinyoye avuga bacuruzi bahora bamutera ubwoba bazamwica bidatinze sibomana agatsiko kayobowe n’uwitwa sebagabo muhire eric bakunda kwita rukamya bazanye imihoro bashaka kunyica ariko imana ikinga akaboko kuko baje bambwira bazanyica kandi nibambura bazica abana banjye n’umugore none ndishinganisha kuko babivuze ruhame theogene ndungutse kazungu wafatanwe biyobyabwenge akaba ashyirwa majwi n’abayobozi kubatera ubwoba myaka y’amavuko afite itanu muriyo ayimaze acuruza biyobyabwenge yatawe yombi inshuro eshanu kubera ibiyobyabwenge kazungu ashyira majwi ubuyobozi kuba ntabireka abayobozi bacu babitera kuko banze njya koperative ncuruza ibiyobyabwenge nkaho ntari umuntu nk’abandi kandi muntu urapfira iwange nanjye ubinywa ntacyo birantwara kandi mbinywa buri munsi umuyobozi w’akarere huye eugene kayiranga muzuka avuga aka kagali cyimana gasanzwe kazwiho bikorwa gucuruza ibiyobyabwenge title: nkore nakundanye n’uwo dukorana- inama
content: ubushakashatsi bwagaragaje by’abantu bagiye bashinduka rukundo n’abantu bakorana nyamara hari biba badahuye politiki y’ikigo mukorera cyangwa se bikaba namwe ubwanyu byababangamira kwerekana bagenzi banyu ibyari ubucuti byabyaye ikintu gikomeye muri nkuru turabagira inama y’uburyo umuntu yakwitwara gihe akundanye n’uwari inshuti kazi cyangwa se n’undi muntu ariwe wese kazi shishikara murimoikintu mbere ugomba kuzirikana waje uje gukora akazi bityo inshingano zawe kazi nizo zitumye uhaguma bitabaye uzaba uteshutse bityo ube waha isura mbi umubano wanyu hari n’ubwo ushobora gusanga kigo mukorera bibujijwe kugirana umubano wihariye cyangwa gukundana n’uwo mukorana bitewe n’impamvu zitandukanye urumva gihe nk’iki uba ushobora kwishyira kaga gihe wongereyeho kuba udatunganya neza inshingano wahawe mbivuge cyangwa ndyumeho gutangaza mugaragaro kazi mukundana bishobora kubakururira ibihano runaka ariko kubivuga bizabafaha guha umwanya akazi kumara umwanya mutekereza uburyo abantu bakorana ibi ntibivuze mudashaka kwereka abandi mutwara amarangamutima yanyu gusa ahubwo binafite igisobanuro n’ubwo mufitanye umubano wihariye mugeze kazi gusa muha agaciro ni byiza mutegereza kubana n’uwo ukunda amasaha y’umunsi ariko ukabana arimo babiri rimwe umukunzi ubundi boss cyangwa mukorana kuvanga bintu bikunaniye uba ugomba guhitamo ukareba ikikuri mutima akazi cyangwa urukundo umufitiye

title: rubingisa pudence yatorewe kuba meya w’umujyi kigali
content: rubingisa pudence watorewe kuyobora umujyi kigali matora yabaye gatandatu akaba asimbuye marie chantal rwakazina uherutse kugirwa ambasaderi w’u rwanda busuwisi rubingisa yahatanaga rutera rose akaba wagize amajwi menshi yamuhesheje kujya mwanya inteko itora y’abantu igizwe n’abajyanama b’umujyi kigali biro nyobozi y’inama njyanama z’imirenge yatoye rubingisa akaba yagize amajwi ho rutera agira impfabusa iba uyu mugabo yakoze imirimo itandukanye yakoze hoze isae busogo yakoze minisiteri y’imari n’igenamigambi ndetse akaba yaranabaye umuyobozi wungirije kaminuza y’u rwanda ushinzwe ubutegetsi n’imari rubingisa yakoreraga ikigo cyigenga amatora komite nyobozi y’umujyi kigali gatandatu yabimburiwe n’ay’abajyanama bagomba guhagararira uturere nama njyanama y’umujyi kigali dr jeannette bayisenge yatorewe kuba perezida w’inama njyanama y’umujyi kigali visi perezida kayihura muganga didas baguma rose umunyamabanga wayo umuyobozi wungirije ushinzwe imiturire n’ibikorwaremezo watowe dr nsabimana ernest na ho umutoni gatsinzi nadine atorewe kuba umuyobozi w’umujyi wungirije ushinzwe ubukungu n’imibereho myiza uyu mudamu aka asanzwe umunyamabanga uhoraho minisiteri y’uburinganire n’iterambere ry’umuryango inkuru rba

content: bagosora nsengiyumva barajuririra igihano cy’igifungo burundu bahawe kubera ibyaha jenoside n’ibindi byaha byibasiye inyoko muntu ntawukulilyayo yajuririye igihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka yakatiwe kubera uruhare yagize jenoside ku itariki ukuboza nibwo bagosora wahoze ayobora ibiro minisitiri w’ingabo yakatiwe nyuma guhamwa n’ibyaha jenoside ibyaha byibasiye ikiremwamuntu n’ibyaha by’intambara birimo kwica uwari minisitiri w’intebe agathe uwilingiyimana n’abandi basirikare b’ababiligi onu bagosora anashinjwa kugira uruhare ishyirwaho bariyeri hirya hino kigali gisenyi hagati y’itariki mata nsengiyumva ukuriye ibikorwa gisirikare gisenyi yahamijwe ubwicanyi bakorewe kaminuza mudende paruwasi nyundo ndetse n’ubwicanyi bwakorewe abasivili gice ayoboye yanahamijwe kandi kuba yarohereje ibitero by’interahamwe bisesero kwica abatutsi bagosora nsengiyumva baburanishirijwe igihe kimwe hamwe n’abandi basirikare babiri aribo brigadier-general gratien kabiligi major aloys ntabakuze kabiligi yahisevarekurwa ntabakuze ajurira rubanza rwabaye itariki werurwe urubanza ntabakuze rwaje gutandukanywa n’urwabandi nyuma y’aho uwamwunganiraga mategeko umunyamerika peter erlinder ananiriwe kwitaba urukiko tariki werurwe ubujurire bwe bwaje gusomwa tariki nzeri na nubu buracyakomeza ntawukulilyayo yakatiwe igihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka kubera uruhare yagize bwicanyi bwakorewe kibuye n’i butare umunyamakuru kigali today

title: politiki nziza n’imiyoborere myiza ibyita buzima byose-perezida kagame
content: perezida repubulika paul kagame arahamagarira ibihugu afurika kongera ingengo y’imari bigenera urwego rw’ubuzima kuko politiki n’imiyoborere nyayo ishyira ubuzima bw’abantu isonga mbere y’ibindi byose ibi perezida repuburika yabitangaje mbere birori gutangiza mugaragaro inama mpuzamahanga sida n’izindi ndwara zandurira mibonano mpuzabitsina icasa atangiza nama mugaragaro perezida repubulika paul kagame yagaragaje sida icyorezo kitagira umupaka bityo ibihugu byose bikwiye gukora ibishoboka byose kugirango bihangane perezida paul kagame avuga ibihugu byose bigomba gufatanya kurwanya icyorezo sida ati sida icyorezo kitagira umupaka ibyagezweho rugamba kurwanya ubwiyongere bw’iyo virusi umusaruro w’ubufatanye mpuzamahanga ni mpamvu kurushaho gushyigikira gahunda zirimo ikigega global gavi ndetse pepfar ingenzi kubw’umusanzu wazo guverinoma afurika ruhande rwazo zikwiye gushyira imbere kwishakamo ubushobozi gutera ibikorwa by’ubuvuzi kubikora ugushyiraho umusingi uhamye kandi urambye w’ubu bufatanye’’ ibi kandi byashimangiwe n’umuyobozi mukuru w’ishami ry’umuryango w’abibumbye ryita buzima oms dr tedros adhanom ghebreyesus wavuze gihe ntego z’iterambere rirambye rwego rw’ubuzima ukugira isi itarangwamo ubwandu bushya virus sida ubuyobozi bufite uruhare runini gufasha isi kwesa muhigo yagaragaje igihugu akomokamo ethiopia ndetse n’u rwanda intangarugero mugabane afurika umuyobozi mukuru w’ishami ry’umuryango w’abibumbye ryita buzima oms dr tedros adhanom ghebreyesus ahamya ubuyobozi bufite uruhare rukomeye kurwanya sida ati ni ibintu nzi nshingiye bunararibonye mfite umusanzu n’ubushake by’inzego nkuru guverinoma ingirakamaro kugira utere intambwe ifatika ibyo byatumye dutera intambwe ethiopia kandi rimwe masomo y’ingenzi tubona hano rwanda umusaruro mwagezeho ntiwari kuboneka bitaba imiyoborere ireba kure yawe nyakubahwa perezida bitari guhanga n’icyorezo sida gusa ahubwo kugeza serivisi z’ubuzima mpamvu nyakubahwa perezida paul kagame ngira ngushimire byimazeyo’’ uyu muhango kandi wanitabiriwe perezida mozambique filipe jacinto nyusi wagaragaje nama nk’urubuga nyarwo gufatira hamwe ingamba guhangana n’icyorezo sida dore igihugu cye kimwe byugarijwe kurusha ibindi afurika ati mozambique kimwe bihugu byugarijwe sida kurusha ibindi afurika munsi y’ubutayu sahara mu rwego kongera ingufu zacu guhangana nayo twaje i kigali kagame yagaragaje guhangana n’icyorezo sida bikwiye guhera hasi baturage bagahabwa ubumenyi buhagije kandi bakegerezwa ibikorwa remezo serivisi z’ubuzima ashimangira politiki nyayo ishyira imbere ubuzima bw’abaturage ati politiki nziza n’imiyoborere myiza ibyita buzima byose nta cyasimbura kubaka umuryango utekanye kandi ufite ubuzima buzira umuze abaturage urubyiruko ndetse n’abakuze bagomba kwibona nk’abafatanyabikorwa kubaka ahazaza ubuzima ugukora amahitamo akwiye aka kanya nyungu z’igihe kirambye ibyo bizadufasha gutsinda urugamba kurwanya sida tukubaka ubudatsimburwa zindi mbogamizi twahura zo’’ inama mpuzamahanga sida mugabane afurika icasa ibaye gihe miliyoni z’abafite virusi itera sida kusi babarizwa mugabane afurika ibirori gutangiza nama byasusurukijwe n’itorero ry’igihugu urukerereza n’abanyeshuri biga ishuri muzika ryo nyundo

content: abagera baturuka tugari tugize umurenge byumba bavuga basabwe gukora imishinga igamije kubateza imbere gusa bamwe bavuga imishinga bayikoze inemezwa n’itsinda ryashyizweho n’umurenge rishinzwe gukurikirana uburyo yateguwe buri muturage yemerewe kugurizwa amafaranga ibihumbi frw bavuga bifashishije inzobere zikabakorera inyigo ituma imishinga bakoze itazahomba ngo bababwira mbere title: koronavirusi hashimangiwe akato k’iminsi bagenderera ibihugu eac
content: abaminisitiri b’ubuzima ab’ubucuruzi abashinzwe ubutwererane bw’ibiguhugu bigize umuryango w’afurika y’iburasirazuba eac n’abanyamabanga leta minisiteri z’ububanyi n’amahanga bashimangiye abagenderera ibihugu bigize muryango bagomba gupimwa gushyirwa kato k’iminsi gukumira ikwirakwira koronavirusi covid-ibihugu eac byiyemeje korohereza ibicuruzwa gufasha abagizweho ingaruka n’ifungwa ry’imipaka itangazo rikubiyemo imyanzuro y’iyo nama yakorewe ikoranabuhanga video conference ryerekana yakozwe hagamijwe gusangira amakuru n’ubumenyi bihari cyorezo covid- gufata ingamba kugikumira kwirinda cyakomeza gukwirakwira ndetse gutegura gahunda ihamye guhangana n’ingaruka z’iki cyorezo bihugu eac iyo nama yayobowe minisitiri w’ubuzima rwanda akaba n’umuyobozi w’inama y’abaminisitiri b’ubuzima eac dr ngamije daniel yemeje hashyirwaho hakanashyigikirwa komite yihariye ikurikirana ishyirwa bikorwa ry’imyanzuro yafashwe abo bayobozi bateranye gihe ibihugu bine bitandatu bagaragayemo abarwayi kugeza uganda kenya u rwanda tanzania u burundi sudani y’epfo bitaratangaza umurwayi n’umwe indi myanzuro yafashwe irimo guhagarika inama z’imbonankubone hakimakazwa ikoranabuhanga guhanahana amakuru koroshya urujya n’uruza rw’ibicuruzwa byambuka imipaka buri kamyo itwaye ibicuruzwa ntigomba kurenza abantu batatu kandi bazajya bapimirwa mupaka mbere kwambuka gihe bafite ibimenyetso kwandura bashyirwe kato ariko batwaye bishakirwe byagezwa cyerekezo cyabyo bikimara guterwa imiti yica virusi ba nyiri ibicuruzwa barasabwa kumenyekanisha ingendo nyambukamipaka mbere kuzikora kandi bakajya bahagarara gusa ahabugenewe kwirinda bagira uruhare ikwirakwizwa ry’icyorezo za ambasade z’ibihugu zasabwe gufasha abagizweho ingaruka n’ifungwa ry’imipaka bakabona uburyo bagera cyerekezo cyabo karere ibihugu byanasabwe gufasha ibigo n’inganda gutunganya ibiribwa n’ibikoresho nkenerwa bihagije cyane cyane ibyifashishwa isuku guhangana covid- imibare itangwa n’ishami ry’umuryango w’abibumbye ryita buzima who yerekana kane tariki werurwe abamaze kwandura covid- abayikize ho imaze gutwara ubuzima indatwaorg

content: ni kenshi abagore cyangwa abakobwa bagira ibibazo bitandukanye ugasanga imihango iragenda nabi bakaba bababara gihe cy’imihango cyangwa se umuntu agahorana umunaniro udashira nyamara byarakubayeho wasanga hari bikuburira bishobora kuba ikimenyetso kugabanuka kw’imisemburo estrogen ni kenshi abagore cyangwa abakobwa bagira ibibazo bitandukanye ugasanga imihango iragenda nabi bakaba bababara gihe cy’imihango cyangwa se umuntu agahorana umunaniro udashira nyamara byarakubayeho wasanga hari bikuburira bishobora kuba ikimenyetso kugabanuka kw’imisemburo estrogen estrogen estrogen imisemburo y’abantu b’igitsina gore abagore ndetse n’abakobwa ifasha umubiri wabo gukora ibintu bitandukanye kandi by’ingenzi ku bakobwa b’abangavu ishinzwe gutuma imyanya myororokere ikura neza mu bindi ikora ifasha imihango kugenda neza igafasha gukura neza kw’amabere bangavu igafasha amagufa gukomera ndetse igafasha kuringaniza ibiro bagore n’abakobwa ese yagabanyutse ubibwirwa n’iki nk’uko title: kwakira abahoze ex far n’indi mitwe harimo n’interahamwe bisobanuye kuri politiki y’u rwanda
content: bamwe bahoze ngabo ex far kimwe n’abitandukanyije n’imitwe itandukanye y’abarwanyi bemeza kongera kwakirwa guhabwa uburenganzira bwose gihugu ikimenyetso politiki nziza izira ivangura ukaba n’umusingi ukomeye w’iterambere ry’u rwanda gashugi faustin kunde utuye karere nyarugenge umwe bahoze ngabo kera ex far akaba sergent major bitwaga abaparakomando avuga ngabo zarangwaga n’ivangura nk’uko politiki y’icyo gihe rwanda iteye rusange kurwanya politiki mbi byatumye ingabo zari iza fpr inkotanyi zitangiza urugamba kubohora u rwanda zikanahagarika jenoside yakorerwaga abatutsi kimwe benshi ngabo ex farmu gashugi yahunze u rwanda yagize nyuma gutsindwa guverinoma y’abatabazi narahunze njya congo mva congo njya congo brazaville nahabaye n’umusirikare mu gihe sassou ngueso yarwanga lisuba turi bamwe bamufashije hamwe n’abanyangola kuko ndibuka twe twafashe ikibuga cy’indege maya maya n’umusozi muremure bita mont barnier nyuma i brazaville kunde n’abandi barwanyi bagarutse i kinshasa bajya ngabo laurent desire kabila bamurwanira bice bitandukanye birimo mbuji mayi mpala moba pepa pweto batsindiwe urugamba bidasubirwaho bagahungira ahitwa kamina ibitekerezo bye byahindukiye ati kubera kubona ukuntu urugamba rwagendaga nakoze analyse nkareba n’abayobozi twari dufite ubwabo ntibumvikanaga haba mudacumura haba mugaragu renzaho bamaze kumufata agiye arusha kuko ntago warwana uvuga ndashaka kujya gihugu ubwanyu namwe mubanza mukarwana urabona jenoside bahigaga abatutsi ariko twageze hariya noneho abakiga n’abanyenduga barahigana ngeze ndareba nsanga intambara turwana ntego dufite kwiba nahise mfata icyemezo gutaha agarutse rwanda kunde yakiriwe neza ibintu avuga byamutunguye ariko bikanamushimisha cyane ati kunyakira ubwa mbere sinabyumvaga urumva umuntu muba mwararwanye imyaka n’imyaka kugira uze umusange hake isi biba ahandi wumva babica wigeze wumva ex far bagira imfungwa z’intambara ntabo ivangura ryabagaho gihe turi abanyarwanda ibyo nabonye rwanda handi biraba isi ingabo zishobora kuvanga njye nayoboye umurenge kimisagara nshinzwe umutekano nkatanga amabwiriza akakirwa nk’amabwiriza commandant ntago barebaga commandant ex far cyangwa w’umucengezi natowe n’abaturage kubera bambonagamo namarira igihugu iyo haba ivangura sinari kugera batorera ubu buhamya gashugi abuhuriraho ngiruwonsanga jean marie vianney wabaye ex far ubu umuhinzi mworozi karere rulindo usibye kwikorera anatubura imbuto kandi agatanga amahugurwa bahinzi bava hirya hino gihugu yemeza yagezeho bishimangira politiki nziza izira ivangura u rwanda rufite ati nabaye umwe basirikare kera ntahukiye nsubira gisirikare nyuma y’ibyo nza kwikorera gihe gito mba conseiller ibyo byonyine agaciro gakomeye urumva bisobanuye leta iyobowe nyakubahwa paul kagame ntacyo itakoreye abanyarwanda uko guhuza abanyarwanda kubonamo umunyarwanda wese ashoboye akubaka igihugu cye birarenze abagarutse rwanda bitandukanyije n’imitwe y’abarwanyi bakirirwa kigo mutobo bahabwa amahugurwa atandukanye arimo kubigisha imyuga ibafasha gusubira buzima busanzwe kwiteza imbere bimenyimana bonaventure bitaga cobra mashyamba congo wahungutse afite ipeti major avuga u rwanda rw’iki gihe ruha agaciro buri wese ntawarugereranya n’urwa mbere ati mu buzima kongo twabaye buzima bubi mfata umwanzuro gutaha ngeze gihugu nakiriwe neza mpugurirwa i mutobo nyarangije mwaka namaze ntagiye soudani butumwa mvuye butumwa natangiye kwiteza imbere reserve force bampa akazi nubatse ecd y’abana b’inshuke musanze abanyeshuri barimo kwiga kuri senateri charles uyisenga inararibonye politiki y’u rwanda guhuriza hamwe abanyarwanda kubaha uburenganzira bungana bifite igisobanuro kinini gihugu ati urumva abantu barwanaga nyuma bakaza kujya ngabo zimwe byerekana abanyarwanda bashobora gukorera igihugu icyo cyerekana budasa bw’u rwanda umusingi ukomeye kuko urumva amaboko y’abana b’u rwanda ntago uvuga abubaka u rwanda abangaba abatahutse nyuma kwitandukanya n’imitwe irwanya u rwanda bemeza gushyira imbere ubumwe nyuma y’urugamba guhagarika jenoside yakorerwaga abatutsi icyemezo cyuje ubushishozi basanga kizafasha u rwanda kurushaho gutera imbere chief editor muhaburarw

title: inkomoko y’imvugo ’nyir’amaguru yirukiye nyir’umugisha’
content: uyu mugani bawuca babonye umuntu wiremyemo amahate ahirimbana ubudahwema ibintu byamara gutengamara hakagororerwa utarushye bavuga ’nyir’amaguru yirukiye nyir’umugisha’ wakomotse kibibi ruzigana abagaragu mukobanya ahayinga umwaka w’i ku ngoma cyilima rugwe hadutse umugabo w’umugoyi witwa mulinda agaba ingabo ze zitera u rwanda yashakaga kurwigarurira anesha kabagali n’ amarangara n’i nduga acumbika mizi kabare munsi kamonyi atuma cyilima muhe umukobwa wawe nyabarondo n’inka yawe munono n’ingoma yawe cyimumugizi mubone gukiranuka rubanda rumaze kumva butumwa beguka rugwe asigara wenyine agiye kwihisha gisura cyari ibanga kamonyi akimaramo iminsi cyilima rugwe amaze gusumbirizwa atuma muhungu mukobanya i bumbogo mbirima u rwanda rwatsinzwe rwatsinzwe mulinda w’umugoyi yanesheje kabagali marangara nduga rukoma none acumbitse mizi kabare kamonyi kandi yantumyeho amananiza ambwira mwoherereze inka yanjye munono n’ingoma yanjye cyimumugizi n’umukobwa wanjye nyabarondo none abigenze ate intumwa rugwe iragenda ibwira mukobanya ubutumwa mukobanya ariyumvira asubiza ntumwa genda umumbwirire uti tanga nyabarondo umukwobwa wawe utange munono warayoroye cyimumugizi si ubuteto uti ahubwo izamuca mubyimba nuko intumwa cyilima irahindukira imubwira ubutumwa mukobanya ikimara guhaguruka i bumbogo mukobanya abwira ingabo ze z’ abambogo i bwami bamerewe nabi bahera bambuka nyabarongo batabaye cyilima rugwe kamonyi gisura yihishemo ubwo mulinda mukobanya bahuriye i kinyambi rugalika mukobanya arahamutsinda ubwo rubanda rw’ i nkuruzuzu bica nkuba nyabakonjo bwanacyambwe abo bavuye i bwanacyambwe bambukira cyambu munsi gihinga kitwaga rutare bateranira bitwa kamonyi barara bavuga amacumu ku wundi munsi barara inkera gutera u bugoyi ni kibibi yahize n’undi mugabo witwaga ruzigana nitugera i bugoyi tuzabutsinda ariko umubisha mbere uwanjye ruzigana urirarira nitugera i bugoyi koko uvuze tuzabutsinda koko ariko ubeshye uvuze umubisha mbere uwawe umubisha w’ibanze uwanjye mukobanya agumya kwumva imihigo bombi ubugoyi tuzabutsinda koko ubishidikanya none wowe kibibi ruzigana uzabanza kwica umubisha nzabugabira ni bageze ingabo zijyana mukobanya akiri umututsi atarima ataraba umwami akigira rugamba ingabo ziboneza iya kibuye zambukira i kilinda bageze rugabano bugoyi bahura n’abagoyi kibibi abirohamo yirukana umugoyi aramutota ruzigana agumana mukobanya ubwo kibibi yica mubisha yatose abagoyi bararakara bakubita abanyarwanda inshuro mukobanya aratsikira umugoyi agiye kumutera ruzigana amurasa inkumbi amutsinda imbere mukobanya ariko kibibi yishe kare yabanje nuko u bugoyi buratsindwa bafata umuhungu mulinda witwaga rushema bamuzanira mukobanya aramutanga bwije barara inkera y’imihigo kibibi ibanze irya njye bugoyi abahungu bati ntabeshya ibanze irye ni waroboye umugoyi hagati y’ingamba zombi amwirukana tureba amutsinda rubuga mukobanya aranga ibanze irya ruzigana warashe umugoyi mbere inkumbi u bugoyi ubwe abahungu barumirwa ni kibibi bamwise nyir’amaguru kuko yirukanye umugoyi akamwica mbere ariko u bugoyi bugahabwa ruzigana wishe nyuma kandi bahigiye ubwo kibibi yirukiye ruzigana wagabanye u bugoyi kwirukira nyir’umugisha kuruhira abandi hifashishijwe igitabo cy’ibirari by’insigamigani

content: muri nyandiko zishimisha perezida museveni rimwe himbara ajya abura gutuka perezida kagame n’umuryango akoresheje ibitutsi byose bibaho kayumba nyamwasa afite konti facebook yise rpf gakwerere ikoreshwa guharabika gutesha agaciro abanyarwanda abita imbohe mu cyumweru gishize hari umuntu wavugutiye umuti bashumba binyuze nyandiko si ugusara barasizora barasakuje perezida kagame title: mukobwaibintu byakwereka umuhungu agukunda by’ukuri cyangwa yishakira kuryamana
content: ni gute wowe mukobwa cyangwa mugore wamenya umugabo agukunda by’ukuri iki ikibazo gikomeye ku gisubiza kuko hari bamwe bagabo benshi bifitiye irari ryo gukunda abagore ariko bakaba bafite umugambi kuryamana nabo atari ukugira bashyingiranwe gusa hari n’abandi bakunda abakobwa babafitiye umugambi rushinga ndetse rugakomera buryarya mukobwa ibi ibimenyetso byakwereka umuhungu agukunda by’ukuri cyangwa yishakira muryamana gusa iyo ashishikajwe kumenya umunsi wawe wagenze bivuze ashaka mukundana bizira uburya bitagamije ukuryamana iyo akwandikiye cyangwa akaguhamagara gitondo bisobanuye ikintu cyambere atekerezaho igihe cyose bivuze agukunda by’ukuri ndetse anacyeneye mwazashyingiranwa iyo akwandikiye ariko akabikora ninjoro yishimiye cyangwa ashishikajwe kuryamana by’ ukuri ntabwo agambiriye mwazashyingiranwa usibye gukorana imibonano mpuzabitsina gusa uko akwita bishobora kukugaragariza agukunda by’ukuri cyangwa ashaka mwiryamaniraakenshi azakwita amazina wumva ntakizere atanga k’umubano wanyu w’ahazaza mwembi usibye y’amazina ashirana n’agahararo iyo agusabye umwoherereza amafoto yawe agaragaza umbwambure bwawe ukoresheje telefone yishimira ku kwamamaza gusa rukundo agufitiye ruzatuma mushyingiranwa usibye kuryamana ikintu kibaho kumwe cyerekana agukunda by’ukuri cyangwa mukundana kuryamanaiyo ashaka mugirana ikiganiro kizaicyo gihe muba mukundana bifite intego kurushingaariko akora byose biganisha kuba yagukorakora ku mabuno kukwitegereza cyane cyangwa ku kwiyegereza cyane muhagaze ntakabuza acyeneye biba ukuryamana gusa iyo yohereje ubutumwa ategura byose bikaba ukukubona kandi akavuga n’ibintu bidasobanutse byose ashaka kuba ukwiryamanira gusa iyo ahora aguhamagara cyangwa akakwandikira bikaba ikiganiro kirekire kidafite kigamije burya agukunda nyabyo gushidikanyaaha bisobanurwa n’uko akenshi ashaka muryamana akuganiriza avuga ndagukumbuye mukunzi ndetse n’ibindi byinshi mu gihe gukorana ikiganiroiyo kuvuga byose biba byerekeranye n’ibice bigize umubiri wawe kandi atari abashaka akumenye nezaahubwo ashaka kindi usibye gutuma wowe wifuza kuryamana nawebityo akaba ageze ntego byoroshye iyo ashaka kumenya byinshi wowe biganiro byose mugiranaicyo gihe agukunda bitagira amacyemwa kandi bishobora kurangira mushyingiranywe yanditswe habarurema djamali

title: umujyi kigali ugiye kwimura imiryango isaga kubera imvura ikomeye yitezwe
content: iyi gahunda ije ikurikira indi yakozwe mpera z’umwaka ushize abaturage batuye bishanga bakuwemo bakimurirwa ahandi hatazateza ikibazo buzima bwabo ishusho igaragazwa mteo-rwanda yerekana umujyi kigali uzagwamo imvura nyinshi kandi gihe kirekire ugereranyije n’ibindi bice by’u rwanda mu kiganiro n’itangazamakuru mbere tariki werurwe umujyi kigali wavuze hari uduce dusaga two mujyi twagaragaye abahatuye bakwiye kwimurwa buryo bwihuse kuko ibimenyetso bigaragaza imvura iteganywa iramutse ibasanze batuye yakwangiza byinshi birimo kubatwara ubuzima minisitiri w’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu prof shyaka anastase yavuze gahunda igamije gutabara abaturage bashobora kwibasirwa n’ibiza ahera asaba abafite inzu zikodeshwa kutazamura ibiciro kubera umubare munini w’abakeneye kwimuka buryo butari bwateguwe ati ubu kwimura abaturage bigamije kubatabara bakavanwa batuye hashobora kubashyira kaga kurushaho gihe ibiza byaba bihabasanze ntaho bihuriye kuba bagiye kwimurwa bw’ibikorwa bigamije inyungu rusange ntihazagire ubyuririraho ashake kubibyaza inyungu z’ikirenga kuko azaba guhungabanya umutekano w’igihugu n’abaturage prof shyaka akomeza avuga ubufatanye bw’inzego zitandukanye bukenewe uru rugamba rwego kurinda abanyarwanda bihe by’ibiza umujyi kigali uvuga ngengo y’imari ihagije yateguwe gikorwa kwimura abaturage bashobora kwibasirwa n’ibiza usibye miliyoni z’amafaranga y’u rwanda azifashishwa gukodeshereza abaturage bazaba bimuwe bavanywe bice kimisagara gitega bikikije ruhurura mpazi gatsata gikondo kimihurura mu myembe kangondo mulindi ahazwi nko rwampara ibice bimwe nyarutarama n’ahandi muri rusange abakeneye kwimurwa buryo bwihuse imiryango ibarirwa hagati umuyobozi w’umujyi kigali pudence rubingisa yavuze baratangije gahunda kubaka inzu zigenewe abazimurwa bishanga manegeka bitarenze kamena mwaka gusa ntihari hateganyijwe hari abandi baturage bazimurwa rwego rw’ubutabazi abazahabwa abatishoboye basanzwe bafashwa leta ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe kurengera ibidukikije rema kivuga nyuma kwimura abaturage batuye bishanga hazakurikiraho gahunda kubitunganya ndetse bikabyazwa umusaruro hakurikijwe igishushanyo mbonera giteganya kuko ibyinshi byangijwe n’ibikorwa byari byarubatswemo meteo rwanda ivuga kugera mpera z’ukwezi gicurasi gice cy’uburasirazuba bw’amajyepfo ho hazagwa imvura iringaniye gihe umujyi kigali ibice by’uburengerazuba ndetse n’uturere twa nyaruguru nyamagabe hazagwa imvura ishobora guteza ibiza umujyi kigali kandi wagize imvura nyinshi kwezi kabiri kuruta ahandi hose rwanda mu mwaka ushize hahagurukiwe ikibazo cy’abaturage batuye bishanga bamwe barimuwe gihe imvura kugwa cyane abandi bishakira gutura ndetse batanga umusanzu gukuraho ibikorwaremezo bafite bishanga hari abanyarwanda bafashije bagenzi kubona kwikinga gihe leta itari ifite ahantu hahagije ho kwimurira abaturage kuva gihe hakozwe ibikorwa bitandukanye birimo kuzibura imiyoboro itwara amazi guhanga imishya gukuraho inzu n’ibindi bikorwa bigaragara biri bishanga n’ibindi mu mpera z’umwaka ushize kandi himuwe imiryango turere twose tugize umujyi bamwe baracyakodesherezwa gihe hakiri gutegurwa uburyo burambye kubatuza umujyi kigali uvuga watangiye gahunda izamara ibyumweru bibiri ikorwa n’itsinda rigizwe polisi n’abakozi b’umujyi kigali kuzenguruka bareba abantu batuye ahantu hateje ikibazo ahegereye ruhura imikingo n’ibishanga basabwa gushaka uburyo bimuka hakiri kare kuko ubutaka bwanyweye amazi menshi bukaba butagifite ubushobozi kwirengera ibikorwaremezo byose biburiho hari inyigo gukorwa n’umujyi kigali ijyanye gutunganya gufata amazi akoreshwa ndetse n’ay’imvura inyigo igomba kumara igihe kitarenze umwaka umujyi kigali wemera hakozwe ikosa ryo gutanga ibyangombwa kubaka bishanga ariko ntibikwiye kuba urwitwazo rw’abinangira bakanga bishanga basaba ingurane gihe nyamara ingurane itangwa hari ibikorwa bigamije inyungu rusange bigiye kubakwa ahari hatuye abaturage ubusanzwe itegeko riteganya abaturage bagomba kubaka cyangwa kugira ikindi gikorwa bashyira y’igishanga hasizwe metero uvuye mbago zacyo gusa ubuyobozi bw’umujyi kigali buvuga bipimo bikwiye kongerwa bikagera metero kuko ubutaka bwagaragaje bubitse amazi menshi cyane ashobora kuba intandaro kuriduka bikaba byateza impanuka kuva ikibazo cy’imvura nyinshi cyatangira kugaragara mpera z’umwaka ushize gihugu hose hamaze kubarurwa abantu bapfuye bazize ibiza abandi barakomereka gihe inzu zisaga yasenyutse ndetse hegitari nyinshi z’ubutaka zigatwarwa n’isuri hatabariwemo ibindi bikorwaremezo bitandukanye byangijwe n’amazi

title: musanzebatatu maboko polisi bakurikiranyweho ubujura bw’imodoka n’inyandiko mpimbano
content: polisi y’u rwanda ikorera karere musanze kuwa kabiri tariki gashyantare yataye yombi umugabo witwa nteziyaremye sostene w’imyaka n’abandi bagenzi babiri bakekwaho ubujura bw’imodoka gukoresha inyandiko mpimbanonkuko byemezwa n’urwego rushinzwe umutekano police y’u rwanda ikorera aka karere bagabo batatu bafashwe bagahita batabwa yombi kuwa kabiri tariki gashyantare umuvugizi polisi y’u rwanda ntara y’amajyaruguru chief inspector of police cip hamdun twizeyimana yavuze nteziyaremye yagurishije imodoka itari iye kuko yayikodeshejwe n’uwitwa niyonizeye clementine yagize atinteziyaremye yakodesheje imodoka bwoko toyotaavensis rad h y’uwitwa niyonizeye clementine utuye mujyi kigali akaba yayikodesheje igihe kingana n’ukwezi kumwe gihe yafashe umwanzuro kuyigurisha kugirango azabone ayigurisha nkomyi nteziyaremye yiyandikiye amasezerano y’ubugure yemeza modoka yayiguze niyonizeye kwezi kanama umwaka ushize akayigura miliyoni esheshatu n’ibihumbi magana inani by’amafaranga y’u rwanda frw aha cip twizeyimana yagize atiaya masezerano y’amahimbano kugirango azerekane modoka iye akaba yarafashijwe n’abakomisiyoneri bitwa habanabakize thomas turimubayo alexis kumushakira umuguzi bakaba bamuboneye uwitwa sibomana emmanuel wemeye kuyigura miliyoni eshanu z’amafaranga y’u rwanda frw yakomeje avuga sibomana ugiye kugura modoka kuko asanzwe umuturanyi nteziyaremye murenge muhoza akarere musanze yagize amakenga ishobora kuba injurano ahita atanga amakuru polisi cip twizeyimana atisibomana amaze kuduha amakuru twahise tuza dusanga bamaze gusinyana amasezerano y’ubugure miliyoni eshanu duhita tumufata nteziyaremye bakomisiyoneri babiri bakaba bafungiye sitasiyo polisi muhoza gihe polisi igikora dosiye yoherezwe bushinjacyaha iyi modoka yahise isubizwa nyirayo niyonizeye cip twizeyimana akaba ashimira sibomana kubera amakuru yatanze yatumye bakekwaho byaha bafatwa ndetse n’iyi modoka igafatwa yasabye nyir’imodoka kumenya imyirondoro y’abo bakorana cyane bakodesha imodoka zabo kugirango igihe habaye ubujura babashe gukurikiranwa kandi bagakurikirana imodoka zabo zikorera yanditswe habarurema djamali

title: hirya hino isi abana basaga miliyoni bihugu byugarijwe n’ amakimbirane
content: abafatanyabikorwa rwego rw’ umutekano kubungabunga amahoro karere k’ uburasirazuba afurika basanga hakenewe ubukangurambanga n’ inyigisho zifasha gukumira iyinjizwa n’ ikoreshwa ry’ abana bikorwa gisirikare ibi byagarutsweho i kigali hatangizwaga inama gukumira iyinjizwa n’ikoreshwa ry’abana mitwe gisirikare hirya hino isi abana basaga miliyoni bihugu byugarijwe n’ amakimbirane bibasirwa n’ ibikorwa by’ urugomo n’ ihohotera ubuhunzi inzara ndetse guhindurwa ibikoresho n’ imitwe gisirikare harimo iya leta n’ indi iba yitwaje intwaro harimo kubinjiza kubakoresha ntambara umuryango ugamije gukumira kurwanya ikoreshwa ry’abana mitwe y’abarwanyi romeo dallaire child soldier initiative’ uvuga mpamvu zituma abana bakoreshwa ntambara harimo kuba batumva neza ingaruka z’ intambara kuba badahenda ababashoye bikorwa umuyobozi mukuru w’ muryango shelly whitman avuga bikorwa bingira ingaruka nyir’ubwite ndetse n’ umuryango rusange yagize dushaka mitwe imenya abana badatsinda intambara ingenzi twe kuvuga tuti wifuza uharanira byemerwa ugomba guhagarika kwinjiza gukoresha abana’ kandi abana barakura abana bazibuka hari bigeze guhohoterwa n’ abantu bakuru babakoresheje buryo budakwiye iyo tutitaye kintu bakuze batekereza kwihorera bazavamo abantu batumva bivuze kuyoborwa mahoro tugomba kumva ingenzi guca uruhererekane rw’ ibikorwa by’ urugomo umuryango w’abibumbye raporo yawo werekanye by’ abasirikare b’ abana isi hose abakobwa bivuze n’ akenshi abahungu bagaragara gisirikare ibitsina byombi bishorwa bikorwa birimo imirwano gukoreshwa imirimo y’ ubucakara harimo gushimisha abarwanyi b’ igitsina gabo bijyanye n’ imibonano mpuzabitsina iyi ngingo nyamukuru igarukwaho n’ abateraniye nama gukumira iyinjizwa n’ ikoreshwa ry’abana gisirikare yatangijwe mugaragaro minisitiri w’ ingabo maj gen albert murasira wasabye abayitabiriye gushakira umuti w’ kibazo mpamvu zigitera umuvugizi w’ ingabo z’ u rwanda lt col munyangango innocent agaragaza ikigamijwe ahanini uguhindura imyumvire kandi abajya butumwa bw’ amahoro bafite uruhare runini kuzana impinduka yagize ububi kwinjiza abana gisirikare ububi gukoresha abana nk’ igikoresho cy’ intambara tubikora hano twigisha abasirikare n’ abandi hano bahagarariye ibindi bisirikare kano karere kandi tubikora turi bikorwa kugarura amahoro hirya hino aho hose duhura n’ bibazo ariko witegure warabyize warabihuguriwe umenya n’ uburyo gufasha n’ abandi batarabigeraho uburyo babivamo umuyobozi rwanda peace academy col jules rutaremara yemeza kwigisha abana n’ imiryango ububi gokoresha abana ntambara kudatuma abasirikare n’ abandi barwanyi bakambika bigo by’ amashuri ndetse kubashyira hamwe nkambi biri byafasha guhangana n’ kibazo muri gicurasi hemejwe amasezerano mpuzamahanga kigali agamije kurengera abasivile ntambara yaje gukurikirwa n’andi y’ i vancouver yemejwe kugeza amaze gusinywa n’ ibihugu kandi u rwanda rukaba rwabaye igihugu mbere afurika cyayemeje iyi nama yitabiriwe n’ abahagarariye inzego gisirikare bihugu uganda kenya sudani y’ epfo sudani tanzaniya somaliya u rwanda kimwe n’ubutumwa bw’ amahoro ntara darfur sudan y’ epfo repubulika iharanira demokarasi kongo chief editor muhaburarw

title: umwubatsi wabaye umudozi urugendo turahirwa moses wambika perezida kagame
content: izina moshion rimaze kubaikimenyabose rwanda muhanga kubera imyambaro myiza cyane ikorerwa muriiyi nzu y’imideli simpamya neza kumyaka yawe waba utarataha ubukwe ubone umukwe yambaye umushananautakishijwe imigongo ikoze masaro y’umukara n’umweru ibuka amafoto y’umuhangowo gusaba umukobwa perezida w’ u rwanda ange kagame cyangwa se ubwoumuyobozi umuyobozi mukuru yasabwa akanakobwa imishanana yambawe n’abakweyari umweru ariko itakishijwe imigongo inshuro zitari nkewabonye umufasha w’umukuru w’igihugu jeannette kagame yambaye amakunzu cyangwase amashati meza atakishijwe imigongo y’amabara y’umweru n’umuhondo cyangwa seumukara n’umweru mu mashati menshi yakorewemu rwanda perezida kagame akunze kwambara hagaragagaramo atakishijwe imigongo injemu mutwe nonaha yambaye yagezaga banyarwanda ijambo ritangizaumwaka mu mafoto y’abayobozibakuru benshi bitabiriye umwiherero w’umwaka twabonye ubwiganze bw’imyendaitakishijwe imigongo uretse abayobozi batandukanyebakomeye bagaragaye myenda ibyamamare ngeri zitandukanyebyitabiriye kuyigura nk’abagura amasuka iyi myenda yoseyakozwe n’umusore umaze kuba umunyabigwi ruganda rw’imideli moses turahirwawashinze inzu yitwa moshions akaba umutumirwa kiganiro cyabreakfast gikorwa sandrine arthur kiss fm mu mwaka ushizeyahawe igihembo rwiyemezamirimo wateje imbere ibikorerwa rwanda rdbbusiness excellency awards nyamasheke-kigali urugendo mosesturahirwa rwatangiriye i nyamasheke ntara y’uburengerazuba yavukiyeakanahakurira kugeza arangije amashuri yisumbuye mu bwana bwe ngoyakundaga gukora utuntu tw’ubukorikori yifashishije ibikoresho yabonaga mucyaro nk’amakoma akayakuramo imitako cyangwa imyambaro mu gihe abandibabaguriraga imyenda maduka turahirwa yahitagamo kwidodeshereza ndetseagategeka abadozi babigenza ibigaragaza akora biri maraso yekuva kera ibyo kumurika imideliyabyumvanaga abana biganaga mashuri yisumbuye baturukaga mujyi kigalibimutera amatsiko kubijyamo mu mwaka nibwo yimukiye mujyi kigali agiye kwiga kaminuza turahirwa yabwiyekiss fm yageraga mujyi kigali yatangiye gukora ibijyanye nokumurika imideli y’abandi ariko afiteintego kuzahanga iye ati natangiyekwinjira ruhando rw’imideli rusange nkirangiza kwiga amashuriyisumbuye natangiye nk’umuntu werekana imyenda y’abandi ariko nari mfite iyonyota kujya urwo ruganda rw’imideli mpera kwerekana imyendantangira kumenyana n’ibigo by’abanyamideli abakora imyenda uyu musore umwe mubanyuze kigo cy’abanyamideli cyitwaga premiere model agency cyanyuzemobenshi bafite izina rikomeye nyuma y’imyaka ibiriamurika imideli y’abandi moses turahirwa yiyemeje gushaka uburyo yava byokumurika iy’abandi atangira gukora ibishushanyo by’imyenda agashakaabayimudodera ati ntangirakumenyana n’abadozi nari ntuye nkababwira nti mfite akantu twicaraneundodere kano kantu’ ntangira kumenya ibijyanye n’amamashini adoda bigendabizamuka icyo gihe yabikoraganko kwishimisha gushaka ahugiraho gihe atari ishuri ntamafaranga yateganyaga kubikuramo umwubatsiwabye umudozi turahirwa moses ibyogukora imideli yatangiye abantu bamwe batabyumva ariko azi ashakaabima amatwi akomeza kwishushyanyiriza imyenda aho yize ishuririkuru iprc kigali yigaga ibijyanye n’ubwubatsi civil engineering muishami ry’amazi ariko ntabwo yigeze afataimpapuro ajye gusaba akazi ishantiye mu mwaka yinjiyemu by’imideli nk’umwuga yiyita moshions ndetse atangira kwitabira ibitaramo byokumurika imideli n’ubwo gihe ubushobozi bwari bukiri hasi ati natangiye kurebaabantu basanzwe bategura amamurika gurisha cyangwa se amaserukiramuco y’imideliubwo banzi nk’umurika imideli mbwira john kigali fashion week nti mfiteimyenda nshaka kwerekana uzampe amahirwe mwaka nzerekane imyenda’ nyuma kwerekanaimyenda kigali fashion week abantu bakunze umwihariko kudakoreshaibitenge byari byarabaye nk’icyita rusange batangira kumugana umwiharikow’imigongo uretse hariabasigaye bayigana ubundi ikaranga imyenda yakozwe moshions imigongo ibaiyitatse buryo butandukanye ubundi imigongo niimitako imyemenyerewe muco kinyarwanda inyandiko zitandukanye zivuga kumateka y’u rwanda zigaragaza imigongo yatangiye gukoreshwa ahagana mukinyejana bwami bw’igisaka karere kirehe ntaray’uburasirazuba imigongo yazanywena kakira umwana w’umwami w’igisaka kimenyi nyuma gushaka ukoyajya ataka inzu akaba avumbura kakira yifashishijeamase y’inka gukora imigongo nzu amabara atandukanye akayakura mungwa umweru igitaka amazi y’ibiti n’ivu ry’ibirere kugira bitangeibara ry’umukara n’ubu bice bitandukanye cyane cyane ahabera ibikorwaby’ubukerarugendo hagaragara inzu zitakishijwe imigongo turahirwa avuga koyatekereje gukoresha imigongo myenda nko gushaka umwihariko ariko kandiugaragaza umuco nyarwanda ati nashakaga gukoraikintu abandi bantu batari barimo gukora ariko noneho nkashaka ikintu kinsubizaku isoko rwanda cyangwa se murange nyarwanda ukoyambitse umuryango perezida kagame umukuru w’igihugu n’abomu muryango abantu bakomeye cyane buryo umuntu wese ugiraakazi abakorera buzima bwabo bwari munsi intoranywa birashoboka hariabatekereza umuryango w’umukuru w’igihugu ukoresha byose biba byatumijwe mahanga ngandazikomeye isi ariko siko biri kuko bambara imyenda yakorewe rwanda cyanecyane iyakozwe moshions kwambika muryangobyari nzozi turahirwa ariko yumvaga ibidashoboka nyuma kwambikaabandi bayobozi bakomeye batandukanye umunsi umwe yahamagawe telefone n’umuntuatari azi abwirwa madamu jeannette kagame yifuza bahura ati umwaka ushize ndabyukanumva umuntu arampamagaye uzaba kazi ryari nyakubahwa umufashawa perezida repubulika azagusura cyangwa se ukwamwereka ukora kugirango arebe yagira imyenda akoresha’ haciye igihe kitarigito baje kongera kumuhamagara baramusura babonana amaso maso inzozi zeazikabya atyo atangira kumwambika moses turahirwa avugako kuba umuryango perezida kagame waramugiriye icyizere ukambara imyendayakoze inkunga ikomeye wamuteye ati kuri njyewe binyubakamo icyizere cy’uko ndi gukora ngomba gukomeza kubishyiramo umuhate kandi bifite ahantu biri kugera iyo inkunga ikomeye umuryango w’umukuru w’igihugu abantu b’icyitegererezo gihugu numva inkunga ikomeye noneho bikandema ngomba gukora ibintu birushijeho

title: abazi amateka y’u rwanda bemeza ingengabitekerezo y’urwango yigishijwe bw’abakoloni
content: abazi amateka y’u rwanda bemeza ingengabitekerezo y’urwango yigishijwe bw’abakoloni yatumye jenoside yakorewe abatutsi ishoboka ikanagira ubukana bukabijebagaragaza jenoside yaje indunduro y’umugambi w’igihe kirekire kurimbura abatutsi gufatanyagusangira n’indi migenzo myiza myinshi bimwe byarangaga abanyarwanda cyera umusaza isidore kayumba w’imyaka y’amavuko imibanire y’abanyarwanda imibanire myiza kandi n’abayobozi barabibatozaga guhana inka guhana abageni byose byatumaga basabana bakabana na ho umubyeyi clotilde ntabwo bahirikanaga ubone bapfa ibintu cyane abantu bakunze gupfa imitungoariko bakwiranye kandi bafashanya udafite ikintu akagishaka wundi icya kabiri cyatumaga binashoboka ubuyobozi bwiza icya gatatu ubuyobozi bwiza aho abakoloni bagereye rwanda ariko ibintu byarahindutse gutoza abantu imigenzo myiza bisimburwa kubigisha urwango kayumba imibanire yatangiye kuzamo agatotsi gihe cy’ubukoloni ubukoloni buriya bwateye imizi myinshi yatumye abantu badakomeza imibanire bajyanye musinga biraherabica rudahigwa biraherabirukana kigeli birahera haje n’amashyaka politiki hagira atinyuka gutukana nka aprosoma gitera zitangira gutuka umwami ugasanga abazungu ntacyo babikozeho kandi ugasanga babyenyegeza kuva abatutsi batangiye kwibasirwa baricwa abandi bameneshwa gihugu cyabo kandi abategetsi b’abakoloni ntibagire babikorahoumusaza kayumba akemeza yabaye intangiriro y’umugambi jenoside yakorewe abatutsi ati noneho batangiza intambara abantu baragendaga bagatinya kwica ariko abandi bakabibatinyura bajyaga kubayobora batera havuye umuzi jenoside nyuma y’urugamba guhagarika jenoside hashyizwe ingufu kunga abanyarwanda biba umusingi kubaka u rwanda rushya muhaburarw

title: ivumburamatsiko fred lyon wambika benshi byamamare nyarwanda
content: ubusanzwe yitwa fred ndicunguye amaze imyaka ibiri n’igice akora akazi gucuruza imyambaro itandukanye inkweto n’ibindi akundwa benshi kuko agira imyambaro igezweho ubaze umubare w’ibyamamare ntiwawurangiza kuko uhereye bruce melodie shaddy boo queen cha safi madiba dj toyxxk marnaud n’abandi benshi igihe yamwegereye imuganiriza byinshi abantu bashobora kumwibazaho ndetse n’uko yatangiye gukora ubucuruza bw’imyenda bwaje gutuma yiharira isoko gukorana n’ibyamamare avuga gucuruza yabitangiye kera yiga kaminuza bushinwa akaza kubona impano ati ni ibintu byari bisanzwe bindimo nkiri kaminuza nabwo nari umucuruzi hari ukuntu ushobora kuba ukora aka kazi ariko biro ugira niko nakoraga nabikoze nkiri ishuri mbona byavamo umugati aho nasoreje kaminuza naratangiye abantu baramenya nanjye bakeneye ndakimenya nize bushinwa ibijyanye n’ubushabitsi mpuzamahanga aho nigaga nakundaga gutembera masoko atandukanye ugasanga njye uhorana ibintu bishya bikaba ngombwa bagenzi banjye title: bimwe bikoresho pulasitiki bikoreshwa rimwe byakumiriwe rwanda
content: ibi bikoresho birimo imiheha pulasitiki ibikoresho byifashishwa kuvanga amakanya ibiyiko ibikombe n’amasahani bikoreshwa inshuro ibipurizo n’ububiko cyangwa ibitwarwamo impapuro bikoze pulasitiki izi ngamba zatangarijwe kiganiro n’itangazamakuru minisiteri y’ibidukikije ifatanyije n’ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe kurengera ibidukikije rema byagiranye n’abanyamakuru hasobanurwaga gutangiza ubukangurambaga icibwa ry’ibikoresho pulasitike bikoreshwa inshuro bikajugunywa imibare igaragaza munsi hakorwa toni miliyoni pulasitiki buri mwaka hakiyongeraho miliyari eshanu z’amasashi pulasitiki n’amacupa abarirwa miliyari kimwe kabiri pulasitiki zikoreshwa rimwe zirajugunywa zigahinduka umwanda bivugwa bikomeje uku pulasitiki zikorwa zizikuba inshuro eshatu kuva u rwanda rwabaye igihugu cyaciye ikoreshwa ry’amasashi hirya hino gihugu naho rushyiraho itegeko n ryo ryerekeye kubuza ikorwa itumizwa mahanga ikoreshwa n’icuruzwa ry’amasashi n’ibikoresho bikozwe pulasitiki bikoreshwa inshuro iri tegeko ryavuguruye iryari risanzwe kugira rigene ibyerekeye pulasitiki zindi zitari zararebwe n’itegeko kuko byagaragaye zitera ihumana ry’ibidukikije ibi byatumye zimwe pulasitiki zibuzwa n’iri tegeko kongera gukoreshwa rwanda minisiteri y’ibidukikije yabwiye abanyamakuru tegeko ribuza itumizwa mahanga ikorwa icuruzwa n’ikoreshwa ry’amasashi n’izindi pulasitiki zikoreshwa inshuro nk’ibipfunyikwamo ibiribwa cyangwa ibindi bintu ibi birimo imiheha pulasitiki ibikoresho byifashishwa kuvanga amakanya ibiyiko ibikombe n’amasahani bikoreshwa inshuro ibipurizo n’ububiko cyangwa ibitwarwamo impapuro bikoze pulasitiki ivuga zimwe ngaruka ziterwa n’ikoresha pulasitiki zikorerwa gukoreshwa inshuro harimo gutera umwanda nkengero z’imihanda mazi gufunga inzira z’amazi kugabanya ubushobozi by’amazi kwinjira butaka bityo bigatuma habaho imyuzure inyinshi pulasitiki zikoreshwa inshuro zikorwa mavuta peteroli zikaba zitabora burundu ahubwo zikagaragara bidukikije nk’uduce duto duto tugira uruhare gutera umwanda kwanduza ibiribwa n’ibindi ubushakashatsi bwakozwe bwemeje impfu nyinshi z’inyamaswa mazi n’inyoni ziterwa kurya pulasitiki uduce twa pulasitiki zitashangutse twasanzwe nyamaswa minisitiri dr mujawamariya yagize guhera munsi bimwe bikoresho pulasitiki birimo amasahane imiheha n’izindi pulasitike zikoreshwa inshuro nk’ibipfunyikwamo ibiribwa cyangwa ibindi bintu bibujijwe kongera gukoreshwa rwanda nta muntu tubujije kugura ibintu bipfunyitse pulasitiki ishati zipfunyitse amazi icupa n’ibindi kubera nganda ntizirabona izisimbura bikoresho kugeza igihe zizaba zabisimbuye tubujije ugupfunyika umugati pulasitiki imbuto pulasitiki inyama pulasitiki isombe n’ibindi kuko bifite ibisimbura pulasitiki minisiteri y’ibidukikije ivuga pulasitiki zikoreshwa n’inganda gupfunyika zisonewe gupfunyikishwa gusa ibicuruzwa bikorerwa ruganda rwabiherewe uruhushya ariko zigomba gushyirwaho ikimenyetso kigaragara n’uruganda ruzipfunyikisha ibicuruzwa byarwo ivuga ikorwa itumizwa mahanga ikoreshwa cyangwa icuruzwa ry’ibikoresho bikozwe pulasitiki ibora miterere isanzwe bikorwa byabanje gusabirwa uruhushya rwego rubifitiye ububasha rema ariko hagaragajwe hari impamvu zihariye uruhushya rusabwa nyadiko bimwe bihano biteganyijwe minisiteri y’ibidukikije ivuga bimwe bihano bihabwa umuntu wese ukora amasashi n’ibikoresho bikozwe pulasitiki bikoreshwa inshuro ahanishwa gufungirwa ibikorwa kwamburwa masashi n’ibyo bikoresho kwishyura ihazabu rwego rw’ubutegetsi ingana miliyoni mafaranga y’u rwanda harimo kandi kwishyura ihazabu rwego rw’ubutegetsi ingana inshuro z’agaciro k’ayo masashi n’ibyo bikoresho bikozwe pulasitiki bikoreshwa rimwe n’ibindi bihano umuyobozi mukuru rema eng colette ruhamya yagize ibi bikoresho abantu bakwiye kujya babyitondera cyane kubishyiramo ibintu bishyushye yego kintu kitagira ingaruka bidukikije ariko ushaka wagabanya ngaruka avuga mbere haciwe amasashi ariko hatewe intambwe kureba n’ibindi bikoresho bikoreshwa inshuro byacibwa

content: muri nama y’abaminisitiri niho hemejwe raporo y’ishyirwa bikorwa gahunda kugabanya ibitumizwa mahanga isaba ingamba zafashwe urwo rwego zakwihutishwa u rwanda kimwe n’ibindi bihugu byinshi afurika ndetse n’ibindi bikiri nzira y’amajyambere usanga ibyinjira gihugu biba biruta ibisohoka hanze y’igihugu abaminisitiri bagejejweho raporo igaragaza ingamba zafashwe kugira u rwanda rukomeze kuza isonga bihugu byorohereza ubucuruzi n’ishoramari nk’uko byagaragarajwe raporo yakozwe banki y’isi bagejejweho kandi raporo y’aho imirimo kubaka uruganda rutunganya umusaruro w’imyumbati kinazi karere ruhango igeze isaba imirimo isigaye yihutishwa kugira uruganda rutangire gutunganya imyumbati aha inama y’abaminisitiri yagejejweho raporo kibazo cy’amata yabuze isoko ntara y’iburasirazuba isaba ingamba zafashwe rwego kubonera isoko ry’amata y’aborozi zakwihutishwa iyi nama yasuzumye kandi yemeza raporo igaragaza gahunda kubaka umuryango w’ibihugu afurika y’i burasirazuba ndetse n’inyungu u rwanda rukura muryango gerard gitoli mbabazi

title: byari agahinda gushyingura ababikira b’abanyarwandakazi baguye yemen -reba amafoto
content: abanyarwandakazi marguerite mukashema umubikira w’i kabgayi muryango w’abamisiyoneri b’urukundo b’aba-calcutta reginette uwingabire w’i janja biciwe yemen bazira abakirisitu basezeweho nyuma rwanda bakazashyingurwa yemen mu bice bitandukanye by’u rwanda habaye misa gusabira babikira zayobowe n’abasenyeri diyoseze bavukamo muri paruwasi kivumu diyoseze kabgayi umushumba wayo musenyeri mbonyintege smaragde yayoboye igitambo misa gusabira sr marguerite mukashema uvuka murenge cyeza paruwasi cyabaye cyumweru tariki werurwe kuri altari hari amafoto y’abo banyarwandakazi umunyakenyakazi n’umuhindekazi bicanywe bakomoka muryango w’intumwa z’urukundo washinzwe tereza w’i calcutta mbonyintege yavuze mukashema aje akurikira umupadiri w’umusuwisi vjeco umumisiyoneri wapfiriye rwanda title: ishavu ry’abanyarwanda ritubere umusingi kwiyubaka umuyobozi w’umurenge bwishyura
content: umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’umurenge bwishyura niyonsaba cyriaque wifatanyije n’abaturage b’imidugudu nyarurembo karutete yagize ishavu ry’abanyarwanda ritubere umusingi kwiyubaka aha niyonsaba yungaga nsanganyamatsiko yahariwe mwaka igira iti twigire mateka turusheho kubaka ejo hazaza niyonsaba yaboneyeho akanya kunenga politike yazanywe n’abazungu gushyamiranya abantu yatunze agatoki ababiligi baje rwanda bagasanga abanyarwanda babanye neza bagasiga barukongeje n’ikintu kigaragara barusigiye umuyobozi w’umurenge bwishyura yagize urugero nk’aha kibuye basize bubatse gereza yonyine nk’aho abanyakibuye bakeneye hatanzwe ubuhamya bw’umwe bacitse icumu kibuye mukangoga emelita ufite imyaka gusa igihe jenoside yabaga yari afite ikiniga kinshi ariko yabashije kuvuga make byamugendekeye yabisobanuye magambo ikintu ntazigera nibagirwa igihe papa yampamagaye arangije guteka inkono y’ibijumba nituze aduhe ifunguro nyuma namubajije impamvu atubwiye atyo ambwira bagiye kutwica kuva bahise badutera turatatanangenda nomongana ntazi ngana hashize akanya gato mbona iwacu barahatwitse narinihishe mbona interahamwe zizanye papa kumwe murumuna papa afite bibiliya barayimwaka barayica amanika amaboko hejuru agira mana bantu ubababarire ntibazi barimo gukora ako kanya bahita bamutema amaboko murumuna babatsinda ahonanjye bashatse kunyica inshuro nyinshi buryo nageze mera nk’ikinya nkajya mbabwira nabi nti nimukore mushakaibyambayeho birebire mbivuze bwakwira bugacyagusa ndashimira imana nkiriho nk’uko mukangoga yakomeje abitangamo ubuhamya mukangoga emelita yasigaye wenyine muryango w’abana nyina bamwishe atwite inda cyenda se n’abavandimwe barabamaze ubu umubyeyi w’abana babili umuhungu w’imyaka n’imfura y’umukobwa w’imyaka ubura umwaka umwe angane mama igihe jenoside yabaga nyuma y’ubuhamya mukangoga hatanzwe n’ikiganiro ruhare leta yagize jenoside umwe bacitse icumu watanze ikiganiro yasobanuye ukuntu abatutsi kibuye kimwe n’ahandi hose rwibutso jenoside ruri iruhande rw’ahahoze sitade gatwaro mujyi kibuye kugera mudugudu nyarurembo ahabereye ibiganiro gukurikira ijambo ry’umukuru w’igihugu yahariye munsi radiyo televiziyo abari babashije gukusanya amafaranga ibihumbi gutera inkunga abacitse icumu mu rwego rw’akarere gutangiza icyunamo byabereye murenge mubuga umuyobozi w’akarere karongi kayumba bernard n’abandi bayobozi bagiye kwifatanya n’abandi kwibuka nshuro jenoside yakorewe abatutsi gasana marcellin

title: gakenke inkeragutabara n’abafasha barahuguwe mateka
content: kubakira byiza mateka y’u rwanda kugira uruhare kubungabunga umutekano hatangwa amakuru gihe muntu wese wahungabanya umutekano bimwe byagarutsweho mahugurwa yateguwe komisiyo gusubiza buzima busanzwe agenewe inkeragutabara n’abafasha yabereye biro by’akarere gakenke ukwakira afungura mahugurwa umuyobozi komisiyo gusubiza buzima busanzwe abahoze rugamba ntara y’amajyaruguru madamu niyonteze clemence yasabye abitabiriye mahugurwa kuyakurikirana neza kuko ingirakamaro mibereho n’abaturanyi yakomeje avuga mahugurwa agamije guhugura cyane cyane abagore b’inkeragutabara bagahugukirwa gahunda leta dore batigeze bahugurwa bagaruka rwababyaye ndetse kumenya ibibazo bafite bwana safali wilson watanze ikiganiro mateka y’u rwanda mahugurwa yasobanuriye abitariye amahugurwa imvano y’amateka yateye jenoside yakorewe abatutsi yavuze abazungu banditse kandi bakigisha amateka y’u rwanda bayagoreka nkana kugira bacemo ibice abanyarwanda babashe kubategeka bise cyongereza divide and rule by’umwihariko ababiligi banditse amateka y’abanyarwanda bagendeye mateka y’amacakubiri gihugu cyabo hagati y’abafurama flamands n’abawaru wallons dore iwabo byacikaga hagati yayo moko uretse bakoroni safali yakomeje avuga natwe ubwacu twabigizemo uruhare cyane cyane ubutegetsi butandukanye bwagiye busimburana bwahembereye macukubiri kugeza abanyarwanda barangajwe imbere n’ubutegetsi bubi bamburaga ubuzima abavandimwe basaga miliyoni asobanura ikigenderewe kwiga amateka yavuze kubaka ejo hazaza bwana safali yagize kumenya amateka yacu bidufasha kwirinda amabi jenoside tukubakira mateka meza bidufasha kandi kumenya twatsinzwe n’aho twatsinze nk’abanyarwanda ni byiza kwiga amateka kuko ushaka kwiyibagiza amateka ashaka kuyasubiramo ibyo bigamije kubaka ejo hazaza h’igihugu cyacu kizira amacakubiri n’ingengabiterezo jenoside umutekano isoko y’iterambere lt muhozi charles ubarizwa batayo ikorera karere gakenke watanze ikiganiro mutekano yavuze iterambere u rwanda rwagezeho rurikesha umutekano niyo mpamvu tugomba kuwubungabunga kugira tutazasubira inyuma yibukije abitariye amahugurwa batagomba kwirara bagomba gutanga amakuru gihe muntu wese ushobora baturutse turere twa rulindo gakenke batahutse bava mashyamba repubulika iharanira demokarasi kongo guhera kugeza mwaka turimo nshimiyimana leonard

title: drone yaje kudufasha kugabanya umubare w’amaraso yangirikaga - dr condo
content: drone zatangiye gukwirakwiza amaraso rwanda mwaka zagabanyije umubare w’amaraso yangirikaga ndetse n’umwanya byafataga amaraso agere bigo nderabuzima bitandukanye gihugu drone zatangiye gukwirakwiza amaraso rwanda mwaka zagabanyije umubare w’amaraso yangirikaga ndetse n’umwanya byafataga amaraso agere bigo nderabuzima bitandukanye gihugu tariki kamena n’umunsi isi yizihiza umunsi mpuzamahanga w’abantu batanga amaraso rwego rw’isi mwaka munsi uzihirizwa rwanda gatanu mubyo u rwanda ruzaba rwishimira rwagezeho harimo uburyo amaraso akwirakwizwa hirya hino gihugu uburyo abikwa ndetse kuba ruri bihugu bifite abaturage batanga amaraso kiguzi bategereje umuyobozi w’ikigo cy’igihugu cy’ubuzima rbc dr jeanine u condo aganira n’itangazamakuru yagize ubu rwanda turi bihugu bike bifite abantu batanga amaraso buntu ibindi bihugu bifite ibibazo kubona abaturage batanga amaraso buntu bihugu afurika gusa nibyo bifite abaturage batanga amaraso buntu yakomeje avuga munsi mpuzamahanga bazanashimira abantu bagerageje gutanga amaraso inshuro nyinshi barimo inzego z’umutekano abanyeshuri n’abaganga dr jeanine condo asobanurira abanyamakuru u rwanda rwiteguye umunsi mpuzamahanga gutanga amaraso dr jeanine u condo yasobanuye myaka itatu ishize drone zitangiye gukoreshwa rwanda zagabanyije ingano y’ amaraso yangirikaga yagize mbere tutaratangira gukoresha drone impuzandengo y’igihe ibitaro byasabiraga amaraso n’igihe yabagereragaho yaragabanutse kuko byavuye masaha ane bigera minota gihugu hose ikindi drone zadufashije n’ukugabanya umubare w’amaraso yangirikiraga bigo nderabuzima kuko amaraso arengeje iminsi yamaze kwangirika habagaho ikibazo abaganga bagasaba amaraso menshi arenza minsi akangirika dr janine u condo avuga drone zatumye igihe umurwayi yamaraga ategereje amaraso kigabanuka iri gabanuka ry’igihe ibitaro byasabiraga amaraso n’igihe byayaboneraga byatumye hari abantu benshi bafashwa buryo bworoheje urugero nk’abagore babyara ariko bagakomeza biraborohera guhita babona amaraso abarwayi malariya nabo batinda kwivuza bakenera amaraso bayabona buryo bwihuse kuva drone zatangira kugeza zimaze gukora ingendo zikwirakwiza amaraso zimaze gutwara udushashi gihugu hose uyu munsi mpuzamahanga ugiye kongera kwizihirizwa afurika kunshuro kabiri nyuma y’imyaka kuko byaherukaga kubera afurika y’epfo ishami ry’umuryango mpuzamahanga ryita buzima oms niryo ritoranya igihugu kizawakira u rwanda rwatoranyijwe bigendeye mubare munini w’abantu batanga amaraso buntu benshi ikiganiro cyitabiriwe n’abanyamakuru bibitangazamakuru bitandukanye bikorera rwanda

title: rubavu rusizi hafatiwe abasore bakwirakwiza amafaranga y’amiganano
content: abasore aribo sadi muhamedi tuyishime pascal maboko polisi turere twa rubavu rusizi ntara y’uburengerazuba bakaba bakurikiranyweho icyaha gukwirakwiza amafaranga y’amiganano umuvugizi polisi ntara y’uburengerazuba inspector of police ip eulade gakwaya yavuze sadi yafatiwe karere rubavu murenge gisenyi aha yavuze yagiye kugura ibintu iduka hanyuma yishyura amafaranga y’amiganano umucuruzi abibonye abibwira abaturage baramufata kanya gato hahise haza n’undi muturage avuga musore yamwishyuye amiganano akaba yamuburiye irengero abo baturage nibo bahise babitumenyesha turamufata afungiye sitasiyo polisi gisenyi ip gakwaya yavuze kandi witwa tuyishime yafatiwe kagari gahunga murenge mururu akarere rusizi akaba yaraguze ibintu yishyura inoti amafaranga yishyuye abaturage bayagiriye amakenga bahita bahamagara polisi bayasuzumye basanga amiganano hanyuma bamusatse bamusangana n’izindi noti nazo z’inyiganano akaba afungiye sitasiyo polisi kamembe yavuze rusange amafaranga y’amiganano adakunze kugaragara ntara y’uburengerazuba ariko bice byegereye umupaka hari ahaboneka asaba abaturage kugira amakenga mafaranga bahawe cyane cyane amashya yavuze iyiganwa ry’amafaranga ntiriratera intera ndende rwanda ariko n’iyo yaba make agira ingaruka mbi bukungu niyo mpamvu buri wese akwiye kubyirinda kubirwanya turagira inama abacuruzi kugira amakenga gusuzuma amafaranga bahabwa n’abakiriya cyane cyane masaha y’umugoroba kuko aribwo batekamutwe babonamo icyuho gutanga amafaranga y’amiganano ndetse bakanihutira kumenyesha polisi igihe hari baketse ayafite ip gakwaya yashimye abaturage batanze amakuru banyabyaha nayo yatumye bafatwa yakomeje avuga kwigana amafaranga bitesha agaciro ifaranga ry’igihugu ndetse bikanagira ingaruka mbi iterambere ry’igihugu rusange yasabye abaturage kwirinda ibikorwa aribyo byose gushaka amafaranga buryo bunyuranije n’amategeko kuko uretse gufatwa bagafungwa binagira ingaruka miryango yavuze iperereza rikomeje kugirango harebwe bandi bakorana n’aba bafashwe bityo nabo bashyikirizwe ubutabera yibukije kwigana gukoresha amafaranga y’amahimbano icyaha gihanwa n’amategeko ingingo gitabo cy’amategeko ahana ibyaha rwanda ivuga umuntu wese ukwirakwiza ibintu byose byakwitiranywa n’amafaranga cyangwa izindi mpapuro zivunjwamo amafaranga ahanishwa igifungo myaka ibiri kugeza itanu n’ihazabu y’amafaranga y’u rwanda yikubye inshuro ebyiri kugeza icumi z’agaciro k’amafaranga y’amiganano src policegovrw

title: inama zagufasha igihe ukunda umuntu ariko atagukunda
content: hari abantu usanga bararenzwe n’urukundo nyamara bakunda atabiyumvamo ndetse akanabibereka ariko bagakomeza bagahatiriza ntawakugira umunyamakosa kuko wisanze ukunda urudashoboka rutazakugarukira ariko hari wakora byagufasha gicuku urimo ugatangira ubuzima bushya nkuko tubikesha elcrema urubuga rwandika rukundo n’mibanire jya umunya udafite uburenganzira kugenzura ibitekerezo by’undi ni koko birababaza kuba warimariyemo umuntu ariko ntabyiteho ariko ugomba kumva none afite impamvu ze akenshi utekereza nkaho hari uburenganzir aufite kuba wahindura imitekerereze ariko buriya wakora cyose atabishatse kimwe cyahinduka irinde ikintu cyose kiguhuza ubikoze kinyabupfura wirinda gukomeza gukurura ibintu byose byatuma uhura cyanwga se umuvugishe iyo wihaye mwanya nibwo ugaruka bitekerezo bizima bikagushoboza kumwikuramo menya ushobora kubaho neza udafite muntu wakunze gusara abenshi bakunze buryo usanga bavuga badashobora kubaho gihe badafite muntu bakunze nyamara biba ukwiyica mutwe kuko n’ubundi azakomeza akwanjye kandi uzabaho neza utamufite irinde kwihorera wakunze hari n’abandi badashobora kwihangana ugasanga kuko yakunze umusore cyanwga se inkumi bakaba bamaranye imyaka runaka abantu babizi nngo amakatiye agiye gushaka ikintu kibi amukorera rwego kumwumvisha atakimukeneye ibyo nabyo ntibikwiriye kandi ntacyo bikubohoraho mutqwwaro w’urukundo uba usigaranye ni byiza kwitwararika wkirind aamagambo mabi umubwira cyangwa se ikindi gikorwa kibi wamukorera irinde gushaka uhirikaho ikosa ibyo nabyo bikunze kuba bantu kababaro kwangwa nabo bakundaga ugasanga gushaka bahirikiraho ikosa ugatangira gutekereza umusore cyanwga se inkumi yamukunze ibiri inyuma ababyeyi se inshuti n’abandi iyo ugiye bigutesha umwanya kandi ukarushaho kubabara kwakira ibyakubayeho shaka ibindi bigushimisha uhugiramo ariko wirinde ibikwangiza washaka inshuti zawe zikajya zikuba ugakora n’ibindi bintu bikurangaza nko kureba filimi siporo n’ibindi gusa none wirinda kwihahuza inzoga kwishora busambanyi n’ibindi bisa nkabyo ibi bimwe byagufasha igihe wakunze umuntu cyane ariko akaba atagukunda gihe mwigeze gukundana akaza kuguhakanira

title: rusizi abaturage barashinja ubugome umukozi ushinzwe ubuvuzi bw’amatungo
content: bamwe baturage batuye umurenge nyakabuye rusizi babwiye ikinyamakuru muhaburarw babangamiwe cyane n’imikorere y’umuyobozi ushinzwe ubuvuzi bw’ amatungo bwana bizimana dieudonne bamushinja bashyira gihombo kubera amatungo amaze gutabisha avuga arwaye kandi atayapimye bakavuga abikorera ubugome nk’uko byemezwa n’abaturage ibi bibaye nyuma yaho kabiri tariki gicurasi yahuye n’abantu batwaye ingurube ku’ igare ababwira ntawemerewe gutwara ingurube magare ababwira nibayibaga wemerewe kuyirya ikimara kubagwa yategetse itabwa kandi wemerewe kuyirya gusa inzego z’umutekano zarahagobotse zirabicyemura ku gatanu i saa mbiri nibwo nabwo umuturage bita ngendahayo yabaze ingurube bahamagaye umuvuzi w’amatungo murenge bizimana dieudone ababwira ngurube igomba gutabwa akurikije ijisho rye nk’umuvuzi w’amatungo wabyigiye umwe baturage baganiriye n’umunyamakuru muhaburarw avuga batazi ikibazo uriya mugabo afite dore gushinja umuntu ubusazi inzego z’ubuvuzi zitarabyemeza icyaha ariko nabwo atakomeza akora amakosa abantu bamurebera kandi bamusingiza ngendahayo wabaze ngurube avuga atazi bapfa dieudonne umukozi w’umurenge ushinzwe ubuvuzi bw’amatungo kuko yamubwiye hari umunsi azaza akamuhombya ibintu afata nk’inkomoko gushaka kumutabira ingurube yagize niba avuga ingurube ifite ikibazo kuki atayipimye yemeze irwaye ahubwo akihutira itabwa kandi atayikozeho byose byarebwaga n’abaturage ese wundi muvuzi w’amatungo uba murenge buryo yayipima ayikozeho akareba iby’ubwo burwayi bizimana dieudonne avuga akarengane kandi agomba kunyishyura kuwa gatandatu taliki gicurasi ahagana i saa yine isoko ry’ amatungo riherereye murenge nyakabuye kagari kamanu mudugudu ruguti mukozi w’umurenge bizimana dieudonne yasanze abaguzi n’abagurisha amatungo arabatuka bikomeye yihanangitlriza ushinzwe imisoro umukozi ngari amubwira agomba kujya aza gusoresha abanje kumubwira terefone kandi atemerewe gusoresha itungo ritarabagwa ni nyuma yaho kandi humvikanye umukecuru mudugudu bunyereri kagari kiziho witwa patricie wakubiswe bikomeye n’uwo mukozi w’umurenge bizimana dieudonne kugeza amuciriyeho imyenda y’ibanga nkuko bivugwa nyirukubikorerwa patricie yagize yasanze ngiye kugura imboga centre kiziho arangije anshota umugeri ibitenge birataraka mba akumiro baturage ansanga muferege ampata imigeri gusa nakijijwe n’umuyobozi kumwe arandeka gusa njye naramuvumye munsi ese imikoranire n’abandi bayobozi ihagaze ite umwe ushinzwe iterambere kagari utashatse amazina atangazwa wize ubuvuzi bw’amatungo yavuze yahuye n’uruva gusenya yapimaga itungo centre kiziho dieudonne yahagera akazikingirana avuga uwazipimye atazi gupima byabaye ngombwa hiyambazwa umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’umurenge nyakabuye ategeka hakingurwa yagize yaje napimye itungo centre ahita afata ingufuri arakinga avuga napimye atabyemera cyakora i saa munani umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’umurenge niwe watanze uburenganzira kuhakingura umuturage acuruza inyama ze ku ruhande veternaire dieudonne avuga akora inshingano ze yazize atarebye ruhande yagize njye nkora inshingano zanjye ibindi by’abantu banzanaho amagambo simbirimo kuko njyewe nize amashuri menshi kandi ndi umuhanga buvuzi bw’amatungogitifu nayobore mayor nayobore nanjye mvure amatungo isomere inkuru bifitanye isano rusizi birababaje umukozi w’umurenge yasabye ubuhungiro sacco ku murongo terefoni muhaburarw vuganye n’umuyobizi n’ushinzwe ubuvuzi bw’amatungo karere avuga hashakwa muvuzi w’amatungo agapima iryo tungo yahageraga yasanze veterineri w’umurenge nyakabuye dieudone yahafunze babura imfunguzo umuyobozi w’akarere rusizi bwana kayumba ephrem yabwiye umunyamakuru muhaburarw imyitwarire y’uriya mukozi w’umurenge ushinzwe ubuvuzi bw’amatungo bizimana dieudonne igomba kwigwaho kayumba yagize atituricara dusesengure turebe myitwarire gusa inzego zitandukanye z’ubuyobozi zivuga uyu mugabo umunyadushya kuko akora usanga hari icy’ibyihishe inyuma ariko kwemezwa muganga ubifitiye ububasha denis fabrice nsengumuremyimuhaburarw
