title: abahoze bakinira amavubi bihanangirije abaganda
content: nta mbaraga nyinshi wababonanaga kwirukanka kugongana kuwi bagande ntago kwagaragaye mukino warimo ubwenge amacenga guhererakanya umupira bitonze byanyuze abanyarwanda batari bacye sitade kigali i nyamirambo wari umukino kivandimwe ugamije gufasha wahuje abahoze bakinira ikipe y’u rwanda n’abahoze bakinira ikipe uganda ukarangira amavubi anyagiye imisambi yiganjemo abagaconze ntangiro y’ikinyejana ibitego bokota labama yeretse bagabo kigero kimwe agifite imbaraga kubarusha ibitego byiza cyane umupira mwiza yahaye saidi abedi makasi bokota yongeye kwibutsa abanyarwanda igikurankota nyacyo myaka ishizewasangaga benshi bafite akanyamuneza maso bongeye kubona bagabo bashimishije benshi myaka ishize kapiteni rwanda b kadubiri yongeye guhura munyaneza djuma kayiranga jean baptiste abafashije u rwanda kujya gikombe cy’africa barangajwe imbere katauti kapiteni wabo karekezi olivier ubayoboye kibuga ntaganda elias karim habimana jimmy mulisa umutoza eric nshimiyimana n’abandi benshi ikipe uganda yinjiye kibuga neza iza gufungura amazamu hakiri kare igitego cyatsinzwe kabuhariwe kayizi vicent waciye hano rwanda ikipe apr fc rwanda rwari rufite abafana benshi sitade kigali rwatangiye kotsa igitutu ikipe uganda bokota saidi abedi batangira guhusha ibitego nyuma guhererekanya neza umupira hagati bokota saidi abedi makasi igikurankota cyafunguye amazamu ruhande rw’u rwanda ntibyatwaye umwanya munini umusore abedi makasi atsinda igitego ruhande rw’u rwanda bajya kuruhuka ibitego uganda bavuye karuhuko umutoza kanamugire yaje gukora impinduka nyuma y’iminota gusa karim winjiye asimbuye umutoza kayiranga abonera u rwanda igitego umutoza uganda yahise akora impinduka yinjiza philip sozi afatanye hakim magumba ariko bokota yaje gufata umupira awukuye kibuga hagati acenga abakinnyi uganda atsinda igitego ntibyatwaye umwanya munini karekezi wakomeje gukina neza yahawe umupira abedi makasi atsinda igitego aha abahoze bakinira u rwanda barushaga bigaragara abakiniye uganda uganda yakoze impinduka yinjiza kibuga abakinnyi benshi barimo francis gonzaga myugariro wahoze akomeye cyane ikipe apr fc umutoza aloys kanamugire kishi bakuragamo abakinnyi benshi binjiza cami hamiss bagumaho muhamud mossi wishimiwe cyane n’abafana canisius n’abandi uganda yatangiye kurusha u rwanda cyane philip sozi aza gutsinda igitego ruhande uganda umupira watwaye umwanya munini kubera kibuga hagati bigaragara uganda ifite inyota y’igitego kurusha u rwanda irwanya kugabanya umwenda ariko matunguru izamu ababera ibamba nako akomeza gushyiramo amafiyeri menshi gangi byashimishaga abari sitade kigali philip sozi wakomeje kuzengereza abahoze bakinira amavubi yaje gutsinda igitego ruhande uganda umukinnyi weretse benshi agifite imbaraga n’amacenga menshi dore bacye batangiye umukino bakanawurangiza mpande zombi uyu mukino unagamije gufasha umuryango nyakwigendera jean marie ntagwabira ndetse n’umwana patrick mafisango nako bifuzaga kuba bafasha bagenzi buzima bubi uyu mukino witabiriwe kandi n’abahoze bayobora ferwafa barimo afande kayizari ceaser ndetse ntagungira celestin bita abega ariko ntihigeze haboneka nzamwita vincent de gaulle uyobora ferwafa aba bifuza imikino nk’iyi yajya iba kenshi igahuza abakiniye amavubi ndetse bakifuza ubutaha habonekamo bagenzi batagaragaye nshuro yanditswe ubwanditsimuhaburarw

title: uko coronavirus yatumye imiti itari iy’ukuri yiyongera isi
content: ishami ry’umuryango w’abibumbye ryita buzima omswho ryaburiye imiti mpimbano ivugwaho kuvura coronavirus yiyongereye bihugu biri nzira y’amajyambere iperereza bbc dukesha nkuru ryasanze hari imiti mpimbano icuruzwa afurika abayicuruza bakaba baca urwaho kuba muti coronavirus uraboneka ndetse n’ibura ry’indi miti y’ibanze oms ivuga imiti nk’iyo ishobora kugira ingaruka zikomeye buzima impuguke yaburiye hashobora kwaduka ikindi cyorezo gitewe n’imiti itujuje ubuziranenge kandi mpimbano ku isi abantu bakomeje kwirundaho imiti y’ibanze bakayihunika zabo ariko gihe ibihugu bibiri mbere bikora imiti myinshi isi ubushinwa n’ubuhinde biri bihe bidasanzwe abacyeneye imiti baruta imiti isoko ndetse n’icuruzwa ry’imiti mpimbano riri kwiyongera ubwo itariki z’ukwa gatatu oms yatangazaga coronavirus icyorezo cyugarije isi cyumweru polisi mpuzamahanga interpol yafashe abigana imiti operation pangea itsinda interpol rirwanya imiti mpimbano yataye yombi abantu bihugu isi gihe cy’iminsi irindwi gusa ibyo byatumye ifata imiti mpimbano yajyaga gushyira ubuzima kaga ifite agaciro karenga miliyoni z’amadolari y’amerika mu bihugu malaysia kugera mozambique abapolisi interpol bafashe kwipfuka maso masquesmasks bibarirwa bihumbi mirongo nyinshi ’masques’ byavugwaga zifite ubushobozi kuvura coronavirus jurgen stock umunyamabanga mukuru interpol yagize ubucuruzi butemewe n’amategeko bw’ibikoresho by’ubuvuzi mpimbano nk’ibyo gihe cy’akaga buzima bugaragaza kutita gacye buzima bw’abantu nkuko oms ibitangaza ubucuruzi bwose hamwe bw’imiti mpimbano harimo n’imiti ishobora kuba yifitemo ubwandu runaka buba bugizwe n’imiti ifite ibikora imiti bitari iby’ukuri oms yongeraho hari nubwo n’ibigize imiti miti mpimbano iba yifitemo cyangwa yaramaze kurangiza igihe oms ivuga ubucuruzi bw’imiti nk’iyo itari bihugu biri nzira y’amajyambere n’ibyateye imbere biciriritse bubarirwa agaciro karenga miliyari z’amadolari y’amerika pernette bourdillion esteve itsinda oms rirwanya imiti itari yagize ibintu bigenze neza miti ishobora kutavura indwara bivugwa yagombaga kuvura bigenze nabi miti iteza ikibazo buzima kubera ishobora kuba yarandujwe n’ikintu kirimo uburozi uko ikwirakwizwa urwego rujyanye gukora imiti rubarirwa agaciro karenga tiriyari trillion y’amadolari y’amerika uko ikwirakwizwa buryo bugari bihera nganda z’ingenzi z’imiti nk’izo bushinwa buhinde bikagera n’aho ishyirirwa bikarito n’amacupa i burayi amerika y’epfo cyangwa aziya bigakomereza kandi bashinzwe gukwirakwiza imiti bayohereza buri gihugu isi esteve yavuze bishoboka kindi kintu cyakwiriye isi kurusha imiti ariko gihe isi yinjiye bihe bidasanzwe urwego gukwirakwiza imiti rwamaze gutangira gucumbagira inganda nyinshi zikora imiti buhinde zabwiye bbc zikora kigero kiri hagati cy’ubushobozi zisanzwe zifite kandi kubera inganda zikora imiti buhinde zihariye by’imiti yibanze yoherezwa afurika ibihugu mugabane biri kugirwaho ingaruka zikomeye ephraim phiri ucuruza imiti murwa mukuru lusaka zambia yavuze byatangiye kumugiraho ingaruka yagize imiti yatangiye gushira kandi yindi turikongera ’stock’ kuyisimbura nta kintu kimwe twabikoraho birikutugora rwose kubona imiticyane cyane nk’irwanya ’microbes’ antibiotics n’irwanya malaria abakora n’abakwirakwiza imiti kugorwa kuko ibikoresho by’ibanze bikoreshwa gukora ibinini bihenze cyane bigatuma inganda zimwe zitabyigerezaho zibone n’uko zunguka - zikabona zaba ziri gukorera gihombo umwe bakora imiti pakistan yavuze yajyaga agura ibyibanze gukoramo umuti hydrochloroquine uvura malaria madolari agera kilo ariko avuga ikilo kimwe cy’ibyo bikoresho by’ibanze bivamo muti cyazamutse kikaba gihagaze madolari mu gihe ibihugu byinshi bikomeje kwinjira bihe bidasanzwe ubuzima busanzwe busa n’ubwahagaze ntabwo gusa igabanuka rw’igabanuka ry’ingano y’imiti ikorwa kwiyongera k’umubare w’abayicyeneye rwatumye oms iburira hari ukwiyongera guteye impungenge kw’ikorwa ry’imiti itari n’icuruzwa ryayo esteve oms yagize iyo imiti ikorwa idahuye n’ikigero cy’abayicyeneye bituma habaho imiti mibi cyangwa imiti itari igerageza kuziba cyuho cy’abacyeneye imiti nyayo ariko ntibayibone imiti itari ubwo bbc yaganiraga n’abacuruzi hydroxychloroquine ishobora kuvura coronavirus yabivugiye biganiro buri munsi agirana n’abanyamakuru biro bye white house chloroquine mpimbano dr congo ibyo byatumye isi abantu batangira kugura bwinshi miti ubusanzwe ikoreshwa kuvura malaria oms yakomeje gutangaza gihamya ntakuka iriho yuko chloroquine cyangwa hydroxychloroquine ishobora kwifashishwa kuvura virusi itera indwara y’ubuhumekero covid- ariko kiganiro aherutse kugirana n’abanyamakuru perezida trump avuga miti ubundi ivura malaria yagize ni uhomba kuwunywa wunywe muri gihe abacyeneye miti barushaho kwiyongera bbc yatahuye chloroquine nyinshi itari iy’ukuri kugurishwa repubulika demokarasi kongo cameroun oms nayo yatahuye imiti mpimbano gucuruzwa gihugu niger chloroquine y’ukuri ivura malaria ubusanzwe igurishwa and burk pharmaceutical limited ariko uruganda rw’imiti ’brown and burk’ rwanditswe rukorera bwongereza rwatangaje ntaho ruhuriye n’uyu muti rwongeyeho ruti ntabwo dukora muti mpimbano muri gihe icyorezo coronavirus gikomeje isi profeseri paul newton impuguke bijyanye n’imiti mpimbano kaminuza oxford bwongereza yagize aburira yavuze icuruzwa ry’imiti mpimbano kandi mibi buzima ahubwo rizarushaho kwiyongera profeseri newton avuga leta z’ibihugu isi kwishyira hamwe zigahashya miti mpimbano zisenyeye mugozi umwe yagize dufite ibyago haduka ikindi cyorezo kivuye miti itujuje ubuziranenge n’imiti itari keretse twese isi niduhuriza hamwe tugashyiraho gahunda ihuriweho y’ikorwa ikwirakwizwa ryo buryo bungana n’igenzura ry’ubudakemwa by’amagerageza imiti n’inkingo bitabaye title: ibikorwa guhiga amavuta mukorogo ahindura uruhu birimo kuvuza ubuhuha
content: mu minsi ine gihugu hose hamaze gufatwa ibikorerwa nganda bitujuje ubuziranenge bihindura uruhu bisaga gahunda kurwanya gukumira ikwirakwira ryabyo ni igikorwa cyatangiye kuwa mbere tariki ugushingo gihuriweho n’inzego z’ubuzima ikigo cy’igihugu cy’ubuziranenge rsb urwego rw’ubugenzacyaha rib polisi n’abandi bafatanyabikorwa hagamijwe gukumira ingaruka zishobora gukomoka ikoresha ry’amavuta uruvangavange rwayo amasabune n’ibindi birimo ikinyabutabure hydroquinone’ bishobora kwangiza ubuzima bw’ubikoresha ibyafashwe byiganjemo ibinyabutabire birimo hydroquinone’ bigizwe n’amavuta bwoko maxi-white skin white fair light secret white diamond white diproson caro light clear men epiderm crme n’amasabune ndetse n’uruvangavange rw’amavuta ruzwi mukorogo’ polisi y’u rwanda itangaza gikorwa cyatangiriye ntara eshatu n’umujyi kigali umubare w’ibimaze gufatwa ugera mu mujyi kigali ibimaze gufatwa majyaruguru ibyafashwe bingana burasirazuba gihe ibyakusanyijwe maduka acuruza amavuta kwisiga n’amasabune koga ntara y’uburengerazuba umuvugizi polisi y’u rwanda commissioner of police cp john bosco kabera avuga gikorwa kigomba gukomeza gihugu hose kuko ibifatwa ibyangiza uruhu n’ubuzima bw’ubikoresha yagize mu majyepfo ntihibagiranye kuko turi kurwanya birahari kandi gahunda igamije guca amavuta abantu bisiga arimo hydroquinone’ amasabure ndetse n’ibindi bitujuje ubuziranenge bakoresha kugira uruhu ruhinduke kuko bifite ingaruka zitandukanye ibyafashwe byose biri rutonde rw’ibintu bitemerewe gukoreshwa gucuruzwa rwanda inzego z’ubuzima ziri gikorwa zemeza uwisiga ibintu birimo ikinyabutabire hydroquinone’ yiyongerera ibyago kurwara kanseri cancer y’uruhu kuko hari uturinda uruhu kwandura ndwara tuvanwaho hydroquinone cp kabera avuga ibikorwa gufata byangiza uruhu bitemewe bigendana kwigisha abantu ingaruka kubikoresha kubicuruza agasaba ubufatanye buhurirweho n’abantu kwirinda kurwanya icuruzwa n’ikoreshwa ry’ibyo binyabutabire ati kugeza turibanda gahunda kubifata ndetse tukanasobanurira abantu ububi n’ingaruka gukoresha ibibujijwe n’amabwiriza minisante ariko tunashyira imbaraga kubibuza kwinjira gihugu kuko ibyinshi ntibikorerwa rwanda kugeza hari bamwe batangiye kujya bafata ubwoko bw’amavuta atandukanye bakayavanga bakabyazamo uruvangavange mukorogo’ buryo uyisiga ahindura uruhu rw’umwimerere bikaba byagorana guhuza ishusho y’uwo muntu n’amafoto kubyangombwa bimuranga igihe cyose akeneye kubyerekana ahabwe serivise minisiteri y’ubuzima yemeje urutonde rw’ibintu birimo n’amavuta kwisiga bigomba kwirindwa bigera ikaburira abantu bisiga amavuta arimo hydroquinone irenze by’ibigize mavuta bikururira ibyago kurwara indwara zitandukanye zirimo kanseri y’uruhu niyomugabo albert muhaburarw

title: rayon sports yegukanye igikombe shampiyona itsinze mukura
content: ikipe rayon sports yegukanye igikombe shampiyona nyuma gutsinda mukura victory sport ibitego - mukino w’ikirarane cy’umunsi shampiyona wakinirwaga sitade kigali gatatu ibitego rayon sports byose byatsinzwe moussa camara ukubutse bihano ’ ’ gihe igitego cy’impozamarira mukura victory sports cyatsinzwe habimana yussuf winjiye asimbuye ni umukino amakipe yombi yakinaga ashaka intsinzi cyane rayon sports yifuzaga kurara byishimo by’igikombe rayon sports yakoze amakosa yatumye mukura itera imipira y’imiterekano free-kicks gihe mukura yatewe imipira yavuye makosa yakoze ivan minaert utari ufite ally niyonzima ufite amakarita atatu y’umuhondo yaje kugira ikibazo munota ’ akuramo manirareba ambroise wagize imvune amusimbuza shyaka philbert wanitwaye neza ruhande rw’ibumoso habimana yussuf ’ samba cedric ’ bagiye bahabwa amakarita y’imihondo bitewe n’amakosa atababarirwa bakoze gihe ruhande rayon sports niyonzima olivier sefu yahawe ikarita y’umuhondo munota ’ mbere kwizera pierrot wayihawe munota ’ ku ruhande rayon sports nova bayama yasimbuye nsengiyumva moustapha ’ ku ruhande mukura shyaka philbert yasimbuye manirareba ambroise ’ ibrahim nshimiyimana asimburwa arstide habihirwe ’ gihe habimana yussuf yasimbuye kwizera tresor yanditswe chief editormuhaburarw

title: amerika yashyizeho imisoro mishya bicuruzwa biva bushinwa by’agaciro miliyari
content: leta zunze ubumwe z’amerika zirigushyira imisoro mishya bicuruzwa biva bushinwa bifite agaciro miliyari z’amadolari y’amerika gihe gihugu gikomeje gukaza intambara y’ubucuruzi n’ubushinwa iyi misoro ireba ibicuruzwa bigera bihumbi kikaba cyiciro kinini kurusha ibindi cy’imisoro amerika ishyiriyeho ubushinwa kugeza ibikapu gutwara ntoki umuceri n’imyenda biri bizasoreshwa ariko ibicuruzwa bimwe bimwe nk’amasaha ahenze n’intebe ndende byari byitezwe gukorwaho n’iyi misoro byakuwe rutonde rw’ibicuruzwa birebwa n’iyi misorombere ubushinwa bwari bwasezeranyije buzihimura amerika niramuka ishyizeho indi misoro byitezwe misoro itangira gusoreshwa guhera itariki y’uku kwezi cyenda igatangira gipimo igakomeza yongerwa kugera gipimo guhera ntangiriro y’umwaka utaha gihe bihugu byombi byaba bidashoboye kumvikana perezida donald trump w’amerika yavuze misoro ijyanye n’ingamba z’ubushinwa zidashyira gaciro bucuruzi zirimo amafaranga agenerwa amasosiyete acururize giciro hasi n’amategeko asaba amasosiyete y’amahanga nzego zimwe agira abafatanya-bikorwa bushinwa bwana trump yanaburiye ubushinwa niburamuka bwihimuye amerika ako kanya yahita ikomeza n’imisoro y’icyiciro gatatu - bivuze ibindi bicuruzwa biva bushinwa byashyirirwaho imisoro ifite agaciro miliyari z’amadolari y’amerika mu gihe byaba bibaye - misoro ifite agaciro miliyari z’amadolari y’amerika ikakwa - byaba bimeze nkaho bisobanuye ibicuruzwa byose ubushinwa bwohereza amerika bisoreshwa imisoro mishya kuri kabiri amasoko y’imigabane bushinwa yafunguye gipimo hasi niyomugabo albert

title: hagaragajwe udushya ikusanyamakuru twafasha afurika kugera iterambere rirambye
content: mu nama iteraniye i kigali yiga guhanga udushya ikoranabuhanga ry’ikusanyamakuru hagamijwe gushyira bikorwa intego z’iterambere rirambye hagaragajwe igenamigambi ry’igihugu rishingira kumenya title: sitting volleyball ikipe y’igihugu yatangiye kwitegura imikino nyafurika izabera i kigali
content: iyi mikino izitabirwa n’amakipe y’ibihugu biri munsi y’ubutayu sahara izatangira tariki ugushyingo uretse u rwanda ruzakira mikino andi makipe azaryitabira harimo burundi cameroon drc kenya namibia nigeria tanzania uganda zambia nk’uko bitangazwa bizimana dominique umuyobozi w’ishyirahamawe ry’imikino y’abamugaye rwanda npc akaba n’umukinnyi abakinnyi bameze neza kandi n’umutoza w’ikipe y’igihugu w’umuholandi peter karreman yaraye ageze rwanda gusa dominique bizimana giti cye ufite akabazo kirenge gusa yizeye gukira vuba akazakina amarushanwa uretse guhatanira igikombe abakinnyi bazaba banashaka itike kuzakina imikino olympique izabera i londres bwongereza kwezi karindwi umwaka utaha abakinnyi bahamagawe bakaba banatangiye imyitozo bizimana dominique rutikanga james ngirinshuti eric ntagawa charles murema jean baptiste tuyishime vincent twagirayezu callixte hirwa danny vuningabo emile kuramba prosper ngizwenimana jean bosco ntawiha fidele gahamanyi jean baptiste kugeza makipe y’u rwanda mikino itandukanye hamaze kuboneka amatike abiri gusa afitwe muvunyi hermas ukina sitting volleyball adrien niyonshuti ukina umukino gusiganwa magare thoneste nisingizwe

title: ivugururwa ry’umujyi huye rigeze kure
content: muri minsi aharimo kuvugururwa agace k’ubucuruzi kazwi izina ryo mucyarabu akabarizwamo amahoteli ibisi faucon ndetse n’amabanki ecobank kbc ahandi harimo kuvugururwa ahahoze sitade huye harimo gusizwa neza hazubakwe indi nziza iyi gahunda kuvugurura igamije gusenya inyubako zishaje kandi zubatswe buryo butakigezweho zigasimbuzwa izijyanye n’igihe turimokuvugurura inyubako z’uyu mujyi tangiranye n’umwaka bikaba kandi bigikomeza ubu hoteli ibis hamwe banki ecobank bikaba byaramaze gusenywa kugirango hubakwe amazu agezweho pascal sahundwa umunyamabanga mpuzabikorwa w’umurenge ngoma karere huye avuga hari ibikorwa by’iterambere biri gukorwa kandi hari n’ibindi byinshi biteganyijwe avuga uretse amazu harimo kuvugururwa imihanda duce dutandukanye tw’uwo mujyi hamaze kuvugurwa ibirometero umunani by’imihanda gace kwitaba kandi nyuma yaho hazavugururwa imihanda ijya tundi duce ngoma matyazo hazakorwa kandi amatara mihanda ndetse haterwe ubusitani n’ibiti by’imirimbo rwego kongera ubwiza nyaburanga ndetse n’isuku y’uyu mujyi pascal asobanura ivugururwa ry’uyu mujyi inyungu buri muturage uwutuyemo ndetse n’igihugu rusange uyu mujyi murangiza kuvugururwa abaturage bazabona ibikorwa by’amajyambere birimo imihanda myiza n’amazu y’ubucuruzi yagutse ibi bizatuma haboneka abacuruzi baturutse bihugu bigize umurwango w’afrika y’iburasirazuba eac habeho ubuhahirane hagati y’uyu mujyi n’ibyo bihugu n’ubwo ubuyobozi bw’umujyi huye butegeka abafite amazu mujyi kuyavugurura bamwe banyiri mazu ntibabyumva kimwe n’ubuyobozi kuko bavugako basabwa kubaka amazu badafitiye ubushobozi umunyamabanga nshingwa bikorwa huye avuga ubuyobozi bw’uyu mujyi bugerageza kubavuganira banki kugirango babone inguzanyo buryo bworoshye hari kandi n’abavuga amwe mazu adakwiye gusenywa kuko afatwa nk’inzibutso z’uwo mujyi umuyobozi hotel ibis yagize kuvugurura ntibivuga gukuraho ibyagakwiye twibutsa ibihe byiza byashize twagiriye hoteli ibis pascal ariko avuga hakiri imbogamizi nyinshi iterambere ry’umujyi huye kuko abagafashije mujyi gutera imbere aribo bawusubiza inyuma aha aragaya abashoramari babona amafaranga nk’aho bayashoye iwabo huye bakajya i kigali n’ahandi bavugako i huye ntakigenda aranenga kandi igikorwa kwimurira amashami amwe n’amwe kaminuza nkuru i kigali abivuga magambo hari ikibazo cy’inyubako kaminuza niyubake kwimura mashami ahamya title: maj gen ntawunguka pacifique wagizwe umuyobozi fdlr ntari bumare kabiri’- gen kabarebe
content: umujyanama mukuru perezida repubulika y’ u rwanda ushinzwe ibya gisirikare n’ umutekano general james kabarebe yavuze byagenze ahamagare major general ntawunguka pacifique amugira inama gutaha akinangira yongeraho mugabo wagize umuyobozi fdlr atazamara kabiri kubera ibitekerezo bye umujyanama mukuru perezida repubulika y’ u rwanda ushinzwe ibya gisirikare n’ umutekano general james kabarebe yavuze byagenze ahamagare major general ntawunguka pacifique amugira inama gutaha akinangira yongeraho mugabo wagize umuyobozi fdlr atazamara kabiri kubera ibitekerezo bye gen kabarebe yabitangaje mutarama yaganiraga n’ abarimu bigisha amateka mashuri yisumbuye rwanda aba barimu itorero riri kubera karere nyanza ishuri christ roi ubwo amaze gutanga ikiganiro mateka y’ u rwanda n’ urugamba guhagarika jenoside yakorewe abatutsi umwe barimu yamubajije iby’ yahamagaye umuyobozi fdlr amusaba gutaha gen kabarebe yavuze yamenye umugore maj gen ntawunguka umwarimu karere rubavu ajyayo kuko afite nomero ze telefone mwarimukazi avugana n’ umugabo arangije telefone ayihereza gen kabarebe yagize baravugana arangije nti mumpe noneho ndamubwira nti dore igihugu kigana wowe umupilote jenoside yabaye bufaransa uraza ujya fdlr abandi baratashye rwarakabije baratashye general gerome baratashye general murenzi brigade commander karongi iki kiganiro gen kabarebe avuga yakigiranye maj gen ntawunguka ataragirwa umuyobozi fdlr kuko gen mudacumura ataricwa ndetse general murenzi atarataha yakomeje agira ndamubwira nti abana general murenzi rdf irabarihira amashuri kandi nibyo general murenzi congo aturwanya fdlr abana rdf yabarihiraga amashuri umwana w’ umuhungu yanabonye presidential scholarship tresor mukiza cyumweru gishize yabonye phd microbiology inzobere kurwanya kanseri ntawunguka turamubwira tuti dore abana murenzi turabigisha n’ abawe igihugu kiriho kirabigisha kuki udataha maj gen ntawunguka yarasubije nkubwire ikintu kimwe general njyewe nzataha rwanda mututsi n’ umwe ukirimo’ gen kabarebe wahoze minisitiri w’ ingabo z’ u rwanda avuga yabwiye ntawunguka kuriya atekereza atazigera ataha rwanda ati ubu mudacumura apfuye pacifique niwe wamusimbuye niwe mukuru fdlr ariko ntari bumaze kabiriabarimu bahise bakoma amashyi gen kabarebe avuga utaba mashyamba congo urwanira gukora jenoside uzabeho ntabwo wabishobora gen kabarebe abishingiye mwarimu wamwigishije neza bigatuma akunda akanatsinda icyongereza yasabye abarimu kuba abarimu beza yababwiye habaho n’ abarimu babi kuko hari umwarimu wamucyashe amubuza kuririmbana n’ abandi kuko umunyarwanda byabaye uganda batuma yanga kuririmba kugeza n’ akoma amashyi gusa ariko ntabwo ajya abumbura umunwa aririmbe abarimu bahawe umwanya gutanga ibitekerezo kubaza ibibazo ibintu bitangaje general james kabarebe wagizwe umujyanama perezida kagame

title: indirimbo j-kid ihagaze neza irushanwa couleurs talent
content: ku gatatu tariki nibwo hari hateganyijwe ikiciro kabiri cy’iryo rushanwa kirangira indirimbo umunani z’abahanzi afurika zari zihanganye mu ndirimbo eshatu mbere zatowe harimo ndirimbo j-kid yitwa udasimburwa abagize itsinda j-kid aribo jabo deo cyiza franck diddy-zo bahagarariwe diddy-zo batangarije kigalitodaycom byabashimishije kuba batsinze bagize bati byadushimishije twumva hari urundi rwego tugiye kugera ho gusa ariko bakomeza bavuga irushanwa ritararangira kuko irushanwa barimo igice kabiri igice bagiye mo kikaba aricyo cyanyuma diddy-zo avuga cyiciro nyuma indirimbo izaba ihanganye n’izindi umunani zavuye bindi byiciro byabanje akomeza asaba abafana ndetse n’abanyarwanda rusange gukomeza kubashyigikira agira twasaba dukomeje abafana bacu kongera kudutora noneho ikazaba ariyo iba iya mbere igatsinda irushanwa indirimbo yatsinze ikaba izatangazwa gatatu w’icyumweru gitaha indirimbo y’aba basore bagize itsinda j-kid ikaba yarabashije kugera iryo rushanwa babibwirwaga n’inshuti zabo ziba bufaransa bahita bayohereza bakoresheje e-mail irushanwa couleurs talent ryemera indirimbo ziri njyana nyafurika rikaba ryakira indirimbo nyinshi ngo ariko hari komite y’iryo rushanwa ishinzwe kumva ndirimbo ikabasha guhita mo izigomba kujya irushanwa norbert niyizurugero

title: ibibazo ugomba kubaza umuganga mbere kubagwa
content: ni byiza umurwayi asobanukirwa neza n’ibyo agiye gukorerwa bikorwa bimumariye ndetse n’ingaruka bishobora kugira bityo akamenya yitwara urwo rugendo rutoroshye dore ibibazo by’ingenzi umurwayi ugiye kubagwa agomba gusobanuza ese ngombwa kubagwa iki kibazo umurwayi akibaza muganga akimubwira agomba kubagwa aha akaba agomba gusobanuza bundi buryo bushobora kumukiza indwara afite atabanje guca cyuma nta mpamvu gutinya kugira ikibazo aricyo cyose umubaza yewe nubwo waba utekereza urondogora cyangwa uruhanya si byiza kugira wihererana kuko ubuzima bwawe buba buri kibazo ndetse uba ushobora gushaka muganga gihe uwa mbere yaguhaye ibisobanuro bitakunyuze kubagwa birakorwa bite aha ntabwo muganga yabigisha babaga nk’uko abizi ariko agomba kubabwira imirongo migari y’ibyo mugomba kumenya kugira namwe mwitegure ntekerezo mwumve neza ibigiye kubakorerwa n’uko mugenda mubyitwaramo ni ibihe bibazo bishobora kuvuka birumvikana utakwizera biza kugenda nea bityo uba ugomba kubaza ibibazo wahura nabyo ndetse n’ingaruka byakugiraho kugira muganga yumve impungege ufite anamenye ubuzima bwawe busanzwe buhagaze umwanzuro muwufatane buri wese atagize yihererana ndetse munarebe ngaruka ziramutse zije hari mwazikemura hari ngomba kwitwara mbere kubagwa mu gihe ugiye kubagwa ugomba kubaza muganga ugomba kwitwara ndetse hari n’imyitwarire wahagarika cyangwa ukayihindura kuko buzima bwacu buri munsi usanga twitwara buryo butandukanye kandi wenda bushobora kugira buhindura buzima bwacu nitegure nte hari usanga umuntu yitegura kubangwa nk’ejo munsi agafata nk’urugendo rurerure cyangwa akarya ibintu runaka kandi wenda bitewe n’igice cy’umubiri azabagwa bitemewe ni byiza kubaza muganga ugomba kwitegura ibagwa ryawe bityo bizagende neza ikinya muntera ngaruka kingiraho hari imiterere y’umuntu ishobora gutuma ikinya kimugiraho ingaruka bityo byiza gusobanuza muganga ubuzima bwanyu cyane cyane ubw’ubuhumekero buhagaze neza amenye gukora kuki ntagomba kurya mbere kubagwa iri tegeko rihabwa umuntu wese ubagwa ariko abenshi usanga barikurikiza buhumyi batazi impamvu ariko impamvu nyayo birindo gihe usinzirijwe n’ikinya waruka ibirutsi bikigira bihaha aha umuntu agomba gusobanuza neza asinzirizwa wese cyangwa igice kimwe akaba yabasha kuruka bigasohoka bityo akaba yakwirira byoroheje ntiyicwe n’inzara cyane usanga hari n’abiyima ibiryo masaha abanziriza kubagwa gukanguka biragenda bite mu gihe wabazwe ikinya kimara igihe runaka kitarashira biyo ugashyirwa cyumba bakangukiramo ariko se bigenda bite aho sinzinzira ubutaza gukanguka ninkanguka se ndaba mbasha kuvuga ndaba numva ububabare se ndaba nshobora kunyeganyega se n’ibindi nk’ibyo umuntu agomba gusobanukirwa nakanguka amenye agomba gukora ndetse n’abaganga bamwizeze kumuba kugeza akangutse nyuma kubagwa biragenda bite iyo umuntu amaze kubagwa ntahita akira atahe ni ngombwa usobanuza uza kwitwara nyuma kubagwa igihe bizafata ukire neza ndetse n’ibindi byose usabwa igihe uzamara urwaye kizabe kigufi kandi kigende neza birantwara amafaranga angahe ni byiza kubaza kibazo mbere rwego kwirinda gutungurwa nyuma hari wasanga uburyo ubagwa bwaba buri hejuru y’ubushobozi bwawe cyangwa se n’iba n’ubwishingizi ukoresha bushobora kubyishyura bityo ugende uzi neza bihagaze

title: neretse fabien yakatiwe gufungwa imyaka
content: uyu mwanzuro watangajwe gatanu tariki ukuboza ubushinjacyaha bwari bwasabiye neretse gufungwa imyaka ariko urukiko rutegeka afungwa imyaka nyuma kumuhamya ibyaha yaregwaga ku kane tariki ukuboza urukiko mpanabyaha mujyi bruxelles bubiligi rwaburanishije neretse rwamuhamije icyaha jenoside n’ibyaha by’intambara mu ugushyingo nibwo urubanza neretse rwatangiye kuburanishwa yashinjwaga ibyaha by’intambara bitatu kwica jenoside yakorewe abatutsi neretse akurikiranyweho ibikorwa by’ubwicanyi gihe jenoside yakorewe abatutsi i nyamirambo mataba yahoze komini ndusu ruhengeri hagati mata nyakanga yarezwe gushishikariza abasirikari kwica abatutsi biciwe i nyamirambo yanashinze umutwe w’interahamwe mataba awuha intwaro mbere kugaba ibitero batutsi ariko anabaha ibihembo by’amafaranga icyemezo cy’urukiko bruxelles gukatira neretse imyaka gifite umwihariko kuko ubwa mbere u bubiligi bukurikiranye bukanahana icyaha jenoside hashingiwe itegeko rihana mbere neretse hari abanyarwanda baburanishijwe n’inkiko z’u bubiligi hashingiwe itegeko rihana ibyaha byibasira inyokomuntu n’iby’intambara urubanza rwe rwaranzwe n’amagambo ahakana jenoside yakorewe abatutsi yavuzwe n’uwunganira neretse me jean flamme abari rubanza harimo n’abacamanza basanze arengera avuga habaye jenoside ebyiri kuva ntangiriro y’urubanza neretse umwunganira me flamme yakoresheje imvugo ihakana jenoside yakorewe abatutsi avuga habaye jenoside ebyiri uyu mugambi kandi watumye atumira rubanza abantu basanzwe bazwiho kuyihakana judi rever joseph matata johann swinnen n’abandi intego kwari ukwerekana jenoside yakorewe abatutsi yabayeho yunganira ruhare abifitemo kuko icyaha akurikiranyweho kitabayeho iyi mvugo yatangaje benshi rukiko bituma umucamanza asaba uwunganira neretse kuyirinda flamme azwiho kuba umuhakanyi nk’uko yabigaragaje rubanza tharcisse renzaho yunganiraga neretse yanashyizeho itsinda ryagombaga gutanga ruswa kugira abatangabuhamya bamushinjure atanga imirima n’amafaranga urubanza fabien neretse w’imyaka rwatangiye ugushyingo hatoranywaga itsinda ry’abaturage bagomba gutanga ubuhamya bumushinja n’ubumushinjura nyuma y’iminsi itatu rutangira kuburanishwa mizi fabien neretse ukomoka ruhengeri yafatiwe bufaransa uyu mugabo ufite ijambo butegetsi habyarimana ashinjwa kugira uruhare kwica umubiligi claire beckers n’umugabo isae bucyana n’umukobwa wabo katia aba biciwe i kigali mata nyuma y’iminsi mike jenoside itangiye neretse afite iminsi kujuririra umwanzuro w’urukiko bruxelles izindi nkuru wasoma urukiko bubiligi rwahamije neretse fabien ibyaha jenoside cnlg yashimye icyemezo rubanza neretse icyita ugutsindwa bahakana jenoside

akubiye ibaruwa bandikiwe n’umunyamabanga mukuru w’iri shyirahamwe uwayezu franois rgis iyi baruwa igira iti tugendeye ikwirakwira ry’icyorezo koronavirusi covid- hirya hino isi ndetse n’ingamba leta title: nyanza muri gahunda girinka umurenge nyagisozi wahawe inka zirwaye zirapfa
content: mu rwego gushyira bikorwa inshingano zabo zirebana kwegera abaturage taliki mutarama kugera gashyantare abagize inteko ishinga amategeko imitwe yombi bakoze ingendo turere twose tw’igihugu basura kandi baganira n’abaturage gukurikirana gahunda leta zigenewe kuvana baturage bukene zigeze zishyirwa bikorwa gutanga inama zatuma gahunda zagenewe abaturage zirushaho kubagirira akamaro mwe ntego bafite muri ngendo z’abagize inteko ishinga amategeko byagaragaye gahunda girinka imaze kugeza abaturage byinshi byiza ariko hakiri n’inzitizi zikigaragara mu nzitizi zagaragaye gahunda harimo kuba hari zatanzwe zirwaye abakozi rab bagiye bahatira abaturage kuzifata nyuma zigapfa aha hatanzwe urugero karere nyanza umurenge nyagisozi wahawe inka zirwaye zikaza gupfa hagaragajwe kandi hari hamwe hamwe kugena abahabwa inka habamo uburiganya urugero rwatanzwe urw’umudamu witwa twizeyimana janviere utuye mudugudu manombe murenge kiyombe bivugwa yahawe inka atayikwiye kuko afite umugabo ukora muganga kandi umucuruzi izindi nzitizi zagaragajwe n’abagize inteko ishingamategeko gahunda zirimo uburangare bw’abavuzi b’amatungo badasura abahawe inka bamenye ibibazo bafite babafashe kubikemura imyitwarire idahwitse bamwe baveterineri mitangire n’imicungire y’inka zihabwa abaturage kuba hari bamwe bahabwa bazigurisha cyangwa bakimuka rimwe rimwe bataritura abandi inka zigurishwa hagatangwa raporo zibwe abayobozi bakabyemeza kandi bazi zagurishijwe abahabwa inka ntibaziteho neza kuba hamwe hamwe ubuyobozi bw’inzego z’ibanze budakurikirana bihagije imigendekere y’iyi gahunda bigatuma ibibazo birimo bidakemurirwa gihe gahunda girinka yatangijwe perezida repubulika nyakubahwa paul kagame mwaka iyi gahunda ifite intego ennye z’ingenzi zikurikira arizo kurwanya imirire mibi kuzamura imibereho myiza guteza imbere umusaruro uva bworozi n’ubuhinzi guteza imbere imibanire myiza y’abanyarwanda abagabiranye inka barushaho kumenyana kugenderanirana muri rusange ibyagaragariye abagize inteko ishinga amategekoni baturage bamaze igihe kirenga umwaka gahunda girinka yabagizeho impinduka nziza abaturage bakennye borojwe inka zishobora gutanga umusaruro utuma biteza imbere babona ifumbire amata n’amafaranga ava musaruro w’amata imvanomakuruki

abaguze amatike bakacyitabira dore n’imvura yagwaga nyinshi ariko ntabwo bayitinye bemeye irabanyagira abandi bitwikira imitaka bakomeza gutambira imana patient bizimana yashimiye cyane papa waje masasu ageze rubyiniro yashimiye abitabiriye ariko avuga yifuza gusengera abantu bashaka kwakira yesu nk’umwami n’umukiza bityo bagakizwa bakandikwa gitabo cy’ubugingo uyu mugore wasizwe amavuta yamagaye abantu bumva bifuza gukizwa akabasengera gusa ntabwo byakunze baza rubyiniro nabwo yahise asaba abumva bashaka kubohoka bakakira yesu nk’umwami n’umukiza kuzamura ibiganza akabasengera yagize yasengeye abemeye kwakira yesu nk’umwami n’umukiza aha pasiteri lydie masasu yazamukaga ajya rubyiniro

title: ivugururwa ry’umujyi huye rigeze kure
content: muri minsi aharimo kuvugururwa agace k’ubucuruzi kazwi izina ryo mucyarabu akabarizwamo amahoteli ibisi faucon ndetse n’amabanki ecobank kbc ahandi harimo kuvugururwa ahahoze sitade huye harimo gusizwa neza hazubakwe indi nziza iyi gahunda kuvugurura igamije gusenya inyubako zishaje kandi zubatswe buryo butakigezweho zigasimbuzwa izijyanye n’igihe turimokuvugurura inyubako z’uyu mujyi tangiranye n’umwaka bikaba kandi bigikomeza ubu hoteli ibis hamwe banki ecobank bikaba byaramaze gusenywa kugirango hubakwe amazu agezweho pascal sahundwa umunyamabanga mpuzabikorwa w’umurenge ngoma karere huye avuga hari ibikorwa by’iterambere biri gukorwa kandi hari n’ibindi byinshi biteganyijwe avuga uretse amazu harimo kuvugururwa imihanda duce dutandukanye tw’uwo mujyi hamaze kuvugurwa ibirometero umunani by’imihanda gace kwitaba kandi nyuma yaho hazavugururwa imihanda ijya tundi duce ngoma matyazo hazakorwa kandi amatara mihanda ndetse haterwe ubusitani n’ibiti by’imirimbo rwego kongera ubwiza nyaburanga ndetse n’isuku y’uyu mujyi pascal asobanura ivugururwa ry’uyu mujyi inyungu buri muturage uwutuyemo ndetse n’igihugu rusange uyu mujyi murangiza kuvugururwa abaturage bazabona ibikorwa by’amajyambere birimo imihanda myiza n’amazu y’ubucuruzi yagutse ibi bizatuma haboneka abacuruzi baturutse bihugu bigize umurwango w’afrika y’iburasirazuba eac habeho ubuhahirane hagati y’uyu mujyi n’ibyo bihugu n’ubwo ubuyobozi bw’umujyi huye butegeka abafite amazu mujyi kuyavugurura bamwe banyiri mazu ntibabyumva kimwe n’ubuyobozi kuko bavugako basabwa kubaka amazu badafitiye ubushobozi umunyamabanga nshingwa bikorwa huye avuga ubuyobozi bw’uyu mujyi bugerageza kubavuganira banki kugirango babone inguzanyo buryo bworoshye hari kandi n’abavuga amwe mazu adakwiye gusenywa kuko afatwa nk’inzibutso z’uwo mujyi umuyobozi hotel ibis yagize kuvugurura ntibivuga gukuraho ibyagakwiye twibutsa ibihe byiza byashize twagiriye hoteli ibis pascal ariko avuga hakiri imbogamizi nyinshi iterambere ry’umujyi huye kuko abagafashije mujyi gutera imbere aribo bawusubiza inyuma aha aragaya abashoramari babona amafaranga nk’aho bayashoye iwabo huye bakajya i kigali n’ahandi bavugako i huye ntakigenda aranenga kandi igikorwa kwimurira amashami amwe n’amwe kaminuza nkuru i kigali abivuga magambo hari ikibazo cy’inyubako kaminuza niyubake kwimura mashami ahamya kaminuza mubiha agaciro mujyi huye clarisse umuhire

title: uko amoko y’abanyarwanda yasangiraga ubutegetsi
content: nubwo abanyarwanda batari basangiye ubwoko bw’imiryango migari cyangwa se ubw’inzuntibyababujije kubana neza gusangira ubutegetsikuko n’ubundi wasangaga bakomoka muryango umwe gihanga padiri leon delmas yakoze ubushakashatsi moko y’abatware b’u rwanda mwaka w’ abashefu n’abasushefu yagaragaje imibare ikurikira ijyanye gusangira ubutegetsi kw’abanyarwanda abongera bose hamwe iyi mibare igaragaza amoko yasangiraga ubutegetsi bitewe umubare wabo ungana n’amaboko bafite gihuguibi kandi ntibyadutangaza kuko gihe bita icya demokarasi ishingiye mashyaka menshi ishyaka rifite abayoboke benshi niryo rigira amajwi bityo rikegukana imyanya myinshi butegtsiaha bikaba bigaragara kugabana ubutegetsi bagiye bafata n’amoko bazanyweho iminyago abashi bagenganga ingoma ijwi batibagiwe n’amoko y’inzu abasyete n’abashigatwa ikindi kigaragara hano abanyiginya aribo benshi kuko n’ubusanzwe aribo basanganywe ingoma abega bakabakurikira kuko aribo basangiraga ubutegetsi bakavamo abagabekazi abatsobe nabo bazagamo bafite imyanya myinshi kuko aribo bakundaga kuvamo abiru akaba aribo bafite n’uburenganzira gutanga abatabazi bamenaga amaraso kugirango u rwanda rwigarurire amahanga gakondo niyo yabazwaga umuganura n’abahinzi bawo ikindi abanyarwanda bakunze gutsitsuraniraho ikibazo kijyanye n’ubuhake ubuhake niko kari akazi ha mbere kandi ntabwo bwari bwihariwe n’abantu bamwe nkuko babivuga ahubwo uwabaga atunze wese yashakaga abakozi kumufasha mirimo n’iyi akaba aribyo bitaga ubuhake umuhutu wihuturaga akava buhutu akajya bututsi akaba umutunzi cyangwa se akanyagwa kubera makosa yarakenaga akajya guhakwa nk’abandi boseiki kikaba ikigaragaza abanyarwanda basaranganyaga ubutunzi bafite bwanganaga koseukize akazamura umukene akoresheje inzira content: iki gitaramo cy’ijoro ryo kwegerana n’imana cyiswe night of worship cyateguwe pasiteri mutagoma afatanyije n’umuryango w’ivugabutumwa new seed cyabereye eglise vivante kanogo gatanu tariki bitabiriye igitaramo binyuze murya w’inanga wakirigitwaga munyakazi n’ijwi rye yahuzaga n’iry’umuvandimwe rigatanga uburyohe matwi y’abaryumva yageze ndirimbo urakwiriye mwami’’ abari rusengero batera hejuru baririmba kumwifuriza isabukuru nziza y’amavuko uyu musore utaganjwe n’amarangamutima yahise ababwira murakoze cyane’’ akomeza kuririmba munyakazi wujuje imyaka abonye izuba yabwiye igihe content: nk’uko bikubiye itangazo ryasohotse gatatu tariki werurwe ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe iterambere rdb cyasabaye abantu bafite ibikorwa by’amahoteri n’andi macumbi amaresitora utubari tangazo abayobozi b’ibigo by’ubucuruzi byavuzwe haruguru baributswa bagomba kubahiriza mabwiriza kandi bakagenzura yubahirizwa polisi y’u rwanda nayo iributsa abanyarwanda rusange bagomba kubahiriza amabwiriza barimo guhabwa hagamijwe kurwanya ikwirakwira ry’icyorezo coronavirus umuvugizi polisi y’u rwanda commissioner of police cp john bosco kabera avuga buri muturarwanda wese agomba kubahiriza title: pdi ntiyanyuzwe kuba umukandida wayo atemerewe kujya sena
content: nyuma y’uko urukiko rw’ikirenga rwanzuye uwamurera salama adafite ubunaribonye bwatuma umusenateri ishyaka pdi akomokamo riravuga ritanyuzwe n’iki cyemezo ho ihuriro nyunguranabitekerezo ry’imitwe politiki yemewe rwanda rikaba ryavuze amatora y’umukandida uzamusimbura azaba kane w’iki cyumweru inkuru y’uko urukiko rw’ikirenga rwanzuye madamu uwamurera salama atujuje ibisabwa n’amategeko mwanya w’umusenateri yabaye kimomo kabiri kopi y’urubanza rwaciwe n’urukiko rw’ikirenga rurebana kwemeza abakandida myanya y’abasenateri umunyamakuru rba dukesha nkuru yabonye ihamya icyemezo cy’urukiko gishingiye kuba umukandida adafite ubunararibonye bukwiye mwanya w’umusenateri nk’uko biteganywa n’itegeko ol ryo kuwa rigenga amatora bimwe bika bibiri kopi y’uru rubanza bigira biti ’’ku bijyanye n’ubunararibonye great experiencegrande experience busabwa gace mbere k’ingingo imaze kuvugwa kugira umuntu atorerwe cyangwa agirwe umusenateri urukiko rurasanga bukwiye kureberwa mirimo umukandida yakoze ugereranyije n’inshingano z’umutwe sena urukiko rw’ikirenga rwemeje uwamurera salama atujuje ibyangombwa bisabwa n’amategeko kugira agirwe umusenateri bityo kandidature ikaba itemejwe’’ umuvugizi w’ihuriro nyunguranabitekerezo ry’imitwe politiki yemewe rwanda mukabunani christine avuga ihuriro ryamaze kugezwaho icyemezo cy’urukiko ndetse kane hazaba amatora gushaka mukandida yagize iyo tumaze gutora dutoye tubashyikiriza urukiko kugirango rubemeze rero tuba twiteze ibintu hari igihe babemeza bombi hari n’igihe nk’uku byatugendekeye bemeza umwe ntibamwemeze twabyakiriye kuko inshingano kandi bushishozi bwabo nk’uko bikwiriye kuba bigenda twebwe twahise dutumiza inama yihuta kugira twongere dutore tuzatora kuwa kane imiryango iba ifunguye n’ubundi nk’uko bisanzwe abazumva bakongera kuza bagapiganwa bazaza bapiganwe dutoremo umuntu umwe umuyobozi w’ishyaka ntangarugero demukarasi pdi uwamurera salama abereye umuhuzabikorwa ntara y’iburengerazuba mussa fazil harelimana avuga shyaka ryubaha icyemezo cy’urukiko rw’ikirenga icyakora akavuga ritanyuzwe nacyo yagize mu ishyaka ryacu kugira tumwamamaze tunamwamamaza turebye yujuje imyaka turebye umuhuzabikorwa w’ishyaka pdi rwego rw’intara turebye yuko amaze imyaka akorera rwego rw’akarere twe twabonaga afite ubunararibonye buhagije ariko ngibyo twe twabonye urukiko rurigenga rwabonye ibindi kandi tugomba kwakira icyemezo cy’urukiko rw’ikirenga ntikijuririrwa ariko nubwo twavuga yuko cyatunyuze ishyaka pdi rivuga ryiteguye kongera gutanga umukandida mwanya matora y’ihuriro nyunguranabitekerezo ry’imitwe politiki yemewe rwanda ateganyijwe kane tariki nzeri byari byatangajwe madamu uwamurera salama nkusi juvenal bakandida b’iri huriro myanya y’abasenateri bahagarariye iryo huriro manda gatatu sena

title: huye uwafunguwe yiciye umugore nzira harakekwa amakimbirane yihishe
content: mu murenge maraba karere huye umugabo witwa nsabimana straton gushakishwa n’inzego z’umutekano kubera icyaha akekwaho gukubita umugore akamwica icyatumye mugabo yiyicira umugore ntabwo kiramenyekana ariko harakekwa ikimbirane rishingiye mwana umugore yabyaye igihe mugabo afunze mu murenge maraba karere huye umugabo witwa nsabimana straton gushakishwa n’inzego z’umutekano kubera icyaha akekwaho gukubita umugore akamwica icyatumye mugabo yiyicira umugore ntabwo kiramenyekana ariko harakekwa ikimbirane rishingiye mwana umugore yabyaye igihe mugabo afunze ku mugoroba nzeri nibwo mugabo straton yakubitiye nzira umugore mukakabayiza marie ufite imyaka bimuviramo urupfu uyu mugore yagiye nyinawabo yajyanye n’ umugabo kuko hari habaye umuhango kuraga bavuyeyo bajya nyirasenge nyakwigendera hari ibirori aha hombi babakiriye baranywa ariko ntibari basinze nk’ byemezwa n’ abaturanyi amakuru umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’ umurenge maraba hakuzimana jean baptiste yahawe n’ umwana w’ imyaka straton mariya kumwe imbarutso yabaye mariya yakandagije umugabo ikirenge kiriho amase yagize umudamu yakandagiye umugabo kirenge harimo amase aramwanduza umugabo n’ umujinya mwinshi ukanyanduza’ batangira gutyo bacyocyorana umugabo amukubise inshyi amukubise imigeri amutaho ariruka ajya rugo bagira agiye kuzana mitiweri ariko mwanya muto mugore amaze kwitaba imana gitifu hakuzimana yagiye rugo nyakwigendera asanga urugo rwifashije rufite amatungo menshi ndetse yanaganiriye n’ abaturanyi bamubwira makimbirane yabaga uru rugo uretse ikibazo kimaze imyaka irenga yagize icyagaragaye nk’ intandaro twaketse nk’ ikimbirane ryari ryihishe mugabo yarafunzwe hari hashize nk’ imyaka afunguwe umugore yarabyaye umwana umugabo aziye ntiyabyakiriye neza ariko yarabyihanganiye ntibyagaragaraga nk’ ikibazo gusa mwana asigaye nyinawabo umurambo nyakwigendera wajyanywe bitaro kaminuza butare chub kugira ukorerwe isuzuma uyu mugabo bahimba rutoni yabonye bibaye ahita atoroka n’ ntabwo arafatwa gusa inzego z’ umutekano ziri kumushakisha

guhindura uburyo position igikorwa gikorwamo nabyo bifasha cyane imigendekere myiza y’igikorwa kandi bugatuma umugabo abasha kumenya umugore akunda ukamurinda kurambirwa guhora buryo bumwe bituma title: amateka intambara hagati y’u bushinwa n’u buyapani yahitanye abantu miliyoni
content: joseph staline wigeze kuyobora u burusiya bukiri repubulika zunze ubumwe z’abasoviyete yigeze kugira urupfu rw’umuntu amakuba urupfu miliyoni imibare ikibabaje amateka asa nk’ayagaragaje munyagitugu yavugaga hari intambara zagiye zitwara miliyoni z’abantu nk’iyo tugiye kugarukaho hagati y’u bushinwa n’u buyapani ariko usanga abantu baribagiwe ahari staline yavuze bishobora kuba bifite ukuri kuko ubwenge bw’abantu kenshi butabasha gupfa kwiyumvisha impfu z’abantu bagera miliyoni cyangwa abarenze urubuga warhistoryonline dukesha nkuru ruvuga joseph stalin umugabo uzi iby’impfu kuko yateje izibarirwa miliyoni ubwe kandi igihugu cye cyapfushije abantu babarirwa miliyoni n’imisago cyarwanaga n’u budage hitler nubwo abantu benshi burengerazuba bw’isi babizi intambara y’ubutita ifite ukuntu yoroheje ingaruka mbi z’intambara y’isi cyangwa igasubiza inyuma urwego ngaruka zari gufatwamo uyu munsi gihe uburengerazuba n’u burusiya bisa nk’ibiri ntambara nshya y’ubutita abantu benshi bafite amakuru bazi repubulika zunze ubumwe z’abasoviyete zapfushije abantu benshi kurusha ikindi gihugu cyose ntambara ii y’isi gusa igitangaje n’uko abandi bantu benshi bitwa bafite amakuru batazi intambara hagati y’u bushinwa n’u buyapani ntambara kabiri y’isi yahitanye byibuze abantu miliyoni nyuma gato y’intambara ii y’isi ishyaka ry’abakomunisiti bushinwa rimaze kujya butegetsi u bushinwa bukarekeraho kuba inshuti y’abanyaburengerazuba ahubwo bugahinduka umwanzi buzima bw’abantu bishwe busa nk’ubutarahawe agaciro by’umwihariko burengerazuba kimwe repubulika zunze ubumwe z’abasoviyete bushinwa abapfuye cyane abasivili itsinda ry’impuguke myitwarire n’ibibera makimbirane oxford companion to wwii ryavuze abashinwa bishwe ntambara bagera miliyoni ebyiri iyi mibare ariko irakemangwa nubwo yatangajwe n’ubuyobozi ariko hatarimo iy’abantu bagiye baburirwa irengero n’abandi imirambo itagiye igaragara impamvu abashinwa ntibarwanaga n’abayapani gusa ahubwo nabo ubwabo ntambara hagati y’abaturage yahereye ikagera ni gihe batangiye kurwana n’abayapani bivugwa hakozwe ubushakashatsi butandukanye mpfu zabereye bushinwa gihe ariko abashakashatsi bakajya bahura n’imbogamizi zitandukanye kenshi ziba ziteye ubwoba ariko hiyongereyeho guhangana n’abayapani guverinoma y’u buyapani n’igisirikare gihe byari byarateje imbere igitekerezo kumvikanisha umuco n’ubwoko by’abayapani biruta title: uri gukora ubukwe baragira iki’ n’ibindi bintu udakwiye gutinya
content: ubukwe gihe bwahinduye isura buryo ubwitegereje neza ukeka burenze kuba igikorwa cy’abantu babiri bagiye kumarana imyaka y’ubuzima basigaje nkuko babyiyemeza igitutu ubukwe bw’ubu butera amenshi ma couples’ hari badatinya kucyitegereza bakaba bavuga giteye asyiii we’ uhereye mutsima bakata birori by’ubukwe ikanzu yambarwa n’umugeni inzu salle ubukwe buberamo ikintu cyose cyerekeye ubukwe usanga agaciro kacyo kaba kadahawe cyane ababiri bagiye kubana ahubwo ugasanga hitawe bindi bintu by’iraha ry’akanya gato ritanafite rimarira abikundaniye bagiye kubaka urwabo nyamara atari byari bikwiye kugenda igitutu umuntu ashyirwaho n’umuryango mugari w’abantu abamo societe cyane yumva cyangwa abonana abandi azi cyangwa mbuga nkoranyambaga aterwa n’umuryango ndetse n’icyo yitera agamije kwemeza’ abandi byatumye ubukwe butakiri ikintu gishyize imbere urukundo bisa n’aho igihabwa agaciro abandi muri nkuru dukesha urubuga interineti el crema turabagezaho ibintu bimwe ababiri bagiye gukora ubukwe badakwiye gutinya gukora igihe bitegura ndetse begereje umunsi gushinga urugo rwabo ntimukagire ubwoba bwo gukora icyo mushaka mwifuza ikintu mushobora kuzicuza bikomeye nyuma y’uko ubukwe bwanyu butashye ugusubiza amaso inyuma mugasanga mwakabaye mwarakoze mwifuzaga gukora bitari abandi bashakaga mukora imiryango inshuti ndetse yemwe n’idini musengeramo bishobora gutuma hari ibyemezo bidakwiye cyangwa bitari ngombwa mufata bukwe bwanyu nyamara inkono ishyushye ishobora guhishwa n’ibyemezo mwafashe kubera mutabanje kwirebaho mwembi mwe muba muzayikorera mutwe wowe n’uwo mwashakanye icyo mukwiriye ugukora mwifuza mwifuje kera mwembi ntimugwe mutego kugira umunsi wanyu w’amateka wanyu ibirori by’abandi nk’aho bazanabubakira urugo muba mwashinze ntimugaterwe ubwoba n’ibyo mudafite gucyuza ubukwe gihe usanga bihenze cyane ndetse ama couples’ adafite ubushobozi gukora ubukwe buhenze nk’ubwo abandi bakora usanga ashobora kurara atagohetse kubera nyamara si byakagenze bwenge burimo kwikokora mukirya mukimara kubera ubukwe nyuma mukazirengera ingaruka ziremereye nyuma kurushinga mwembi mwenyine amenyo y’abasetsi i bubi aho guta umwanya kubura amahoro kubera mudafite mukwiye kwita bihari mufite kandi mufitiye ubushobozi mukaba mwifashisha bukwe ibyo abandi bakora cyangwa uko abandi babigenje iyo urebye usanga ababiri couple’ y’umusore n’inkumi bitegura kurushinga abenshi babanza kureba abandi bakora cyangwa bakoze bukwe bwabo buryo bagenderaho bafata ibyemezo bazakora munsi w’ubukwe bwabo bazemeze isi maye ayinya wari ukwiye kureka ubukwe bwanyu bukaba ubwawe n’umukunzi wawe gusa ukibagirwa burundu ibirori biryoheye ijisho kwemeza abantu cyane cyane udafite ubushobozi kubikora ugomba kumenya umubano wawe n’uwo mwemerenyije kubana atari intambara cyangwa irushanwa kuki se ubukwe bwanyu wabutegura nk’utegura intambara kora ufitiye ubushobozi unatekereza mibereho y’urugo rwanyu ruzamara iminsi ibihumbi ndetse n’abazarukomokaho bitari abandi utanateze rimwe kuzashimisha ijana rindi kuko umugani muyombo thomas tom close bene adamu ntibanyurwa’ si nanjye wavuze isi munoza icyo rubanda bazagutekerezaho n’ayo bazakuvuga uko byagenda kose ntiwabuza inyombya kuyomba n’iyo ubukwe bwanyu bwacyurizwa kwezi rubanda iteka bazavuga bashaka ndetse kizababuza gutekereza bifuza nkuko butaha butagezwe intorezo ubukwe bwawe butazigera bunyura cyangwa bushimwe cyangwa bunyure abantu nimutegura ubukwe mugamije murabyimenyere kandi mwibuke nyamwirukira gushimwa yasanze umuyaga wamutanze imbere icyo mukwiye gukora ukwihagararaho mugakomeza umutsi ntimukangwe gato baragira iki’ rwose ntimuzabihe agaciro kuko muzabonera rugo mugiye kubakana bibi kurusha mwabonera bukweuritegura cyangwa uteganya kuzakora ubukwe ntuzatume tuvuze haruguru biyobora imyanzuro yawe iradukunda fidele samson

title: alarm ministries yakoze igitaramo cy’amateka cyahembukiyemo imitima benshi- amafoto
content: ku mugoroba cyumweru tariki werurwe alarm ministries yakoze igitaramo kidasanzwe kumurika album y’indirimbo z’amashusho yiswe turakomeye’ cyaranzwe n’ubwitabire rwego hejuru imbyino zidasanzwe ndetse n’imyambarire itari imenyerewe baririmbyi ku mugoroba cyumweru tariki werurwe alarm ministries yakoze igitaramo kidasanzwe kumurika album y’indirimbo z’amashusho yiswe turakomeye’ cyaranzwe n’ubwitabire rwego hejuru imbyino zidasanzwe ndetse n’imyambarire itari imenyerewe baririmbyi imbaga y’abantu baturutse hirya hino bitabiriye gitaramo bagaragaje imbamutima n’ibyishimo bisaaze kubwo kunyurwa gukorwa mutima n’imiririmbire baririmbyi bagaragaje buri wese wabonaga afite ibyishimo bisendereye ubwo tsinda alarm ministries ryageraga ruhimbi ryakiranwe ibyishimo bidasanzwe birimo amashyi y’urufaya ibivugirizo bivanze n’impundu bigaragaza bategerezanyijwe urukumbuzi n’amatsiko adasanzwe iki gitaramo cyakoze mitima y’imbaga yacyitabiriye n’imyambarire idakunze kugaragara baririmbyi gihe cyane cyane bagore bambaye imyambaro y’ibitenge bakenyeye buryo kinyarwanda alarm ministries yaririmbye indirimbo zose ziri album turakomeye’ ndetse n’izindi zagiye zikundwa ha mbere zirimo songa mbele’ yaziririmbye byiciro bibiri igice mbere cyarangiye hakurikiraho ijambo ry’imana ryatanzwe apotre dr gitwaza wigishije ijambo ryakoze mitima y’abitabiriye gitaramo appotre gitwaza yasomye gitabo yesaya - n’icy’ibyahishuwe - yasobanuye yesu yagiriye akamaro ijuru isi n’ikuzimu asubiza ikibazo cyabajijwe isezerano kera n’irishyandatuma nde nde watugendera ni nde ukwiriye kubumbura igitabo ndetse ahuza abantu n’imana kugira babashe kuyiramya aptre gitwaza kandi yavuze imana ifite ubukene kubura amashimwe y’abantu kuko mwana w’umuntu waramyaga imana kuko byakorwaga n’abamalayika gusa gihe apotre dr gitwaza niwe wigishije ijambo ry’imana mu cyigisho cye kitarambiranye dore imbaga gitaramo yafashijwe n’izi nyigisho akiva ruhimbi yakirijwe urufaya rw’amashyi n’impundu ahita yakirwa n’abaririmbyi alarm bahita bakomerezaho icyiciro kabirio nacyo bamurikiyemo album turakomeye’ mu ndirimbo zari album hagaragayemo n’izo ndimi z’amahanga nk’izigiswahili n’icyongereza nazo zashimishije abitabiriye gitaramo bitewe n’uburyo ziririmbitse ndetse n’ubutumwa buzikubiyemo ubwo bageraga ndirimbo turakomeye nayo yitiriwe album abantu bitabiriye gitaramo bafashwe n’imbamutima bamwe basimbukira hejuru nako basukiranya amashyi bsnsfatanya n’abaririmbyi kuyiririmba bigaragara kjo banyuzwe n’iki gitaramo alarm kandi yifatanyije n’itsinda rimaze kwamamara ndirimbo kuramya guhimbaza imana healing worship team chorale shalom adepr nyarugenge yatumiwe ntiyabashije kuboneka dore n’abitabiriye gitaramo korali binjiye baguze amatike nk’abandi alarm ministries ihuriyemo abaririmbyi b’amadini n’amatorero atandukanye rwanda imaze imyaka irenga itangijwe yatangiye itsinda rito cyane ry’abantu batageze icumi alarm ministries yakoze igitaramo cy’amateka iki gitaramo cyitabiriwe n’abantu benshi cyane umuyobozi alarm ministriescharles mazeze bishop rugagi yitabiriye gitaramo mu cyiciro kabiri alarm ministries yaserutse myambarire idasanzwe abagore n’abakobwa bambaye ibitenge gusa abasore n’abagabo baserutse makositimu umuyobozi mukuru w’itorero ry’igihugu bamporiki eduard bitabiriye gitaramo akanyamuneza kari kose maso y’abitabiriye gitaramo aline gahonayire yaje gushyigikira alarm ministries abantu benshi cyane appotre dr gitwaza yigishije ijambo ry’imana abantu barafashwa indiurimbo yitwa songa mbele yakoze mutima bishop rugagi asaba bayisubiramo abantu barabohotse kubera ubutumwa bwatangiwe gitaramo umunyamakuru karangwa vitar yafashijwe bikomeye imbamutima zari zose kubari bitabiriye gitaramo umuramyi patient bizimana yaje gushyigikira bagenzi healing worship team yafashije alarm ministries gususurutsa imbaga yaje gitaramo umunyamakuru anita pendo yitabiriye gitaramo amafoto mjere pictures byishimo espoir

content: burya tuvuga fashion ntago iragirira mubyo twambara gusa ahubgo bigera twahitamo gutaka inzu dutuyemo buryo bunyuranye kandi busa neza ndetse bunyura abatuye munzu nababasuratubasangiza title: u rwanda kongo bagiye gukingira ebola abambukiranya imipaka barenga ibihumbi

title: ibyo wafataga nk’ibitakureba nibyo ukwiye kumenya gihe cy’imibonano mpuzabitsina

title: urubanza rw’ubujurire bagosora bagenzi ruzacibwa tariki ukuboza
content: bagosora nsengiyumva barajuririra igihano cy’igifungo burundu bahawe kubera ibyaha jenoside n’ibindi byaha byibasiye inyoko muntu ntawukulilyayo yajuririye igihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka yakatiwe kubera uruhare yagize jenoside ku itariki ukuboza nibwo bagosora wahoze ayobora ibiro minisitiri w’ingabo yakatiwe nyuma guhamwa n’ibyaha jenoside ibyaha byibasiye ikiremwamuntu n’ibyaha by’intambara birimo kwica uwari minisitiri w’intebe agathe uwilingiyimana n’abandi basirikare b’ababiligi onu bagosora anashinjwa kugira uruhare ishyirwaho bariyeri hirya hino kigali gisenyi hagati y’itariki mata nsengiyumva ukuriye ibikorwa gisirikare gisenyi yahamijwe ubwicanyi bakorewe kaminuza mudende paruwasi nyundo ndetse n’ubwicanyi bwakorewe abasivili gice ayoboye yanahamijwe kandi kuba yarohereje ibitero by’interahamwe bisesero kwica abatutsi bagosora nsengiyumva baburanishirijwe igihe kimwe hamwe n’abandi basirikare babiri aribo brigadier-general gratien kabiligi major aloys ntabakuze kabiligi yahisevarekurwa ntabakuze ajurira rubanza rwabaye itariki werurwe urubanza ntabakuze rwaje gutandukanywa n’urwabandi nyuma y’aho uwamwunganiraga mategeko umunyamerika peter erlinder ananiriwe kwitaba urukiko tariki werurwe ubujurire bwe bwaje gusomwa tariki nzeri na nubu buracyakomeza ntawukulilyayo yakatiwe igihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka kubera uruhare yagize bwicanyi bwakorewe kibuye n’i butare umunyamakuru kigali today

title: abahindi bifatanyije n’abanyarwanda kwibuka jenoside y’abatutsi
content: icyo gikorwa kwibuka cyabereye ishuri rikuru bangalore murwamukuru new delhi cyitabirwa n’abantu bagera magana ane nyuma y’urugendo kwibuka umuyobozi uhagarariye u rwanda buhindi williams nkurunziza yavuze jenoside yakorewe abatutsi itazongera ukundi ati twibagiwe ubumuntu duhinduka inyamaswa dutsemba abavandimwe bacu iyi inkovu itari ikwiye kubaho turizeza ibyabaye bizasubira ukundi yatangaje u rwanda ruviriye jenoside rwateye intambwe itangaje ubukungu bw’igihugu bwiyongereye kigereranyo ijana ugereranyije n’imyaka ishize n’ubukene bukagabanuka gipimo ijana myaka itanu ishize iterambere u rwanda rwagezeho rurikesha perezida paul kagame nyuma kuyobohoza u rwanda agahagarika jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mwaka yahitanye ubuzima bw’inzirakarengane zisaga miliyoni nk’uko nkurunziza akomeza abitangaza ibikorwa nk’ibyo kwibuka byabereye kandi n’i pune salem kuri cyumweru tariki biteganyijwe abanyarwanda bagera i chidambaram coimbatore bangalore nabo baza kwibuka jenoside yakorewe abatutsi nshimiyimana leonard

content: umunyarwanda ruzigamanzi flicien w’imyaka y’amavuko ukomoka kagari noma umurenge musheri akarere nyagatare yagaragaje uburyo yakorewe iyicarubozo uganda yakubiswe bikomeye akanakoreshwa imirimo y’ingufu avuga yambutse ajya uganda agiye gukora akazi ariko nyuma y’igihe gito afatwa n’abapolisi b’icyo gihugu baramufunga arakubitwa abwirwa badakeneye abanyarwanda butaka bwabo bagomba kuguma iwabo ruzigamanzi navuye rwanda nyakanga banyibaga igare nari natijwe n’umuntu kubona bimeze gutyo ntinya gusubira iwacu mfata umwanzuro kujya gukorera amafaranga uganda nkora akazi kajyanye kubaka ibidari bakoreramo ubukwe kugira nzaryishyure mu kwakira nafashwe ndafungwa kuko tutifuzwa kiriya gihugu nk’uko babitubwiraga avuga yafunzwe amezi nyuma gufatwa n’abapolisi uganda bamufatiye kazi yarimo akora ageze gereza avuga ubuzima yabayemo bwari bubi kuko yakubiswe bikomeye akoreshwa imirimo y’ingufu ahantu hari umubyigano ukabije buryo ntakwinyagambura nk’uko ruzigamanzi abisobanurango yaje gukatirwa amezi gusa akurikiranyweho kuba umunyarwanda agaragaza yaje kurangiza igihano ke asubizwa polisi uganda ahitwa ntungamo ariko nabwo ahava asubizwa gereza yamaze iminsi yasohowemo ruzigamanzi atangaza baryaga umutsima w’ibigori nabwo inshuro munsi uretse kwicishwa inzara yakubiswe agaterwa ibikomere mubiri gusa avuga gufungirwa ubunyarwanda atari ikibazo yisangije wenyine kuko yasanzemo n’abandi benshi nk’uko akomeza abisobanura ruzigamanzi avuga ufashwe afungwa kubera umunyarwanda urangije igifungo ke agafungurwa akoherezwa iwabo atanga ubutumwa banyarwanda kuguma gihugu cyabo bakareka kujya uganda kuko kiza cyaho bashobora kuhasiga ubuzima

content: abakinnyi batanu berekeje asmara adrien niyonshuti uherutse kwegukana tour de kigali’ gasore hategeka nicodem habiyambere nathan byukusenge joseph biziyaremye bakaba baherekwejwe n’umutoza wabo jonathan boyer n’umuyobozi w’ishyirahamwe ry’imikino y’amagare rwanda ferwacy aimable bayingana u rwanda rwagombaga kandi guserukirwa n’umukobwa witwa angelique mukandekezi ariko kubera impamvu z’uko imyitozo itabaye myiza ubuyobozi ferwacy bwahisemo kumusiga umwe bakinnyi bahabwa amahirwe kuzitwara neza ruhande rw’u rwanda adrien niyonshuti yadutangarije yizeye kuzatahukana umwanya mwiza kuko yiteguye neza kandi n’isiganwa tour de kigali’ aheruka gutwara ryamwongereye imbaraga niyonshuti kandi avuga ikipe y’igihugu kibazo ifite kuko bafite ibikoresho bihagije ndetse bafite n’amagare mashya kandi agezweho buryo uruhare rusigaye urwabo kwigaragaza muri rushanywa harahabwa amahirwe abanya eritrea kuko ubushize bihariye imyanya mbere ryaberaga rwanda daniel teklehaymanot ukinira world cycling center busuwisi yabaye uwa mbere akaba yarasize iminota n’amasegonda niyonshuti adiren waje mwanya kane iri rushwa rizitabirwa n’ibihugu theoneste nisingizwe

content: mu ijambo rye ritangiza icyunamo kwibuka abazize jenoside yakorewe abatutsi u rwanda cyatangiye gatandatu tariki perezida paul kagame yasezeranyije abanyarwanda leta n’inzego ishamikiyeho bizakora ibishoboka byose kugira inzira y’iterambere u rwanda rwihaye idahagarara perezida paul kagame yagize nababwiraga mahirwe miliyoni miliyoni mahirwe bafitemo kugira badusubize inyuma kuko bidashoboka ntibishoboka ntabwo bishoboka muri jambo yavuze ndimi ebyiri icyongereza n’ikinyarwanda umukuru w’igihugu yibajije impamvu ibihugu byitwa byateye imbere demokarasi ntacyo bikora bigeze imbere y’ubutabera abakoze jenoside bidegembya mijyi yabyo gihe u rwanda rwibuka yavuze n’iyo babafashe babikora nyirarureshwa nyuma y’igihe gito bakabarekura gihe bihugu batewe byiyambaza isi kugira ibifashe guhangana n’abagizi nabi kagame yakomeje agira ntabwo byakumvikana impamvu banyarwanda cyangwa bandi dufitanye isano nk’abanyafurika bitagenda bityo bivuze wenda agaciro k’abanyarwanda cyangwa abanyafurika gato perezida w’u rwanda yasoje ijambo rye asaba abanyarwanda gukomeza kugira imbaraga gukomeza gufatanya kugira bakomeze guhangana n’ibibazo bahura kubaka ubuzima bwabo emmanuel n hitimana

title: rubavu yafashwe yinjiza urumogi gihugu arutwaye mapine y’igare yasunikaga
content: polisi y’u rwanda karere rubavu ifungiye sitasiyo gisenyi uwitwa iremberabo donatien nyuma kumufatana udupfunyika tw’uromogi adutwaye mapine y’igare yasunikaga aturutse repubulika iharanira demokarasi kongo uyu mugabo ufite imyaka y’amavuko yafatiwe kagari nengo ho murenge gisenyi ahagana saa moya z’ijoro ryo uku kwezi asobanura yafashwe umuvugizi polisi y’u rwanda ntara y’iburengerazuba chief inspector of police cip theobard kanamugire yagize ubwo yavaga gihugu cy’igituranyi polisi y’u rwanda yasatse mapine y’igare siporo yasunikaga isangamo urwo rumogi ifatwa rye ryaturutse makuru polisi y’u rwanda ifite y’uko ashobora kuba batunda urumogi cip kanamugire yaburiye abishora biyobyabwenge agira atiababitunda n’ababikoresha buryo bumwe cyangwa ubundi baragirwa inama kubireka kuko amayeri tuyazi abatazabireka bamenye igihe cyose bazafatwa babihanirwe na none munsi polisi y’u rwanda karere kamonyi yafatanye abagore babiri udupfunyika tw’urumogi dupima ibiro bitandatu umuvugizi polisi y’u rwanda ntara y’amajyepfo chief inspector of police cip andr hakizimana yavuze abarufatanwe uwineza assia ufite imyaka y’amavuko muhawenimana madine ufite imyaka y’amavuko yavuze bombi bafatiwe batuye kagari kavumu murenge busasamana yagize atibaguwe gitumo rugo uwineza barimo bapfunyika urwo rumogi dupfunyika duto cip hakizimana yavuze bagore bafungiwe sitasiyo polisi busasamana gihe iperereza rikomeje yibukije ibiyobyabwenge bitera ababinyoye gukora ibyaha birimo gukubita gukomeretsa gusambanya abana gufata ngufu n’ihohoterwa rishingiye gitsina hanyuma asaba abantu kubyirinda kugira uruhare kurwanya ikoreshwa n’itundwa ryabyo batanga amakuru atuma hafatwa ababitunda n’ababikoresha gukora guhindura kwinjiza kugurisha gihugu ibiyobyabwenge n’urusobe rw’imiti ikoreshwa buryo bunyuranije n’amategeko bihanishwa igifungo myaka itatu kugeza myaka itanu n’ihazabu y’amafaranga y’u rwanda bihumbi magana atanu kugeza miliyoni eshanu nk’uko biteganywa n’ingingo gitabo cy’amategeko ahana ibyaha rwandavia rnp yanditswe ubwanditsimuhaburarw

title: shampiyona apr fc yaratsinze rayon sports fc iratsindwa
content: nyuma gustindira as kigali stade regional i nyamirambo ibitego busa apr fc ikipe irimo guhagarara gikombe shampiyona ibitse yatangiye gusiga amakipe zihanganye ibi ikaba yabigezeho icyi cyumweru ibikesha ibitego by’abasore bahagaze neza minsi olivier karekezi kapiteni w’iyi kipe n’umunya uganda dan wagaluka rayon sport mukeba mbere apr fc yatakaje amanota imbere la jeunesse yiganjemo abakinnyi bakiri bato kandi byagaragaraga bamenyeranye cyane bayitsinda ibitego bibiri kimwe ikindi cyaje gukomeza mukino emmanuel ruremesha umutoza la jeunesse wahoze atoza rayon sport akaba ayizi neza ndetse nyuma y’umukino akaba yaradutangarije yifuzaga gutsinda rayon sport kugirango agaragaze la jeunesse atari ikipe yisukirwa kandi akiri umutoza ukomeye jean marie ntagwabira umutoza rayon sport n’ubwo yatsinzwe ntiyababaye bitewe n’uko hari abakinnyi bakomeye bakina inyuma batagaragaye mukino avuga atarenganya abahakinnye n’ubwo ntandaro gutsindwa twabuze amahirwe menshi imbere y’izamu ariko kandi n’ibitego twatsinzwe byatewe n’abakinnyi bakina inyuma ariko simbabaye kuko abakinnyi nari nizeye bakina iddy nshimiyimana mbanza hussein tambwe floribert munota nyuma byaje guhinduka gusa abakinnye bakoze bashoboye cyane abenshi badasanzwe babanza kibuga gusa ntagwabira yizeye kuzaba afite abakinnyi bakomeye azaba ahanganye apr fc ikipe yanatoje igihe kirekire mukino utaha uzahuza makipe tariki ukwakira stade amahoro police fc indi kipe yatangiye shampiyona ifite umuvuduko inatsinda ibitego byinshi yagaragazaga ishobora kuzahangana apr rayon sport ikazitwara igikombe dore n’umutoza wayo w’umunya serbia goran kuponovic yatakaje amanota abiri i huye imbere mukura vs nyuma kunganya ubusa busa umukino marine etincelles utegerejwe n’imbaga y’abanya rubavu kubera guhangana bitajya bishira hagati y’aya makipe warangiye etincelles atahanye amanota atatu nyuma gusinda marine ibitego busa stade umugandakuri stade mumena kiyovu sport izahagararira u rwanda mikino confederation cup yahatsidiye bitagoranye amagaju ibitego shyaka jean akili mabula serugaba erc barebye ncundura amakipe yazamukiye rimwe cyiciro mbere mwaka ndetse akaba yombi yanatangiye shampiyona yitwara nabi nyanza fc espoir zanganyirije ubusa busa i nyanza ubu apr isonga n’amanota etincelles irayikurikiye n’amanota rayon sport mwanya gatatu ifite amanota gihe police fc iza mwanya kane title: guverineri gatabazi yavuze hari umuyobozi w’akarere wamunaniye ufite ingeso mbi kutitaba telefoni
content: guverineri w’intara y’amajyaruguru gatabazi jean marie vianney yanenze bamwe bayobozi banga gutanga amakuru rimwe rimwe bakanga kwitaba telefoni avuga ingeso kudatanga amakuru muyobozi kimwe bidindiza iterambere n’imibereho myiza y’abaturage ibi guverineri gatabazi yabivugiye nama yamuhuje n’abanyamakuru tariki ukuboza yasubizaga ikibazo umunyamakuru yamubajije bayobozi bamwe bamwe banga kwitaba telefoni z’abanyamakuru ndetse n’izindi rusange guverineri gatabazi yavuze kutitaba telefoni kw’abayobozi akenshi biba bishingiye bibazo bifitiye binyuranyije n’imikorere myiza ijyanye n’inshingano zabo yavuze ubwe atajya ava murongo n’iyo kazi kamuhugije ngo asoje ako kazi areba telefoni akavugana n’abamushatse kugira yumve bamushakiraga agira ubu ndi hano uwampamagaye yambuze kuko telephone mfite hano ariko nayishyize murongo ninsubira telefoni byose abambuze ndabashaka akomeza agira gusa abayobozi duhamagarwa n’abantu benshi hari nsanga abanshatse igihumbi sinahamagara abantu igihumbi mbishobore ariko duhe agaciro umuntu uduhamagaye hari yahuye n’ikibazo gikomeye cyakemurwa n’umuyobozi guverineri gatabazi yasabye abayobozi kujya bitaba telefoni kuko banze kwitaba hari byinshi bipfa bijyanye n’inshingano zabo ababwira gukorana n’itangazamakuru biri bizamura imikoranire myiza hagati n’abaturage bayobora hari urugero yatanze rw’umwe bayobozi b’uturere atashatse kuvuga amzina n’akarere ayobora ufite ingeso kutitaba telefoni bihe binyuranye amushatse aramubura agira ntangazwa n’abayobozi bimana amakuru hari umu meya umwe twaganiriye minsi ndamubwira ndaguhamagara nanjye nkakubura ntunampamagare nyuma yaho umbwire wabonetsebagenzi banjye dufate abanyamakuru nk’abafatanyabikorwa mbere abanyamakuru batabayeho dukora ntaho byagera uzi umunyamakuru umwe ashobora gutangaza ikintu cyari butware miliyoni kugira kigere baturage akakivuga ijambo rimwe muri nama abayobozi b’uturere dutanu tugize intara y’amajyaruguru bayitabiriye basezeranyije guverineri gatabazi bagiye guhindura imikorere bakarushaho gukorana n’itangazamakuru nabo ubwabo bemeye harimo icyuho baharanira kurushaho gukemura ibibazo bibangamiye abaturage ntara chief editormuhaburarw

title: rdb yavuze mpinduka zimaze kugaragara nyuma y’imyaka ibiri ibiciro gusura ingagi bikubwe kabiri
content: yabigarutseho kane kiganiro n’itangazamakuru nyuma y’itahwa singita kwitonda lodge and kataza house nyubako yitezweho kuzajya yakira mukerarugendo rwego hejuru yubatse munsi y’ikirunga sabyinyo ni nyubako izajya yakira abasura u rwanda bashaka gusura ingagi muri gicurasi nibwo rdb yatangaje u rwanda rwakubye kabiri igiciro cy’abajya gusura ingagi kiva madolari kigera bantu kandi kigahita gitangira gukurikizwa hanashyizweho icyiciro gishya umuntu uzajya asura umuryango wose w’ingagi azajya yishyura nyuma y’itangazwa ry’ibyo biciro abantu bavuze byinshi abanyarwanda batazajya babasha kwishyura mafaranga ariko baza gushyirirwaho gahunda zihariye zibafasha kwitegereza ibyiza igihugu cyabo gifite nyuma y’imyaka ibiri akamanzi avuga imibare y’abasura ingagi yagabanyutse nubwo bijyanye n’amafaranga avamo yazamutse yagize impamvu tuzi dufite ingagi kandi ntabwo inyamaswa zihora zibyara buri gihe bivuga tugomba kuzibungabunga neza cyane bivuze kugira umuntu ashobore kubona ingagi bigomba gusaba amafaranga menshi kubera amafaranga naba make abantu benshi bazajya kuzireba kandi ntabwo byiza kuzibungabunga niyo mpamvu kugira turebe abantu bake bashoboka ariko bashobora kwishyura kugira dushobore kubona mafaranga nubwo abantu bake bajyayo bivuze igihe twongereye ibiciro by’ingagi amafaranga tubona ngubu aruta amafaranga twabonaga mbere yuko twongera igiciro bihe mukerarugendo bake akamanzi yavuze mwaka mbere ibiciro bimaze kuzamurwa abantu basura ingagi bagabanyutse cyane ariko batangiye kwiyongera ndetse n’amafaranga aboneka basura ingagi yabaye menshi nubwo umubare w’abantu wagabanyutse ariko ntiyatangaje umubare yakomeje umubare w’abantu bagura impushya ntabwo munini cyane kundi ariko bigenda byiyongera ariko nubwo amafaranga menshi kuko twakubye kabiri ibiciro turashaka twakira mukerarugendo benshi bashoboka kuko nubwo bagenda biyongera nitugurisha impushya zose tukarenza n’izo twagurishaga mbere tuzabona amafaranga menshi kurusha tubona nubwo tutagurisha impushya zose twagurishaga mbere amafaranga yariyongereye ariko n’umubare w’impushya tugurisha ugenda wiyongera bivuze nitugurisha impushya zose amafaranga azaba menshi kurusha tubona ngubu icyo navuga icyemezo cyafashwe twongere ibiciro cyari icyemezo cyiza nubwo abantu benshi bibazaga ibibazo byinshi ariko turareba mibare byabaye ibintu byiza akamanzi yavuze u rwanda rukeneye abantu bashobora kureba ingagi munsi kuko rufite imiryango y’ingagi zisurwa buri muryango uba ukeneye gusurwa n’abantu umunani munsi ingagi birunga nke isi hasigaye izigera gusa u rwanda rukagiramo yazo muri kamena zari zivuye zabaruwe guverinoma y’u rwanda igenera abaturiye pariki by’inyungu iva bukerarugendo u rwanda rufite intego kwinjiza miliyoni avuye bukerarugendo gihe bwinjije miliyoni inkuru wasoma u rwanda rwazamuye ibiciro gusura ingagi birunga

title: imodoka zihariye zigiye kujya zifashishwa kwereka mukerarugendo ubwiza kigali
content: munyandamutsa augustin watangije mushinga yabwiye the newtimes bamaze kuzana imodoka ifite ibyicaro hasi hejuru bakaba biteze kwezi gutaha hazaba habonetse indi tariki werurwe nibwo mushinga uzamurikwa mugaragaro umunsi ukurikiyeho akazi gutembereza abantu umujyi kigali gatangire munyandamutsa yavuze intego ugutembereza abasura kigali ndetse n’abayisanzwemo ibice byayo biteye amatsiko yaba uduce tw’umujyi twatuwe kera ndetse n’utwubatswe vuba ati twamaze kubona umujyi wacu wakira inama nyinshi buryo bw’ubukerarugendo amahirwe mukerarugendo kumenya byinshi mujyi gihe gito yakomeje avuga bazajya batembereza abantu byiciro bitatu buri cyiciro kikamara amasaha atatu icyiciro mbere kizajya gitangira saa tatu gitondo kugeza saa sita abantu batemberezwe duce twa kera tw’umujyi nyamirambo kimisagara nyabugogo n’ahandi guhera saa munani kugeza saa kumi n’imwe abantu bazajya batemberezwa duce dushya tw’umujyi kigali nyarutarama kibagabaga kacyiru n’ahandi kuva saa moya z’umugoroba kugeza saa tanu z’ijoro bazajya bajyanwa bice kicukiro rebero kugira bitegereze neza umujyi kigali masaha y’ijoro bazajya banatemberezwa ahantu hatandukanye hagaragaza ubuzima bw’umujyi masaha y’ijoro munyandamutsa yashishikarije abanya-kigali n’abanyarwanda rusange kwitabira bukerarugendo bushya kumenya neza umujyi kigali umunyamahanga azajya yishyura amadolari buri cyiciro bitatu umunyarwanda cyangwa afurika y’iburasirazuba yishyure frw meya w’umujyi kigalimarie chantal rwakazina yashimye mushingayemeza ugamije gufasha abantu gusobanukirwa kigali ati kigali ifite ahantu hatandukanye hateye amatsiko kuhasura nk’urwibutso jenoside n’ ahandi hagaragaza amateka kera hari imihanda mishya turi gukora izafasha mukerarugendo gusobanukirwa mateka y’u rwanda iyo mihanda izajya inifashishwa n’izo modoka kuva umwaka w’ingengo y’imari watangira ubukerarugendo bushingiye nama bumaze kwinjiriza igihugu miliyoni z’amadolari nkuko byatangajwe n’ikigo gishinzwe kumenyekanisha ubukerarugendo bushingiye nama rcb umwaka u rwanda rurashaka kwinjiza miliyoni z’amadolari zivuye bukerarugendo bushingiye nama

title: imijyi itanu mbere isi yiganjemo abanyabwenge
content: ihuriro ry’imiryango y’abahanga n’ ikigo cy’ubushakashatsi nyamerika gishinzwe amajyambere n’imibereho y’abantu bashyize mugaragaro imijyi isi irusha iyindi kugira ubwenge bwinshi gihamyacom igiye kubagezaho imijyi umunani yashyizwe hanze n’urubuga interineti yahoofr duhereye turahasanga umujyi tallinn estonie tallinn umurwa mukuru repubulika estonie iherereye majyaruguru y’uburayi uyu mujyi uza mwanya mijyi ifite ubwenge bwinshi bashingiye nganda zateye imbere zikava zikagera gihe cy’imyaka ikindi ikoranabuhanga rikoreshwa cyane rubyiruko kuko kigo cy’amashuri abanzaayisumbuye kaminuza kidafite mudasobwa n’umurongo interineti rwego hejurutaichung umwe mijyi gihugu taiwan ufatwa nk’ishuhso y’umugabane w’aziya wose kubera urimo inganda z’amashanyarazi ziciriritse ndetse n’amabanki menshi n’imikoranire myiza hagati y’inganda zaho bituma mujyi uza mwanya stratford umujyi muto ntara ontariomu gihugu canada nk’iyindi mijyi twavuze mujyi ukungahaye ikoranabuhanga interineti ndetse ikaza mwanya mbere kugira umurongo interineti wihuta cyane isi ndetse ubuvuzi bukaba bugeze rwego ruhambaye binyuze ivuriro rikuru ry’uyu mujyi stratford general hospital bituma uza uru rutonde mwanya oulu umujyi uherereye gihugu finlande mujyi uzwi nk’inkomoko irushanwa air guitar si gusa kuko mujyi buri mwaka wakira abanyeshuri ibihumbi kaminuza bituma hakorwa ubushakashatsi kurwego hejuru inganda z’ikoranabuhanga kandi ziciriritse ziri byatumye mujyi uza mwanya kuko mujyi wteye inkunga imishinga y’ urubyiruko igere umujyi uhiga iyindi mijyi umujyi columbus murwa mukuru ariho haba kaminuza nkuru y’u rwanda nur urebye icyatumye mijyi iza myanya mbere n’imirimo abaturage bagiramo uruhare nubwo naza kaminuza zibigiramo uruhare rukomeye sitio ndoli email sitiogihamyacom title: abaturage bakwiye kurushaho kubungabunga ubuzima bwabo bihe by’imvura
content: mu bihe by’imvura aribyo tunarimo rwanda usanga aribwo hamera ibigunda nkike z’ingo nyinshi cyane biturage nk’uko mukambungo esperance umujyanama w’ubuzima mudugudu rubugurizoumurenge shyogwe birukanwa buryo butemewe n’amategeko bakiyambaza inkiko zibarenganure ibi bimwe byagaragaye abakozi komisiyo y’abakozi leta baganiraga n’abashinzwe abakozi abayobozi bungirije turere twose ndetse amazu meza yakubakirwa batishoboye yakubakwamo ibyumba by’amashuri birenga mafaranga menshi noneho agiye kubera hari icyemezo cyafashwe bitubahirije amategeko ntabwo yakomeje agira atiicyo tugomba leta yatsinzwemo haba byemezo biba byarafatiwe abakozi hanyuma tubona imibare rusange ntara turere n’uruhare rwatwo twaberetse uruhare rwabo gihombo tubyita igihombo kuko amafaranga yasohotse kandi title: kwitwara neza buroko gufasha urukiko bimwe bitumye bagaragaza agiye kurekurwa
content: iki cyemezo cyafashwe tariki ukwakira n’umucamanza khalida rachid khan uyobora urukiko mpuzamahanga mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho u rwanda tpir gusaba irekurwa bagaragaza michel wakatiwe igihano gufungwa imyaka mwaka ushize amakuru kigalitodaycom gikesha itangazo ry’uryo rukiko aravuga mpamvu zatanzwe kumurekura harimo kuba urukiko mpuzamahanga mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho yougoslavia tpiy rufite imikorere ijya gusa n’iya tpir ruteganya imfungwa zakatiwe zishobora kurekurwa nyuma kumara bitatu kane by’igifungo barakatiwe kandi bagaragaza amaze imyaka afunze ukuvuga by’imyaka umunani yakatiwe izindi mpamvu michel bagaragaza ubwe yiyemeje kwishyikiriza urukiko akanemera yashinjwaga ndetse akerekana azi uburemere bwabyo akanabyicuza kuba yararanzwe n’imyitwarire myiza afungiye sude mugabane w’u burayi nyakanga umunyarwanda michel bagaragaza yahoze umuyobozi mukuru w’ikigo ocir- ishami ry’icyayi akaba yarafatwaga nk’umwe nkoramutima juvnal habyarimana perezida w’u rwanda yamaze igihe ashakishwa tpir byaha kunoza umugambi jenoside yakorewe abatutsi kugira uruhare jenoside n’ubufatanyacyaha jenoside tariki kanama bagaragaza yishyikirije tpir bwende bwe yitaba urukiko munsi ukurikiyeho ariko ahakana byaha byose yashinjwaga nyuma y’aho bidashobokeye yoherezwa kuburanishirizwa rwanda nyuma kugirana imishyikirano yihariye n’ubushinjacyaha bagaragaza yemeye kuba yaragize uruhare ruziguye jenoside kuko yaremeye intwaro zari zigenewe gukora jenoside zibikwa ruganda rw’icyayi rubaya ndetse akaba yaranaguriraga interahamwe inzoga akanaziha amafaranga yemereye urukiko kandi yahaga interahamwe imodoka z’uruganda bazikoreshe ngendo zabo ariko yongeraho yabikoraga akiza amagara n’umuryango uko gufasha interahamwe bikaba aribyo byatumaga ubushinjacyaha buvuga yazorohereje akazi bigatuma zibasha kwica abantu bahungiye musozi kesho kiliziya nyundo utwo duce twose turi karere rubavu kubera kwemera yaregwaga kubisabira imbabazi imbere y’urukiko tariki ugushyingo bagaragaza yakatiwe igifungo cy’imyaka umunani kandi urukiko rutegeka hakurwamo igihe yafunzwe michel bagaragaza azafungurwa itariki ukuboza bivuze ashigaje ukwezi kumwe n’iminsi itandatu buroko ernestine musanabera

title: abakerarugendo bahawe imyaka ibiri guhindura amatariki gusura pariki kubera coronavirus
content: iri tangazo ryashyizwe hanze mbere nyuma y’uko inzego zitandukanye zikomeje gufata ingamba guhashya coronavirus guhitana imbaga hirya hino isi ishami ry’umuryango w’abibumbye ryita buzima who ryatangaje covid- icyorezo gihangayikishije isi ndetse kwirinda cyagera rwanda hafashwe ingamba zifatika inama y’abaminisitiri werurwe yemeje gushyira ingufu kugikumira guhangana nacyo harimo gukomeza gukangurira abaturage gukurikiza inama kucyirinda kwitabaza inzego z’ubuzima gihe hari ugaragayeho kimwe bimenyetso biranga cyorezo kugabanya ingendo n’inama zitari ngombwa hanze n’imbere gihugu iki gikorwa kiyobowe serivisi minisitiri w’intebe minisiteri y’ubuzima iy’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu n’inzego z’umutekano itangazo minisitiri w’intebe dr edouard ngirente yashyizeho umukono werurwe rivuga rwego kwirinda gukumira coronavirus u rwanda rwifashisha camera kibuga mpuzamahanga cy’indege kigali i kanombe gutahura uyiketsweho coronavirus icyorezo cyatangiriye bushinwa mpera z’ukuboza muri abakerarugendo bashaka gusubika cyangwa kwimura ingendo zabo iryo tangazo rivuga hakuweho uburyo umuntu yamenyeshaga mbere y’iminsi irindwi kugira asure pariki hakuweho iminsi yagenwaga ikigo content: mu rwanda haba imikino itandukanye ariko hari umukino utangwaho amafaranga menshi umupira w’amaguru kandi niwo mukino bigaragara musaruro muzima utanga uyu mukino utangwaho akayabo ariko rwanda kibazo cy’ubushobozi rufite bijyanye gukora ibishoboka byose ikipe y’igihugu amavubi itsinde ndetse byigeze kwemezwa perezida repubulika y’u rwanda paul kagame wavuze badakwiye kwitwaza title: kenya yashimye uburyo u rwanda rushyigikira abashoramari
content: abashoramari kenya bavuga uburyo u rwanda rworoshya gukora ishoramari isoko ry’u rwanda kimwe bituma bashishikarira kuhashora imari nk’uko babitangaje nama bagiranye ambasade y’u rwanda kenya itariki ukuboza afungura nama ambasaderi w’u rwanda kenya james kimonyo yavuze u rwanda rwakoze ibishoboka byose rube igihugu kibereye ishoramari bituma ruza isonga bihugu abashoramari bagana rwikekwe yagize nk’uko mwese mubizi u rwanda gihugu mbere cyorohereza abashoramari afurika y’uburasirazuba ndetse icya gatatu afurika nk’uko raporo banki y’isi doing business’ yabyerekanye ikinyamakuru
