ubuyobozi bwiza kandi bufite icyerekezo pereziza paul kagame ambasaderi kimonyo yanavuze kuba abanyarwanda bashaka perezida kagame akomeza kubayobora nyuma umuyobozi mwiza yagaragaje kenya ifite abashoramari benshi rwanda bafite igishoro kigera miliyoni zikabakaba z’amadolari amerika kikaba ikimenyetso cy’uko ishoramari rikomeye ridakeneye gusa abaturuka ikantarange yongeyeho u rwanda rwakoze ibishoboka byose kugira rureshye abashoramari ati buri wese ashobora kwandikisha ubucuruzi bwe kigo cy’igihugu cy’iterambere rdb yifashishije internetmu masaha atandatu gusa serivise akaba arayibonye umuyobozi w’ikigo rich management’ aly khan satchu wayoboye ibikorwa by’iyi nama yashimye perezida kagame avuga yateye intambwe idasubira inyuma rugendo kuzahura igihugu ati izamuka ry’ubukungu gipimo title: bushali n’abagenzi maboko y’ubutabera bakurikiranyweho gukoresha biyobyabwenge
content: umuhanzi hagenimana jean paul wamamaye izina bushali nyuma kujya muziki yatawe yombi akekwaho gukoresha urumogi n’ibindi biyobyabwenge hamwe bagenzibe kumwe mu masaha mugitondo nibwo umuhanzi bushali kumwe slim drip hamwe n’abakobwa babiri babonywe rugo rw’umukecuru bifungiranye nsabimana desir umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’umurenge nyakabanda byabereyemo yabwiye kigali today dukesha nkuru baraye nzu y’uyu mukecuru bayihawe n’umwana usanzwe ayiraramo ariko akaba yabimukiye yagiye kurara ahandi ubwo mukecuru yabyukaga gitondo yumvise abantu benshi bavugira nzu niko gutabaza inzego z’umudugudu n’akagari akagari nako gatabaza umurenge nyakabanda bufatanye n’inzego z’umutekano bahanzi n’abakobwa bararanye batabwa yombi umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’umurenge nyakabanda yasobanuye batazi barayemo ariko kuko bahamaze ijoro ryose ariko bafatwaga babasanganye ibiyobyabwenge ati twabasanganye udupfunyika tubiri tw’urumogi n’ikindi gicupa kirimo ibintu banywaga tutazi kugeza bushali umaze kwamamara kubera amagambo yaririmbye ese muebue yahurije njyana trap igezweho yagaragaye yicaye modoka itwara abakekwaho ibyaha inzego z’ibanze nyakabanda zikaba zivuga bajyanywe bakorweho iperereza ry’ibyaha bakekwaho gukoresha ibiyobyabwenge bushali yitamirije inweri z’amabara mutwe agakunda kwikura ishati hejuru n’agakapu gato atwara nda umwe bakunzwe n’urubyiruko kubera kuririmba injyana igezweho yitwa trap ifite imizi amerika avuga wayizanye rwanda ndetse trap ikozwe kinyarwanda yayise kinya-trap akongeraho akajambo ku mugongo agaragaza uyihetse

title: iki kigega ishema ryacu ntikizagarukira ngwate ltgen karenzi karake
content: urugaga rw’abikorera rwanda psf rutangaza ikigega agaciro kacu kitazahita gihagarara nyuma gutanga ingwate yasabwe lt gen karenzi karake abanyarwanda bagomba guhora biteguye gutegereza guterwa babone kwitegura mu kiganiro rwanda today kfm gatatu tariki nyakanga umuyobozi psf steven ruzibiza yavuze ikigega ishema ryacu uru rugaga rwatangije cyumweru gishize uburyo kwirwanaho kwihesha ishema nk’abanyarwanda hirindwa kuzajya habaho gutegereza habaho ikintu kidasanzwe yagize iki kigega kizahoraho umwanya kugirango nk’abanyarwanda twe guhora dutegereza duterwa tujye duhora twiteguye tureke kujya dutegereza habaho ikintu nk’iki cyabaye gen karake dutangire kwikusanya nubwo kibaho hatabaye impamvu mu gutangiza ikigega ishema ryacu benshi bibazaga lt gen karenzi narekurwa abatanze amafaranga bazayasubizwa iki kigega ishema ryacu cyatangijwe mugaragaro kuwa gatanu tariki kamena n’urugaga rw’abikorera rwego gukusanya amafaranga asaga miliyari y’amanyarwanda urukiko westminster westminster magistrates’ court rwaciye ltgen karenzi karake nk’ingwate rumurekure ariko ategekwa kuguma bwongereza akajya yitaba polisi umuyobozi psf yavuze kigega kitareba gen karake gusa nubwo yabaye imbarutso ariko hari n’abandi rutonde guhigwa n’abigize abapolisi b’isi ku ikubitiro abacuruzi bagera bakusanyije miliyoni zisaga iki gikorwa kirakomeje kandi icy’abanyarwanda kuko kugeza ubishoboye yajya banki y’abaturage banki kigali agatanga inkunga kigega

title: uko ibuka europe yakiriye ifatwa kabuga ukekwaho uruhare jenoside yakorewe abatutsi
content: ubutabera bw’u bufaransa bwatangaje bwataye yombi flicien kabuga gicurasi musaza yabaga nzu asnires-sur-seine i paris yarahinduye imyirondoro flicien kabuga w’imyaka afatwa nk’uwabaye umuterankunga ukomeye jenoside ugushyingo gihe sosiyete kabuga yinjije gihugu toni z’imihoro ivuye bushinwa nyuma werurwe agura indi mihoro ibihumbi ni intwaro zakoreshejwe kwica abatutsi jenoside uretse ashinjwa n’umwe banyamigabane bashinze radio rtlm yagize uruhare rukomeye kubiba urwango mbere gihe jenoside nyuma y’imyaka ashyiriweho impapuro mpuzamahanga kumuta yombi agakomeza gukoresha ubutunzi bwe yihishahisha ibuka europe yakiriye neza ifatwa rye ryagizwemo uruhare n’inzego zitandukanye ibuka europe izina ry’abarokotse jenoside yakorewe abatutsi yashimye urwego rwasigariyeho inkiko mpuzamahanga mpanabyaha irmct ndetse n’u bufaransa ifatwa kabuga itangazo muryango wageneye itangazamakuru rivuga ntambwe irakuraho imigirire yagaragaraga bihugu burengerazuba ndetse by’umwihariko bufaransa jenoside yakorewe abatutsi’’ yibukije igikorwa gufata kabuga kizagira agaciro gihe hazafatwa n’abandi’ ibuka europe yasabye irmct guhagarika kurekura bidakurikije amategeko bamwe bahamijwe ibyaha ndetse bakatiwe n’urukiko kandi bagifite ibihano bagomba kurangiriza gereza ikomeza ivuga bibabaza abarokotse jenoside bigaha ababyungukiramo n’inshuti zabo icyuho gutesha agaciro icyaha jenoside kuyihakana turayihamagarira kongera imbaraga gushaka abandi bihisha ubutabera’’ uyu muryango wasabye ibihugu burengerazuba bw’isi kwihutisha iperereza birego byatanzwe nkiko kunoza imikoranire y’u rwanda irmct uvuga akaga kubona ibihugu nk’u busuwisi u bubiligi n’u bufaransa byaracumbikiye igihe kirekire umuntu ushinjwa icyaha gikomeye u burayi ntibugomba guhinduka indiri y’ubwihisho bw’abanyabyaha bahunga ubutabera’’ ibuka europe yagaragaje umuco kudahana atari igitutsi barokotse gusa ahubwo ubutumwa gushyigikira abicanyi b’ahazaza ndetse ukugambanira ikiremwamuntu’ itangazo ibuka europe ryashyizweho umukono n’abayobozi bw’uwo muryango barimo perezida wayo akaba n’uwa ibuka france nsanzimana etienne flicit lyamukuru uyobora ibuka belgique christine safari ibuka hollande honorine mujyambere ibuka italie jacqueline mukandanga blam ibuka allemagne murangira csar ibuka suisse kabuga yashyiriweho ictr impapuro kumuta yombi byaha birindwi birimo icyaha jenoside title: muhanga ihungabana rikomoka jenoside si iry’abacitse icumu gusa
content: mu biganiro yagiranye n’abanyamuhanga tariki nyirabahire yasobanuye ihungabana imihindukire y’imyitwarire imiterere iterwa n’ikintu kibi kibaye muntu bimutunguye avuga ihungabana riterwa jenoside yakorewe abatutsi ritagirwa gusa n’abacitse icumu kuko n’abandi bashobora kurigira kubera babonye bakoze cyangwa bumvise gihe jenoside umunyamabanga w’inama njyanama y’akarere muhanga avuga n’abatarahigwaga bashobora guhura n’ikibazo cy’ihungabana gihe cy’icyunamo yagize umuntu ashobora guhungabana bitewe n’ibyo yabonye bakorera abicwaga yarahetse intumbi cyangwa imirambo cyangwa yaragize uruhare bwicanyi umuntu wagize uruhare kwica abantu cyangwa kandi karengane arangwa kwiheba agahora yicira imanza ndetse agahora yifuza uwamubaza byabaye kugira abashe kubivuga abyikurimo nk’uko nyirabahire yakkomeje abisobanura yongeyeho benshi banyarwanda bahuye n’ihungabana ariko ngero zitandukanye abanyarwanda hanze y’igihugu hari ababa bumva buri munyarwanda wese umwicanyi ikaba byatera ihungabana rikomeye nk’uko umunyamabanga w’inama njyanama y’akarere muhanga abyemeza gerard gitoli mbabazi

title: rulindo bishatsemo izisaga gahunda y’inka y’akaguru
content: inka y’akaguru ni gahunda yateguwe n’ubuyobozi bw’akarere rulindo abafatanyabikorwa ndetse bamwe bavuka aka karere ariko bakorera hirya hino mugihugu hanze yaho rwego kunganira gahunda gir’inka munyarwanda isanzwe yarashyizweho leta y’u rwanda hatekerezwa gahunda y’inka y’akaguru aka karere hari hagamijwe uburyo kunganira gahunda gir’inka bitabaye ngombwa gutegereza leta izabakorera byose ahubwo bahisemo gushaka ubundi buryo koroza abatuye aka karere batishoboye cyane ubuyobozi bw’akarere rulindo bwemeza umwihariko wabo kuko uburyo muturage wishoboye afata mugenzi ukiri bukene akamworoza binyuze gahunda y’inka y’akaguru muri gikorwa hakaba harakusanijwe inka zisaga zikaba zije ziyongera zigera bihumbi umunani bamaze kugeraho kayiranga emannuel umuyobozi w’akarere rulindo asobanura uburyo impamvu n’uburyo batekerejemo gahunda yagize igenamigambi ryari ryarakozwe gahunda gir’inka kugeza mwaka aka karere kasabwaga kuba gafite inka zigera gusa munsi none tukaba twari tumaze kugera nibyo byatumye dutekereza gahunda ikindi twazibonaga gihe kingana n’umwaka none urabona zibonetse munsi umwe birumvikana gahunda gahunda nziza nasaba muntu wese ufite ubushake gushyigikira gahunda gir’inka munyarwanda ahawe ikaze kandi natwe nk’ubuyobozi bw’akarere rulindo tuzamushyigikira umuyobozi w’akarere rulindo akomeza avuga mwaka bamaze kugeza mubare w’inka zijyanye n’ingengo y’imari y’uyu mwaka bakaba bagiye gutangirana n’izi bashaka iz’umwaka utaha kandi bakaba bafite icyizere cy’uko bazarenza umubare w’inka basabwa koroza abaturage iyi gahunda yashimwe cyane n’abafatanyabikorwa b’akarere rulindo ndetse rwiyemezamirimo aka karere bashimangira gahunda izajya ibafasha kuzamura bagenzi bagifite ubushobozi buke bityo bakazamurana nk’abaturage batuye aka karere rulindo yanditswe snappy akayezu jean de dieumuhaburarw

title: dore uburyo bwagufasha kugabanya ibinure n’ubunini nda
content: abantu benshi bagira nda hanini ariko bakaba badashobora kumenya impamvu yabyo ndetse n’ushatse kubigabanya akayoberwa uburyo yabikoramo cyangwa se haba hangana nk’uko ubyifuza ukifuza hagumana ingano yaho dore zimwe nama twabagira kugira nda hanyu hangane nk’uko ubyifuza gerageza umenye ibiro byawe byinshi bihererye iyo turya ibidutunga bigira bijya kurusha ahandi bitewe n’imiterere yacu hari byirunda kibuno cyangwa bibero abandi nda cyangwa se gituza mbere gushaka gutangira gukora ibyagufasha kugabanya ubunini nda hawe banza umenye ariho koko hari ibiro byinshi itonde gihe urimo gufata ifunguro ryawe kurya vuba vuba bituma umira umwuka mwinshi bityo igogorwa ntirikorwe nk’uko bikwiriye rya wicayewitonze byibura minota uhekenye neza kurya byose ushyize kanwa ubone kumira gerageza kongera imboga n’imbuto urya kuko byoroshya igogorwa ndetse bigafasha iyo bibuze mubiri bifata mara bigatera kubyimba kw’inda mu biryo urya jya ugerageza urye inyama amafi n’amagi kuko bimwe byongera imbaraga mubiri hatabayeho kubyimba kw’igifu jya urya ibiryo biteguye neza kandi bihiye neza burya imitegurire y’ibyo turya nayo igira uruhare igogorwa ryabyo gabanya umunyu urya umunyu mwinshi utuma habaho kwireka kw’amazi nda jya urya umunyu muke ushoboka irinde kuba muntu uhora ahekenya burya buri gihe ugize ushyira hagati y’amenyo niyo kaba akantu gato cyane amatembabuzi gifu yitegura kwakira iryo funguro igifu gicibwa intege n’uburyo uba ukivangiye kandi udahaze rya ariko gihe kandi urye uhage gerageza gufata umwanya guhumeka neza uruhutse bikubuza amahoro ibi bifasha cyane kwirinda uburwayi hato hato imyitozo ngororamubiri ntugahore mwanya umwe ujye ugerageza kunyeganyega iyo umuntu arya ibinure biragenda bikibika mubiri wacu ngombwa tubivoma byiretse kora imyitozo ngororamubiri byibura inshuro ebyiri cyumweru iminota buri nshuro ushobora kwiruka koga mazi menshinatation kugenda igare gabanya isukari n’ibiyikomokaho byose cyane cyane byakorewe nganda ibi bitera kwireka kw’amaraso bice bitandukanye mubiri bityo ugasanga umuntu yarabyibushye ibice bimwe bimwe by’umubiri gerageza ushakishe isukari itaraciye ruganda nk’iyo mbuto n’ibindi nk’ibyo

title: umuganda inyunganizi ngengo y’imari y’igihugu
content: kimwe n’indi myaka yashize mwaka - wakozwemo ibikorwa binyuranye by’umuganda gihugu hose birimo guhanga imihanda y’imigenderano gutinda amateme kubaka amazu y’abatishoboye kubaka amashuli y’uburezi bw’ibanze bw’imyaka ybe kubaka ubwiherero kubaka ibigega guhunikamo imyaka gucukura imyobo guteramo ibiti gutera ibiti kubaka ibiro by’utugari gucukura ibyobo bifata amazi n’ibindi ibikorwa byose byakozwe bikaba byarahawe agaciro kangana y’amafaranga y’u rwanda nk’uko bigaragara rapport yashyizwe ahagaragara minaloc italiki mbere nzeli n’ubwo ibikorwa byakozwe bifite agaciro kanini gihugu hose ariko ntibyabujije hakorwa ibarura rigamije kumenya ubwitabire buri ntara muri raporo baragaragaza umujyi kigali hamwe n’intara y’uburengerazuba ziri mwanya nyuma n’ubwitabire bungana akaba nazo zifite ubwitabire buri hasi ugereranyije n’izindi ntara gihe intara y’amajyaruguru mwanya mbere n’ubwitabire igakurikirwa n’intara y’amajyepfo ifite intara y’uburasirazuba ikaza mwanya gatatu n’ubwitabire bungana aha intara zititwaye neza zikaba zisabwa kwikubita agashyi nyuma kumenya ubwitabire buhagaze gihugu hose barebye intara yakoze ibikorwa bifite agaciro kanini intara y’iburasirazuba iza isonga n’ibikorwa bifite agaciro kangana z’amafaranga y’u rwanda gihe umujyi kigali uza mwanya nyuma n’ibikorwa bifite agaciro kangana z’amanyarwanda aha kugira agaciro k’ibikorwa by’umuganda karusheho kuzamuka abakoze raporo berekanye hari ibintu by’ingenzi bitatu bigomba kwitabwaho ubwitabire bw’abaturage umurava buri wese witabiriye igenamigambi rinoze kandi risesengura neza ibikorwa by’ingenzi bifitiye abaturage n’igihugu rusange akamaro si gusa ariko byakozwe kuko mpera z’ukwezi werurwe minisiteri y’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu yatangije amarushanwa y’ibikorwa by’umuganda nshuro kabiri akaba yarashyiriweho kugirango atere imbaraga n’ubushake abaturage barusheho gukunda kwitabira ibikorwa by’umuganda benshi binyuze muco guhiga guhanga udushya umurenge kavumu karere ngororero intara y’uburengerazuba akaba waje mwanya mbere rwego rw’igihugu ubikesha urugomero rw’amashanyarazi rwubatswe n’abaturage bakabasha kwivana icuraburindi ku mwanya kabiri haje umurenge musange karere nyamagabeintara y’amajyepfo wahinze inanasi buso bungana ha bikazabafasha kwikura bukene ku mwanya gatatu hari umurenge manyagiro karere gicumbi intara y’amajyaruguru abaturage bawutuyemo bubatse amazu y’abahejwe inyuma n’amateka rwego kubafasha kwiteza imbere batura heza uretse ibikorwa byakozwe muganda rusange kandi raporo irerekana ibindi byakozwe n’ingabo polisi cyumweru army week police week n’ibindi byakozwe n’abanyarwanda banyuranye nzego zitandukanye hari kandi n’ibyakorewe mahanga babaga butumwa rwego kumenyekanisha umuco mwiza igihugu cyacu gifite aha twavuga ingabo z’u rwanda butumwa bw’amahoro bw’umuryango w’abibumbye majyaruguru darfur ahitwa el-fasher batangizaga umuganda buri kwezi bafatanyije n’ingabo z’ibindi bihugu ziri butumwa nyuma y’umuganda hagendaga habaho ibiganiro bitandukanye bigamije gukangurira abaturage kwitabira gahunda leta hamwe kugira uruhare bikorwa bibakorerwa batanga umusanzu wabo rwego kwiyubakira igihugu cyane cyagerwaho batabigizemo uruhare anne niwemwiza

title: bishop rugagi umaze amezi bukode avuye amerika kurambagiza indege azagura
content: umuvugabutumwa umaze kumenyekana nk’umunyabitangaza rwanda boshop rugagi innocent uyobora itorero redeemed gospel church yatangaje aherutse i washington ruganda boeing rukora indege agiye kubaza igiciro cy’iyo azagura minsi imbere umuvugabutumwa umaze kumenyekana nk’umunyabitangaza rwanda boshop rugagi innocent uyobora itorero redeemed gospel church yatangaje aherutse i washington ruganda boeing rukora indege agiye kubaza igiciro cy’iyo azagura minsi imbere ibi bishop rugagi innocent yabigarutseho gihe urusengero rwe rumaze amezi asaga bukode akodesha icyumba serena hotel akaba ariho bakorera amateraniro nyuma gufungirwa kubera kutubahiriza rwari rwasabwe gukosora n’akarere nyarugenge ku mugoroba mbere tariki gashyantare nibwo urusengero redeemed gospel church ruhereyeye mujyi rwagati rwashyizweho ingufuri rwafungiwe hakaba harimo gusakuriza bikomeye abaruturiye bishop rugagi wakunze gutangariza abayoboke afite inyota kugura indege gutemberamo cyumweru tariki nzeri yarimo yigisha ijambo ry’imana yatangaje afite gahunda kugura indege vuba cyane ndetse yanamaze kugera zikorerwa leta zunze ubumwe amerika rwego kubaza igiciro inkuru yatunguye abatari bacye yagize ubwo nari ndi leta washington nagiye gusura uruganda rw’indege boeing nagezeyo mbaza igiciro cy’indege nzagura imana ikubwiye izaguha ihene ujye uhita ushaka ikiziriko nikubwira izaguha inka jya uhita wubaka ikiraro avuga imana yamusezeranyije indege kera akaba ariyo mpamvu yagiye zikorerwa kugira amenye igiciro atangire abyitegure bishop rugagi yakomeje abwira abari materaniro bagomba kumwigiraho kugira umutima ukomeye kwizera kuko aribyo bituma umuntu abasha kugera kucyo yifuza kugeraho yagize mu bantu bizera ndi uwa mbere isi nintanayitungira hano namaze kumenya nzayitungira kuko imana yamaze kumpa uruhushya kwemerwa abantu bamaze kubona imana imbamomumpere imana amashyi menshi mu minsi ishize mbuga nkoranyambaga zinyuranye hakwirakwiye amafoto agaragaza bishop rugagi ruganda boeing i washington leta zunze ubumwe amerika yanifotoreje ndege byaketswe ariyo yasize arambagije ibi byatangajwe bishop rugagio byabaye nk’ibitunguye abatari bacye dore binigaragaza hari byinshi byihutirwa yakagombye kubanza gukora kurusha kubanza kugura indege muri harimo nko kubanza kubaka urusengero bajya basengeramo dore abayoboke b’iri torero redeemed gospel church mujyi kigali bamaze amezi asanga arindwi bakorera amateraniro bukode cyumba kimwe serena hotel bishop rugagi avuga yamaze kubaza igiciro cy’indege azagura rugagi yafashe umwanya uhagije atembera ruganda boeng abantu batunguwe kumva bishop rugagi agiye kugura indege iyi niyo modoka rugagi yatemberagamo america

title: abahanzi basuye urwibutso jenoside ntarama n’urwa nyamata
content: abahanzi batorewe gukomeza cyikiro kabiri bitabiriye urwo rugendo usibye knowless bubiligi kwitabira gahunda zijyanye kwibuka nk’uko umujyanama manager abitangaza abo bahanzi babanje gusura urwibutso ntarama basobanuriwe amateka yaho ndetse n’iyicwarubozo ryahabereye basobanuriwe ukuntu mbere jenoside abatutsi bahigwaga ariko uwabaga yahungiye kiriziya ntacyo yabaga ibyo byatumye jenoside benshi bahungira kiriziya bizeye gukira nk’uko byagendaga mbere ariko siko byagenze kuko bamaze kwirundiramo interahamwe zabasanzemo zibica urw’agashinyaguro abatutsi bahungiye kiriziya central ntarama babanje kwihagararaho ariko bigeze itariki nibwo abasirikare n’interahamwe baje banakoresha n’ibisasu kuburyo haguye abagera mu rwibutso ntarama hari imibiri y’abatutsi bazize jenoside kandi hagaragara bimwe bikoresho byifashishwa rugo baje bitwaje cyangwa se bahunganye kuko batekerezaga igihe kizagera bagasubira mungo zabo hagaragara kandi n’imyenda biteye agahinda buri munyarwanda wese ava akagera yagombye kugira ntibizongere ukundi nyangezi freddy umwe baherekeje abahanzi akaba uhagarariye bralirwa gikorwa yagize kwibuka igikorwa buri wese ku ruhande rwacu bralirwa igikorwa twubaha cyane uretse guteza imbere abahanzi tugomba kubigisha amateka bralirwa yubatse inzibutso ebyiri jenoside zishyinguwemo abakozi bakoraga bralirwa bazize jenoside gisenyi kigali bralirwa kandi ikorana n’urwibutso gisozi rwego kugira busitani bwarwo hahore hasukuye ikindi abana b’imfuzi ababyeyi bishwe jenoside bakoraga bralirwa bishyurirwa amafaranga y’ishuri mashuri mato kugera secondaire ariko hari gahunda gutangira kubishyurira kaminuza ku rwibutso nyamata ahantu hafite amateka yihariye nk’uko abahanzi babisobanuriwe niho ha mbere haguye abatutsi benshi cyane gihugu abatutsi baguye hano nyamata barashinyaguriwe bitavugwa nyamata ituwe n’abatutsi barakuwe turere dutandukanye tw’amajyaruguru gisenyi ruhengeri rwego kugira bapfe kuko hari ishyamba habagamo inyamaswa nyinshi ndetse n’amasazi yateraga indwara tsetse hapfiriye benshi gihe mu mwaka habaye ubwicanyi bumeze nk’aho byari igeragezwa jenoside buhitana abatutsi bagera kandi ntawigeze ahanirwa ukwicwa kw’abo batutsi hari umuzungu w’umutariyanikazi utuye witwaga tonia locatelli bamwishe tariki bamuziza yababwiraga adashyigikiye iyicwa ry’abatutsi bahatuye buryo ndetse yaranatangiye kubatabariza miryango mpuzamahanga mu mwaka w’ haguye abatutsi barenga hakaba hashyinguye abagera muri bahashyinguye harimo umubyeyi witwaga mukandori annonciata wishwe abanje gufatwa ngufu n’interahamwe z’abagabo nyuma bamujomba igisongo gitsina kirakomeza gitunguka mutwe uwo ashyinguwe ukwe isanduku wenyine rwego kugira harusheho kugaragazwa ubugome bw’indengakamere bwakorewe mubyeyinyuma gusobanurirwa byinshi kwirebera n’amaso abahanzi bagize babivugaho ntakirutimana danny uzwi izina danny nanone yagize hari ikiyongereyeho kuko ubwa mbere nsuye nyamata hiyongereye mateka narinzi nk’uko jenoside yagizwe uruhare n’abahanzi ndateganya gukora indirimbo irimo ubutumwa ubutumwa natanga kubagezweho jenoside ukwihangana gukurikiza gahunda z’icyunamo kudaheranwa n’agahinda tukiyubaka ikivi cy’abacu tuzacyusa kandi ibyabaye ntibizongere buri muhanzi cyangwa se itsinda bagize bavuga kubyo bamaze kubwirwa ndetse kwirebera n’amaso dore magambo make ubutumwa bwatanzwe n’abahanzi nyuma gusura urwibutso ntarama n’urwa nyamata riderman yagize igihe kirageze dutange ubutumwa bwibaka banyarwanda king james ngiye kurushaho gutanga ubutumwa bwunga abanyarwanda ndirimbo zanjye bull dog abahanzi batanze ubutumwa bwanganisha abanyarwanda bakwiye kubiryozwa dream boys ijwi platini iti umuhanzi indorerwamo rubanda duharanire gusiga isi nziza kurusha twayisanze just family ijwi jimmy iti dukwiye guhindura amateka y’umuziki tukirinda ubutumwa busenya emmy yagize ibyo mbonye birandenze dukwiye gukora bwabaga kugira bitazongera young grace atinjye nari muto mbyumva mateka ariko abafana banjye n’abanyarwanda rusange nabakangurira kunga ubumwe bagakundana bakaba ubumwe jay polly iyo mbonye ibintu nkibi birandenga abakoze bashyiraga bikorwa ibitekerezo by’abategetsi babi twe twongere ingufu gushyira bikorwa iby’abayobozi beza badusaba danny dukwiye guharanira bitongera kubaho ukundi umuyobozi mukuru east african promotors yasobanuye impamvu bazanye bahanzi gusura inzibutso magambo ukugira batazakora batazanatekereza n’umunsi rimwe kuba bakora ibikorwa nk’ibi bashyigikira cyangwa bakaririmba ibikorwa nk’ibi kuko byatugejeje ahantu nakwita habi cyane ndasaba urubyiruko rusange igikorwa cyabaye rwanda cy’ubwicanyi bumeze gutya bw’indengakamere kitabaho ukundi marie clemence cyiza uwimanimpaye

title: abakuramo inda buryo magendu bahombya leta arenga miliyali buri mwaka
content: byagarutsweho n’umujyanama kigo giharanira uburenganzira guteza imbere ubuzima health development initiative hdi mporanyi theobald yagiranaga ibiganiro n’abayobozi batandukanye karere huye bungurana ibitekerezo itegeko ryo gukuramo inda ibyo biganiro bibaye nyuma y’ibyabaye cyumweru hdi yaganiriye n’abangavu batewe inda imburagihe ababyeyi inzego z’urubyiruko n’iz’abagore abajyanama b’ubuzima ndetse n’ishyirahamwe ry’abakora umwuga w’uburaya yagaragaje uwakuyemo inda buryo magendu ashobora gukurizamo ubumuga n’uburwayi bukomeye ariko kandi ateza umuryango igihombo ndetse leta ikabihomberamo ati nk’uko ubushakashatsi bwakozwe n’ishuri rishinzwe ubuzima rusange kaminuza y’u rwanda bwerekanye inda z’abagore zivamo buri mwaka zirenga ibihumbi hari nyinshi zakuwemo buryo magendu zimwe zimwe kugira bavure benezo mwaka bitwara arenga miliyoni n’ibihumbi by’amadolari arenga miliyari y’amanyarwanda yasobanuye hari abajya muganga bangiritse imyanya myibarukiro abakurwamo nyababyeyi kuko yangiritse n’abahura n’ibindi bibazo bigatuma bihenda leta kubavuza kuko bahabwa ubuvuzi n’inzobere akenshi zituruka hanze y’igihugu mu mpera rwanda hatowe itegeko ryemerera abakobwa n’abagore kuba bajya muganga gukuzamo inda buryo bwemewe kandi bukozwe neza igihe bujuje ibisabwa ababyemerewe byiciro bitanu icya mbere umwana watewe inda afite imyaka y’amavuko munsi uwa kabiri umukobwa cyangwa umugore wafashwe ngufu uwa gatatu uwatewe inda n’uwo bafitanye isano itarenze igisanira kabiri uwa kane uwabanishijwe ngufu n’umugabo bagashyingiranywa gahato uwa gatanu umugore utwite ariko abaganga bakabona atwite adashobora kuvuka kubera impamvu zijyanye n’ubuzima ni itegeko ryitezweho umusaruro umukozi ushinzwe uburinganire n’iterambere ry’umuryango karere huye christine dusabeyezu yavuze iryo tegeko baryitezeho umusaruro buryo bugera bune ubwa mbere uguteza imbere abakobwa kuko batewe inda imburagihe bibadindiza kwiga gukora ibibateza imbere ubwa kabiri uguhosha amakimbirane miryango kuko abana babyaye biteza ibibazo bigakurura ubwumvikane buke uburyo gatatu yavuze ubukungu kuko abangavu batewe inda imburagihe leta itakaza amafaranga menshi kubitaho igihe babyaye kugira basubire buzima busanzwe n’abataye ishuri barisubiremo yasobanuye icya kane ubuzima bwabo kuko bakuyemo inda buryo magendu bahatakariza ubuzima cyangwa bagakuramo ubumuga n’izindi ndwara zitandukanye umuganga witwa kayitesi francine yavuze ibiganiro bahawe iryo tegeko bibakanguye bityo bakaba bagiye kujya bihutisha serivise muntu ubagannye aje gukuzamo inda igihe yujuje igifungo kiri hagati y’umwaka umwe n’imyaka itatu n’ihazabu hagati y’amafaranga ibihumbi n’ibihumbi uwayimukuriyemo ahabwa igihano cy’igifungo kiri hagati y’imyaka itatu n’itanu n’ihazabu y’amafaranga title: nyamagabe ubuyobozi bwafatiriye ibikoresho by’akabari kubera ideni umukozi wako afitiye banki
content: ubuyobozi bw’akagari kigeme nyamagabe bumaze ibyumweru bibiri bufatiriye ibikoresho resto-bar gikundiro kubera ideni umukozi wayo afitiye microfinance asa nyiribikoresho yagannye rib isaba gitifu w’akagari kubisubiza atsimbarara azabishyikiriza microfinance ni kigeme centre murenge gasaka akarere nyamagabe resto-bar gikundirotrust food restaurant iya fulgence munyaneza wahoze umukozi w’ibitaro kigeme nyuma akaza kazi akajya kuba karere huye kuwa gatanu tariki mutarama nibwo umugore munyaneza yazaga gupakira ibikoresho resitora atungurwa gitifu w’akagari kigeme bagambiki jean pierre kumwe n’umyobozi microfinance asa barabimupakuruza babitwara biro by’akagari nk’uko munyaneza abyivugira bikoresho bifite agaciro miliyoni eshatu iyi resto-bar gikundiro ifite abakozi barimo bajeneza aline colombe wafashe inguzanyo itsinda munyaneza fulgence agira nyuma kazi bitaro kigeme umukozi ukuriye abandi yakoze ubukwe mbona wundi nzabona niyemeza kwimura ibikoresho nakodeseheje inzu karere huye ntanga ubukode bw’amezi atatu tariki mutarama nohereje madamu gupakira bikoresho bifite agaciro miliyoni eshatu amaze kubipakira haza gitifu w’akagari n’umuyobozi microfinance asa babwira madamu umukozi wacu afite ideni itsinda ibikoresho barabitwaye bimwe babijyana kagari ibindi babibitsa yindi resitora n’ubu biri gukoreshwa tariki gashyantare nagiye rib bahamagara gitifu azane bikoresho asubiza azabiha microfinance ntihagaragara isano y’inguzanyo n’akabari niyonsenga evode niwe washakanye bajeneza aline colombe umukozi gikundiro kandi basezeranye ivangamutungo mu ukuboza bigiriye inama gusaba inguzanyo itsinda microfinance asa ibaha amafaranga niyonsenga ubwe yihamiriza bikoresho resitora bagwatirije kandi kugeza bishyura neza buri gatanu kuraranya nk’uko amasezerano bagiranye banki abiteganya atitwafashe inguzanyo y’ ibihumbi ukuboza twatangiye kwishyura mutarama mu masezerano twagiranye asa twishyura buri gatanu tuzishyura mezi atandatu buri gatanu turishyura ntiruraranya natanze icyangombwa cy’umutungo ho ingwate yemwe ntanga n’irangamuntu yanjye bikoresho fulgence twigeze tugwatiriza natunguwe kumva banki bampamagaye bavuga tugiye kwimuka narababajije nti ese mutwara ibikoresho by’abandi amasezerano twagiranye ntimuyafite kuri cyumweru tariki gashyantare twagerageje guhamagara ubuyobozi bw’akagari kigeme tumenye ukuri kw’aya makuru ariko bwarinze bwira gitifu atarabasha kwitaba telefoni mu ijoro rwagati twamwandikiye ubutumwa tumubaza isano hagati y’inguzanyo n’ibikoresho twizeraga abubona akibyuka akabusubiza turaheba muri gitondo nyuma kongera kumuhamagara ntiyitabe nibwo atanze ubutumwa burira buti ndi nama natwe tuti inama nirangira musubize butumwa magambo make turizeza abasomyi hafiyawe aduhera igisubizo tuzakibagezaho gusa kugeza munyaneza fulgence avuga mbere agana inkiko kubera ibihombo yatejwe gufatirwa ibikoresho ati ubu ndi gukorera gihombo kubera inzu nakodeshe imodoka nishyuye kubitwara ikagaruka ubusa nanjye nkaba ntacyo ndi gukora ibikoresho byanjye nabyo bikaba bikoreshwa n’utarabikodesheje karegeya omar

title: gakenke inkeragutabara n’abafasha barahuguwe mateka
content: kubakira byiza mateka y’u rwanda kugira uruhare kubungabunga umutekano hatangwa amakuru gihe muntu wese wahungabanya umutekano bimwe byagarutsweho mahugurwa yateguwe komisiyo gusubiza buzima busanzwe agenewe inkeragutabara n’abafasha yabereye biro by’akarere gakenke ukwakira afungura mahugurwa umuyobozi komisiyo gusubiza buzima busanzwe abahoze rugamba ntara y’amajyaruguru madamu niyonteze clemence yasabye abitabiriye mahugurwa kuyakurikirana neza kuko ingirakamaro mibereho n’abaturanyi yakomeje avuga mahugurwa agamije guhugura cyane cyane abagore b’inkeragutabara bagahugukirwa gahunda leta dore batigeze bahugurwa bagaruka rwababyaye ndetse kumenya ibibazo bafite bwana safali wilson watanze ikiganiro mateka y’u rwanda mahugurwa yasobanuriye abitariye amahugurwa imvano y’amateka yateye jenoside yakorewe abatutsi yavuze abazungu banditse kandi bakigisha amateka y’u rwanda bayagoreka nkana kugira bacemo ibice abanyarwanda babashe kubategeka bise cyongereza divide and rule by’umwihariko ababiligi banditse amateka y’abanyarwanda bagendeye mateka y’amacakubiri gihugu cyabo hagati y’abafurama flamands n’abawaru wallons dore iwabo byacikaga hagati yayo moko uretse bakoroni safali yakomeje avuga natwe ubwacu twabigizemo uruhare cyane cyane ubutegetsi butandukanye bwagiye busimburana bwahembereye macukubiri kugeza abanyarwanda barangajwe imbere n’ubutegetsi bubi bamburaga ubuzima abavandimwe basaga miliyoni asobanura ikigenderewe kwiga amateka yavuze kubaka ejo hazaza bwana safali yagize kumenya amateka yacu bidufasha kwirinda amabi jenoside tukubakira mateka meza bidufasha kandi kumenya twatsinzwe n’aho twatsinze nk’abanyarwanda ni byiza kwiga amateka kuko ushaka kwiyibagiza amateka ashaka kuyasubiramo ibyo bigamije kubaka ejo hazaza h’igihugu cyacu kizira amacakubiri n’ingengabiterezo jenoside umutekano isoko y’iterambere lt muhozi charles ubarizwa batayo ikorera karere gakenke watanze ikiganiro mutekano yavuze iterambere u rwanda rwagezeho rurikesha umutekano niyo mpamvu tugomba kuwubungabunga kugira tutazasubira inyuma yibukije abitariye amahugurwa batagomba kwirara bagomba gutanga amakuru gihe muntu wese ushobora kuhungabanya umutekano koloneli karegeya claudien komisiyo gusubiza buzima busanzwe witandukanyije fdlr yabasabye gukangurira abavandimwe ndetse n’inshuti zabo zikiri mashyamba kongo gutahuka bagafatanya n’abandi banyarwanda kubaka igihugu cyabo kandi abizeza kuzabafasha kubagezaho butumwa izo nkeragutabara zitandukanyije fdlr zinjijwe gahunda zitandukanye z’iterambere barihirwa amashuri y’imyuga barubakiwe bavanwa nyakatsi ndetse baninjizwa gahunda gira inka mushimiyimana jeannette umwe mubakurikiranye mahugurwa avuga mahugurwa yayungukiyemo byinshi yavuze yasobanukiwe imvano jenoside amateka yagoretswe akaba agiye gufata iya mbere akayarwanya avuga amateka y’ukuri kandi agomba kubaka igihugu cy’u rwanda ayo mahugurwa yitabiriwe n’inkeragutabara hamwe n’abafasha basaga baturutse turere twa rulindo gakenke batahutse bava mashyamba repubulika iharanira demokarasi kongo guhera kugeza mwaka turimo nshimiyimana leonard

title: kiliziya gatolika irifuza ingengabihe y’amashuri ihinduka umwaka ukajya utangira nzeri
content: kiliziya gatolika yasabye leta y’u rwanda guhindura ingengabihe y’amashuri buryo yakongera kujya atangira nzeri ikavuga byarushaho gufasha abanyeshuri myigire hashize imyaka isaga imiterere y’ingengabihe y’amashuri rwanda isaba abanyeshuri batangira umwaka mutarama ugasozwa ugushyingo gihe mbere watangiraga nzeri ugasozwa kamena ubwo kiliziya gatolika yasozaga icyumweru cyahariwe uburezi kamena paruwasi zaza umushumba diyoseze gikongoro hakizimana clestin yatanze ubutumwa izina ry’umushumba w’iya butare ushinzwe uburezi gatolika rwanda phillipe rukamba avuga abanyeshuri babangamiwe kuba biga mpeshyi yagize nagira ngire nisabira umushyitsi mukuru uwari uhagarariye minisitiri w’uburezi rwego kunoza imikoranire myiza isanzwe iranga leta kiliziya burezi ndahera ngengabihe y’umwaka w’amashuri hashize igihe twifuza umwaka w’amashuri wajya utangira kwezi cyenda ukarangira kwezi gatandatu mu mpamvu batanga harimo kuba abanyeshuri biga gihe cy’izuba bikagira ingaruka myigire ati impamvu nyinshi ariko cyane cyane igihe cy’izuba n’ibura ry’amazi tuzi twese biremerera abana bacu mashuri kwezi munani hakiyongeraho gahunda zinyuranye ziba ziri mezi rwego kiliziya buzima mbonezamubano bibangamira cyane abarezi bagomba kuzitabira kugeza amashuri abanza n’ayisumbuye rwanda agera agera angana kiliziya gatolika mu banyeshuri miliyoni eshatu biga mashuri abanza n’ayisumbuye abagera barererwa kiliziya gatolika ibyo kandi biza byongera kuba kiliziya gatolika ifatwa n’uruhongore rw’intiti nyinshi ziri rwanda ndetse byatumye umuyobozi mukuru wungirije w’ikigo cy’igihugu cy’uburezi reb dr michel rwibasira ashima uburezi n’uburere kiliziya ikomeje guha umwana w’umunyarwanda avuga n’ibyo kiliziya yasabye bazabyigana ubushishozi n’abo bireba bigakemuka yagize kuba byagira ishingiro wabihuza n’izindi mpamvu zose hari izuba noneho hari kureba ibihugu biri karere afurika y’iburasirazuba tubihinduye tugomba kwiga tukareba ingaruka byagira abanyeshuri bava hanze batugana baramutse basanze bitandukanye yongeyeho iyo ukemura ikibazo giterwa n’impamvu byakoroha tumaze iminsi natwe tubiganiraho ariko turashaka tubanze duhuze n’impamvu nyinshi zirimo n’iyo y’abanyeshuri kugira dufate umwanzuro bifite ishingiro ariko kugira tubifataho umwanzuro bikenera dufata n’izindi mpamvu zirimo nababwiye kugira nyuma tuzafate ukwiriye abanyeshuri ukwiriye u rwanda ariko ukwiriye n’abarezi icyumweru cyahariwe uburezi gatolika cyasorejwe karere ngoma ntara y’uburasirazuba paruwasi zaza diyoseze kibungo cyari gifite insanganyamatsiko igira iti nk’abakirisitu ntangiriro kiliziya ishuri ryacu turigire igicumbi cy’ubumwe n’ubufatanye kugeza diyoseze habarirwa ibigo by’amashuri birimo amashuri abanza amashuri yisumbuye y’uburezi bw’ibanze bw’imyaka icyenda agera ikagira n’amashuri acumbikira abanyeshuri kwizihiza cyumweru byari bibaye nshuro cyenda kuko byatangiye yanditswe chief editormuhaburarw

title: miliyoni z’amadolari amerika agiye gushorwa mushinga kwagura iprc musanze
content: kuri kane tariki gicurasi ishuri rikuru ry’imyuga n’ubumenyingiro musanze- iprc musanze- riherereye murenge nkotsi akarere musanze habereye umuhango gushyira ibuye ry’ifatizo ahagiye kubakwa inyubako zifite agaciro miliyoni cumi n’esheshatu z’amadolari amerika yatanzwe leta y’ubushinwa rwego kwagura shuri umushyitsi mukuru muhango minisitiri w’uburezi dr mutimura eugene hari kandi guverineri w’intara y’amajyaruguru hon gatabazi jean marie vianney ambasaderi w’ubushinwa rwanda rao hongwei inzego z’umutekano n’abandi bayobozi batandukanye abanyeshuri n’abarimu iprc musanze ndetse n’abaturage b’umurenge nkotsi baturiye shuri mu ijambo rye minisitiri w’uburezi yavuze imirimo kubaka inyubako ziteganyijwe ndetse n’ibikoresho bizazishyirwamo rwego kwagura iprc musanze zizatwara miliyoni cumi n’esheshatu z’amadolari amerika kandi yatanzwe leta y’ubushinwa yaboneyeho gushima ubufatanye hagati leta y’u rwanda n’ubushinwa yashimangiye bufatanye bushingiye cyane cyane bucuti bukomeye perezida repubulika y’u rwanda nyakubahwa paul kagame afitanye n’igihugu cy’ubushinwa by’umwihariko perezida xi jinping w’ubushinwa minisitiri mutimura yasabye abaturage baturiye iprc musanze gukomeza gufatanya ryo guteza imbere uburezi bw’abana kwiteza imbere ubwabo bahereye mahirwe babonye y’imirimo y’inyubako zigiye kuhazamurwa ku ruhande rwe guverineri w’intara y’amajyaruguru yavuze inkunga miliyoni cumi n’esheshatu z’amadolari amerika ubushinwa bwateye u rwanda ikaba ije ntara y’amajyaruguru izagira uruhare rukomeye iterambere ry’iyi ntara cyane cyane ije kubaka ibikorwaremezo bizafasha urubyiruko kuzamura urwego rw’ubumenyi musingi w’iterambere rirambye ry’igihugu guverineri gatabazi yijeje umutekano abashinwa bagiye gukora imirimo kwagura shuri kandi anasaba abaturage kuzababanira neza kuzabyaza umusaruro mahirwe babonye kuko nk’uko yabishimangiye imirimo igiye kuhakorerwa izatanga akazi batari bake bityo babone amafaranga azabafasha iterambere ryabo ambasaderi w’ubushinwa rwanda yijeje leta y’igihugu cye ahagarariye izakomeza gufatanya n’u rwanda mishinga itandukanye igamijwe iterambere n’imibereho myiza y’abaturage nk’uko byatangajwe inyubako ziteganyijwe kubakwa rwego kwagura iprc musanze zizubakwa buso metero kare ubwazo zikazaba zizaba zifite ubuso bungana metero kare zikazubakwa gihe cy’amezi izo nyubako zizaba zigizwe n’amashuri kwigiramo icyumba kinini cy’inama amacumbi y’abanyeshuri inzu laboratuwari n’izindi zizashyirwamo serivisi zitandukanye

nibyo byinjiza amadevize menshi ugereranije n’ibindi byoherezwa mahanga bivuye rwanda ibi bihingwa kandi bigirira akamaro kanini umuhinzi wabyo kuko bimuzanira amafaranga kugeza umuhinzi w’icyayi ahabwa amafaranga ijana kiro cy’amababi y’icyayi kigero cy’ubwiza kiri hagati naho cyayi kiri bwiza kugeza umuhinzi ahabwa amafaranga kiro ariko hari n’inganda zimwe zishobora kuyarenza muri mwaka umusaruro ndetse kwikenura kuko umuhinzi aguriwe giciro cyiza agira umwete kongera umusaruro kugira yeze byinshibimwe bihugu kawa ikunze kugurishwamo harimo leta zunze ubumwe z’amarikaubuyapani ndetse bimwe bihugu by’iburayi icyayi gikunze kubona amasoko bihugu by’abayisiramu iby’abarabu ndetse bimwe bihugu by’iburayi nk’uko corneille aritangaza abanyarwanda ntibitabira cyane kunywa icyayi n’ikawa avuga abanyanyarwanda bakwiriye kuba isoko ry’ibyo beza ntibatege amasoko banyamahanga gusa umwaka ushize umusaruro w’icyayi woherejwe hanze urenga toni zinjije akayabo kagera miliyoni z’amadorari y’amerika umusaruro kawa woherejwe hanze ugera toni zinjije miliyoni z’amadorari y’amerika corneille avuga bihingwa bifasha cyane igihugu kuko bituma ubukungu bw’igihugu kuzamuka ndetse bigatuma u rwanda rugira ijambo rwego mpuzamahanga aya madevize kandi afasha u rwanda kugura ibicuruzwa rukura hanze rudahenzwe avuga u rwanda rweza umusaruro muke ugereranyije n’ibihugu duturanye ariko icyari title: bpr plc yavuguruye inguzanyo mushahara gutunga inzu n’iyo kugura imodoka
content: ku bijyanye n’imodoka banki y’abaturage isanzwe itanga inguzanyo kuyigura itarengeje imyaka itandatu ikozwe yatangaje yaje gusanga abashoboye kugura modoka bake kubera inshya ihenda ibyo byatumye bahindura bashyiraho guha umuntu inguzanyo kugura imodoka imaze imyaka ikozwe igihe kwishyura kiva myaka ine gishyirwa myaka itanu banki y’abaturage itangaza bizorohereza abakiliya kuko imodoka nyinshi zinjira rwanda ziri cyiciro kandi zikaba ziri cyiciro ibigo by’ubwishingizi byishingira inguzanyo kugura cyangwa kubaka inzu yakuwe myaka ishyirwa myaka amezi umushahara ugomba kuba umaze unyura konti wikurikiranya kugira umuntu ayemererwe yakuwe mezi ashyirwa mezi atandatu ni gihe inguzanyo mushahara yashyizwe miliyoni frw zidafite ingwate avuye miliyoni frw igihe kwishyura cyongerewe kigera myaka itanu kivuye ine umuyobozi ushinzwe ubucuruzi bpr mugisha shema xavier yavuze bahinduye kugira bajyanishe n’impinduka zabayeho buzima bw’abaturage gukomeza kuba banki y’abaturage koko kandi yumva abakiliya ati hari impamvu nyinshi zatumye tuvugurura ziriya serivisi iya mbere ibihe byagiye bihinduka mugisha yatanze urugero nguzanyo mushahara avuga bakurikije ibibazo uyifata agiye gukemura n’uburyo ibiciro byahindutse isoko basanze batangaga mbere adahagije yagize kenshi ugiye kuyifata uba ugiye gukemura ibibazo byawe nko kugura ibikoresho nzu kugura imodoka se cyangwa kugura ikibanza ibintu nk’ibyo ariko wajya kureba ugasanga ibiciro bihagaze isoko ugasanga miliyoni frw twatangaga mbere ntabwo zihagije dusanga tugomba guhindura kugira dukomeze tube banki y’abaturage yumva ibyifuzo by’abakiliya bacu ku mwihariko korohereza abantu bijyanye n’inguzanyo ibafasha gutunga inzu mugisha yavuze bizatuma abafite imishahara iringanirye n’iciriritse b’abakiliya banki y’abaturage bamwe bazungukira gahunda leta gufasha abantu gutunga inzu zabo ni gihe banki y’abaturage y’u rwanda ifite gahunda gutera inkunga umushinga leta kubaka inzu ziciriritse kandi abagenerwabikorwa bawo bakazaba abantu bafite imishahara iringaniye cyangwa iciriritse

title: umukinnyi cristiano ronaldo yahishuye inenge yatumye abuza nyina kureba imikino ikomeye
content: umukinnyi bakinnyi mbere bakomeye isi cristiano ronaldo yahishuye yabuje nyinama kureba imikino ikomeye y’ umupira w’ amaguru anavuga impamvu yafatiye nyina cyemezo umukinnyi bakinnyi mbere bakomeye isi cristiano ronaldo yahishuye yabuje nyinama kureba imikino ikomeye y’ umupira w’ amaguru anavuga impamvu yafatiye nyina cyemezo ni kiganiro yagiranye n’ umunyamakuru piers morgan ukorera itv gatatu w’ cyumweru mbere y’ umukino ubanza uefa champions league uyu mukinnyi w’ imyaka y’ amavuko yavuze yabujije nyina maria dolores dos santos kuko agira amarangamutima atuma ababara cyane arebye umupira ronaldo avuga nyina yaguye igihumure inshuro ebyiri sitade agira arakara vuba buryo ntashobora kwiyumvisha ntabwo yemerewe kureba imikino ikomeye nasabye inshuti zisigaragana rugo kuko yigeze kwitura hasi sitade inshuro ebyeri arakara vuba cristiano ronaldo yakomeje agira ntibishoboka ntabwo mfite papa sinshaka kubura mama naramubwire nti ntabwo wemerewe kureba imikino kimwe kabiri n’ imikino nyuma ukundi

content: kimwe n’indi myaka yashize mwaka - wakozwemo ibikorwa binyuranye by’umuganda gihugu hose birimo guhanga imihanda y’imigenderano gutinda amateme kubaka amazu y’abatishoboye kubaka amashuli title: polisi yagaragaje neza ubushake politikimu kurwanya ruswa
content: abapolisi baturutse mitwe itandukanye polisi y’u rwanda italiki nyakanga batangiye umwiherero w’iminsi ibiri cyicaro gikuru polisi kacyiru gahunda kongera imbaraga kurwanya ruswa gipolisi gihugu rusange abitabiriye umwiherero abakora bugenzuzi bw’umurimo bashinzwe umutekano muhanda abarwanya inyerezwa ry’imisoro abagenzacyaha abakora iperereza n’abandi umuyobozi mukuru polisi y’u rwanda igpemmanuel k gasana watangije mwiherero yahaye abawitabiriye inshingano gukumira ruswa igp gasana yagize atibirasaba ubukangurambaga gukora ubushakashatsi tugomba kujyana n’imyumvire mishya twubaka igipolisi kigezweho kandi bigaragazwa disipuline n’imyitwarire myiza bigomba kugera banyarwanda tubibakanguriye mu nyigisho yahatangiye igaragaza uruhare rw’umutwe bakoreramo guhindura intumbero polisi mo impinduka nziza umuyobozi polisi yagize atiinzego zirwanya ruswa niwo musingi w’ubuzima bw’igihugu kugera kubyo twiyemeje ubugenzuzi bw’umurimo ruhande rumwe bushinzwe kurwanya ruswa n’inyerezwa nzego leta yongeyeho ubugenzuzi bw’umurimo nirwo rufunguzo rw’intumbero polisi ifite ariko bisaba buba bubyumva kandi bugafasha polisi kugera ntego zayo kuri kurangiza inshingano kurwanya ruswa bagomba kumva ibintu by’ibanze bagomba kumenya amakuru kuba bafite ibyangombwa kandi hari basabwa gukora aha yagize atimugomba kumenya igihugu cyahisemo indangagaciro polisi kumenya mushaka kandi mugashyiraho mukura amakuru yavuze ubugenzuzi buhoraho n’amahugurwa nibyo bizageza polisi rwego kutihanganira ruswa haba polisi imbere gihugu itangizwa ry’umwiherero kandi ryari ryitabiriwe n’umuyobozi transparency international-rwanda marie immaculee ingabire athanase gatare umukuru w’iperereza biro by’umuvunyi polisi y’u rwanda ikaba yishimira ubufatanye bukomeye hagati yayo n’izi nzego zombi zirwanya ruswa nyuma y’amasezerano y’ubufatanye ifitanye nazo ku ruhanda rwe ingabire yagize atiurwego nyobora polisi twembi tuzi neza gusangira amakuru ntwaro gutsinda urugamba kurwanya ruswa yagize kandi atitransparency international-rwanda ibona amakuru ariko ntishinja cyangwa ikore iperereza byaha polisi niyo ifite gukumira nshingano gushaka kugenza ibyaha n’ubwo polisi ishyirwa rutonde rw’inzego zirangwamo ruswa yagize atipolisi yagaragaje neza ubushake politiki kurwanya ruswa nibura ibirego byakiriwe transparency international-rwanda ruswa mwaka ibyaregwaga polisiyanditswe rnp

content: bagosora nsengiyumva barajuririra igihano cy’igifungo burundu bahawe kubera ibyaha jenoside n’ibindi byaha byibasiye inyoko muntu ntawukulilyayo yajuririye igihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka yakatiwe kubera uruhare yagize jenoside ku itariki ukuboza nibwo bagosora wahoze ayobora ibiro minisitiri w’ingabo yakatiwe nyuma guhamwa n’ibyaha jenoside ibyaha byibasiye ikiremwamuntu n’ibyaha by’intambara birimo kwica uwari minisitiri w’intebe agathe uwilingiyimana n’abandi basirikare b’ababiligi onu bagosora anashinjwa kugira uruhare ishyirwaho bariyeri hirya hino kigali gisenyi hagati y’itariki mata nsengiyumva ukuriye ibikorwa gisirikare gisenyi yahamijwe ubwicanyi bakorewe kaminuza mudende paruwasi nyundo ndetse n’ubwicanyi bwakorewe abasivili gice ayoboye yanahamijwe kandi kuba yarohereje ibitero by’interahamwe bisesero kwica abatutsi bagosora nsengiyumva baburanishirijwe igihe kimwe hamwe n’abandi basirikare babiri aribo brigadier-general gratien kabiligi major aloys ntabakuze kabiligi yahisevarekurwa ntabakuze ajurira rubanza rwabaye itariki werurwe urubanza ntabakuze rwaje gutandukanywa n’urwabandi nyuma y’aho uwamwunganiraga mategeko umunyamerika peter erlinder ananiriwe kwitaba urukiko tariki werurwe ubujurire bwe bwaje gusomwa tariki nzeri na nubu buracyakomeza ntawukulilyayo yakatiwe igihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka kubera uruhare yagize bwicanyi bwakorewe kibuye n’i butare umunyamakuru kigali today

title: loni yashimye amasezerano yasinywe n’u rwanda uganda
content: loni yatangaje yiteguye gutanga ubufasha bwose bushoboka kugira karere haboneke amahoro n’iterambere rirambye ku gatatu tariki kanama nibwo perezida paul kagame mugenzi uganda yoweri kaguta title: rulindo abaturage barasabwa gusiba ibyobo byose birangaye
content: mu karere rulindo hari ahantu hamwe hamwe hakunze kuboneka ibyoboiyo ubajije iby’ibo byobo abaturage bavuga biba byacukuwemo imicanga cyangwa amabuye bashaka gukoresha bwubatsi ibyo byobo ubona biba birangaye buryo bishobora kuba byahungabanya ubuzima bw’ibinyabuzima utaretse n’ubw’abantu nyamara ubajije bamwe baturage baturiye byobo usanga mpungenge bafite byoboaho usanga umuturage avuga icyobo kirekamo amazi ariko ntiyunve bizi birekamo bishobora gukurura imibu ikaba yabatera indwara ikindi umuntu yakwibaza bijyanye n’umutekanokuko byobo bishobora guhisha abagizi nabi nk’abajura munyandinda jean boscoumukozi ushinzwe ibidukikije karere rulindo avuga hari ingamba zikomeye zafashwe n’aka karere rwego gukumira byobo kubisiba bikigaragara misozi yagize atiabakeneye gucukura imicanga cyangwa amabuye bagomba kuza bagahabwa ibyangombwa bibemerera bakagirana n’akarere amasezerano avuga nibarangiza gukuramo bakeneye bagomba kongera bagasubiranya ubutaka bukamera nk’uko babusanze akomeza avuga basabwa n’amafranga y’ingwate utahasibye ntayasubizwa ngo kubera ngamba zafashwe n’ubuyobozi bw’akarere ibyobo byagiye bigabanuka buryo bugaragara n’ubwo bitacika burundu mu rwego kubungabunga ibidukikije kandiabaturage bafatanije n’ubuyobozi bagenda bagerageza kubisiba cyane cyane gikorwa cy’umuganda bahuriramo ramuni ernestumukozi uhagarariye ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe kwita bidukikije karere rulindo remaavuga mbere karere rulindo hari ibyobo byinshi birangayeariko hamwe gufatanya n’abaturage byaragabanutse avuga rema igenda ibakangurira inabigisha uburyo bagomba gusigasira ibidukikije basiba byobokandi byagize akamaro gakomeye yagize atiubu byaragabanutse kuko mbere wasangaga ibyobo byinshi birangaye misozi hagati ngoariko hamwe gufatanya n’abaturage tugenda tubunvisha impungenge bakwiye kugira zaterwa n’ibyo byoboabaturage barabyunvise buryo bagenda babisiba nabo ubwabo abaturage karere rulindo bakaba barihaye gahunda gusiba byobo n’ubwo hakiri bikigaragara ariko bizasibwa byose

title: impamvu zituma ukururwa n’uwo mutashakanye ukumva umukunze
content: bijya bibaho umwe bashakanye wumva yakunze muntu kandi yaramaze guhitamo bazabana birashoboka urwo rukundo rwabo runakomeza akaba yasiga barashakanye agasanga mushya muri nkuru tugiye kureba impamvu zituma umwe bashakanye yisanga akururwa n’undi n’icyo wakora igihe bikubayeho umuhanga by’imitekerereze witwa mullinax avuga kuba umuntu wubatse yakibona akururwa n’undi muntu batashakanye kibazo kirimo aho biba ibyiyumviro biza ako kanya ariko nyuma bigashira mu bushakashatsi n’abandi bakoreye bagore biga kaminuza buhinde bagaragaje abagera bemeje bigeze gukururwa n’undi muntu batashakanye gusa bavuga bihita bishirira kuko abagera gusa aribo bemeje gukururwa byaje kuvamo urukundo rubaganisha guca inyuma bashakanye ku rundi ruhande ariko hari abavuga igihe cyose wiyumvisemo wakuruwe n’undi muntu mutashakanye kandi waramaze guhitamo gihe uba wamaze gutangira inzira kumuca inyuma ari abavuga gukururwa n’uwo mutashakanye kibazo kirimo n’ababona harimo ikibazo bahuriraho hari impamvu zituma ukururwa n’uwo batashakanye agera rwego kumva yamukunze akaba yanaca inyuma bashakanye dore impamvu zimwe zituma gukururwa n’undi muntu bivamo urukundo guta mwashakanye kuba urugo rwawe ruri bibazo iyo musanzwe mutumvikana n’uwo mwashakanye biroroshye ukururwa n’abandi bagore cyangwa se abandi bagabo bamwe bagenda bashaka amahoro kuko bumva bayaburiye rugo rwabo nyamara icyiza ukwiye kubanza gukora ushoboye ugarura amahoro rugo rwawe gutwarwa umutima n’abandi ikinda ugomba kuzirikana urukundo rwose rugira igihe k’ibibazo n’igihe cy’ibyishimo gusa urukundo ruramba nyirarwo bazi bakemura ibibazo bagirana hagati guhora ubona ibibi gusa by’uwo mwashakanye akenshi uhora ubona ibibi gusa by’uwo mwashakanye biroroshye wisanga wakuruwe n’undi mutashakanye ibyo biterwa mwashakanye umubona ukamubonamo ibibi k’uwundi ukaba ujya kureba ibyiza utabona k’uwo mwashakanye nta muntu ubaho w’umutagatifu abagore n’abagabo buri wese afite uruhande rubi n’urwiza iyo ushaka kubaka urugo runezerewe kandi rurambye wirinda guha agaciro ibibi kurusha ibyiza by’uwo mwashakanye ibibazo biza nyuma kubaka urugo nyuma gushinga urugo hari hagati y’abashakanye havuka ibibazo kuba basanzwe batabana kuba umuntu aribwo yiyereka bashakanye ntacyo amukinze rimwe rimwe bibazo bituma utangira kwibaza ushobora kuba waribeshye k’uwo mwashakanye iyo ugize muntu mukubitana ubona ariwe ugukunze kurusha mubana nyamara burya ushobora kumukurikira ugasanga usize urabisanze kuba utarigeze ukunda mwashakanye muri minsi usanga kubeshyanya mukundana byaragwiriye buryo umuntu murinda mujya kubana uziko agukunda kandi akuryarya niba waraje ukurikiye ibindi bintu k’uwo mwashakanye niyo wabibona ntabwo umutima wawe uzatuza wihingemo urukundo ruze niho uzasanga ahubwo wisanze ukururwa n’abandi ukabona ibyiza byabo rimwe rimwe mwashakanye abifite ariko kuko utamukunze ntabyo wabona kuba umuntu ugukurura afite agamije hari wibwira yuri gukururwa n’undi muntu mutashakanye ukumva biterwa kuba umukunze nyamara akaba aguhiga afite ikindi agamije shishoza n’usanga muntu afite ibindi agamije birimo kugusenyera kurya amafaranag yawe kukwinezezaho urugero abagabo bashobora agutanga ukazabibona nyuma muri make ntabwo wavuga uzirinda guhura n’abandi bantu kimwe utazabirinda mwashakanye gusa ugomba kuzirikana mwashakanye wamuhisemo bandi kandi ukamuha cyizere kuba yaragutoranyije bandi ibyo bizabarinda gukururwa n’abandi kugera rwego kuba urukundo kuba mwacana inyuma nta mpamvu n’imwe ukwiye kwitwaza ugomba guharanire wasigasira urukundo rw’uwo mwashakanye ukaba aribyo title: hashyizweho ibipimo fatizo by’ikibanza cy’inyubako abashoramari bakomeye bahabwa umwihariko
content: ibipimo fatizo bishya by’ikibanza kigenewe inyubako rimwe mateka minisitiri ryemerejwe nama y’abaminisitiri yabaye mbere tariki nyakanga mu bipimo bishya ikibanza kubakamo inzu isanzwe guturamo cyashyizwe metero kare ikibanza kubakamo inzu igerekeranye y’amagorofa agera ntikizajya kirenza hegitari mu iteka rishya ikibanza kubakamo ishuri ry’incuke ntikigomba kurenza metero kare ishuri ribanza rikagira hegitari n’igice amashuri yisumbuye akagira hegitari ebyiri n’igice ikigo cy’amashuri kirimo ay’incuke abanza n’ayisumbuye ntibirenze hegitari ikibanza cy’amashuri y’imyuga n’ubumenyingiro ntikigomba kurenza hegitari eshanu ikibanza cyubakwamo kaminuza ntikizajya kirenza hegitari esheshatu ku bijyanye n’amavuriro ivuriro ry’ibanze poste de sant rizajya ryubakwa buso butarenze metero kare ikigo nderabuzima cyubakwe buso butarenze hegitari ibitaro byigenga n’ibya leta ntibirenge hegitari eshanu insengero ntabwo zigomba kurenza metero kare ibihumbi bitanu inyubako z’ubucuruzi zijyana n’igenamigambi ry’imijyi n’andi mategeko y’uko ubutaka bugenda busaranganywa abashoramari bakomeye bahawe umwihariko minisitiri w’ibikorwa remezo claver gatete yavuze bahisemo guha umwihariko abashoramari bakomeye bifuza inyubako gihugu ariko bakoze ibikorwa bikomeye bigiteza imbere abo bashoramari hakurikijwe agaciro k’ishoramari ryabo gihugu bazajya bemererwa kubaka buso bwisumbuye gihe bashatse gutura minisitiri gatete yagize dukeneye abantu b’abakire cyane cyane abaza kudufasha ufashe howard buffet wubatse i nasho hegitari zirenga agashyiraho agace k’ubuhinzi n’ubworozi akigisha abanyarwanda rwego ruhanitse akubaka imihanda inyuranye muntu ashatse gutura ha hantu ntabwo ajya nzu metero kare ashaka ahantu hanini mu iteka rishya bice by’icyaro gihe umuntu yazanye gihugu ishoramari rifite agaciro kari hagati miliyoni frw kugeza miliyoni frw azajya yemererwa kubaka inzu buso bungana n’igice hegitari uzanye ishoramari riri hagati miliyoni frw kugeza title: kigaliikiganiro robot yitwa sophia yatanze nama transform africa kigatangaza benshi
content: mu nama transform africa kubera i kigali rwanda mbere yitabiriwe ’robot’ imeze nk’abantu imaze kumenyekana isi yitwa sophia yari yakenyejwe umukenyero kinyarwanda ku mbuga nkoranyambaga abantu benshi rwanda batangariye ’robot’ kiganiro yababwiye yishimiye kuba i kigali iyi ’robot’ yakozwe kompanyi yitwa hanson robotics hong kong ifite ubushobozi kwerekana amaragamutima yayo maso kwitegereza kubona abantu ikabamenya kuganiriza abantu kigero runaka ndetse ishobora kugendesha amaguru intera ntoya ikiganiro gito sophia yagiranye n’uwari uyoboye inamamc gikurikira sophia mwaramutse mwakoze kuntumira mc uzi sophia yego rwose ndi mujyi ukomeye kigali rwanda burasirazuba africa mc waje ute sophia naje ndege banshyize ivarisiariko nzavugisha abanzanye ubutaha nzicare idirishya mc sophia uzi indimi zingahe sophia nzi cyane cyane icyongereza n’igishinwa gikeya ariko nzi n’indamukanyo zimwe zimwe zindi ndimi urashaka kuzumva mc yego yego sophia mu gifaransa baravuga bonjour mu cyarabu salam alekum mu giswahili habari zenu mu kinyarwanda muraho neza mc hagati wambaye neza sophia urakoze cyane nanjye nabikunze ni umukenyero wakozwe moshions inzu y’imideri rwanda mc ni byiza ndabizi hari wateguye kutugezaho ngaho umwanya uwawe sophia yatangiye ijambo rye avuga yishimiye kuba nama irimo abantu benshi n’abakuru b’ibihugu igamije kuganira ejo hazaza h’ikoranabuhanga africa avuga abantu bitabagoye kubona ’artificial intelligence’ guhindura ubuzima bwabo neza bukungu ubuvuzi ubuhizi n’ibindi byinshi ati hano rwanda mukoresha uburyo kwishyura ingendo mudatanze cash n’abantu bakabone serivisi leta murandasi n’ibindini ibintu byiza yemeza ubuhanga mw’ikoranabuhanga bukorerwa africa butanga umusaruro n’ahandi isi kuko hari bimwe bice bimugize sophia byakorewe i addis ababa ethiopia kuri intangiriro gusa avuga nizeye dufatanyije abantu robot twagera byiza byinshi n’imibanire myiza isi sophia akoresha ikoranabuhanga ’artificial intelligence’ rituma kigero runaka abasha kumenya kumva kuvuga gusubiza kugenda gutekereza rwego rugereranyije nk’abantu

title: u rwanda ruyoboye isi gushyiraho amabwiriza agenga imikorere drones
content: u rwanda rwabaye igihugu mbere gushyiraho amabwiriza agenga imikorere y’indege zitagira abapilote drones akaba intambwe izafasha gukomeza guhanga udushya kwagura imikorere y’izo ndege mu nibwo leta y’u rwanda ifatanyije n’ikigo gikora indege zifashishwa gutwara amaraso zitagira abapilote zipline batangije uburyo mbere isi kwifashisha indege nto zitagira abapilote gutwara amaraso n’ibindi bikenerwa buvuzi zikabigeza bice kure ubundi buryo bw’ingendo bugoye kuri ndege rwanda zimaze gukora ingendo zisaga ibihumbi bitatu minisitiri w’ikoranabuhanga n’itumanaho jean de dieu rurangirwa yavuze u rwanda ruzakomeza guteza imbere ikoranabuhanga ruteza imbere ibijyanye drones yagize tugendeye buryo gutwara amaraso hifashishijwe drones tugiye guteza imbere ibijyanye nazo tuzakomeza gushyiraho ibikorwa remezo n’ingamba guhangana n’umuvuduko w’ikoranabuhanga riri gutera imbere guhindura ubuzima benshi gushyiraho amabwiriza agenga drones hashingiwe mikorere yazo bizafasha abazigenzura n’abazikoresha gufatanya gukemura ibibazo bishobora kuvuka birimo nko kubungabunga umutekano w’abaturage rurangirwa yakomeje agira kongera imbaraga migenzurire drones twabifashijwemo n’ikigo cy’inama y’isi y’ubukungu world economic forum center gishinzwe iby’impinduramatwara kane bukungu ni intambwe ikomeye gushyiraho uburyo bwiza buzoroshya iterambere drones turi gushyiraho gahunda kubaka ubushobozi bafite impano gihugu gufatanya n’abikorera gushyiraho umusingi impinduramatwara kane bukungu izubakiraho umuyobozi w’ikigo gishinzwe impinduramatwara kane murat sonmez yavuze intego ugufasha ibihugu nk’u rwanda bishyigikiye iterambere ry’ikoranabuhanga yagize intego yacu ugufasha guverinoma nk’u rwanda zifasha ubucuruzi rwiyemezamirimo bato abagize sosiyete sivile n’abakora ubushakashatsi guteza imbere ikoranabuhanga kurikoresha nyungu z’abaturage murat yakomeje agira u rwanda nicyo gihugu mbere twafatanyije bijyanye drones kuba u rwanda ruri isonga gushyiraho amabwiriza agenga drones urugero bindi bihugu bishaka gukoresha buryo izindi gahunda u rwanda rushaka gushyira bikorwa bijyanye drones harimo kuba igihugu mbere afurika kizashyiraho uburyo kugenzura drones kirere ikigo cy’icyitegererezo bijyanye n’imyitozo y’ibya drones ndetse gukoresha ndege kurwanya rushimusi pariki umugereka w’amabwiriza minisitiri mata arebana n’iby’indege gisivili zitagira abapilote ugaragaza amategeko agenga ndege zizakorera rwanda zikazajya zikorera ibilo bitarenze kandi zikaguruka kirere uziyoboye abasha kuzireba biteganywa zizajya zifashishwa bikorwa birimo gufotora gukurikirana ibihingwa murima gushakisha cyangwa ubutabazi ubwikorezi bwihuse ubushakashatsi uburezi kwishimisha ayo mabwiriza avuga ndege zitemerewe gukorera rwanda gihe zitandikishijwe kigo gishinzwe iby’indege gisivili kandi nyirayo agahabwa icyemezo gishingiye mabwiriza nyuma kwishyura frw gukoresha drones kugeza amaraso muganga bimaze gutangizwa bitaro rwanda birimo kabgayi nyanza muhororo gitwe kirinda gakoma gikonko kaduha kabaya shyira ruhango ruliumwaka ushize u rwanda rwahawe igihembo mpuzamahanga gihabwa abantu cyangwa ibigo byabaye indashyikirwa guhanga udushya kizwi index awards kubera itangizwa drones gutwara amaraso

title: amafoto mpangano y’abami batwaye u rwanda imyaka n’abagabekazi
content: hifashishijwe ibisigo by’abasizi bisingiza abami n’ingoma zabo ndetse n’abacurabwenge abarinzi b’amateka n’intekerezo z’igihugu hiyongereyeho n’abiru abanyamabanga n’abagaragu b’ingoma hakusanyijwe amateka y’u rwanda ntango yarwo gihanga i ngomijana yashyiragaho imfatiro z’igihugu kugera ingoma cyami yasimburwaga repubulika mu bakoreye ngata gihanga i ngomijana harimo ubuvivi bwe ndoba watwaye u rwanda ahasaga kugera arangwa n’ibitekerezo bihanitse bumenyi by’ibidukikije inyamaswa n’urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima muri make ndoba afite ubuhanga karemano siyansi dore dukesha title: umuganda inyunganizi ngengo y’imari y’igihugu
content: kimwe n’indi myaka yashize mwaka - wakozwemo ibikorwa binyuranye by’umuganda gihugu hose birimo guhanga imihanda y’imigenderano gutinda amateme kubaka amazu y’abatishoboye kubaka amashuli y’uburezi bw’ibanze bw’imyaka ybe kubaka ubwiherero kubaka ibigega guhunikamo imyaka gucukura imyobo guteramo ibiti gutera ibiti kubaka ibiro by’utugari gucukura ibyobo bifata amazi n’ibindi ibikorwa byose byakozwe bikaba byarahawe agaciro kangana y’amafaranga y’u rwanda nk’uko bigaragara rapport yashyizwe ahagaragara minaloc italiki mbere nzeli n’ubwo ibikorwa byakozwe bifite agaciro kanini gihugu hose ariko ntibyabujije hakorwa ibarura rigamije kumenya ubwitabire buri ntara muri raporo baragaragaza umujyi kigali hamwe n’intara y’uburengerazuba ziri mwanya nyuma n’ubwitabire bungana akaba nazo zifite ubwitabire buri hasi ugereranyije n’izindi ntara gihe intara y’amajyaruguru mwanya mbere n’ubwitabire igakurikirwa n’intara y’amajyepfo ifite intara y’uburasirazuba ikaza mwanya gatatu n’ubwitabire bungana aha intara zititwaye neza zikaba zisabwa kwikubita agashyi nyuma kumenya ubwitabire buhagaze gihugu hose barebye intara yakoze ibikorwa bifite agaciro kanini intara y’iburasirazuba iza isonga n’ibikorwa bifite agaciro kangana z’amafaranga y’u rwanda gihe umujyi kigali uza mwanya nyuma n’ibikorwa bifite agaciro kangana z’amanyarwanda aha kugira agaciro k’ibikorwa by’umuganda karusheho kuzamuka abakoze raporo berekanye hari ibintu by’ingenzi bitatu bigomba kwitabwaho ubwitabire bw’abaturage umurava buri wese witabiriye igenamigambi rinoze kandi risesengura neza ibikorwa by’ingenzi bifitiye abaturage n’igihugu rusange akamaro si gusa ariko byakozwe kuko mpera z’ukwezi werurwe minisiteri y’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu yatangije amarushanwa y’ibikorwa by’umuganda nshuro kabiri akaba yarashyiriweho kugirango atere imbaraga n’ubushake abaturage barusheho gukunda kwitabira ibikorwa by’umuganda benshi binyuze muco guhiga guhanga udushya umurenge kavumu karere ngororero intara y’uburengerazuba akaba waje mwanya mbere rwego rw’igihugu ubikesha urugomero rw’amashanyarazi rwubatswe n’abaturage bakabasha kwivana icuraburindi ku mwanya kabiri haje umurenge musange karere nyamagabeintara y’amajyepfo wahinze inanasi buso bungana ha bikazabafasha kwikura bukene ku mwanya gatatu hari umurenge manyagiro karere gicumbi intara y’amajyaruguru abaturage bawutuyemo bubatse amazu y’abahejwe inyuma n’amateka rwego kubafasha kwiteza imbere batura heza uretse ibikorwa byakozwe muganda rusange kandi raporo irerekana ibindi byakozwe n’ingabo polisi cyumweru army week police week n’ibindi byakozwe n’abanyarwanda banyuranye nzego zitandukanye hari kandi n’ibyakorewe mahanga babaga butumwa rwego kumenyekanisha umuco mwiza igihugu cyacu gifite aha twavuga ingabo z’u rwanda butumwa bw’amahoro bw’umuryango w’abibumbye majyaruguru darfur ahitwa el-fasher batangizaga umuganda buri kwezi bafatanyije n’ingabo z’ibindi bihugu ziri butumwa nyuma y’umuganda hagendaga habaho ibiganiro bitandukanye bigamije gukangurira abaturage kwitabira gahunda leta hamwe kugira uruhare bikorwa bibakorerwa batanga umusanzu wabo rwego kwiyubakira igihugu cyane cyagerwaho batabigizemo uruhare anne niwemwiza

bafashwe batajya batanga mande kuko babeshya ntayo bafite bagahita bafungurwa bitarenze iminsi itatu nyuma gufungurwa bagaruka bishyizemo abantu bagize uruhare ifatwa ryabo umuyobozi w’umudugudu title: ishavu ry’abanyarwanda ritubere umusingi kwiyubaka umuyobozi w’umurenge bwishyura
content: umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’umurenge bwishyura niyonsaba cyriaque wifatanyije n’abaturage b’imidugudu nyarurembo karutete yagize ishavu ry’abanyarwanda ritubere umusingi kwiyubaka aha niyonsaba yungaga nsanganyamatsiko yahariwe mwaka igira iti twigire mateka turusheho kubaka ejo hazaza niyonsaba yaboneyeho akanya kunenga politike yazanywe n’abazungu gushyamiranya abantu yatunze agatoki ababiligi baje rwanda bagasanga abanyarwanda babanye neza bagasiga barukongeje n’ikintu kigaragara barusigiye umuyobozi w’umurenge bwishyura yagize urugero nk’aha kibuye basize bubatse gereza yonyine nk’aho abanyakibuye bakeneye hatanzwe ubuhamya bw’umwe bacitse icumu kibuye mukangoga emelita ufite imyaka gusa igihe jenoside yabaga yari afite ikiniga kinshi ariko yabashije kuvuga make byamugendekeye yabisobanuye magambo ikintu ntazigera nibagirwa igihe papa yampamagaye arangije guteka inkono y’ibijumba nituze aduhe ifunguro nyuma namubajije impamvu atubwiye atyo ambwira bagiye kutwica kuva bahise badutera turatatanangenda nomongana ntazi ngana hashize akanya gato mbona iwacu barahatwitse narinihishe mbona interahamwe zizanye papa kumwe murumuna papa afite bibiliya barayimwaka barayica amanika amaboko hejuru agira mana bantu ubababarire ntibazi barimo gukora ako kanya bahita bamutema amaboko murumuna babatsinda ahonanjye bashatse kunyica inshuro nyinshi buryo nageze mera nk’ikinya nkajya mbabwira nabi nti nimukore mushakaibyambayeho birebire mbivuze bwakwira bugacyagusa ndashimira imana nkiriho nk’uko mukangoga yakomeje abitangamo ubuhamya mukangoga emelita yasigaye wenyine muryango w’abana nyina bamwishe atwite inda cyenda se n’abavandimwe barabamaze ubu umubyeyi w’abana babili umuhungu w’imyaka n’imfura y’umukobwa w’imyaka ubura umwaka umwe angane mama igihe jenoside yabaga nyuma y’ubuhamya mukangoga hatanzwe n’ikiganiro ruhare leta yagize jenoside umwe bacitse icumu watanze ikiganiro yasobanuye ukuntu abatutsi kibuye kimwe n’ahandi hose rwanda bagiye bahezwa gahunda leta y’icyo gihe umuntu akabaho atazi bucya kugeza igihe jenoside ibereye n’uwo bitaga inshuti n’umuturanyi arabahinduka umuhango wabimburiwe n’urugendo rwahereye rwibutso jenoside ruri iruhande rw’ahahoze sitade gatwaro mujyi kibuye kugera mudugudu nyarurembo ahabereye ibiganiro gukurikira ijambo ry’umukuru w’igihugu yahariye munsi radiyo televiziyo abari babashije gukusanya amafaranga ibihumbi gutera inkunga abacitse icumu mu rwego rw’akarere gutangiza icyunamo byabereye murenge mubuga umuyobozi w’akarere karongi kayumba bernard n’abandi bayobozi bagiye kwifatanya n’abandi kwibuka nshuro jenoside yakorewe abatutsi gasana marcellin

title: umukinnyi w’umunyafurika rutonde rumwe messi cristiano yatorewe kuba perezida
content: nyuma gutsindwa inshuro ebyiri matora y’umukuru w’igihugu cye liberia george weah umukinnyi w’umupira w’amaguru waciye agahigo katarabasha kugerwaho n’undi munyafurika yabashije noneho kwegukana intsinzi asimbura ellen jonhson sirleaf usanzwe ayobora gihugu george weah w’imyaka y’amavuko yamenyekanye nk’umukinnyi w’igihangange mateka y’umupira w’amaguru afurika mwaka w’ yegukanaga umupira zahabu ballon d’or bivuga rutonde rw’ibihangange cristiano ronaldo lionel messi zinedine zidane luis figo kaka ronaldinho n’abandi batari benshi babashije gukora mateka george weah wahagaritse iby’umupira w’amaguru akajya politiki yatwaye ballon d’or nk’umukinnyi w’umwaka isi yakinaga ac milan butaliyani hari mwaka w’ yanagiye aca uduhigo afurika kuko yagiye ahabwa igihembo cy’umukinnyi w’umwaka mugabane afurika mu mwaka w’ yahawe igihembo cy’umukinnyi w’ikinyejana afurika mu mwaka yashyizwe n’icyamamare pel rutonde rw’abakinnyi b’umupira w’amaguru b’ibihangange kurusha abandi isi bakiriho george weah yatangiriye umupira w’amaguru gihugu cye liberia ariko aza gukomereza i burayi yamaze imyaka akinira amakipe atandukanye bufaransa butaliyani bwongereza arsene wenger usigaye atoza arsenal niwe wamujyanye i burayi amusinyisha amasezerano ikipe monaco yatozaga gihe mu yagiye paris saint germain ayifasha gutwara igikombe shampiyona mu mikino y’amakipe yabaye mbere iwayo azwi uefa champions league mwaka w’imikino w’ george weah niwe warangije rutahizamu ufite ibitego byinshi ahita anaterwa imboni n’ikipe ac milan yahise imugura agahita atwara ballon d’or yamaze kipe imyaka ine yubakiramo amateka akomeye mupira w’amaguru yatwaye inshuro ebyeri igikombe shampiyona butaliyani kumwe ac milan ahita yerekeza bwongereza yakiniye chelsea manchester city hanyuma aza gusubira bufaransa akinira marseille aza kurangiriza umupira w’amaguru al-jazira hari uyu mugabo kandi yafashije igihugu cye kugera mikino nyuma y’igikombe cy’afurika can inshuro ebyiri muri george weah yiyamamarije umwanya perezida aratsindwa ariko akomeza kugaragaza imbaraga gushaka kwinjira cyane politiki hamwe n’ishyaka ayobora riharanira impinduka demokarasi congress for democratic change party george weah yatorewe kujya sena leberia ndetse yiyamamaje asanzwe n’ubundi umusenateri gihugu cye liberia

title: abayobora ibitaro baravuga impinduka serivisi gutwara amaraso hakoreshejwe drones
content: nyuma y’uko leta y’u rwanda itangije uburyo kugeza amaraso bitaro biri hirya hino gihugu hakoreshejwe indege nto zitagira abapilote gutwara amaraso zizwi drones bamwe bayobozi b’ibitaro by’umwihariko ntara y’amajyepfo baravuga gahunda ibafasha cyane gutwara amaraso bikagabanya n’igiciro cy’amafaranga yakoreshwaga serivisi kugeza amaraso bitaro nyuma y’uko leta y’u rwanda itangije ibafasha cyane gutwara amaraso bikagabanya n’igiciro cy’amafaranga yakoreshwaga serivisi kugeza amaraso bitaro ubuyobozi bw’ibitaro kabgayi biri karere muhanga n’ubw’ibitaro ruhango biri karere ruhango hose ntara y’amajyepfo buravuga gahunda gutwara amaraso hifashishijwe drone yihutisha uburyo kubona amaraso ndetse byagabanyije ikiguzi cyagendaga maraso dr nteziryayo philippe uyobora ibitaro kabgayi yavuze gihe cy’iminota gusa amaraso ashobora kuba abagezeho ikindi kandi byagabanyije uburyo bw’amafaranga yakoreshwaga i muhanga bagera i kigali kuzana maraso bakoreshaga imodoka irimo umushoferi n’umuganga laboratwari umuherekeza yagize iyo dukoze komande iminota amaraso aje ariko igihe bibaye ngombwa ubundi bagenda bayazana tukayabika hano impinduka igihe kubona amaraso cyaragabanutse urumva twavaga hano tukajya kuzana amaraso i kigali dukoresheje imodoka n’ujya kuyazana kandi hano ugera i kigali harimo urugendo rw’isaha irenga ukava hano ukagaruka urumva umwanya byatwaraga yakomeje agira ikindi twabitse n’amafaranga kuko imodoka yagendaga tukishyura lisansi imodoka ntigenda yonyine ijyana n’umushoferi ikanajyana mukozi laboratwari byose amafaranga nk’ibitaro tubika ikindi kandi mukozi yagiye yakoraga hasigara hari ubusa akazi kagapfa uburyo dushimira leta yacu iyobowe nyakubahwa perezida kagame ufasha abanyarwanda buryo bugaragara dr usabyineza richard uyobora ibitaro ruhango biri karere ruhango yavuze bakoraga urugendo kujya kuzana amaraso i kigali byabagora gihe bakeneye amaraso buryo bwihutirwa ariko bakaba bahita bayabona gihe kitageze minota bayakeneye tariki ukwakira nibwo perezida repubulika y’u rwanda paul kagame yamuritse mugaragaro utu tudege avuga u rwanda ruzi imbaraga ikoranabuhanga rifite guhindura imibereho myiza n’iterambere igihugu cyahisemo izi ndege zitagira pilote zizwi drones ifite ubushobozi gutwara ikiro kimwe n’igice cy’amaraso bivugwa iminota zikoresha i kigali kagera i muhanga ibaye myinshi itagera aha kuwa ukwakira perezida kagame atangiza mugaragaro ikoreshwa ry’izi ndege nto ’drones’ gutwara amarasoifotoububiko

title: indege air france yajyanye abantu banduye coronavirus ’cameroun’ yakuruye impaka
content: kuri kabiri tariki werurwe indege air france yageze i douala umurwa mukuru w’ubukungu kameruni yateje impaka zikomeye kibuga cy’indege mpuzamahanga douala kubera abantu bayirimo banduye coronavirus iyi ndege yateje ubwoba gihugu afurika hagati kubera abanyakameruni batinya bagenzi kameruni ndetse bamwe bafaransa bayijemo banduye ndwara coronavirus iteje akaga kandi yahungabanije ibikorwa by’ubukungu isi ikanahitana ibihumbi n’ibihumbi by’abantu cyane cyane bushinwa virusi yatangiriye abarenga kimwe kabiri cy’abo bagenzi bapimiwe kibuga cy’indege basanze baranduye bituma abantu benshi bemeza bishobora guhagarika igihugu nyuma kumva ikibazo kiri i douala guverinoma yaound ifite ingufu nke kandi guhomba yategetse gusa ndege gusubiza mizigo y’abanduye i paris ariko abakozi bayo bavuga roissy charles de gaulle ifunzwe bitashoboka kuzana imizigo y’abantu banduye bufaransa ndetse n’abafaransa baje ndege batangaje badashobora gusubira bufaransa kubera virusi yuzuye bufaransa hose gushakisha yahitana ibi bintu byasabye guverineri littoral yabigiramo uruhare yahise agera kibuga cy’indege kugira abashe kubyitaho abagenzi n’abakozi air france bashyizwe kato hoteri yaho i douala isi ntirabona umubare munini wabantu banduye ndege kameruni buri gihe itanga urugero ndetse mubihe bibi abagenzi ndege ntibagombaga kuza i douala kuko basanzwe bagaragaza ibimenyetso by’iyi indwara coronavirus yica mbere yuko binjira ndege i paris ku kibuga cy’indege mpuzamahanga douala habaye urujijo rwose kuko abagenzi banduye basabwe gusubira i paris banduriye virusi idashakwa hano gihugu birakekwa abagenzi ndege banduriye icyorezo coronavirus burayi umwe bayobozi kibuga cy’indege douala wahisemo kutamenyekana yabwiye itsinda concord news group kameruni air france yarangije kwica abanyakameruni yongeraho abanyakameruni benshi vuba bagiye kwerekeza mva hakiri kare kubera ikosa ritababarirwa ryakozwe mukuzana imizigo nkiyi idashakwa mugihugu kugira ikibuga cy’indege kigarure ituze guverineri littoral yamenyesheje abagenzi kubera ibibazo byinshi coronavirus abari ndege bazashyirwa gereza kugira barusheho gusuzumwa gukurikiranwa ariko abanyakameruni basanzwe babura ibitotsi kuko bazi ibintu bikora mugihugu cyabo gahunda z’ubugenzuzi z’igihugu zisiga byinshi byifuzwa kandi urebye urwego ruswa gihugu bamwe bagenzi bashobora gutanga ruswa kugira bave bigo by’akato ati mu mujyi gihugu hari ubwoba bwinshi aba bagenzi air france banyangirije umunsi nabonye imbaga y’abantu banduye televiziyo sinari nzi igihugu cyanjye kizakira bamwe hano kameruni ibi bikaba byavuzwe concord news group mu gihugu hose hari igitutu cyinshi kandi amakuru y’aba bahageze yatumye ibintu birushaho kuba bibi abantu benshi barateganya guhungira midugudu kuko virusi ikwira mijyi

title: ubucuruzi u rwanda rwahaye uburenganzira ikigo mbere afurika y’epfo rukoreramo
content: ikigo kigenzura isoko ry’imari n’imigabane ry’u rwanda cma cyahaye uburenganzira nshuro mbere ikigo cy’ubucuruzi afurika y’epfo cyitwa rh bophelo limited kuza isoko ry’imari ry’u rwanda kikazaba aricyo kigo mbere kije isoko ry’u rwanda kivuye hanze y’akarere k’afurika y’iburasirazuba kandi kizongera umubare w’ibigo biri soko bibe icyenda ikigo rh bophelo cyanditswe nk’ikigo cy’ubucuruzi afurika y’epfo kandi cyagiye isoko ry’imari n’imigabane johannesburg nyakanga kigo gikora ibijyanye n’ishoramari bikorwa by’ubuvuzi kugeza ubuvuzi benshi rh bophelo kandi ikurikira cyane ahava inyungu kandi yibanda mikoranire n’abafatanyabikorwa batandukanye ariko inita kuba serivisi z’ubuzima zatangwa buryo bunoze umuyobozi mukuru w’agateganyo w’ikigo kigenzura isoko ry’imari n’imigabane rwanda eric bundugu avuga kuza isoko ry’imari n’imigabane rh bophelo yagize uku kuza isoko kw’iki kigo rh bophelo intambwe ikomeye kurushaho gushyira u rwanda isonga karere rwego mpuzamahanga nk’ahantu waca ushaka imari kwagura ibikorwa bitandukanye bibyara inyungu kuza isoko ry’u rwanda rh bophelo birerekana u rwanda rukomeje kuza isonga nk’ahantu hizewe ho gushora imari ndetse hizewe gukorerwa ubucuruzi bwambukiranya imipaka

title: amashyaka rud urunana rnc yashyizwe majwi kugira indiri uganda
content: u rwanda rurasaba uganda gusenya indiri z’amashyaka rnc rud urunana uganda ikavuga hari abaturage bayo bafungiwe rwanda binyuranije n’amategeko ni nama gatatu komisiyo gusuzuma ishyirwa bikorwa ry’amasezerano luanda agamije kugarura umubano hagati y’u rwanda uganda yabereye i kigali gatanu taliki gashyantare muri biganirointumwa z’ibihugu byombi zagaragaje ibikoma nkokora umubano wabyo uganda izana ikibazo gishya cy’abagande bafungiye rwanda buryo bunyuranije n’amategeko umunyamabanga leta minisiteri y’ububanyi n’amahanga amb olivier nduhungirehe uyoboye itsinda ry’u rwanda yagarutse mitwe y’iterabwoba ifite indiri uganda iyo mitwe igamije guhungabanya umutekano w’u rwanda irimo rnc rud-urunana u rwanda rukaba rusaba uganda guhagarika ibikorwa gushyigikira mitwe ndetse igafatira ibihano abayobozi nzego z’icyo gihugu bakomeje kuyitera inkunga nduhungirehe yavuze u rwanda rusaba uganda gusenya ibikorwa rnc rud urunana ugandagufata ndetse ikohereza rwanda abarwanyi bateye kinigi bahungiye butaka bwayo mu bindi u rwanda rusaba uganda harimo guhagarika pasiporo uganda no a yahawe charlotte mukankusi usanzwe komiseri rnc ushinzwe dipolomasi imufasha kugenda yamamaza amatwara rnc ikindi ugukurikirana abantu bakorana rnc rud urunana barimo umunyamabanga leta philemon mateke brig gen abel kandiho uyobora cmi brig gen fred karara col sike asiimwe major fred mushambo col kaka bagyenda n’abandi bayobozi bagira uruhare bikorwa kohereza rwanda umubiri samuel mageza gutanga ibisobanuro rupfu rwe kimwe n’abandi banyarwanda babiri sendegeya theogene rwembo mucyo boherejwe bitaro butabika bavanwe cmi nyuma bakaza kuburirwa irengero ikindi ukwemerera umunyarwandakazi julienne kayirere kongera guhura n’umwana joanna imanirakiza umaze ukwezi kumwe nyuma kubatandukanyiriza uganda yafatwaga ugushyingo karere mubende nduhungirehe yasoje asaba uganda kurekura mananiza abanyarwanda bafungiwe uganda buryo bunyuranyije n’amategeko leta y’u rwanda yongeye gushimangira igisubizo bibazo biri mubano w’ibihugu byombi bitazava nama nyinshi zikorwa gihe uganda bushake igaragaza guhagarika imigambi mibisha rwanda n’abanyarwanda batuye n’abagenda gihugu ku ruhande uganda minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga uganda sam kutesayavuze ntangiriro z’uyu mwaka barekuye abanyarwanda bafungiwe uganda ndetse n’abandi bafunzwe bagiye kugezwa imbere y’ubutabera kutesa agasaba u rwanda kurekura abanya uganda rufunze buryo budakurikije amategeko ibi birego byahise biterwa utwatsi amb olivier nduhungirehe uyoboye intumwa z’u rwanda biganiro washinje uganda kuyobya uburari kibazo ambnduhungirehe olivier yavuze abanya uganda maboko y’ubutabera bw’u rwanda nyuma gukatirwa n’inkiko kandi abadipolomate uganda n’abandi babyifuza bakaba bemerewe kubasura nkomyi nduhungirehe yagaragaje kandi amasezerano luanda yashyirwaho umukono abanya-uganda maboko y’ubutabera barekuwe nyuma kuburanishwa n’inkiko biteganyijwe tariki z’uku kwezi abakuru bine bazahurira mupaka gatuna karegeya omar

title: inguzanyo z’amahanga k’u rwanda nkeya ugereranyije uganda- umulisa rwakunda
