title: abarokotse jenoside bafite ibibazo by’ ubuzima mutwe’
content: ikigero cy’ agahinda gakabije rwanda kiri rusange ariko barokotse jenoside yakorewe abatutsi by’ umwihariko kigero kiri ikigero cy’ agahinda gakabije rwanda kiri rusange ariko barokotse jenoside yakorewe abatutsi by’ umwihariko kigero kiri inzobere kuvura indwara mutwe akaba n’umuyobozi w’agashami gashinzwe ubuvuzi mutwe kigo cy’igihugu cy’ubuzima rbc dr jean damascne iyamuremye yatangaje abantu umwaka ushize bagiye bitaro leta kwivuza indwara mutwe muri ikigo rbc gifatanije n’ abarimo kaminuza y’ u rwanda n’ urwego rw’ ubutabera bakoze inyigo igamije kumenya ubuzima mutwe buhagaze ni inyigo yakorewe bantu ibihumbi barimo barokotse jenoside dr iyamuremye amurika ibyavuye nyigo yavuze basanze agahinda gakabije banyarwanda kari barokotse jenoside yakorewe abatutsi dr iyamuremye jean damascene dr iyamuremye yavuze abashakashatsi basanze ababajijwe bazi serivise zita buzima mutwe zihari ariko bake muribo nibo bafite ubushake kuzigana yakomeje agira nubwo hakenewe ubushakashatsi kugira hamenyekane impamvu zituma abarwayi batitabira kwivuza zimwe muzo abashakashatsi babonye akato ubumenyi buke butuma badafata ikibazo mutwe nk’ indwara hakaba n’ abafite imyizerere y’ bene ndwara zivurwa n’ abapfumu the new times yatangaje dr iyamuremye yavuze bitera abanyarwanda ibibazo mutwe hivaids ariko hari n’ izindi mpamvu zirimo n’ ubukene u rwanda rufite inzobere mitekerereze muntu n’ abandi kuminuza ibijyanye n’ ubuzima mutwe ishami ry’ umuryango w’ abibumbye ryita buzima oms rivuga umuganga umwe mutwe yita bantu ndetse by’ ibihugu bigize isi igitanda kimwe bitaro bivura ndwara kiba kigenewe abantu magingo ibihugu birenga ntibifite politiki guhangana n’ ibibazo mutwe ibirenga ntibifite gahunda kwita buzima mutwe

title: uri umukobwa mwiza ariko ntago abahungu bakwiyumvamo ese waba uzi ikibura ukundwe nk’abandi dore inama zagufasha kugira
content: buriya abantu benshi bagira bahitamo cyane kubijyanye n’uwo bakwiye gukunda cyangwa babana usanga abahungu bajya guhitamo inshuti bakareba isura y’umuntu uburyo yambara akomoka ndetse n’uburyo agaragara ariko muby’ukuri uzaba wibeshye cyane nujya guhitamo umukobwa mukundana ukagendera twavuze haruguru guhitamo inshuti muzarambana hano twabateguriye inama zagufasha umukobwa kugirango umuhungu wese ukubonye yumve yifuje kukgira inshuti iyiteho ndakeka umuntu wese uzakubona wikozeho mbese wafashe neza umubiri wawe ukagerageza kwisiga amavuta meza ruhu rwawe ndetse n’imibavu burya ingenzi kuko biri bizatuma umuhungu ukubona yumva umukobwa ugira isuku y’umubiri kandi wiyitaho bityo akururwe n’uko kwiyitaho kwawe imico myiza burya ntago byiza cyane mukobwa kwitwara yishakiye kuko burya urebye mumuco cyangwa ugasoma ibyanditswe byose usanga umukobwa witwaye neza ntawe utamwifuza kandi n’inshingano z’umukobwa wese kuko n’imana yafashe umukobwa imuha inshingano kubaha igitsina gabo kuko umugore yabaye ho kubera umugabo n’urangwa n’imyitwarire myiza uzakundwa ntakabuza isuku aha kugira isuku inshingano buri kiremwa muntu ariko mukobwa ho biba akarusho kuko akenshi usanga umukobwa n’umuhungu batameze kimwe buryo bw’imiterere wenda twavuga uburyo umukobwa atuye bimusaba kugira isuku cyane kurenza umuhungu umukobwa urangwa n’isuku ndakeka muhungu n’umwe uzagushidikanya ho kwambara neza twagihuza n’isuku cyangwa se kwambara neza bikunganira kugira isuku gusa burya abahanga baravuga uwambaye neza agaragara neza birumvikana niwambara neza ntakabuza uzagaragara neza kandi uzanakundwa by akayezu snappy

title: abahembwe gahunda bk urumuri initiative bishimiye iterambere bamaze kugeraho
content: iyi gahunda yiswe bk urumuri initiative yatangijwe tariki werurwe gahunda kwizihiza imyaka banki imaze itangiye gukora ubwo yatangizaga gahunda umuyobozi mukuru bk dr diane karusisi yavuze ikigamijwe ukureba abafite ibitekerezo bizima bishobora kuvamo ubucuruzi bukomeye bihe biri imbere ati iyo turebye imyaka imbere twibazaga twafasha abakiri bato kugira ejo hazaza bagire ubucuruzi bukomeye kandi bakoresha ikoranabuhanga twabonaga natwe tugomba kubigiramo uruhare kuko natwe bizatugiraho ingaruka muri gahunda abatoranywa bahabwa amahugurwa bufatanye n’ikigo inkomoko gisanzwe gihugura rwiyemezamirimo abahembwa bavuga imyato bk umuyobozi akaba washinze zima entreprise ikora ibintu bitandukanye nzuzi z’ibihaza mukagahima marie ange avuga urumuri initiative’ yamugiriye akamaro uhereye mahugurwa bahawe n’inguzanyo bahawe buryo ibikorwa bye byagutse yabwiye igihe ikigo cyacu cyongerera agaciro ibihaza dukora amavuta nzuzi y’ibihaza n’ibisuguti byabyo gihembo cyadufashije mbere y’uko tukibona hari tutari dufite nk’iyo fu y’ibihaza make byaratugoraga cyane kuyibona tuboneye nkunga twashoboye kugura utumashini dutoya tudufasha kuyumisha tukabasha gukora ibisuguti neza yakomeje agira icyerekezo dufite ukwagura amasoko tukagera gihugu cyose nubwo n’ubu tugera henshi make bk yatubereye ikiraro cy’aho turi munsi uwizeye josue uyobora ikigo josh innovation gikora ibicanwa bitangiza ibidukikije yashimangiye inguzanyo yahawe bk yatumye ashobora kwagura ibikorwa bye ndetse birushaho kumenyekana uwizeye avuga batangiye gukora drones ariko bakaba bibanda cyane bushakashatsi yagize mu minsi vuba leta yavuze igiye gushyiraho ikigo kiteranya drones kuzigurutsa twe turi ikigo mbere kigurutsa drones turimo gukorana n’abafatanyabikorwa mafaranga bk yatumye nshobora kugira umufatanyabikorwa buryo ndakeka biri ahantu heza agaragaza nubwo habaye ikibazo cy’amafaranga yaratumyeho ibikoresho bushinwa ntibize kubera icyorezo kiriyo coronavirus akeka title: muri bihe hari abakozi batemerewe kujyana imodoka kazi kubera ubwinshi bwazo
content: abakorera ibigo bitandukanye bitanga serivisi z’ibanze zikenewe bihe baributswa polisi y’u rwanda bagomba kugenda modoka rusange bajya cyangwa bava kazi uzafatwa yatwaye imodoka azahanwa bikomeye cp kabera yibukije abaturarwanda gahunda kuguma rugo ikomeje kugeza tariki ibi bimwe bikubiye butumwa umuvugizi polisi y’u rwanda cp john bosco kabera yagejeje banyarwanda makuru televisiyo rwanda mata cp kabera yibukije abaturarwanda gahunda kuguma rugo ikomeje kugeza tariki nkuko biherutse kwemezwa n’inama idasanzwe y’abaminisitiri yateranye mpera z’iki cyumweru avuga bijyanye n’abakozi bajya kazi bihe yagize ibigo bifite abakozi benshi nk’amabanki ibigo by’itumanaho cyangwa amasosiyete y’itumanaho n’ibindi bigo bifite abakozi benshi byemerewe gukora akazi nkuko bigaragara mabwiriza abakozi babyo bagomba kugenda modoka rusange hubahirizwa intera hagati cyangwa intambwe hagati urugero niba imodoka isanzwe itwara abantu igomba gutwara abantu abakozi b’ibi bigo bazongera kugaragara batwara ibinyabiziga byabo bazafatwa bahanwe buryo bukomeye imodoka ntoya nukuvuga amavatiri kamyoneti cyangwa amajipe z’abantu giti cyabo ntizigomba gutwara abantu barenze babiri gihe bibaye ngombwa urugero bagiye guhaha kubikuza n’izindi serivisi ngombwa amakamyoneti n’amakamyo agemura ibiribwa cyangwa ibindi bintu ngombwa ntagomba kurenza abantu babiri nukuvuga umushoferi komvuwayeri convoyeur yongeyeho hari ibigo byabwiwe abakozi babyo batajyana imodoka zabo kazi kubera ubwinshi bwazo yakomeje avuga polisi yihanangiriza abantu bafite umuco kuyibeshya bagiye gukora ingendo ngombwa abagisengera matsinda abasurana zabo abishyira hamwe bagashaka uburyo banywa inzoga abakorera siporo hanze bazakomeza gufatwa bagafungwa bagacibwa amande ndetse abafite ibinyabiziga bigafatirwa kugeza igihe gahunda kurwanya icyorezo coronavus irangiriye polisi kandi irashimira abaturarwanda bagize gahunda iyabo cyane cyane abakangurira bagenzi kuguma rugo abatanga amakuru bayaha polisi kazi kayo buri munsi uburyo batanga amakuru y’abantu barenga mabwiriza kandi dushishikariza abantu mabwiriza bayagira ayabo abaturarwanda bakaba bagirwa inama gukora gahunda y’icyumweru serivisi bakeneye bagasohoka bakazibonera icyarimwe bityo bikabarinda gusohoka zabo buri munsi yasoje butumwa agira turabibutsa kwirinda coronavirusi ur’ukuyirinda abawe ndetse n’abaturarwanda rusange title: hagiye gushyirwaho amakusanyirizo agena igiciro kimwe birayi
content: ministeri y’ubucuruzi n’inganda iravuga hagomba gushyirwaho amakusanyirizo y’ibirayi hirya hino buryo igiciro cy’ibirayi kizajya kiba kimwe gihugu hose uyu umwanzuru watangejwe nyuma y’biganiro byagarutse kungorane abahinzi bahura nazo mwuga wabo birimo kugura imbuto bahenzwe bagatanga umusaruro kugiciro hasi gukomwa nkokora n’ibihe by’imvura umusaruro ukabora n’ibindi ni ibiganiro byahuje minisiteri y’ubucuruzi n’inganda n’abahinzi abacuruzi ndetse n’abikorera giti cyabo hagamijwe gukemura bibazo ndetse n’akavuyo kaboneka bucuruzi bw’ibirayi bigatera ibihombo hashize igihe abahinzi b’ibirayi binubira abacuruzi bagurira giciro hasi kandi baraguze imbuto ibahenze bigatuma bucuruzi bukorwa buryo bw’akajagari bikabatera igihombo muhawenimana philippe umuhinzi karere burera avuga hari abacuruzi bajya kurangura ibirayi bice by’ibyaro bakishyura giciro cyohasi kuko abahinzi bashaka kwikuraho umusaruro utababorana bakabyemera ati abacuruzi b’ibirayi baraza bakaduhenda kubera giciro gihamye kiro cy’ibirayi bigatuma duhomba kandi natwe ntabwo twagumana umusaruro kuko wabora yanongeyeho hari iminzani bacuruzi bakoresha itujuje ubuziranenge ituma bibwa ibiro bagakorera gihombo murebwayire christine umuyobozi uhagarariye abahinzi n’aborozi rwanda rwego rw’abikorera yemeza uretse amakusanyirizo y’ibirayi gukorera mashyirahamwebigiye gukemura bazo bajyaga bahura nabyo bibahombya nyamara leta ishimangira kibazo cy’iminzani yazanye iyujuje ubuziranenge buryo bice byose ariyo ikoreshwa minisiteri w’ubucuruzi n’inganda franois kanimba yamaze impungenge bacuruzi abahinzi ndetse n’abagura ibirayi kugirango birinde kugwa gihombo ati leta igiye gushyiraho amakusanyirizo y’ibirayi gihugu ndetse rwego rw’igihugu buryo igiciro kizajya cyiba kimwe mwero w’ibirayi yongeraho ngamba gushyiraho makusanyirizo bizafasha abacuruzi n’abahinzi b’ibirayi guhangana n’ikibazo cyabazamura ibiciro biboneye ikindi kandi bizatuma umusaruro w’iyongera habeho kwihaza biribwa gusagurira amasoko ku biciro abitabiriye biganiro bumvikanye umuhinzi yajya agurirwa nibura mafaranga kilo makusanyirizo turere ikusanyirizo ry’i kigali rikabagurira kilo ariko bikaba iby’agateganyo ibi biganiro byanzuye umugabane nshingiro kujya ihuriro rikusanya ibirayi ibihumbi ukaguramo imigabane bingana miliyoni eshatu ariko ugatanga kimwe cumi andi ukaba wayishyura myaka ibiri

title: rubavu ku munsi bakenera m ibihumbi z’amazi meza bakabona m ibihumbi gusa
content: akarere rubavu gahereye ntara y’iburengerazuba kagizwe n’imirenge mirenge kubona amazi meza biragoranye yewe n’imirenge gice cy’umujyi kubona amazi meza ikibazo buryo bituma habaho isaranganya akarere rubavu gahereye ntara y’iburengerazuba kagizwe n’imirenge mirenge kubona amazi meza biragoranye yewe n’imirenge gice cy’umujyi kubona amazi meza ikibazo buryo bituma habaho isaranganya umurenge rubavu umwe mirenge ifite ikibazo kubura amazi kagali mbugangari babona amazi inshuro cyumweru cyangwa ntanaboneke dusingizimbana zacharie umuyobozi w’ishuri ryitwa ubumwe community center riherereye kagali mbugangari rifasha abafite ubumuga avuga bagorwa n’ibura ry’amazi bigasaba rimwe rimwe bayagura giciro gihanitse yagizeati ubusanzwe aka karere rubavu amazi ikibazo cy’ingutu kuko ahari ntahagije bisaba habaho isaranganya bigatuma twe hano mbugangari tuyabona inshuro cyumweru ariko hari igihe n’ibyumweru bishobora gushira tutayabonye twerero nk’ishuri twagerageje kugura ibigega tukajya dufata amazi y’imvura ndetse n’ibifata amazi wasac ariko hari igihe mazi ashirira rimwe nko gihe cy’izuba kandi abanyeshuri bakeneye kujya gukorerwa isuku biga mashuri bwiherero n’ahandi iyotwayabuze biraduhenda cyane kuko munsi bidusaba kugura amazi y’ibihumbi frw urumva bibaye icyumweru cyangwa ibyumweru biba ikibazo iki kigega nicyo gishyirwamo amazi abanyeshyuri banywa amazi yabuze bisaba kuyagura ndetse kuyateka bigahenda cyane akomeza agira ati’’ urumva abuze nibura tugura ibyumweru tugura amazi y’ibihumbi frw urumva ibintu uba utarateganyije ngengo y’imari hari ibipfa kuko waguze amazi kandi utagombaga kuyagura ukongeraho n’imiti tugura gushyira bijyega bifata amazi y’imvura bikaduhenda cyane hari igihe bidusaba kuyateka kuko abana bakeneye amazi kunywa dusingizimbana zacharie umuyobozi w’ishuri ryitwa ubumwe community center avuga babuze amazi bagura ay’ibihumbi frw munsi nubwo amazi ikibazo karere rubavu ariko wasac ivuga kwezi kamena kibazo cy’amazi meza kizaba amateka nsabimana edison umuyobozi w’umusigire wasac asobanura kibazo cy’amazi meza kirimo kuvugutirwa umuti vuba bwangu yagize muri rubavu amazi meza kibazo kuko dufite ntahagije abaturage dufite kuko dufite amazi angana m buri munsi kandi dukeneye nibura angana m buri munsi bituma hari imirenge mwe iburamo amazi nyamyumba rubavu rugerero buryo bisaba gusaranganya amazi bamwe bakayabona inshuro cyumweru bwobigoranye akomeza avuga uruganda gihira bakuraho amazi rumaze imyaka isaga ru kora kandi umujyi rubavu ukaba warakuze ndetse n’abaturage bariyongereye ariko hari ingamba zafashwe atiumushyinga kubaka uruganda rushya gihira n’urwari rusanzweho byose hamwe bizata angana m ubusanzwe twakeneraga murumva tuzajya tuba dufite ibihumbi m twizigamye hari ahantu byagoranaga kugeza amazi mbungangari kubera imiterere yaho iteye ariko uruganda nirumara kuzura tuzashyirayo imiyoboro minini ndetse n’ibigega buryo twizera ikibazo kigiye gukemuka vuba cyane ishuri ry’ubumwe community center rifasha abanyeshuri bafite ubumuga butandukanye rikabigisha imyuga n’ubukorikori umuziki rifata abana mwaka umwe rikabarifite n’amashuri kibura mwaka kugeza mashuri y’isimbuye rifite abanyeshuri barenga ndetse bufatanye n’ibindi bigo biri karere rubavu rikaba rireberera abandi basaga nabo bafite ubumuga hamwe bakaba bigira ubuntu uretse abandi banyeshuri bahiga badafite ubumuga biga biyishyurira ishuri ry’ubumwe community center rifasha abanyeshuri bafite ubumuga butandukanye rikabigisha imyuga n’ubukorikori n’umuziki

title: ububiko bw’amateka ha mbere ingoma ngabe rukombamazi
content: muri gice tugiye kubatekerereza bimwe bimenyetso ndangamateka bigaragaza imiterere tumwe turere tw’u rwanda ha mbere rutaraturwa rube insinsiro zisakayemo abantu aha akaba bimenyetso bitugaragariza ubugenge n’ubuhanga bw’abakurambere mpangarwanda bakoresheje kugira batunganye uru rwanda rube igihugu cyujuje ibyangombwa bibasha gukenerwa n’abarutuye nkuko tubikesha igitabo ’’imizi y’u rwanda’’ n’igitabo ’’ intwari z’imbanza zubatse u rwanda rugahamya igitinyiro’’ byombi dukesha umwanditsi n’umusizi nsanzabera jean de dieu tugiye gutekerereza hamwe amateka y’ingoma ngabe rukombabazi yahoze ingoma ngabe y’igihugu cy’u bugesera bihe ha mbere yabaye ikimenyetso kibitse amateka akomeye agaragaza imiterere y’igihugu cy’u bugesera mbere y’uko gihangwamo igihugu n’ikimenyetso kigaragaza bene uburyo bakuturanyije bakagitunganya kikaba igihugu kikanje ubu butaka butaraba igihugu cy’u bugesera bwari igihugu cy’imigina n’ibishanga by’imifunzo by’amasanzure y’akanyaru n’akagera mu bihe ha mbere igihugu cy’u bugesera cyari hagati y’ingoma nduga byatandukanywaga n’uruzi rw’akanyaru burengherazuba majyepfo hakaba ingoma y’u burundi burasirazuba hari ingoma y’i gisaka cy’abazirankende kikagabanywa nabwo n’ikiyaga mugesera kitiriwe mugesera muzirankende umwe bakurambere b’abagesera bahanze ingoma y’i gisaka majyaruguru hari ingoma y’u bwanacyambwe bw’abongera bwagabanwaga n’u bugesera n’uruzi nyabarongo ni ubutaka bwari buvangavanze n’amazi akomoka nzuzi z’akanyaru nyabarongo byakubitiraho n’imisozi y’imirambi gutandukanya amazi n’ubutaka bikaba byagorana byatumye abami b’ibihugu byituranye n’ubwo butaka badashishikazwa kuhagurira ibihugu byabo hakomeza kuba igisigara kigari cyabaye nk’ikidaturwa kubera amazi menshi yarangwaga ako karere atabasha gutandukanywa n’ubutaka bushobora guturwaho hashize imyaka myinshi gihugu kimwe gitekereza kuzahatuza abaturage bacyo iyagurabihugu ryakorwaga buryo kwimura imbago ahasaga mwaka abanyiginya isibaniro ryo kwagura ubutaka bw’agahugu gato gasabo bamaze guhanga nibwo gihanga wagenganga ingoma y’i gasabo murage yahaye abana yafashe umwe amuraga gisigara cy’ubutaka ibindi bihugu byari byaranze agihangemo igihugu nuko gihanga afata umwe bana kanyabugesera mugondo yabyaranye nyamususa jeni rurenge amuraga gisigara cy’ubutaka bwari hagati y’ingoma y’i gisaka cy’abazirankende nduga y’ababanda u burundi ndetse n’u bwanacyambwe agende abuhangemo igihugu cy’igihangange kizafasha ingoma nkuru y’i gasabo gutangatanga ibihugu by’abasangwabutaka mugambi w’igihe kirekire kubihuza bikaba igihugu kimwe nuko kanyabugesera mugondo mwene gihanga aragenda akoresha ubuhanga buhambaye agomorora amazi atwikiriye butaka ayaha inzira buri ayoboka inzira karemano y’aho agomba kwerekeza muri bihe nibwo amazi y’akanyaru yamenaga cyogogo rwabusoro n’ubutaka buhegereye yayahaye inzira yihariye aragenda ahura nyabarongo nayo yasandaraga cyogogo cyayo birahura bihabwa rugari birema uruzi runini arirwo rwaje kwitwa akagera amazi atari miyoboro migari anyanyagiye hagati butaka niyo yakoreye imiyoboro iyagomorora butaka ikayaganisha ahayo ayarunda hamwe arema biriya biyaga byose tubona karere bugesera ibyo biyaga byabonetse guha inzira amazi agandaganje butaka bwaje kuba igihugu cy’u bugesera kuyakamya niyo yaje kubyara ibiyaga birimo mugesera sake cyohoha rweru birira mirayi n’ibindi nuko ahangamo igihugu gikomeye kandi kinini acyita izina risanisha n’irye acyita u bugesera izina kanyabugesera yashyikirijwe ugenekereje izina rishaka gusobanura kanyaburumbuke cyangwa kanyabutunzi ubwo se se gihanga yamuragaga butaka yabumuraze nk’ubutaka bwera imyaka y’amoko kandi bufite n’inka zibufumbira yamwifurije uburumbuke bw’uburyo bwose kuko kinyarwanda uburumbuke busobanuye kororoka kw’abantu amatungo kurumbuka k’umwero w’ubutaka nuko igihugu aremye agiha izina ry’u bugesera rwego kukitirirwa nk’uwagihanze ariko anakifuriza uburumbuke bw’ibihe byose kanyabugesera mugondo se muhondogo ukomokwaho n’ubwoko bw’abahondogo bakunze kwita ’’abagesera b’abahondogo’’ bagengaga ingoma y’u bugesera gihe cy’imyaka myinshi ikirangabwoko cyabo cyari inyamanza kanyabugesera mugondo akimara guhanga ingoma y’u bugesera yahise ayiha ingoma ngabe nk’ikirango cy’igihugu ariko gifatiye mateka y’ibihe bikomeye banyuzemo bakamya amazi menshi atwikiriye ubutaka amwe umugambi gukamya mazi guhangamo igihugu gituwe n’abantu babasha kubakiraho imitungo ingoma ngabe y’u bugesera yitwaga rukombamazi yaremwe nk’ikimenyetso cy’amateka atazibagirana gukamya amazi gutonesha umwe bakozi avuga muyobozi agendera cyenewabo yafashe umukwe akamugira umushoferi moto y’ikigo nderabuzima ndetse ugasanga moto ikoreshwa n’izindi service zitajyanye n’icyo yatangiwe ministeri y’ubuzima rwanda usanga moto iterura imizigo y’ibyahashywe ibijyana macuba rugo rw’uwo muyobozi yagize atiubwe ntabwo kazi usanga kumwe n’umukwe gahunda zabo buri munsi kuko niyo moto ntiba amakosa azabibazwe n’amategeko sikubwabo emmanuel ushijwa rwana nyirabuja imbere barwayi yavuze mwanya afite vugana n’itangazamakuru kandi muntu bafitanye ikibazo sikubwabo yagize nta muntu dufitanye ikibazo ugifite azansange hano kandi sinkorana n’itangazamakuru rikorana meya ampfiteho ikibazo azaze andebe kandi ndahuze ndimo gukora raporo y’akazi ku murongo telephone muhaburarw yavuganye n’umuyobozi w’ibitaro kibogora dr sarathiel avuga kibazo akizi kuko yabonye raporo ivuga myitwarire mibi y’uriya mubaruramari emmanuel kandi batazabyihanganira yagize atikuva yatangira akazi ashwana n’abayobozi b’ibigo nderabuzima titulaire kugeza yimuwe kubera imyitwarire idahwitse kunyereza umutungo w’ikigo akabeshya yaguze essance kandi abeshya gusa akarere kari kubisuzuma gashingiye kw’iyo raporo gafate umwanzuro yakomeje avuga muyobozi w’ikigo nderabuzima ruheru abaye nk’urwa kane wikomye mucungamari gusa hazabo gusuzuma bayobozi banga mucungamari kandi barabanye bihe bitandukanye ibitumvikanywehomu nama nyinshi z’abayobozi bakuru b’igihugu usanga perezida repuburika agira inama abayobozi abereka gukorera hamwe aribyo bibageza iterambere rirambye kandi ryifuzwa buri wese denis fabrice nsengumuremyi muhaburarw

content: igikorwa kwibuka kitabiriwe kandi n’abahagarariye ibihugu byabo canada n’izindi nshuti uyu muhango watangijwe n’urugendo walk to remember rwatangiriye nteko ishingamategeko canada rugera biro w’ishyirahamwe ry’abacitse kw’icumu rizwi kw’izina humura alain ntwali bagaragaje bibuka amateka jenoside yabaye rwanda bagamije gufata ingamba ibyabaye ntibizongere kuba ukundi nk’uko itangazo ambasade y’u rwanda canada ribivuga berekanye umuhango ukorwa ugamije kwibuka ariko abantu bakanatekereza uburyo gufasha abacitse icumu bagarutse nsanganyamatsiko y’uyu mwaka twigire mateka twubaka ejo hazaza bavuga genoside yakorewe abatutsi mateka y’ubu n’ejo hazaza itazibagirana mu muhango kwibuka kandi hatanzwe ibiganiro bibiri l’historique de l’impunit des crimes haineux au rwanda et les signes avant-coureurs du gnocide contre les tutsis cyatanzwe bwana richard nsanzabaganwa les mots qui tuent cyatanzwe prof philippe basabose nsanzabaganwa yerekanye ubwicanyi bwagiye buba ariko ubutegetsi ntibuhane abakoze ibyaha kwica aha yavuze uduce tunyuranye ubwoko bw’abatutsi bwagiye bwicwa yerekanye kwica byagiye bishyigikirwa n’ubutegetsi kurengera abatutsi babaga bibasiwe prof basabose yerekanye amagambo yagiye akoreshwa rwanda yagize uruhare ishyirwa bikorwa ry’ubwicanyi yakoze isesengura ry’ijambo ryavuzwe leon mugesera i kabaya yakanguriye abanyamuryango mrnd abereka umwanzi wabo umututsi n’abahutu mashyaka ataravugaga rumwe mrnd gahunda ziteganijwe zijyanye kwibuka zizagera kwezi gatanu zirimo amasengesho ikiriyo n’ibiganiro bizatangwa taliki mata abanyarwanda n’inshuti zabo bongeye guhura gitambo misa kwibuka cyabereye paruwasi mutagatifu yozefu gatineau quebec

title: intwaro z’ingenzi abanyarwanda bifashishaga guhangana n’ibyorezo by’inzara n’indwara
content: hari ibyorezo bitandukanye byagiye byibasira u rwanda birimo nk’indwara z’umuze gusogobwa byahitanye abatagira ingano iyima mutara semugeshi hari indwara y’ubushita yateye gisaka ngoma mibambwe sentabyo hari ibindi biza byaje u rwanda rwar ruhanganye n’ubukoloni hagati y’umwaka n’uwa muri bihe u rwanda rwibasiwe n’indwara z’amatungo zirimo uburenge iragara muryamo n’amashuya hateye kandi indwara z’abantu zirimo mugiga ubushita n’ibihara haza gutera inzara karundura zahitanye abatagira ingano zirimo muhatibicumuro ruyaga rumanura gakwege rwakayihura ruzagayura n’ubwo byorezo byazaga bikidegembya ndetse hakaba n’ibimara iminsi itari mike ntibyabuzaga abanyarwanda bafata ingamba kubitsinda ubutazagaruka mu murage gihanga yahaye u rwanda ihangwa ry’igihugu gasabo yahaye abazamukomokaho n’umuryango mugari w’abenegihugu umurage ukomeye ugomba kugenga imiyoborere y’igihugu n’imibereho n’imibanire y’abanyarwanda myaka amagana n’amagana azaba atakiriho imitekerereze- murage gihanga yabaga inakubiye mihango y’ubwiru yakorwaga rwego kohera ibiza bizaza gihugu mu rwanda ha mbere bagiraga amahame y’imiyoborere imibereho n’imibanire akurikira gukunda imana yaremye u rwanda n’abanyarwanda gukunda u rwanda nk’umurage ukomeye ugomba kubungabungwa gukunda gukeza umwami cyangwa se kubaha kumvira ubuyobozi kubaha kurengera ikiremwamuntu n’urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima kugendera mahame kirazira kugira utinya n’ibyo wubaha ayo mahame niyo ngenderwaho kwesa imihigo y’ibyo babaga barahize kugeraho ibihe byose muri mahame habonekagamo intwaro zikomeye zifashishwaga guhangana n’ibiza ibyorezo by’inzara n’indwara z’abantu n’amatungo izo ntwaro zarimo gukunda kuramya umwami nubwo mvugo yakoreshwaga ityo bihe ha mbere yabaga ishaka kugaragaza abanyarwanda bahawe umurage w’ihame ryo gukunda kubaha ubuyobozi bwabo ibyo bikabarinda amakimbirane kurwanira ubuyobozi kubangamira gahunda leta iyo ikaba ariyo nkomoko-muzi kumvira abayobozi kw’abanyarwanda nayo mpamvu gihe cy’amatora kubashyiraho biba bimeze nk’ubukwe yandi mahanga amatora akaba intambara zihitana benshi kumvira ubuyobozi kw’abanyarwanda kwababereye intwaro idasaza yabafashije guhangana n’ibyorezo bikaze byabaga byarazengereje igihugu iyo ubuyobozi bwafatanga ingamba kurwanya kwagiriza byorezo abaturage bazakiranaga yombi bikanaborohera kuzishyira bikorwa kuko zabaga zatanzwe n’ubuyobozi bakunda kugira kirazira mu murage w’abanyarwanda batojwe kugira baziririza bibafasha kwigengesera bakora kugira ubushishozi bubatoza kudakora cyangwa se kiriya izo kirazira nizo zabafashije guhangana n’ibyorezo byadukaga gihugu kuko babibonaga nk’ibizira bigomba kwirindwa bakabirwanya bivuye inyuma

title: ubwoko bw’imisatsi abagore bashyiraho mugihe cy’ubukonje
content: iyo mugihe cy’ubukonje usanga abantu bibagora kumenya ubwoko style bw’imisatsi bagirwa inama kuba bafite aho usanga bamwe bahitamo kuyogosha kubera akenshi gihungu cyacu mugihe cy’ubukonje n’imvura iba igwa rimwe rimwe ikaba yanakujyangira bikagiza umusatsi wawe ikindi hari abahitamo kuyireka kubera gihe cy’ubukonje ibafasha kwikingira mbeho gusa hakabamo nabayisuka kubera kwita k’umusatsi gihe cy’ubukonje bigorana mu banyarwandakazi twaganiriye banyuranye abenshi muribo twasanze bumenyi bwinshi babifiteho kuko wasangaga bibanda kubyo bakunda cyane aribyo baheraho bakora gihe kwita misatsi ariko se koko byukuri ubuhe bwoko style bw’misatsi inzobere by’imisatsi batugira inama kuba twatuga gihe bimeze gutya nkuko tubikesha urubuga harperbazarcom burya nkuko benshi mubizi bavuga ubwiza bw’umugore umusatsi niyo mpamvu inama yambere baguha aruko utangomba gukata umusatsi uwumareho ahubwo ugerageza ukagira umusatsi uringaniye ndavuga nko munsi y’amatama kuburyo utagera hasi cyane ukore mugongo uburyo imisatsi ikatwa biratandukanye kuko ushobora guhita style ikubereye bitewe wowe ubushaka uburyo bwambere wakatamo umusatsi n’ukuwukata ukagera matama neza kandi hose ukaba ureshya ubona bidasumbana uburyo kabiri nukuwukata ariko ukawusumbanya buryo butagaragara kuko biba byiza kubikora nkuko ariko ugasokoza twist buryo bitagaragara usumbana uburyo gatatu guhera iburyo ukaba mugufi hanyuma ukata ujya ibumoso ukawugira muremure uburyo gatandatu nabwita coupe ariko noneho ntago umusatsi bawumaraho mpande ahubgo basigaho mwinshi gusa utamanutse ufate title: rusizi ababyeyi batewe inkeke n’imyambarire y’abanyeshuri b’abakobwa
content: ikibazo cy’abanyeshuri biga bigo bibacumbikira badodesherezwa imyambaro y’ishuri ikwiye n’ababyeyi nyamara bagera hirya bakayigabanyisha igasigara utuntu bita udukojeje isoni’ title: museveni yijeje gukemura ibibazo yagaragarijwe n’u rwanda umunsi coronavirus yavuye nzira
content: hashize imyaka itatu u rwanda uganda bidacana uwaka nyuma y’aho abaturage barwo bahohotewe n’inzego gisirikare uganda kugeza bamwe babura ubuzima abandi bakahakura ubumuga bw’iteka usibye ihohotera rikorerwa abanyarwanda uganda u rwanda rushinja uganda gushyigikira imitwe igamije guhungabanya umutekano warwo irimo rnc fdlr fln rud-urunana u rwanda rwasabye angola repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo kuba abahuza kibazo kuko inzira y’ibiganiro isanzwe imaze igihe idatanga umusaruro mu kiganiro yagiranye televiziyo nbs museveni yatangaje akiri biganiro n’abahuza rugendo ruganisha kubona igisubizo kirambye cy’ikibazo ati turavugana tuvugana guverinoma angola rdc twagombaga kugira indi nama ariko coronavirus irabyitambika iyo yagombaga kuba inama nyuma mu gihe coronavirus irangiye tuzasubukura yakomeje avuga gushaka gukemura ikibazo nohereje ambasaderi adonia ayebare bizakemuka uyu ambasaderi adonia ayebare yakiriwe village urugwiro mugoroba cyumweru tariki ukuboza yahuye perezida kagame amushyikiriza ubutumwa museveni nyuma yaho perezida kagame yavuze ntumwa i kigali bikorwa bimaze igihe bigamije gushaka umuti w’ibibazo ariko nyuma y’ibiganiro ikiba ingenzi ishyirwa bikorwa ry’imyanzuro yabyo ati kuvuga haje intumwa icyizere cyabonetse ntabwo nibwira nabivuga njye navuga indi ntambwe ikomeje guterwa buryo gushakisha icyatuma ikibazo aricyo cyose cyaba gihari gishobora gukemuka kandi nyine biva bantu kuvugana kuganira museveni yakomeje avuga yizeye neza nyuma y’icyorezo coronavirus ibibazo bizakemuka kuko igihugu cye kidafitanye ibibazo n’ikindi aricyo cyose yewe n’u rwanda ati ndabyizeye kuko twe kibazo kimwe dufitanye n’u rwanda cyangwa ikindi gihugu afurika imvugo nk’izi museveni si igitangaza kuko si ubwa mbere avuze buryo butanga icyizere gukemura ikibazo ariko ibikorwa bikagaragaza ibindi nko butumwa yashyize twitter ukuboza yagize vuba impande zombi zigiye gufata imyanzuro ihamye guhosha umwuka mubi ndabizeza uganda izakora isabwa gushyira buryo umubano mwiza w’ibihugu byombi gusa minsi ishize coronavirus yakazaga umurego abanyarwanda bashyizwe hamwe n’inzego z’ubuyobozi uganda zibajugunya mipaka itemewe rwanda turere twa burera gicumbi ntara y’amajyaruguru zibashinja gukwirakwiza coronavirus uganda imitwe igamije guhungabanya umutekano w’u rwanda irimo rnc fdlr rud-urunana nayo ntiyigeze ihagarika gukorera uganda yakomeje guhabwa icyicaro buryo bweruye n’ikimenyetso cyerekana uganda guca ukubiri nabo mu uganda yasabwaga n’u rwanda kandi harimo kohereza abantu baruhungabanyiriza umutekano uganda barimo n’abakomeje kugira uruhare bikorwa rnc gihugu ni icyemezo cyagombaga gushyirwa bikorwa nyuma y’uko impande zombi zari zimaze gusinya amasezerano agena uburyo guhererekanya abanyabyaha hari amakuru bashoboraga koherezwa ikubitiro barimo sulah nuwamanya wakabiligi prossy bonabaana bakorana cmi rnc icengezamatwara ryibasira u rwanda binyuze muryango bashinze self-worth initiative ni ibikorwa u rwanda rwakomeje kwamaganira kure gusa rundi ruhande bivugwa bashobora guhungishwa bakajyanwa bindi bihugu umusesenguzi politiki n’umwanditsi gatete thierry aherutse kubwira igihe uganda idateze kureka gufasha rnc n’indi mitwe kuko ubwabyo byayibera ikibazo gikomeye bitewe n’ubufasha imaze kuyiha atanga urugero rw’uburyo fldr yakirijwe yombi rdc u rwanda rwashaka gusaba congo kuyitsinsura ikinangira nyuma abarwanyi bayo batangiye gufata ngufu kwica urubozo abanye-congo ati na rnc ubona hariya ukuntu uganda yayifashe neza iziko guhima u rwanda uganda iramutse yumvikanye n’u rwanda ntabwo rnc uganda yayikira kandi ariyo yayizaniye umutego mubi ushibukana nyirawo kwirahuriraho amakara wowe atwika biragoye uganda yakwitandukanya bariya bantu ibi byose bituma abantu bakwiye gutegereza bakazabonesha amaso koko ibibazo bikemutse kugira icyizere gishingiye mvugo museveni gishobora kuraza amasinde

title: gasaboabarimu babiri batawe yombi bazira gukubita abanyeshuri umwe bikamuviramo gucika ururimi
content: abarimu babiri bigisha kigo cy’ishuri cyuga giherereye murenge jali akarere gasabo batawe yombi bazira gukubita abanyeshuri babiri bigishaga umwe bikamuviramo gucika ururimi rukadodwa abo barimu mukaremera christine ufite imyaka niyonshuti theoneste ufite imyaka aba barimu bombi bigishaga kigo cy’amashuri cyuga giherereye karere gasabo murenge jali uyu mukaremera christine niwe tariki nzeri yakubise umwana w’umukobwa ufite imyaka wiga mwaka gatanu w’amashuri abanza bikamuviramo gucika ururimi ni gihe uwitwa niyonshuti theoneste tariki nzeri wigisha kigo cy’ishuri yakubise umuyeshuri w’imyaka bikamuviramo gukomereka jisho umuvugizi polisi mujyi kigali chief inspector of police cip marie gorette umutesi avuga uriya mwarimukazi mugenzi bakubise abana bikabaviramo gukomereka cyane yagize uriya mukaremera yakubise umwana urushyi mutwe agiye kumukubita urwa kabiri umwana ashaka kwihisha munsi y’intebe hariho isahane ajyanamo impamba ayikubitaho ururimi kuko yagendaga arira yasamye bituma rukomereka niyonshuti yakubise umwana igipfunsi jisho cip marie gorette umutesi yaboneyeho gusaba abarimu ndetse n’abandi bafite inshingano kurera kwirinda guhana abana bikabije kuko binyuranyije n’amategeko arengera umwana yagize gukubita cyangwa guha umwana ibihano bikabije ntabwo byemewe yaba abarimu mashuri cyangwa abandi barezi turabasaba kwirinda gukubita cyangwa guhana abana bikabije yakomeje avuga uretse kuba bariya bana barakubiswe bikabaviramo gukomereka hari bamwe barezi cyangwa ababyeyi usanga baha abana ibihano bibabaza umubiri cyangwa bagakoreshwa imirimo ivunanye idahwanye n’imyaka ibintu biba binyuranyije n’amategeko arengera uburenganzira bw’umwana cip umutesi akomeza avuga ibyakozwe bariya barimu icyaha gihanwa n’amategeko kuko bakubise bakanakomeretsa amakuru y’ibyakozwe n’aba barimu yatanzwe n’abaturage polisi yakurikiranaga bibazo ubuyobozi bw’ishuri bigishagaho nabwo bwemeje makuru kuri barimu bombi bafashwe bashyikirizwa urwego rw’ubugenzacyaha rib kugira bakurikiranwe cyaha bacyekwaho ingingo gitabo gishyiraho ibyaha n’ibihano byabyo iteganya umuntu wese abishaka ukomeretsa umukubita cyangwa umusagarira buryo kiboko bubabaje akoze icyaha iyo icyaha cyakorewe umwana umubyeyi bashyingiranywe cyangwa umuntu udashoboye kwitabara kubera imiterere mubiri cyangwa bwenge ahanishwa igifungo kirenze imyaka itanu ariko kitarenze imyaka umunani n’ihazabu y’amafaranga y’u rwanda atari munsi miliyoni frw ariko atarenga miliyoni ebyiri frw iyo gukubita cyangwa gukomeretsa byateye indwara cyangwa kudashobora kugira umuntu yikorera buryo budahoraho igihano kiba igifungo kitari munsi y’imyaka icumi ariko kitarenze imyaka cumi n’itanu n’ihazabu y’amafaranga y’u rwanda atari munsi miliyoni eshatu frw ariko atarenze miliyoni eshanu frw chief editormuhaburarw

title: bugesera nyuma y’inzara yaharanzwe karahahira utundi turere
content: mu myaka yashize cyane cyane umwaka w’ akarere bugesera kagaragayemo ikibazo cy’amapfa akabije hari abantu bicwaga n’inzara abandi bagasuhukamuri gihe uhatembereye ushobora kugira amateka cyangwa se amakabyankuru y’abantu abenshi baturage hari bahatuye nibo bivugira kibazo cy’inzara kihaherutseniyonzima joseph w’imyaka utuye murenge nyamata akagari maranyundo amaze imyaka aka karere avuga inzara yatangiye kugaragara bugesera mpera y’ ariko ikaza gukaza umurego mwaka w’ avuga gihe ibintu byose byari byarabuze biryo mvaruganda kugeza bijumba bihingiragaagira umva ibijumba ibijumba gihe inaha byaribwaga n’umuntu ufite imodoka ndakubwiza ukuri mukene wapfaga kubyigondera niyonzima yongeraho impamvu yateraga byose izuba ryari ryaracanye buryo batirirwaga bahinga n’uwahinganga ntiyeze avuga igihe ahantu hapfaga kwera ibijumba hari bishanga kandi byajyaga kubageraho byahenze yongeraho mwaka w’ abantu bishwe n’inzara buryo bukabije duce twa gashora ngenda gahembe maranyundo abandi barasuhuka ati gihe abagabo benshi barahungaga kubera kubura bagaburira imiryango abagore bakishyira migozi kubera kubura bagaburira abana mukanzaramba feresita umugore w’imyaka y’amavuko atuye murenge mayange avuga ikintu cyaje kubarokora bugesera haje imishinga n’imwe igatangira kubaha imfashanyo z’ibiribwaagira muri gihe tutarabona imfashanyo amahirwe yasekeraga yabonaga rukacarara icyo gihe twayitaga shira umuteto kuko mbere wasangaga hari abantu batarya umutsima w’amasaka gusa abatuye aka gace bavuga ibintu bisa n’ibyasubiye buryo kuko imyaka irera abantu bakabona ibiryo bavuga ufite inoti y’igihumbi urya amanywa n’ijoro nyirabitanga jolie utuye bugesera avuga nzara ikiharangwa aka karere gahagaze neza isoko ibintu biraboneka ibiboneka kurusha ibindi harimo imboga ibishyimbo imyumbati inanasi ibigori n’ibindi ugeze isoko nyamata gice gicururizwamo imboga abacuruzi bazo nabo bemeza imboga ziboneka bwinshi mukarwema annonciata umucuruzi soko nyamata umaze imyaka igera acuruza avuga ibicuruzwa byabonetse nyuma y’aho mbere gucuruza byasaga n’ibigoranye kubera baburaga barangurira agira ibintu biriho ikibigaragaza inyanya intoryi n’izindi kandi urabona hano isoko abacuruza imboga babaye benshi kandi n’abo tundi turere basigaye baza kurangura hano aganira kigalitodaycom rwagaju louis uyobora akarere bugesera avuga icyatumye inzara igabanuka aka karere leta yafashe ingamba gutera ibiti n’amashyamba hirya hino kariya gace avuga iterwa ry’ibiti ryatumye imvura itangira kugwa n’imyaka ikaboneraho gutangira kwera ati ubu hari ibicuruzwa abacuruzi b’ i kigali baza kurangura inaha ndetse nubu dufitanye ubuhahirane n’intara kirundo gihugu cy’u burundi yongeraho byose babigezeho bakangurira abaturage gukora cyane guhinga kuzigama gukora imirimo itegamiye buhinzi gusa muri ako karere hari igihe cyageze bitoroshye kubona n’igiti kubera izuba ryari ryarahibasiye umuntu yashoboraga gusanga amatungo yapfiriye nzira kubera kubura ubwatsi n’amazi kuko hendaga kuba ubutayu egide kayiranga

title: abakobwa majyepfo afurika babonye itike kwitabira miss career africa izasorezwa rwanda
content: abakobwa batoranyijwe barimo lerato moeko prudence maloka gift wezzie somakwabe nelisiwe ntuli mpho phasa afurika y’epfo jessica mundie uiras ester shifotoka namibia victoria rutendo maphosa natasha dlamini nothabo ncumbe zimbabwe ubuyobozi miss career bwabandikiye bubashimira bw’imishinga ndetse bunabaha ikaze muryango w’abazitabira rushanwa rwanda mpera z’umwaka haramutse hatagize imbogamizi zizamo buti mwakoze cyane amanywa n’ijoro n’amanywa mubone amanota wari umukino utoroshye ariko mwabonye intsinzi bwakomeje buvuga n’umwe woroshye bahataniraga kugera cyiciro kibahesha itike y’i kigali ndetse banabwirwa bemerewe itike y’indege izabazana kigali mwiherero miss career africa uzaba guhera kugeza ugushyingo aba bakobwa bagaragaje ibyishimo bikomeye ndetse bavuga iby’agaciro kuba babonye itike kuzaza rwanda irushanwa miss career africa nka victoria rutendo maphosa zimbabwe yagize aya amahirwe aza rimwe buzima kuba irushanwa nk’iri nasazwe n’ibyishimo kuba bahagarariye ibihugu byabo umushinga w’uyu mukobwa witwa educate’ ufatanye n’undi witwa love me campaign international’ yagize igitekezo cyawo kuko agamije gutanga ubufasha rubyiruko nzira kubaha umurongo kumenya guhitamo buzima bwabo bakabereka ukuri ndetse bagakosora imyumvire bifitemo bijyanye n’utuzi duciriritse uyu mushinga ujyanye kwigisha abantu cyane cyane urubyiruko uburyo bategura imishinga buryo bugendanye n’igihe mu majyepfo afurika abakobwa nibo banditse basaba kwitabira irushanwa miss career africa buri wese yagaragaje umushinga nyuma hatoranywamo bavuyemo bazahagararira afurika y’amajyepfo bamwe bakobwa bihariye guhatana harimo uwitwa jessica mundie uiras namibia ugaragaza amaze kwegukana amakamba atanu atangiye kwitabira amarushanwa y’ubwiza yegukanye ikamba world miss university namibia tera queen th world miss university miss grand namibia miss heritage ndetse miss charm undi mukobwa dlamini natasha zimbabwe ni umukinnyi filime akaba n’umusizi usanzwe umuvugizi w’ishami ry’umuryango w’abibumbye ryita mpunzi unhcr yatoranyijwe nk’umukinnyi mwiza iserukiramuco pan-african ryabereye mujyi los angeles dlamini yanatoranyijwe ambasaderi global peace gihugu cye muri bakobwa kandi harimo uwitwa nelisiwe ntuli uvuga amaze gutsindira ibihembo yivuga nk’umukobwa wifashije kwinjira bushabitsi akora bijyanye gutegura ahabera ibirori anabifatanya n’akazi kwakira abantu bagana ikigo cy’itangazamakuru akorera mu myaka itanu yifuza ikigo cye yise bianca exquisite events kizaba cyatanze akazi bantu iri rushanwa rizazenguruka bice bitandukanye afurika miss career africa ifite intumbero y’imyaka byibura abakobwa bazaba bamaze kuvamo rwiyemezamirimo bato abahanga mirimo n’inganda zitandukanye afurika iri rushanwa rizajya riba hasimbukwe umwaka umwe ryongere kuba ku ikubitiro miss career africa azatorerwa rwanda birori bikomeye bizaba ugushyingo gihe rushanwa rizabera nigeria hazatorwa uzahiga abandi abe ariwe ugirwa miss career africa gihe hazatangwa andi makamba arimo miss speaker miss technology miss hospitality miss science miss talent miss art ibisabwa bashaka guhatana ukuba hagati y’imyaka - umushabitsi wasoje amashuri yisumbuye cyangwa wiga kaminuza unabarizwa afurika

title: u rwanda mwanya gatatu bihugu byiza wakoreramo ubucuruzi afurika
content: iyi raporo yakozwe bihugu bikorerwamo ubucuruzi isi yasanze u rwanda ruri mwanya afurika rukaza mwanya rwego rw’isi rukaba rwigiye imbere ho imyanya itanu ugereranyije n’umwaka washize ibyo u rwanda rubikesha kuba rwaraguye ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi kwihangira imirimo rugerageza kugeza umuriro w’amashanyarazi ahatari hake amategeko agenga imisoro nayo yaravuguruwe ndetse runorohereza abashaka inguzanyo bihangire imirimo n’ubwo ariko u rwanda rwateye intambwe igaragara korohereza abashoramari gushora imari rwanda raporo itunga agatoki bimwe bidahagaze neza gihe rwanda cyane cyane bikorwa birimo kwemerera abantu kubaka guha abaturage uburenganzira butaka bwabo gushyiraho amategeko ahamye arengera abashoramari n’ibindi aha bakwiye kwikubita agashyi bityo bikabafasha gukomeza kwitwara neza ruhando rw’amahanga minisitiri w’ubucuruzi n’inganda francois kanimba yavuze asanga mwanya u rwanda ruriho udakwiye gutuma habaho kwirara avuga hakiri byinshi gukorwa birimo kugabanya umwanya ukoreshwa n’abashaka kwandikisha ubucuruzi kugirango abantu barusheho kwihuta bikorwa by’ubucuruzi n’ibindi madamu mimi ladipo umuyobozi banki y’isi rwanda yagize avuga raporo avuga habayeho gutera imbere buryo bugaragara yagize munsi u rwanda ruri mwanya rwego rw’isi bihugu umuntu yashoramo imari ntekereza tugomba gushima ikirenge rwateye kandi twizera ruzakomeza bityo n’ibindi bihugu bikareberaho anne-marie nwemwiza

title: allain jupp avuga atahakanye jenoside ahubwo yayemeye kuba
content: jupp avuga mwaka w’ butumwa bw’inteko ishinga amategeko yasobanuye yakoresheje ijambo jenoside kuya gicurasi nama y’abagize akanama k’abaminisitiri b’u burayi yabereye i buruseli bubiligi cyishwemo abantu benshi aha bakaba bibaza bitaba ugusubiza ubwenge gihe igihe cyarenze prise de conscience tardive aha bavuga guverinoma y’u bufaransa rwanda gihe jenoside iriho itegurwa kandi ntacyo ingoro perezida w’u bufaransa bakiriye jrme bicamumpaka minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga w’u rwanda gihe jenoside ndetse jean-bosco barayagwiza umurwanashyaka w’ishyaka cdr aha bakaba bavuga icyiswe title: kamonyi umugore avuga yabonye hanze y’ itaburiya igitsina cy’ umuganga kumubyaza
content: umugore karere kamonyi aravuga ashobora kuba yarasambanyijwe n’ umuganga kigo nderabuzima nyamiyaga wamubyaje mpera z’ icyumweru gishize muganga yatawe yombi gihe iperereza rigikomeje umugore karere kamonyi aravuga ashobora kuba yarasambanyijwe n’ umuganga kigo nderabuzima nyamiyaga wamubyaje mpera z’ icyumweru gishize muganga yatawe yombi gihe iperereza rigikomeje urwego rw’ igihugu rw’ ubugenzacyaha rib rwamaze kwinjira kibazo ruri kugikoraho iperereza nk’ bitangazwa n’ umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’ umurenge nyamiyaga karere kamonyi bikekwa cyaha cyabereye umugabo w’ mugore avuga tariki ugushyingo aribwo umugore yagiye kigo nderabuzima kubyara bagezeyo saa tatu z’ umugoroba umuganga yakira umugore akomeza kumwitaho bigeze saa cyenda z’ ijoro nibwo mugore yasohotse cyumba cy’ ababyeyi materinite avuga umuganga warimo amubyaza ashobora kuba yamusambanyije jean de dieu kubwimana umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’ umusigire murenge nyamiyaga avuga kibazo kiri gukurikiranwa n’ inzego z’ ubutabera kandi bizeye ukuri kuzamenyekana ati umwana amaze kuvuka nibwo umubyeyi yagaragaje umuganga yamufashe ngufu umuganga twaraganiriye aravuga mahano sinayakora kuko twe twe ntabumenyi dufite twasabye urwego rw’ igihugu rw’ ubugenzacyaha rib gukora iperereza ngubu nibo bafite muganga uyu muganga n’ mubyeyi boherejwe bitaro remera rukoma bapimwe harebwe koko mugore yarasambanyijwe hatekerejwe ikizava isuzuma muganga umuyobozi w’ ikigo nderabuzima nyamiyaga tuyiringire emmanuel yabwiye ibicu tv muganga asanzwe yitwara neza yongeraho yaganiriye nyiri ubwite uvuga yasambanyijwe ndetse akanaganira n’ abari ivuriro gihe agira umurwayi yatubwiye yabonye igitsina cy’ umuganga kiri hanze y’ itaburiya ariko yambaye imyenda cyaciye bipesu tumubajije yabibonye yavuze yegutse amutunguye akabibona gutyo anatubwira atazi yarasambanyijwe cyangwa atarasambanyijwe umuvugizi rib marie michelle umuhoza yatangarije ukwezi muganga yatawe yombi ndetse afungiye sitasiyo runda karere kamonyi yagize ayo makuru twarayamenye dosiye yarafunguwe iperereza ririho rirakorwa muganga arafunze afungiye rib sitasiyo runda karere kamonyi umuhoza avuga rib isaba abanyarwanda abantu kwirinda bakunze gukora amakosa ndetse bakumvako umukobwa azabona ufite ibintu byinshi ariho azahera agukunda kandi kurundi ruhande ntibibuke hari byiza wamenyereje mukobwa bishobora gushira ndetse ugasanga rukundo waguraga urarubuze mwaruguraga akajya kurugurisha ahandi hari amafaranga gufata umukunzi wawe nk’ikigirwamana ho kumpande zombie kuba ukunda umuntu ntibivuze agomba kuza mbere y’akazi content: ubusanzwe mikino ihuza amakipe rwanda burundi rdc yitabirwa n’amakipe y’abakuru ariko ishyirahamwe ry’umukino basketball rwanda ferwaba ryasabye abategura mikino u rwanda rwahagararirwa n’ikipe y’igihugu y’abatarengeje imyaka kugira bizayifashe kwitegura imikino y’akarere gatanu izabera rwanda tariki kugeza umunyamabanga mukuru ferwaba richard mutabazi avuga bagambiriye abakinnyi b’u rwanda bakiri batoya bagenda bagakina n’abandi bakuze kandi babarusha inararibonye kugira bazagere igihe cy’imikino y’akarere gatanu baramaze kumenyera guhangana n’amakipe akomeye ikipe y’u rwanda y’abahungu batarengeje imyaka isanzwe yitabira amarushanwa mpuzamahanga kuko yitabiriye imikino y’igikombe afurika cyabereye rwanda ariko rwego rw’abakobwa batarengeje imyaka bizaba nshuro mbere richard mutabazi avuga kuba ubwa mbere u rwanda rugiye kwitabira imikino mpuzamaganga rwego rw’abakobwa batarengeje imyaka bizatuma abakinnyi b’u rwanda batinyuka ndetse binafashe ferwaba kumenya izahera itegura abakinnyi bazitwara neza myaka imbere yabisobanuye magambo bashobora kuzatsindirwayo ariko hari byinshi bazunguka bizadufasha gusuzuma urwego rw’imikinire bazaba bariho kugira bizadufashe kumenya tuzahera dutegura abakinnyi bazitwara neza minsi imbere amakipe yombi amaze iminsi akorera imyitozo petit stade i remera gusa ikipe y’abahungu igiye i bujumbura nyuma kubura umwe bakinnyi kuzayifasha gikombe cy’akarere gatanu rutare jonathan witabye imana gatandatu ushize azize urupfu rutunguranye yiteguraga gusanga bagenzi myitozo i kigali avuye leta zunze ubumwe amerika yigaga nubwo bahombye inararibonye jonathan rutare hagati kipe itegereje vuba abandi bakinnyi bakina hanze y’u rwanda bazaza kubafasha mikino y’akarere gatanu aribo adronis rwabigwi ngenzi eric manzi danny karenzi ronald shyaka scifon twagirayezu patrice ishimwe norbert imikino y’akarere gatanu izatangira tariki izitabirwa n’u rwanda uganda kenya tanzania ethiopia sudan ethiopia theoneste nisingizwe

title: allain jupp avuga atahakanye jenoside ahubwo yayemeye kuba
content: jupp avuga mwaka w’ butumwa bw’inteko ishinga amategeko yasobanuye yakoresheje ijambo jenoside kuya gicurasi nama y’abagize akanama k’abaminisitiri b’u burayi yabereye i buruseli bubiligi ikinyamakuru survie dukesha nkuru gitangaza alain jupp yaba yaratangaje nyuma y’uko uwari umunyamabanga mukuru loni gihe boutros boutros ghali yatangaje ibiri kuba rwanda atari ubwicanyi busanzwe ahubwo jenoside iki kinyamakuru gikomeza gitangaza minisitiri jupp yaba yaratangaje gihe jenoside rwanda igeze hagati ikorwa kandi n’igihe cyari gishize kikaba cyari gihe gikomeye cyane kuko aricyo cyishwemo abantu benshi aha bakaba bibaza bitaba ugusubiza ubwenge gihe igihe cyarenze prise de conscience tardive aha bavuga guverinoma y’u bufaransa rwanda gihe jenoside iriho itegurwa kandi ntacyo yakoze ibe yahagarika ubwicanyi bwatangiye tariki mata survie ikomeza ivuga gihe jenoside yakorerwaga abatutsi iriho kuba itariki mata jupp minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga w’u bufaransa hamwe l’lyse ingoro perezida w’u bufaransa bakiriye jrme bicamumpaka minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga w’u rwanda gihe jenoside ndetse jean-bosco barayagwiza umurwanashyaka w’ishyaka cdr aha bakaba bavuga icyiswe opration turquoise yazanywe n’ingabo z’abafaransa itariki kamena yafashije abari bamaze gukora jenoside guhungira cyahoze cyitwa zare akaba repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo muri babashije guhungishwa n’abafaransa havugwamo thodore sindikubwabo umukuru w’u rwanda gihe jenoside ndetse jrme bicamumpaka umaze amezi abiri yakiriwe jupp mu gihe cy’uruzinduko mbere perezida kagame yagiriye bufaransa kwezi gushize jupp yatangaje adashobora guhindura imyumvire jenoside raporo yitiriwe mucyo’ kubera izina ry’uwari umuyobozi w’iyo komisiyo mucyo jean de dieu yerekana alain jupp yagize uruhare bikorwa bitandukanye muri harimo kuba yarakoranye atizigamye guverinoma yakoraga jenoside iyo raporo kandi ivuga kuba tariki mata alain jupp yarakiriye jrme bicamumpaka jean bosco barayagwiza guverinoma y’abatabazi ikibazo gikomeye kuko umuryango mpuzamahanga warafashe icyemezo guha akato guverinoma ndetse u bubiligi leta zunze ubumwe z’amerika bakaba bamaze kubigaragaza bima viza bagabo inkuru dukesha igihecom

title: filimi niko zubakwa ishingiye mibereho y’abanyarwanda gihe
content: doruwase atangaza filimi yayanditse ashingiye buryo abantu babanyeho bihe bimwe bimwe kubaho ukize cyangwa ukenye akaba yaringeye gushingira rubyiruko rw’iki gihe hari abashobora guhura n’ubuzima bubasaba kubaho nabi bitewe kubura ababyeyi cyangwa gutandukana kwabo ariko buri umwe akagira abyitwaramo aganira kigali today yatangaje ikindi cyamuteye kwandika filimi nyuma y’uko umuntu yihanganira byinshi bimugeragegeza ahura rugo rwe bigira ingaruka nziza muryango akaba nako zubakwa filimi nikozubakwa ivuga mibereho y’ingo ebyiri zirimo abagabo gasana francois baca inyuma abagore bakajya busambanyi bimwe bakunze kwita ubuhehesi francois agatera inda umwana w’umukobwa nyuma gasana yakoze bigakurikirana abana nickson sabrine muri filime niko zubakwa hagaragaramo abahanzi bamenyerewe muzika patrick nyamitari theo bakunze kwita bosebabireba iyi filimi biteganywa izagera isoko kuwa mbere tariki abakunzi sinema nyarwanda bagashobora kwihera amaso filimi yakozwe n’itsinda back to jesus film production kigali today

content: ni igikorwa cyabaye gatatu nzira zafungurwaga mugaragaro zihabwa n’amanota bitewe n’imiterere yazo igaragaza ibyiza ndangamateka nyaburanga cyitabiriwe n’abayobozi barimo minisitiri w’abami i mwima hatabarijwe umwami mutara iii rudahigwa tariki nyakanga umwami kigeli v watabarijwe mutarama ndetse n’umwamikazi gicanda rosalie wahatabarijwe tariki mata inzira kabiri yitwa big view’ title: kamonyiibiza abahinzi b’umuceri gihombo gikomeye hegitari mukunguri zaratwawe
content: abahinzi b’umuceri kibaya mukunguri gihuza akarere kamonyi ruhango barataka igihombo gikomeye batewe n’ibiza by’imvura iheruka aho bateganyaga gusarura toni kubona bizagorana ibikorwa remezo content: afungura imurikagurisha minisitiri w’ubucuruzi n’inganda francois kanimba yashimiye urugaga rw’abikorera ntara y’amajyaruguru n’ubuyobozi bw’uturere bwabigizemo uruhare kugira ishobore gutangira yavuze imurika gurisha rigaragaza abanyarwanda bageze iterambere kuko rituma abantu bashobora kungurana ibitekerezo rikaba n’ishuri benshi baboneramo batari bazi bagashobora kwiga kubikora abitabiriye imurikagurisha bavuga bishimiye umwanya bahawe kugaragaza bakora ndetse bagashobora kubona ibyahandi bashobora kwigiraho bakora ibintu byiza kanimba yasobanuye leta gushyira ingufu kongerera ubushobozi ibigo bito n’ibiciriritse hihutishwa serivise bacyenera ikoranabuhanga kubafasha gushaka isoko ry’umusaruro bakora abaturage hamwe n’abikorera ntara y’amajyaruguru baratangaza aribwo bagira imurikagurisha ryitabirwa n’abanyamahanga bavuye bihugu muryango w’afurika y’iburasirasuba eac n’abashoramari bihugu asiya repubulika iharanira demokarasi kongo abanyarwanda bakaba bagomba guhangana n’isoko rinini u rwanda rwagiye ry’umuryango w’ibihugu by’iburasirazuba eac yves hirwa akora top sai ikora ibijyanye n’ubugeni yvuze ibikorwa byabo byatunguye benshi kuko ababasura hari batari bazi yemeza kuba ibikorwa byabo bimenywa n’abantu benshi bizongera umubare w’ababagurira ubuyobozi bw’uturere bwitabiriye imurika gurisha bukaba buvuga bwasanze umwanya kumenyekanisha ibikorerwa turere iri murikagurisha riteganyijwe gusoza taliki ugushyingo cyakora hari imbogamizi imvura nyinshi ikunze kugwa ntara y’amajyaruguru ishobora kuzangiza ibicuruzwa n’ibimurikwa nkuko byagenze cyumweru yagwaga nyuma gufungura imurika gurisha sylidio sebuharara

title: ngomaumuyobozi uzajya uha umuturage inka azajya abyirengera
content: umuyobozi ministeri y’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu ushyinzwe igenamigambi rugambaegide aravuga umuyoboziuzajya uha umuturage inka azajye ayimuhaku giti cye ibiabivuze nyuma y’aho abadepite bahaye inka umusaza witwa nzabandora pascal utuye mukarere ngoma umurenge kibungo akagali cyasemakamba umuduguduwa gatoro ariko kujyeza n’ubu akaba yarabuze uwamushyikiriza yemerewe iki kibazo kigaragaye nyuma y’aho abadepite basuriye akarereka ngoma muntangiriro z’ukwezi kwakanama mugikorwa gukusanya ibyifuzo byabaturage hirya hino gihugu kubijyanye gahunda guhindura ingingo y’itegekonshinga uyu muzasa pascal yakomeje kubaza uwamushyikiriza ariko ubuyobozi bwakomeje kwitana bamwana mukubona yemerewe n’abo badepite aganira n’ikinyamakuru muhaburarw yavuze ubuyobozi bwamurangaranye kugeza n’ubu akaba atazi uburyo azayibonamo twegereye umuyobozi w’akarere ngoma w’ungirije ushinzwe iterambere n’ubukungu bwana mpezi george avuga azayihabwa kimwe n’abandi batishoboye gahunda girinka munyarwanda kandi bigira inzira binyuramo kuko akarere katagira urwuri rw’inka cyagwa se ifamu nyamara n’ubwo umuyobozi w’akarereka ngoma w’ungirije avuga y’uko inka agomba kuyihabwa kimwe n’abandi baturage batishoboye musasa avugako yayiherewe n’abadepite kandi ntabwo bigize bavuga agomba gutegereza igihe z’abatishoboye zizabonekera iby’uwo musaza pascal avuga n’ibyo n’umukozi ministeri y’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu ushinzwe igenamigambi rugamba egide ashingiraho avuga umuyobozi wese uzajya utanga inka ayihaye umuturage agomba kuyimwihera kugiti cye kuko agiye kuyitanga ntabwo yatumwe ministeriy’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu anavuga gahunda girinka munyarwanda iba ifite uburyo itegurwamo kandi ikaba mugihugu hose ntabwo ibakumuturage umwe gusa byumvikane umusaza pascal azayihabwa n’abo badepite bayimwemereye si ubwambere hirya hino gihugu humvikana bamwe bayobozi bakuru basura ahantu bakagabira amwe mumatungo umuturage y’aba amatungo maremare cyangwa amagufi bakagenda nyuma abaturage bagategereza amaso agahera mukirere by bagabo john
